/*
 * GrimAC-Inspired Server-Side AntiCheat for NeoForge 1.21.1
 * 
 * Features:
 * - Master Toggle (ENABLE / DISABLE AntiCheat system)
 * - Exclusive Developer Whitelist (UUID + Username matching for "Dev" and "honeypie_3301")
 * - Thread-Safe Concurrent Multi-Threading Support (ConcurrentHashMap)
 * - Reconnection Exploit Mitigation (60-second VL persistence cache on disconnect/relog)
 * - Teleport & Dimension Change Immunity (Fixes /tp, Ender Pearls, Portals, Chorus Fruit)
 * - Knockback, Explosion, Piston, Flowing Water & Wind Charge Velocity Grace Windows
 * - Vehicle Dismount & Riding Position Re-Synchronization
 * - Multi-Tick Packet Batching Buffer (Smooths 150-250ms high-ping latency spikes)
 * - Dynamic /tick rate, /tick freeze & /tick sprint Compensation
 * - NoSlow Check (Item usage, eating, blocking, drawing bow, crouching)
 * - Terrain-Aware Speed Allowance (Ice variants, Honey blocks, Soul Sand, Soul Speed)
 * - Elytra Boundary & Firework Speed Cap Checks
 * - Ability Spoof Validation (Detects & resets unauthorized client fly toggles)
 * - Server-Side NoFall & Fall Damage Verification
 * - Ranged Attack & Projectile Aimbot Validation
 * - Entity Box Size Geometry Awareness (Fixes false KillAura on Dragon/Warden/Boats)
 * - Rotational Snap & Aimbot Locking Detection
 * - Dynamic Server-Side Entity Attribute Calculations (Movement Speed & Attack Range)
 * - Comprehensive Mod Compatibility Bypasses (the_backwoods, Iron's Spells, Ars Nouveau, Create, etc.)
*/

	// COMPATIBILITY MODE: unlike KNOWN_COMPATIBLE_MOD_IDS above (pure documentation, unused by any
	// check), this is an active, server-wide tolerance widening. It is safe to use ModList here
	// because it answers "is this movement-altering mod installed on the server at all", which is
	// identical for every player and cannot be spoofed or selectively triggered by an individual
	// cheater, unlike a per-player ability flag. If any of these mods are present, every player
	// could plausibly use their mechanics, so widening thresholds for everyone is consistent and
	// not exploitable. Computed once at server start, not per-tick.
	private static final Set<String> MOVEMENT_ALTERING_MOD_IDS = Set.of(
		"paraglider", "ironjetpacks", "walljump", "parcool", "parkour", "combatroll", "tetra", "bettercombat",
		"irons_spellbooks", "ars_nouveau", "epicfight", "origins", "mekanism", "botania", "tconstruct",
		"artifacts", "relics", "alexscaves", "simplyswords", "createbigcannons", "create_jetpack",
		"projecte", "pneumaticcraft"
	);
	private static volatile boolean MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE = false;

	// LOGGING TOGGLES: Configure alert and logging destinations (All defaulted to false for silent enforcement)
	// NOTE: When all three are false, AntiCheat operates in silent mode: setbacks and combat cancels still trigger actively, but no messages or files are written.
	public static final boolean LOG_TO_CONSOLE = false;
	public static final boolean LOG_TO_FILE = false;
	public static final boolean LOG_TO_STAFF_CHAT = false;

	// Log Rotation Settings (5 MB max size, keeps up to 5 historical backup files)
	private static final long MAX_LOG_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
	private static final int MAX_LOG_BACKUPS = 5;

	// Async Single-Threaded Violation File Logger (Prevents Main Thread Disk I/O & Daemon Thread Allows Clean JVM Exit)
	private static final java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService LOG_EXECUTOR = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(r -> {
		Thread t = new Thread(r, "AntiCheat-Log-Worker");
		t.setDaemon(true);
		return t;
	});

	// Thread-Safe Player Anti-Cheat Tracking Data
	private static final Map<UUID, PlayerData> playerDataMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	// 60-Second Reconnection Cache (Mitigates VL reset by relogging)
	private static final Map<UUID, DisconnectRecord> recentDisconnectCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
	private static long lastCacheCleanupTime = 0;

	public AntiCheat() {
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		new AntiCheat();
	}

	@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clientLoad(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static class AntiCheatForgeBusEvents {

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
			playerDataMap.clear();
			recentDisconnectCache.clear();
			lastLogTimestamps.clear();
			MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE = MOVEMENT_ALTERING_MOD_IDS.stream()
				.anyMatch(id -> net.neoforged.fml.ModList.get().isLoaded(id));
			if (MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE) {
				System.out.println("[Backwoods AntiCheat] Movement-altering mod detected, compatibility tolerance widened for all players.");
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onServerStopping(ServerStoppingEvent event) {
			try {
				LOG_EXECUTOR.shutdown();
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
			playerDataMap.clear();
			recentDisconnectCache.clear();
			lastLogTimestamps.clear();
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onPlayerLoggedIn(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				UUID uuid = player.getUUID();
				DisconnectRecord record = recentDisconnectCache.remove(uuid);
				if (record != null && (System.currentTimeMillis() - record.timestamp < 60000)) {
					// Restore VL values from recent session
					playerDataMap.put(uuid, record.data);
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onPlayerLoggedOut(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				UUID uuid = player.getUUID();
				PlayerData data = playerDataMap.remove(uuid);
				if (data != null) {
					// Cache VL for 60 seconds to prevent reconnect exploits
					recentDisconnectCache.put(uuid, new DisconnectRecord(data, System.currentTimeMillis()));
				}
				lastLogTimestamps.keySet().removeIf(key -> key.startsWith(uuid + ":"));
			}
		}

		// --- EVENT 1: TELEPORT EXEMPTION (Fixes /tp, pearls, portals, chorus fruit, respawns) ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onEntityTeleport(EntityTeleportEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);
				if (data != null) {
					Vec3 targetPos = new Vec3(event.getTargetX(), event.getTargetY(), event.getTargetZ());
					data.lastPos = targetPos;
					data.lastValidPos = targetPos;
					data.teleportGraceTicks = 20; // 20 ticks of grace after teleporting
					data.movementVL = 0.0;
					data.flyVL = 0.0;
					data.serverFallDistance = 0.0F;
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onPlayerDimensionChange(PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);
				if (data != null) {
					data.lastPos = player.position();
					data.lastValidPos = player.position();
					data.teleportGraceTicks = 25;
					data.movementVL = 0.0;
					data.serverFallDistance = 0.0F;
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onPlayerRespawn(PlayerEvent.PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);
				if (data != null) {
					data.lastPos = player.position();
					data.lastValidPos = player.position();
					data.teleportGraceTicks = 25;
					data.movementVL = 0.0;
					data.serverFallDistance = 0.0F;
				}
			}
		}

		// --- EVENT 2: KNOCKBACK, DAMAGE, EXPLOSION & PUSH VELOCITY GRACE ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onLivingDamage(LivingDamageEvent.Post event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);
				if (data != null) {
					data.velocityGraceTicks = 35; // 1.75s grace window for knockback momentum & arcs
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onLivingKnockback(LivingKnockBackEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);
				if (data != null) {
					data.velocityGraceTicks = 40; // Extended grace window for Knockback II+ arcs
				}
			}
		}

		// --- EVENT 3: VEHICLE MOUNT / DISMOUNT RESYNC ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onEntityMount(EntityMountEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntityMounting() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);
				if (data != null) {
					data.lastPos = player.position();
					data.lastValidPos = player.position();
					data.teleportGraceTicks = 15;
				}
			}
		}

		// --- EVENT 3.5: PROJECTILE LAUNCH LOOK ANGLE CAPTURE ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onProjectileSpawn(EntityJoinLevelEvent event) {
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof Projectile projectile && projectile.getOwner() instanceof ServerPlayer shooter) {
				Vec3 look = shooter.getLookAngle();
				var persistentData = projectile.getPersistentData();
				persistentData.putDouble("LaunchLookX", look.x);
				persistentData.putDouble("LaunchLookY", look.y);
				persistentData.putDouble("LaunchLookZ", look.z);
				persistentData.putBoolean("HasLaunchAngle", true);
			}

			// Firework rocket used for elytra boosting: open a short velocity grace window so the
			// resulting acceleration isn't mistaken for an elytra speed hack.
			if (event.getEntity() instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.FireworkRocketEntity firework
				&& firework.getOwner() instanceof ServerPlayer booster) {
				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(booster);
				data.velocityGraceTicks = Math.max(data.velocityGraceTicks, 30);
			}
		}

		// --- EVENT 4: RANGED PROJECTILE AIMBOT CHECK ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onLivingIncomingDamage(LivingIncomingDamageEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLED) {
				return;
			}

			if (event.getSource().getDirectEntity() instanceof Projectile projectile && event.getSource().getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer shooter) {
				if (shooter.isCreative() || isWhitelistedUser(shooter) || hasModBypass(shooter)) {
					return;
				}

				Entity victim = event.getEntity();
				if (victim == null || victim.equals(shooter)) {
					return;
				}

				PlayerData data = getPlayerData(shooter);

				// Retrieve shooter's look vector captured at launch time
				Vec3 shooterLook;
				var persistentData = projectile.getPersistentData();
				if (persistentData.getBoolean("HasLaunchAngle")) {
					shooterLook = new Vec3(
						persistentData.getDouble("LaunchLookX"),
						persistentData.getDouble("LaunchLookY"),
						persistentData.getDouble("LaunchLookZ")
					);
				} else {
					shooterLook = shooter.getLookAngle();
				}

				Vec3 targetDir = victim.position().subtract(shooter.position()).normalize();
				double dot = shooterLook.dot(targetDir);

				// If shooter was facing away from projectile target during fire (< -0.3 dot product)
				if (dot < -0.3 && shooter.distanceToSqr(victim) > 9.0) {
					data.rangedAimbotVL += 1.5;
					if (data.rangedAimbotVL >= 3.0) {
						logViolation(shooter, "RangedAimbot", data.rangedAimbotVL, String.format("Ranged shot outside launch camera direction (Dot: %.2f)", dot));
						event.setCanceled(true);
					}
				} else {
					data.rangedAimbotVL = Math.max(0, data.rangedAimbotVL - 0.1);
				}
			}
		}

		// --- MAIN TICK CHECK (Movement, Rotation, Timer, NoSlow, Elytra, Spoof, NoFall) ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onPlayerTick(PlayerTickEvent.Post event) {
			// Master Toggle Check
			if (!ENABLED) {
				return;
			}

			if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)) {
				return;
			}

			// Exclude Spectator, Creative, or Whitelisted Developer Accounts
			if (!player.isAlive() || player.isSpectator() || player.isCreative()) {
				return;
			}

			if (isWhitelistedUser(player)) {
				return;
			}

			// --- MOD COMPATIBILITY BYPASS CHECK ---
			if (hasModBypass(player)) {
				return;
			}

			PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);

			// Decrement Grace Counters
			if (data.teleportGraceTicks > 0) {
				data.teleportGraceTicks--;
				data.lastPos = player.position();
				data.lastValidPos = player.position();
				data.serverFallDistance = 0.0F;
				return;
			}

			if (data.velocityGraceTicks > 0) {
				data.velocityGraceTicks--;
			}

			// Riptide trident launches the player at high velocity similar to an elytra/firework
			// boost. There is no dedicated "riptide activated" event on the bus, so this is detected
			// after the fact: only grant grace when the player is wet, holding an enchanted trident,
			// AND actually shows a sudden velocity spike this tick. Requiring the spike (not just
			// held-item + wet) prevents a player from standing in rain holding a trident to farm a
			// permanent, continuously-renewing speed-hack grace window.
			net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack mainHandItem = player.getMainHandItem();
			double preGraceSpeedSq = player.getDeltaMovement().lengthSqr();
			if (mainHandItem.is(net.minecraft.world.item.Items.TRIDENT)
				&& mainHandItem.getEnchantments().keySet().stream().anyMatch(h -> h.is(Enchantments.RIPTIDE))
				&& (player.isInWater() || player.level().isRainingAt(player.blockPosition()))
				&& preGraceSpeedSq > 2.25) { // ~1.5 blocks/tick, well above passive swim/walk speed
				data.velocityGraceTicks = Math.max(data.velocityGraceTicks, 25);
			}

			// Resync if riding vehicle
			if (player.isPassenger()) {
				data.lastPos = player.position();
				data.lastValidPos = player.position();
				data.serverFallDistance = 0.0F;
				return;
			}

			long now = System.currentTimeMillis();

			// Throttled cleanup for recentDisconnectCache (runs once per 5 seconds server-wide instead of per player-tick)
			if (now - lastCacheCleanupTime > 5000) {
				lastCacheCleanupTime = now;
				if (!recentDisconnectCache.isEmpty()) {
					recentDisconnectCache.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> (now - entry.getValue().timestamp) > 60000);
				}
			}

			// --- CHECK 1: ABILITY SPOOF VALIDATION (Flight Hack Detection) ---
			boolean isMayFlyAllowed = player.gameMode.getGameModeForPlayer() == GameType.CREATIVE 
				|| player.gameMode.getGameModeForPlayer() == GameType.SPECTATOR 
				|| player.hasEffect(MobEffects.LEVITATION)
				|| hasModBypass(player);

			if (!isMayFlyAllowed && (player.getAbilities().mayfly || player.getAbilities().flying)) {
				data.abilitySpoofVL += 2.0;
				if (data.abilitySpoofVL >= 4.0) {
					logViolation(player, "AbilitySpoof", data.abilitySpoofVL, "Unauthorized fly ability packet detected");
					// Reset flight status server-side
					player.getAbilities().mayfly = false;
					player.getAbilities().flying = false;
					player.onUpdateAbilities();
					data.abilitySpoofVL = 2.0;
				}
			} else {
				data.abilitySpoofVL = Math.max(0, data.abilitySpoofVL - 0.1);
			}

			// --- CHECK 2: DYNAMIC /tick rate, /tick freeze & /tick sprint TIMER CHECK ---
			double currentServerTickRate = 20.0;
			boolean isFrozen = false;
			boolean isSprinting = false;

			if (player.getServer() != null) {
				var tickRateManager = player.getServer().tickRateManager();
				currentServerTickRate = tickRateManager.tickrate();
				isFrozen = tickRateManager.isFrozen();
				isSprinting = tickRateManager.isSprinting();
			}

			// Suspend Timer check during /tick freeze and /tick sprint loops
			if (!isFrozen && !isSprinting && currentServerTickRate > 1.0) {
				// Primitive long[] ring buffer instead of Deque<Long>: avoids boxing 20 Long objects
				// per player on every single tick, which is a real, constant allocation cost that a
				// deque of boxed Longs incurs whether or not the timer check ever fires a violation.
				data.tickTimestamps[data.tickTimestampHead] = now;
				data.tickTimestampHead = (data.tickTimestampHead + 1) % PlayerData.TICK_WINDOW;
				if (data.tickTimestampCount < PlayerData.TICK_WINDOW) {
					data.tickTimestampCount++;
				}
				if (data.tickTimestampCount >= PlayerData.TICK_WINDOW) {
					long oldest = data.tickTimestamps[data.tickTimestampHead]; // slot about to be overwritten next is the oldest
					long elapsed = now - oldest;
					double expectedMs = (20.0 / currentServerTickRate) * 1000.0;
					double minimumThresholdMs = expectedMs * 0.60; // 40% packet batching margin for 150-250ms high ping

					if (elapsed < minimumThresholdMs && !player.isPassenger()) {
						data.timerVL += 1.5;
						if (data.timerVL > 10.0) {
							logViolation(player, "Timer", data.timerVL, String.format("Packets arriving too fast (%dms / expected %.0fms)", elapsed, expectedMs));
							data.timerVL = 5.0;
						}
					} else {
						data.timerVL = Math.max(0, data.timerVL - 0.1);
					}
				}
			}

			// --- CHECK 3: ROTATION SNAP & PITCH CLAMP CHECK ---
			float currentYaw = player.getYRot();
			float currentPitch = player.getXRot();

			// Impossible Pitch Check
			if (Math.abs(currentPitch) > 90.5F) {
				data.rotationVL += 2.0;
				logViolation(player, "InvalidPitch", data.rotationVL, "Pitch out of bounds: " + currentPitch);
				player.setXRot(Math.max(-90.0F, Math.min(90.0F, currentPitch)));
			}

			// Rotational Snap / Aimbot Lock Check
			float yawDelta = Math.abs(currentYaw - data.lastYaw);
			if (yawDelta > 180.0F) {
				yawDelta = 360.0F - yawDelta;
			}
			float pitchDelta = Math.abs(currentPitch - data.lastPitch);

			// Freecam mods can cause the reported look angle to jump when a player snaps their real
			// camera back before attacking, so this threshold is intentionally lenient (not a true
			// detection of freecam, just a tolerance so it doesn't false-flag on the snap-back).
			if (yawDelta > 120.0F && pitchDelta > 45.0F && !player.isPassenger()) {
				data.rotationSnapVL += 1.0;
				if (data.rotationSnapVL >= 4.0) {
					logViolation(player, "RotationSnap", data.rotationSnapVL, String.format("Instant camera snap (Yaw Delta: %.1f, Pitch Delta: %.1f)", yawDelta, pitchDelta));
					data.rotationSnapVL = 2.0;
				}
			} else {
				data.rotationSnapVL = Math.max(0, data.rotationSnapVL - 0.1);
			}

			// --- CHECK 4: MOVEMENT PHYSICS, TERRAIN & NOSLOW PREDICTION ---
			Vec3 currentPos = player.position();
			double dx = currentPos.x - data.lastPos.x;
			double dy = currentPos.y - data.lastPos.y;
			double dz = currentPos.z - data.lastPos.z;
			double horizontalDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);

			// GENERIC MODDED-ABILITY SPIKE GRACE: many spell/dash/jetpack/launcher mods (Iron's
			// Spellbooks, Ars Nouveau, Epic Fight, Origins, Mekanism, Botania, Tinkers' Slime Sling,
			// Artifacts, Relics, cannons, ProjectE, PneumaticCraft, etc) move the player via direct
			// setDeltaMovement calls with no damage and no vanilla knockback/teleport event, so there
			// is nothing to hook per-mod. Instead of listing every mod's classes individually (a list
			// that can never be complete), detect the PATTERN: a single-tick velocity spike far beyond
			// anything vanilla movement produces. If compat mode is on (a movement-altering mod is
			// present) and no explanation exists yet (no damage grace already open), treat it as a
			// probable ability launch and open a short, RATE-LIMITED grace window rather than
			// flagging immediately. The 2-second cooldown between grants prevents this from being
			// abused as a renewable speed-hack window, a real hack sustained over many ticks will
			// still exceed one 15-tick grace and get caught by the checks below once it expires.
			if (MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE && data.velocityGraceTicks == 0) {
				double spikeTotal = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
				long nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
				if (spikeTotal > 4.0 && (nowMs - data.lastSpikeGraceGrantTime) > 2000) {
					data.velocityGraceTicks = 15;
					data.lastSpikeGraceGrantTime = nowMs;
				}
			}

			boolean isFlyingAllowed = player.getAbilities().flying || player.isFallFlying() || player.isPassenger() || player.isSpectator() || player.hasEffect(MobEffects.LEVITATION);
			boolean isInLiquid = player.isInWater() || player.isInLava() || player.level().getBlockState(player.blockPosition()).is(Blocks.POWDER_SNOW);
			// Crawling has its own vanilla speed profile distinct from standing/sneaking; treat it
			// like liquid for the purposes of skipping the standard speed cap so legitimate crawling
			// through 1-block gaps doesn't false-flag as NoSlow/Speed.
			boolean isCrawling = player.getPose() == net.minecraft.world.entity.Pose.SWIMMING && !player.isInWater() && !player.isInLava();

			// --- TERRAIN-AWARE FRICTION & BLOCK SPEED ALLOWANCE ---
			BlockPos feetPos = player.blockPosition();
			BlockPos groundPos = feetPos.below();
			BlockState feetState = player.level().getBlockState(feetPos);
			BlockState groundState = player.level().getBlockState(groundPos);

			double terrainMultiplier = 1.0;
			boolean isOnIce = groundState.getBlock() instanceof IceBlock 
				|| groundState.is(Blocks.PACKED_ICE) 
				|| groundState.is(Blocks.BLUE_ICE);

			if (isOnIce) {
				terrainMultiplier *= 1.85; // Ice sliding friction allowance
			} else if (groundState.is(Blocks.HONEY_BLOCK) || feetState.is(Blocks.HONEY_BLOCK)) {
				terrainMultiplier *= 0.55; // Honey block slowdown
			} else if (groundState.is(Blocks.SOUL_SAND) || groundState.is(Blocks.SOUL_SOIL)) {
				if (player.getEffect(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SPEED) == null) {
					terrainMultiplier *= 0.65; // Soul sand slowdown without soul speed / speed effect
				}
			}

			// Piston push or flowing water allowance
			boolean isInFlowingWaterOrPiston = feetState.is(Blocks.WATER) || feetState.is(Blocks.PISTON) || feetState.is(Blocks.MOVING_PISTON);
			if (isInFlowingWaterOrPiston) {
				terrainMultiplier *= 1.75;
			}

			// --- NOSLOW CHECK (Item Usage & Sneaking) ---
			boolean isUsingItem = player.isUsingItem();
			boolean isCrouching = player.isCrouching();

			double noSlowMaxMultiplier = 1.0;
			if (isUsingItem) {
				noSlowMaxMultiplier = 0.35; // Item usage (eating, blocking, drawing bow) slows to 35% speed
			} else if (isCrouching) {
				noSlowMaxMultiplier = MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE ? 0.70 : 0.45; // Sliding/parkour mods can move fast while crouched
			}

			double baseAttrSpeed = player.getAttributeValue(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED);
			double maxAllowedSpeed = baseAttrSpeed * 2.8 * terrainMultiplier;

			MobEffectInstance speedEffect = player.getEffect(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SPEED);
			if (speedEffect != null) {
				maxAllowedSpeed += maxAllowedSpeed * 0.20 * (speedEffect.getAmplifier() + 1);
			}

			if (!player.onGround()) {
				maxAllowedSpeed *= MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE ? 1.85 : 1.45; // Air momentum buffer, widened if a wall-run/parkour-style mod is present
			}

			if (data.velocityGraceTicks > 0) {
				maxAllowedSpeed *= 2.5; // Knockback/explosion grace multiplier
			}

			// Enforce NoSlow speed limit if using item/crouching
			if ((isUsingItem || isCrouching) && !isFlyingAllowed && !isInLiquid && !isCrawling && data.velocityGraceTicks == 0) {
				double itemSlowSpeedCap = maxAllowedSpeed * noSlowMaxMultiplier + 0.20;
				if (horizontalDist > itemSlowSpeedCap) {
					data.noSlowVL += 1.0;
					if (data.noSlowVL >= 4.0) {
						logViolation(player, "NoSlow", data.noSlowVL, String.format("Speed %.2f exceeded item slow cap %.2f (UsingItem: %b, Crouching: %b)", horizontalDist, itemSlowSpeedCap, isUsingItem, isCrouching));
						setbackPlayer(player, data.lastValidPos);
						data.noSlowVL = 2.5;
					}
				} else {
					data.noSlowVL = Math.max(0, data.noSlowVL - 0.1);
				}
			} else {
				data.noSlowVL = Math.max(0, data.noSlowVL - 0.1);
			}

			// --- CHECK 5: ELYTRA BOUNDARY CHECK ---
			if (player.isFallFlying()) {
				double totalSpeed = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
				// Steep dives (dy < 0) gain significant vertical acceleration
				double verticalAllowance = dy < 0 ? Math.abs(dy) * 1.8 : 0.0;
				// Firework boosting accelerates forward/upward rather than diving, so it needs its
				// own allowance or legitimate boosted flight gets flagged the same as an
				// unauthorized elytra speed hack. There is no clean server-side "is boosting right
				// now" flag for fireworks, so this approximates it with a short grace window: any
				// nearby firework rocket explosion/consumption within the last few ticks. Simplest
				// reliable proxy is checking recent velocity grace ticks, which already opens
				// briefly on knockback-style impulses; extend that same window to cover boosts too.
				boolean isFireworkBoosting = data.velocityGraceTicks > 0;
				double fireworkAllowance = isFireworkBoosting ? 2.2 : 0.0;
				double maxElytraTotal = 3.5 + verticalAllowance + fireworkAllowance;
				double maxElytraHorizontal = 3.2 + (isFireworkBoosting ? 1.5 : 0.0);

				if (data.velocityGraceTicks > 0) {
					maxElytraTotal *= 1.8;
					maxElytraHorizontal *= 1.8;
				}

				if (horizontalDist > maxElytraHorizontal || totalSpeed > maxElytraTotal) {
					data.elytraSpeedVL += 1.5;
					if (data.elytraSpeedVL >= 5.0) {
						logViolation(player, "ElytraSpeed", data.elytraSpeedVL, String.format("Elytra speed (H: %.2f, Total: %.2f) exceeded limit (Max H: %.2f, Max Total: %.2f)", horizontalDist, totalSpeed, maxElytraHorizontal, maxElytraTotal));
						setbackPlayer(player, data.lastValidPos);
						data.elytraSpeedVL = 2.0;
					}
				} else {
					data.elytraSpeedVL = Math.max(0, data.elytraSpeedVL - 0.1);
				}
			}

			// --- CHECK 6: HORIZONTAL SPEED CHECK ---
			if (!isFlyingAllowed && !isInLiquid && !isCrawling && player.hurtTime == 0 && data.velocityGraceTicks == 0 && horizontalDist > maxAllowedSpeed + 0.50) {
				data.movementVL += 1.0;
				if (data.movementVL >= 6.0) {
					logViolation(player, "Speed", data.movementVL, String.format("Speed %.2f > Max %.2f", horizontalDist, maxAllowedSpeed));
					setbackPlayer(player, data.lastValidPos);
					data.movementVL = 3.0;
				}
			} else {
				data.movementVL = Math.max(0, data.movementVL - 0.05);
			}

			// --- CHECK 7: AIR HOLD / FLY CHECK ---
			if (!isFlyingAllowed && !isInLiquid && !player.onGround() && !player.onClimbable() && data.velocityGraceTicks == 0) {
				if (Math.abs(dy) < 0.0001 && player.getDeltaMovement().y >= 0) {
					data.airHoverTicks++;
					int hoverThreshold = MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE ? 30 : 14; // Wall-run/vault mods can legitimately hold near-zero dy longer
					if (data.airHoverTicks > hoverThreshold) {
						data.flyVL += 1.5;
						if (data.flyVL >= 5.0) {
							logViolation(player, "Fly", data.flyVL, "Hovering in mid-air for " + data.airHoverTicks + " ticks");
							setbackPlayer(player, data.lastValidPos);
							data.flyVL = 2.0;
						}
					}
				} else {
					data.airHoverTicks = 0;
				}
			} else {
				data.airHoverTicks = 0;
				data.flyVL = Math.max(0, data.flyVL - 0.1);
			}

			// --- CHECK 8: SERVER-SIDE NOFALL / FALL DAMAGE CHECK ---
			if (!player.onGround() && dy < 0 && !isFlyingAllowed && !isInLiquid && !player.hasEffect(MobEffects.SLOW_FALLING)) {
				data.serverFallDistance += (float) Math.abs(dy);
			} else if (player.onGround()) {
				boolean isSafeFallBlock = feetState.is(Blocks.SLIME_BLOCK) || feetState.is(Blocks.HAY_BLOCK) || feetState.is(Blocks.WATER) || groundState.is(Blocks.SLIME_BLOCK) || groundState.is(Blocks.HAY_BLOCK);
				
				if (data.serverFallDistance > 3.8F && player.fallDistance == 0.0F && !isSafeFallBlock && player.hurtTime == 0 && data.velocityGraceTicks == 0) {
					data.noFallVL += 1.5;
					if (data.noFallVL >= 4.0) {
						logViolation(player, "NoFall", data.noFallVL, String.format("Landed from %.1f blocks without fall damage packet", data.serverFallDistance));
						// Calculate raw fall damage
						float rawDamage = data.serverFallDistance - 3.0F;
						// Reduce fall damage based on Feather Falling enchantment on equipped boots
						net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack boots = player.getItemBySlot(EquipmentSlot.FEET);
						if (!boots.isEmpty()) {
							int featherFallingLevel = 0;
							var enchants = boots.getEnchantments();
							for (var entry : enchants.entrySet()) {
								var holder = entry.getKey();
								if (holder.is(Enchantments.FEATHER_FALLING) 
									|| holder.unwrapKey().map(k -> k.location().getPath().equals("feather_falling")).orElse(false)) {
									featherFallingLevel = entry.getValue();
									break;
								}
							}
							if (featherFallingLevel > 0) {
								float reduction = Math.min(0.48F, featherFallingLevel * 0.12F);
								rawDamage *= (1.0F - reduction);
							}
						}
						if (rawDamage > 0.5F) {
							player.hurt(player.damageSources().fall(), rawDamage);
						}
						data.noFallVL = 2.0;
					}
				} else {
					data.noFallVL = Math.max(0, data.noFallVL - 0.1);
				}
				data.serverFallDistance = 0.0F;
			}

			// Update Valid Position State
			if (player.onGround() && !isFlyingAllowed) {
				data.lastValidPos = currentPos;
			}

			data.lastPos = currentPos;
			data.lastYaw = currentYaw;
			data.lastPitch = currentPitch;
		}

		// --- COMBAT CHECKS (Reach & KillAura with Geometry Scaling) ---
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onPlayerAttack(AttackEntityEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLED) {
				return;
			}

			if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)) {
				return;
			}

			Entity target = event.getTarget();
			if (target == null || !(target instanceof LivingEntity)) {
				return;
			}

			if (player.gameMode.getGameModeForPlayer() == GameType.CREATIVE) {
				return;
			}

			if (isWhitelistedUser(player) || hasModBypass(player)) {
				return;
			}

			PlayerData data = getPlayerData(player);

			// --- A0. ATTACK COOLDOWN CHECK (Full-damage hit-spam prevention) ---
			// player.getAttackStrengthScale(0.5F) mirrors vanilla's own cooldown calculation; a
			// hacked client suppressing cooldown client-side still shows up here since this reads
			// server-authoritative swing timing, not anything the client reports.
			float attackStrength = player.getAttackStrengthScale(0.5F);
			float attackCooldownThreshold = MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE ? 0.20F : 0.35F; // Combat roll/BetterCombat can legitimately alter swing timing
			if (attackStrength < attackCooldownThreshold) {
				data.attackCooldownVL += 1.0;
				if (data.attackCooldownVL >= 5.0) {
					logViolation(player, "AttackCooldown", data.attackCooldownVL, String.format("Hit registered at %.2f attack strength (bypassing cooldown penalty)", attackStrength));
					data.attackCooldownVL = 2.5;
				}
			} else {
				data.attackCooldownVL = Math.max(0, data.attackCooldownVL - 0.15);
			}

			// --- A. REACH CHECK (Eye-to-AABB Distance) ---
			Vec3 eyePos = player.getEyePosition(1.0F);
			AABB targetBox = target.getBoundingBox().inflate(0.1);
			
			double distSq = targetBox.distanceToSqr(eyePos);
			double reachDist = Math.sqrt(distSq);

			double baseAttributeReach = player.getAttributeValue(Attributes.ENTITY_INTERACTION_RANGE);
			// Crouching, swimming, and crawling shift effective eye height/hitbox slightly versus
			// standing; give a small pose-based allowance so legitimate crouched combat isn't tight
			// against the threshold.
			double poseAllowance = (player.isCrouching() || player.isSwimming() || player.getPose() == net.minecraft.world.entity.Pose.SWIMMING) ? 0.25 : 0.0;
			double compatReachAllowance = MOVEMENT_MOD_COMPAT_MODE ? 0.75 : 0.0; // Tetra/BetterCombat can apply non-attribute reach bonuses
			double maxReachThreshold = Math.max(3.0, baseAttributeReach) + 0.85 + poseAllowance + compatReachAllowance;

			if (reachDist > maxReachThreshold) {
				data.reachVL += 1.0;
				if (data.reachVL >= 2.0) {
					logViolation(player, "Reach", data.reachVL, String.format("Attacked target from %.2f blocks (Max Allowed: %.2f)", reachDist, maxReachThreshold));
					event.setCanceled(true);
					return;
				}
			} else {
				data.reachVL = Math.max(0, data.reachVL - 0.2);
			}

			// --- B. GEOMETRY-AWARE KILLAURA / FOV CHECK ---
			Vec3 targetCenter = target.position();
			double bbWidth = target.getBbWidth();

			// Widened from -0.15 to -0.35 to reduce false flags from freecam mods that briefly report
			// a stale or transitional look angle during the camera snap-back on attack.
			double fovThreshold = -0.35;
			if (bbWidth > 2.0) {
				fovThreshold = -0.65;
			}

			Vec3 dirToTarget = targetCenter.subtract(player.position()).normalize();
			Vec3 lookDir = player.getLookAngle();
			double dotProduct = lookDir.dot(dirToTarget);

			if (dotProduct < fovThreshold && bbWidth <= 3.5) {
				data.auraVL += 1.5;
				if (data.auraVL >= 3.0) {
					logViolation(player, "KillAura", data.auraVL, "Attacking entity outside camera FOV (Dot: " + String.format("%.2f", dotProduct) + ")");
					event.setCanceled(true);
				}
			} else {
				data.auraVL = Math.max(0, data.auraVL - 0.1);
			}
		}
	}

	// Helper: Get or Create Thread-Safe PlayerData
	private static PlayerData getPlayerData(ServerPlayer player) {
		return playerDataMap.computeIfAbsent(player.getUUID(), k -> new PlayerData(player));
	}

	// Helper: Dual Whitelist Checker (UUID + Username)
	private static boolean isWhitelistedUser(ServerPlayer player) {
		if (WHITELISTED_UUIDS.contains(player.getUUID())) {
			return true;
		}
		String username = player.getScoreboardName();
		return WHITELISTED_USERNAMES.contains(username);
	}

	// Helper: Dynamic Ability and Mod Bypass Checker
	// Checks active custom ability flags populated by The Backwoods procedures, plus engine-level passenger/riding states
	private static boolean hasModBypass(ServerPlayer player) {
		// Native engine checks: riding entities, vehicles, or passenger states
		if (player.isPassenger() || player.getVehicle() != null || player.getRootVehicle() != player) {
			return true;
		}

		var persistentData = player.getPersistentData();

		// Check active NBT ability flags set by The Backwoods or addon procedures
		return persistentData.getBoolean("BackwoodsAbilityActive") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("IsHypnotized") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("SpellCasting") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("DashActive") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("FlightActive") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("IsTeleporting") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("SuperpowerActive") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("GodMode") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("ModdedFlight") || 
			persistentData.getBoolean("CustomMovement");
	}

	// Helper: Setback Player to Safe Location
	private static void setbackPlayer(ServerPlayer player, Vec3 setbackPos) {
		if (setbackPos != null) {
			player.teleportTo(player.serverLevel(), setbackPos.x, setbackPos.y, setbackPos.z, java.util.Set.of(), player.getYRot(), player.getXRot());
			// Zero out velocity so a speed/fly client doesn't resume the same illegal motion next tick
			player.setDeltaMovement(Vec3.ZERO);
			player.hurtMarked = true;
		}
	}

	// Debounce window: suppress repeat log entries for the same player+check within this many ms,
	// prevents log spam from a player oscillating right around a threshold.
	private static final long LOG_DEBOUNCE_MS = 4000;
	private static final Map<String, Long> lastLogTimestamps = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	// Helper: Log AntiCheat Flag to Server Console, Rolling Log File & Staff Alert
	private static void logViolation(ServerPlayer player, String checkName, double vl, String details) {
		String debounceKey = player.getUUID() + ":" + checkName;
		long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
		Long lastLogged = lastLogTimestamps.get(debounceKey);
		if (lastLogged != null && (now - lastLogged) < LOG_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
			return;
		}
		lastLogTimestamps.put(debounceKey, now);

		String msg = String.format("[Backwoods AntiCheat] %s failed %s (VL: %.1f) - %s", player.getScoreboardName(), checkName, vl, details);
		
		if (LOG_TO_CONSOLE) {
			System.out.println(msg);
		}

		if (LOG_TO_FILE) {
			writeViolationToFile(msg);
		}

		if (LOG_TO_STAFF_CHAT && player.getServer() != null) {
			Component alertComponent = Component.literal("§c[AntiCheat] §f" + player.getScoreboardName() + " §7failed §e" + checkName + " §7(VL: " + String.format("%.1f", vl) + ")");
			player.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayers().forEach(p -> {
				if (p.hasPermissions(2)) {
					p.sendSystemMessage(alertComponent);
				}
			});
		}
	}

	private static void writeViolationToFile(String logMessage) {
		if (!LOG_TO_FILE) {
			return;
		}

		LOG_EXECUTOR.submit(() -> {
			try {
				java.io.File dir = new java.io.File("logs");
				if (!dir.exists()) {
					dir.mkdirs();
				}
				java.io.File logFile = new java.io.File(dir, "anticheat-violations.log");
				
				// Multi-generation rolling log rotation (Keeps up to MAX_LOG_BACKUPS generations)
				if (logFile.exists() && logFile.length() > MAX_LOG_FILE_SIZE) {
					// Shift existing backup files (.4 -> .5, .3 -> .4, .2 -> .3, .1 -> .2)
					for (int i = MAX_LOG_BACKUPS; i >= 1; i--) {
						java.io.File currentBackup = new java.io.File(dir, "anticheat-violations." + i + ".log");
						if (i == MAX_LOG_BACKUPS) {
							if (currentBackup.exists()) {
								currentBackup.delete();
							}
						} else {
							if (currentBackup.exists()) {
								java.io.File nextBackup = new java.io.File(dir, "anticheat-violations." + (i + 1) + ".log");
								if (nextBackup.exists()) {
									nextBackup.delete();
								}
								currentBackup.renameTo(nextBackup);
							}
						}
					}
					// Rotate active log to .1.log
					java.io.File backupOne = new java.io.File(dir, "anticheat-violations.1.log");
					logFile.renameTo(backupOne);
				}

				java.time.LocalDateTime now = java.time.LocalDateTime.now();
				String timestampedMessage = String.format("[%s] %s%n", now.toString(), logMessage);
				java.nio.file.Files.writeString(
					logFile.toPath(), 
					timestampedMessage, 
					java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.CREATE, 
					java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.APPEND
				);
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
		});
	}

	// Record class for short-lived reconnect cache
	private static class DisconnectRecord {
		public final PlayerData data;
		public final long timestamp;

		public DisconnectRecord(PlayerData data, long timestamp) {
			this.data = data;
			this.timestamp = timestamp;
		}
	}

	// Internal Player Tracking Data Model
	private static class PlayerData {
		public Vec3 lastPos;
		public Vec3 lastValidPos;
		public float lastYaw;
		public float lastPitch;

		public int airHoverTicks = 0;
		public int teleportGraceTicks = 0;
		public int velocityGraceTicks = 0;
		public float serverFallDistance = 0.0F;

		public double movementVL = 0.0;
		public double flyVL = 0.0;
		public double reachVL = 0.0;
		public double auraVL = 0.0;
		public double rotationVL = 0.0;

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class AntiGravityFarlands {
	// The coordinate threshold (X or Z absolute value) past which gravity begins to decay. Default: 836721
	public static int FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD = 836721;

	// Scale factor for how quickly gravity decays. Higher values cause gravity to decay slower over distance. Default: 10000.0
	public static double GRAVITY_DECAY_RATE = 10000.0;

	// Maximum block radius multiplier for attracting dropped items together. Default: 5.0
	public static double MAGNETIC_RANGE_MULTIPLIER = 5.0;

	// Maximum jump height multiplier scale under fully decayed gravity. Default: 1.8
	public static double JUMP_MULTIPLIER_SCALE = 1.8;

	// Toggle to cluster floating items/drops together in zero-g fields. Default: true
	public static boolean ENABLE_MAGNETIC_DEBRIS = true;

	static {
		loadConfig();
	}

	public static void loadConfig() {
		File configFile = new File("config/backwoods_antigrav.properties");
		Properties props = new Properties();
		if (!configFile.getParentFile().exists()) {
			configFile.getParentFile().mkdirs();
		}
		if (configFile.exists()) {
			try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(configFile)) {
				props.load(fis);
				FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD = Integer.parseInt(props.getProperty("farLandsThreshold", "836721"));
				GRAVITY_DECAY_RATE = Double.parseDouble(props.getProperty("gravityDecayRate", "10000.0"));
				MAGNETIC_RANGE_MULTIPLIER = Double.parseDouble(props.getProperty("magneticRangeMultiplier", "5.0"));
				JUMP_MULTIPLIER_SCALE = Double.parseDouble(props.getProperty("jumpMultiplierScale", "1.8"));
				ENABLE_MAGNETIC_DEBRIS = Boolean.parseBoolean(props.getProperty("enableMagneticDebris", "true"));
			} catch (Exception e) {
				// Fallback to defaults
			}
		} else {
			props.setProperty("farLandsThreshold", String.valueOf(FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD));
			props.setProperty("gravityDecayRate", String.valueOf(GRAVITY_DECAY_RATE));
			props.setProperty("magneticRangeMultiplier", String.valueOf(MAGNETIC_RANGE_MULTIPLIER));
			props.setProperty("jumpMultiplierScale", String.valueOf(JUMP_MULTIPLIER_SCALE));
			props.setProperty("enableMagneticDebris", String.valueOf(ENABLE_MAGNETIC_DEBRIS));
			try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(configFile)) {
				props.store(fos, "Anti-Gravity Farlands Mod Configuration");
			} catch (IOException e) {
				// Ignore write fail
			}
		}
	}

	public AntiGravityFarlands() {
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		new AntiGravityFarlands();
	}

	@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clientLoad(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
		Entity entity = event.getEntity();
		if (entity == null) return;

		Level level = entity.level();
		double x = entity.getX();
		double z = entity.getZ();

		// Check if entity is inside the Far Lands coordinate sectors
		boolean inFarLands = Math.abs(x) >= FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD || Math.abs(z) >= FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD;
		
		// Context check: Ensure we are in a Backwoods-related dimension path
		String dimPath = level.dimension().location().getPath();
		boolean inBackwoods = dimPath.contains("backwoods") || dimPath.contains("grain") || dimPath.contains("rotting") || dimPath.contains("loss");

		if (inFarLands && inBackwoods) {
			// Calculate deep-coordinate progressive gravity decay factor:
			// As coordinates get farther beyond FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD, gravityFactor approaches 0.0 (near-weightlessness)
			double maxDistance = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z));
			double deltaDistance = maxDistance - FAR_LANDS_THRESHOLD;
			// Halves the dynamic gravity effectiveness according to the configured decay rate past the border
			double gravityFactor = 1.0 / (1.0 + (deltaDistance / GRAVITY_DECAY_RATE));

			// Subvert physics based on entity category and current gravity intensity!
			
			// 1. FLOATING LOOT / HOVERING ARTIFACTS
			if (entity instanceof ItemEntity item) {
				if (!item.isNoGravity()) {
					item.setNoGravity(true);
					item.getPersistentData().putBoolean("backwoods_antigrav", true);
				}
				Vec3 delta = item.getDeltaMovement();
				// Bobbing amplitude gets slightly wider/slower as gravity weakens
				double bobAmplitude = 0.012 + 0.008 * (1.0 - gravityFactor);
				double bobSpeed = 0.04 * gravityFactor + 0.01;
				double bobY = bobAmplitude * Math.sin((item.getId() + item.tickCount) * bobSpeed);
				item.setDeltaMovement(new Vec3(delta.x * 0.95, bobY, delta.z * 0.95));

				// Gentle magnetic clustering: pull nearby floating item drops together to form debris structures
				if (ENABLE_MAGNETIC_DEBRIS && item.tickCount % 5 == 0) {
					double radius = 5.0 + MAGNETIC_RANGE_MULTIPLIER * (1.0 - gravityFactor); // Magnetic pull range expands as gravity weakens
					java.util.List<Entity> nearbyItems = level.getEntities(item, item.getBoundingBox().inflate(radius), e -> e instanceof ItemEntity);
					for (Entity other : nearbyItems) {
						if (other != item) {
							Vec3 attractionVec = other.position().subtract(item.position());
							double dist = attractionVec.length();
							if (dist > 0.4 && dist < radius) {
								Vec3 pull = attractionVec.normalize().scale(0.004 * (2.0 - gravityFactor));
								item.setDeltaMovement(item.getDeltaMovement().add(pull));
							}
						}
					}
				}

				// Spawn faint glowing trail particles
				if (item.tickCount % 15 == 0 && level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
					serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.GLOW, item.getX(), item.getY() + 0.2, item.getZ(), 1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.0);
				}
			}
			
			// 2. PROGRESSIVE LOW-GRAVITY FOR LIVING ENTITIES
			else if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
				// We map high jumps and low terminal fall vectors dynamically with the gravity factor,
				// which preserves precise player standard input controls and walking/jumping kinematics!
				if (!living.onGround()) {
					Vec3 delta = living.getDeltaMovement();
					// Counteract and absorb standard gravity on downward falls based on dynamic coordinates depth
					if (delta.y < 0) {
						// Dampen descend speed: ranges from 0.76 (at threshold) down to 0.98 (very high coordinate drift)
						double damping = 0.98 - (0.22 * gravityFactor);
						// Terminal velocity limit: ranges from -0.50 (at threshold) down to -0.06 (extremely slow orbit float)
						double terminalLimit = -0.06 - (0.44 * gravityFactor);
						living.setDeltaMovement(new Vec3(delta.x * 0.99, Math.max(delta.y * damping, terminalLimit), delta.z * 0.99));
					} else {
						// Prolong high-jump floatation phase: ranges from 0.94 up to 0.99
						double riseDamp = 0.99 - (0.05 * gravityFactor);
						living.setDeltaMovement(new Vec3(delta.x * 0.99, delta.y * riseDamp, delta.z * 0.99));
					}
					living.fallDistance = 0.0f; // Negate all kinetic fall damage safely
				} else {
					Vec3 delta = living.getDeltaMovement();
					// High-G thrust: jump impulse scales stronger as the regional gravity gets weaker!
					if (delta.y > 0.1) {
						double jumpMultiplier = 1.0 + (JUMP_MULTIPLIER_SCALE * (1.0 - gravityFactor));
						living.setDeltaMovement(new Vec3(delta.x * 1.25, delta.y * jumpMultiplier, delta.z * 1.25));
					}
				}

				// Create environmental distortion particles around active living entities
				if (living.tickCount % 25 == 0 && level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
					serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.PORTAL, living.getX(), living.getY() + living.getBbHeight() * 0.5, living.getZ(), 2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.3, 0.0);
				}
			}

			// 3. ZERO-GRAVITY RAYCAST PROJECTILES
			else if (entity instanceof Projectile arrow) {
				if (!arrow.isNoGravity()) {
					arrow.setNoGravity(true);
					arrow.getPersistentData().putBoolean("backwoods_antigrav", true);
				}
				// Projectiles fly in perfectly flat, continuous paths through the grid labyrinth
				if (level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel && arrow.tickCount % 2 == 0) {
					serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.ELECTRIC_SPARK, arrow.getX(), arrow.getY(), arrow.getZ(), 1, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
			}
		} else {
			// Restore original gravity status and physics parameters when leaving Far Lands chunk sectors
			if (entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("backwoods_antigrav")) {
				entity.setNoGravity(false);
				entity.getPersistentData().remove("backwoods_antigrav");
			}
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static class AntiGravityFarlandsForgeBusEvents {
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
		}
	}
} // 1.21.1

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityJoinLevelEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent;

@SuppressWarnings({"deprecation", "removal"})
@EventBusSubscriber(bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
public class AttributeLimitBypass {
	public static class BypassProfile {
		public final double maxHp;
		public final double armor;
		public final double toughness;
		public final double knockbackResistance;

		public BypassProfile(double maxHp, double armor, double toughness, double knockbackResistance) {
			this.maxHp = maxHp;
			this.armor = armor;
			this.toughness = toughness;
			this.knockbackResistance = knockbackResistance;
		}
	}

		// ==================== CONFIGURABLE BOSS STATS ====================
	public static double BASE_MAX_HP = 2500.0D;
	public static double BASE_ARMOR = 150.0D;
	public static double BASE_TOUGHNESS = 40.0D;
	public static double BASE_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE = 1.0D;

	public static double SUPERCHARGED_MAX_HP = 8000.0D;
	public static double SUPERCHARGED_ARMOR = 450.0D; // Tripled base armor (150 * 3)
	public static double SUPERCHARGED_TOUGHNESS = 80.0D;
	public static double SUPERCHARGED_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE = 1.0D;

private static final Map<String, BypassProfile> REGISTERED_PROFILES = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	static {
		registerProfile("verdant", new BypassProfile(BASE_MAX_HP, BASE_ARMOR, BASE_TOUGHNESS, BASE_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE));
		registerProfile("verdantengine", new BypassProfile(BASE_MAX_HP, BASE_ARMOR, BASE_TOUGHNESS, BASE_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE));
	}

	public AttributeLimitBypass() {
	}

	public static void registerProfile(String entityIdentifier, BypassProfile profile) {
		REGISTERED_PROFILES.put(entityIdentifier.toLowerCase(), profile);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		event.enqueueWork(AttributeLimitBypass::unlockAllAttributes);
	}

	@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clientLoad(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
	}

	public static void unlockAllAttributes() {
		unlockRangedAttribute(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH, 10_000_000.0D);
		unlockRangedAttribute(Attributes.ARMOR, 100_000.0D);
		unlockRangedAttribute(Attributes.ARMOR_TOUGHNESS, 100_000.0D);
		unlockRangedAttribute(Attributes.ATTACK_DAMAGE, 100_000.0D);
		unlockRangedAttribute(Attributes.KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE, 100.0D);
	}

	private static void unlockRangedAttribute(Holder<Attribute> holder, double newMax) {
		if (holder == null) return;
		try {
			Attribute attr = holder.value();
			if (attr instanceof RangedAttribute ranged) {
				double curMax = ranged.getMaxValue();
				for (Field field : RangedAttribute.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
					if (field.getType() == double.class) {
						field.setAccessible(true);
						double val = field.getDouble(ranged);
						// Only target the exact maxValue field to prevent modifying minValue or defaultValue
						if (Double.compare(val, curMax) == 0 && (field.getName().toLowerCase().contains("max") || field.getName().equals("f_22187_") || val > ranged.getMinValue())) {
							field.setDouble(ranged, newMax);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		} catch (Exception ignored) {}
	}

	public static void applyBypass(LivingEntity entity, double maxHp, double armor) {
		applyBypass(entity, maxHp, armor, 20.0D, 1.0D);
	}

	public static void applyBypass(LivingEntity entity, double maxHp, double armor, double toughness, double knockbackRes) {
		if (entity == null) return;
		unlockAllAttributes();

		if (maxHp > 0) {
			AttributeInstance hpAttr = entity.getAttribute(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH);
			if (hpAttr != null) {
				hpAttr.setBaseValue(maxHp);
				if (entity.getHealth() < (float) maxHp) {
					entity.setHealth((float) maxHp);
				}
			}
		}

		if (armor > 0) {
			AttributeInstance armorAttr = entity.getAttribute(Attributes.ARMOR);
			if (armorAttr != null) {
				armorAttr.setBaseValue(armor);
			}
		}

		if (toughness > 0) {
			AttributeInstance toughAttr = entity.getAttribute(Attributes.ARMOR_TOUGHNESS);
			if (toughAttr != null) {
				toughAttr.setBaseValue(toughness);
			}
		}

		if (knockbackRes > 0) {
			AttributeInstance kbAttr = entity.getAttribute(Attributes.KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE);
			if (kbAttr != null) {
				kbAttr.setBaseValue(knockbackRes);
			}
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	public static class AttributeLimitBypassForgeBusEvents {
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
			unlockAllAttributes();
		}

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onEntityJoin(EntityJoinLevelEvent event) {
			Entity e = event.getEntity();
			if (e instanceof LivingEntity living && !e.level().isClientSide()) {
				CompoundTag nbt = living.getPersistentData();
				String descId = living.getType().getDescriptionId().toLowerCase();
				String className = living.getClass().getSimpleName().toLowerCase();

				for (Map.Entry<String, BypassProfile> entry : REGISTERED_PROFILES.entrySet()) {
					String key = entry.getKey();
					if (descId.contains(key) || className.contains(key)) {
						if (!nbt.getBoolean("bypass_attributes_configured")) {
							nbt.putBoolean("bypass_attributes_configured", true);
							BypassProfile p = entry.getValue();
							applyBypass(living, p.maxHp, p.armor, p.toughness, p.knockbackResistance);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

/**
 * Standalone client visual policy: no generated dimension element needs to be locked.
 * Config: config/backwoods-dimension-visuals.json (created on the first client tick).
 * Rules match actual dimension IDs, not shared dimension-effects IDs; first matching rule wins.
 * INHERIT keeps existing dimension/biome/fog-event colors, including data-pack changes.
 * sky=NONE suppresses the whole native sky, including sun, moon, stars and sunrise.
 * A post-world depth mask replaces empty sky pixels after shader lighting, before hand/HUD rendering.
 * This removes background sun/cloud imagery without disabling the pack or changing dimension colors.
 * Packs with nonstandard depth, translucent foreground effects or reflected skies may need extra support.
 * Set postSkyFilter=false to retain native-only controls when a pack is incompatible.
 * BYPASS_IRIS is optional and disables the entire pack; it also requires ALLOW_SHADER_PACK_BYPASS.
 * Iris preferences are restored on leaving the controlled dimensions or disconnecting;
 * a process crash cannot run restoration. Other shader loaders remain best-effort.
 * Solar adaptation generates a cached pack-specific compatible copy; original archives and workspace elements stay untouched.
 * The generated copy is selected at runtime and uses dimension-specific programs; other dimensions keep normal lighting.
 * Direct celestial light (including moonlight) is removed; ambient uses the live dimension factor and skylight flag.
 * Traced block lighting is preserved; client-generated adapter ZIPs also work in release builds.
 * Generated packs retain the original pack resources/settings, have readable names, and obsolete verified copies are removed after switching.
 * All matching server dimensions are prepared at login; ordinary portal trips reuse the same generated archive.
 * Generated archives are self-contained; the original is needed only for generation, updates or restoring the original pack.
 * Native fog is captured before vanilla resets its uniforms and applied after pack compositing; no fixed colors/density.
 * Unsupported packs are logged and left unchanged; this is not a universal lighting override.
 */
public class BackwoodsDimensionVisuals {
    public static boolean ENABLED = true;
    public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_CONFIG_GEN = true;
    public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_SUNLIGHT_ADAPTER = true; // Nine source-validated pack adapters; unknown layouts remain unchanged.
    public static boolean ALLOW_SHADER_PACK_BYPASS = false; // Explicit opt-in; also guards older BYPASS_IRIS JSON configs.
    private static final org.slf4j.Logger LOGGER = com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger();
    private static final com.google.gson.Gson JSON = new com.google.gson.GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();

    public BackwoodsDimensionVisuals() {}

    public static final class Configuration {
        public boolean enabled = true;
        public int reloadSeconds = 2;
        public boolean preserveVanillaFog = true; // Native terrain-fog event range/color; applied after shader compositing.
        public boolean postSkyFilter = true; // Runs only when the matched rule requests sky=NONE and hideClouds=true.
        public String[] exclude = { "the_backwoods:the_still" };
        public java.util.List<Rule> rules = new java.util.ArrayList<>(java.util.List.of(new Rule()));
    }

    public static final class Rule {
        public String dimension = "the_backwoods:*";
        public boolean enabled = true;
        public String sky = "NONE"; // NONE or INHERIT; NONE includes sun, moon and stars.
        public boolean hideClouds = true;
        public boolean disableSunlight = true; // Pack-aware: RV direct/indirect celestial light; ambient/block lights stay enabled.
        public String fogColor = "INHERIT"; // INHERIT or #RRGGBB; also colors the sky background when sky=NONE.
        public String shaderPolicy = "NATIVE_ONLY"; // Preserves the pack; BYPASS_IRIS additionally requires the global opt-in.
        private transient int rgb = -1;
    }

    private static boolean matches(String selector, String dimension) {
        if (selector.equals("*")) return true;
        if (selector.endsWith(":*")) return dimension.startsWith(selector.substring(0, selector.length() - 1));
        return selector.equals(dimension);
    }

    private static void validateSelector(String selector) {
        if (selector == null || !selector.matches("(?:\\*|[a-z0-9_.-]+:(?:\\*|[a-z0-9_./-]+))"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected namespace:dimension, namespace:* or *: " + selector);
    }

    private static Configuration validate(Configuration config) {
        if (config == null || config.exclude == null || config.rules == null || config.rules.size() > 256
                || config.exclude.length > 256 || config.reloadSeconds < 1 || config.reloadSeconds > 3600)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid dimension visual configuration");
        for (String selector : config.exclude) validateSelector(selector);
        for (Rule rule : config.rules) {
            if (rule == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null dimension rule");
            validateSelector(rule.dimension);
            if (!"NONE".equals(rule.sky) && !"INHERIT".equals(rule.sky)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("sky must be NONE or INHERIT");
            if (!"BYPASS_IRIS".equals(rule.shaderPolicy) && !"NATIVE_ONLY".equals(rule.shaderPolicy))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("shaderPolicy must be BYPASS_IRIS or NATIVE_ONLY");
            if ("INHERIT".equals(rule.fogColor)) rule.rgb = -1;
            else if (rule.fogColor != null && rule.fogColor.matches("#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}")) rule.rgb = Integer.parseInt(rule.fogColor.substring(1), 16);
            else throw new IllegalArgumentException("fogColor must be INHERIT or #RRGGBB");
        }
        return config;
    }

    private static Rule select(Configuration config, String dimension) {
        if (!ENABLED || !config.enabled || dimension == null) return null;
        for (String selector : config.exclude) if (matches(selector, dimension)) return null;
        for (Rule rule : config.rules) if (matches(rule.dimension, dimension)) return rule.enabled ? rule : null;
        return null;
    }

    @net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist.CLIENT)
    public static final class Client {
        private static Configuration config = validate(new Configuration());
        private static long nextConfigCheck;
        private static java.nio.file.attribute.FileTime configTime;
        private static long configSize = -1;
        private static Rule active;
        private static final IrisBridge IRIS = new IrisBridge();
        private static final SunlightAdapter SUNLIGHT = new SunlightAdapter();

        private static void refreshConfig() {
            long now = System.nanoTime();
            if (nextConfigCheck != 0 && now - nextConfigCheck < 0) return;
            nextConfigCheck = now + config.reloadSeconds * 1_000_000_000L;
            var file = net.neoforged.fml.loading.FMLPaths.CONFIGDIR.get().resolve("backwoods-dimension-visuals.json");
            try {
                if (!java.nio.file.Files.exists(file)) {
                    if (!ENABLE_AUTO_CONFIG_GEN) return;
                    java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
                    try {
                        java.nio.file.Files.writeString(file, JSON.toJson(new Configuration()) + "\n", java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8,
                            java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW, java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption.WRITE);
                    } catch (java.nio.file.FileAlreadyExistsException ignored) { /* Another writer won; read its file. */ }
                }
                var stamp = java.nio.file.Files.getLastModifiedTime(file);
                long size = java.nio.file.Files.size(file);
                if (stamp.equals(configTime) && size == configSize) return;
                configTime = stamp;
                configSize = size;
                if (size > 131072) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dimension visual config exceeds 128 KiB");
                Configuration candidate = validate(JSON.fromJson(java.nio.file.Files.readString(file), Configuration.class));
                config = candidate; // Publish only a fully validated snapshot; malformed edits keep the previous rules.
                LOGGER.info("Loaded dimension visual policy from {}", file);
            } catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException exception) {
                LOGGER.warn("Dimension visual config unavailable/invalid; retaining previous rules: {}", file, exception);
            }
        }

        @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
        public static void tick(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent.Pre event) {
            refreshConfig();
            var minecraft = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
            active = select(config, minecraft.level == null ? null : minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString());
            IRIS.update(ALLOW_SHADER_PACK_BYPASS && active != null && "BYPASS_IRIS".equals(active.shaderPolicy));
            SUNLIGHT.update(minecraft.level == null ? null : minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString());
            enforce(minecraft.level);
            if (minecraft.level == null) { skyColorDimension = nativeFogDimension = null; NativeFogPass.close(); }
        }

        @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent
        public static void login(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientPlayerNetworkEvent.LoggingIn event) {
            refreshConfig();
            SUNLIGHT.nextCheck = 0;
            var level = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().level;
            SUNLIGHT.update(level == null ? null : level.dimension().location().toString());
        }

        private static float nativeFogStart, nativeFogEnd, nativeRenderStart, nativeRenderEnd;
        private static int nativeFogShape;
        private static String nativeFogDimension;
        private static boolean nativeFogFailed;

        private static void filterFog(org.joml.Matrix4fc projection, org.joml.Matrix4fc view) {
            if (!config.preserveVanillaFog || nativeFogFailed || !IRIS.packActive()) return;
            var minecraft = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
            if (minecraft.level == null || minecraft.gameRenderer.getMainCamera().getFluidInCamera() != net.minecraft.world.level.material.FogType.NONE) return;
            String dimension = minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString();
            if (select(config, dimension) == null || !dimension.equals(nativeFogDimension) || !dimension.equals(skyColorDimension)) return;
            try {
                var target = minecraft.getMainRenderTarget();
                NativeFogPass.draw(target.getColorTextureId(), target.getDepthTextureId(), target.width, target.height,
                    projection, view, skyRed, skyGreen, skyBlue, nativeFogStart, nativeFogEnd, nativeRenderStart, nativeRenderEnd, nativeFogShape);
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                nativeFogFailed = true;
                LOGGER.warn("Native fog preservation unavailable on this renderer; leaving pack fog active", failure);
            }
        }

        @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST, receiveCanceled = true)
        public static void fogRange(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ViewportEvent.RenderFog event) {
            if (event.getMode() != net.minecraft.client.renderer.FogRenderer.FogMode.FOG_TERRAIN) return;
            var minecraft = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
            if (minecraft.level == null || event.getType() != net.minecraft.world.level.material.FogType.NONE) return;
            String dimension = minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString();
            if (select(config, dimension) == null) return;
            nativeFogStart = event.getNearPlaneDistance(); nativeFogEnd = event.getFarPlaneDistance();
            nativeRenderStart = 0; nativeRenderEnd = -1;
            nativeFogShape = event.getFogShape() == com.mojang.blaze3d.shaders.FogShape.CYLINDER ? 1 : 0;
            nativeFogDimension = dimension;
        }

        private static float skyRed, skyGreen, skyBlue;
        private static String skyColorDimension;
        private static boolean skyFilterFailed;

        private static void filterSky() {
            if (!config.postSkyFilter || skyFilterFailed) return;
            var minecraft = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
            if (minecraft.level == null || minecraft.gameRenderer.getMainCamera().getFluidInCamera() != net.minecraft.world.level.material.FogType.NONE) return;
            String dimension = minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString();
            Rule rule = select(config, dimension);
            if (rule == null || !"NONE".equals(rule.sky) || !rule.hideClouds || !dimension.equals(skyColorDimension)) return;
            try {
                drawSkyBackground(skyRed, skyGreen, skyBlue);
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError exception) {
                skyFilterFailed = true;
                LOGGER.warn("Post-render sky filter unavailable on this renderer; native controls remain active", exception);
            }
        }

        @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
        public static void afterLevel(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
            if (event.getStage() == net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_LEVEL) {
                filterSky();
                filterFog(event.getProjectionMatrix(), event.getModelViewMatrix());
            }
        }

        private static void drawSkyBackground(float red, float green, float blue) {
            var target = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().getMainRenderTarget();
            if (target.getDepthTextureId() <= 0) return;
            var projection = new org.joml.Matrix4f(com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.getProjectionMatrix());
            var sorting = com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.getVertexSorting();
            var shader = com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.getShader();
            float[] tint = com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.getShaderColor().clone();
            int program = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetInteger(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL20.GL_CURRENT_PROGRAM);
            int framebuffer = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetInteger(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING);
            int readFramebuffer = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetInteger(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING);
            int depthFunction = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetInteger(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_DEPTH_FUNC);
            boolean depthWrite = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetBoolean(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_DEPTH_WRITEMASK);
            boolean depth = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glIsEnabled(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_DEPTH_TEST);
            boolean blend = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glIsEnabled(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_BLEND);
            boolean cull = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glIsEnabled(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_CULL_FACE);
            boolean scissor = org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glIsEnabled(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
            try (var stack = org.lwjgl.system.MemoryStack.stackPush()) {
                var viewport = stack.mallocInt(4);
                var colorMask = stack.malloc(4);
                org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetIntegerv(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_VIEWPORT, viewport);
                org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.glGetBooleanv(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_COLOR_WRITEMASK, colorMask);
                var modelView = com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.getModelViewStack();
                modelView.pushMatrix();
                try {
                    target.bindWrite(true);
                    modelView.identity();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setProjectionMatrix(new org.joml.Matrix4f(), com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexSorting.ORTHOGRAPHIC_Z);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShader(net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1, 1, 1, 1);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.depthFunc(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL11.GL_EQUAL);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.depthMask(false);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableBlend();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableCull();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableScissor();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.colorMask(true, true, true, false);
                    // Exact far depth: only empty background pixels pass; scene depth is never changed.
                    var vertices = com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.Tesselator.getInstance().begin(
                        com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.TRIANGLES, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
                    vertices.addVertex(-1, -1, 1).setColor(red, green, blue, 1);
                    vertices.addVertex(3, -1, 1).setColor(red, green, blue, 1);
                    vertices.addVertex(-1, 3, 1).setColor(red, green, blue, 1);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.BufferUploader.drawWithShader(vertices.buildOrThrow());
                } finally {
                    modelView.popMatrix();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setProjectionMatrix(projection, sorting);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShader(() -> shader);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.GlStateManager._glUseProgram(program);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShaderColor(tint[0], tint[1], tint[2], tint[3]);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.depthMask(depthWrite);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.depthFunc(depthFunction);
                    if (depth) com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.enableDepthTest(); else com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();
                    if (blend) com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.enableBlend(); else com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableBlend();
                    if (cull) com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.enableCull(); else com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableCull();
                    if (scissor) com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.GlStateManager._enableScissorTest(); else com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableScissor();
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.colorMask(colorMask.get(0) != 0, colorMask.get(1) != 0, colorMask.get(2) != 0, colorMask.get(3) != 0);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.GlStateManager._glBindFramebuffer(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30.GL_DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER, framebuffer);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.GlStateManager._glBindFramebuffer(org.lwjgl.opengl.GL30.GL_READ_FRAMEBUFFER, readFramebuffer);
                    com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.viewport(viewport.get(0), viewport.get(1), viewport.get(2), viewport.get(3));
                }
            }
        }

        @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
        public static void fog(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ViewportEvent.ComputeFogColor event) {
            var minecraft = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
            Rule rule = select(config, minecraft.level == null ? null : minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString());
            // Leave fluid fog and inherited colors alone; defaults never hardcode dimension colors.
            if (rule == null || event.getCamera().getFluidInCamera() != net.minecraft.world.level.material.FogType.NONE) return;
            if (rule.rgb >= 0) {
                event.setRed(((rule.rgb >> 16) & 255) / 255.0f);
                event.setGreen(((rule.rgb >> 8) & 255) / 255.0f);
                event.setBlue((rule.rgb & 255) / 255.0f);
            }
            // Reuse the actual dimension/fog event colors; no per-dimension color table.
            skyRed = event.getRed(); skyGreen = event.getGreen(); skyBlue = event.getBlue();
            skyColorDimension = minecraft.level.dimension().location().toString();
        }

        private static java.lang.reflect.Field effectsField;
        private static boolean effectsLookupAttempted;
        private static boolean effectsFailureReported;

        private static void enforce(net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel level) {
            if (level == null || effectsFailureReported) return;
            try {
                // Match by field type, not mapped/obfuscated names; resolve only once.
                if (!effectsLookupAttempted) {
                    effectsLookupAttempted = true;
                    for (var field : net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
                        if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers())
                                && field.getType() == net.minecraft.client.renderer.DimensionSpecialEffects.class) {
                            field.setAccessible(true);
                            effectsField = field;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (effectsField == null) throw new NoSuchFieldException("ClientLevel dimension-effects field");
                }
                if (effectsField == null) return;
                var current = level.effects();
                if (active != null && !(current instanceof Effects)) effectsField.set(level, new Effects(current));
                else if (active == null && current instanceof Effects controlled) effectsField.set(level, controlled.original);
            } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException exception) {
                if (!effectsFailureReported) {
                    effectsFailureReported = true;
                    LOGGER.warn("Cannot install dimension visual wrapper; native controls unavailable on this build", exception);
                }
            }
        }

        private static final class Effects extends net.minecraft.client.renderer.DimensionSpecialEffects {
            private final net.minecraft.client.renderer.DimensionSpecialEffects original;
            private Effects(net.minecraft.client.renderer.DimensionSpecialEffects original) {
                super(original.getCloudHeight(), original.hasGround(), original.skyType(), original.forceBrightLightmap(), original.constantAmbientLight());
                this.original = original;
            }
            @Override public boolean hasGround() { return original.hasGround(); }
            @Override public boolean forceBrightLightmap() { return original.forceBrightLightmap(); }
            @Override public boolean constantAmbientLight() { return original.constantAmbientLight(); }
            @Override public float getCloudHeight() { return active != null && active.hideClouds ? Float.NaN : original.getCloudHeight(); }
            @Override public SkyType skyType() { return active != null && "NONE".equals(active.sky) ? SkyType.NONE : original.skyType(); }
            @Override public float[] getSunriseColor(float time, float partial) { return active != null && "NONE".equals(active.sky) ? null : original.getSunriseColor(time, partial); }
            @Override public net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3 getBrightnessDependentFogColor(net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3 color, float sun) { return original.getBrightnessDependentFogColor(color, sun); }
            @Override public boolean isFoggyAt(int x, int z) { return original.isFoggyAt(x, z); }
            @Override public boolean renderSky(net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel level, int ticks, float partial, org.joml.Matrix4f view, net.minecraft.client.Camera camera, org.joml.Matrix4f projection, boolean foggy, Runnable fog) {
                return active != null && "NONE".equals(active.sky) || original.renderSky(level, ticks, partial, view, camera, projection, foggy, fog);
            }
            @Override public boolean renderClouds(net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel level, int ticks, float partial, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack poses, double x, double y, double z, org.joml.Matrix4f view, org.joml.Matrix4f projection) {
                return active != null && active.hideClouds || original.renderClouds(level, ticks, partial, poses, x, y, z, view, projection);
            }
            @Override public boolean renderSnowAndRain(net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel level, int ticks, float partial, net.minecraft.client.renderer.LightTexture light, double x, double y, double z) {
                return original.renderSnowAndRain(level, ticks, partial, light, x, y, z);
            }
            @Override public boolean tickRain(net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel level, int ticks, net.minecraft.client.Camera camera) { return original.tickRain(level, ticks, camera); }
            @Override public void adjustLightmapColors(net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel level, float partial, float darken, float flicker, float sky, int x, int y, org.joml.Vector3f colors) {
                original.adjustLightmapColors(level, partial, darken, flicker, sky, x, y, colors);
            }
        }
    }

    /** One cached OpenGL fog pass, after pack compositing; no changes to shader archives or Iris selection. */
    private static final class NativeFogPass {
        private static int program, vao, framebuffer, sampler;
        private static int inverseProjectionLocation, inverseViewLocation, colorLocation, rangesLocation, shapeLocation, clipLocation, depthLocation;
        private static final org.joml.Matrix4f inverseScratch = new org.joml.Matrix4f();
        private static final String VERTEX = """
#version 150
out vec2 uv;
void main() {
    vec2 p = vec2((gl_VertexID << 1) & 2, gl_VertexID & 2);
    uv = p;
    gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
""";
        private static final String FRAGMENT = """
#version 150
in vec2 uv;
out vec4 result;
uniform sampler2D SceneDepth;
uniform mat4 InverseProjection;
uniform mat4 InverseView;
uniform vec3 NativeColor;
uniform vec4 NativeRanges;
uniform int NativeShape;
uniform int ZeroToOne;
float fogAmount(float distance, float start, float end) {
    if (end <= start || end > 1e20) return 0.0;
    return smoothstep(start, end, distance);
}
void main() {
    float depth = texture(SceneDepth, uv).r;
    float clipZ = ZeroToOne != 0 ? depth : depth * 2.0 - 1.0;
    vec4 view = InverseProjection * vec4(uv * 2.0 - 1.0, clipZ, 1.0);
    float amount = 1.0;
    if (abs(view.w) > 1e-8) {
        vec3 p = view.xyz / view.w;
