package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.item.FallingBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;

/** Shared budgets and synchronized launches for real Rot and Verdant terrain debris. */
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods")
public final class BackwoodsImpactDebris {
    public static boolean ENABLED = true;
    public static boolean ROT_SHOCKWAVES = true;
    public static boolean ROT_HEAVY_PUNCHES = true;
    public static boolean ROT_RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING = true;
    public static float ROT_MAX_BLOCK_HARDNESS = 50.0F;
    public static boolean VERDANT_POUNDS = true;
    public static double MIN_HEAVY_DAMAGE = 40;
    public static int MAX_ACTIVE = 192;
    public static int MAX_SPAWNS_PER_TICK = 16;
    public static int VERDANT_BLOCKS_PER_POUND = 16;
    public static double VERDANT_RING_OFFSET = 2.0;
    public static double VERDANT_RING_SCATTER = 1.25;
    public static boolean VERDANT_RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING = true;
    public static double VERDANT_PILLAR_HEIGHT_SCALE = 1.0;
    public static int MAX_SAMPLES_PER_TICK = 48;
    public static int MAX_BURSTS = 32;
    public static int MAX_FRAGMENTS_PER_BURST = 32;
    public static int LIFETIME_TICKS = 48;
    public static int POUND_BOUNCES = 2;
    public static double MAX_RADIUS = 96;
    private static final String UNTIL = "backwoods_impact_debris_until";
    private static final String REAL = "backwoods_verdant_real_block";
    private static final String ROT_REAL = "backwoods_rot_real_block";
    private record RealLaunch(ServerLevel level, BlockPos source, Vec3 velocity, String tag) {}
    private static final ThreadLocal<RealLaunch> PENDING_REAL_LAUNCH = new ThreadLocal<>();
    private static final String BOUNCES = "backwoods_impact_debris_bounces";
    private static final java.util.Map<MinecraftServer, State> STATES = new java.util.IdentityHashMap<>();

    public BackwoodsImpactDebris() {}
    private static final class State {
        final java.util.ArrayDeque<Burst> bursts = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
        final java.util.ArrayList<FallingBlockEntity> fragments = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        int budgetTick = Integer.MIN_VALUE, spawned;
    }
    private record Burst(ServerLevel level, java.util.UUID owner, Vec3 center, double radius, double damage,
            boolean vertical, double yaw, Vec3 forward, boolean bounce, BlockState fallback, long created, int count, int[] index) {}

    public static int fragmentCount(double damage, double radius) {
        if (!Double.isFinite(damage) || !Double.isFinite(radius) || damage <= 0 || radius <= 0) return 0;
        double energy = Math.sqrt(Math.min(damage, 4096) / 12.0);
        double coverage = Math.sqrt(Math.min(radius, 32) / 6.0);
        return Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.min(64, MAX_FRAGMENTS_PER_BURST)), Math.max(1, (int)Math.ceil(5 * energy * coverage)));
    }
    private static void prepare(State state, MinecraftServer server) {
        if (state.budgetTick != server.getTickCount()) { state.budgetTick = server.getTickCount(); state.spawned = 0; }
    }
    public static boolean terrainCapacity(ServerLevel level) {
        if (!ENABLED) return false;
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
        prepare(state, level.getServer());
        return state.spawned < Math.max(0, Math.min(32, MAX_SPAWNS_PER_TICK))
                && state.fragments.size() < Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_ACTIVE));
    }
    public static void trackTerrain(FallingBlockEntity falling) {
        if (!(falling.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || falling.isRemoved()) return;
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
        prepare(state, level.getServer());
        if (!isRealTerrain(falling)) falling.getPersistentData().putLong(UNTIL, level.getGameTime() + Math.max(1, Math.min(100, LIFETIME_TICKS)));
        if (!state.fragments.contains(falling)) { state.fragments.add(falling); state.spawned++; }
    }
    public static void ring(Entity owner, Vec3 center, double radius, double damage, boolean vertical, double yaw, boolean bounce) {
        if (owner == null || !ENABLED || bounce && !VERDANT_POUNDS || !bounce && !ROT_SHOCKWAVES) return;
        queue(owner, center, radius, damage, vertical, yaw, null, bounce);
    }
    public static void verdantPound(Entity owner, Vec3 center, double beamRadius, double damage) {
        if (!ENABLED || !VERDANT_POUNDS || !(owner instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity living) || !(owner.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)
                || !Double.isFinite(damage) || damage <= 0 || !Double.isFinite(beamRadius)) return;
        if (VERDANT_RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING && !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.canEntityGrief(level, owner)) return;
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
        prepare(state, level.getServer());
        int count = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.min(32, VERDANT_BLOCKS_PER_POUND)),
                Math.max(0, Math.min(32, MAX_SPAWNS_PER_TICK) - state.spawned));
        double offset = Double.isFinite(VERDANT_RING_OFFSET) ? Math.max(1.5, Math.min(16, VERDANT_RING_OFFSET)) : 2;
        double radius = Math.max(0, Math.min(96, beamRadius)) + offset;
        double scatter = Double.isFinite(VERDANT_RING_SCATTER) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(8, VERDANT_RING_SCATTER)) : 1.25;
        double phase = level.getRandom().nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2;
        double scale = Double.isFinite(VERDANT_PILLAR_HEIGHT_SCALE) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(2, VERDANT_PILLAR_HEIGHT_SCALE)) : 1;
        if (scale == 0) return;
        java.util.HashSet<Long> sampledColumns = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < count && terrainCapacity(level); i++) {
            double angle = phase + Math.PI * 2 * (i + (level.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.9) / count;
            double sampleRadius = Math.max(Math.max(0, Math.min(96, beamRadius)) + 1.0,
                    radius + (level.getRandom().nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * scatter);
            int x = (int)Math.floor(center.x + Math.cos(angle) * sampleRadius);
            int z = (int)Math.floor(center.z + Math.sin(angle) * sampleRadius);
            if (!sampledColumns.add(((long)x << 32) ^ (z & 0xffffffffL))) continue;
            var chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(x >> 4, z >> 4);
            if (chunk == null) continue;
            int y = chunk.getHeight(net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING, x & 15, z & 15);
            if (Math.abs(y - center.y) > 24) continue;
            BlockPos source = new BlockPos(x, y, z);
            BlockState block = chunk.getBlockState(source);
            if (block.isAir() || block.hasBlockEntity() || !block.getFluidState().isEmpty()
                    || block.getDestroySpeed(level, source) < 0 || !block.canEntityDestroy(level, source, owner)
                    || !chunk.getBlockState(source.above()).isAir()
                    || !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.onEntityDestroyBlock(living, source, block)) continue;
            double upward = Math.min(1.5, (0.45 + Math.sqrt(Math.min(4096, damage) / 100.0) * 0.35) * scale);
            launchReal(level, source, block, new Vec3(0, upward, 0), REAL);
        }
    }
    public static boolean isRealTerrain(Entity entity) {
        return entity.getPersistentData().contains(REAL) || entity.getPersistentData().contains(ROT_REAL);
    }
    /** Caller must validate mob-griefing and block destruction hooks before conversion. */
    public static FallingBlockEntity liftRotBlock(ServerLevel level, BlockPos source, BlockState block, Vec3 velocity) {
        return launchReal(level, source, block, velocity, ROT_REAL);
    }
    private static FallingBlockEntity launchReal(ServerLevel level, BlockPos source, BlockState block, Vec3 velocity, String tag) {
        if (!terrainCapacity(level) || !Double.isFinite(velocity.lengthSqr()) || velocity.lengthSqr() > 16) return null;
        var chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(source.getX() >> 4, source.getZ() >> 4);
        if (chunk == null || !chunk.getBlockState(source).equals(block) || block.isAir()
                || block.hasBlockEntity() || !block.getFluidState().isEmpty() || block.getDestroySpeed(level, source) < 0) return null;
        // Convert exactly the original block; preserve native landing and fallback drops.
        FallingBlockEntity falling;
        RealLaunch previous = PENDING_REAL_LAUNCH.get();
        PENDING_REAL_LAUNCH.set(new RealLaunch(level, source, velocity, tag));
        try {
            falling = FallingBlockEntity.fall(level, source, block);
        } finally {
            if (previous == null) PENDING_REAL_LAUNCH.remove(); else PENDING_REAL_LAUNCH.set(previous);
        }
        if (falling.isRemoved() || level.getEntity(falling.getUUID()) != falling) {
            if (chunk.getBlockState(source).isAir()) level.setBlock(source, block, 3);
            return null;
        }
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
        state.fragments.add(falling);
        state.spawned++;
        return falling;
    }
    public static void punch(Entity owner, Entity victim, Vec3 direction, double damage) {
        if (!ENABLED || !ROT_HEAVY_PUNCHES || owner == null || victim == null || damage < MIN_HEAVY_DAMAGE) return;
        double radius = Math.max(2, Math.min(14, Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, damage)) * 0.65));
        queue(owner, victim.position(), radius, damage, false, 0, direction.normalize(), false);
    }
    private static void queue(Entity owner, Vec3 center, double radius, double damage, boolean vertical, double yaw, Vec3 forward, boolean bounce) {
        if (!(owner.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !owner.isAlive()) return;
        double r = Math.max(0, Math.min(Double.isFinite(MAX_RADIUS) ? MAX_RADIUS : 96, radius));
        int count = fragmentCount(damage, r);
        if (count == 0) return;
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
        if (state.bursts.size() >= Math.max(0, Math.min(128, MAX_BURSTS))) return;
        BlockState fallback = null;
        state.bursts.add(new Burst(level, owner.getUUID(), center, r, damage, vertical, yaw, forward, bounce,
                fallback, level.getGameTime(), count, new int[]{0}));
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void tick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Pre event) {
        State state = STATES.get(event.getServer());
        if (state == null) return;
        state.fragments.removeIf(fragment -> {
            if (fragment.isRemoved()) return true;
            if (isRealTerrain(fragment)) return false;
            if (!ENABLED || fragment.level() instanceof ServerLevel level && level.getGameTime() >= fragment.getPersistentData().getLong(UNTIL)) {
                fragment.discard(); return true;
            }
            return false;
        });
        if (!ENABLED) { state.bursts.clear(); STATES.remove(event.getServer()); return; }
        prepare(state, event.getServer());
        int spawnBudget = Math.max(0, Math.min(32, MAX_SPAWNS_PER_TICK) - state.spawned);
        int samples = Math.max(0, Math.min(128, MAX_SAMPLES_PER_TICK));
        while (spawnBudget > 0 && samples-- > 0 && !state.bursts.isEmpty()) {
            Burst burst = state.bursts.remove();
            Entity owner = burst.level.getEntity(burst.owner);
            if (owner == null || !owner.isAlive() || burst.level.getGameTime() - burst.created > 16) continue;
            if (state.fragments.size() >= Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_ACTIVE))) { state.bursts.clear(); break; }
            int i = burst.index[0]++;
            double angle = 2 * Math.PI * (i + 0.25) / burst.count;
            double spread = 0.85 + burst.level.getRandom().nextDouble() * 0.3;
            Vec3 direction;
            Vec3 point;
            if (burst.forward != null) {
                Vec3 forward = burst.forward.lengthSqr() > 0.0001 ? burst.forward.normalize() : new Vec3(1, 0, 0);
                double a = Math.sin(angle) * 0.45, cos = Math.cos(a), sin = Math.sin(a);
                direction = new Vec3(forward.x * cos - forward.z * sin, 0.1, forward.x * sin + forward.z * cos).normalize();
                point = burst.center.add(direction.scale(burst.radius * (0.2 + 0.8 * (i + 1.0) / burst.count)));
            } else if (burst.vertical) {
                double yaw = Math.toRadians(burst.yaw);
                direction = new Vec3(Math.cos(angle) * Math.sin(yaw), Math.sin(angle), -Math.cos(angle) * Math.cos(yaw));
                point = burst.center.add(direction.scale(burst.radius));
            } else {
                direction = new Vec3(Math.cos(angle), 0, Math.sin(angle));
                point = burst.center.add(direction.scale(burst.radius * spread));
            }
            if (spawn(state, burst, point, direction)) spawnBudget--;
            if (burst.index[0] < burst.count) state.bursts.add(burst);
        }
        if (state.bursts.isEmpty() && state.fragments.isEmpty()) STATES.remove(event.getServer());
    }
    private static boolean spawn(State state, Burst burst, Vec3 point, Vec3 direction) {
        Entity owner = burst.level.getEntity(burst.owner);
        if (!(owner instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity living)
                || ROT_RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING && !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.canEntityGrief(burst.level, owner)) return false;
        BlockPos seed = BlockPos.containing(point.x, point.y - 0.1, point.z);
        for (int depth = 0; depth < 6; depth++) {
            BlockPos source = seed.below(depth);
            var chunk = burst.level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(source.getX() >> 4, source.getZ() >> 4);
            if (chunk == null) return false;
            BlockState block = chunk.getBlockState(source);
            if (block.isAir()) continue;
            float hardness = block.getDestroySpeed(burst.level, source);
            if (block.hasBlockEntity() || !block.getFluidState().isEmpty() || hardness < 0 || hardness > ROT_MAX_BLOCK_HARDNESS
                    || !block.canEntityDestroy(burst.level, source, owner)
                    || !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.onEntityDestroyBlock(living, source, block)) return false;
            double energy = Math.min(2.0, 0.3 + Math.sqrt(Math.min(4096, burst.damage) / 100.0) * 0.6);
            Vec3 velocity = new Vec3(direction.x * energy, Math.max(0.2, direction.y * energy + 0.35 + energy * 0.35), direction.z * energy);
            return liftRotBlock(burst.level, source, block, velocity) != null;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void fragmentTick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof FallingBlockEntity falling) || !(falling.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        if (isRealTerrain(falling)) return;
        long until = falling.getPersistentData().getLong(UNTIL);
        if (until <= 0) return;
        if (!ENABLED || level.getGameTime() >= until) { falling.discard(); return; }
        Vec3 velocity = falling.getDeltaMovement();
        var area = falling.getBoundingBox().expandTowards(velocity).inflate(0.1);
        if (area.maxX - area.minX > 8 || area.maxY - area.minY > 16 || area.maxZ - area.minZ > 8) { falling.discard(); return; }
        for (int x = ((int)Math.floor(area.minX)) >> 4; x <= ((int)Math.floor(area.maxX)) >> 4; x++)
            for (int z = ((int)Math.floor(area.minZ)) >> 4; z <= ((int)Math.floor(area.maxZ)) >> 4; z++)
                if (level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(x, z) == null) { falling.discard(); return; }
        int bounces = falling.getPersistentData().getInt(BOUNCES);
        if (bounces > 0 && velocity.y < -0.08) {
            int bottom = (int)Math.floor(falling.getY() + velocity.y - 0.05);
            for (int y = (int)Math.floor(falling.getY() - 0.05); y >= bottom; y--) {
                BlockPos below = BlockPos.containing(falling.getX() + velocity.x, y, falling.getZ() + velocity.z);
                var chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(below.getX() >> 4, below.getZ() >> 4);
                if (chunk == null) { falling.discard(); return; }
                var shape = chunk.getBlockState(below).getCollisionShape(level, below);
                if (!shape.isEmpty()) {
                    double top = below.getY() + shape.max(net.minecraft.core.Direction.Axis.Y);
                    if (falling.getY() >= top - 0.1 && falling.getY() + velocity.y <= top + 0.04) {
                        falling.setPos(falling.getX(), top + 0.05, falling.getZ());
                        falling.setDeltaMovement(velocity.x * 0.65, Math.min(0.8, Math.max(0.16, -velocity.y * 0.45)), velocity.z * 0.65);
                        falling.setOnGround(false);
                        falling.getPersistentData().putInt(BOUNCES, bounces - 1);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (falling.onGround()) falling.discard();
    }
    @SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void joined(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityJoinLevelEvent event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof FallingBlockEntity falling) || !(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        RealLaunch launch = PENDING_REAL_LAUNCH.get();
        if (launch != null && launch.level == level && launch.source.equals(falling.blockPosition())) {
            // EntityJoinLevel fires before tracking snapshots the initial position and velocity.
            falling.time = 1;
            falling.setHurtsEntities(0, 0);
            falling.getPersistentData().putBoolean(launch.tag, true);
            falling.setDeltaMovement(launch.velocity);
            falling.hasImpulse = true;
            return;
        }
        if (isRealTerrain(falling)) {
            State realState = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
            if (!realState.fragments.contains(falling)) realState.fragments.add(falling);
            return;
        }
        long until = falling.getPersistentData().getLong(UNTIL);
        if (until <= 0) return;
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new State());
        if (!ENABLED || level.getGameTime() >= until || state.fragments.size() >= Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_ACTIVE))) {
            event.setCanceled(true); falling.discard(); return;
        }
        falling.disableDrop(); falling.dropItem = false;
        if (!state.fragments.contains(falling)) state.fragments.add(falling);
    }
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void stopped(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStoppedEvent event) { STATES.remove(event.getServer()); }
}

        java.util.List<String> aliases=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<Part> parts=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<Long> due=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        long nextVisual,lastCrack;
    }
    private static final class Document {int version=1,nextOverlay=-1_000_000;java.util.Map<String,Wear> stones=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();}
    private static final class Ledger extends net.minecraft.world.level.saveddata.SavedData {
        Document doc=new Document();
        static Ledger decode(java.util.List<String> chunks) {
            var data=JSON.fromJson(String.join("",chunks),Document.class);
            if(data==null||data.version!=1||data.stones==null) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid transit wear data; refusing a silent reset");
            for(var e:data.stones.entrySet()) {
                var w=e.getValue();
                if(w==null||!e.getKey().equals(w.id)||w.wear<0||w.wear>10||w.shown<0||w.shown>w.wear||w.required<0||w.uses<0
                        ||w.parts==null||w.parts.size()>8||w.aliases==null||w.due==null||w.due.size()!=w.wear-w.shown)
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid persistent transit wear record");
            }
            var result=new Ledger();result.doc=data;return result;
        }
        java.util.List<String> encode() {
            String json=JSON.toJson(doc);var result=new java.util.ArrayList<String>();
            for(int i=0;i<json.length();i+=8000) result.add(json.substring(i,Math.min(i+8000,json.length())));
            return result; // Chunked strings avoid NBT's per-string UTF size limit in large worlds.
        }
        @Override public net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag save(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag,net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider registries){
            var chunks=new net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag();for(String chunk:encode())chunks.add(net.minecraft.nbt.StringTag.valueOf(chunk));tag.put("chunks",chunks);return tag;
        }
        static Ledger load(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag,net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider registries){
            var list=tag.getList("chunks",8);var chunks=new java.util.ArrayList<String>();for(int i=0;i<list.size();i++)chunks.add(list.getString(i));return decode(chunks);
        }
    }
    private static final net.minecraft.world.level.saveddata.SavedData.Factory<Ledger> STORE=new net.minecraft.world.level.saveddata.SavedData.Factory<>(Ledger::new,Ledger::load,null);
    private record ChunkKey(String dimension,int x,int z) {}
    private record Job(String id,long at,boolean advance) {}
    private record Placement(String id,net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block block,BlockPos expected,long expires) {}
    private static final class RuntimeState {
        final Ledger ledger;
        final java.util.Map<String,String> aliases=new java.util.HashMap<>(),positions=new java.util.HashMap<>();
        final java.util.Map<ChunkKey,java.util.Set<String>> chunks=new java.util.HashMap<>();
        final java.util.Set<String> active=new java.util.HashSet<>();
        final java.util.ArrayDeque<String> repaint=new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
        final java.util.Set<String> queuedPaint=new java.util.HashSet<>();
        final java.util.PriorityQueue<Job> jobs=new java.util.PriorityQueue<>(java.util.Comparator.comparingLong(Job::at));
        final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID,Placement> placements=new java.util.HashMap<>();
        final java.util.Map<Object,Long> completed=new java.util.IdentityHashMap<>();
        final java.util.List<MekCharge> energyCharges=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        long completedTick=Long.MIN_VALUE;
        RuntimeState(Ledger ledger){this.ledger=ledger;for(var w:ledger.doc.stones.values()){index(w);if(w.nextVisual>0&&!w.due.isEmpty()) jobs.add(new Job(w.id,w.nextVisual,true));}}
        void index(Wear w){for(String id:w.aliases) aliases.put(w.provider+":"+id,w.id);for(var p:w.parts){positions.put(position(w.dimension,p.pos()),w.id);chunks.computeIfAbsent(new ChunkKey(w.dimension,p.x>>4,p.z>>4),k->new java.util.HashSet<>()).add(w.id);}}
        void unindex(Wear w){for(var p:w.parts){positions.remove(position(w.dimension,p.pos()),w.id);var key=new ChunkKey(w.dimension,p.x>>4,p.z>>4);var ids=chunks.get(key);if(ids!=null){ids.remove(w.id);if(ids.isEmpty())chunks.remove(key);}}}
    }
    private static RuntimeState runtime(MinecraftServer server){return SERVERS.computeIfAbsent(server,s->new RuntimeState(server.overworld().getDataStorage().computeIfAbsent(STORE,"backwoods_transit_fracture")));}
    private static String dimension(ServerLevel level){return level.dimension().location().toString();}
    private static String position(String dimension,BlockPos pos){return dimension+"|"+pos.getX()+","+pos.getY()+","+pos.getZ();}
    private static boolean matches(String selector,String id){return selector.equals("*")||selector.equals(id)||(selector.endsWith(":*")&&id.startsWith(selector.substring(0,selector.length()-1)));}
    private static boolean affected(String dimension){for(String s:EXCLUDED_DIMENSIONS)if(matches(s,dimension))return false;for(String s:AFFECTED_DIMENSIONS)if(matches(s,dimension))return true;return false;}
    private static boolean eligible(Device origin,Device destination){return destination!=null&&(affected(dimension(destination.level))||WEAR_ON_EXIT&&origin!=null&&affected(dimension(origin.level)));}
    private static void debug(ServerPlayer player,String message){if(DEBUG_USE_FEEDBACK)player.sendSystemMessage(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component.literal("[Transit] "+message));}
    private static int random(int min,int max){if(min<0||max<min||max>1_000_000)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid transit interval");return java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(min,max+1);}
    private static int threshold(net.minecraft.world.Difficulty difficulty){
        int min,max;switch(difficulty){case PEACEFUL->{min=PEACEFUL_MIN_USES;max=PEACEFUL_MAX_USES;}case EASY->{min=EASY_MIN_USES;max=EASY_MAX_USES;}case HARD->{min=HARD_MIN_USES;max=HARD_MAX_USES;}default->{min=NORMAL_MIN_USES;max=NORMAL_MAX_USES;}}
        if(min<1)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Uses per transit crack must be at least one");return random(min,max);
    }
    private static void earnedUse(Wear w,long now,net.minecraft.world.Difficulty difficulty){
        if(w.wear>=10)return;
        if(w.required==0)w.required=threshold(difficulty); // Chosen once and saved: mining/reloading never rerolls it.
        if(++w.uses>=w.required){w.uses=0;w.wear++;w.required=w.wear<10?threshold(difficulty):0;
            w.due.add(Math.max(1,now+Math.max(0,CRACK_DELAY_TICKS)+random(0,Math.max(0,CRACK_JITTER_TICKS))));
            if(w.nextVisual==0)w.nextVisual=w.due.get(0);
        }
    }
    /** Call exactly once after the adapter confirms a successful player teleport. */
    public static void recordSuccessfulUse(ServerPlayer player,Device device){
        if(!ENABLED||!affected(dimension(device.level)))return;var server=player.level().getServer();
        if(!server.isSameThread()){server.execute(()->recordSuccessfulUse(player,device));return;}
        var rt=runtime(server);var w=bind(rt,device,null,true);if(w==null)return;
        commit(rt,w,server.overworld().getGameTime(),device.level.getDifficulty());feedback(player,w);
    }
    public static void recordSuccessfulTransit(ServerPlayer player,Device origin,Device destination){
        if(!ENABLED||destination==null)return;
        if(!eligible(origin,destination)){debug(player,"Successful teleport ignored: neither eligible endpoint is in an affected dimension");return;}
        var server=player.level().getServer();if(!server.isSameThread()){server.execute(()->recordSuccessfulTransit(player,origin,destination));return;}
        var rt=runtime(server);long now=server.overworld().getGameTime();var seen=new java.util.HashSet<String>();
        var devices=new java.util.ArrayList<Device>();if(DAMAGE_DESTINATION)devices.add(destination);if(DAMAGE_ORIGIN&&origin!=null)devices.add(origin);
        if(devices.isEmpty())debug(player,"Successful teleport ignored: both damage toggles are disabled");
        for(var d:devices){if(!ENABLE_WARP_PLATE_WEAR&&waystones!=null&&waystones.isWarpPlate(d)){debug(player,"Warp plate wear disabled");continue;}var w=bind(rt,d,null,true);if(w!=null&&seen.add(w.id)){commit(rt,w,now,d.level.getDifficulty());feedback(player,w);}else if(w==null)debug(player,"Successful teleport could not bind its transit device");}
    }
    private static void feedback(ServerPlayer player,Wear w){
        debug(player,"Counted "+w.dimension+" @ "+w.x+", "+w.y+", "+w.z+": "+w.wear+"/10 stages; "+(w.wear>=10?"fully fractured":w.uses+"/"+w.required+" uses toward next crack"));
    }
    private static void commit(RuntimeState rt,Wear w,long now,net.minecraft.world.Difficulty difficulty){
        long previous=w.nextVisual;earnedUse(w,now,difficulty);rt.ledger.setDirty();
        if(previous==0&&w.nextVisual>0)rt.jobs.add(new Job(w.id,w.nextVisual,true));
    }
    public static boolean canUse(Device device){
        if(!ENABLED||!DISABLE_AT_MAX_WEAR)return true;
        var server=device.level.getServer();if(!server.isSameThread())return false; // No off-thread ledger/world reads.
        var w=bind(runtime(server),device,null,false);return w==null||w.wear<10;
    }
    private static Wear bind(RuntimeState rt,Device d,String carriedId,boolean create){
        if(d==null||d.provider==null||d.nativeId==null||d.nativeId.isEmpty()||d.nativeId.length()>256||d.parts==null||d.parts.isEmpty()||d.parts.size()>8)return null;
        String id=carriedId;
        if(id==null&&d.level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(d.base.getX()>>4,d.base.getZ()>>4)!=null){var be=d.level.getBlockEntity(d.base);if(be!=null)id=be.getPersistentData().getString(ITEM_KEY);}
        Wear w=id==null?null:rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id);
        if(w==null){id=rt.aliases.get(d.provider+":"+d.nativeId);w=id==null?null:rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id);}
        if(w==null&&!create)return null;
        if(w==null){w=new Wear();w.id=java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString();w.provider=d.provider;w.overlay=rt.ledger.doc.nextOverlay;rt.ledger.doc.nextOverlay-=8;rt.ledger.doc.stones.put(w.id,w);}
        if(!w.provider.equals(d.provider))return null;
        if(!w.aliases.contains(d.nativeId)){w.aliases.add(d.nativeId);rt.aliases.put(d.provider+":"+d.nativeId,w.id);rt.ledger.setDirty();}
        boolean loaded=d.parts.stream().allMatch(p->d.level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(p.getX()>>4,p.getZ()>>4)!=null);
        String dim=dimension(d.level);var parts=new java.util.ArrayList<Part>();
        for(var p:d.parts)parts.add(new Part(p,loaded?net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(d.level.getBlockState(p).getBlock()).toString():""));
        boolean moved=!dim.equals(w.dimension)||w.x!=d.base.getX()||w.y!=d.base.getY()||w.z!=d.base.getZ()||w.parts.size()!=parts.size();
        if(moved){clear(rt,w,d.level.getServer());rt.unindex(w);w.dimension=dim;w.x=d.base.getX();w.y=d.base.getY();w.z=d.base.getZ();w.parts=parts;rt.index(w);rt.ledger.setDirty();}
        if(!loaded)return w;
        for(var part:w.parts){var be=d.level.getBlockEntity(part.pos());if(be!=null){String value=be.getPersistentData().getString(ITEM_KEY);if(!w.id.equals(value)){be.getPersistentData().putString(ITEM_KEY,w.id);be.setChanged();}}}
        if(w.shown>0)rt.active.add(w.id);
        return w;
    }
    private static Device resolve(MinecraftServer server,Wear w){
        var adapter=ADAPTERS.get(w.provider);if(adapter==null)return null;
        try{for(int i=w.aliases.size()-1;i>=0;i--){Device d=adapter.resolve(server,w.aliases.get(i));if(d!=null)return d;}}
        catch(ReflectiveOperationException|RuntimeException failure){LOGGER.warn("Transit device resolution failed for {}",w.provider,failure);}return null;
    }
    private static Device present(RuntimeState rt,Wear w,MinecraftServer server){
        Device d=resolve(server,w);if(d==null||d.level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(d.base.getX()>>4,d.base.getZ()>>4)==null)return null;
        Wear found=bind(rt,d,null,false);return found==w?d:null;
    }
    private static int partStage(Wear w,int part,long now){int shown=w.shown;if(part>0&&now<w.lastCrack+Math.max(0,PART_STAGGER_TICKS))shown--;return shown<=0?-1:Math.min(9,shown-1);}
    private static void paint(RuntimeState rt,Wear w,MinecraftServer server){
        Device d=present(rt,w,server);if(d==null){clear(rt,w,server);rt.active.remove(w.id);return;}
        boolean tracked=false;long now=server.overworld().getGameTime();
        for(var player:server.getPlayerList().getPlayers()){
            if(player.level()!=d.level||!player.getChunkTrackingView().contains(w.x>>4,w.z>>4))continue;tracked=true;
            for(int i=0;i<w.parts.size();i++)player.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockDestructionPacket(w.overlay-i,w.parts.get(i).pos(),partStage(w,i,now)));
        }
        if(!tracked)rt.active.remove(w.id);
    }
    private static void clear(RuntimeState rt,Wear w,MinecraftServer server){
        if(w.dimension==null)return;
        for(var player:server.getPlayerList().getPlayers())if(dimension((ServerLevel)player.level()).equals(w.dimension))
            for(int i=0;i<w.parts.size();i++)player.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockDestructionPacket(w.overlay-i,w.parts.get(i).pos(),-1));
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent
    public static void started(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent event){
        for(var difficulty:net.minecraft.world.Difficulty.values())threshold(difficulty);
        if(CRACK_DELAY_TICKS<0||CRACK_DELAY_TICKS>1_000_000||CRACK_JITTER_TICKS<0||CRACK_JITTER_TICKS>1_000_000
                ||QUEUED_CRACK_MIN_GAP<0||QUEUED_CRACK_MAX_GAP<QUEUED_CRACK_MIN_GAP||QUEUED_CRACK_MAX_GAP>1_000_000
                ||PART_STAGGER_TICKS<0||PART_STAGGER_TICKS>200||OVERLAY_REFRESH_TICKS<1||OVERLAY_REFRESH_TICKS>200
                ||MAX_CRACK_JOBS_PER_TICK<1||MAX_CRACK_JOBS_PER_TICK>1024||MAX_REFRESH_PER_TICK<1||MAX_REFRESH_PER_TICK>4096)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid transit fracture timing or work budget");
        runtime(event.getServer());
        if(!Double.isFinite(MEKANISM_ENERGY_MULTIPLIER)||MEKANISM_ENERGY_MULTIPLIER<1||MEKANISM_ENERGY_MULTIPLIER>1024||MAX_MEKANISM_PENDING_PER_TICK<1||MAX_MEKANISM_PENDING_PER_TICK>4096)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Mekanism transit multiplier or budget");
        try{mekanism=new MekanismEnergy();LOGGER.info("Mekanism transit energy adapter ready");}
        catch(ClassNotFoundException absent){mekanism=null;}
        catch(ReflectiveOperationException|LinkageError failure){mekanism=null;LOGGER.warn("Unsupported Mekanism API; transit energy adapter inactive",failure);}
        try{waystones=new WaystonesAdapter();registerAdapter("waystones",waystones);if(!hooksInstalled){waystones.install();hooksInstalled=true;}LOGGER.info("Waystones transit-fracture adapter ready");}
        catch(ClassNotFoundException absent){waystones=null;LOGGER.info("Waystones API classes absent; optional transit-fracture adapter inactive");}
        catch(ReflectiveOperationException|LinkageError failure){waystones=null;LOGGER.warn("Unsupported Waystones/Balm API; transit-fracture adapter not installed",failure);}
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent
    public static void stopped(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStoppedEvent event){var rt=SERVERS.remove(event.getServer());if(rt!=null)for(String id:rt.active)clear(rt,rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id),event.getServer());}
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent
    public static void tick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Post event){
        var server=event.getServer();var rt=runtime(server);long now=server.overworld().getGameTime();
        if(mekanism!=null)mekanism.settle(server,rt);
        if(rt.completedTick!=now){rt.completed.clear();rt.completedTick=now;}
        rt.placements.entrySet().removeIf(e->e.getValue().expires<now);
        if(!ENABLED){for(String id:new java.util.ArrayList<>(rt.active))clear(rt,rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id),server);rt.active.clear();return;}
        int jobs=0;
        while(!rt.jobs.isEmpty()&&rt.jobs.peek().at<=now&&jobs++<MAX_CRACK_JOBS_PER_TICK){
            var job=rt.jobs.poll();var w=rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(job.id);if(w==null)continue;
            if(!job.advance){paint(rt,w,server);continue;}
            if(w.nextVisual!=job.at||w.due.isEmpty())continue;
            w.due.remove(0);w.shown++;w.lastCrack=now;
            Device d=present(rt,w,server);
            if(d!=null)d.level.playSound(null,d.base,net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.TURTLE_EGG_CRACK,net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.BLOCKS,1.0f,random(85,115)/100.0f);
            w.nextVisual=w.due.isEmpty()?0:Math.max(w.due.get(0),now+random(QUEUED_CRACK_MIN_GAP,QUEUED_CRACK_MAX_GAP));
            if(w.nextVisual>0)rt.jobs.add(new Job(w.id,w.nextVisual,true));
            rt.ledger.setDirty();rt.active.add(w.id);paint(rt,w,server);rt.jobs.add(new Job(w.id,now+Math.max(1,PART_STAGGER_TICKS),false));
        }
        if(now%Math.max(1,OVERLAY_REFRESH_TICKS)==0)for(String id:rt.active)if(rt.queuedPaint.add(id))rt.repaint.add(id);
        for(int i=0;i<MAX_REFRESH_PER_TICK&&!rt.repaint.isEmpty();i++){
            String id=rt.repaint.remove();rt.queuedPaint.remove(id);var w=rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id);if(w!=null&&rt.active.contains(id))paint(rt,w,server);
        }
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent
    public static void watch(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.level.ChunkWatchEvent.Sent event){
        var level=event.getLevel();var rt=runtime(level.getServer());var pos=event.getPos();
        var ids=rt.chunks.get(new ChunkKey(dimension(level),pos.x,pos.z));if(ids!=null)for(String id:new java.util.ArrayList<>(ids)){var w=rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id);if(w.shown>0){rt.active.add(id);if(ENABLED)paint(rt,w,level.getServer());}}
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority=net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void drops(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.level.BlockDropsEvent event){
        var level=event.getLevel();var rt=runtime(level.getServer());String id=rt.positions.get(position(dimension(level),event.getPos()));
        if(id==null&&event.getBlockEntity()!=null)id=event.getBlockEntity().getPersistentData().getString(ITEM_KEY);
        var w=id==null?null:rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(id);if(w==null)return;
        for(var drop:event.getDrops()){
            var stack=drop.getItem();
            if(stack.getItem() instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem block&&block.getBlock()==event.getState().getBlock()){
                final String owned=w.id;net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData.update(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA,stack,tag->tag.putString(ITEM_KEY,owned));
            }
        }
        clear(rt,w,level.getServer());rt.active.remove(w.id); // Ledger and pending wear intentionally survive item pickup.
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority=net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void rightClick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event){
        if(!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player))return;var level=(ServerLevel)player.level();var stack=player.getItemInHand(event.getHand());
        if(!(stack.getItem() instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem block))return;
        var custom=stack.get(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA);if(custom==null)return;
        String id=custom.copyTag().getString(ITEM_KEY);var rt=runtime(level.getServer());if(id.isEmpty()||!rt.ledger.doc.stones.containsKey(id))return;
        var pos=event.getPos();if(!level.getBlockState(pos).canBeReplaced())pos=pos.relative(event.getFace());
        rt.placements.put(player.getUUID(),new Placement(id,block.getBlock(),pos,level.getServer().overworld().getGameTime()+2));
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority=net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void placed(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.level.BlockEvent.EntityPlaceEvent event){
        if(!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)||!(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level))return;
        var rt=runtime(level.getServer());var placement=rt.placements.get(player.getUUID());
        if(placement==null||placement.block!=event.getPlacedBlock().getBlock()||!placement.expected.equals(event.getPos())||placement.expires<level.getServer().overworld().getGameTime())return;
        rt.placements.remove(player.getUUID());var w=rt.ledger.doc.stones.get(placement.id);if(w==null)return;
        var pos=event.getPos();for(var p:java.util.List.of(pos,pos.above())){if(level.getBlockState(p).getBlock()!=event.getPlacedBlock().getBlock())continue;var be=level.getBlockEntity(p);if(be!=null){be.getPersistentData().putString(ITEM_KEY,w.id);be.setChanged();}}
        try{if(waystones!=null){Device d=waystones.at(level,pos);if(d!=null){bind(rt,d,w.id,false);rt.active.add(w.id);paint(rt,w,level.getServer());}}}
        catch(ReflectiveOperationException failure){LOGGER.warn("Transit wear placement binding deferred until next use",failure);}
    }

    // ---- Mekanism integration: optional runtime API, no extra mod dependency ----
    private static final class MekCharge {
        final net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent event;
        final net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity entity;
        final ServerLevel origin;
        final net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey<net.minecraft.world.level.Level> destination;
        final Object container,automation;final long extra;boolean arrived;
        MekCharge(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent event,net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity entity,
                ServerLevel origin,net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey<net.minecraft.world.level.Level> destination,Object container,Object automation,long extra){
            this.event=event;this.entity=entity;this.origin=origin;this.destination=destination;this.container=container;this.automation=automation;this.extra=extra;
        }
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority=net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void mekanismArrived(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent event){
        if(!(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player))return;
        var rt=SERVERS.get(player.level().getServer());if(rt==null)return;
        for(var charge:rt.energyCharges)if(charge.entity.getUUID().equals(player.getUUID())&&charge.destination.equals(event.getTo()))charge.arrived=true;
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority=net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void mekanismTeleport(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent event){
        if(ENABLED&&ENABLE_MEKANISM_ENERGY_COST&&mekanism!=null&&!event.isCanceled())mekanism.before(event);
    }
    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent
    public static void stopping(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStoppingEvent event){
        var rt=SERVERS.get(event.getServer());if(rt!=null&&mekanism!=null)mekanism.settle(event.getServer(),rt);
    }
    private static final class MekanismEnergy {
        final Class<?> eventType,portableType,tileType;
        final java.lang.reflect.Method cost,targetDimension,portableStack,itemEnergy,tileEnergy,extract,insert;
        final java.lang.reflect.Field bounds;
        final Object execute,simulate,internal,manual;
        boolean warned;
        MekanismEnergy()throws ReflectiveOperationException{

        static long totalCost(long base,double multiplier){
            if(base<0||!Double.isFinite(multiplier)||multiplier<1||multiplier>1024)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Mekanism energy cost");
            return java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(base).multiply(java.math.BigDecimal.valueOf(multiplier))
                    .setScale(0,java.math.RoundingMode.CEILING).longValueExact();
        }
        Object sourceContainer(ServerLevel level,net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity entity)throws ReflectiveOperationException{
            Object found=null;var center=entity.blockPosition();
            // At most 150 loaded block-entity lookups, only when a machine actually attempts a teleport.
            for(var pos:BlockPos.betweenClosed(center.offset(-2,-3,-2),center.offset(2,2,2))){
                var chunk=level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(pos.getX()>>4,pos.getZ()>>4);if(chunk==null)continue;
                var be=chunk.getBlockEntities().get(pos);if(!tileType.isInstance(be))continue;
                Object box=bounds.get(be);
                if(box instanceof net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB area&&area.intersects(entity.getBoundingBox())){
                    Object candidate=tileEnergy.invoke(be);
                    if(found!=null&&found!=candidate)throw new IllegalStateException("Ambiguous source teleporter");
                    found=candidate;
                }
            }
            return found;
        }
        void reject(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent event,String reason){
            event.setCanceled(true);
            if(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)debug(player,"Mekanism teleport blocked: "+reason);
        }
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        void before(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent event){
            if(!eventType.isInstance(event)||!(event.getEntity().level() instanceof ServerLevel level))return;
            Object container=null,automation=null;long paid=0;
            try{
                var destination=(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey<net.minecraft.world.level.Level>)targetDimension.invoke(event);
                if(!affected(destination.location().toString()))return;
                var server=level.getServer();
                if(!server.isSameThread()){reject(event,"off-thread energy transaction");return;}
                long base=((Number)cost.invoke(event)).longValue();
                long total=totalCost(base,MEKANISM_ENERGY_MULTIPLIER),extra=total-base;
                if(extra==0)return; // Preserve native creative/free teleports and a multiplier of one.
                var rt=runtime(server);
                if(rt.energyCharges.size()>=MAX_MEKANISM_PENDING_PER_TICK){reject(event,"energy transaction budget exhausted; retry");return;}
                boolean portable=portableType.isInstance(event);automation=portable?manual:internal;
                container=portable?itemEnergy.invoke(null,portableStack.invoke(event),0):sourceContainer(level,event.getEntity());
                if(container==null){reject(event,"could not identify native energy payer");return;}
                long available=((Number)extract.invoke(container,total,simulate,automation)).longValue();
                if(available!=total){reject(event,"insufficient energy for multiplied cost");return;}
                paid=((Number)extract.invoke(container,extra,execute,automation)).longValue();
                if(paid!=extra){reject(event,"energy changed during reservation");if(paid>0)refund(container,automation,paid);paid=0;return;}
                rt.energyCharges.add(new MekCharge(event,event.getEntity(),level,destination,container,automation,paid));paid=0;
                if(event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)debug(player,"Mekanism reserved "+extra+" extra energy; total cost "+total);
            }catch(ReflectiveOperationException|RuntimeException failure){
                reject(event,"energy adapter failed");
                if(paid>0)try{refund(container,automation,paid);}catch(ReflectiveOperationException refundFailure){failure.addSuppressed(refundFailure);}
                if(!warned){warned=true;LOGGER.warn("Mekanism transit energy transaction failed",failure);}
            }
        }
        void refund(Object container,Object automation,long amount)throws ReflectiveOperationException{
            long remaining=((Number)insert.invoke(container,amount,execute,automation)).longValue();
            if(remaining>0)LOGGER.debug("Transit energy refund exceeded current container capacity by {}",remaining);
        }
        void settle(MinecraftServer server,RuntimeState rt){
            for(var charge:rt.energyCharges){
                var level=server.getLevel(charge.destination);
                var entity=charge.entity.isRemoved()?(level==null?null:level.getEntity(charge.entity.getUUID())):charge.entity;
                boolean arrived=!charge.event.isCanceled()&&(charge.arrived||entity!=null&&entity.level()==level
                        &&(charge.origin!=level||entity.position().distanceToSqr(charge.event.getTarget())<=16));
                if(!arrived)try{refund(charge.container,charge.automation,charge.extra);}
                catch(ReflectiveOperationException|RuntimeException failure){LOGGER.error("Mekanism transit energy refund failed",failure);}
                if(charge.entity instanceof ServerPlayer player)debug(player,arrived?"Mekanism surcharge committed":"Mekanism surcharge refunded after cancelled/failed teleport");
            }
            rt.energyCharges.clear();
        }
    }

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import com.mojang.brigadier.Command;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.IntegerArgumentType;
import com.mojang.brigadier.arguments.StringArgumentType;
import com.mojang.brigadier.context.CommandContext;
import com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException;
import com.mojang.brigadier.tree.CommandNode;
import net.minecraft.commands.CommandSourceStack;
import net.minecraft.commands.Commands;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.saveddata.SavedData;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.RegisterCommandsEvent;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.WeakHashMap;

/** Allows repeated zero-warmup trio and conquest starts without ending existing Viltrumite events. */
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods")
public final class BackwoodsViltrumiteEventOverride {
    public static boolean ENABLED = true;
    /** Zero means unlimited; a positive value limits simultaneous trio events per dimension. */
    public static int MAX_PARALLEL_TRIOS = 0;
    public static int MAX_PARALLEL_CONQUESTS = 0;

    private static final Set<CommandNode<CommandSourceStack>> WRAPPED =
            Collections.newSetFromMap(new WeakHashMap<>());
    private static Api api;
    private record Held(int index, Object event) {}
    private record Api(Method manager, Method events, Method byId, Method type, Method over) {}

    public BackwoodsViltrumiteEventOverride() {}

    private static CommandNode<CommandSourceStack> child(CommandNode<CommandSourceStack> parent, String name) {
        return parent == null ? null : parent.getChild(name);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void register(RegisterCommandsEvent event) {
        CommandNode<CommandSourceStack> root = child(event.getDispatcher().getRoot(), "viltrumite");
        CommandNode<CommandSourceStack> ids = child(child(child(root, "event"), "start"), "id");
        CommandNode<CommandSourceStack> seconds = child(ids, "seconds");
        if (seconds == null || seconds.getCommand() == null || WRAPPED.contains(seconds)) return;
        try {
            if (api == null) {
                Class<?> manager = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.worldevent.WorldEventManager");
                Class<?> types = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.worldevent.WorldEvents");
                Class<?> worldEvent = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.worldevent.WorldEvent");
                api = new Api(manager.getMethod("get", ServerLevel.class), manager.getMethod("activeEvents"),
                        types.getMethod("byId", String.class), worldEvent.getMethod("type"), worldEvent.getMethod("isOver"));
            }
            Command<CommandSourceStack> original = seconds.getCommand();
            ids.addChild(Commands.argument("seconds", IntegerArgumentType.integer(0, 3600))
                    .requires(seconds.getRequirement())
                    .executes(context -> start(context, original)).build());
            WRAPPED.add(seconds);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError failure) {
            com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger().warn("Backwoods: Viltrumite event API unsupported; keeping its original command", failure);
        }
    }

    private static int start(CommandContext<CommandSourceStack> context, Command<CommandSourceStack> original)
            throws CommandSyntaxException {
        String id = StringArgumentType.getString(context, "id");
        if (!ENABLED || !("trio".equals(id) || "conquest".equals(id))
                || IntegerArgumentType.getInteger(context, "seconds") != 0) return original.run(context);
        try {
            Object manager = api.manager.invoke(null, context.getSource().getLevel());
            Object type = api.byId.invoke(null, id);
            if (type == null || !(manager instanceof SavedData saved)) return original.run(context);
            Object value = api.events.invoke(manager);
            if (!(value instanceof List<?>)) return original.run(context);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            List<Object> active = (List<Object>) value;
            List<Held> held = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < active.size(); i++) {
                Object running = active.get(i);
                if (api.type.invoke(running) == type && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(api.over.invoke(running)))
                    held.add(new Held(i, running));
            }
            int limit = "trio".equals(id) ? MAX_PARALLEL_TRIOS : MAX_PARALLEL_CONQUESTS;
            if (limit > 0 && held.size() >= limit) {
                context.getSource().sendFailure(Component.literal("Configured parallel " + id + "-event limit reached."));
                return 0;
            }
            if (held.isEmpty()) return original.run(context);
            int removed = 0;
            try {
                // Only hide matching entries during the native start check; never finish or tick them here.
                for (int i = held.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    active.remove(held.get(i).index);
                    removed++;
                }
                return original.run(context);
            } finally {
                // Restore every previous event in its original order, including after a failed command.
                for (int i = held.size() - removed; i < held.size(); i++) {
                    Held previous = held.get(i);
                    active.add(Math.min(previous.index, active.size()), previous.event);
                }
                saved.setDirty();
            }
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) {
            context.getSource().sendFailure(Component.literal("Backwoods could not access the Viltrumite event manager: "
                    + failure.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

    private static void generate(java.nio.file.Path project,HeightRule rule) throws java.io.IOException {

            if(!java.nio.file.Files.isDirectory(root)) continue;
            changed|=write(root.resolve(typePath),typeText);
            changed|=write(root.resolve(dimensionPath),dimensionText);
        }
        if(changed) LOGGER.info("Prepared {} build range [{}, {}); create a new world to use it; terrain gradients and fixed-height features are unchanged",id,min,min+height);
    }
    private static void backup(java.nio.file.Path project,java.nio.file.Path source,String relative) throws java.io.IOException {
        var target=project.resolve(".backwoods-world-height-backups").resolve(relative);
        if(java.nio.file.Files.exists(target)) return;
        java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());java.nio.file.Files.copy(source,target);
    }
    private static boolean write(java.nio.file.Path path,String content) throws java.io.IOException {
        if(java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(path)&&java.nio.file.Files.readString(path).equals(content)) return false;
        java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());var temporary=java.nio.file.Files.createTempFile(path.getParent(),"world-height-",".tmp");
        try {
            java.nio.file.Files.writeString(temporary,content);
            try {java.nio.file.Files.move(temporary,path,java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}
            catch(java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ignored) {java.nio.file.Files.move(temporary,path,java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}
        } finally {java.nio.file.Files.deleteIfExists(temporary);}
        return true;
    }
	public BackwoodsWorldHeight() {
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		new BackwoodsWorldHeight();
        autoGenerateWorldHeight();
	}

	@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clientLoad(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static class BackwoodsWorldHeightForgeBusEvents {
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
		}
	}
}

	public static boolean isBlackHole(AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
		if (cloud == null) return false;
		if (cloud.getTags().contains("BlackHoleEntity")) return true;
		Component name = cloud.getCustomName();
		if (name != null) {
			String str = name.getString();
			return str.startsWith(BH_NAME_PREFIX) || str.startsWith(RIFT_STEADY_PREFIX) || str.startsWith(RIFT_RAPID_PREFIX) || str.startsWith(RIFT_VERDANT_PREFIX);
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static boolean isBlackHole(Entity entity) {
		if (entity instanceof AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
			return isBlackHole(cloud);
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static boolean isShockwave(AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
		if (cloud == null) return false;
		return cloud.getTags().contains("BH_SHOCKWAVE_ENTITY");
	}

	public static boolean isShockwave(Entity entity) {
		if (entity instanceof AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
			return isShockwave(cloud);
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static boolean isRotEntity(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		if (entity.getTags().contains("TheRot") || entity.getTags().contains("rot") || entity.getTags().contains("rot_entity")) return true;
		try {
			String entityKey = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType()).toString();
			if (entityKey.contains("rot")) return true;
		} catch (Exception ignored) {}
		String className = entity.getClass().getSimpleName().toLowerCase();
		return className.contains("rot");
	}

	public static boolean isVerdantEngine(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		if (entity.getTags().contains("verdant_engine") || entity.getTags().contains("verdant")) return true;
		try {
			String entityKey = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType()).toString();
			if (entityKey.contains("verdant")) return true;
		} catch (Exception ignored) {}
		String className = entity.getClass().getSimpleName().toLowerCase();
		return className.contains("verdant");
	}

	public static boolean isImmuneBoss(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		if (isRotEntity(entity)) return true;
		if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) return true;
		return false;
	}

	public static int getMode(AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
		if (cloud.getTags().contains("BH_RIFT_VERDANT")) return MODE_VERDANT_SPAWN_RIFT;
		if (cloud.getTags().contains("BH_RIFT_RAPID")) return MODE_RIFT_RAPID;
		if (cloud.getTags().contains("BH_RIFT_STEADY")) return MODE_RIFT_STEADY;
		if (cloud.getTags().contains("BH_BLACK_HOLE")) return MODE_BLACK_HOLE;
		Component name = cloud.getCustomName();
		if (name != null) {
			String str = name.getString();
			if (str.startsWith(RIFT_VERDANT_PREFIX)) return MODE_VERDANT_SPAWN_RIFT;
			if (str.startsWith(RIFT_RAPID_PREFIX)) return MODE_RIFT_RAPID;
			if (str.startsWith(RIFT_STEADY_PREFIX)) return MODE_RIFT_STEADY;
		}
		return MODE_BLACK_HOLE;
	}

	public static float getRadius(AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
		for (String tag : cloud.getTags()) {
			if (tag.startsWith("BH_RAD_")) {
				try {
					return Float.parseFloat(tag.substring(7));
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
		}
		Component name = cloud.getCustomName();
		if (name != null) {
			String str = name.getString();
			int idx = str.indexOf(':');
			if (idx != -1) {
				try {
					int secondIdx = str.indexOf(':', idx + 1);
					String radStr = secondIdx != -1 ? str.substring(idx + 1, secondIdx) : str.substring(idx + 1);
					return Float.parseFloat(radStr);
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
		}
		float r = cloud.getRadius();
		return r > 0.05f ? r : 1.2f;
	}

	public static float getDynamicInterpolatedRadius(AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
		float maxRadius = getRadius(cloud);
		if (maxRadius <= 0.05f) maxRadius = 1.2f;

		int maxTicks = getMaxTicks(cloud);
		if (maxTicks <= 0) return maxRadius;

		float ageProgress = Math.min(1.0f, Math.max(0.0f, (float) cloud.tickCount / (float) maxTicks));
		int mode = getMode(cloud);

		if (mode == MODE_VERDANT_SPAWN_RIFT) {
			if (ageProgress < 0.50f) {
				float ramp = ageProgress / 0.50f;
				return maxRadius * (ramp * ramp * (3.0f - 2.0f * ramp));
			} else if (ageProgress < 0.75f) {
				return maxRadius;
			} else {
				float t = (ageProgress - 0.75f) / 0.25f;
				return maxRadius * (float) Math.pow(2.0, -10.0 * t);
			}
		} else if (mode == MODE_RIFT_RAPID) {
			if (ageProgress < 0.75f) {
				float ramp = ageProgress / 0.75f;
				return maxRadius * (ramp * ramp * (3.0f - 2.0f * ramp));
			} else {
				float endPhase = (ageProgress - 0.75f) / 0.25f;
				float rem = Math.max(0.0f, 1.0f - endPhase);
				return maxRadius * (rem * rem);
			}
		} else {
			if (ageProgress < 0.15f) {
				float t = ageProgress / 0.15f;
				return maxRadius * (t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t));
			} else if (ageProgress < 0.80f) {
				return maxRadius;
			} else {
				float t = (ageProgress - 0.80f) / 0.20f;
				float rem = Math.max(0.08f, 1.0f - t);
				return maxRadius * (rem * rem);
			}
		}
	}

	public static int getMaxTicks(AreaEffectCloud cloud) {
		if (cloud == null) return 1200;
		for (String tag : cloud.getTags()) {
			if (tag.startsWith("BH_MAXTICKS_")) {
				try {
					return Integer.parseInt(tag.substring(12));
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			} else if (tag.startsWith("BH_SW_MAXTICKS_")) {
				try {
					return Integer.parseInt(tag.substring(15));
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
		}
		Component name = cloud.getCustomName();
		if (name != null) {
			String str = name.getString();
			int firstIdx = str.indexOf(':');
			if (firstIdx != -1) {
				int secondIdx = str.indexOf(':', firstIdx + 1);
				if (secondIdx != -1) {
					try {
						return Integer.parseInt(str.substring(secondIdx + 1));
					} catch (Exception ignored) {}
				}
			}
		}
		return 1200;
	}
