@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods")
public final class BlindspotAfterimage {
    public static final float OPACITY = 0.90F;
    public static final int REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE = 60;
    public static final int CHANCE_PERCENT = 35; // One roll per eligible seen -> unseen opportunity, not per tick.
    public static final int PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 40 * 20;
    public static final int MIN_PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 20 * 20;
    public static final int SOURCE_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 15 * 20;
    public static final int MAX_COOLDOWN_SLOTS = 64;
    public static final int MIN_MIRROR_TICKS = 60, MAX_MIRROR_TICKS = 160, MIRROR_FADE_TICKS = 8;
    private static final long LIFETIME_NANOS = 3_000_000_000L;
    private static final long FADE_NANOS = 400_000_000L;
    private static final ResourceLocation COOLDOWNS = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:blindspot_afterimages");
    // Weak entity keys: observations never retain an unloaded mob or its level.
    private static final Map<BlindspotSplinterEntity, Observation> OBSERVATIONS = new WeakHashMap<>();

    public static final int MAX_IMAGES = 200;
    private static final Map<ServerPlayer, Trial> TRIALS = new WeakHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer, long[]> PLAN_BUDGET = new WeakHashMap<>();
    private static final int RETREAT = 0, ENCIRCLE = 1, ECHO = 2, REINFORCE = 3, BAIT = 4, AFTERMATH = 5;

    private static final class Trial {
        UUID source, viewer;
        String dimension;
        int entityId, mode, seen;
        long start, until, nextSample, witnessAt;
        int lifetime, spacing, linger;
        boolean witnessed, fading;
        java.util.List<UUID> actors = java.util.List.of();
        Vec3 startPlayer, sourceStart;
        java.util.List<Vec3> copies;
        float health;
        boolean shot, rushed, retreated, approached, swung;
        int phase;
    }

    public static float opacityForExperience(int experience) {
        return Mth.clamp(OPACITY + (Mth.clamp(experience, REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE, 100)
                - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE) * (1.0F - OPACITY) / (100 - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE), OPACITY, 1.0F);
    }

    private static boolean planBudget(ServerLevel level, long now) {
        long[] budget = PLAN_BUDGET.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), key -> new long[] {-1, 0});
        if (budget[0] != now) { budget[0] = now; budget[1] = 0; }
        return budget[1]++ < 2;
    }

    private static boolean lineLoaded(ServerLevel level, Vec3 from, Vec3 to) {
        if (from.distanceToSqr(to) > 128 * 128) return false;
        int minX = Mth.floor(Math.min(from.x, to.x)) >> 4, maxX = Mth.floor(Math.max(from.x, to.x)) >> 4;
        int minZ = Mth.floor(Math.min(from.z, to.z)) >> 4, maxZ = Mth.floor(Math.max(from.z, to.z)) >> 4;
        for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) for (int z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++)
            if (!level.hasChunkAt(new BlockPos(x << 4, Mth.floor(from.y), z << 4))) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean clearRay(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer player, Vec3 point) {
        Vec3 eye = player.getEyePosition();
        return lineLoaded(level, eye, point) && level.clip(new net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext(
                eye, point, net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER,
                net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, player)).getType()
                == net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult.Type.MISS;
    }

    private static Vec3 groundSite(ServerLevel level, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, ServerPlayer player,
                                  Vec3 candidate, Vec3 anchor) {
        int x = Mth.floor(candidate.x), z = Mth.floor(candidate.z), y = Mth.floor(candidate.y);
        for (int dy : new int[] {0, 1, -1, 2, -2, -3, -4}) {
            BlockPos feet = new BlockPos(x, y + dy, z);
            if (!level.hasChunkAt(feet) || level.isOutsideBuildHeight(feet)
                    || !level.getBlockState(feet.below()).isFaceSturdy(level, feet.below(), net.minecraft.core.Direction.UP)
                    || !level.getFluidState(feet).isEmpty() || !level.getFluidState(feet.above()).isEmpty()) continue;
            Vec3 position = Vec3.atBottomCenterOf(feet);
            if (position.distanceToSqr(anchor) > 14 * 14 || position.distanceToSqr(player.position()) > 36 * 36
                    || position.distanceToSqr(player.position()) < 3 * 3
                    || position.distanceToSqr(mob.position()) < 1.0) continue;
            net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB box = mob.getBoundingBox().move(position.subtract(mob.position()));
            if (!level.hasChunkAt(BlockPos.containing(box.minX, box.minY, box.minZ))
                    || !level.hasChunkAt(BlockPos.containing(box.maxX, box.maxY, box.maxZ))
                    || !level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(box) || !level.noCollision(mob, box)
                    || !level.getEntitiesOfClass(net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity.class, box,
                            entity -> entity != mob && entity.isAlive()).isEmpty()) continue;
            if (clearRay(level, player, position.add(0, mob.getEyeHeight(), 0))
                    || clearRay(level, player, position.add(0, mob.getBbHeight() * 0.55, 0))) return position;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static int memorySlot(CompoundTag root, UUID player) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_COOLDOWN_SLOTS; i++)
            if (player.toString().equals(text(root, "Player" + i))) return i;
        return -1;
    }

    private static int chooseMode(BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, CompoundTag memory, int experience) {
        if (mob.getHealth() < mob.getMaxHealth() * 0.35) return RETREAT;
        if (experience < 70) return mob.getRandom().nextBoolean() ? BAIT : RETREAT;
        int total = 0;
        int[] weights = new int[6];
        for (int mode = 0; mode < weights.length; mode++) {
            int wins = integer(memory, "Win" + mode), losses = integer(memory, "Loss" + mode);
            weights[mode] = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, 3 + wins - losses));
            if (mode == BAIT && integer(memory, "Shots") > integer(memory, "Ignored")) weights[mode] += 2;
            if (mode == ENCIRCLE && integer(memory, "Retreated") > 1) weights[mode] += 2;
            if (mode == AFTERMATH && experience < 85) weights[mode] = 0;
            total += weights[mode];
        }
        int choice = mob.getRandom().nextInt(Math.max(1, total));
        for (int mode = 0; mode < weights.length; mode++) if ((choice -= weights[mode]) < 0) return mode;
        return BAIT;
    }

    private static java.util.List<Vec3> planCopies(ServerLevel level, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob,
            ServerPlayer player, Vec3 anchor, int mode, int desired, Observation observation) {
        java.util.List<Vec3> copies = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        Vec3 first = groundSite(level, mob, player, anchor, anchor);
        if (first != null) copies.add(first);
        var path = mob.getNavigation().getPath();
        Vec3 exit = path != null && !path.isDone()
                ? path.getEntityPosAtNode(mob, path.getNodeCount() - 1).subtract(player.position()).multiply(1, 0, 1).normalize()
                : mob.position().subtract(player.position()).multiply(1, 0, 1).normalize();
        // Actual, recently walked positions are preferable to arbitrary geometry for delayed echoes.
        if (mode == ECHO) for (Vec3 point : observation.trail) {
            if (copies.size() >= desired) break;
            Vec3 site = groundSite(level, mob, player, point, anchor);
            if (site != null && separated(copies, site)) copies.add(site);
        }
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 32 && copies.size() < desired; attempt++) {
            double angle = mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2;
            double radius = 2.5 + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * (mode == ENCIRCLE ? 10 : 7);
            Vec3 candidate = anchor.add(Math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, Math.sin(angle) * radius);
            Vec3 fromPlayer = candidate.subtract(player.position()).multiply(1, 0, 1).normalize();
            if (mode == ENCIRCLE && fromPlayer.dot(exit) > 0.7) continue; // An apparent gap toward the real ambush route.
            Vec3 site = groundSite(level, mob, player, candidate, anchor);
            if (site != null && (mode != REINFORCE || nearCover(level, site)) && separated(copies, site)) copies.add(site);
        }
        return copies;
    }

    private static boolean separated(java.util.List<Vec3> positions, Vec3 site) {
        return positions.stream().noneMatch(point -> point.distanceToSqr(site) < 2.0 * 2.0);
    }

    private static boolean nearCover(ServerLevel level, Vec3 point) {
        BlockPos pos = BlockPos.containing(point);
        for (net.minecraft.core.Direction direction : net.minecraft.core.Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL) {
            BlockPos neighbor = pos.relative(direction);
            if (level.hasChunkAt(neighbor) && !level.getBlockState(neighbor.above()).isAir()) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean readyToFade(long start, long now, boolean confirmed, boolean interrupted) {
        long elapsed=Math.max(0L,now-start);
        return interrupted || elapsed>=MAX_MIRROR_TICKS || confirmed && elapsed>=MIN_MIRROR_TICKS;
    }

    private static void sendPhase(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer owner, UUID source, java.util.List<UUID> actors,
                                  long cloakTick, long visualTick) {
        // Other observers need the same concealment lease; only the assigned viewer receives/ends copies.
        MirrorPhase phase=new MirrorPhase(source,owner.getUUID(),level.dimension().location().toString(),
                cloakTick,visualTick,actors);
        for(ServerPlayer viewer:level.players()) PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(viewer,phase);
    }

    public static int afterimageCooldown(int experience) {
        int progress = Mth.clamp(experience - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE, 0, 100 - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE);
        return PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS - (PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS - MIN_PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS)
                * progress / Math.max(1, 100 - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE);
    }

    private static void deploy(ServerLevel level, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, ServerPlayer player,
                               Observation observation, long now, int experience, boolean debug) {
        if (!planBudget(level, now) || TRIALS.containsKey(player) || TRIALS.size() >= MAX_COOLDOWN_SLOTS) return;
        CompoundTag root = level.getServer().getCommandStorage().get(COOLDOWNS);
        int slot = memorySlot(root, player.getUUID());
        if (!debug && slot >= 0 && number(root, "Until" + slot) > now
                && number(root, "Until" + slot) - now <= PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS) return;
        CompoundTag memory = slot >= 0 ? root.getCompound("Memory" + slot) : new CompoundTag();
        int mode = chooseMode(mob, memory, experience);
        boolean disciplined = integer(memory, "Ignored") >= 2 && integer(memory, "Ignored") > integer(memory, "Shots");
        boolean nothing = false; // A successful opportunity always deploys visible copies.
        int desired = disciplined ? 2 : Math.min(MAX_IMAGES, 3 + (experience - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE) / 8);
        if (mode == BAIT || mob.getRandom().nextInt(5) == 0) desired = 1;
        java.util.List<Vec3> positions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (!debug && !claimCooldown(level, player.getUUID(), now, afterimageCooldown(experience))) return;
        observation.attempted = true;
        observation.cooldown = now + SOURCE_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
        if (nothing) return; // A deliberate absence is not scored as the player ignoring a nonexistent swarm.
        int lifetime = MAX_MIRROR_TICKS + MIRROR_FADE_TICKS;
        int linger = -1; // The whole swarm now fades after latched flank confirmation, not independent fixed linger timers.
        int sound = experience >= 70 && mob.getRandom().nextInt(4) == 0 ? positions.size() - 1 : -1;
        if (!SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.beginMirrorSwarm(
                mob, player, MAX_MIRROR_TICKS + MIRROR_FADE_TICKS + 12)) return;
        java.util.List<UUID> actors = SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.mirrorParticipants(mob);
        // No world tick or movement occurs between beginMirrorSwarm and these departure snapshots.
        for (UUID id : actors) {
            if (!(level.getEntity(id) instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity actor)) continue;
            Vec3 departure = actor.position();
            positions.add(departure);
            Snapshot packet = new Snapshot(actor.getId(), id, player.getUUID(),
                    level.dimension().location().toString(), level.getGameTime(), departure, false,
                    java.util.List.of(departure), player.getEyePosition(), experience, lifetime, 0, linger, -1);
            PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player, packet);
        }
        sendPhase(level,player,mob.getUUID(),actors,level.getGameTime()+180,0L);
        Trial trial = new Trial();
        trial.source = mob.getUUID(); trial.viewer = player.getUUID(); trial.entityId = mob.getId();
        trial.dimension = level.dimension().location().toString(); trial.mode = mode;
        trial.start = now; trial.until = now + lifetime; trial.nextSample = now + 4;
        trial.actors = actors;
        trial.lifetime = lifetime; trial.spacing = 0; trial.linger = linger;
        trial.startPlayer = player.position();
        trial.sourceStart = mob.position(); trial.health = mob.getHealth(); trial.copies = java.util.List.copyOf(positions);
        trial.swung = player.swinging; trial.phase = player.swingTime;
        TRIALS.put(player, trial);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void observeTrials(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
        long now = event.getServer().overworld().getGameTime();
        int samples = 0;
        var iterator = TRIALS.entrySet().iterator();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            var entry = iterator.next();
            ServerPlayer player = entry.getKey(); Trial trial = entry.getValue();
            if (player == null || player.isRemoved() || player.level().getServer() != event.getServer()
                    || !player.isAlive() || player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()
                    || !(player.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)
                    || !level.dimension().location().toString().equals(trial.dimension)) { iterator.remove(); continue; }
            Entity source = level.getEntity(trial.entityId);
            if (!(source instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity mob) || !mob.getUUID().equals(trial.source)) {
                iterator.remove(); continue; // Unloading is not evidence of a failed tactic.
            }
            boolean interrupted = !mob.isAlive() || mob.getTarget() != player
                    || mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose) != 0
                    || mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress) != 0;
            if (!trial.fading) {
                boolean confirmed = !trial.actors.isEmpty();
                int activeActors = 0;
                for (UUID uuid : trial.actors) if (level.getEntity(uuid) instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity actor
                        && actor.isAlive() && actor.getTarget() == player) {
                    activeActors++;
                    confirmed &= actor.getPersistentData().getBoolean("htMirrorConfirmed");
                }
                confirmed &= activeActors > 0;
                if (readyToFade(trial.start,now,confirmed,interrupted)) {
                    trial.fading = true;
                    trial.until = now + MIRROR_FADE_TICKS;
                    trial.lifetime = (int) (trial.until-trial.start);
                    SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.finishMirrorSwarm(level, trial.actors, trial.until);
                    sendPhase(level,player,trial.source,trial.actors,level.getGameTime()+MIRROR_FADE_TICKS+12,
                            level.getGameTime()+MIRROR_FADE_TICKS);
                }
            }
            if (!trial.fading && (now-trial.start)%20==0) {
                sendPhase(level,player,trial.source,trial.actors,
                        level.getGameTime()+Math.max(0L,trial.start+180-now),0L);
            }
            if (!interrupted && now < trial.until && now >= trial.nextSample && samples < 16) {
                trial.nextSample = now + 4; samples++;
                if (witnessed(level, mob, player, trial, now)) sampleTrial(level, mob, player, trial);
            }
            if (now >= trial.until) {
                if (!interrupted || mob.getHealth() < trial.health) finishTrial(level, mob, player, trial);
                iterator.remove();
            }
        }
    }


    private static boolean copyActive(Trial trial, int index, long now) {
        long age = now - trial.start;
        return age >= Math.min(9, index * trial.spacing)
                && age < trial.lifetime + (index == trial.linger ? 12 : 0);
    }

    private static boolean witnessed(ServerLevel level, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, ServerPlayer player, Trial trial, long now) {
        if (now < trial.witnessAt) return trial.witnessed;
        trial.witnessAt = now + 8;
        trial.witnessed = mob.hasLineOfSight(player);
        if (trial.witnessed) return true;
        int[] examined = {0};
        level.getEntities().get(net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityTypeTest.forClass(net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob.class),
                player.getBoundingBox().inflate(24), sibling -> {
            if (sibling.isAlive() && sibling.getTarget() == player
                    && (sibling instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity
                        || sibling instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.SplinterEntity
                        || sibling instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.LogSplinterEntity
                        || sibling instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity)
                    && sibling.hasLineOfSight(player)) trial.witnessed = true;
            return trial.witnessed || ++examined[0] >= 32 ? net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.ABORT
                    : net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.CONTINUE;
        });
        return trial.witnessed;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onSourceDeath(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.living.LivingDeathEvent event) {
        if (event.isCanceled() || !(event.getEntity() instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity mob)
                || !(mob.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        var iterator = TRIALS.entrySet().iterator();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            var entry = iterator.next();
            if (!entry.getValue().source.equals(mob.getUUID()) || entry.getKey().level() != level) continue;
            finishTrial(level, mob, entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
            iterator.remove();
        }
    }

    private static void sampleTrial(ServerLevel level, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, ServerPlayer player, Trial trial) {
        long now = level.getServer().overworld().getGameTime();
        Vec3 eye = player.getEyePosition(), look = player.getLookAngle();
        boolean began = player.swinging && (!trial.swung || player.swingTime < trial.phase);
        trial.swung = player.swinging; trial.phase = player.swingTime;
        boolean seesCopy = false;
        for (int index = 0; index < trial.copies.size(); index++) {
            if (!copyActive(trial, index, now)) continue;
            Vec3 copy = trial.copies.get(index);
            Vec3 aim = copy.add(0, mob.getEyeHeight(), 0).subtract(eye);
            if (aim.lengthSqr() < 0.01 || look.dot(aim.normalize()) < 0.8 || !clearRay(level, player, copy.add(0, mob.getEyeHeight(), 0))) continue;
            seesCopy = true;
            if (began && aim.lengthSqr() < 4.5 * 4.5) trial.shot = true;
            if (player.hurtTime == 0 && player.distanceToSqr(copy) < 2.5 * 2.5
                    && player.getDeltaMovement().dot(copy.subtract(player.position())) > 0.025
                    && copy.distanceToSqr(mob.position()) > 3 * 3) trial.rushed = true;
        }
        if (seesCopy) {
            trial.seen++;
            if (player.hurtTime == 0 && player.position().distanceToSqr(trial.startPlayer) > 3.5 * 3.5
                    && player.getDeltaMovement().dot(player.position().subtract(trial.sourceStart)) > 0.02) trial.retreated = true;
        }
        Vec3 toward = mob.position().subtract(eye);
        if (now - trial.start < trial.lifetime && toward.lengthSqr() > 0.01 && look.dot(toward.normalize()) < 0.25
                && mob.position().distanceToSqr(trial.sourceStart) > 1.5 * 1.5
                && mob.getDeltaMovement().dot(player.position().subtract(mob.position())) > 0.025
                && mob.distanceToSqr(player) + 9 < trial.sourceStart.distanceToSqr(trial.startPlayer)) trial.approached = true;
        int[] examined = {0};
        level.getEntities().get(net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityTypeTest.forClass(
                net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile.class), player.getBoundingBox().inflate(32), shot -> {
            if (shot.isAlive() && shot.getOwner() == player && shot.tickCount <= now - trial.start + 2
                    && shot.getDeltaMovement().lengthSqr() > 0.015) {
                Vec3 end = shot.position(), start = end.subtract(shot.getDeltaMovement().scale(Math.min(4, shot.tickCount)));
                if (lineLoaded(level, start, end)) for (int index = 0; index < trial.copies.size(); index++) {
                    if (!copyActive(trial, index, now)) continue;
                    Vec3 copy = trial.copies.get(index);
                    net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB box = mob.getBoundingBox().move(copy.subtract(mob.position())).inflate(0.12);
                    if (box.clip(start, end).isPresent()) { trial.shot = true; break; }
                }
            }
            return ++examined[0] >= 24 ? net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.ABORT
                    : net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.CONTINUE;
        });
    }

    private static void finishTrial(ServerLevel level, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, ServerPlayer player, Trial trial) {
        // Deception and combat share the same allowed learning dimensions.
        if (!SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.learningDimension(level) || trial.seen < 2) return;
        CompoundTag root = level.getServer().getCommandStorage().get(COOLDOWNS);
        int slot = memorySlot(root, player.getUUID());
        if (slot < 0) return;
        CompoundTag memory = root.getCompound("Memory" + slot);
        boolean fooled = trial.shot || trial.rushed || trial.retreated || trial.approached;
        String result = (mob.getHealth() < trial.health || !fooled ? "Loss" : "Win") + trial.mode;
        memory.putInt(result, Math.min(24, integer(memory, result) + 1));
        String response = trial.shot ? "Shots" : trial.rushed ? "Rushed" : trial.retreated ? "Retreated" : "Ignored";
        memory.putInt(response, Math.min(24, integer(memory, response) + 1));
        root.put("Memory" + slot, memory);
        level.getServer().getCommandStorage().set(COOLDOWNS, root);
    }



    private static final class Observation {
        UUID viewer;
        String dimension;
        Vec3 position;
        long seen, cooldown;
        boolean attempted;
        final java.util.ArrayDeque<Vec3> trail = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
    }

    private static long number(CompoundTag data, String key) { return data.getLong(key); }
    private static int integer(CompoundTag data, String key) { return data.getInt(key); }
    private static String text(CompoundTag data, String key) { return data.getString(key); }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void serverTick(EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity mob)
                || !(mob.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || (mob.tickCount & 1) != 0) return;
        if (!mob.isAlive() || !(mob.getTarget() instanceof ServerPlayer player)
                || !player.isAlive() || player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()
                || player.level() != level || mob.distanceToSqr(player) < 16 || mob.distanceToSqr(player) > 1296
                || mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose) != 0
                || mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress) != 0) {
            OBSERVATIONS.remove(mob);
            return;
        }
        long now = level.getServer().overworld().getGameTime();
        CompoundTag data = mob.getPersistentData();
        if (number(data, "ahPlacePose") > now
                || SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.experience(mob, player) < REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE) return;
        String dimension = level.dimension().location().toString();
        Observation observation = OBSERVATIONS.get(mob);
        if (observation == null) {
            if (OBSERVATIONS.size() >= 256) {
                OBSERVATIONS.values().removeIf(o -> now < o.seen || now - o.seen > 40);
                if (OBSERVATIONS.size() >= 256) return;
            }
            observation = new Observation();
            observation.viewer = player.getUUID();
            observation.dimension = dimension;
            OBSERVATIONS.put(mob, observation);
        }
        if (!player.getUUID().equals(observation.viewer) || !dimension.equals(observation.dimension)) {
            OBSERVATIONS.remove(mob);
            return;
        }
        boolean sees = player.hasLineOfSight(mob);
        Vec3 direction = mob.getEyePosition().subtract(player.getEyePosition()).normalize();
        if (sees && !mob.isInvisible() && player.getLookAngle().dot(direction) > 0.45) {
            if (observation.trail.isEmpty() || observation.trail.peekLast().distanceToSqr(mob.position()) >= 2.25) {
                if (observation.trail.size() >= 6) observation.trail.removeFirst();
                observation.trail.addLast(mob.position());
            }
            observation.position = mob.position();
            observation.seen = now;
            observation.attempted = false;
            return;
        }
        if (sees && player.getLookAngle().dot(direction) > 0.2
                || observation.position == null || observation.attempted) return;
        boolean flank = BlindspotSplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.isAfterimageFlankActive(mob, player);
        boolean debug = SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.afterimageDebugActive(player);
        if (!flank || now < observation.seen || now - observation.seen > 20
                || observation.position.distanceToSqr(mob.position()) < 1.5625
                || !debug && now < observation.cooldown) return;
        if (TRIALS.containsKey(player)) return;
        observation.attempted = true; // Exactly one roll for this eligible seen -> unseen opportunity, even if deployment is blocked.
        if (!debug && mob.getRandom().nextInt(100) >= CHANCE_PERCENT) return;
        deploy(level, mob, player, observation, now,
                SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.experience(mob, player), debug);
    }



    public static String debugStatus(ServerPlayer player) {
        if (!player.createCommandSourceStack().hasPermission(2))
            return "Status requires operator permission level 2.";
        ServerLevel level = (ServerLevel) player.level();
        BlindspotSplinterEntity[] chosen = {null};
        int[] examined = {0};
        level.getEntities().get(net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityTypeTest.forClass(BlindspotSplinterEntity.class),
                player.getBoundingBox().inflate(36), mob -> {
            if (mob.isAlive() && mob.distanceToSqr(player) <= 36 * 36
                    && (chosen[0] == null || mob.getTarget() == player && chosen[0].getTarget() != player
                        || (mob.getTarget() == player) == (chosen[0].getTarget() == player)
                            && mob.distanceToSqr(player) < chosen[0].distanceToSqr(player))) chosen[0] = mob;
            return ++examined[0] >= 64 ? net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.ABORT
                    : net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.CONTINUE;
        });
        BlindspotSplinterEntity mob = chosen[0];
        if (mob == null) return "No living Blindspot within 36 blocks.";
        long now = level.getServer().overworld().getGameTime();
        int xp = SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.experience(mob, player);
        boolean debug = SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.afterimageDebugActive(player);
        java.util.List<String> reasons = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) reasons.add("natural use needs Survival/Adventure");
        if (mob.getTarget() != player) reasons.add("not targeting you");
        if (mob.distanceToSqr(player) < 16) reasons.add("closer than 4 blocks");
        if (xp < REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE) reasons.add("needs 60 XP");
        if (mob.isInvisible()) reasons.add("Blindspot is invisible");
        if (mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose) != 0
                || player.getMainHandItem().is(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks.ASH_ROSE.get().asItem())
                || player.getOffhandItem().is(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks.ASH_ROSE.get().asItem()))
            reasons.add("ash rose");
        if (mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress) != 0) reasons.add("mining");
        if (number(mob.getPersistentData(), "ahPlacePose") > now) reasons.add("building");
        if (!BlindspotSplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.isAfterimageFlankActive(mob, player))
            reasons.add("not flanking/withdrawing/weaving");
        Observation observation = OBSERVATIONS.get(mob);
        if (observation == null || observation.position == null) reasons.add("look directly at it first");
        else {
            if (now < observation.seen || now - observation.seen > 20) reasons.add("last sighting older than 1s");
            if (observation.position.distanceToSqr(mob.position()) < 1.5625) reasons.add("needs 1.25 blocks of movement");
            Vec3 toward = mob.getEyePosition().subtract(player.getEyePosition()).normalize();
            if (player.hasLineOfSight(mob) && player.getLookAngle().dot(toward) > 0.2)
                reasons.add("still in your view");
            if (observation.attempted) reasons.add("this disappearance already attempted");
            if (!debug && now < observation.cooldown) reasons.add("source cooldown");
        }
        CompoundTag root = level.getServer().getCommandStorage().get(COOLDOWNS);
        int slot = memorySlot(root, player.getUUID());
        if (!debug && slot >= 0 && number(root, "Until" + slot) > now)
            reasons.add("shared cooldown " + ((number(root, "Until" + slot) - now + 19) / 20) + "s");
        if (TRIALS.containsKey(player)) reasons.add("swarm/trial already active");
        return "XP=" + xp + "; test=" + (debug ? "ON" : "OFF")
                + "; " + (reasons.isEmpty() ? "eligible; needs grounded visible copy sites"
                        : String.join(", ", reasons))
                + (debug ? "; chance/cooldown bypassed" : "; 15% roll per disappearance");
    }

    // OP-only visual probe: never spawns an entity or changes the real Blindspot's AI.
    public static String debugPreview(ServerPlayer player) {
        if (!player.createCommandSourceStack().hasPermission(2)) return "Preview requires operator permission level 2.";
        ServerLevel level = (ServerLevel) player.level();
        long now = level.getServer().overworld().getGameTime();
        CompoundTag data = player.getPersistentData();
        if (!planBudget(level, now)) return "Swarm planner is busy this tick; retry.";
        if (data.contains("hiveDebugPreviewAt") && now >= number(data, "hiveDebugPreviewAt")
                && now - number(data, "hiveDebugPreviewAt") < 20L) return "Wait one second between previews.";
        data.putLong("hiveDebugPreviewAt", now);
        BlindspotSplinterEntity[] nearest = {null};
        int[] examined = {0};
        level.getEntities().get(net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityTypeTest.forClass(BlindspotSplinterEntity.class),
                player.getBoundingBox().inflate(32.0), mob -> {
            Vec3 direction = mob.getEyePosition().subtract(player.getEyePosition()).normalize();
            if (mob.isAlive() && !mob.isInvisible() && mob.distanceToSqr(player) <= 32 * 32
                    && player.getLookAngle().dot(direction) > 0.45 && player.hasLineOfSight(mob)
                    && (nearest[0] == null || mob.distanceToSqr(player) < nearest[0].distanceToSqr(player))) nearest[0] = mob;
            return ++examined[0] >= 64 ? net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.ABORT
                    : net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.CONTINUE;
        });
        BlindspotSplinterEntity mob = nearest[0];
        if (mob == null) return "Look directly at a visible Blindspot within 32 blocks, then retry.";
        Vec3 facing = player.getLookAngle().multiply(1, 0, 1).normalize();
        if (facing.lengthSqr() < 0.01) return "Look horizontally toward the Blindspot, then retry.";
        Vec3 right = new Vec3(-facing.z, 0, facing.x).scale(2.0);
        Vec3 position = null;
        for (int side : new int[] {1, -1}) {
            Vec3 offset = right.scale(side);
            Vec3 candidate = mob.position().add(offset);
            net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB box = mob.getBoundingBox().move(offset);
            if (!level.hasChunkAt(BlockPos.containing(candidate)) || !level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(box)
                    || !level.noCollision(mob, box)) continue;
            var hit = level.clip(new net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext(player.getEyePosition(),
                    candidate.add(0, mob.getEyeHeight(), 0), net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER,
                    net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, player));
            if (hit.getType() == net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult.Type.MISS) { position = candidate; break; }
        }
        if (position == null) return "No visible empty space beside this Blindspot; move to a more open spot.";
        int experience = SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.experience(mob, player);
        Observation preview = new Observation();
        java.util.List<Vec3> positions = planCopies(level, mob, player, position, ENCIRCLE,
                Math.min(MAX_IMAGES, 3 + Math.max(0, experience - REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE) / 8), preview);
        if (positions.isEmpty()) return "No visible grounded swarm sites nearby; move to a more open spot.";
        PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player, new Snapshot(mob.getId(), mob.getUUID(), player.getUUID(),
                level.dimension().location().toString(), level.getGameTime(), position, true,
                positions, player.getEyePosition(), experience, 60, 3, positions.size() - 1, -1));
        return "Swarm preview requested (90-100% learned opacity, delayed echoes and a lingering copy); use first-person. AI and XP are unchanged.";
    }

    private static boolean claimCooldown(ServerLevel level, UUID viewer, long now) {
        return claimCooldown(level, viewer, now, PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS);
    }

    private static boolean claimCooldown(ServerLevel level, UUID viewer, long now, int duration) {
        CompoundTag root = level.getServer().getCommandStorage().get(COOLDOWNS);
        String owner = viewer.toString();
        int vacant = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_COOLDOWN_SLOTS; i++) {
            long until = number(root, "Until" + i);
            boolean active = until > now && until - now <= PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
            if (owner.equals(text(root, "Player" + i))) {
                if (active) return false;
                vacant = i;
                break;
            }
            if (!active && vacant < 0) vacant = i;
        }
        if (vacant < 0) return false; // Bounded MP storage; fail closed if all slots are busy.
        if (!owner.equals(text(root, "Player" + vacant))) root.remove("Memory" + vacant);
        root.putString("Player" + vacant, owner);
        root.putLong("Until" + vacant, now + Mth.clamp(duration, MIN_PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS, PLAYER_COOLDOWN_TICKS));
        level.getServer().getCommandStorage().set(COOLDOWNS, root);
        return true;
    }


    // One bounded S2C swarm snapshot; no client messages can change AI or learned state.
    public static final class Snapshot implements CustomPacketPayload {
        private final int entityId;
        private final UUID source;
        private final UUID viewer;
        private final String dimension;
        private final long tick;
        private final Vec3 position;
        private final boolean preview;
        private final java.util.List<Vec3> positions;
        private final Vec3 attention;
        private final int experience, lifetime, spacing, linger, sound;

        public Snapshot(int entityId, UUID source, UUID viewer, String dimension, long tick, Vec3 position) {
            this(entityId, source, viewer, dimension, tick, position, false);
        }

        public Snapshot(int entityId, UUID source, UUID viewer, String dimension, long tick, Vec3 position, boolean preview) {
            this(entityId, source, viewer, dimension, tick, position, preview, java.util.List.of(position),
                    position.add(0, 1.6, 1), REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE, 60, 0, -1, -1);
        }

        public Snapshot(int entityId, UUID source, UUID viewer, String dimension, long tick, Vec3 position,
                boolean preview, java.util.List<Vec3> positions, Vec3 attention, int experience,
                int lifetime, int spacing, int linger, int sound) {
            if (positions.isEmpty() || positions.size() > MAX_IMAGES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid swarm size");
            this.entityId = entityId; this.source = source; this.viewer = viewer; this.dimension = dimension;
            this.tick = tick; this.position = position; this.preview = preview;
            this.positions = java.util.List.copyOf(positions); this.attention = attention;
            this.experience = Mth.clamp(experience, 0, 100);
            this.lifetime = Mth.clamp(lifetime, 60, MAX_MIRROR_TICKS + MIRROR_FADE_TICKS); this.spacing = Mth.clamp(spacing, 0, 3);
            this.linger = linger >= 0 && linger < positions.size() ? linger : -1;
            this.sound = sound >= 0 && sound < positions.size() ? sound : -1;
        }

        public int entityId() { return entityId; }
        public UUID source() { return source; }
        public UUID viewer() { return viewer; }
        public String dimension() { return dimension; }
        public long tick() { return tick; }
        public Vec3 position() { return position; }
        public boolean preview() { return preview; }
        public java.util.List<Vec3> positions() { return positions; }
        public Vec3 attention() { return attention; }
        public int experience() { return experience; }
        public int lifetime() { return lifetime; }
        public int spacing() { return spacing; }
        public int linger() { return linger; }
        public int sound() { return sound; }

        public static final Type<Snapshot> TYPE = new Type<>(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:blindspot_afterimage"));
        public static final StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, Snapshot> CODEC = StreamCodec.of((buffer, value) -> {
            buffer.writeVarInt(value.entityId()); buffer.writeUUID(value.source()); buffer.writeUUID(value.viewer());
            buffer.writeUtf(value.dimension(), 128); buffer.writeLong(value.tick());
            writePoint(buffer, value.position()); buffer.writeBoolean(value.preview());
            writePoint(buffer, value.attention()); buffer.writeVarInt(value.experience()); buffer.writeVarInt(value.lifetime());
            buffer.writeVarInt(value.spacing()); buffer.writeVarInt(value.linger()); buffer.writeVarInt(value.sound());
            buffer.writeVarInt(value.positions().size());
            for (Vec3 point : value.positions()) writePoint(buffer, point);
        }, buffer -> {
            int entityId = buffer.readVarInt(); UUID source = buffer.readUUID(), viewer = buffer.readUUID();
            String dimension = buffer.readUtf(128); long tick = buffer.readLong();
            Vec3 position = readPoint(buffer); boolean preview = buffer.readBoolean(); Vec3 attention = readPoint(buffer);
            int experience = buffer.readVarInt(), lifetime = buffer.readVarInt(), spacing = buffer.readVarInt();
            int linger = buffer.readVarInt(), sound = buffer.readVarInt(), count = buffer.readVarInt();
            if (count < 1 || count > MAX_IMAGES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid swarm size");
            java.util.List<Vec3> positions = new java.util.ArrayList<>(count);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) positions.add(readPoint(buffer));
            return new Snapshot(entityId, source, viewer, dimension, tick, position, preview, positions,
                    attention, experience, lifetime, spacing, linger, sound);
        });

        private static void writePoint(RegistryFriendlyByteBuf buffer, Vec3 point) {
            buffer.writeDouble(point.x); buffer.writeDouble(point.y); buffer.writeDouble(point.z);
        }

        private static Vec3 readPoint(RegistryFriendlyByteBuf buffer) {
            return new Vec3(buffer.readDouble(), buffer.readDouble(), buffer.readDouble());
        }

        @Override public Type<Snapshot> type() { return TYPE; }
    }


    /** Server-only phase lease: no client acknowledgements or client-controlled extension of combat immunity. */
    public static final class MirrorPhase implements CustomPacketPayload {
        private final UUID source, viewer;
        private final String dimension;
        private final long cloakUntil, visualUntil;
        private final java.util.List<UUID> actors;
        public MirrorPhase(UUID source, UUID viewer, String dimension, long cloakUntil, long visualUntil, java.util.List<UUID> actors) {
            if (actors.isEmpty() || actors.size() > MAX_IMAGES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor count");
            this.source=source; this.viewer=viewer; this.dimension=dimension;
            this.cloakUntil=cloakUntil; this.visualUntil=visualUntil; this.actors=java.util.List.copyOf(actors);
        }
        public static final Type<MirrorPhase> TYPE = new Type<>(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:blindspot_mirror_phase"));
        public static final StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, MirrorPhase> CODEC = StreamCodec.of((buffer, value) -> {
            buffer.writeUUID(value.source); buffer.writeUUID(value.viewer); buffer.writeUtf(value.dimension,128);
            buffer.writeLong(value.cloakUntil); buffer.writeLong(value.visualUntil); buffer.writeVarInt(value.actors.size());
            for (UUID actor : value.actors) buffer.writeUUID(actor);
        }, buffer -> {
            UUID source=buffer.readUUID(), viewer=buffer.readUUID(); String dimension=buffer.readUtf(128);
            long cloak=buffer.readLong(), visual=buffer.readLong(); int size=buffer.readVarInt();
            if (size<1 || size>MAX_IMAGES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor count");
            java.util.List<UUID> actors=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            for(int i=0;i<size;i++)actors.add(buffer.readUUID());
            return new MirrorPhase(source,viewer,dimension,cloak,visual,actors);
        });
        @Override public Type<? extends CustomPacketPayload> type() { return TYPE; }
    }

    @EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
    public static final class Network {
        @SubscribeEvent
        public static void register(RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent event) {
            // S2C only: the client cannot request ghosts or send learned-state changes.
            var registrar=event.registrar("blindspot_afterimage_v5");
            registrar.playToClient(Snapshot.TYPE, Snapshot.CODEC,
                    (packet, context) -> context.enqueueWork(() -> Client.receive(packet)));
            registrar.playToClient(MirrorPhase.TYPE, MirrorPhase.CODEC,
                    (packet, context) -> context.enqueueWork(() -> Client.receivePhase(packet)));
        }
    }


    @EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
    public static final class Client {
        private record Pose(ClientLevel level, UUID source, Vec3 position, float yaw, float scale,
                            PartPose[] parts, boolean[] visible, boolean[] skip, int layers, long tick, long captured) {}
        private record Ghost(Snapshot packet, Pose pose, HumanoidModel<BlindspotSplinterEntity> model, ResourceLocation texture, long born, int index) {}
        private record Retired(ResourceLocation texture, long until) {}
        private static final Map<UUID, Pose> POSES = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        private static final java.util.ArrayDeque<Retired> RETIRED = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
        private static ClientLevel currentLevel;

        private static final Map<UUID, Long> CONCEALED = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        private static long visualEndNanos = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        public static boolean isConcealed(Entity actor) {
            if (actor == null || !(actor.level() instanceof ClientLevel level)) return false;
            Long until = CONCEALED.get(actor.getUUID());
            if (level != currentLevel || until == null || until <= level.getGameTime() || until-level.getGameTime()>240) {
                CONCEALED.remove(actor.getUUID()); return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        public static void receivePhase(MirrorPhase packet) {
            Minecraft mc=Minecraft.getInstance();
            maintain(mc);
            if(mc.level==null || mc.player==null
                    || !packet.dimension.equals(mc.level.dimension().location().toString())) return;
            long remaining=packet.cloakUntil-mc.level.getGameTime();
            if(remaining<0 || remaining>240) return;
            for(UUID actor:packet.actors) {
                if(CONCEALED.size()>=MAX_IMAGES * MAX_COOLDOWN_SLOTS && !CONCEALED.containsKey(actor)) continue;
                CONCEALED.put(actor,packet.cloakUntil);
            }
            if(active!=null && packet.viewer.equals(mc.player.getUUID()) && !active.packet().preview()
                    && active.packet().source().equals(packet.source) && packet.visualUntil>0) {
                long end=System.nanoTime()+Math.max(0L,packet.visualUntil-mc.level.getGameTime())*50_000_000L;
                visualEndNanos=Math.min(visualEndNanos,end); // One-way transition: confirmation changes cannot restart a fade.
            }
        }


        private static Ghost active;
        private static long textureSerial, retryAfter;


        private static ModelPart[] parts(HumanoidModel<?> model) {
            return new ModelPart[] { model.head, model.hat, model.body, model.rightArm, model.leftArm, model.rightLeg, model.leftLeg };
        }

        private static int layers(BlindspotSplinterEntity mob) {
            int mask = 0;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayConditionProcedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 1;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition2Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 2;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition3Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 4;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition4Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 8;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition5Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 16;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition6Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 32;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition7Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 64;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition8Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 128;
            if (BlindspotSplinterDisplayCondition9Procedure.execute(mob)) mask |= 256;
            return mask;
        }

        private static boolean watchable(Minecraft mc, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob) {
            if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null || mob.level() != mc.level || !mob.isAlive()
                    || mob.isInvisible() || mob.distanceToSqr(mc.player) > 40 * 40) return false;
            return true; // Capture the actual last rendered pose, including off-centre visible models.
        }

        private static void remember(Minecraft mc, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob, HumanoidModel<?> model,
                                     Vec3 position, float yaw, float scale) {
            ModelPart[] modelParts = parts(model);
            PartPose[] poses = new PartPose[modelParts.length];
            boolean[] visible = new boolean[modelParts.length], skip = new boolean[modelParts.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < modelParts.length; i++) {
                poses[i] = modelParts[i].storePose();
                visible[i] = modelParts[i].visible;
                skip[i] = modelParts[i].skipDraw;
            }
            POSES.remove(mob.getUUID());
            if (POSES.size() >= MAX_IMAGES * 2) POSES.remove(POSES.keySet().iterator().next());
            POSES.put(mob.getUUID(), new Pose(mc.level, mob.getUUID(), position, yaw, scale,
                    poses, visible, skip, layers(mob), mc.level.getGameTime(), System.nanoTime()));
        }


        @SubscribeEvent
        public static void capture(RenderLivingEvent.Post<?, ?> event) {
            if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity mob)
                    || !(event.getRenderer().getModel() instanceof HumanoidModel<?> model)) return;
            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
            maintain(mc);
            if (!watchable(mc, mob)) return;
            float partial = event.getPartialTick();
            remember(mc, mob, model, new Vec3(Mth.lerp(partial, mob.xo, mob.getX()),
                    Mth.lerp(partial, mob.yo, mob.getY()), Mth.lerp(partial, mob.zo, mob.getZ())),
                    Mth.rotLerp(partial, mob.yBodyRotO, mob.yBodyRot), mob.getScale());
        }

        private static void maintain(Minecraft mc) {
            long now = System.nanoTime();
            if (currentLevel != mc.level) {
                clearSwarm(now);
                POSES.clear(); CONCEALED.clear();
                currentLevel = mc.level;

            }
            if (mc.level!=null) CONCEALED.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue()<=mc.level.getGameTime()
                    || e.getValue()-mc.level.getGameTime()>240);
            POSES.values().removeIf(p -> p.level() != mc.level || now - p.captured() > 1_500_000_000L);
            while (!RETIRED.isEmpty() && now >= RETIRED.peekFirst().until())
                mc.getTextureManager().release(RETIRED.removeFirst().texture());
        }

        private static void retire(Ghost ghost, long now) {
            // Submitted geometry may still reference this texture in the renderer's current frame.
            RETIRED.addLast(new Retired(ghost.texture(), now + 2_000_000_000L));
        }


        private static final java.util.List<Ghost> GHOSTS = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        private static int soundStep;
        private static ResourceLocation swarmTexture;
        private static final Map<Integer, ResourceLocation> SWARM_TEXTURES = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        private static void clearSwarm(long now) {
            for (ResourceLocation texture : SWARM_TEXTURES.values())
                RETIRED.addLast(new Retired(texture, now + 2_000_000_000L));
            SWARM_TEXTURES.clear(); swarmTexture = null;
            GHOSTS.clear(); active = null; soundStep = 0; visualEndNanos = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        }

        private static boolean finite(Vec3 point) {
            return Double.isFinite(point.x) && Double.isFinite(point.y) && Double.isFinite(point.z)
                    && Math.abs(point.x) <= 30_000_000 && Math.abs(point.y) <= 30_000_000
                    && Math.abs(point.z) <= 30_000_000;
        }

        private static long duration(Ghost ghost) {
            return Math.min(ghost.packet().lifetime() * 50_000_000L
                    + (ghost.index() == ghost.packet().linger() ? 600_000_000L : 0),
                    visualEndNanos == Long.MAX_VALUE ? Long.MAX_VALUE : Math.max(0L, visualEndNanos - ghost.born()));
        }

        private static long delay(Ghost ghost) {
            return Math.min(9, ghost.index() * ghost.packet().spacing()) * 50_000_000L;
        }

        private static boolean appeared(Ghost ghost) {
            long age = System.nanoTime() - ghost.born();
            return age >= delay(ghost) && age < duration(ghost);
        }


        private static void captureDeparture(Minecraft mc, BlindspotSplinterEntity mob) {
            HumanoidModel<BlindspotSplinterEntity> model = new HumanoidModel<>(mc.getEntityModels().bakeLayer(ModelLayers.PLAYER));
            model.young = false; model.riding = mob.isPassenger(); model.crouching = mob.isCrouching();
            model.attackTime = mob.getAttackAnim(1.0F);
            float walk = mob.walkAnimation.position(1.0F), speed = mob.walkAnimation.speed(1.0F);
            model.prepareMobModel(mob, walk, speed, 1.0F);
            model.setupAnim(mob, walk, speed, mob.tickCount, Mth.wrapDegrees(mob.yHeadRot - mob.yBodyRot), mob.getXRot());
            remember(mc, mob, model, mob.position(), mob.yBodyRot, mob.getScale());
        }

        public static void receive(Snapshot packet) {
            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
            visible(mc);
            long now = System.nanoTime();
            boolean sameSwarm = active != null && !active.packet().preview() && !packet.preview()
                    && active.packet().tick() == packet.tick() && active.packet().viewer().equals(packet.viewer());
            if (active != null && !sameSwarm || GHOSTS.size() + packet.positions().size() > MAX_IMAGES
                    || GHOSTS.stream().anyMatch(g -> g.packet().source().equals(packet.source()))
                    || now < retryAfter || mc.level == null || mc.player == null
                    || !mc.player.isAlive() || mc.player.isSpectator() || !packet.viewer().equals(mc.player.getUUID())
                    || !packet.dimension().equals(mc.level.dimension().location().toString())
                    || !finite(packet.position()) || !finite(packet.attention())
                    || packet.positions().isEmpty() || packet.positions().size() > MAX_IMAGES
                    || packet.attention().distanceToSqr(mc.player.getEyePosition()) > 16 * 16
                    || Math.abs(mc.level.getGameTime() - packet.tick()) > 40) return;
            Entity source = mc.level.getEntity(packet.entityId());
            Pose pose = POSES.get(packet.source());
            if (source instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity candidate
                    && (pose == null || pose.tick() < packet.tick() - 1 || now - pose.captured() > 100_000_000L)) {
                captureDeparture(mc, candidate); pose = POSES.get(packet.source());
            }
            if (!(source instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity mob) || !source.getUUID().equals(packet.source())
                    || !source.isAlive() || packet.preview() && source.isInvisible() || pose == null || pose.level() != mc.level
                    || now - pose.captured() > 250_000_000L || pose.position().distanceToSqr(packet.position()) > 9
                    || pose.position().distanceToSqr(mc.player.position()) > 40 * 40) return;
            for (Vec3 position : packet.positions()) if (!finite(position)
                    || position.distanceToSqr(packet.position()) > 16 * 16
                    || position.distanceToSqr(mc.player.position()) > 40 * 40
                    || !mc.level.hasChunkAt(BlockPos.containing(position))) return;
            try {
                // One texture allocation per swarm, not one texture per copy.
                swarmTexture = SWARM_TEXTURES.get(pose.layers());
                if (swarmTexture == null) {
                    swarmTexture = mergeTexture(mc, pose.layers());
                    SWARM_TEXTURES.put(pose.layers(), swarmTexture);
                }
                for (int index = 0; index < packet.positions().size(); index++) {
                    Vec3 position = packet.positions().get(index);
                    Vec3 facing = packet.attention().subtract(position.add(0, mob.getEyeHeight(), 0));
                    float yaw = (float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(-facing.x, facing.z));
                    float pitch = (float) -Math.atan2(facing.y, Math.max(0.001, Math.hypot(facing.x, facing.z)));
                    HumanoidModel<BlindspotSplinterEntity> model = new HumanoidModel<>(mc.getEntityModels().bakeLayer(ModelLayers.PLAYER));
                    model.young = false;
                    ModelPart[] modelParts = parts(model);
                    for (int i = 0; i < modelParts.length; i++) {
                        modelParts[i].loadPose(pose.parts()[i]);
                        modelParts[i].visible = pose.visible()[i];
                        modelParts[i].skipDraw = pose.skip()[i];
                    }
                    // Natural copies freeze the departing body/head/limbs; previews retain fixed last-target facing.
                    if (packet.preview()) {
                        model.head.yRot = 0; model.head.xRot = Mth.clamp(pitch, -1.2F, 1.2F);
                        model.hat.loadPose(model.head.storePose());
                    } else yaw = pose.yaw();
                    Pose fixed = new Pose(pose.level(), pose.source(), position, yaw, pose.scale(),
                            pose.parts(), pose.visible(), pose.skip(), pose.layers(), pose.tick(), pose.captured());
                    GHOSTS.add(new Ghost(packet, fixed, model, swarmTexture,
                            now - Math.max(0L, mc.level.getGameTime() - packet.tick()) * 50_000_000L, index));
                }
                active = GHOSTS.get(0);
                if (!packet.preview()) {
                    CONCEALED.put(packet.source(),mc.level.getGameTime()+180);
                    mob.setInvisible(true); // The real model disappears in the very frame the copies become available.
                }
            } catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
                clearSwarm(now); retryAfter = now + 30_000_000_000L;
                com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger().warn("Blindspot swarm skipped: texture preparation failed", failure);
            }
        }

        private static Ghost visible(Minecraft mc) {
            maintain(mc);
            if (active == null) return null;
            long now = System.nanoTime();
            Entity source = mc.level == null ? null : mc.level.getEntity(active.packet().entityId());
            if (mc.player == null || !mc.player.isAlive() || mc.player.isSpectator()
                    || !(source instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity mob) || !mob.isAlive()
                    || active.packet().preview() && mob.isInvisible()
                    || !mob.getUUID().equals(active.packet().source())
                    || !active.packet().preview() && (mob.getEntityData().get(BlindspotSplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose) != 0
                            || mob.getTarget() != null && !mob.getTarget().getUUID().equals(active.packet().viewer()))
                    || now - active.born() >= duration(active)
                    || active.packet().position().distanceToSqr(mc.player.position()) > 48 * 48) clearSwarm(now);
            return active;
        }

        private static int color(Ghost ghost) {
            long remaining = duration(ghost) - (System.nanoTime() - ghost.born());
            float fade = Mth.clamp(remaining / (float) FADE_NANOS, 0.0F, 1.0F);
            // Hold the requested 90%-100% body opacity, then truly fade out over the final 0.4 seconds.
            float opacity = opacityForExperience(ghost.packet().experience()) * fade;
            return (Math.round(opacity * 255) << 24) | 0xFFFFFF;
        }

        private static void borrowedSteps(Minecraft mc) {
            if (active == null || active.packet().sound() < 0 || mc.level == null || mc.player == null || mc.isPaused()) return;
            long age = (System.nanoTime() - active.born()) / 50_000_000L;
            if (soundStep >= 3 || age < 8 + soundStep * 6) return;
            soundStep++;
            Vec3 position = active.packet().positions().get(active.packet().sound());
            Vec3 toward = position.add(0, 1.0, 0).subtract(mc.player.getEyePosition());
            if (toward.lengthSqr() < 1 || toward.lengthSqr() > 20 * 20
                    || mc.player.getLookAngle().dot(toward.normalize()) > 0.75) return;
            mc.level.playLocalSound(position.x, position.y, position.z,
                    net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.WOOD_STEP, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.HOSTILE,
                    0.35F, 0.95F, false);
        }

        private static void transform(PoseStack stack, Ghost ghost, Vec3 camera) {
            Vec3 position = ghost.pose().position();
            stack.translate(position.x - camera.x, position.y - camera.y, position.z - camera.z);
            stack.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(180.0F - ghost.pose().yaw()));
            float scale = ghost.pose().scale();
            stack.scale(-scale, -scale, scale);
            stack.translate(0.0, -1.501, 0.0);
        }



        @SubscribeEvent
        public static void render(RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
            if (event.getStage() != RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_PARTICLES) return;
            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
            visible(mc);
            if (GHOSTS.isEmpty() || swarmTexture == null) return;
            PoseStack stack = event.getPoseStack();
            RenderType type = RenderType.entityTranslucent(swarmTexture, false);
            var buffers = mc.renderBuffers().bufferSource();
            for (Ghost ghost : GHOSTS) {
                if (!appeared(ghost)) continue;
                stack.pushPose();
                try {
                    transform(stack, ghost, event.getCamera().getPosition());
                    ghost.model().renderToBuffer(stack, buffers.getBuffer(type),
                            LevelRenderer.getLightColor(mc.level, BlockPos.containing(ghost.pose().position())),
                            OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY, color(ghost));
                } finally { stack.popPose(); }
            }
            buffers.endBatch(type); // Flush one shared swarm texture, never other entities' geometry.
        }

        @SubscribeEvent
        public static void clientTick(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
            Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
            visible(mc);
            borrowedSteps(mc); // At most three local cues per swarm; never creates hostile entities.
        }

        private static ResourceLocation texture(String name) {
            return ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/" + name + ".png");
        }

        private static NativeImage read(Minecraft mc, String name) throws java.io.IOException {
            try (InputStream stream = mc.getResourceManager().open(texture(name))) {
                NativeImage image = NativeImage.read(stream);
                if (image.getWidth() < 1 || image.getHeight() < 1 || image.getWidth() > 1024 || image.getHeight() > 1024) {
                    image.close();
                    throw new java.io.IOException("Afterimage texture exceeds 1024x1024");
                }
                return image;
            }
        }

        private static int over(int below, int above) {
            // Independent low-byte channels: works for ABGR (1.21.1) and ARGB (26.1.2).
            int a = above >>> 24, b = below >>> 24;
            int out = a + (b * (255 - a) + 127) / 255;
            if (out == 0) return 0;
            int result = out << 24;
            for (int shift = 0; shift <= 16; shift += 8) {
                long numerator = (long) ((above >>> shift) & 255) * a * 255
                        + (long) ((below >>> shift) & 255) * b * (255 - a);
                int channel = (int) ((numerator + out * 127L) / (out * 255L));
                result |= Math.min(255, channel) << shift;
            }
            return result;
        }

        private static ResourceLocation mergeTexture(Minecraft mc, int mask) throws java.io.IOException {
            NativeImage merged = read(mc, "oak_biped");
            DynamicTexture dynamic = null;
            boolean registered = false;
            try {
                for (int layer = 0; layer < 9; layer++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << layer)) == 0) continue;
                    try (NativeImage overlay = read(mc, layer == 8 ? "rot_biped_base" : "rot_stage_" + layer)) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < merged.getHeight(); y++) {
                            for (int x = 0; x < merged.getWidth(); x++) {
                                int ox = x * overlay.getWidth() / merged.getWidth();
                                int oy = y * overlay.getHeight() / merged.getHeight();
                                merged.setPixelRGBA(x, y, over(merged.getPixelRGBA(x, y), overlay.getPixelRGBA(ox, oy)));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // One composited texture: rot layers cannot compound the requested 90% opacity.
                dynamic = new DynamicTexture(merged);
                ResourceLocation id = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:afterimage/" + (++textureSerial));
                mc.getTextureManager().register(id, dynamic);
                registered = true;
                return id;
            } finally {
                if (!registered) {
                    if (dynamic != null) dynamic.close();
                    else merged.close();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;

public class AmberGritBlock extends Block {
	public static final EnumProperty<Direction.Axis> AXIS = BlockStateProperties.AXIS;

	public AmberGritBlock() {
		super(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of().mapColor(MapColor.TERRACOTTA_LIGHT_GRAY).sound(SoundType.TUFF).strength(3f, 9f).requiresCorrectToolForDrops().instrument(NoteBlockInstrument.GUITAR));
		this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any().setValue(AXIS, Direction.Axis.Y));
	}

	@Override
	protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
		super.createBlockStateDefinition(builder);
		builder.add(AXIS);
	}

	@Override
	public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
		BlockState state = super.getStateForPlacement(context);
		if (state == null)
			return null;
		return state.setValue(AXIS, context.getClickedFace().getAxis());
	}

	@Override
	public BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rot) {
		return RotatedPillarBlock.rotatePillar(state, rot);
	}
}

	public BackwoodsPortalBlock() {

	@Override

	@Override

	public CrackedNullstoneBlock() {
		super(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of().mapColor(MapColor.METAL).sound(SoundType.EMPTY).strength(1.8f, 6f).requiresCorrectToolForDrops());
		this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any().setValue(FACING, Direction.NORTH));
	}

	@Override
	protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
		super.createBlockStateDefinition(builder);
		builder.add(FACING);
	}

	@Override
	public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
		BlockState state = super.getStateForPlacement(context);
		if (state == null)
			return null;
		return state.setValue(FACING, context.getHorizontalDirection().getOpposite());
	}

	public BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rot) {
		return state.setValue(FACING, rot.rotate(state.getValue(FACING)));
	}

	public BlockState mirror(BlockState state, Mirror mirrorIn) {
		return state.rotate(mirrorIn.getRotation(state.getValue(FACING)));
	}

	@Override
	public void onProjectileHit(Level world, BlockState blockstate, BlockHitResult hit, Projectile entity) {
		NullstoneOnBlockHitByProjectileProcedure.execute(world, hit.getBlockPos().getX(), hit.getBlockPos().getY(), hit.getBlockPos().getZ());
	}
}

public class NullstoneSlabBlock extends SlabBlock {
	public NullstoneSlabBlock() {
		super(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of().mapColor(MapColor.WOOL).sound(SoundType.EMPTY).strength(2.2f, 7.5f).requiresCorrectToolForDrops().instrument(NoteBlockInstrument.HAT));
	}

	@Override
	public void attack(BlockState blockstate, Level world, BlockPos pos, Player entity) {
		super.attack(blockstate, world, pos, entity);
		NullstonePlayerStartsToDestroyProcedure.execute(entity);
	}

	@Override

		NullstoneOnBlockHitByProjectileProcedure.execute(world, hit.getBlockPos().getX(), hit.getBlockPos().getY(), hit.getBlockPos().getZ());
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.block;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.DeferredSoundType;

import net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.NoteBlockInstrument;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.FenceBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

public class PetrifiedRottenOakFenceBlock extends FenceBlock {
	public PetrifiedRottenOakFenceBlock() {
		super(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of().mapColor(MapColor.TERRACOTTA_LIGHT_GRAY)
				.sound(new DeferredSoundType(1.0f, 1.0f, () -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.wood.break")), () -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rotten_planks_step")),
						() -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.cherry_wood.place")), () -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rotten_planks_break")),
						() -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.cherry_wood.place"))))
				.strength(10f, 7.6f).friction(0.8f).instrument(NoteBlockInstrument.DIDGERIDOO).forceSolidOn());
	}

	@Override
	public int getFlammability(BlockState state, BlockGetter world, BlockPos pos, Direction face) {
		return 1;
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.block;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.DeferredSoundType;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.OnlyIn;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;

import net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.NoteBlockInstrument;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.EnumProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BlockStateProperties;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.RotatedPillarBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.item.TooltipFlag;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

import java.util.List;

public class PetrifiedRottenOakLogBlock extends Block {
	public static final EnumProperty<Direction.Axis> AXIS = BlockStateProperties.AXIS;

	public PetrifiedRottenOakLogBlock() {
		super(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of().mapColor(MapColor.TERRACOTTA_WHITE)
				.sound(new DeferredSoundType(1.0f, 1.0f, () -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.wood.break")), () -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rotten_planks_step")),
						() -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.cherry_wood.place")), () -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rotten_planks_break")),
						() -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.cherry_wood.place"))))
				.strength(20f, 22.5f).friction(0.7f).instrument(NoteBlockInstrument.DIDGERIDOO));
		this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any().setValue(AXIS, Direction.Axis.Y));
	}

	@Override
	@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)
	public void appendHoverText(ItemStack itemstack, Item.TooltipContext context, List<Component> list, TooltipFlag flag) {
		super.appendHoverText(itemstack, context, list, flag);
		list.add(Component.translatable("block.the_backwoods.petrified_rotten_oak_log.description_0"));
	}

	@Override
	protected void createBlockStateDefinition(StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
		super.createBlockStateDefinition(builder);
		builder.add(AXIS);
	}

	@Override
	public BlockState getStateForPlacement(BlockPlaceContext context) {
		BlockState state = super.getStateForPlacement(context);
		if (state == null)
			return null;
		return state.setValue(AXIS, context.getClickedFace().getAxis());
	}

	@Override
	public BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rot) {
		return RotatedPillarBlock.rotatePillar(state, rot);
	}

	@Override
	public int getFlammability(BlockState state, BlockGetter world, BlockPos pos, Direction face) {
		return 1;
	}
}

				.strength(17f, 22f).friction(0.7f).instrument(NoteBlockInstrument.DIDGERIDOO));
		this.registerDefaultState(this.stateDefinition.any().setValue(AXIS, Direction.Axis.Y));
	}

	@Override

		super.createBlockStateDefinition(builder);
		builder.add(AXIS);

	}

	@Override
	public BlockState rotate(BlockState state, Rotation rot) {
		return RotatedPillarBlock.rotatePillar(state, rot);
	}

						() -> BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("block.cherry_wood.place"))))
				.strength(3f, 15f).friction(0.8f).randomTicks().ignitedByLava().instrument(NoteBlockInstrument.DIDGERIDOO));

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.block;

import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.PushReaction;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.SoundType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.FlowerBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelReader;
import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffects;
import net.minecraft.tags.BlockTags;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks;

public class SedgebrushBlock extends FlowerBlock {
	private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = box(0, 0, 0, 14, 16, 14);

	public SedgebrushBlock() {
		super(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SPEED, 100,
				BlockBehaviour.Properties.of().mapColor(MapColor.DIRT).sound(SoundType.GRASS).strength(0.3f, 0f).speedFactor(0.98f).jumpFactor(0.94f).noCollission().offsetType(BlockBehaviour.OffsetType.XZ).pushReaction(PushReaction.DESTROY));
	}

	@Override
	public VoxelShape getShape(BlockState state, BlockGetter world, BlockPos pos, CollisionContext context) {
		Vec3 offset = state.getOffset(world, pos);
		return SHAPE.move(offset.x, offset.y, offset.z);
	}

	@Override
	public int getFlammability(BlockState state, BlockGetter world, BlockPos pos, Direction face) {
		return 100;
	}

	@Override
	public int getFireSpreadSpeed(BlockState state, BlockGetter world, BlockPos pos, Direction face) {
		return 60;
	}

	@Override
	public boolean mayPlaceOn(BlockState groundState, BlockGetter worldIn, BlockPos pos) {
		return groundState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.PETRIFIED_ROTTEN_OAK_WOOD.get()) || groundState.is(BlockTags.create(ResourceLocation.parse("c:stones"))) || groundState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.FOSSILIZED_SILT.get());
	}

	@Override
	public boolean canSurvive(BlockState blockstate, LevelReader worldIn, BlockPos pos) {
		BlockPos blockpos = pos.below();
		BlockState groundState = worldIn.getBlockState(blockpos);
		return this.mayPlaceOn(groundState, worldIn, blockpos);
	}
}

	}

	@Override
	public boolean mayPlaceOn(BlockState groundState, BlockGetter worldIn, BlockPos pos) {
		return groundState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.PETRIFIED_ROTTEN_OAK_WOOD.get()) || groundState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.FOSSILIZED_SILT.get()) || groundState.is(BlockTags.create(ResourceLocation.parse("c:stones")));
	}

	@Override
	public boolean canSurvive(BlockState blockstate, LevelReader worldIn, BlockPos pos) {
		BlockPos blockpos = pos.below();
		BlockState groundState = worldIn.getBlockState(blockpos);
		if (blockstate.getValue(HALF) == DoubleBlockHalf.UPPER)
			return groundState.is(this) && groundState.getValue(HALF) == DoubleBlockHalf.LOWER;
		else
			return this.mayPlaceOn(groundState, worldIn, blockpos);
	}
}
