package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.boss.enderdragon.EndCrystal;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileWriter;

public class MonolithicOakWallFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    // ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN: Enable ONLY during workspace development if you need to generate JSONs for new biomes or initial testing.
    public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN = false;

    private static final BlockState PLANKS = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
    private static final BlockState AIR = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();

    static {
        if (ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) {
            autoGenerateDataPackJsons();
        }
    }

    public MonolithicOakWallFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    public static void autoGenerateDataPackJsons() {
        if (!ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) return;

        try {
            String[] candidateRoots = new String[] {
                "src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "../src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "../../src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "build/resources/main/data/the_backwoods"
            };

            for (String rootPath : candidateRoots) {
                File rootDir = new File(rootPath);
                File parent = rootDir.getParentFile();

                if (rootDir.exists() || (parent != null && parent.exists())) {
                    File confDir = new File(rootDir, "worldgen/configured_feature");
                    confDir.mkdirs();
                    File confFile = new File(confDir, "monolithic_oak_wall.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(confFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"type\": \"the_backwoods:monolithic_oak_wall\",\n  \"config\": {}\n}");
                    }

                    File placedDir = new File(rootDir, "worldgen/placed_feature");
                    placedDir.mkdirs();
                    File placedFile = new File(placedDir, "monolithic_oak_wall_placed.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(placedFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"feature\": \"the_backwoods:monolithic_oak_wall\",\n  \"placement\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:in_square\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:heightmap\",\n      \"heightmap\": \"WORLD_SURFACE_WG\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:biome\"\n    }\n  ]\n}");
                    }

                    File biomeDir = new File(rootDir, "neoforge/biome_modifier");
                    biomeDir.mkdirs();
                    File biomeFile = new File(biomeDir, "add_monolithic_oak_wall.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(biomeFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"type\": \"neoforge:add_features\",\n  \"biomes\": [\n    \"the_backwoods:wood_plains\",\n    \"the_backwoods:deep_backwoods\",\n    \"the_backwoods:the_thicket\"\n  ],\n  \"features\": \"the_backwoods:monolithic_oak_wall_placed\",\n  \"step\": \"surface_structures\"\n}");
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level = context.level();
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        RandomSource random = context.random();

        int absX = Math.abs(origin.getX());
        int absZ = Math.abs(origin.getZ());

        boolean onXWall = (absX >= 250000 && absX <= 250070);
        boolean onZWall = (absZ >= 250000 && absZ <= 250070);

        if (!onXWall && !onZWall) {
            return false;
        }

        // Strict current chunk bounds
        int chunkMinX = origin.getX() & ~15;
        int chunkMinZ = origin.getZ() & ~15;

        long chunkSeed = (long) origin.getX() * 341873128712L + (long) origin.getZ() * 132897987541L;
        random.setSeed(chunkSeed);

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mutablePos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        // 6 to 10 compressed overlapping buildings per chunk
        int buildingCount = 6 + random.nextInt(5);

        for (int b = 0; b < buildingCount; b++) {
            int widthX = 5 + random.nextInt(6); // 5 to 10
            int widthZ = 5 + random.nextInt(6); // 5 to 10
            int height = 10 + random.nextInt(61); // 10 to 70

            int minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ;

            // Anchor edge buildings specifically to chunk borders to guarantee zero gaps between chunks
            if (b == 0) {
                minX = chunkMinX;
                maxX = minX + widthX - 1;
                minZ = chunkMinZ + random.nextInt(Math.max(1, 16 - widthZ));
                maxZ = minZ + widthZ - 1;
            } else if (b == 1) {
                maxX = chunkMinX + 15;
                minX = maxX - widthX + 1;
                minZ = chunkMinZ + random.nextInt(Math.max(1, 16 - widthZ));
                maxZ = minZ + widthZ - 1;
            } else if (b == 2) {
                minZ = chunkMinZ;
                maxZ = minZ + widthZ - 1;
                minX = chunkMinX + random.nextInt(Math.max(1, 16 - widthX));
                maxX = minX + widthX - 1;
            } else if (b == 3) {
                maxZ = chunkMinZ + 15;
                minZ = maxZ - widthZ + 1;
                minX = chunkMinX + random.nextInt(Math.max(1, 16 - widthX));
                maxX = minX + widthX - 1;
            } else {
                minX = chunkMinX + random.nextInt(Math.max(1, 16 - widthX));
                maxX = minX + widthX - 1;
                minZ = chunkMinZ + random.nextInt(Math.max(1, 16 - widthZ));
                maxZ = minZ + widthZ - 1;
            }

            int startY = origin.getY();
            int roofY = startY + height;
            boolean isHollow = random.nextFloat() < 0.30f;

            // 1. Deep Ground Foundation
            for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
                for (int z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++) {
                    mutablePos.set(x, startY, z);
                    level.setBlock(mutablePos, PLANKS, 2);

                    for (int down = 1; down <= 32; down++) {
                        mutablePos.set(x, startY - down, z);
                        BlockState underState = level.getBlockState(mutablePos);
                        if (underState.isAir() || underState.canBeReplaced()) {
                            level.setBlock(mutablePos, PLANKS, 2);
                        } else {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // 2. Build Monolithic Tower Structure
            for (int y = 1; y <= height; y++) {
                int currentY = startY + y;
                boolean isRoof = (y == height);

                for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
                    for (int z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++) {
                        mutablePos.set(x, currentY, z);

                        if (isRoof) {
                            level.setBlock(mutablePos, PLANKS, 2);
                        } else if (isHollow) {
                            boolean isOuterWall = (x == minX || x == maxX || z == minZ || z == maxZ);
                            if (isOuterWall) {
                                level.setBlock(mutablePos, PLANKS, 2);
                            } else {
                                level.setBlock(mutablePos, AIR, 2);
                            }
                        } else {
                            level.setBlock(mutablePos, PLANKS, 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // 3. End Crystal Apex (+1 block height above roof)
            int bCenterX = (minX + maxX) / 2;
            int bCenterZ = (minZ + maxZ) / 2;

            mutablePos.set(bCenterX, roofY + 1, bCenterZ);
            level.setBlock(mutablePos, AIR, 2);
            mutablePos.set(bCenterX, roofY + 2, bCenterZ);
            level.setBlock(mutablePos, AIR, 2);

            EndCrystal crystal = new EndCrystal(EntityType.END_CRYSTAL, level.getLevel());
            crystal.setPos(bCenterX + 0.5, roofY + 1.0, bCenterZ + 0.5);
            crystal.setShowBottom(false);
            level.addFreshEntity(crystal);
        }

        return true;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.network;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.NeoForgeRegistries;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredRegister;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.handling.IPayloadContext;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.PlayerTickEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.INBTSerializable;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.attachment.AttachmentType;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;

import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.PacketFlow;
import net.minecraft.network.codec.StreamCodec;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.TheBackwoodsMod;

import java.util.function.Supplier;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class TheBackwoodsModVariables {
	public static final DeferredRegister<AttachmentType<?>> ATTACHMENT_TYPES = DeferredRegister.create(NeoForgeRegistries.Keys.ATTACHMENT_TYPES, TheBackwoodsMod.MODID);
	public static final Supplier<AttachmentType<PlayerVariables>> PLAYER_VARIABLES = ATTACHMENT_TYPES.register("player_variables", () -> AttachmentType.serializable(PlayerVariables::new).build());

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		TheBackwoodsMod.addNetworkMessage(PlayerVariablesSyncMessage.TYPE, PlayerVariablesSyncMessage.STREAM_CODEC, PlayerVariablesSyncMessage::handleData);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onPlayerLoggedInSyncPlayerVariables(PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedInEvent event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)
			PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player, new PlayerVariablesSyncMessage(player.getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES)));
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onPlayerRespawnedSyncPlayerVariables(PlayerEvent.PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)
			PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player, new PlayerVariablesSyncMessage(player.getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES)));
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onPlayerChangedDimensionSyncPlayerVariables(PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player)
			PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player, new PlayerVariablesSyncMessage(player.getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES)));
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onPlayerTickUpdateSyncPlayerVariables(PlayerTickEvent.Post event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player && player.getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES)._syncDirty) {
			PacketDistributor.sendToPlayer(player, new PlayerVariablesSyncMessage(player.getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES)));
			player.getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES)._syncDirty = false;
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clonePlayer(PlayerEvent.Clone event) {
		PlayerVariables original = event.getOriginal().getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES);
		PlayerVariables clone = new PlayerVariables();
		clone.music_stopped_s2 = original.music_stopped_s2;
		clone.music_stopped_s3 = original.music_stopped_s3;
		clone.music_stopped_s4 = original.music_stopped_s4;
		clone.dayIncrementedToday = original.dayIncrementedToday;
		clone.daysInFamiliar = original.daysInFamiliar;
		clone.lossProgress = original.lossProgress;
		clone.lossTimer = original.lossTimer;
		clone.backwoods_adaptation = original.backwoods_adaptation;
		clone.fade_level = original.fade_level;
		if (!event.isWasDeath()) {
		}
		event.getEntity().setData(PLAYER_VARIABLES, clone);
	}

	public static class PlayerVariables implements INBTSerializable<CompoundTag> {
		boolean _syncDirty = false;
		public double music_stopped_s2 = 0;
		public double music_stopped_s3 = 0;
		public double music_stopped_s4 = 0;
		public boolean dayIncrementedToday = false;
		public double daysInFamiliar = 0;
		public double lossProgress = 0.0;
		public double lossTimer = 0;
		public double backwoods_adaptation = 0;
		public double fade_level = 0;

		@Override
		public CompoundTag serializeNBT(HolderLookup.Provider lookupProvider) {
			CompoundTag nbt = new CompoundTag();
			nbt.putDouble("music_stopped_s2", music_stopped_s2);
			nbt.putDouble("music_stopped_s3", music_stopped_s3);
			nbt.putDouble("music_stopped_s4", music_stopped_s4);
			nbt.putBoolean("dayIncrementedToday", dayIncrementedToday);
			nbt.putDouble("daysInFamiliar", daysInFamiliar);
			nbt.putDouble("lossProgress", lossProgress);
			nbt.putDouble("lossTimer", lossTimer);
			nbt.putDouble("backwoods_adaptation", backwoods_adaptation);
			nbt.putDouble("fade_level", fade_level);
			return nbt;
		}

		@Override
		public void deserializeNBT(HolderLookup.Provider lookupProvider, CompoundTag nbt) {
			music_stopped_s2 = nbt.getDouble("music_stopped_s2");
			music_stopped_s3 = nbt.getDouble("music_stopped_s3");
			music_stopped_s4 = nbt.getDouble("music_stopped_s4");
			dayIncrementedToday = nbt.getBoolean("dayIncrementedToday");
			daysInFamiliar = nbt.getDouble("daysInFamiliar");
			lossProgress = nbt.getDouble("lossProgress");
			lossTimer = nbt.getDouble("lossTimer");
			backwoods_adaptation = nbt.getDouble("backwoods_adaptation");
			fade_level = nbt.getDouble("fade_level");
		}

		public void markSyncDirty() {
			_syncDirty = true;
		}
	}

	public record PlayerVariablesSyncMessage(PlayerVariables data) implements CustomPacketPayload {
		public static final Type<PlayerVariablesSyncMessage> TYPE = new Type<>(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(TheBackwoodsMod.MODID, "player_variables_sync"));
		public static final StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf, PlayerVariablesSyncMessage> STREAM_CODEC = StreamCodec
				.of((RegistryFriendlyByteBuf buffer, PlayerVariablesSyncMessage message) -> buffer.writeNbt(message.data().serializeNBT(buffer.registryAccess())), (RegistryFriendlyByteBuf buffer) -> {
					PlayerVariablesSyncMessage message = new PlayerVariablesSyncMessage(new PlayerVariables());
					message.data.deserializeNBT(buffer.registryAccess(), buffer.readNbt());
					return message;
				});

		@Override
		public Type<PlayerVariablesSyncMessage> type() {
			return TYPE;
		}

		public static void handleData(final PlayerVariablesSyncMessage message, final IPayloadContext context) {
			if (context.flow() == PacketFlow.CLIENTBOUND && message.data != null) {
				context.enqueueWork(() -> context.player().getData(PLAYER_VARIABLES).deserializeNBT(context.player().registryAccess(), message.data.serializeNBT(context.player().registryAccess()))).exceptionally(e -> {
					context.connection().disconnect(Component.literal(e.getMessage()));
					return null;
				});
			}
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.boss.enderdragon.EndCrystal;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.StairBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.StairsShape;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class OakPyramidFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {
    public OakPyramidFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level = context.level();
        // Anchor at the center of the generating chunk (offset 8, 8)
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        BlockPos center = new BlockPos((origin.getX() & ~15) + 8, origin.getY(), (origin.getZ() & ~15) + 8);
        RandomSource random = context.random();

        // Single deterministic chunk seed
        long chunkSeed = (long) center.getX() * 341873128712L + (long) center.getZ() * 132897987541L;
        random.setSeed(chunkSeed);

        // Pre-cached BlockStates
        BlockState PLANKS = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState AIR = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();

        // 4 Straight Stairs (Outward facing steps)
        BlockState STAIR_N = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.SOUTH)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.STRAIGHT);
        BlockState STAIR_S = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.STRAIGHT);
        BlockState STAIR_E = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.WEST)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.STRAIGHT);
        BlockState STAIR_W = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.EAST)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.STRAIGHT);

        // 4 Mitered Outer Corner Stairs
        BlockState CORNER_NW = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.SOUTH)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.OUTER_LEFT);
        BlockState CORNER_NE = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.SOUTH)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.OUTER_RIGHT);
        BlockState CORNER_SW = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.OUTER_RIGHT);
        BlockState CORNER_SE = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.NORTH)
                .setValue(StairBlock.SHAPE, StairsShape.OUTER_LEFT);

        // Base size between 24 and 30 blocks (halfSize 12 to 15 blocks)
        // Fits entirely within the generating chunk + 1 chunk buffer with zero chunk boundary clipping
        int halfSize = 12 + random.nextInt(4); // 12, 13, 14, 15 (24x24 to 30x30 base)
        int height = halfSize;
        int startY = center.getY();

        // 1. Solid Oak Planks Foundation Floor & Deep Ground Seal
        for (int x = -halfSize; x <= halfSize; x++) {
            for (int z = -halfSize; z <= halfSize; z++) {
                BlockPos floorPos = center.offset(x, 0, z);
                level.setBlock(floorPos, PLANKS, 2);

                // Extrude solid support downwards into the ground so it never floats on slopes
                for (int down = 1; down <= 32; down++) {
                    BlockPos under = floorPos.below(down);
                    BlockState underState = level.getBlockState(under);
                    if (underState.isAir() || underState.canBeReplaced()) {
                        level.setBlock(under, PLANKS, 2);
                    } else {
                        break; // Solid ground reached
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Build Stepped Pyramid Shell Layer by Layer (Unified Single-Pass)
        for (int levelY = 0; levelY < height; levelY++) {
            int currentExtent = halfSize - levelY;
            if (currentExtent < 0) break;

            int currentY = startY + 1 + levelY;

            for (int x = -currentExtent; x <= currentExtent; x++) {
                for (int z = -currentExtent; z <= currentExtent; z++) {
                    BlockPos targetPos = new BlockPos(center.getX() + x, currentY, center.getZ() + z);

                    boolean isNorth = (z == -currentExtent);
                    boolean isSouth = (z == currentExtent);
                    boolean isWest  = (x == -currentExtent);
                    boolean isEast  = (x == currentExtent);

                    boolean isOuterShell = isNorth || isSouth || isWest || isEast;
                    boolean isInnerWall = (Math.abs(x) == currentExtent - 1 && Math.abs(z) <= currentExtent - 1)
                                       || (Math.abs(z) == currentExtent - 1 && Math.abs(x) <= currentExtent - 1);

                    if (isOuterShell) {
                        // Place seamless connected outer stairs
                        if (isNorth && isWest) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, CORNER_NW, 2);
                        } else if (isNorth && isEast) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, CORNER_NE, 2);
                        } else if (isSouth && isWest) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, CORNER_SW, 2);
                        } else if (isSouth && isEast) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, CORNER_SE, 2);
                        } else if (isNorth) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, STAIR_N, 2);
                        } else if (isSouth) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, STAIR_S, 2);
                        } else if (isWest) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, STAIR_W, 2);
                        } else if (isEast) {
                            level.setBlock(targetPos, STAIR_E, 2);
                        }
                    } else if (isInnerWall) {
                        // Oak planks backing inside the shell
                        level.setBlock(targetPos, PLANKS, 2);
                    } else {
                        // Clear hollow interior chamber
                        level.setBlock(targetPos, AIR, 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Clear center column & spawn End Crystal 2 blocks above floor
        BlockPos centerFloor = center.above();
        level.setBlock(centerFloor, AIR, 2);
        level.setBlock(centerFloor.above(), AIR, 2);
        level.setBlock(centerFloor.above(2), AIR, 2);

        EndCrystal crystal = EntityType.END_CRYSTAL.create(level.getLevel());
        if (crystal != null) {
            crystal.setPos(center.getX() + 0.5, startY + 2.0, center.getZ() + 0.5);
            crystal.setShowBottom(false);
            level.addFreshEntity(crystal);
        }

        return true;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.features;

import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;

public class OakStalactiteFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {
    public OakStalactiteFeature() {
        super(NoneFeatureConfiguration.CODEC);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel world = context.level();
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        RandomSource random = context.random();

        // Ensure we are placing under a solid ceiling
        if (!world.getBlockState(origin.above()).isSolidRender(world, origin.above())) {
            return false;
        }

        // ==========================================
        //         REFINED STALACTITE SETTINGS
        // ==========================================
        int minHeight = 8;        
        int heightVariation = 12; 
        float baseRadius = 1.2f + random.nextFloat() * 1.8f; // Slightly tightened max base
        float roughness = 0.35f;
        int maxAnchorDepth = 5;   
        // ==========================================

        int height = minHeight + random.nextInt(heightVariation);
        BlockState logBlock = Blocks.OAK_LOG.defaultBlockState();

        // 1. ANCHOR / BLENDING (Grows UP into the ceiling with an inverse taper)
		// 1. Anchor/Blending (Grow Upward into ceiling)
		int anchorRange = (int) Math.ceil(baseRadius);
		for (int x = -anchorRange; x <= anchorRange; x++) {
		    for (int z = -anchorRange; z <= anchorRange; z++) {
		        if (x * x + z * z <= (baseRadius * baseRadius)) {
		            for (int dy = 0; dy <= maxAnchorDepth; dy++) {
		                BlockPos checkPos = origin.above(dy).offset(x, 0, z);
		                
		                // CRITICAL FIX: If the block ABOVE checkPos is air, we are at the surface!
		                // Break immediately BEFORE placing the log so it never pops out on the floor.
		                if (world.isEmptyBlock(checkPos.above())) {
		                    break; 
		                }
		
		                // Force place logs into the ceiling to break up the flat plank texture safely
		                world.setBlock(checkPos, logBlock, 2);
		            }
		        }
		    }
		}

        // 2. MAIN BODY (Grows DOWN from the ceiling)
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            float progress = (float) y / height;
            
            // Replaced the sharp Math.pow with a smoother cosine interpolation for the top transition,
            // then tapering thin near the tip.
            float targetRadius = baseRadius * (float) Math.pow(1.0f - progress, 1.3f);
            
            // Smooth out the immediate transition at y = 0 to prevent the lip
            if (y == 0) targetRadius *= 0.9f; 
            if (y == 1) targetRadius *= 0.95f;

            if (targetRadius < 0.1f) break;

            int loopRange = (int) Math.ceil(targetRadius + roughness);
            for (int x = -loopRange; x <= loopRange; x++) {
                for (int z = -loopRange; z <= loopRange; z++) {
                    float noise = (float) (Math.sin(x * 1.5 - y) * Math.cos(z * 1.5 - y)) * roughness;
                    if (x * x + z * z <= (targetRadius + noise) * (targetRadius + noise)) {
                        BlockPos pos = origin.below(y).offset(x, 0, z);
                        
                        // Only replace air, non-solid, or fluid blocks so it doesn't delete floors
                        if (world.isEmptyBlock(pos) || !world.getBlockState(pos).isSolidRender(world, pos)) {
                            world.setBlock(pos, logBlock, 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

================================================
File: src/main/java/net/mcreator/thebackwoods/PlaqueTreeFeature.java
================================================
package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class PlaqueTreeFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    // ==========================================
    // TREE CONFIGURATION
    // Adjust this multiplier to change the overall size of the tree.
    // 1.0f = Standard Bonsai Size (Previous version)
    // 1.5f = 50% Larger (Current setting)
    // 2.0f = Double Size (Massive)
    private static final float SIZE_SCALE = 1.5f; 
    // ==========================================

    public PlaqueTreeFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level = context.level();
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        RandomSource random = context.random();

        BlockState plaqueState = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK
            .getOptional(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("the_backwoods", "plaque"))
            .orElse(Blocks.OAK_LOG)
            .defaultBlockState();

        BlockPos startPos = level.getHeightmapPos(net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, origin);
        if (startPos.getY() <= level.getMinBuildHeight() || startPos.getY() >= level.getMaxBuildHeight() - (50 * SIZE_SCALE)) {
            return false;
        }

        // 1. Root Anchors
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            double rootAngle = (Math.PI / 2.0) * i + (random.nextDouble() * 0.5);
            int rootLen = (int) ((random.nextInt(3) + 3) * SIZE_SCALE);
            BlockPos rootEnd = startPos.offset(
                (int) (Math.cos(rootAngle) * rootLen),
                (int) (-2 * SIZE_SCALE),
                (int) (Math.sin(rootAngle) * rootLen)
            );
            List<BlockPos> rootPath = interpolateBezier(startPos, startPos.above(1), rootEnd, (int) (8 * SIZE_SCALE));
            for (int r = 0; r < rootPath.size(); r++) {
                float rad = (1.5f * SIZE_SCALE) * (1.0f - ((float) r / rootPath.size()));
                placeSphere(level, rootPath.get(r), plaqueState, rad, 1.0);
            }
        }

        // 2. Elegant S-Curve Trunk
        int trunkHeight = (int) ((random.nextInt(6) + 22) * SIZE_SCALE); 
        double leanAngle = random.nextDouble() * 2 * Math.PI;
        int maxLean = (int) ((random.nextInt(4) + 10) * SIZE_SCALE); 

        // Control point pushes out, end point curves heavily back in
        BlockPos p0 = startPos;
        BlockPos p1 = startPos.above((int) (trunkHeight * 0.45)).offset(
            (int) (Math.cos(leanAngle) * maxLean),
            0,
            (int) (Math.sin(leanAngle) * maxLean)
        );
        BlockPos p2 = startPos.above(trunkHeight).offset(
            (int) (Math.cos(leanAngle) * (maxLean * 0.2)), 
            0,
            (int) (Math.sin(leanAngle) * (maxLean * 0.2))
        );

        // Increase interpolation steps based on scale to avoid block gaps on huge trees
        List<BlockPos> trunkPath = interpolateBezier(p0, p1, p2, (int) (40 * Math.max(1.0f, SIZE_SCALE)));

        for (int i = 0; i < trunkPath.size(); i++) {
            float progress = (float) i / trunkPath.size();
            float currentRadius = (2.0f * SIZE_SCALE) * (1.0f - progress) + (0.8f * SIZE_SCALE) * progress;
            placeSphere(level, trunkPath.get(i), plaqueState, currentRadius, 1.0);
        }

        // 3. Upward-Arching Thin Boughs
        int numBranches = random.nextInt(2) + 4; // 4 to 5 main branches
        double currentAngle = leanAngle + Math.PI; // Start opposite to trunk lean

        for (int b = 0; b < numBranches; b++) {
            float progress = 0.35f + (0.55f * ((float) b / Math.max(1, numBranches - 1)));
            int trunkIdx = (int) (trunkPath.size() * progress);
            if (trunkIdx >= trunkPath.size()) continue;

            BlockPos bStart = trunkPath.get(trunkIdx);
            
            // Spiral around the tree
            currentAngle += (Math.PI / 1.8) + (random.nextDouble() * 0.5);
            
            int bLength = (int) ((random.nextInt(5) + 9) * SIZE_SCALE); 
            int bHeight = (int) ((random.nextInt(4) + 5) * SIZE_SCALE); 

            BlockPos bEnd = bStart.offset(
                (int) (Math.cos(currentAngle) * bLength),
                bHeight,
                (int) (Math.sin(currentAngle) * bLength)
            );
            
            BlockPos bMid = bStart.above(bHeight / 2).offset(
                (int) (Math.cos(currentAngle) * (bLength * 0.5)),
                0,
                (int) (Math.sin(currentAngle) * (bLength * 0.5))
            );

            List<BlockPos> branchPath = interpolateBezier(bStart, bMid, bEnd, (int) (20 * Math.max(1.0f, SIZE_SCALE)));
            
            float branchBaseRadius = (1.2f * SIZE_SCALE) * (1.0f - progress) + (0.5f * SIZE_SCALE);

            for (int i = 0; i < branchPath.size(); i++) {
                float bProgress = (float) i / branchPath.size();
                float bRad = branchBaseRadius * (1.0f - bProgress) + (0.4f * SIZE_SCALE) * bProgress;
                placeSphere(level, branchPath.get(i), plaqueState, bRad, 1.0);
            }

            // Distribute wide, flat canopy pads at the ends
            buildFluffyCanopy(level, bEnd, plaqueState, random);
        }

        // Hanging twisted detail branch
        int hangIndex = (int) (trunkPath.size() * 0.45f);
        if (hangIndex < trunkPath.size()) {
            BlockPos hangStart = trunkPath.get(hangIndex);
            BlockPos hangEnd = hangStart.offset(0, (int) (-5 * SIZE_SCALE), 0).offset(
                (int) (Math.cos(leanAngle - Math.PI/2) * (3 * SIZE_SCALE)), 
                0, 
                (int) (Math.sin(leanAngle - Math.PI/2) * (3 * SIZE_SCALE))
            );
            List<BlockPos> hangPath = interpolateBezier(hangStart, hangStart.offset(1, (int) (-2 * SIZE_SCALE), 1), hangEnd, (int) (12 * SIZE_SCALE));
            for (BlockPos hp : hangPath) {
                placeSphere(level, hp, plaqueState, 0.6f * SIZE_SCALE, 1.0);
            }
        }

        // Crown Main Canopy
        buildFluffyCanopy(level, trunkPath.get(trunkPath.size() - 1), plaqueState, random);

        return true;
    }

    private void buildFluffyCanopy(WorldGenLevel level, BlockPos center, BlockState state, RandomSource random) {
        int numBlobs = random.nextInt(3) + 4; // 4 to 6 clusters per pad
        for (int i = 0; i < numBlobs; i++) {
            int offsetX = (int) ((random.nextInt(9) - 4) * SIZE_SCALE); 
            int offsetY = (int) ((random.nextInt(3) - 1) * SIZE_SCALE); 
            int offsetZ = (int) ((random.nextInt(9) - 4) * SIZE_SCALE);
            float blobRadius = (random.nextFloat() * 1.5f + 3.0f) * SIZE_SCALE; 
            
            placeCanopyBlob(level, center.offset(offsetX, offsetY, offsetZ), state, blobRadius, random);
        }
    }

    private void placeCanopyBlob(WorldGenLevel level, BlockPos center, BlockState state, float radius, RandomSource random) {
        int r = (int) Math.ceil(radius);
        
        // Scale the flat-bottom boundary limits based on our size config
        int yMin = (int) Math.floor(-1.0 * SIZE_SCALE);
        int yMax = (int) Math.ceil(2.5 * SIZE_SCALE);

        for (int x = -r; x <= r; x++) {
            for (int y = yMin; y <= yMax; y++) { 
                for (int z = -r; z <= r; z++) {
                    // Squashes the Y axis. Bottom is flat (weight 5.0), top is slightly domed (weight 2.5)
                    double yWeight = (y > 0) ? (y * y * 2.5) : (y * y * 5.0);
                    double distSq = x * x + yWeight + z * z; 
                    
                    if (distSq <= radius * radius) {
                        placeIfReplaceable(level, center.offset(x, y, z), state);
                    }
                    
                    // Sparse hanging bits for texture
                    if (y == yMin && distSq > radius * radius * 0.4 && distSq <= radius * radius) {
                        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.15f) {
                            placeIfReplaceable(level, center.offset(x, yMin - 1, z), state);
                            if (random.nextBoolean()) {
                                placeIfReplaceable(level, center.offset(x, yMin - 2, z), state);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void placeSphere(WorldGenLevel level, BlockPos center, BlockState state, float radius, double yScale) {
        int r = (int) Math.ceil(radius);
        if (r == 0) r = 1; 
        for (int x = -r; x <= r; x++) {
            for (int y = -r; y <= r; y++) {
                for (int z = -r; z <= r; z++) {
                    if (x * x + (y * y / yScale) + z * z <= radius * radius) {
                        placeIfReplaceable(level, center.offset(x, y, z), state);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void placeIfReplaceable(WorldGenLevel level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (level.getBlockState(pos).isAir() || level.getBlockState(pos).canBeReplaced()) {
            level.setBlock(pos, state, 2);
        }
    }

    private List<BlockPos> interpolateBezier(BlockPos p0, BlockPos p1, BlockPos p2, int steps) {
        List<BlockPos> points = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
            double t = i / (double) steps;
            double u = 1.0 - t;

            double x = u * u * p0.getX() + 2 * u * t * p1.getX() + t * t * p2.getX();
            double y = u * u * p0.getY() + 2 * u * t * p1.getY() + t * t * p2.getY();
            double z = u * u * p0.getZ() + 2 * u * t * p1.getZ() + t * t * p2.getZ();

            BlockPos pos = new BlockPos((int) Math.round(x), (int) Math.round(y), (int) Math.round(z));
            if (points.isEmpty() || !points.get(points.size() - 1).equals(pos)) {
                points.add(pos);
            }
        }
        return points;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.items.IItemHandlerModifiable;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.Capabilities;

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks;

public class AntiObsidianProcedure {
	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null)
			return;
		double slot = 0;
		double itemCount = 0;
		slot = 0;
		if (entity.getCapability(Capabilities.ItemHandler.ENTITY, null) instanceof IItemHandlerModifiable _modHandlerIter) {
			for (int _idx = 0; _idx < _modHandlerIter.getSlots(); _idx++) {
				ItemStack itemstackiterator = _modHandlerIter.getStackInSlot(_idx).copy();
				itemCount = itemstackiterator.getCount();
				if (itemstackiterator.getItem() == Blocks.OBSIDIAN.asItem()) {

	// BEGIN TYPO MATCHER: pure, bounded parsing; never searches for commands inside a sentence.
	private static final class ChatCommandMatcher {

			"didnt mean to hit you".split(" "), "didnt mean to hurt you".split(" ")
		};
		private static final String[][] PHRASES = {
			{"follow", "follow"}, {"follow me", "follow"}, {"come here", "follow"},
			{"stay", "stay"}, {"stay here", "stay"}, {"wait here", "stay"},
			{"watch", "watch"}, {"watch my back", "watch"},
			{"help me", "help me"}, {"protect me", "help me"}, {"status", "status"},
			{"this is home", "this is home"}, {"this is our home", "this is home"},
			{"remember this place", "this is home"},
			{"this is our camp", "this is home"}, {"this is our base", "this is home"},
			{"this is a watchtower", "this is home"},
			{"this is also home", "this is also home"}, {"remember this area too", "this is also home"},
			{"stay home", "stay home"}, {"stay at home", "stay home"},
			{"forget home", "forget home"}, {"forget this home", "forget home"},
			{"home status", "home status"}, {"restore home", "restore home"}
		};
		private static final String[][] WORDS = new String[PHRASES.length][];
		static {
			for (int i = 0; i < PHRASES.length; i++) WORDS[i] = PHRASES[i][0].split(" ");
		}

		static String match(String rawText) {
			if (rawText == null || rawText.length() > 96) return null;
			String text = rawText.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
			int end = text.length();
			while (end > 0 && ".!?".indexOf(text.charAt(end - 1)) >= 0) end--;
			StringBuilder normalized = new StringBuilder(end);
			boolean space = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < end; i++) {
				char ch = text.charAt(i);
				if (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') { normalized.append(ch); space = false; }
				else if ((ch == '\'' || ch == '\u2019') && i > 0 && i + 1 < end
						&& text.charAt(i - 1) >= 'a' && text.charAt(i - 1) <= 'z'
						&& text.charAt(i + 1) >= 'a' && text.charAt(i + 1) <= 'z') { /* I'm -> im */ }
				else if (ch == ' ' || ch == '\t' || ch == ',' || ch == ':') {
					if (!space) { normalized.append(' '); space = true; }
				} else return null; // Quoted commands, hidden characters, slash commands and other scripts are not guessed.
			}
			String command = normalized.toString().trim();
			if (command.isEmpty()) return null;
			String[] tokens = command.split(" ");
			int skip = 0;
			if (tokens.length > 2 && tokens[0].equals("ash") && isAddress(tokens[1])) skip = 2;
			else if (tokens.length > 1 && (isAddress(tokens[0]) || tokens[0].equals("ashweaver"))) skip = 1;
			if (skip > 0) command = String.join(" ", java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(tokens, skip, tokens.length));
			if (isApology(command, skip > 0)) return "apologize";
			for (String[] phrase : PHRASES) if (phrase[0].equals(command)) return phrase[1];
			// Exact unaddressed commands remain compatible; typo correction requires a clear addressee.
			if (skip == 0) return null;
			String[] input = java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(tokens, skip, tokens.length);
			int best = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
			String winner = null;
			boolean ambiguous = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < PHRASES.length; i++) {
				String[] expected = WORDS[i];
				if (input.length != expected.length) continue;
				String action = PHRASES[i][1];
				if (action.equals("forget home") || action.equals("restore home")) continue; // Memory changes must be exact.
				boolean home = action.contains("home");
				int allowance = home || PHRASES[i][0].length() < 14 ? 1 : 2;
				int score = 0;
				for (int word = 0; word < input.length; word++) {
					String wanted = expected[word];
					String actual = input[word];
					if (wanted.equals(actual)) continue;
					// Short words carry meaning: never turn "say" into "stay" or "some" into "home".
					if (wanted.length() <= 3 || wanted.length() == 4 && !shortTypo(actual, wanted)) {
						score = allowance + 1; break;
					}
					int limit = wanted.length() >= 8 && !home ? 2 : 1;
					int edits = distance(actual, wanted, limit);
					if (edits > limit) { score = allowance + 1; break; }
					score += edits;
					if (score > allowance) break;
				}
				if (score > allowance) continue;
				if (score < best) { best = score; winner = action; ambiguous = false; }
				else if (score == best && !action.equals(winner)) ambiguous = true;
			}
			return ambiguous ? null : winner;
		}


		private static boolean isApology(String command, boolean addressed) {
			String[] input = command.split(" ");
			int first = 0, last = input.length;
			if (first < last && (input[first].equals("hey") || input[first].equals("hi"))) first++;
			if (last - first >= 3 && input[first].equals("ash") && isAddress(input[first + 1])) {
				first += 2; addressed = true;
			} else if (last - first >= 2 && (isAddress(input[first]) || input[first].equals("ashweaver"))) {
				first++; addressed = true;
			}
			if (last - first >= 3 && input[last - 2].equals("ash") && isAddress(input[last - 1])) {
				last -= 2; addressed = true;
			} else if (last - first >= 2 && (isAddress(input[last - 1]) || input[last - 1].equals("ashweaver"))) {
				last--; addressed = true;
			}
			if (first < last && input[first].equals("please")) first++;
			if (first < last && input[last - 1].equals("please")) last--;
			if (first < last && (input[last - 1].equals("buddy") || input[last - 1].equals("friend")
					|| input[last - 1].equals("dude"))) last--;
			if (last - first <= 0 || last - first > 10) return false;
			// Whole phrases only: "not sorry", quotes and unrelated sentences cannot become apologies.
			if (addressed && last - first == 1 && input[first].equals("mb")) return true;
			for (String[] phrase : APOLOGIES) {
				if (last - first != phrase.length) continue;
				int budget = phrase.length >= 3 ? 2 : 1, score = 0;
				boolean matches = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < phrase.length; i++) {
					String actual = input[first + i], wanted = phrase[i];
					if (actual.equals(wanted)) continue;
					if (wanted.length() <= 3) {
						if (wanted.length() == 3 && shortTypo(actual, wanted)) score++;
						else { matches = false; break; }
					} else {
						// Unaddressed one-word typos need an apology-like initial, not e.g. "worry".
						if (!addressed && phrase.length == 1 && (actual.isEmpty()
								|| actual.charAt(0) != wanted.charAt(0))) { matches = false; break; }
						int limit = wanted.length() >= 8 ? 2 : 1;
						int edits = distance(actual, wanted, limit);
						if (edits > limit) { matches = false; break; }
						score += edits;
					}
					if (score > budget) { matches = false; break; }
				}
				if (matches) return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static boolean isAddress(String word) {
			return word.equals("weaver") || word.length() >= 5 && word.length() <= 7
					&& distance(word, "weaver", 1) == 1;
		}

		private static boolean shortTypo(String actual, String wanted) {
			if (actual.length() == wanted.length()) {
				for (int i = 0; i + 1 < actual.length(); i++)
					if (actual.charAt(i) == wanted.charAt(i + 1) && actual.charAt(i + 1) == wanted.charAt(i)
							&& actual.substring(0, i).equals(wanted.substring(0, i))
							&& actual.substring(i + 2).equals(wanted.substring(i + 2))) return true;
			} else if (actual.length() == wanted.length() + 1) {
				for (int i = 1; i < actual.length(); i++)
					if (actual.charAt(i) == actual.charAt(i - 1)
							&& (actual.substring(0, i) + actual.substring(i + 1)).equals(wanted)) return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		// Bounded edit distance with adjacent-key transpositions treated as one typo.
		private static int distance(String actual, String wanted, int limit) {
			if (actual.length() > 16 || Math.abs(actual.length() - wanted.length()) > limit) return limit + 1;
			int[] before = new int[wanted.length() + 1];
			int[] previous = new int[wanted.length() + 1];
			int[] current = new int[wanted.length() + 1];
			for (int j = 0; j <= wanted.length(); j++) previous[j] = j;
			for (int i = 1; i <= actual.length(); i++) {
				current[0] = i;
				for (int j = 1; j <= wanted.length(); j++) {
					int change = actual.charAt(i - 1) == wanted.charAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
					current[j] = Math.min(previous[j] + 1, Math.min(current[j - 1] + 1, previous[j - 1] + change));
					if (i > 1 && j > 1 && actual.charAt(i - 1) == wanted.charAt(j - 2)
							&& actual.charAt(i - 2) == wanted.charAt(j - 1))
						current[j] = Math.min(current[j], before[j - 2] + 1);
				}
				int[] reuse = before; before = previous; previous = current; current = reuse;
			}
			return previous[wanted.length()];
		}
	}
	// END TYPO MATCHER


	// One transient reply per Weaver; weak keys and UUID-only values avoid retaining unloaded entities.
	private static final java.util.Map<AshWeaverEntity, Conversation> CONVERSATIONS =
			java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new java.util.WeakHashMap<>());

	private static final class Conversation {
		java.util.UUID playerId;
		String dimension;
		String text;
		long due;
		long expires;
		long noticeAt;
		long lookUntil;
		long nextSpeechAt;
		boolean urgent;
		boolean silent;
	}

	private static boolean speechBusy(AshWeaverEntity weaver, boolean urgent) {
		var data = weaver.getPersistentData();
		int state = chatInt(data, KEY_STATE, 0);
		long now = weaver.level().getGameTime();
		boolean usingDoor = data.contains("ashWeaverDoorPending")
				&& now - chatLong(data, "ashWeaverDoorFaceAt", now) <= 20L
				|| data.contains("ashWeaverDoorPos") && data.contains("ashWeaverDoorCloseAt")
					&& now - chatLong(data, "ashWeaverDoorCloseAt", now) <= 20L;
		return !weaver.onGround() || weaver.isInWater() || weaver.hurtTime > 0
				|| state == 4 || state == 8 || state == 9 || state == 12
				|| usingDoor
				|| !urgent && (state == 2 || state == 7 || state == 10);
	}

	public static void processPendingReply(AshWeaverEntity weaver) {
		Conversation conversation = CONVERSATIONS.get(weaver);
		if (conversation == null) return;
		if (!(weaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !weaver.isAlive()) {
			CONVERSATIONS.remove(weaver);
			return;
		}
		long now = level.getGameTime();
		String owner = weaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer);
		ServerPlayer player = level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(conversation.playerId);
		if (player == null || !player.isAlive() || player.level() != level
				|| !owner.equals(conversation.playerId.toString())
				|| !level.dimension().toString().equals(conversation.dimension)
				|| weaver.distanceToSqr(player) > 32.0 * 32.0
				|| now > conversation.expires) {
			CONVERSATIONS.remove(weaver);
			return;
		}
		if (conversation.text == null || now < conversation.due || now < conversation.nextSpeechAt) return;
		if (conversation.silent) {
			conversation.text = null;
			conversation.lookUntil = 0L;
			return;
		}
		if (speechBusy(weaver, conversation.urgent)) return;
		String text = currentFeedback(weaver, conversation.text);
		conversation.text = null;
		conversation.nextSpeechAt = now + 8L;
		conversation.lookUntil = now + 6L;
		sendReply(player, weaver, text);
	}

	private static String currentFeedback(AshWeaverEntity weaver, String text) {
		var data = weaver.getPersistentData();
		boolean movementReply = text.equals("Following.") || text.equals("Waiting here.")
				|| text.equals("Staying home.") || text.equals("Watching for threats.") || text.equals("I'll protect you.");
		if (!movementReply) return text;
		if (chatBoolean(data, "ashWeaverAvoidOwner", false)
				|| AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.relationship(weaver) <= -25.0) return "Keep your distance.";
		if (chatBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false)) return "Staying home.";
		if (chatBoolean(data, KEY_CHAT_STAY, false)) return "Waiting here.";
		return text.equals("Waiting here.") || text.equals("Staying home.") ? "Following." : text;
	}

	// Invoked after movement/look arbitration; never steals attention from an action or danger.
	public static void updateConversationLook(AshWeaverEntity weaver) {
		Conversation conversation = CONVERSATIONS.get(weaver);
		if (conversation == null || !(weaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
		long now = level.getGameTime();
		if (now < conversation.noticeAt || now > conversation.lookUntil || now > conversation.expires) return;
		var data = weaver.getPersistentData();
		int state = chatInt(data, KEY_STATE, 0);
		if (state != 0 && state != 1 && state != 11 || speechBusy(weaver, false)
				|| chatBoolean(data, "ashWeaverAvoidOwner", false) || conversation.silent
				|| weaver.swinging
				|| !weaver.getNavigation().isDone() || weaver.getDeltaMovement().horizontalDistanceSqr() > 0.01) return;
		ServerPlayer player = level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(conversation.playerId);
		if (player == null || player.level() != level || !player.isAlive()
				|| !player.getUUID().toString().equals(weaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer))
				|| weaver.distanceToSqr(player) > 8.0 * 8.0 || !weaver.hasLineOfSight(player)) return;
		weaver.getLookControl().setLookAt(player, 14.0F, 10.0F);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onChat(ServerChatEvent event) {
		if (event == null || event.getPlayer() == null) return;
		ServerPlayer player = event.getPlayer();
		handleChat(player, player.serverLevel(), event.getRawText());
	}

	public static void execute() {
		// MCreator procedure entry point; chat handling is performed by onChat.
	}

	public static void cancelConversation(AshWeaverEntity weaver) {
		CONVERSATIONS.remove(weaver);
	}

	private static void handleChat(ServerPlayer player, ServerLevel level, String rawText) {
		String command = ChatCommandMatcher.match(rawText);
		if (command == null) return;
		if (!player.isAlive() || player.isSpectator()) return;
		long chatTime = level.getGameTime();
		var playerData = player.getPersistentData();
		if (chatTime < chatLong(playerData, "ashWeaverCommandAt", 0L)) return;
		playerData.putLong("ashWeaverCommandAt", chatTime
				+ (command.equals("help me") || command.equals("watch") ? 4L : 10L));

		boolean follow = command.equals("follow") || command.equals("follow me") || command.equals("come here");
		boolean stay = command.equals("stay") || command.equals("stay here") || command.equals("wait here");
		boolean watch = command.equals("watch") || command.equals("watch my back");
		boolean help = command.equals("help me") || command.equals("protect me");
		boolean status = command.equals("status");
		boolean apology = command.equals("apologize");
		String homeAction = switch (command) {
			case "this is home", "this is our home", "remember this place" -> "set";
			case "this is also home", "remember this area too" -> "extend";
			case "stay home", "stay at home" -> "stay";
			case "forget home", "forget this home" -> "forget";
			case "home status" -> "status";
			case "restore home" -> "restore";
			default -> "";
		};
		if (!follow && !stay && !watch && !help && !status && !apology && homeAction.isEmpty()) return;

		AshWeaverEntity weaver = findOwnedWeaver(player);
		if (weaver == null) return;

		var data = weaver.getPersistentData();
		if (weaver.level() != level || weaver.distanceToSqr(player) > 32.0 * 32.0) return;
		long gameTime = level.getGameTime();
		if (apology) {
			// Reconciliation is heard even when wary; it never earns normal chat rewards or changes an order.
			reply(player, weaver, AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.apologize(weaver, player));
			return;
		}
		AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.noteConversation(weaver, gameTime);
		if (data.getBoolean("ashWeaverAvoidOwner") || AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.relationship(weaver) <= -25.0) {
			if (stay) data.putBoolean(KEY_CHAT_STAY, true);
			reply(player, weaver, "Keep your distance.");
			return;
		}
		if (!homeAction.isEmpty()) {
			reply(player, weaver, AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.homeCommand(weaver, player, homeAction));
			return;
		}
		if (follow || stay || watch || help) AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.acceptMovementOrder(weaver);
		if (follow) {
			data.remove("ashWeaverHomeStay");
			data.remove(KEY_CHAT_STAY);
			if (data.getInt(KEY_STATE) == 0) setState(data, 1, gameTime, 0L);
			reply(player, weaver, "Following.");
		} else if (stay) {
			data.remove("ashWeaverHomeStay");
			data.putBoolean(KEY_CHAT_STAY, true);
			reply(player, weaver, "Waiting here.");
		} else if (watch || help) {
			data.remove("ashWeaverHomeStay");
			data.remove(KEY_CHAT_STAY);
			data.putLong(KEY_NEXT_WARNING, 0L);
			if (data.getInt(KEY_STATE) == 0) setState(data, 1, gameTime, 0L);
			reply(player, weaver, watch ? "Watching for threats." : "I'll protect you.");
		} else {
			reply(player, weaver, data.getBoolean("ashWeaverHomeStay") ? "Staying home."
					: data.getBoolean(KEY_CHAT_STAY) ? "Waiting here." : "Following.");
		}
	}



	private static void reply(ServerPlayer player, AshWeaverEntity weaver, String text) {
		if (text == null || text.isBlank() || !(weaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
		long now = level.getGameTime();
		var data = weaver.getPersistentData();
		double bond = AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.relationship(weaver);
		boolean urgent = text.equals("I'll protect you.");
		int state = chatInt(data, KEY_STATE, 0);
		boolean wary = bond < -10.0 || chatBoolean(data, "ashWeaverAvoidOwner", false)
				|| state == 2 || state == 7 || state == 8 || state == 9 || state == 10
				|| weaver.getHealth() <= weaver.getMaxHealth() * 0.4F
				|| now < chatLong(data, "ashWeaverDistractionUntil", 0L);
		boolean unfamiliar = AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.speechObfuscation(weaver) > 0.55;
		int min = urgent ? 4 : wary ? 20 : unfamiliar ? 18 : 8;
		int max = urgent ? 8 : wary ? 50 : unfamiliar ? 36 : 18;
		// Averaging two draws favors a natural middle rather than abrupt extreme delays.
		int delay = min + (weaver.getRandom().nextInt(max - min + 1)
				+ weaver.getRandom().nextInt(max - min + 1)) / 2;
		Conversation conversation = CONVERSATIONS.get(weaver);
		if (conversation == null) {
			conversation = new Conversation();
			CONVERSATIONS.put(weaver, conversation);
		}
		conversation.playerId = player.getUUID();
		conversation.dimension = level.dimension().toString();
		conversation.text = text; // A newer recognized request replaces, rather than queues behind, this reply.
		conversation.due = Math.max(now + delay, conversation.nextSpeechAt);
		conversation.expires = now + 120L;
		conversation.noticeAt = now + 2L + weaver.getRandom().nextInt(3);
		conversation.lookUntil = conversation.due + 6L;
		conversation.urgent = urgent;
		conversation.silent = !urgent && bond < -25.0 && weaver.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.2F;
	}

	private static void sendReply(ServerPlayer player, AshWeaverEntity weaver, String text) {
		if (weaver.getPersistentData().getInt("ashWeaverState") == 10) text = "Taking cover.";
		double fraction = AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.speechObfuscation(weaver);
		int letters = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(text.charAt(i))) letters++;
		int hidden = (int) Math.round(letters * fraction);
		MutableComponent message = Component.empty();
		for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
			char ch = text.charAt(i);
			boolean obscure = false;
			if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(ch)) {
				obscure = letters > 0 && weaver.getRandom().nextInt(letters) < hidden;
				letters--;
				if (obscure) hidden--;
			}
			MutableComponent part = Component.literal(String.valueOf(ch));
			if (obscure) part.withStyle(ChatFormatting.OBFUSCATED);
			message.append(part);
		}
		player.sendSystemMessage(message, true);
	}


	private static int chatInt(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag data, String key, int fallback) {
		return data.contains(key) ? data.getInt(key) : fallback;
	}

	private static long chatLong(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag data, String key, long fallback) {
		return data.contains(key) ? data.getLong(key) : fallback;
	}

	private static boolean chatBoolean(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag data, String key, boolean fallback) {
		return data.contains(key) ? data.getBoolean(key) : fallback;
	}

	private static AshWeaverEntity findOwnedWeaver(ServerPlayer player) {
		MinecraftServer server = player.getServer();
		if (server == null) return null;
		String ownerId = player.getUUID().toString();
		AshWeaverEntity otherDimensionMatch = null;
		for (ServerLevel dimension : server.getAllLevels()) {
			for (Entity entity : dimension.getAllEntities()) {
				if (entity instanceof AshWeaverEntity candidate && candidate.isAlive()
						&& ownerId.equals(candidate.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer))
						&& AshWeaverOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.isCanonicalCompanion(candidate, ownerId)) {
					if (candidate.level() == player.level()) return candidate;
					if (otherDimensionMatch == null) otherDimensionMatch = candidate;
				}
			}
		}
		return otherDimensionMatch;
	}

	private static void setState(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag data, int state, long gameTime, long until) {
		data.putInt(KEY_STATE, state);
		data.putLong(KEY_STATE_STARTED, gameTime);
		data.putLong(KEY_STATE_UNTIL, until);
	}
}

	private static void execute(@Nullable Event event, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		// AshWeaverEntity.baseTick() also calls this procedure. The post-tick event is the
		// sole authority so vanilla goals cannot overwrite this state machine afterward.
		if (event == null || !(world instanceof ServerLevel level) || !(entity instanceof AshWeaverEntity ashWeaver)) return;
		if (!ashWeaver.isAlive()) {
			cancelTransientActions(ashWeaver, level.getGameTime());
			return;
		}

		CompoundTag data = ashWeaver.getPersistentData();
		long gameTime = level.getGameTime();
		if (dataLong(data, KEY_LAST_TICK, Long.MIN_VALUE) == gameTime) return;
		long previousTick = dataLong(data, KEY_LAST_TICK, gameTime);
		if (gameTime - previousTick > 1L) cancelTransientActions(ashWeaver, gameTime);
		data.putLong(KEY_LAST_TICK, gameTime);
		if (!dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverInitialized", false))
			AshWeaverOnInitialEntitySpawnProcedure.initialize(ashWeaver);
		rememberNearDeath(level, ashWeaver, data, gameTime);

		int roseCooldown = ashWeaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_roseCooldown);
		if (roseCooldown > 0) ashWeaver.getEntityData().set(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_roseCooldown, roseCooldown - 1);

		Player assignedPlayer = resolveAssignedPlayer(level, ashWeaver);
		if (assignedPlayer == null) assignedPlayer = tryAssignPlayer(level, ashWeaver, x, y, z);
		if (lifecycleOwnsTick(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime)) return;
		AshWeaverChatCommandProcedure.processPendingReply(ashWeaver);
		updateHomeSurvey(level, ashWeaver, data, gameTime);
		if (dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false) && homeHere(level, data)
				&& (assignedPlayer == null || !assignedPlayer.isAlive() || assignedPlayer.isSpectator() || assignedPlayer.level() != level)) {
			ensurePlayerPace(ashWeaver);
			if (!ashWeaver.isInWater() && handleFearAndHiding(level, ashWeaver, null, data, gameTime)) return;
			handleHomeStay(level, ashWeaver, null, data, gameTime);
			return;
		}
		if (assignedPlayer == null) {
			resetVisibleAction(ashWeaver);
			if (dataString(data, "ashWeaverRelationshipOwner", "").isEmpty()
					&& ashWeaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer).isEmpty()
					&& !dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeKnown", false) && ashWeaver.tickCount % 100 == 0
					&& level.getNearestPlayer(x, y, z, 128.0, false) == null) ashWeaver.discard();
			return;
		}

		// Keep loyalty when the owner changes dimensions; never silently bind to another player.
		if (assignedPlayer.level() != level) {
			setState(data, STATE_REGROUP, gameTime, gameTime + 40L);
			ashWeaver.getNavigation().stop();
			resetVisibleAction(ashWeaver);
			return;
		}
		updateRelationship(ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
		ensurePlayerPace(ashWeaver);
		if (ashWeaver.isInWater()) {
			clearHeldRose(ashWeaver);
			setSneaking(ashWeaver, false);
			ashWeaver.setSprinting(false);
			clearPlantingIntent(data);
			data.remove(KEY_PARKOUR_JUMPED);
			if (dataBoolean(data, KEY_CHAT_STAY, false) || dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false))
				ashWeaver.getNavigation().stop();
			else if (Math.floorMod(ashWeaver.tickCount + ashWeaver.getId(), 20) == 0)
				ashWeaver.getNavigation().moveTo(assignedPlayer, PLAYER_NAV_SPEED);
			// Float/swim behavior retains vertical control; never apply ground jumps in water.
			return;
		}

		if (handleFearAndHiding(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime)) return;

		// Avoidance owns movement before follow, recovery, planting and door handlers run.
		if (dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverAvoidOwner", false)) {
			handleRelationshipAvoidance(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			return;
		}

		LivingEntity attacker = findOwnerAttacker(ashWeaver, assignedPlayer);
		if (dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false) && homeHere(level, data)
				&& ashWeaver.distanceToSqr(assignedPlayer) > 12.0 * 12.0)
			attacker = null;
		Entity threat = updateThreatAwareness(level, ashWeaver, data, gameTime);
		boolean immediateDanger = threat != null && ashWeaver.distanceToSqr(threat) <= IMMEDIATE_DANGER_RANGE_SQ;
		if (dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false) && homeHere(level, data) && !immediateDanger
				&& (attacker == null || ashWeaver.distanceToSqr(assignedPlayer) > 12.0 * 12.0)) {
			handleHomeStay(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			return;
		}
		int state = dataInt(data, KEY_STATE, STATE_IDLE);
		if (!data.getBoolean(KEY_CHAT_STAY) && state != STATE_SEEK_PLANT_SITE && state != STATE_PLANT && state != STATE_WAIT
				&& state != STATE_REGROUP && (attacker == null || attacker instanceof Mob mob
					&& isHostileSplinter(mob) && mob.getTarget() == assignedPlayer)
				&& tryStartPlanting(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime))
			state = STATE_SEEK_PLANT_SITE;
		boolean planting = state == STATE_SEEK_PLANT_SITE || state == STATE_PLANT;
		boolean directThreat = threat instanceof Mob mob && mob.getTarget() == ashWeaver;

		if (attacker != null && !(planting && attacker instanceof Mob mob
				&& isHostileSplinter(mob) && mob.getTarget() == assignedPlayer)
				&& (state != STATE_DEFEND || !attacker.getUUID().toString().equals(dataString(data, KEY_DEFEND_UUID, "")))) {
			clearPlantingIntent(data);
			data.putString(KEY_DEFEND_UUID, attacker.getUUID().toString());
			setState(data, STATE_DEFEND, gameTime, gameTime + 120L);
			state = STATE_DEFEND;
		} else if (immediateDanger && (!planting || directThreat) && state != STATE_ALERT && state != STATE_DEFEND) {
			clearPlantingIntent(data);
			setState(data, STATE_ALERT, gameTime, gameTime + 30L);
			state = STATE_ALERT;
		} else if (!immediateDanger && state != STATE_DEFEND && state != STATE_ALERT
				&& gameTime >= dataLong(data, KEY_NEXT_DODGE, 0L) && isOwnerAimingAtWeaver(assignedPlayer, ashWeaver)) {
			if (startDodge(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime)) {
				clearPlantingIntent(data);
				state = STATE_DODGE;
			}
		} else if (!immediateDanger && threat != null && !planting && state != STATE_DEFEND && state != STATE_ALERT
				&& state != STATE_DODGE && state != STATE_WARN && gameTime >= dataLong(data, KEY_NEXT_WARNING, 0L)
				&& shouldWarnPlayer(ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, threat)) {
			clearPlantingIntent(data);
			setState(data, STATE_WARN, gameTime, gameTime + 25L);
			data.putLong(KEY_NEXT_WARNING, gameTime + 180L);
			state = STATE_WARN;
		}

		if (!dataBoolean(data, KEY_CHAT_STAY, false)
				&& !(dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false) && homeHere(level, data)))
			updateProgressAndRecovery(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, state, gameTime);
		state = dataInt(data, KEY_STATE, state);
		if (ashWeaver.distanceToSqr(assignedPlayer) > 10.0 * 10.0
				&& (state == STATE_SEEK_PLANT_SITE || state == STATE_PLANT || state == STATE_WAIT)) {
			clearPlantingIntent(data);
			clearHeldRose(ashWeaver);
			setSneaking(ashWeaver, false);
			setState(data, STATE_FOLLOW, gameTime, 0L);
			state = STATE_FOLLOW;
		}
		if (ashWeaver.distanceToSqr(assignedPlayer) > 20.0 * 20.0 && state == STATE_DEFEND) {
			data.remove(KEY_DEFEND_UUID);
			setState(data, STATE_FOLLOW, gameTime, 0L);
			state = STATE_FOLLOW;
		}

		if (data.getBoolean(KEY_CHAT_STAY) && state != STATE_DEFEND && state != STATE_DODGE
				&& state != STATE_WARN && state != STATE_ALERT) {
			clearPlantingIntent(data);
			clearHeldRose(ashWeaver);
			ashWeaver.getNavigation().stop();
			ashWeaver.setSprinting(false);
			setSneaking(ashWeaver, false);
			data.remove(KEY_PARKOUR_JUMPED);
			setStateIfChanged(data, STATE_IDLE, gameTime, 0L);
			state = STATE_IDLE;
		} else switch (state) {
			case STATE_DEFEND -> handleDefend(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_DODGE -> handleDodge(ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_WARN -> handleWarn(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, threat, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_ALERT -> handleAlert(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, threat, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_SEEK_PLANT_SITE -> handleSeekPlantSite(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_PLANT -> handlePlant(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_WAIT -> handleWait(ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			case STATE_REGROUP -> handleRegroup(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime);
			default -> handleSocialFollowAndPlanting(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, threat, data, gameTime);
		}

		handleDoorInteraction(level, ashWeaver, data, state, gameTime);
		maybeDropEmergencyRose(level, ashWeaver, assignedPlayer, data, gameTime, state);
		continueParkour(level, ashWeaver, data, gameTime);
		applySneakEdgeBrake(level, ashWeaver);
		enforceGroundSpeed(ashWeaver);
		separateFromOtherWeavers(level, ashWeaver, gameTime);
		AshWeaverChatCommandProcedure.updateConversationLook(ashWeaver);
	}




	private static final int STATE_HOME = 11;

	private static final int STATE_TRAVEL = 12;

	private static net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation bondKey(String owner) {
		return net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:weaver_bond/" + UUID.fromString(owner));
	}

	private static CompoundTag bondRecord(ServerLevel level, String owner) {
		return level.getServer().getCommandStorage().get(bondKey(owner));
	}

	private static void saveBond(ServerLevel level, String owner, CompoundTag record) {
		level.getServer().getCommandStorage().set(bondKey(owner), record);
	}

	public static boolean isCanonicalCompanion(AshWeaverEntity ashWeaver, String owner) {
		if (!(ashWeaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || owner == null || owner.isEmpty()) return false;
		try {
			return ashWeaver.getUUID().toString().equals(dataString(bondRecord(level, owner), "Weaver", ""));
		} catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) { return false; }
	}

	private static boolean registerBond(ServerLevel level, AshWeaverEntity ashWeaver, String owner, long now) {
		CompoundTag record = bondRecord(level, owner);
		String claimed = dataString(record, "Weaver", "");
		if (!claimed.isEmpty() && !claimed.equals(ashWeaver.getUUID().toString())) return false;
		if (claimed.isEmpty() && hasEarlierClaim(level, ashWeaver, owner)) return false;
		ashWeaver.setPersistenceRequired();
		if (claimed.isEmpty() || now >= dataLong(ashWeaver.getPersistentData(), "ashWeaverBondCheckpoint", 0L)) {
			record = record.copy();
			record.putString("Weaver", ashWeaver.getUUID().toString());
			record.putString("Dimension", level.dimension().toString());
			record.putLong("Pos", ashWeaver.blockPosition().asLong());
			saveBond(level, owner, record);
			ashWeaver.getPersistentData().putLong("ashWeaverBondCheckpoint", now + 200L);
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static void cancelTransientActions(AshWeaverEntity ashWeaver, long now) {
		CompoundTag data = ashWeaver.getPersistentData();
		clearPlantingIntent(data);
		clearHeldRose(ashWeaver);
		ashWeaver.setTarget(null);
		ashWeaver.getNavigation().stop();
		ashWeaver.setSprinting(false);
		setSneaking(ashWeaver, false);
		for (String key : new String[] {KEY_DEFEND_UUID, KEY_THREAT_UUID, KEY_CRIT_UNTIL, KEY_PARKOUR_JUMPED,
				KEY_PARKOUR_X, KEY_PARKOUR_Y, KEY_PARKOUR_Z, KEY_BOUNDARY_UNTIL, KEY_DETOUR_UNTIL,
				KEY_DOOR_PENDING, KEY_DOOR_POS, KEY_DOOR_CLOSE_AT, KEY_DISTRACTION_UUID, KEY_DISTRACTION_UNTIL,
				KEY_MIRROR_UNTIL, KEY_EYE_CONTACT_UNTIL, KEY_AIM_WATCH_UNTIL, KEY_BOLD_UNTIL, KEY_HESITATE_UNTIL,
				"ashWeaverHomePendingAction", "ashWeaverHomePendingUntil", "ashWeaverHomePendingDimension",
				"ashWeaverHomePendingPos"}) data.remove(key);
		data.putInt(KEY_STUCK_TICKS, 0);
		setState(data, STATE_IDLE, now, 0L);
		AshWeaverChatCommandProcedure.cancelConversation(ashWeaver);
	}

	public static void acceptMovementOrder(AshWeaverEntity ashWeaver) {
		if (ashWeaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level
				&& dataInt(ashWeaver.getPersistentData(), KEY_STATE, STATE_IDLE) != STATE_HIDE)
			cancelTransientActions(ashWeaver, level.getGameTime());
	}


	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onOwnerTravel(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityTravelToDimensionEvent event) {
		if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof Player owner) || !(owner.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
		BlockPos feet = owner.blockPosition();
		BlockPos entrance = null;
		for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1 && entrance == null; dx++)
			for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1 && entrance == null; dz++) for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
				BlockPos pos = feet.offset(dx, dy, dz);
				if (level.hasChunkAt(pos) && level.getBlockState(pos).getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.Portal
						&& owner.getBoundingBox().inflate(0.1).intersects(new AABB(pos))) { entrance = pos; break; }
			}
		if (entrance == null) return; // Commands, respawns and unknown teleporters are not assumed to be portals.
		for (AshWeaverEntity weaver : level.getEntitiesOfClass(AshWeaverEntity.class, owner.getBoundingBox().inflate(16.0),
				candidate -> owner.getUUID().toString().equals(candidate.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer)))) {
			if (!weaver.hasLineOfSight(owner) || !isCanonicalCompanion(weaver, owner.getUUID().toString())) continue;
			CompoundTag data = weaver.getPersistentData();
			data.putLong("ashWeaverPortalPos", entrance.asLong());
			data.putString("ashWeaverPortalBlock", BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(level.getBlockState(entrance).getBlock()).toString());
			data.putString("ashWeaverPortalFrom", level.dimension().toString());
			data.putLong("ashWeaverPortalSeenAt", level.getGameTime());
		}
	}


	private static void holdWitnessedPortalRoute(ServerLevel level, AshWeaverEntity weaver, BlockPos portal) {
		// One short-lived vanilla lease per crossing, only for the two already-loaded route chunks.
		// Never refresh this from the entity tick or turn it into a permanent chunk loader.
		for (BlockPos pos : new BlockPos[] {weaver.blockPosition(), portal}) {
			if (!level.hasChunkAt(pos)) continue;
			level.getChunkSource().addRegionTicket(net.minecraft.server.level.TicketType.PORTAL,
					new net.minecraft.world.level.ChunkPos(pos), 2, pos);
		}
	}


	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onOwnerDimensionChange(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent.PlayerChangedDimensionEvent event) {
		Player owner = event.getEntity();
		if (!(owner.level() instanceof ServerLevel current)) return;
		for (ServerLevel source : current.getServer().getAllLevels()) for (Entity candidate : source.getAllEntities()) {
			if (!(candidate instanceof AshWeaverEntity weaver)
					|| !owner.getUUID().toString().equals(weaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer))) continue;
			CompoundTag data = weaver.getPersistentData();
			long now = source.getGameTime();
			boolean witnessed = event.getFrom().toString().equals(dataString(data, "ashWeaverPortalFrom", ""))
					&& now >= dataLong(data, "ashWeaverPortalCooldown", 0L)
					&& now - dataLong(data, "ashWeaverPortalSeenAt", Long.MIN_VALUE / 2L) <= 60L;
			cancelTransientActions(weaver, now);
			if (witnessed && !dataBoolean(data, KEY_CHAT_STAY, false) && !dataBoolean(data, "ashWeaverHomeStay", false)) {
				data.putString("ashWeaverPortalTo", event.getTo().toString());
				data.putLong("ashWeaverPortalUntil", now + 600L);
				data.putLong("ashWeaverPortalReady", now + 8L + weaver.getRandom().nextInt(13));
				data.putInt("ashWeaverPortalAttempts", 0);
				holdWitnessedPortalRoute(source, weaver, BlockPos.of(dataLong(data, "ashWeaverPortalPos", 0L)));
			} else data.remove("ashWeaverPortalUntil");
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onOwnerRespawn(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent.PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
		resetOwnerActions(event.getEntity());
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onOwnerLogout(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent.PlayerLoggedOutEvent event) {
		resetOwnerActions(event.getEntity());
	}

	private static void resetOwnerActions(Player owner) {
		if (!(owner.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
		for (ServerLevel dimension : level.getServer().getAllLevels()) for (Entity candidate : dimension.getAllEntities())
			if (candidate instanceof AshWeaverEntity weaver
					&& owner.getUUID().toString().equals(weaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer))) {
				cancelTransientActions(weaver, dimension.getGameTime());
				weaver.getPersistentData().remove("ashWeaverPortalUntil");
				weaver.getPersistentData().remove("ashWeaverPortalSeenAt");
			}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onCompanionRemoved(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityLeaveLevelEvent event) {
		if (!(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !(event.getEntity() instanceof AshWeaverEntity weaver)) return;
		Entity.RemovalReason reason = weaver.getRemovalReason();
		// Unload and dimension transfer preserve the claim; actual removal releases only this UUID.
		if (reason != Entity.RemovalReason.KILLED && reason != Entity.RemovalReason.DISCARDED) return;
		String owner = weaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer);
		if (!isCanonicalCompanion(weaver, owner)) return;
		CompoundTag record = bondRecord(level, owner).copy();
		for (String key : new String[] {"Weaver", "Dimension", "Pos"}) record.remove(key);
		saveBond(level, owner, record); // Rose quotas deliberately survive deaths and replacement companions.
		HOME_SURVEYS.remove(weaver);
		AshWeaverChatCommandProcedure.cancelConversation(weaver);
	}

	private static void observeOwnerPortal(ServerLevel level, AshWeaverEntity ashWeaver, Player player, CompoundTag data, long now) {
		if (now < dataLong(data, "ashWeaverPortalCooldown", 0L)
				|| Math.floorMod(ashWeaver.tickCount + ashWeaver.getId(), 5) != 0
				|| ashWeaver.distanceToSqr(player) > 16.0 * 16.0 || !ashWeaver.hasLineOfSight(player)) return;
		BlockPos feet = player.blockPosition();
		for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) for (int dy = 0; dy <= 1; dy++) {
			BlockPos portal = feet.offset(dx, dy, dz);
			if (!level.hasChunkAt(portal) || !(level.getBlockState(portal).getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.Portal)
					|| !player.getBoundingBox().inflate(0.1).intersects(new AABB(portal))) continue;
			data.putLong("ashWeaverPortalPos", portal.asLong());
			data.putString("ashWeaverPortalBlock", BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(level.getBlockState(portal).getBlock()).toString());
			data.putString("ashWeaverPortalFrom", level.dimension().toString());
			data.putLong("ashWeaverPortalSeenAt", now);
			return;
		}
	}

	private static boolean portalPathSafe(ServerLevel level, Path path, BlockPos portal) {
		if (path == null || !path.canReach() || path.getNodeCount() > 80) return false;
		for (int i = path.getNextNodeIndex(); i < path.getNodeCount(); i++) {
			var node = path.getNode(i);
			BlockPos feet = new BlockPos(node.x, node.y, node.z);
			if (!level.hasChunkAt(feet) || !level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(feet)) return false;
			boolean gate = feet.distSqr(portal) <= 4.0
					&& level.getBlockState(feet).getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.Portal;
			if (!gate && !isSafeStandingPosition(level, feet)
					&& !(level.getBlockState(feet).getBlock() instanceof DoorBlock)) return false;
			BlockPos below = feet.below();
