@EventBusSubscriber(value = Dist.CLIENT)
class ClientCompassAndF3GlitchSubscriber {

	private static boolean isBlank(String str) {
		if (str == null) return true;
		int len = str.length();
		if (len == 0) return true;
		for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
			if (!Character.isWhitespace(str.charAt(i))) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static boolean containsIgnoreCase(String src, String search) {
		if (src == null || search == null) return false;
		final int length = search.length();
		if (length == 0) return true;
		for (int i = src.length() - length; i >= 0; i--) {
			if (src.regionMatches(true, i, search, 0, length)) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static String fastStripColor(String input) {
		if (input == null) return "";
		int len = input.length();
		if (len == 0) return "";
		int firstSection = input.indexOf('\u00A7');
		if (firstSection == -1) {
			return input;
		}
		StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(len);
		for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
			char c = input.charAt(i);
			if (c == '\u00A7' && i + 1 < len) {
				i++; // Skip the § and the following format code
			} else {
				sb.append(c);
			}
		}
		return sb.toString();
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onDebugText(CustomizeGuiOverlayEvent.DebugText event) {
		if (!CompassAndF3GlitchProcedure.ENABLE_GLITCH) {
			return;
		}

		net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || mc.player.level() == null || mc.player.isCreative() || mc.player.isSpectator())
			return;

		if (CompassAndF3GlitchProcedure.clientIsNearby && CompassAndF3GlitchProcedure.clientActiveIntensity > 0.005) {
			double ratio = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, CompassAndF3GlitchProcedure.clientActiveIntensity));

			// Scramble coordinates and game orientation overlay fields on F3 (Beautiful raw white obfuscation)
			List<String> left = event.getLeft();
			for (int i = 0; i < left.size(); i++) {
				String line = left.get(i);
				if (isBlank(line))
					continue;

				if (line.startsWith("§f§k")) {
					continue;
				}

				boolean shouldScramble = false;
				if (ratio >= 0.8) {
					shouldScramble = true; // Extreme proximity: scramble everything
				} else if (ratio >= 0.4) {
					if (line.startsWith("XYZ:") || line.startsWith("Block:") || line.startsWith("Chunk:") || line.startsWith("Facing:") || line.startsWith("Biome:") || line.startsWith("E:") || containsIgnoreCase(line, "fps")) {
						shouldScramble = true;
					}
				} else {
					if (line.startsWith("Facing:") || line.startsWith("Biome:") || line.startsWith("E:")) {
						shouldScramble = true;
					}
				}

				if (shouldScramble && Math.random() < ratio) {
					String clean = fastStripColor(line);
					left.set(i, "§f§k" + clean);
				}
			}

			// Scramble specs, server metrics and hardware allocations overlay fields depending on entity proximity
			List<String> right = event.getRight();
			for (int i = 0; i < right.size(); i++) {
				String line = right.get(i);
				if (isBlank(line))
					continue;

				if (line.startsWith("§f§k")) {
					continue;
				}

				boolean shouldScramble = false;
				if (ratio >= 0.8) {
					shouldScramble = true; // Extreme proximity: scramble everything
				} else if (ratio >= 0.4) {

						shouldScramble = true;
					}
				} else {
					if (line.contains("Server:") || line.contains("Client:")) {
						shouldScramble = true;
					}
				}

				if (shouldScramble && Math.random() < ratio) {
					String clean = fastStripColor(line);
					right.set(i, "§f§k" + clean);
				}
			}
		}
	} // 1.21.1

    // =========================================================================
    // FIRE DEFENSE LOGIC
    // =========================================================================
    private static void tickFireDefense(Level level, Player player, ResourceKey<Level> dim) {
        // Process active domino purge queue every tick
        processDominoPurge(level, player);

        boolean isStrongDim = dim == THE_GRAIN || dim == THE_SUB_STRATA || dim == THE_CROSSWORKS;
        int interval = isStrongDim ? 4 : FIRE_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS;
        if (player.tickCount % interval != 0) return;

        BlockPos center = player.blockPosition();

        // 1. SILENT CLEANUP (Beyond close range, up to full SCAN_RADIUS_XZ)
        silentPurgeSliced(level, center, player.tickCount);

        // 2. ACTIVE THREAT RADIUS CHECK
        int cd = player.getPersistentData().getInt(NBT_FIRE_COOLDOWN_KEY);
        if (cd > 0) {
            player.getPersistentData().putInt(NBT_FIRE_COOLDOWN_KEY, Math.max(0, cd - interval));
            return;
        }

        int threshold = isStrongDim ? 15 : BIG_FIRE_THRESHOLD;
        int fireCount = countFireInThreatRadius(level, center);
        if (fireCount < threshold) return;

        // Perform the domino threat purge
        startDominoPurge(level, player, center);

        // Set the cooldown
        int cooldown = isStrongDim ? 40 : FIRE_PURGE_COOLDOWN_TICKS;
        player.getPersistentData().putInt(NBT_FIRE_COOLDOWN_KEY, cooldown);
    }

    private static void silentPurgeSliced(Level level, BlockPos center, int tickCount) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return;
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();

        boolean isStrongDim = level.dimension() == THE_GRAIN || level.dimension() == THE_SUB_STRATA || level.dimension() == THE_CROSSWORKS;
        int totalSlices = isStrongDim ? 3 : 12;
        int interval = isStrongDim ? 4 : FIRE_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS;
        int currentSlice = (int) ((tickCount / interval) % totalSlices);

        int range = FIRE_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ;
        int sliceWidth = (range * 2 + 1 + totalSlices - 1) / totalSlices;
        int startDx = -range + currentSlice * sliceWidth;
        int endDx = Math.min(range, startDx + sliceWidth - 1);

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos p = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
        int cx = center.getX();
        int cy = center.getY();
        int cz = center.getZ();

        int minY = cy - FIRE_SCAN_RADIUS_Y;
        int maxY = cy + FIRE_SCAN_RADIUS_Y;

        for (int dx = startDx; dx <= endDx; dx++) {
            int absX = cx + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -FIRE_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= FIRE_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz++) {
                int absZ = cz + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int localMinY = Math.max(currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight(), minY);
                int localMaxY = Math.min(currentChunk.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, maxY);

                int minSection = (localMinY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;
                int maxSection = (localMaxY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;

                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();

                for (int secIndex = minSection; secIndex <= maxSection; secIndex++) {
                    if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                    net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                    if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                    if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(DimensionDefenseProcedure::isFire)) continue;

                    int secMinY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight() + (secIndex << 4);
                    int startY = Math.max(localMinY, secMinY);
                    int endY = Math.min(localMaxY, secMinY + 15);

                    for (int absY = startY; absY <= endY; absY++) {
                        int dy = absY - cy;
                        if (Math.abs(dx) <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ && Math.abs(dy) <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y && Math.abs(dz) <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        BlockState state = section.getBlockState(absX & 15, absY & 15, absZ & 15);
                        if (isFire(state)) {
                            p.set(absX, absY, absZ);
                            level.setBlock(p, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                            if (level.random.nextFloat() < 0.05f) {
                                BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("block.fire.extinguish")).ifPresent(extinguish -> {
                                    level.playSound(null, p, extinguish, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.2f, 1.2f + level.random.nextFloat() * 0.4f);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static int countFireInThreatRadius(Level level, BlockPos center) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return 0;
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();

        int count = 0;
        int cx = center.getX();
        int cy = center.getY();
        int cz = center.getZ();

        int minY = cy - FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y;
        int maxY = cy + FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y;

        for (int dx = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dx <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dx += 4) {
            int absX = cx + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dz += 4) {
                int absZ = cz + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int localMinY = Math.max(currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight(), minY);
                int localMaxY = Math.min(currentChunk.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, maxY);

                int minSection = (localMinY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;
                int maxSection = (localMaxY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;

                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();

                for (int secIndex = minSection; secIndex <= maxSection; secIndex++) {
                    if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                    net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                    if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                    if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(DimensionDefenseProcedure::isFire)) continue;

                    int secMinY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight() + (secIndex << 4);
                    int startY = Math.max(localMinY, secMinY);
                    int endY = Math.min(localMaxY, secMinY + 15);

                    for (int dy = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y; dy <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y; dy += 4) {
                        int absY = cy + dy;
                        if (absY >= startY && absY <= endY) {
                            BlockState state = section.getBlockState(absX & 15, absY & 15, absZ & 15);
                            if (isFire(state)) count += 64;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static void purgeFireInThreatRadius(Level level, BlockPos center) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return;
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos p = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
        int cx = center.getX();
        int cy = center.getY();
        int cz = center.getZ();

        int minY = cy - FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y;
        int maxY = cy + FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y + 1;

        for (int dx = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dx <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dx += 2) {
            int absX = cx + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dz += 2) {
                int absZ = cz + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int localMinY = Math.max(currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight(), minY);
                int localMaxY = Math.min(currentChunk.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, maxY + 1);

                int minSection = (localMinY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;
                int maxSection = (localMaxY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;

                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();

                for (int secIndex = minSection; secIndex <= maxSection; secIndex++) {
                    if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                    net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                    if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                    if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(DimensionDefenseProcedure::isFire)) continue;

                    int secMinY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight() + (secIndex << 4);
                    int startY = Math.max(localMinY, secMinY);
                    int endY = Math.min(localMaxY, secMinY + 15);

                    for (int dy = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y; dy <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y; dy += 2) {
                        for (int ox = 0; ox < 2; ox++) {
                            int checkX = absX + ox;
                            for (int oz = 0; oz < 2; oz++) {
                                int checkZ = absZ + oz;
                                for (int oy = 0; oy < 2; oy++) {
                                    int absY = cy + dy + oy;
                                    if (absY >= startY && absY <= endY) {
                                        int subCxChunk = checkX >> 4;
                                        int subCzChunk = checkZ >> 4;
                                        if (subCxChunk == cxChunk && subCzChunk == czChunk) {
                                            BlockState state = section.getBlockState(checkX & 15, absY & 15, checkZ & 15);
                                            if (isFire(state)) {
                                                p.set(checkX, absY, checkZ);
                                                level.setBlock(p, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                                                if (level.random.nextFloat() < 0.15f) {
                                                    serverLevel.sendParticles(net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.SMOKE, p.getX() + 0.5, p.getY() + 0.5, p.getZ() + 0.5, 1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.05);
                                                    BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("block.fire.extinguish")).ifPresent(extinguish -> {
                                                        level.playSound(null, p, extinguish, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.25f, 1.2f + serverLevel.random.nextFloat() * 0.4f);
                                                    });
                                                }
                                            }
                                        } else {
                                            p.set(checkX, absY, checkZ);
                                            if (isFire(level.getBlockState(p))) {
                                                level.setBlock(p, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                                                if (level.random.nextFloat() < 0.15f) {
                                                    serverLevel.sendParticles(net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.SMOKE, p.getX() + 0.5, p.getY() + 0.5, p.getZ() + 0.5, 1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.05);
                                                    BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("block.fire.extinguish")).ifPresent(extinguish -> {
                                                        level.playSound(null, p, extinguish, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.25f, 1.2f + serverLevel.random.nextFloat() * 0.4f);
                                                    });
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void startDominoPurge(Level level, Player player, BlockPos center) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return;
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();

        List<BlockPos> firePositions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<BlockPos> plankPositions = new ArrayList<>();
        int cx = center.getX();
        int cy = center.getY();
        int cz = center.getZ();

        int minY = cy - FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y;
        int maxY = cy + FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_Y + 1;

        for (int dx = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dx <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ + 1; dx++) {
            int absX = cx + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= FIRE_THREAT_RADIUS_XZ + 1; dz++) {
                int absZ = cz + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int localMinY = Math.max(currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight(), minY);
                int localMaxY = Math.min(currentChunk.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, maxY);

                int minSection = (localMinY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;
                int maxSection = (localMaxY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;

                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();

                for (int secIndex = minSection; secIndex <= maxSection; secIndex++) {
                    if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                    net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                    if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                    if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(state -> isFire(state) || isSmolderingPlank(state))) continue;

                    int secMinY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight() + (secIndex << 4);
                    int startY = Math.max(localMinY, secMinY);
                    int endY = Math.min(localMaxY, secMinY + 15);

                    for (int absY = startY; absY <= endY; absY++) {
                        BlockState state = section.getBlockState(absX & 15, absY & 15, absZ & 15);
                        if (state.isAir()) continue;
                        if (isFire(state)) {
                            firePositions.add(new BlockPos(absX, absY, absZ));
                        } else if (isSmolderingPlank(state)) {
                            plankPositions.add(new BlockPos(absX, absY, absZ));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (firePositions.isEmpty() && plankPositions.isEmpty()) return;

        firePositions.sort((p1, p2) -> Double.compare(p1.distSqr(center), p2.distSqr(center)));

        plankPositions = sortAsInfectionSpread(plankPositions, center);

        if (firePositions.size() > 1000) {
            firePositions = firePositions.subList(0, 1000);
        }

        ListTag fireList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos pos : firePositions) {
            fireList.add(StringTag.valueOf(pos.getX() + "," + pos.getY() + "," + pos.getZ()));
        }

        if (!fireList.isEmpty()) {
            player.getPersistentData().put("grain_domino_queue", fireList);
        }

        if (!plankPositions.isEmpty()) {
            plankPositions = sortAsInfectionSpread(plankPositions, center);

            ListTag plankList = new ListTag();
            for (BlockPos pos : plankPositions) {
                plankList.add(StringTag.valueOf(pos.getX() + "," + pos.getY() + "," + pos.getZ()));
            }

            if (!plankList.isEmpty()) {
                player.getPersistentData().put("grain_plank_queue", plankList);
                player.getPersistentData().putInt("grain_plank_total", plankList.size());
            }
        }

        if (!firePositions.isEmpty() || !plankPositions.isEmpty()) {
            if (!firePositions.isEmpty()) {
                BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("block.fire.extinguish")).ifPresent(extinguish -> {
                    level.playSound(null, center, extinguish, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.3f, 0.85f);
                });
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isBurntBlock(BlockState state) {
        if (state == null || state.isAir()) return false;
        Block block = state.getBlock();
        ResourceLocation reg = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(block);
        if (reg != null) {
            String namespace = reg.getNamespace();
            String path = reg.getPath().toLowerCase();
            if (namespace.equals("burnt") && (path.equals("wood_fire") || path.matches("wood_fire_[2-9]"))) {
                return false;
            }
            if (path.contains("brick") || path.contains("stone") || path.contains("tile") || path.contains("glass") || path.contains("metal") || path.contains("ore")) {
                return false;
            }
            if (namespace.equals("burnt") || namespace.equals("burnt_basic") || namespace.equals("firesdelight") || namespace.equals("nether_delight")) {
                return true;
            }
            if (path.contains("burnt") || path.contains("smoldering") || path.contains("sooty") || path.contains("charred")) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static BlockState getHealthyEquivalent(BlockState burntState) {
        if (burntState == null) {
            return TheBackwoodsModBlocks.LIGNUM_CARO.get().defaultBlockState();
        }
        Block block = burntState.getBlock();
        ResourceLocation reg = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(block);
        if (reg != null) {
            String path = reg.getPath().toLowerCase();
            if (path.contains("broken_log")) {
                boolean isLog = path.contains("log") || path.contains("stem") || path.contains("wood") || path.contains("hyphae") || path.contains("bark");
                Block healthyBlock = path.contains("spruce") ? (isLog ? Blocks.SPRUCE_LOG : Blocks.SPRUCE_PLANKS) :
                                     path.contains("birch") ? (isLog ? Blocks.BIRCH_LOG : Blocks.BIRCH_PLANKS) :
                                     path.contains("jungle") ? (isLog ? Blocks.JUNGLE_LOG : Blocks.JUNGLE_PLANKS) :
                                     path.contains("acacia") ? (isLog ? Blocks.ACACIA_LOG : Blocks.ACACIA_PLANKS) :
                                     path.contains("dark_oak") ? (isLog ? Blocks.DARK_OAK_LOG : Blocks.DARK_OAK_PLANKS) :
                                     path.contains("mangrove") ? (isLog ? Blocks.MANGROVE_LOG : Blocks.MANGROVE_PLANKS) :
                                     path.contains("cherry") ? (isLog ? Blocks.CHERRY_LOG : Blocks.CHERRY_PLANKS) :
                                     (isLog ? Blocks.OAK_LOG : Blocks.OAK_PLANKS);
                if (healthyBlock != null) {
                    return copyBlockStateProperties(burntState, healthyBlock.defaultBlockState());
                }
            }
        }
        return copyBlockStateProperties(burntState, TheBackwoodsModBlocks.LIGNUM_CARO.get().defaultBlockState());
    }

    private static List<BlockPos> sortAsInfectionSpread(List<BlockPos> positions, BlockPos center) {
        if (positions.isEmpty()) return positions;
        Set<BlockPos> remaining = new HashSet<>(positions);
        List<BlockPos> ordered = new ArrayList<>();

        BlockPos seed = positions.get(0);
        double minDist = seed.distSqr(center);
        for (BlockPos p : positions) {
            double d = p.distSqr(center);
            if (d < minDist) {
                minDist = d;
                seed = p;
            }
        }

        ArrayDeque<BlockPos> frontier = new ArrayDeque<>();
        frontier.add(seed);
        remaining.remove(seed);
        ordered.add(seed);

        while (!frontier.isEmpty() && !remaining.isEmpty()) {
            BlockPos current = frontier.removeFirst();
            for (Direction d : Direction.values()) {
                BlockPos n = current.relative(d);
                if (!remaining.remove(n)) continue;
                ordered.add(n);
                frontier.add(n);
            }
            if (frontier.isEmpty() && !remaining.isEmpty()) {
                BlockPos nextSeed = remaining.iterator().next();
                double minNextDist = nextSeed.distSqr(current);
                for (BlockPos r : remaining) {
                    double d = r.distSqr(current);
                    if (d < minNextDist) {
                        minNextDist = d;
                        nextSeed = r;
                    }
                }
                remaining.remove(nextSeed);
                ordered.add(nextSeed);
                frontier.add(nextSeed);
            }
        }

        for (BlockPos r : remaining) {
            ordered.add(r);
        }
        return ordered;
    }

    private static void processDominoPurge(Level level, Player player) {
        CompoundTag data = player.getPersistentData();
        boolean hasFire = data.contains("grain_domino_queue", Tag.TAG_LIST);
        boolean hasPlanks = data.contains("grain_plank_queue", Tag.TAG_LIST);

        if (!hasFire && !hasPlanks) return;

        if (hasFire) {
            ListTag list = data.getList("grain_domino_queue", Tag.TAG_STRING);
            if (list.isEmpty()) {
                data.remove("grain_domino_queue");
            } else {
                int extinguishCount = Math.min(list.size(), 12);
                List<BlockPos> toExtinguish = new ArrayList<>();

                for (int i = 0; i < extinguishCount; i++) {
                    String s = list.getString(0);
                    list.remove(0);
                    BlockPos p = parsePos(s);
                    if (p != null) {
                        toExtinguish.add(p);
                    }
                }

                if (list.isEmpty()) {
                    data.remove("grain_domino_queue");
                } else {
                    data.put("grain_domino_queue", list);
                }

                if (level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel) {
                    for (BlockPos pos : toExtinguish) {
                        if (isFire(level.getBlockState(pos))) {
                            level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                            serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SMOKE, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 2, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.05);
                            if (serverLevel.random.nextFloat() < 0.2f) {
                                BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("block.fire.extinguish")).ifPresent(extinguish -> {
                                    level.playSound(null, pos, extinguish, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.25f, 1.2f + serverLevel.random.nextFloat() * 0.4f);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (hasPlanks) {
            int plankDelay = data.contains("grain_plank_delay", Tag.TAG_INT) ? data.getInt("grain_plank_delay") : 0;
            if (plankDelay > 0) {
                data.putInt("grain_plank_delay", plankDelay - 1);
            } else {
                data.putInt("grain_plank_delay", 14);
                ListTag list = data.getList("grain_plank_queue", Tag.TAG_STRING);
                if (list.isEmpty()) {
                    data.remove("grain_plank_queue");
                    data.remove("grain_plank_delay");
                } else {
                    int processCount = Math.min(list.size(), 1);
                    List<BlockPos> toRestore = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < processCount; i++) {
                        String s = list.getString(0);
                        list.remove(0);
                        BlockPos p = parsePos(s);
                        if (p != null) {
                            toRestore.add(p);
                        }
                    }

                    if (list.isEmpty()) {
                        data.remove("grain_plank_queue");
                        data.remove("grain_plank_delay");
                        data.remove("grain_plank_total");
                    } else {
                        data.put("grain_plank_queue", list);
                    }

                    if (level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel) {
                        int totalInitial = data.contains("grain_plank_total") ? data.getInt("grain_plank_total") : 50;
                        double conversionChance;
                        if (totalInitial <= 100) {
                            conversionChance = 0.05 + (double) totalInitial * (0.45 / 100.0);
                        } else {
                            conversionChance = 0.50 + Math.min(0.48, (double) (totalInitial - 100) * (0.48 / 100.0));
                        }
                        conversionChance = Math.max(0.02, Math.min(0.98, conversionChance + (serverLevel.random.nextDouble() * 0.1 - 0.05)));

                        for (BlockPos pos : toRestore) {
                            BlockState currentState = level.getBlockState(pos);
                            if (isSmolderingPlank(currentState)) {
                                if (serverLevel.random.nextDouble() < conversionChance) {
                                    BlockState restoredState = getRestoredPlankState(currentState, serverLevel.random);
                                    level.setBlock(pos, restoredState, 3);
                                    serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.HAPPY_VILLAGER, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.02);
                                    if (serverLevel.random.nextFloat() < 0.15f) {
                                        BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("block.cherry_wood.place")).ifPresent(placeSound -> {
                                            level.playSound(null, pos, placeSound, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.4f, 0.8f + serverLevel.random.nextFloat() * 0.3f);
                                        });
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SMOKE, pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isSmolderingPlank(BlockState state) {
        if (state == null || state.isAir()) return false;
        Block block = state.getBlock();
        Boolean cached = SMOLDERING_PLANK_CACHE.get(block);
        if (cached != null) return cached;

        boolean result = false;
        ResourceLocation reg = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(block);
        if (reg != null) {
            String path = reg.getPath().toLowerCase();
            if (path.contains("smoldering") && path.contains("plank")) {
                result = true;
            }
        }
        SMOLDERING_PLANK_CACHE.put(block, result);
        return result;
    }

    private static BlockState getRestoredPlankState(BlockState burntState, net.minecraft.util.RandomSource random) {
        Block targetBlock = random.nextBoolean() ? TheBackwoodsModBlocks.LIGNUM_CARO.get() : Blocks.OAK_PLANKS;
        return copyBlockStateProperties(burntState, targetBlock.defaultBlockState());
    }

    private static BlockState copyBlockStateProperties(BlockState from, BlockState to) {
        BlockState result = to;
        for (Property<?> property : from.getProperties()) {
            if (result.hasProperty(property)) {
                result = copyPropertyHelper(from, result, property);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static <T extends Comparable<T>> BlockState copyPropertyHelper(BlockState from, BlockState to, Property<T> property) {
        return to.setValue(property, from.getValue(property));
    }

    private static BlockPos parsePos(String s) {
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) return null;
        try {
            String[] parts = s.split(",");
            if (parts.length == 3) {
                return new BlockPos(
                    Integer.parseInt(parts[0]),
                    Integer.parseInt(parts[1]),
                    Integer.parseInt(parts[2])
                );
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {}
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isFire(BlockState state) {
        if (state == null || state.isAir()) return false;
        Block block = state.getBlock();
        Boolean cached = FIRE_CACHE.get(block);
        if (cached != null) return cached;

        boolean result = false;
        if (block instanceof BaseFireBlock || block == Blocks.FIRE || block == Blocks.SOUL_FIRE) {
            result = true;
        } else {
            ResourceLocation reg = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(block);
            if (reg != null) {
                String namespace = reg.getNamespace();
                String path = reg.getPath().toLowerCase();
                if (namespace.equals("burnt") && (path.equals("wood_fire") || path.matches("wood_fire_[2-9]"))) {
                    result = true;
                }
            }
        }
        FIRE_CACHE.put(block, result);
        return result;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // LAVA DEFENSE LOGIC
    // =========================================================================
    private static void tickLavaDefense(Level level, Player player) {
        if (player.tickCount % LAVA_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS != 0) return;

        int cd = player.getPersistentData().getInt(NBT_LAVA_COOLDOWN_KEY);
        if (cd > 0) {
            player.getPersistentData().putInt(NBT_LAVA_COOLDOWN_KEY, Math.max(0, cd - LAVA_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS));
            return;
        }

        BlockPos center = player.blockPosition();

        int lavaCount = countLavaInRadius(level, center);
        if (lavaCount < BIG_LAVA_THRESHOLD) return;

        BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:ambient.cave")).ifPresent(cave -> {
            level.playSound(null, center, cave, SoundSource.AMBIENT, 1.3f, 0.85f);
        });

        purgeLavaInRadius(level, center);

        player.getPersistentData().putInt(NBT_LAVA_COOLDOWN_KEY, LAVA_PURGE_COOLDOWN_TICKS);
    }

    private static int countLavaInRadius(Level level, BlockPos center) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return 0;
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();

        int count = 0;
        int cx = center.getX();
        int cy = center.getY();
        int cz = center.getZ();

        int minY = cy - LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_Y;
        int maxY = cy + LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_Y;

        for (int dx = -LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dx <= LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dx += 2) {
            int absX = cx + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz += 2) {
                int absZ = cz + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int localMinY = Math.max(currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight(), minY);
                int localMaxY = Math.min(currentChunk.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, maxY);

                int minSection = (localMinY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;
                int maxSection = (localMaxY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;

                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();

                for (int secIndex = minSection; secIndex <= maxSection; secIndex++) {
                    if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                    net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                    if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                    if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(DimensionDefenseProcedure::isLava)) continue;

                    int secMinY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight() + (secIndex << 4);
                    int startY = Math.max(localMinY, secMinY);
                    int endY = Math.min(localMaxY, secMinY + 15);

                    for (int dy = -LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_Y; dy <= LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_Y; dy += 2) {
                        int absY = cy + dy;
                        if (absY >= startY && absY <= endY) {
                            BlockState state = section.getBlockState(absX & 15, absY & 15, absZ & 15);
                            if (isLava(state)) count += 8;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static void purgeLavaInRadius(Level level, BlockPos center) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return;
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos p = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
        int cx = center.getX();
        int cy = center.getY();
        int cz = center.getZ();

        int minY = cy - LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_Y;
        int maxY = cy + LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_Y;

        for (int dx = -LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dx <= LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dx++) {
            int absX = cx + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= LAVA_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz++) {
                int absZ = cz + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int localMinY = Math.max(currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight(), minY);
                int localMaxY = Math.min(currentChunk.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, maxY);

                int minSection = (localMinY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;
                int maxSection = (localMaxY - currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight()) >> 4;

                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();

                for (int secIndex = minSection; secIndex <= maxSection; secIndex++) {
                    if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                    net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                    if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                    if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(DimensionDefenseProcedure::isLava)) continue;

                    int secMinY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight() + (secIndex << 4);
                    int startY = Math.max(localMinY, secMinY);
                    int endY = Math.min(localMaxY, secMinY + 15);

                    for (int absY = startY; absY <= endY; absY++) {
                        BlockState state = section.getBlockState(absX & 15, absY & 15, absZ & 15);
                        if (isLava(state)) {
                            p.set(absX, absY, absZ);
                            level.setBlock(p, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                            serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE, p.getX() + 0.5, p.getY() + 0.5, p.getZ() + 0.5, 3, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.05);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean isLava(BlockState state) {
        if (state == null || state.isAir()) return false;
        if (state.is(Blocks.LAVA)) return true;
        net.minecraft.world.level.material.FluidState fluid = state.getFluidState();
        return !fluid.isEmpty() && (fluid.is(Fluids.LAVA) || fluid.is(Fluids.FLOWING_LAVA));
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // LAVA SUPPRESSION LOGIC
    // =========================================================================
    private static void tickLavaSuppression(Level level, Player player, ResourceKey<Level> dim) {
        if (!(level instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel)) return;
        if (player.tickCount % SUPPRESSION_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS != 0) return;

        if (!isTargetDimension(dim)) return;

        // Trigger scan only when the player is deep underground where underground pools exist (-30 and below)
        if (player.getY() > -30) return;

        cleanupOldPlayerPlacedLava(level);

        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerChunkCache cache = serverLevel.getChunkSource();
        Map<Long, net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk> loadedChunks = new HashMap<>();
        BlockPos center = player.blockPosition();

        // Slicing to distribute performance budget over multiple ticks
        int totalSlices = 12;
        int currentSlice = (int) ((player.tickCount / SUPPRESSION_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS) % totalSlices);

        int range = SUPPRESSION_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ;
        int sliceWidth = (range * 2 + 1 + totalSlices - 1) / totalSlices;
        int startDx = -range + currentSlice * sliceWidth;
        int endDx = Math.min(range, startDx + sliceWidth - 1);

        // OPTIMIZATION: Reusable pos pointers prevent billions of temporary object allocations
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mutablePos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos neighborPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        int checked = 0;
        int removed = 0;

        for (int dx = startDx; dx <= endDx; dx++) {
            int absX = center.getX() + dx;
            int cxChunk = absX >> 4;
            int lastChunkZ = -999;
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk currentChunk = null;

            for (int dz = -SUPPRESSION_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz <= SUPPRESSION_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ; dz++) {
                int absZ = center.getZ() + dz;
                int czChunk = absZ >> 4;

                if (currentChunk == null || czChunk != lastChunkZ) {
                    lastChunkZ = czChunk;
                    long chunkKey = ChunkPos.asLong(cxChunk, czChunk);
                    currentChunk = loadedChunks.get(chunkKey);
                    if (currentChunk == null) {
                        currentChunk = cache.getChunkNow(cxChunk, czChunk);
                        if (currentChunk != null) loadedChunks.put(chunkKey, currentChunk);
                    }
                }

                if (currentChunk == null) continue;

                int minBuildY = currentChunk.getMinBuildHeight();
                if (-64 < minBuildY) continue;
                int secIndex = (-64 - minBuildY) >> 4;
                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection[] sections = currentChunk.getSections();
                if (secIndex < 0 || secIndex >= sections.length) continue;
                net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunkSection section = sections[secIndex];
                if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) continue;
                if (!section.getStates().maybeHas(state -> isLava(state) || state.getBlock() instanceof BaseFireBlock || state.is(Blocks.FIRE) || state.is(Blocks.SOUL_FIRE))) continue;

                for (int absY = -64; absY <= -49; absY++) {
                    checked++;
                    if (checked > MAX_CHECKS_PER_PLAYER_SCAN) return;

                    BlockState state = section.getBlockState(absX & 15, absY & 15, absZ & 15);
                    if (state.isAir()) continue;

                    if (absY <= Y_THRESHOLD) {
                        // --- LAVA PLACEMENT ZONE (-64 to -54) ---
                        if (state.is(Blocks.LAVA) || state.getFluidState().is(Fluids.LAVA)) {
                            mutablePos.set(absX, absY, absZ);
                            // Skip any coordinates protected by player placement actions
                            if (PLAYER_PLACED_LAVA.containsKey(mutablePos.asLong())) continue;

                            level.setBlock(mutablePos, Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState(), 2);
                            removed++;

                            // Extinguish adjacent fire blocks immediately around the newly converted wood
                            for (net.minecraft.core.Direction dir : net.minecraft.core.Direction.values()) {
                                if (dir == net.minecraft.core.Direction.DOWN) continue;
                                neighborPos.set(absX + dir.getStepX(), absY + dir.getStepY(), absZ + dir.getStepZ());
                                if (level.hasChunkAt(neighborPos)) {
                                    BlockState neighborState = level.getBlockState(neighborPos);
                                    if (neighborState.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.BaseFireBlock
                                        || neighborState.is(Blocks.FIRE)
                                        || neighborState.is(Blocks.SOUL_FIRE)) {
                                        level.setBlock(neighborPos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            if (removed >= MAX_REMOVALS_PER_PLAYER_SCAN) {
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        // --- THE ACTIVE FIRE CEILING ZONE (-53 to -49) ---
                        // Extinguish any fire blocks in the air layers sitting directly on top of the suppression threshold
                        if (state.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.BaseFireBlock
                            || state.is(Blocks.FIRE)
                            || state.is(Blocks.SOUL_FIRE)) {
                            mutablePos.set(absX, absY, absZ);
                            level.setBlock(mutablePos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void cleanupOldPlayerPlacedLava(Level level) {
        if (level.getGameTime() % PROTECTION_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_TICKS != 0) return;

        long now = level.getGameTime();
        PLAYER_PLACED_LAVA.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> now - entry.getValue() > PLAYER_LAVA_PROTECTION_TICKS);
    }

    private static boolean isTargetDimension(ResourceKey<Level> dim) {
        return dim.equals(BACKWOODS) || dim.equals(THE_GRAIN) || dim.equals(THE_SUB_STRATA) || dim.equals(THE_CROSSWORKS);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // TNT DEFENSE LOGIC
    // =========================================================================
    private static void tickTntDefense(Level level, Player player) {
        if (player.tickCount % TNT_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS != 0) return;

        int cd = player.getPersistentData().getInt(NBT_TNT_COOLDOWN_KEY);
        if (cd > 0) {
            player.getPersistentData().putInt(NBT_TNT_COOLDOWN_KEY, Math.max(0, cd - TNT_CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS));
            return;
        }

        BlockPos center = player.blockPosition();

        int tntCount = countPrimedTntInRadius(level, center);
        if (tntCount < BIG_TNT_THRESHOLD) return;

        player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.BLINDNESS, 60, 5, false, false));
        player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 80, 5, false, false));

        BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.getOptional(ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:ambient.cave")).ifPresent(cave ->
            level.playSound(null, center, cave, SoundSource.AMBIENT, 1.3f, 0.85f)
        );

        BlockPos capturedCenter = center;
        Level capturedLevel = level;
        net.mcreator.thebackwoods.TheBackwoodsMod.queueServerWork(40, () -> {
            purgePrimedTntInRadius(capturedLevel, capturedCenter);
        });

        player.getPersistentData().putInt(NBT_TNT_COOLDOWN_KEY, TNT_PURGE_COOLDOWN_TICKS);
    }

    private static boolean isExplosiveEntity(Entity entity) {
        if (!entity.isAlive()) return false;
        if (entity instanceof PrimedTnt) return true;

        ResourceLocation registryName = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType());
        if (registryName != null) {
            String idStr = registryName.toString();
            return idStr.equals("alexscaves:nuclear_bomb");
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static int countPrimedTntInRadius(Level level, BlockPos center) {
        AABB box = AABB.ofSize(
                new Vec3(center.getX() + 0.5, center.getY() + 0.5, center.getZ() + 0.5),
                TNT_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ * 2.0,
                TNT_SCAN_RADIUS_Y * 2.0,
                TNT_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ * 2.0
        );
        return level.getEntitiesOfClass(Entity.class, box, DimensionDefenseProcedure::isExplosiveEntity).size();
    }

    private static void purgePrimedTntInRadius(Level level, BlockPos center) {
        AABB box = AABB.ofSize(
                new Vec3(center.getX() + 0.5, center.getY() + 0.5, center.getZ() + 0.5),
                TNT_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ * 2.0,
                TNT_SCAN_RADIUS_Y * 2.0,
                TNT_SCAN_RADIUS_XZ * 2.0
        );

        List<Entity> tnts = level.getEntitiesOfClass(Entity.class, box, DimensionDefenseProcedure::isExplosiveEntity);
        for (Entity tnt : tnts) {
            ResourceLocation registryName = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(tnt.getType());
            if (registryName != null && registryName.toString().equals("alexscaves:nuclear_bomb")) {
                double targetY = tnt.level().dimension().equals(THE_CROSSWORKS)
                        ? tnt.getY() + CROSSWORKS_NUKE_HEIGHT_OFFSET : ALEXSCAVES_NUKE_NORMAL_Y;
                tnt.teleportTo(tnt.getX(), targetY, tnt.getZ());
                tnt.setDeltaMovement(new Vec3(0, -0.2, 0));
                tnt.hurtMarked = true;
            } else {
                tnt.discard();
            }
        }
    }
}

	private static void execute(@Nullable Object event, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, DamageSource damagesource, Entity entity, Entity immediatesourceentity, Entity sourceentity) {

			return;

				double sideSign = mob.getRandom().nextBoolean() ? 1.0 : -1.0;

				double dist = 6.0 + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * 5.0; // 6 - 11 blocks

				double tryX = px + (awayVec.x * Math.cos(angleOffset) - awayVec.z * Math.sin(angleOffset)) * dist;
				double tryZ = pz + (awayVec.x * Math.sin(angleOffset) + awayVec.z * Math.cos(angleOffset)) * dist;

				for (int yOffset = 3; yOffset >= -4; yOffset--) {
					BlockPos pos = BlockPos.containing(tryX, py + yOffset, tryZ);
					BlockPos below = pos.below();

			}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectInstance;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffects;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import java.util.Comparator;

public class DorcelessSplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure {

	private static final double DETECTION_RADIUS = 32.0;
	private static final double MIN_TELEPORT_DIST = 3.0; // Keeps at least 3 blocks distance during gaze
	private static final String NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER = "dorceless_tp_timer";
	private static final String NBT_GAZE_TICKS = "dorceless_gaze_ticks";

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		execute(null, world, x, y, z, entity);
	}

	private static void execute(@Nullable Object event, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		if (!(entity instanceof Mob mob) || !mob.isAlive() || mob.isRemoved()
				|| !(world instanceof Level))
			return;

		// 1. Target Acquisition / Retention (Exclude Creative & Spectator players)
		Player targetPlayer = null;
		if (mob.getTarget() instanceof Player playerTarget && isSurvivalPlayer(playerTarget)
				&& playerTarget.level() == mob.level() && mob.distanceToSqr(playerTarget) <= DETECTION_RADIUS * DETECTION_RADIUS) {
			targetPlayer = playerTarget;
		} else {
			final Vec3 center = new Vec3(x, y, z);
			targetPlayer = world.getEntitiesOfClass(Player.class, new AABB(center, center).inflate(DETECTION_RADIUS), p -> isSurvivalPlayer(p))
				.stream().min(Comparator.comparingDouble(p -> p.distanceToSqr(center))).orElse(null);
			if (targetPlayer != null) {
				mob.setTarget(targetPlayer);
			}
		}

		if (targetPlayer == null) {
			// Decay gaze counter when no target is in range
			double currentVal = Math.max(0, mob.getPersistentData().getDouble(NBT_GAZE_TICKS) - 2);
			mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_GAZE_TICKS, currentVal);
			mob.getPersistentData().putDouble("stare_ticks", currentVal);
			return;
		}

		// 2. Body Alignment & Head Snap (Whole body turns to face target instantly)
		double headY = mob.getY() + mob.getEyeHeight();
		double targetHeadY = targetPlayer.getY() + targetPlayer.getEyeHeight();
		
		double dxToPlayer = targetPlayer.getX() - mob.getX();
		double dzToPlayer = targetPlayer.getZ() - mob.getZ();
		float targetYaw = (float) (Mth.atan2(dzToPlayer, dxToPlayer) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0F;

		mob.setYRot(targetYaw);
		mob.setYBodyRot(targetYaw);
		mob.setYHeadRot(targetYaw);
		mob.getLookControl().setLookAt(targetPlayer.getX(), targetHeadY, targetPlayer.getZ(), 360.0F, 360.0F);

		// 3. Mutual Stare / Line-of-Sight Detection
		Vec3 mobEyePos = new Vec3(mob.getX(), headY, mob.getZ());
		Vec3 playerEyePos = new Vec3(targetPlayer.getX(), targetHeadY, targetPlayer.getZ());
		Vec3 pToD = mobEyePos.subtract(playerEyePos).normalize();
		Vec3 playerLook = targetPlayer.getLookAngle().normalize();

		double dot = playerLook.dot(pToD);
		boolean playerLookingAtDorceless = dot > 0.45 && targetPlayer.hasLineOfSight(mob);

		double currentDist = mob.distanceTo(targetPlayer);

		// 4. EYE MAGNET (Subtle crosshair magnet drag toward Dorceless's hollow face)
		if (world instanceof Level clientLevel && clientLevel.isClientSide()
				&& playerLookingAtDorceless && currentDist <= 20.0) {
			double dxToMob = mob.getX() - targetPlayer.getX();
			double dzToMob = mob.getZ() - targetPlayer.getZ();
			double dyToMob = headY - targetPlayer.getEyePosition().y;
			double distHoriz = Math.sqrt(dxToMob * dxToMob + dzToMob * dzToMob);

			float idealYaw = (float) (Mth.atan2(dzToMob, dxToMob) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0F;
			float idealPitch = (float) (-(Mth.atan2(dyToMob, distHoriz) * (180.0 / Math.PI)));

			float yawDiff = Mth.wrapDegrees(idealYaw - targetPlayer.getYRot());
			float pitchDiff = Mth.wrapDegrees(idealPitch - targetPlayer.getXRot());

			// Smooth magnetic pull locking player crosshair onto Dorceless's face
			targetPlayer.setYRot(targetPlayer.getYRot() + yawDiff * 0.08F);
			targetPlayer.setXRot(targetPlayer.getXRot() + pitchDiff * 0.08F);
		}

		// Only the server owns effects, damage, timers and teleports; the client keeps the visual gaze pull.
		if (!(world instanceof ServerLevel)) return;

		// 5. PROGRESSIVE DARKNESS & CONTINUOUS GAZE OVERLOAD
		double gazeTicks = mob.getPersistentData().getDouble(NBT_GAZE_TICKS);
		double alertTicks = mob.getPersistentData().getDouble("dorceless_alert_ticks");

		if (playerLookingAtDorceless) {
			gazeTicks += 1;
			alertTicks = 80; // Keep fully alert (4s linger duration) when actively looked at
			mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_GAZE_TICKS, gazeTicks);
			mob.getPersistentData().putDouble("stare_ticks", gazeTicks);

			if (gazeTicks < 40) { // 0 - 2 seconds: Initial Darkness I
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 40, 0, false, false, true));
			} else if (gazeTicks < 100) { // 2 - 5 seconds: Darkness II + Slowness I
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 40, 1, false, false, true));
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 40, 0, false, false, true));
			} else if (gazeTicks < 160) { // 5 - 8 seconds: Darkness III + Slowness II + Nausea
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 40, 2, false, false, true));
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 40, 1, false, false, true));
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.CONFUSION, 60, 0, false, false, true));
			} else { // 8+ seconds: CONTINUOUS SUSTAINED OVERLOAD
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 60, 4, false, false, true));
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.BLINDNESS, 60, 0, false, false, true));
				targetPlayer.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 60, 2, false, false, true));

				// Inflict void/magic damage pulse every 30 ticks (1.5 seconds) continuously while staring
				if (gazeTicks % 30 == 0) {
					targetPlayer.hurt(targetPlayer.damageSources().magic(), 3.0F);

					if (world instanceof Level level) {
						level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(targetPlayer.getX(), targetPlayer.getY(), targetPlayer.getZ()),
							SoundEvents.ENDER_DRAGON_GROWL, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 0.6F, 0.2F);
					}

					// Jump-scare positioning shift on pulse
					attemptSmartTeleportNear(world, mob, targetPlayer, MIN_TELEPORT_DIST, MIN_TELEPORT_DIST + 2.0, false);
				}

				// Cap gaze counter at 200 so pulse loops seamlessly
				if (gazeTicks > 200) {
					mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_GAZE_TICKS, 160);
					mob.getPersistentData().putDouble("stare_ticks", 160);
				}
			}
		} else {
			if (gazeTicks > 0) {
				double decayVal = Math.max(0, gazeTicks - 2);
				mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_GAZE_TICKS, decayVal);
				mob.getPersistentData().putDouble("stare_ticks", decayVal);
			}
			if (alertTicks > 0) {
				alertTicks -= 1; // Gradually cool down alert timer after looking away
			}
		}
		mob.getPersistentData().putDouble("dorceless_alert_ticks", alertTicks);

		// 6. POSITIONING TELEPORTATION (ACTIVE APPROACH OR LINGERING STALKING)
		double tpTimer = mob.getPersistentData().getDouble(NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER);
		tpTimer -= 1;
		
		boolean isAlert = alertTicks > 0;

		if (playerLookingAtDorceless && gazeTicks >= 20) {
			// Active Stare Approach
			if (tpTimer <= 0) {
				mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER, 40 + mob.getRandom().nextInt(51)); // 2-4.5s cooldown

				if (currentDist > MIN_TELEPORT_DIST + 0.5) {
					double targetTpDist = Math.max(MIN_TELEPORT_DIST, currentDist - (3.0 + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * 3.5));
					attemptSmartTeleportNear(world, mob, targetPlayer, MIN_TELEPORT_DIST, targetTpDist, false);
				}
			} else {
				mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER, tpTimer);
			}
		} else if (isAlert && currentDist > 6.0) {
			// Lingering Stalking: Player turned away, but Dorceless remains alert and stalks behind
			if (tpTimer <= 0) {
				mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER, 30 + mob.getRandom().nextInt(41)); // 1.5-3.5s cooldown

				double targetTpDist = Math.max(MIN_TELEPORT_DIST + 1.0, currentDist - (2.5 + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * 3.0));
				attemptSmartTeleportNear(world, mob, targetPlayer, MIN_TELEPORT_DIST + 1.0, targetTpDist, true);
			} else {
				mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER, tpTimer);
			}
		} else {
			// Player looked away and alert timer expired -> Dorceless stays frozen in position
			mob.getPersistentData().putDouble(NBT_TELEPORT_TIMER, 40);
		}
	}

	private static boolean isSurvivalPlayer(Player p) {
		return p.isAlive() && !p.isSpectator() && !p.isCreative();
	}

	private static void attemptSmartTeleportNear(LevelAccessor world, Mob mob, Player player, double minDist, double maxDist, boolean isStalking) {
		double px = player.getX();
		double py = player.getY();
		double pz = player.getZ();

		boolean playerHoldingRanged = player.getMainHandItem().is(Items.BOW) || player.getMainHandItem().is(Items.CROSSBOW) || player.isUsingItem();

		// Current vector from player to mob
		double dxToMob = mob.getX() - px;
		double dzToMob = mob.getZ() - pz;
		double currentAngleFromPlayer = Math.atan2(dzToMob, dxToMob);

		for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 14; attempt++) {
			double tryX, tryZ;
			double dist = minDist + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * (maxDist - minDist);

			if (isStalking) {
				// Teleport behind or in blind spot of player when player turns away
				double sideSign = mob.getRandom().nextBoolean() ? 1.0 : -1.0;
				double blindAngle = player.getYRot() * (Math.PI / 180.0) + Math.PI + sideSign * (mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * (Math.PI / 6.0));
				tryX = px + Math.sin(-blindAngle) * dist;
				tryZ = pz + Math.cos(-blindAngle) * dist;
			} else if (playerHoldingRanged) {
				// Zigzag Flank maneuver if player has ranged weapon out
				double sideSign = mob.getRandom().nextBoolean() ? 1.0 : -1.0;
				double flankAngle = currentAngleFromPlayer + sideSign * (Math.PI / 4.0 + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * (Math.PI / 6.0));
				tryX = px + Math.cos(flankAngle) * dist;
				tryZ = pz + Math.sin(flankAngle) * dist;
			} else {
				// DIRECT STRAIGHT LINE APPROACH toward player with small side jitter (±15°)
				double sideOffset = (mob.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5) * (Math.PI / 6.0);
				double approachAngle = currentAngleFromPlayer + sideOffset;
				tryX = px + Math.cos(approachAngle) * dist;
				tryZ = pz + Math.sin(approachAngle) * dist;
			}

			for (int yOffset = 3; yOffset >= -4; yOffset--) {
				BlockPos pos = BlockPos.containing(tryX, py + yOffset, tryZ);
				BlockPos below = pos.below();

				if (world.getBlockState(below).isSolid() && world.isEmptyBlock(pos) && world.isEmptyBlock(pos.above())) {
					double finalX = tryX;
					double finalY = pos.getY();
					double finalZ = tryZ;

					if (world instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
						serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SQUID_INK, mob.getX(), mob.getY() + 1.0, mob.getZ(), 15, 0.2, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05);
					}
					if (world instanceof Level level) {
						level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(mob.getX(), mob.getY(), mob.getZ()), SoundEvents.ENDERMAN_TELEPORT, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 0.8F, 0.5F);
					}

					mob.teleportTo(finalX, finalY, finalZ);
					
					// Face body & head immediately after teleport
					double dx = player.getX() - finalX;
					double dz = player.getZ() - finalZ;
					float yaw = (float) (Mth.atan2(dz, dx) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0F;
					mob.setYRot(yaw);
					mob.setYBodyRot(yaw);
					mob.setYHeadRot(yaw);
					mob.getLookControl().setLookAt(player, 360.0F, 360.0F);

					if (world instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
						serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SQUID_INK, finalX, finalY + 1.0, finalZ, 15, 0.2, 0.5, 0.2, 0.05);
					}
					if (world instanceof Level level) {
						level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.ENDERMAN_TELEPORT, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 0.8F, 0.5F);
					}

					return;
				}
			}
		}
	}
} // 1.21.1

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.ProjectileImpactEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.network.TheBackwoodsModVariables;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class FadingPhysicalPhaseProcedure {

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onProjectileImpact(ProjectileImpactEvent event) {
        if (event.getRayTraceResult() instanceof net.minecraft.world.phys.EntityHitResult entityHitResult) {
            Entity hitEntity = entityHitResult.getEntity();
            if (hitEntity != null) {
                double fadeLevel = getFadeLevel(hitEntity);
                if (fadeLevel > 15.0) {
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Highly optimized fade level retrieval for 1.21.1.
     */
    public static double getFadeLevel(Entity entity) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Player player) {
            try {
                return player.getData(TheBackwoodsModVariables.PLAYER_VARIABLES).fade_level;
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        try {
            return entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("fade_level");
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return 0.0;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.AttackEntityEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.PlayerTickEvent;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;

import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.network.TheBackwoodsModVariables;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class FamiliarEntityLookProcedure {

    private static final double LOOK_RANGE = 32.0;
    private static final double STARE_RANGE = 24.0;
    private static final double STARE_DOT_THRESHOLD = 0.97;
    private static final int STARE_TICKS_MIN = 60;
    private static final int STARE_TICKS_MAX = 100;
    private static final int SOUND_COOLDOWN = 200;
    private static final double DESPAWN_CHANCE = 0.15;

    private static final Map<UUID, Integer> stareTimers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<UUID, Integer> soundCooldowns = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private static final ResourceKey<Level> FAMILIAR_DIM =
        ResourceKey.create(Registries.DIMENSION, ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:the_familiar"));

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onPlayerTick(PlayerTickEvent.Post event) {
        Player player = event.getEntity();
        if (player == null || player.level().isClientSide())
            return;

        if (!player.level().dimension().equals(FAMILIAR_DIM))
            return;

        UUID playerUUID = player.getUUID();
        TheBackwoodsModVariables.PlayerVariables vars = player.getData(TheBackwoodsModVariables.PLAYER_VARIABLES);

        // --- IMPROVED DAY TRACKING ---
        long time = player.level().getDayTime() % 24000;
        
        // Between 0 and 1000 ticks is early morning
        if (time < 1000 && !vars.dayIncrementedToday) {
            vars.daysInFamiliar += 1;
            vars.dayIncrementedToday = true;
            vars.markSyncDirty();
        } else if (time > 1000 && vars.dayIncrementedToday) {
            // Reset the "Check" after morning passes so it can trigger tomorrow
            vars.dayIncrementedToday = false;
            vars.markSyncDirty();
        }

        // Difficulty scaling: Day 1: 0%, Day 2: 33%, Day 3: 66%, Day 4+: 100%
        double stareChance = Math.min(1.0, Math.max(0, (vars.daysInFamiliar - 1) * 0.33));

		// --- THE LOOKING LOGIC ---
        Vec3 playerPos = player.position();
        player.level().getEntitiesOfClass(Mob.class,
                new AABB(playerPos, playerPos).inflate(LOOK_RANGE),
                mob -> true) // We already know they are Mobs, no need to check for Player
            .forEach(mob -> {
                // Use Mob UUID to keep behavior consistent for that specific entity
                double entitySeed = Math.abs(mob.getUUID().getLeastSignificantBits() % 100) / 100.0;
                
                if (entitySeed < stareChance) {
                    mob.lookAt(net.minecraft.commands.arguments.EntityAnchorArgument.Anchor.EYES,
                        new Vec3(player.getX(), player.getEyeY(), player.getZ()));
                }
            });

        // --- STARE DETECTION SOUNDS ---
        int cooldown = soundCooldowns.getOrDefault(playerUUID, 0);
        if (cooldown > 0) soundCooldowns.put(playerUUID, cooldown - 1);

        Vec3 eyePos = player.getEyePosition();
        Vec3 lookDir = player.getLookAngle().normalize();

        boolean staringAtMob = player.level().getEntitiesOfClass(Mob.class,
                new AABB(playerPos, playerPos).inflate(STARE_RANGE))
            .stream()
            .anyMatch(mob -> {
                Vec3 toEntity = mob.getEyePosition().subtract(eyePos).normalize();
                return lookDir.dot(toEntity) > STARE_DOT_THRESHOLD;
            });

        if (staringAtMob) {
            int stareTime = stareTimers.getOrDefault(playerUUID, 0) + 1;
            stareTimers.put(playerUUID, stareTime);

            if (stareTime >= (STARE_TICKS_MIN + player.getRandom().nextInt(40)) && cooldown <= 0) {
                player.level().playSound(null, player.blockPosition(), 
                    BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT.get(ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:ambient.cave")), 
                    SoundSource.AMBIENT, 1.0f, 0.8f);
                stareTimers.put(playerUUID, 0);
                soundCooldowns.put(playerUUID, SOUND_COOLDOWN);
            }
        } else {
            stareTimers.put(playerUUID, 0);
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onAttackEntity(AttackEntityEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity().level().isClientSide() || !event.getEntity().level().dimension().equals(FAMILIAR_DIM))
            return;

        if (Math.random() < DESPAWN_CHANCE) {
            Entity target = event.getTarget();
            if (target.level() instanceof ServerLevel _level) {
                _level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE, target.getX(), target.getY() + 1, target.getZ(), 50, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.1);
            }
            target.discard();
            event.setCanceled(true);
        }
    }
}

				AttributeModifier modifier = new AttributeModifier(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:weight"), (coreCount * (-0.04) + heavyCoreCount * (-0.12)), AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_VALUE);
				if (!_entity.getAttribute(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED).hasModifier(modifier.id())) {
					_entity.getAttribute(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED).addTransientModifier(modifier);
				}
			}
			if (entity instanceof LivingEntity _entity) {
				AttributeModifier modifier = new AttributeModifier(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:weight2"), (coreCount * 0.017 + heavyCoreCount * 0.051), AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_VALUE);
				if (!_entity.getAttribute(Attributes.GRAVITY).hasModifier(modifier.id())) {
					_entity.getAttribute(Attributes.GRAVITY).addTransientModifier(modifier);
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
