	    private static Class<?> statsApi, flightApi;
	    private static java.lang.reflect.Method ignoreThreshold, damageReduction, stopFlight;
	    private static boolean checkedPowers;

	    public RotViltrumiteAdaptation() {}

	    public static boolean isViltrumite(Entity entity) {
	        if (entity == null) return false;
	        if (!checkedApi) {
	            checkedApi = true;
	            try {
	                playerApi = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.util.ViltrumiteCorePlayer");
	                isViltrumite = playerApi.getMethod("isViltrumite");
	                npcType = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.entity.ViltrumiteFakePlayer");
	            } catch (ClassNotFoundException absent) {
	                // Viltrumite Core is optional; explicit entity IDs can still enable another implementation.
	            } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError failure) { warn(failure); }
	        }
	        if (npcType != null && npcType.isInstance(entity)) return true;
	        if (playerApi != null && isViltrumite != null && playerApi.isInstance(entity)) {
	            try { if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(isViltrumite.invoke(entity))) return true; }
	            catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) { warn(failure); }
	        }
	        if (ADDITIONAL_VILTRUMITE_ENTITY_IDS.length > 0) {
	            String id = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType()).toString();
	            for (String configured : ADDITIONAL_VILTRUMITE_ENTITY_IDS) if (configured.equals(id)) return true;
	        }
	        return false;
	    }

	    private static void warn(Throwable failure) {
	        if (!warned) {
	            warned = true;
	            com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger().warn("Rot Viltrumite adaptation API unavailable", failure);
	        }
	    }

	    private static boolean alive(RotEntity rot) {
	        return rot.isAlive() && !rot.isRemoved() && !rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath)
	                && !net.mcreator.thebackwoods.RotDataGuardian.isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot);
	    }

	    private static void remember(RotEntity rot, Entity threat) {
	        if (!(rot.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !isViltrumite(threat)) return;
	        rot.getPersistentData().putString(THREAT, threat.getUUID().toString());
	        rot.getPersistentData().putLong(CONTACT, level.getGameTime());
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent
	    public static void hurt(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.living.LivingDamageEvent.Post event) {
	        if (!ENABLED || event.getNewDamage() <= 0 || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) return;
	        Entity attacker = event.getSource().getEntity();
	        if (event.getEntity() instanceof RotEntity rot && alive(rot)) remember(rot, attacker);
	        else if (attacker instanceof RotEntity rot && alive(rot)) remember(rot, event.getEntity());
	    }

	    private static Entity opponent(RotEntity rot, ServerLevel level) {
	        LivingEntity target = rot.getTarget();
	        if (target != null && target.isAlive() && isViltrumite(target)) return target;
	        var data = rot.getPersistentData();
	        String id = data.getString(THREAT);
	        long age = level.getGameTime() - data.getLong(CONTACT);
	        if (id.isEmpty() || age < 0 || age > Math.max(0, RECENT_COMBAT_TICKS)) return null;
	        try {
	            Entity remembered = level.getEntity(java.util.UUID.fromString(id));
	            return remembered != null && remembered.isAlive() && isViltrumite(remembered) ? remembered : null;
	        } catch (IllegalArgumentException invalid) { return null; }
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent
	    public static void sample(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
	        if (!ENABLED || !(event.getEntity() instanceof RotEntity rot) || !(rot.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !alive(rot)) return;
	        var data = rot.getPersistentData();
	        long now = level.getGameTime(), previous = data.getLong(SAMPLE);
	        int interval = Math.max(1, SAMPLE_INTERVAL_TICKS);
	        if (now >= previous && now - previous < interval) return;
	        data.putLong(SAMPLE, now);
	        Entity target = opponent(rot, level);
	        double distance = Math.max(0, MAX_COMBAT_DISTANCE);
	        if (target != null && rot.distanceToSqr(target) <= distance * distance) {
	            int elapsed = (int)Math.min(interval, Math.max(0L, now - previous));
	            int cap = Math.max(1, STAGE_THREE_COMBAT_TICKS);
	            data.putInt(PROGRESS, (int)Math.min(cap, (long)Math.max(0, data.getInt(PROGRESS)) + elapsed));
	        }
	    }

	    public static int stage(Entity entity) {
	        if (!ENABLED || !(entity instanceof RotEntity rot) || !alive(rot)
	                || !net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures.RotOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.MINOS_MODE) return 0;
	        int ticks = rot.getPersistentData().getInt(PROGRESS);
	        return ticks >= Math.max(1, STAGE_THREE_COMBAT_TICKS) ? 3
	                : ticks >= Math.max(1, STAGE_TWO_COMBAT_TICKS) ? 2
	                : ticks >= Math.max(1, STAGE_ONE_COMBAT_TICKS) ? 1 : 0;
	    }

	    public static void punch(Entity entity, Entity target, Vec3 direction) {
	        if (target == null) return;
	        double base = Math.min(100.0, net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures.RotOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.MELEE_PUNCH_DAMAGE
	                * net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures.RotOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.getAdaptationMultiplier(entity));
	        net.mcreator.thebackwoods.BackwoodsImpactDebris.punch(entity, target, direction, heavyDamage(entity, target, base));
	        int stage = combatStage(entity, target);
	        if (stage == 0) return;
	        Vec3 start = target.position().add(0, target.getBbHeight() * 0.45, 0);
	        Vec3 forward = direction.lengthSqr() > 0.0001 ? direction.normalize() : entity.getLookAngle();
	        double length = setting(PUNCH_LENGTHS, stage, 16);
	        Strike strike = new Strike();
	        Impact initial = enqueue(entity, target, start, start.add(forward.scale(length)), setting(PUNCH_RADII, stage, 4), false, 0, strike);
	        if (initial != null && ENABLE_SWEPT_COLLISIONS && target.level() == entity.level()) {
	            Work work = WORK.get(initial.level.getServer());
	            if (work.launches.containsKey(target.getUUID()) || work.launches.size() < Math.max(0, Math.min(128, MAX_TRACKED_LAUNCHES)))
	                work.launches.put(target.getUUID(), new Launch(initial.level, entity.getUUID(), target, strike));
	        }
	    }

	    public static void slam(Entity entity, Entity target, Vec3 position) {
	        int stage = stage(entity);
	        if (stage == 0) return;
	        enqueue(entity, target, position, position, setting(CRATER_RADII, stage, 6), true, setting(CRATER_DEPTHS, stage, 4), new Strike());
	    }

	    private static int combatStage(Entity entity, Entity target) {
	        int learned = stage(entity);
	        if (learned == 0 || !(entity instanceof RotEntity rot) || !(rot.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return 0;
	        Entity threat = target != null && isViltrumite(target) ? target : opponent(rot, level);
	        double range = Math.max(0, MAX_COMBAT_DISTANCE);
	        return !ONLY_DURING_VILTRUMITE_COMBAT || threat != null && threat.isAlive() && rot.distanceToSqr(threat) <= range * range ? learned : 0;
	    }

	    public static double heavyDamage(Entity entity, Entity target, double base) {
	        int learned = combatStage(entity, target);
	        if (!SCALE_HEAVY_DAMAGE || learned == 0) return base;
	        double ceiling = Double.isFinite(MAX_ADAPTED_HEAVY_DAMAGE) ? Math.max(base, MAX_ADAPTED_HEAVY_DAMAGE) : base;
	        return Math.min(ceiling, base * Math.max(1, setting(HEAVY_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIERS, learned, 4)));
	    }

	    public static double heavyKnockback(Entity entity, Entity target) {
	        int learned = combatStage(entity, target);
	        return !SCALE_HEAVY_KNOCKBACK || learned == 0 ? 1 : Math.max(1, setting(HEAVY_KNOCKBACK_MULTIPLIERS, learned, 3));
	    }

	    private static double setting(double[] values, int stage, double maximum) {
	        if (values == null || values.length < stage || !Double.isFinite(values[stage - 1])) return 0;
	        return Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, values[stage - 1]));
	    }

	    private static Impact enqueue(Entity entity, Entity target, Vec3 start, Vec3 end, double radius, boolean crater, double depth, Strike strike) {
	        if (!(entity instanceof RotEntity rot) || !(rot.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || radius <= 0 || !alive(rot)) return null;
	        Entity threat = target != null && isViltrumite(target) ? target : opponent(rot, level);
	        double range = Math.max(0, MAX_COMBAT_DISTANCE);
	        if (ONLY_DURING_VILTRUMITE_COMBAT && (threat == null || !threat.isAlive() || rot.distanceToSqr(threat) > range * range)) return null;
	        if (RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING && !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.canEntityGrief(level, rot)) return null;
	        Work work = WORK.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new Work());
	        int perRot = work.owners.getOrDefault(rot.getUUID(), 0);
	        if (work.jobs.size() >= Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_QUEUED_IMPACTS))
	                || perRot >= Math.max(0, Math.min(16, MAX_IMPACTS_PER_ROT))) return null;
	        Impact impact = new Impact(level, rot.getUUID(), start, end, radius, crater, depth, level.getGameTime(), strike, null);
	        work.jobs.add(impact);
	        work.owners.put(rot.getUUID(), perRot + 1);
	        return impact;
	    }


	    private static void powers() {
	        if (checkedPowers) return;
	        checkedPowers = true;
	        try {
	            statsApi = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.util.ViltrumiteStatHolder");
	            ignoreThreshold = statsApi.getMethod("getDamageIgnoreThreshold");
	            damageReduction = statsApi.getMethod("getDamageReduction");
	        } catch (ClassNotFoundException absent) {
	        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError failure) { warn(failure); }
	        try {
	            flightApi = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumiteflight.util.ViltrumiteFlightPlayer");
	            stopFlight = flightApi.getMethod("stopFlight");
	        } catch (ClassNotFoundException absent) {
	        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError failure) { warn(failure); }
	    }

	    /** Learn the actual weak-hit threshold; normal hurt processing, armor, blocking and invulnerability still apply. */
	    public static float attackDamage(Entity attacker, Entity target, float original) {
	        if (!ENABLED || !LEARN_WEAK_HIT_THRESHOLD || !(attacker instanceof RotEntity rot) || !alive(rot)
	                || !(rot.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !isViltrumite(target) || target.isInvulnerable()
	                || !Float.isFinite(original) || original <= 0) return original;
	        if (target instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player
	                && (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator() || player.getAbilities().invulnerable)) return original;
	        powers();
	        if (statsApi == null || !statsApi.isInstance(target) || ignoreThreshold == null || damageReduction == null) return original;
	        try {
	            double threshold = ((Number)ignoreThreshold.invoke(target)).doubleValue();
	            double fraction = 1.0 - ((Number)damageReduction.invoke(target)).doubleValue() * 0.01;
	            if (!Double.isFinite(threshold) || !Double.isFinite(fraction) || threshold <= 0 || fraction <= 0.001
	                    || original * fraction >= threshold) return original;
	            var data = rot.getPersistentData();
	            long now = level.getGameTime(), last = data.getLong(WEAK_SAMPLE);
	            if (!data.contains(WEAK_SAMPLE) || now < last || now - last >= 10) {
	                data.putInt(WEAK_HITS, Math.min(64, Math.max(0, data.getInt(WEAK_HITS)) + 1));
	                data.putLong(WEAK_SAMPLE, now);
	            }
	            remember(rot, target);
	            if (data.getInt(WEAK_HITS) < Math.max(1, WEAK_HITS_TO_LEARN)) return original;
	            double cap = Double.isFinite(MAX_THRESHOLD_ADAPTED_DAMAGE) ? Math.max(original, Math.min(2048, MAX_THRESHOLD_ADAPTED_DAMAGE)) : original;
	            return (float)Math.max(original, Math.min(cap, (threshold + 0.5) / fraction));
	        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) { warn(failure); return original; }
	    }

	    private static final class Lift {
	        final ServerLevel level;
	        final java.util.UUID owner;
	        final Entity victim;
	        final double startY;
	        final boolean reinforce;
	        double rise;
	        int remaining = 4; // Matches the existing uppercut launch window; never changes combo clocks.
	        Lift(ServerLevel level, RotEntity owner, Entity victim) {
	            this.level = level; this.owner = owner.getUUID(); this.victim = victim; startY = victim.getY();
	            reinforce = owner.getPersistentData().getInt(FAILED_LIFTS) >= Math.max(1, FAILED_LAUNCHES_TO_LEARN);
	        }
	    }

	    public static void uppercut(Entity entity, Entity victim) {
	        if (!ENABLED || !LEARN_UPPERCUT_RESISTANCE || !(entity instanceof RotEntity rot) || !alive(rot)
	                || !(rot.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || victim == null || !victim.isAlive()
	                || !isViltrumite(victim) || victim.level() != level) return;
	        remember(rot, victim);
	        Work work = WORK.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new Work());
	        if (work.lifts.containsKey(victim.getUUID()) || work.lifts.size() < Math.max(0, Math.min(128, MAX_TRACKED_UPPERCUTS)))
	            work.lifts.put(victim.getUUID(), new Lift(level, rot, victim));
	    }

	    private static boolean freeHeadroom(ServerLevel level, Entity entity) {
	        BlockPos head = BlockPos.containing(entity.getX(), entity.getBoundingBox().maxY + 0.1, entity.getZ());
	        var chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(head.getX() >> 4, head.getZ() >> 4);
	        return chunk != null && !chunk.getBlockState(head).blocksMotion();
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent
	    public static void observeUppercuts(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
	        Work work = WORK.get(event.getServer());
	        if (work == null) return;
	        for (var iterator = work.lifts.values().iterator(); iterator.hasNext();) {
	            Lift lift = iterator.next();
	            Entity owner = lift.level.getEntity(lift.owner), target = lift.victim;
	            if (!ENABLED || !LEARN_UPPERCUT_RESISTANCE || !(owner instanceof RotEntity rot) || !alive(rot)
	                    || !target.isAlive() || target.isRemoved() || target.level() != lift.level || rot.distanceToSqr(target) > 4096) {
	                iterator.remove(); continue;
	            }
	            boolean room = freeHeadroom(lift.level, target);
	            lift.rise = Math.max(lift.rise, target.getY() - lift.startY);
	            if (lift.reinforce && room) {
	                powers();
	                if (flightApi != null && stopFlight != null && flightApi.isInstance(target)) {
	                    try { stopFlight.invoke(target); }
	                    catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) { warn(failure); }
	                }
	                Vec3 motion = target.getDeltaMovement();
	                double minimum = Math.min(3.8, 1.6 + rot.getPersistentData().getInt(FAILED_LIFTS) * 0.4);
	                target.setDeltaMovement(motion.x, Math.min(3.8, Math.max(minimum, motion.y)), motion.z);
	                target.hasImpulse = true; target.hurtMarked = true;
	                if (target instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
	                    player.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(player));
	            }
	            if (--lift.remaining <= 0) {
	                if (room && lift.rise < 0.75) {
	                    var data = rot.getPersistentData();
	                    data.putInt(FAILED_LIFTS, Math.min(8, Math.max(0, data.getInt(FAILED_LIFTS)) + 1));
	                }
	                iterator.remove();
	            }
	        }
	    }

	    private static final class Work {
	        final java.util.ArrayDeque<Impact> jobs = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
	        final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, Integer> owners = new java.util.HashMap<>();
	        final java.util.LinkedHashMap<java.util.UUID, Launch> launches = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
	        final java.util.LinkedHashMap<java.util.UUID, Lift> lifts = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
	        final java.util.ArrayList<net.minecraft.world.entity.item.FallingBlockEntity> debris = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
	        int spawnedThisTick;
	        void finish(Impact job) { job.finished = true; owners.computeIfPresent(job.owner, (id, count) -> count <= 1 ? null : count - 1); }
	    }

	    private static final class Strike { int broken, debris; boolean blocked; }


	    private static final class Launch {
	        final ServerLevel level;
	        final java.util.UUID owner;
	        final Entity victim;
	        final Strike strike;
	        Vec3 previous, velocity;
	        Impact pending;
	        int remaining, lastBroken;
	        Launch(ServerLevel level, java.util.UUID owner, Entity victim, Strike strike) {
	            this.level = level; this.owner = owner; this.victim = victim; this.strike = strike;
	            previous = victim.position(); velocity = victim.getDeltaMovement();
	            remaining = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, LAUNCH_LIFETIME_TICKS));
	        }
	    }

	    private static Vec3 limited(Vec3 velocity) {
	        double cap = Double.isFinite(MAX_LAUNCH_SPEED) ? Math.max(0.5, Math.min(12, MAX_LAUNCH_SPEED)) : 8;
	        return velocity.lengthSqr() > cap * cap ? velocity.normalize().scale(cap) : velocity;
	    }

	    private static void launches(Work work) {
	        for (var iterator = work.launches.values().iterator(); iterator.hasNext();) {
	            Launch launch = iterator.next();
	            Entity victim = launch.victim;
	            Entity owner = launch.level.getEntity(launch.owner);
	            if (!ENABLE_SWEPT_COLLISIONS || !(owner instanceof RotEntity rot) || !alive(rot)
	                    || !victim.isAlive() || victim.isRemoved() || victim.level() != launch.level
	                    || launch.remaining-- <= 0 || launch.strike.blocked || launch.strike.broken >= Math.max(0, Math.min(1024, MAX_BLOCKS_PER_IMPACT))
	                    || victim.position().distanceToSqr(launch.previous) > 256
	                    || RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING && !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.canEntityGrief(launch.level, rot)) {
	                iterator.remove(); continue;
	            }
	            if (launch.level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(victim.blockPosition().getX() >> 4, victim.blockPosition().getZ() >> 4) == null) {
	                iterator.remove(); continue;
	            }
	            Vec3 velocity = limited(launch.velocity);
	            if (velocity.lengthSqr() < 0.25) { iterator.remove(); continue; }
	            victim.setDeltaMovement(velocity);
	            victim.hasImpulse = true; victim.hurtMarked = true;
	            if (victim instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player && (launch.remaining & 1) == 0)
	                player.connection.send(new net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(player));
	            if ((launch.pending == null || launch.pending.finished)
	                    && work.jobs.size() < Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_QUEUED_IMPACTS))
	                    && work.owners.getOrDefault(launch.owner, 0) < Math.max(0, Math.min(16, MAX_IMPACTS_PER_ROT))) {
	                // Match meteor physics: sweep the physical body along its motion, including the last observed segment.
	                var area = victim.getBoundingBox().minmax(victim.getBoundingBox().move(launch.previous.subtract(victim.position())))
	                        .expandTowards(velocity).inflate(0.2);
	                double volume = (area.maxX - area.minX + 1) * (area.maxY - area.minY + 1) * (area.maxZ - area.minZ + 1);
	                if (volume <= 4096) {
	                    launch.pending = new Impact(launch.level, launch.owner, victim.position(),
	                            victim.position().add(velocity), 0.2, false, 0, launch.level.getGameTime(), launch.strike, area);
	                    work.jobs.addFirst(launch.pending);
	                    work.owners.merge(launch.owner, 1, Integer::sum);
	                    launch.previous = victim.position();
	                }
	            }
	            int resistance = Math.max(0, launch.strike.broken - launch.lastBroken);
	            launch.lastBroken = launch.strike.broken;
	            double drag = Math.max(0.6, 1.0 - resistance * 0.004);
	            launch.velocity = new Vec3(velocity.x * 0.98 * drag, velocity.y * 0.98 - 0.08, velocity.z * 0.98 * drag);
	        }
	    }

	    private static boolean debris(Work work, Impact job, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
	        if (!ENABLE_FALLING_DEBRIS || (job.strike.broken + 1) % Math.max(1, DEBRIS_EVERY_N_BLOCKS) != 0
	                || !net.mcreator.thebackwoods.BackwoodsImpactDebris.terrainCapacity(job.level)
	                || work.spawnedThisTick >= Math.max(0, Math.min(32, MAX_DEBRIS_PER_TICK))
	                || job.strike.debris >= Math.max(0, Math.min(64, MAX_DEBRIS_PER_IMPACT))
	                || work.debris.size() >= Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS))) return false;
	        Vec3 direction = job.crater ? Vec3.atCenterOf(pos).subtract(job.start).multiply(1, 0, 1) : job.end.subtract(job.start);
	        if (direction.lengthSqr() > 0.0001) direction = direction.normalize(); else direction = new Vec3(1, 0, 0);
	        var random = job.level.getRandom();
	        Vec3 velocity = new Vec3(direction.x * 0.6 + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.3,
	                0.35 + random.nextDouble() * 0.55, direction.z * 0.6 + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.3);
	        var falling = net.mcreator.thebackwoods.BackwoodsImpactDebris.liftRotBlock(job.level, pos, state, velocity);
	        if (falling == null) return false;
	        if (!work.debris.contains(falling)) work.debris.add(falling);
	        work.spawnedThisTick++; job.strike.debris++;
	        return true;
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent
	    public static void debrisTick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
	        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.item.FallingBlockEntity falling)
	                || !(falling.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
	        long until = falling.getPersistentData().getLong(DEBRIS_UNTIL);
	        if (until <= 0) return;
	        if (!ENABLED || !ENABLE_FALLING_DEBRIS || level.getGameTime() >= until || falling.onGround()) {
	            falling.discard(); return;
	        }
	        var area = falling.getBoundingBox().expandTowards(falling.getDeltaMovement()).inflate(0.1);
	        if (area.maxX - area.minX > 8 || area.maxY - area.minY > 16 || area.maxZ - area.minZ > 8) { falling.discard(); return; }
	        for (int x = ((int)Math.floor(area.minX)) >> 4; x <= ((int)Math.floor(area.maxX)) >> 4; x++)
	            for (int z = ((int)Math.floor(area.minZ)) >> 4; z <= ((int)Math.floor(area.maxZ)) >> 4; z++)
	                if (level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(x, z) == null) { falling.discard(); return; }
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
	    public static void debrisJoined(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityJoinLevelEvent event) {
	        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.item.FallingBlockEntity falling)
	                || !(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
	        if (falling.getPersistentData().contains("backwoods_rot_real_block")) {
	            Work work = WORK.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new Work());
	            if (!work.debris.contains(falling)) work.debris.add(falling);
	            return;
	        }
	        long until = falling.getPersistentData().getLong(DEBRIS_UNTIL);
	        if (until <= 0) return;
	        Work work = WORK.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), ignored -> new Work());
	        if (!ENABLED || !ENABLE_FALLING_DEBRIS || level.getGameTime() >= until
	                || work.debris.size() >= Math.max(0, Math.min(256, MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS))) {
	            event.setCanceled(true); falling.discard(); return;
	        }
	        falling.disableDrop(); falling.dropItem = false;
	        if (!work.debris.contains(falling)) work.debris.add(falling);
	    }

	    private static final class Impact {
	        final ServerLevel level;
	        final java.util.UUID owner;
	        final Vec3 start, end;
	        final double radius, depth;
	        final boolean crater;
	        final Strike strike;
	        final net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB swept;
	        final long created;
	        final int x, y, z, width, height, volume;
	        int cursor;
	        boolean finished;
	        Impact(ServerLevel level, java.util.UUID owner, Vec3 start, Vec3 end, double radius, boolean crater, double depth, long created, Strike strike, net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB swept) {
	            this.level = level; this.owner = owner; this.start = start; this.end = end;
	            this.radius = radius; this.crater = crater; this.depth = depth; this.created = created;
	            this.strike = strike; this.swept = swept;
	            x = (int)Math.floor(swept != null ? swept.minX : Math.min(start.x, end.x) - radius);
	            y = (int)Math.floor(swept != null ? swept.minY : crater ? start.y - depth : Math.min(start.y, end.y) - radius);
	            z = (int)Math.floor(swept != null ? swept.minZ : Math.min(start.z, end.z) - radius);
	            width = (int)Math.floor(swept != null ? swept.maxX : Math.max(start.x, end.x) + radius) - x + 1;
	            height = (int)Math.floor(swept != null ? swept.maxY : crater ? start.y - 0.01 : Math.max(start.y, end.y) + radius) - y + 1;
	            int length = (int)Math.floor(swept != null ? swept.maxZ : Math.max(start.z, end.z) + radius) - z + 1;
	            volume = Math.max(0, width * height * length);
	        }
	        BlockPos next() {
	            int index = cursor++;
	            return new BlockPos(x + index % width, y + index / width % height, z + index / (width * height));
	        }
	        boolean includes(BlockPos pos) {
	            if (swept != null) return true; // Native meteor logic scans the victim's expanded bounding box.
	            Vec3 point = Vec3.atCenterOf(pos);
	            if (crater) {
	                double dx = point.x - start.x, dz = point.z - start.z;
	                double below = Math.max(0, start.y - point.y);
	                return point.y < start.y && dx * dx + dz * dz + below * below <= radius * radius;
	            }
	            Vec3 axis = end.subtract(start);
	            double length = axis.lengthSqr();
	            double t = length <= 0.0001 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, point.subtract(start).dot(axis) / length));
	            double widening = 0.5 + Math.max(0, radius - 0.5) * t;
	            return point.distanceToSqr(start.add(axis.scale(t))) <= widening * widening;
	        }
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent
	    public static void work(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Pre event) {
	        Work work = WORK.get(event.getServer());
	        if (work == null) return;
	        if (!ENABLED) { for (var debris : work.debris) if (!net.mcreator.thebackwoods.BackwoodsImpactDebris.isRealTerrain(debris)) debris.discard(); WORK.remove(event.getServer()); return; }
	        work.debris.removeIf(debris -> {
	            if (debris.isRemoved()) return true;
	            if (net.mcreator.thebackwoods.BackwoodsImpactDebris.isRealTerrain(debris)) return false;
	            if (debris.level() instanceof ServerLevel level && level.getGameTime() >= debris.getPersistentData().getLong(DEBRIS_UNTIL)) { debris.discard(); return true; }
	            return false;
	        });
	        work.spawnedThisTick = 0;
	        launches(work);
	        int scans = Math.max(0, Math.min(4096, MAX_SCANS_PER_TICK));
	        int changes = Math.max(0, Math.min(512, MAX_BLOCKS_PER_TICK));
	        int limit = Math.max(0, Math.min(1024, MAX_BLOCKS_PER_IMPACT));
	        while (scans > 0 && changes > 0 && !work.jobs.isEmpty()) {
	            Impact job = work.jobs.remove();
	            Entity owner = job.level.getEntity(job.owner);
	            if (!(owner instanceof RotEntity rot) || !alive(rot)
	                    || job.level.getGameTime() - job.created > (job.swept != null ? 3 : Math.max(1, Math.min(200, MAX_JOB_AGE_TICKS)))
	                    || RESPECT_MOB_GRIEFING && !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.canEntityGrief(job.level, rot)) {
	                work.finish(job); continue;
	            }
	            for (int slice = 0; slice < 16 && scans > 0 && changes > 0 && job.cursor < job.volume && job.strike.broken < limit; slice++) {
	                scans--;
	                BlockPos pos = job.next();
	                if (!job.includes(pos) || pos.getY() < job.level.getMinBuildHeight() || pos.getY() >= job.level.getMaxBuildHeight()) continue;
	                var chunk = job.level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(pos.getX() >> 4, pos.getZ() >> 4);
	                if (chunk == null) continue;
	                BlockState state = chunk.getBlockState(pos);
	                if (state.isAir() || state.hasBlockEntity() || !state.getFluidState().isEmpty()) continue;
	                float hardness = state.getDestroySpeed(job.level, pos);
	                if (hardness < 0 && job.swept != null) job.strike.blocked = true;
	                if (hardness < 0 || hardness > MAX_BLOCK_HARDNESS || !state.canEntityDestroy(job.level, pos, rot)
	                        || !net.neoforged.neoforge.event.EventHooks.onEntityDestroyBlock(rot, pos, state)) continue;
	                if (debris(work, job, pos, state) || job.level.destroyBlock(pos, DROP_BLOCKS, rot)) { job.strike.broken++; changes--; }
	            }
	            if (job.cursor >= job.volume || job.strike.broken >= limit) work.finish(job); else work.jobs.add(job);
	        }
	        if (work.jobs.isEmpty() && work.launches.isEmpty() && work.lifts.isEmpty() && work.debris.isEmpty()) WORK.remove(event.getServer());
	    }

	    @SubscribeEvent
	    public static void stopped(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStoppedEvent event) { WORK.remove(event.getServer()); }
	}

}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec2;
import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.commands.CommandSourceStack;
import net.minecraft.commands.CommandSource;

public class RotPlayerCollidesWithThisEntityProcedure {
	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity, Entity sourceentity) {
		if (entity == null || sourceentity == null)
			return;

		boolean isPhaseShifting = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_shifting");
		if (isPhaseShifting) {
			// Ghost pass-through effect: gently glide the colliding player through the Rot
			Vec3 moveDir = sourceentity.getDeltaMovement();
			if (moveDir.lengthSqr() < 0.01) {
				moveDir = sourceentity.getLookAngle().scale(0.15);
			}
			sourceentity.setDeltaMovement(sourceentity.getDeltaMovement().add(moveDir.x * 0.2, 0.0, moveDir.z * 0.2));
			sourceentity.hasImpulse = true;
		}
	}

public class RotStateInfinityToggleOffProcedure {
	public static void execute(CommandContext<CommandSourceStack> arguments, Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null)
			return;
		(commandParameterEntity(arguments, "target")).getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_is_infinity_totem", false);
		if (entity instanceof Player _player && !_player.level().isClientSide())
			_player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Rot infinity state is now ACTIVE!"), true);
	}

	private static Entity commandParameterEntity(CommandContext<CommandSourceStack> arguments, String parameter) {
		try {
			return EntityArgument.getEntity(arguments, parameter);

		}
	}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity;

public class RotThisEntityKillsAnotherOneProcedure {
	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity, Entity immediatesourceentity, Entity sourceentity) {
		if (world == null)
			return;

		RotEntity rot = null;
		Entity victim = null;

		if (entity instanceof RotEntity r) {
			rot = r;
			victim = (sourceentity != null && sourceentity != r) ? sourceentity : immediatesourceentity;
		} else if (sourceentity instanceof RotEntity r) {
			rot = r;
			victim = (entity != r) ? entity : immediatesourceentity;
		} else if (immediatesourceentity instanceof RotEntity r) {
			rot = r;
			victim = (sourceentity != null && sourceentity != r) ? sourceentity : entity;
		}

		if (rot == null)
			return;

		RotOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.UniversalCombatPredictionEngine.recordRotKill(rot, victim);

		if (victim != null) {
			String victimUuid = victim.getUUID().toString();
			String heldUuid = getPersistentString(rot, "overhead_target_uuid");
			if (victimUuid.equals(heldUuid)) {
				rot.getPersistentData().remove("overhead_target_uuid");
				rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_overhead_ticks", 0);
			}

			rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_armor_rip_ticks", 0);
			rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("is_armor_ripping", false);
			rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("current_combat_action_state", 0);
			rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("current_action_commitment", 0);
			rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("ai_is_attacking", false);

			advanceTargetQueue(world, rot, victim);

			net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player master = null;
			if (rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("master_guard_mode")) {
				master = RotOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.getGuardPlayer(world, rot);
			} else if (rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("master_follow_enabled")) {
				master = RotOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.getFollowPlayer(world, rot);
			}
			boolean masterInDanger = false;
			if (master != null) {
				masterInDanger = master.getHealth() < master.getMaxHealth() * 0.5F || master.hurtTime > 0 || master.getLastHurtByMob() != null;
			}
			double postKillDelay = masterInDanger ? 10.0 : (20.0 + rot.getRandom().nextDouble() * 20.0);
			rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_post_kill_teleport_delay_ticks", postKillDelay);
		}
	}

	private static void advanceTargetQueue(LevelAccessor world, RotEntity rot, Entity victim) {
		int currentKillId = getPersistentInt(rot, "master_kill_target_id");
		String queueStr = getPersistentString(rot, "master_target_queue");

		if (!queueStr.isEmpty()) {
			String[] ids = queueStr.split(",");
			Entity nextTarget = null;
			StringBuilder newQueue = new StringBuilder();

			for (String idStr : ids) {
				try {
					int id = Integer.parseInt(idStr.trim());
					if (victim != null && id == victim.getId()) {
						continue;
					}
					if (world instanceof Level level) {
						Entity candidate = level.getEntity(id);
						if (candidate instanceof LivingEntity le && le.isAlive() && candidate != rot) {
							if (nextTarget == null) {
								nextTarget = candidate;
							} else {
								if (newQueue.length() > 0) newQueue.append(",");
								newQueue.append(id);
							}
						}
					}
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}

			if (nextTarget != null) {
				rot.getPersistentData().putString("master_target_queue", newQueue.toString());
				rot.getPersistentData().putInt("master_kill_target_id", nextTarget.getId());
				if (rot instanceof Mob mob && nextTarget instanceof LivingEntity livingNext) {
					mob.setTarget(livingNext);
				}
			} else {
				rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_kill_target_id");
				rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_target_queue");
				rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_assassinate_player_name");
				rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_queued_assassination_player");
			}
		} else if (victim != null && victim.getId() == currentKillId) {
			rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_kill_target_id");
			rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_target_queue");
			rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_assassinate_player_name");
			rot.getPersistentData().remove("master_queued_assassination_player");
		}
	}

	private static String getPersistentString(Entity entity, String key) {
		return entity.getPersistentData().getString(key);
	}

	private static int getPersistentInt(Entity entity, String key) {
		return entity.getPersistentData().getInt(key);
	}
} // 1.21.1

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent;

public class ScandereLignumLogOnBlockRightclickedProcedure {
	
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock event) {
		execute(event, event.getLevel(), event.getPos().getX(), event.getPos().getY(), event.getPos().getZ(), event.getEntity());
	}

	public static void execute() {
		// Dummy execute method to satisfy MCreator's code generator if dependencies aren't refreshed
	}

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z) {
		execute(null, world, x, y, z, null);
	}

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		execute(null, world, x, y, z, entity);
	}

	private static void execute(@Nullable Event event, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null)
			return;

		BlockPos pos = new BlockPos((int) x, (int) y, (int) z);
		BlockState blockstate = world.getBlockState(pos);

		// Check if the block has the oozing property
		Property<?> rawOozingProp = blockstate.getBlock().getStateDefinition().getProperty("oozing");
		if (rawOozingProp instanceof BooleanProperty oozingProperty) {
			
			// If it's currently oozing
			if (blockstate.getValue(oozingProperty)) {
				
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					ItemStack mainHandItem = player.getMainHandItem();
					
					// Check if the player is holding an Axe
					if (mainHandItem.getItem() instanceof AxeItem) {
						
						// 1. Set oozing to false
						world.setBlock(pos, blockstate.setValue(oozingProperty, false), 3);
						
						// 2. Play a scraping/squishing sound
						if (world instanceof Level level && !level.isClientSide()) {
							level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.SLIME_BLOCK_BREAK, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 1.2F);
							level.playSound(null, pos, SoundEvents.SLIME_BLOCK_STEP, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0F, 0.8F);
							
							// 3. Drop the raw resin item
							ItemStack dropItem = new ItemStack(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModItems.SCANDERE_RESIN.get());
							ItemEntity entityToSpawn = new ItemEntity(level, x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5, dropItem);
							entityToSpawn.setPickUpDelay(10);
							level.addFreshEntity(entityToSpawn);
						}
						
						// 4. Swing the player's arm
						player.swing(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, true);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BlockStateProperties;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.IntegerProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.Property;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks;

public class ScandereLignumLogOnTickUpdateProcedure {

	// GROWTH SPEED SETTING: Controls the growth rate (from 0.0 to 5.0+)
	// - 1.0 = Default standard growth rate (100% speed)
	// - 0.5 = Half speed (50% slower)
	// - 2.0 = Double speed (2x rate)
	// - 5.0 = Five times speed (5x rate, maximum recommended)
	// - 0.0 = Completely disables growth
	public static final double GROWTH_SPEED = 1.0;

	public static void execute() {
	}

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z) {
		// Fallback if called without blockstate dependency
		BlockPos currentPos = new BlockPos((int) x, (int) y, (int) z);
		BlockState state = world.getBlockState(currentPos);
		execute(world, x, y, z, state);
	}

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, BlockState blockstate) {
		if (world == null || blockstate == null) {
			return;
		}

		if (GROWTH_SPEED <= 0.0) {
			return;
		}

		RandomSource random = world.getRandom();

		// Handle growth speed (supporting values from 0 to 5+):
		// - Values < 1.0 execute probabilistically
		// - Values >= 1.0 run the growth logic multiple times per tick simulation
		int fullRuns = (int) GROWTH_SPEED;
		double fractionalChance = GROWTH_SPEED - fullRuns;

		for (int i = 0; i < fullRuns; i++) {
			runGrowthTick(world, x, y, z, blockstate, random);
		}

		if (fractionalChance > 0.0 && random.nextDouble() < fractionalChance) {
			runGrowthTick(world, x, y, z, blockstate, random);
		}
	}

	private static void runGrowthTick(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, BlockState blockstate, RandomSource random) {
		BlockPos currentPos = new BlockPos((int) x, (int) y, (int) z);
		boolean isWoodbound = world.getBiome(currentPos).is(net.minecraft.tags.TagKey.create(net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries.BIOME, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("the_backwoods", "woodbound_biomes")));

		// 1. Age the active block for realistic, finite growth
		Property<?> rawAgeProp = blockstate.getBlock().getStateDefinition().getProperty("age");
		int currentAge = 0;
		int maxAge = 450;
		boolean reachedMaxAge = false;
		if (rawAgeProp instanceof IntegerProperty ageProperty) {
			currentAge = blockstate.getValue(ageProperty);
			
			// Dynamically get the max age from the property
			for (Integer val : ageProperty.getPossibleValues()) {
				if (val > maxAge) maxAge = val;
			}

			if (currentAge >= maxAge) {
				reachedMaxAge = true;
			} else {
				currentAge++;
				blockstate = blockstate.setValue(ageProperty, currentAge);
				// Flag 2 prevents unnecessary neighbor block updates for simple age changes
				world.setBlock(currentPos, blockstate, 2);
			}
		}

		// 2. Oozing Resin Logic
		Property<?> rawOozingProp = blockstate.getBlock().getStateDefinition().getProperty("oozing");
		if (rawOozingProp instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty oozingProperty) {
			boolean isOozing = blockstate.getValue(oozingProperty);
			if (!isOozing && currentAge >= 75) {
				// Calculate chance: scales up to 80% (0.80f) as age approaches maxAge
				float chance = 0.80f * ((float)(currentAge - 75) / (maxAge - 75));
				
				// Only let exposed blocks ooze (must have air horizontally adjacent)
				boolean isExposed = false;
				for (Direction dir : Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL) {
					if (world.getBlockState(currentPos.relative(dir)).isAir()) {
						isExposed = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				
				if (isExposed && random.nextFloat() < chance) {
					blockstate = blockstate.setValue(oozingProperty, true);
					world.setBlock(currentPos, blockstate, 3);
				}
			}
		}

		if (reachedMaxAge) {
			return; // Block has reached maximum maturity and stops growing
		}

		// Check block above and below early for optimization
		boolean hasLogAbove = world.getBlockState(currentPos.above()).is(blockstate.getBlock());
		boolean hasLogBelow = world.getBlockState(currentPos.below()).is(blockstate.getBlock());

		// OPTIMIZATION 1: If this block is deeply buried inside the trunk, it does not grow leaves or branches.
		// Exiting here prevents massive lag from leaf-checking on the 50-80 tall trunk.
		if (hasLogAbove && hasLogBelow) {
			// If there is wood at least 8 blocks above us, skip branching/canopy logic.
			if (world.getBlockState(currentPos.above(8)).is(blockstate.getBlock())) {
				return;
			}
		}

		boolean isTip = !hasLogAbove;

		// 1. OPTIMIZATION & PRECISION: Calculate absolute height from the soil/ground
		// We scan up to 100 blocks down to reliably locate the ground for super tall trees.
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos groundScan = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos(currentPos.getX(), currentPos.getY(), currentPos.getZ());
		int heightFromSoil = 0;
		while (heightFromSoil < 100) {
			groundScan.move(0, -1, 0);
			BlockState scanState = world.getBlockState(groundScan);
			if (scanState.isAir() || scanState.is(Blocks.OAK_LEAVES) || scanState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.FALSE_OAK_PLANKS.get()) || scanState.is(Blocks.VINE) || scanState.is(blockstate.getBlock())) {
				heightFromSoil++;
			} else {
				// We hit dirt, grass, stone, sand, sand etc. This is the actual ground.
				break;
			}
		}

		// Calculate local trunk height straight below us (for local logic)
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos tempPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos(currentPos.getX(), currentPos.getY(), currentPos.getZ());
		int localTrunkHeight = 1;
		while (localTrunkHeight < 12) {
			tempPos.move(0, -1, 0);
			BlockState downState = world.getBlockState(tempPos);
			if (downState.is(blockstate.getBlock())) {
				localTrunkHeight++;
			} else {
				break;
			}
		}

		// 2. Trunk growth (Ascendance)
		if (isTip) {
			// Limit maximum height naturally to a colossal range (50 to 80 blocks tall)
			int maxAllowedHeight = 50 + random.nextInt(31); 
			if (heightFromSoil < maxAllowedHeight) {
				BlockPos abovePos = currentPos.above();
				BlockState aboveState = world.getBlockState(abovePos);
				if (isReplaceable(aboveState)) {
					// Grow trunk upwards! Preserve the log block state
					world.setBlock(abovePos, blockstate, 3);
					
					// Spawn growth particles and play wood place sound
					if (world instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
						serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.COMPOSTER, abovePos.getX() + 0.5, abovePos.getY() + 0.5, abovePos.getZ() + 0.5, 8, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.05);
						serverLevel.playSound(null, abovePos, SoundEvents.CHERRY_WOOD_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.0f, 0.85f);
					}
					return; // Trunk grew! Let's exit this tick update
				}
			}

			// 3. Sprout horizontal branches (15% chance if tree has scaled high enough)
			// This generates gorgeous massive branches mainly on the mid-to-high sections of the giant tree.
			if (heightFromSoil >= 10 && random.nextFloat() < 0.15f) {
				Direction dir = Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL.getRandomDirection(random);
				BlockPos branchPos = currentPos.relative(dir);
				BlockState branchState = world.getBlockState(branchPos);
				if (isReplaceable(branchState)) {
					BlockState orientedState = blockstate;
					if (blockstate.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.AXIS)) {
						orientedState = blockstate.setValue(BlockStateProperties.AXIS, dir.getAxis());
					}
					world.setBlock(branchPos, orientedState, 3);
					
					if (world instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
						serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.COMPOSTER, branchPos.getX() + 0.5, branchPos.getY() + 0.5, branchPos.getZ() + 0.5, 5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.02);
						serverLevel.playSound(null, branchPos, SoundEvents.WOOD_PLACE, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.8f, 0.95f);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// 4. Canopy leaf growth (Oak leaves spawn, forming a majestic dense crown at the top - Sequoia/Redwood style)
		// We scan upwards to check if we are within the top 12 blocks of the trunk (the active canopy crown).
		int blocksAbove = 0;
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos tipScan = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos(currentPos.getX(), currentPos.getY(), currentPos.getZ());
		while (blocksAbove < 12) {
			tipScan.move(0, 1, 0);
			if (world.getBlockState(tipScan).is(blockstate.getBlock())) {
				blocksAbove++;
			} else {
				break;
			}
		}

		// Only grow beautiful crown foliage in the top 12 blocks of the trunk!
		// This keeps the lower/middle 80% of the monolithic giant trunk clean and pristine.
		if (blocksAbove < 12 && heightFromSoil >= 3) {
			// Periodically grow oak leaves around this log segment
			int dx = random.nextInt(5) - 2; // -2 to 2
			int dy = random.nextInt(4) - 1; // -1 to 2
			int dz = random.nextInt(5) - 2; // -2 to 2
			BlockPos leafPos = currentPos.offset(dx, dy, dz);
			double distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;

			// Define a beautiful natural canopy shape (radius limit of 7.5)
			if (distSq <= 7.5) {
				BlockState leafState = world.getBlockState(leafPos);
				if (leafState.isAir() || leafState.is(Blocks.VINE)) {
					BlockState placedLeafState;
					if (isWoodbound) {
						placedLeafState = TheBackwoodsModBlocks.FALSE_OAK_PLANKS.get().defaultBlockState();
					} else {
						placedLeafState = Blocks.OAK_LEAVES.defaultBlockState();
						if (placedLeafState.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.PERSISTENT)) {
							placedLeafState = placedLeafState.setValue(BlockStateProperties.PERSISTENT, false);
						}
						// Calculate decay distance property relative to closest wood block (which is currentPos)
						if (placedLeafState.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.DISTANCE)) {
							int dist = Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.max(Math.abs(dy), Math.abs(dz)));
							int finalDist = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, dist));
							placedLeafState = placedLeafState.setValue(BlockStateProperties.DISTANCE, finalDist);
						}
					}
					world.setBlock(leafPos, placedLeafState, 3);

					// AESTHETIC ENHANCEMENT: Grow beautiful hanging Vines underneath this newly created leaf block!
					if (random.nextFloat() < 0.15f) { // 15% chance
						BlockPos belowLeaf = leafPos.below();
						if (world.getBlockState(belowLeaf).isAir()) {
							// Place natural draping vine block on the proper side orientation
							BlockState vineState = Blocks.VINE.defaultBlockState();
							if (vineState.hasProperty(BlockStateProperties.UP)) {
								vineState = vineState.setValue(BlockStateProperties.UP, true);
							}
							world.setBlock(belowLeaf, vineState, 3);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// 5. Climbing Walls (Ascend along adjacent solid structures)
		// Optimization: Climbing only places a block directly above us, which is only possible if we are the tip.
		if (isTip && heightFromSoil < 80) {
			for (Direction dir : Direction.Plane.HORIZONTAL) {
				BlockPos wallPos = currentPos.relative(dir);
				BlockState wallState = world.getBlockState(wallPos);
				if (wallState.isRedstoneConductor(world, wallPos) && !wallState.is(blockstate.getBlock())) {
					// We are adjacent to a solid wall. Let's climb up!
					BlockPos climbPos = currentPos.above();
					BlockState climbState = world.getBlockState(climbPos);
					if (isReplaceable(climbState)) {
						// 10% chance to climb on random tick
						if (random.nextFloat() < 0.10f) {
							world.setBlock(climbPos, blockstate, 3);
							if (world instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
								serverLevel.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.HAPPY_VILLAGER, climbPos.getX() + 0.5, climbPos.getY() + 0.5, climbPos.getZ() + 0.5, 4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.01);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static boolean isReplaceable(BlockState state) {
		return state.isAir() 
			|| state.is(Blocks.VINE) 
			|| state.is(Blocks.OAK_LEAVES) 
			|| state.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.FALSE_OAK_PLANKS.get())
			|| state.is(Blocks.GLOW_LICHEN) 
			|| state.is(Blocks.SHORT_GRASS) 
			|| state.is(Blocks.TALL_GRASS) 
			|| state.is(Blocks.FERN) 
			|| state.is(Blocks.LARGE_FERN);
	}
} // 1.21.1

// 1.21.1 neo
import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.tags.BlockTags;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.Animal;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.IntegerProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.Property;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks;

public class ScandereLignumSpreadOnTickUpdateProcedure {
	// Simulated tickrate target (20 = normal MC, 50 = faster spread behavior)
	private static final int DESIRED_TPS = 50;

	// Fertilization influence from nearby passive animals
	private static final int FERTILIZE_ANIMAL_RADIUS = 6;
	private static final int FERTILIZE_MAX_DELAY_REDUCTION = 4;

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z) {
		if (world == null) return;

		RandomSource random = (world instanceof ServerLevel sl) ? sl.getRandom() : RandomSource.create();
		BlockPos origin = BlockPos.containing(x, y, z);
		BlockState currentState = world.getBlockState(origin);
		
		int currentAge = 0;
		IntegerProperty ageProperty = null;
		for (Property<?> prop : currentState.getProperties()) {
			if (prop.getName().equals("age") && prop instanceof IntegerProperty) {
				ageProperty = (IntegerProperty) prop;
				currentAge = currentState.getValue(ageProperty);
				break;
			}
		}
		if (currentAge >= 10) return;

		boolean openSky = world.canSeeSky(origin);

		// Direction bias
		int roll = Mth.nextInt(random, 0, 99);
		int dir;
		if (openSky) {
			// mostly horizontal on surface
			if (roll < 80) {
				int h = Mth.nextInt(random, 0, 3);
				dir = switch (h) {
					case 0 -> 0; // +X
					case 1 -> 1; // -X
					case 2 -> 4; // +Z
					default -> 5; // -Z
				};
			} else if (roll < 92) {
				dir = 3; // down a bit
			} else {
				dir = 2; // rare up
			}
		} else {
			// underground roots: down + horizontal
			if (roll < 60) dir = 3;
			else if (roll < 95) {
				int h = Mth.nextInt(random, 0, 3);
				dir = switch (h) {
					case 0 -> 0;
					case 1 -> 1;
					case 2 -> 4;
					default -> 5;
				};
			} else dir = 2;
		}

		BlockPos target = switch (dir) {
			case 0 -> origin.east();
			case 1 -> origin.west();
			case 2 -> origin.above();
			case 3 -> origin.below();
			case 4 -> origin.south();
			default -> origin.north();
		};

		// Base speed model
		int spreadDelay = 1;
		if (!openSky) spreadDelay += 1;
		if (dir == 3) spreadDelay = Math.max(1, spreadDelay - 4);

		// Animal fertilization: nearby passive entities accelerate spread a bit
		int nearbyAdults = countNearbyAdultAnimals(world, origin, FERTILIZE_ANIMAL_RADIUS);
		int fertilizeBoost = Math.min(FERTILIZE_MAX_DELAY_REDUCTION, nearbyAdults);
		spreadDelay = Math.max(1, spreadDelay - fertilizeBoost);

		BlockState targetState = world.getBlockState(target);
		if (world.getBlockEntity(target) != null) return;

		// Basic exclusions
		if (targetState.isAir() || !world.getFluidState(target).isEmpty()) return;

		net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block tBlock = targetState.getBlock();
		boolean isValidTarget = tBlock == Blocks.DIRT 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.COARSE_DIRT 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.ROOTED_DIRT 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.GRASS_BLOCK
				|| tBlock == Blocks.ANDESITE 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.GRANITE 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.DIORITE
				|| tBlock == Blocks.CLAY 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.SAND 
				|| tBlock == Blocks.RED_SAND
				|| tBlock == Blocks.STONE;

		if (!isValidTarget) return;

		// Vein-shape control
		int scandereNeighbors = countScandereNeighbors(world, target);

		// hard anti-blob cap
		if (scandereNeighbors >= 2) return;

		boolean goodVeinConnection = (scandereNeighbors == 1);
		boolean rareBranch = (scandereNeighbors == 1 && random.nextInt(12) == 0);

		if (!goodVeinConnection && !rareBranch) return;

		BlockState targetPlacementState = TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get().defaultBlockState();
		if (ageProperty != null && targetPlacementState.hasProperty(ageProperty)) {
			targetPlacementState = targetPlacementState.setValue(ageProperty, currentAge + 1);
		}
		world.setBlock(target, targetPlacementState, 3);

		// Simulate faster tickrate (e.g., 50 TPS instead of 20 TPS)
		int spreadDelayAdjusted = Math.max(1, Mth.ceil(spreadDelay * (20.0 / DESIRED_TPS)));
		world.scheduleTick(target, TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get(), spreadDelayAdjusted);
	}

	private static int countScandereNeighbors(LevelAccessor world, BlockPos pos) {
		int count = 0;
		if (world.getBlockState(pos.east()).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) count++;
		if (world.getBlockState(pos.west()).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) count++;
		if (world.getBlockState(pos.above()).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) count++;
		if (world.getBlockState(pos.below()).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) count++;
		if (world.getBlockState(pos.south()).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) count++;
		if (world.getBlockState(pos.north()).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) count++;
		return count;
	}

	private static int countNearbyAdultAnimals(LevelAccessor world, BlockPos pos, int radius) {
		if (!(world instanceof ServerLevel level)) return 0;
		AABB box = AABB.ofSize(
				new Vec3(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5),
				radius * 2.0, radius * 2.0, radius * 2.0
		);
		return level.getEntitiesOfClass(Animal.class, box, a -> a.isAlive() && !a.isBaby()).size();
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.Animal;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModBlocks;

import java.util.List;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class ScandereSymbiosisAuraProcedure {
	private static final int CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS = 40;
	private static final int LOG_SCAN_RADIUS = 16;
	private static final int LOG_SCAN_Y_DOWN = 5;
	private static final int LOG_SCAN_Y_UP = 6;
	private static final int MAX_LOGS_PER_PASS = 8;

	private static final int ANIMAL_SCAN_RADIUS = 24;
	private static final float ATTRACT_CHANCE = 0.45f;
	private static final double IDLE_RING_MIN = 2.5;
	private static final double IDLE_RING_MAX = 5.0;

	// Breeding settings
	private static final float BREED_CHANCE = 0.045f; // % per eligible check
	private static final int BREED_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 20 * 40;

	// Fertilization settings
	private static final float FERTILIZE_CHANCE = 0.18f;
	private static final int FERTILIZE_ATTEMPTS = 8;
	private static final int FERTILIZE_RADIUS_XZ = 3;
	private static final int FERTILIZE_RADIUS_Y_DOWN = 2;
	private static final int FERTILIZE_RADIUS_Y_UP = 1;

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onServerTick(ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
		MinecraftServer server = event.getServer();
		if (server == null) return;
		if (server.getTickCount() % CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS != 0) return;

		for (ServerLevel level : server.getAllLevels()) {
			if (level.players().isEmpty()) continue;

			RandomSource random = level.getRandom();

			level.players().forEach(player -> {
				BlockPos p = player.blockPosition();
				int processedLogs = 0;

				for (int dx = -LOG_SCAN_RADIUS; dx <= LOG_SCAN_RADIUS && processedLogs < MAX_LOGS_PER_PASS; dx++) {
					for (int dz = -LOG_SCAN_RADIUS; dz <= LOG_SCAN_RADIUS && processedLogs < MAX_LOGS_PER_PASS; dz++) {
						for (int dy = -LOG_SCAN_Y_DOWN; dy <= LOG_SCAN_Y_UP && processedLogs < MAX_LOGS_PER_PASS; dy++) {
							BlockPos logPos = p.offset(dx, dy, dz);

							if (level.getBlockState(logPos).getBlock() != TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM_LOG.get()) continue;

							processedLogs++;
							influenceNearbyAnimals(level, logPos, random);
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}
	}

	private static void influenceNearbyAnimals(ServerLevel level, BlockPos logPos, RandomSource random) {
		AABB area = AABB.ofSize(
				new Vec3(logPos.getX() + 0.5, logPos.getY() + 0.5, logPos.getZ() + 0.5),
				ANIMAL_SCAN_RADIUS, ANIMAL_SCAN_RADIUS, ANIMAL_SCAN_RADIUS
		);

		List<Animal> animals = level.getEntitiesOfClass(Animal.class, area, a -> a.isAlive() && !a.isBaby());

		for (Animal animal : animals) {
			if (!(animal instanceof Mob mob)) continue;

			// Attraction / idle near log
			if (random.nextFloat() <= ATTRACT_CHANCE) {
				double angle = random.nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0;
				double r = Mth.nextDouble(random, IDLE_RING_MIN, IDLE_RING_MAX);
				double tx = logPos.getX() + 0.5 + Math.cos(angle) * r;
				double tz = logPos.getZ() + 0.5 + Math.sin(angle) * r;
				double ty = logPos.getY();

				mob.getNavigation().moveTo(tx, ty, tz, 0.75);

				if (random.nextFloat() < 0.16f) {
					mob.getNavigation().stop();
				}
			}

			// Passive breeding trigger with cooldown (1.21.8-safe Optional handling)
			int cd = animal.getPersistentData().getInt("scandere_breed_cd");
			if (cd > 0) {
				animal.getPersistentData().putInt("scandere_breed_cd", Math.max(0, cd - CHECK_INTERVAL_TICKS));
				continue;
			}

			// Only trigger if animal is not already in love and old enough
			if (!animal.isInLove() && animal.getAge() == 0 && random.nextFloat() < BREED_CHANCE) {
				animal.setInLove(null); // no player required
				animal.getPersistentData().putInt("scandere_breed_cd", BREED_COOLDOWN_TICKS);
			}

			// Animals fertilize nearby Lignum: extra scheduled ticks around the animal
			if (random.nextFloat() < FERTILIZE_CHANCE) {
				fertilizeNearbyLignum(level, animal.blockPosition(), random);
			}
		}
	}

	private static void fertilizeNearbyLignum(ServerLevel level, BlockPos center, RandomSource random) {
		for (int i = 0; i < FERTILIZE_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
			int dx = Mth.nextInt(random, -FERTILIZE_RADIUS_XZ, FERTILIZE_RADIUS_XZ);
			int dy = Mth.nextInt(random, -FERTILIZE_RADIUS_Y_DOWN, FERTILIZE_RADIUS_Y_UP);
			int dz = Mth.nextInt(random, -FERTILIZE_RADIUS_XZ, FERTILIZE_RADIUS_XZ);
			BlockPos p = center.offset(dx, dy, dz);

			if (level.getBlockState(p).getBlock() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get()) {
				level.scheduleTick(p, TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SCANDERE_LIGNUM.get(), 1 + random.nextInt(4));
			}
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

public class SplinterAvengeOnHurtProcedure {
	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity, Entity sourceentity) {
		if (entity == null || sourceentity == null)
			return;

    public static int attractionRadius(Difficulty difficulty, boolean hardcore) {
        return hardcore ? HARDCORE_RADIUS : difficulty == Difficulty.HARD ? HARD_RADIUS
                : difficulty == Difficulty.NORMAL ? NORMAL_RADIUS : EASY_RADIUS;

    public static int requiredItems(int kind, Difficulty difficulty, boolean hardcore) {
        if (kind < 2 || kind == 5) {
            int planks = hardcore ? PLANKS_HARDCORE : difficulty == Difficulty.HARD ? PLANKS_HARD
                    : difficulty == Difficulty.NORMAL ? PLANKS_NORMAL : PLANKS_EASY;
            return Mth.clamp(planks, 1, 1024);
        }
        return hardcore ? 4 : difficulty == Difficulty.HARD ? 5 : difficulty == Difficulty.NORMAL ? 7 : 10;
