    private static int materialUnits(int kind) {
        int sticks = Mth.clamp(STICKS_PER_PLANK, 1, 64);
        return kind == 5 ? 1 : kind == 2 || kind == 3 ? sticks * 4 : sticks;
    }
    private static int kind(ServerLevel level, ItemStack stack) {
        String id = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(stack.getItem()).toString();
        if (id.equals("minecraft:stick")) return 5;
        if (id.equals("the_backwoods:lignum_caro")) return 4; // Universal biomass; choose one of the four variants once per formation.
        if (PETRIFIED.contains(id)) return 3;
        if (LOGS.contains(id)) return 2;
        if (PLANKS.contains(id)) return dimension(level).equals("the_backwoods:the_grain") ? 1
                : DIMENSIONS.contains(dimension(level)) ? 0 : -1;
        return -1;
    }
    private static boolean markedLoot(ItemStack stack) {
        CompoundTag tag = stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag();
        if (!tag.getBoolean(LOOT)) return false;
        tag.remove(LOOT);
        if (!tag.isEmpty()) return false; // Do not consume renamed/configured items or foreign custom metadata.
        ItemStack plain = stack.copy(); plain.remove(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA);
        return ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents(plain, new ItemStack(stack.getItem()));
    }
    private static void markLoot(ItemEntity item) {
        CustomData.update(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, item.getItem(), tag -> tag.putBoolean(LOOT, true));
        item.getPersistentData().remove(SKIP);
    }
    private static void rejectPlayerDrop(ItemEntity item) {
        CustomData.update(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, item.getItem(), tag -> tag.remove(LOOT));
        item.getPersistentData().putBoolean(SKIP, true);
    }
    private static boolean caro(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos) {
        return level.hasChunkAt(pos) && level.getBlockState(pos).is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.LIGNUM_CARO.get());
    }
    private static boolean donor(Entity entity) {
        String id = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType()).toString();
        return member(entity) || id.startsWith("the_backwoods:") && id.endsWith("_splinter");
    }

    private static boolean eligible(ServerLevel level, ItemEntity item) {
        return item.isAlive() && item.level() == level && item.getAge() >= MIN_ITEM_AGE
                && item.getAge() < item.lifespan - 260 && !item.hasPickUpDelay() && item.getTarget() == null
                && !item.getPersistentData().contains(CLAIM) && !item.getPersistentData().getBoolean(SKIP)
                && !item.isPassenger() && !item.isInWater() && !item.isInLava() && !item.isOnFire()
                && !item.getItem().isEmpty() && kind(level, item.getItem()) >= 0
                && !(item.getOwner() instanceof Player) && markedLoot(item.getItem())
                && !extractorNear(level, item.position());
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onItemJoin(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityJoinLevelEvent event) {
        if (event.isCanceled() || !(event.getEntity() instanceof ItemEntity item)
                || !(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        // Item NBT is the recovery journal: no item stacks are ever copied into a second inventory.
        if (item.getPersistentData().contains(CLAIM)) restore(item);
        if (item.getOwner() instanceof Player) rejectPlayerDrop(item);
        if (!DIMENSIONS.contains(dimension(level)) || kind(level, item.getItem()) < 0 || !markedLoot(item.getItem())) return;
        State state = STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), key -> new State());
        queue(state, item);
    }
    private static void queue(State state, ItemEntity item) {
        if (state.queued.containsKey(item.getUUID()) || state.queued.size() >= MAX_CANDIDATES || state.candidates.size() >= MAX_CANDIDATES) return;
        WeakReference<ItemEntity> ref = new WeakReference<>(item);
        state.queued.put(item.getUUID(), ref); state.candidates.addLast(ref);
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onTick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
        State state = STATES.get(event.getServer());
        if (state == null) return;
        long now = event.getServer().overworld().getGameTime();
        state.cooldowns.removeIf(c -> now >= c.until() || c.until() - now > REGION_COOLDOWN);
        for (Formation group : new ArrayList<>(state.formations.values())) advance(event.getServer(), state, group, now);
        if (now % SCAN_INTERVAL != 0 || state.formations.size() >= MAX_FORMATIONS) return;
        int attempts = Math.min(SCANS_PER_PASS, state.candidates.size()), starts = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
            WeakReference<ItemEntity> ref = state.candidates.removeFirst();
            ItemEntity seed = ref.get();
            if (seed == null || !seed.isAlive() || seed.isRemoved()) continue;
            state.queued.remove(seed.getUUID());
            if (!(seed.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !permitted(level)) { queue(state, seed); continue; }
            if (eligible(level, seed) && starts < 2 && tryStart(level, state, seed, now)) starts++;
            if (seed.isAlive()) queue(state, seed);
        }
        // Expired weak references do not permanently consume candidate capacity.
        if (now % 200 == 0) state.queued.entrySet().removeIf(e -> { ItemEntity item = e.getValue().get(); return item == null || !item.isAlive(); });
    }

    private static ServerLevel level(MinecraftServer server, String id) {
        net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation parsed = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.tryParse(id);
        return parsed == null ? null : server.getLevel(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey.create(
                net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries.DIMENSION, parsed));
    }
    private static Mob create(ServerLevel level, int kind) {
        return switch (kind) {
            case 0 -> new SplinterEntity(TheBackwoodsModEntities.SPLINTER.get(), level);
            case 1 -> new BlindspotSplinterEntity(TheBackwoodsModEntities.BLINDSPOT_SPLINTER.get(), level);
            case 2 -> new LogSplinterEntity(TheBackwoodsModEntities.LOG_SPLINTER.get(), level);
            default -> new PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity(TheBackwoodsModEntities.PETRIFIED_LOG_SPLINTER.get(), level);
        };
    }
    private static boolean member(Entity entity) {
        return entity instanceof SplinterEntity || entity instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity
                || entity instanceof LogSplinterEntity || entity instanceof PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity;
    }
    private static boolean crowded(ServerLevel level, Vec3 center) {
        int[] found = {0}, checked = {0};
        level.getEntities().get(net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityTypeTest.forClass(Mob.class),
                new AABB(center, center).inflate(32, 12, 32), entity -> {
            if (entity.isAlive() && member(entity)) found[0]++;
            return found[0] >= MAX_NEARBY_SPLINTERS || ++checked[0] >= 96
                    ? net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.ABORT
                    : net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.CONTINUE;
        });
        return found[0] >= MAX_NEARBY_SPLINTERS || checked[0] >= 96;
    }
    private static boolean danger(BlockState state) {
        return state.is(Blocks.FIRE) || state.is(Blocks.SOUL_FIRE) || state.is(Blocks.MAGMA_BLOCK)
                || state.is(Blocks.CACTUS) || state.is(Blocks.POWDER_SNOW) || state.is(Blocks.WITHER_ROSE)
                || state.is(Blocks.COBWEB) || state.is(Blocks.SWEET_BERRY_BUSH)
                || state.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.CampfireBlock
                || state.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.Portal;
    }
    private static boolean extractorNear(ServerLevel level, Vec3 point) {
        BlockPos base = BlockPos.containing(point);
        for (int x = -1; x <= 1; x++) for (int y = -1; y <= 0; y++) for (int z = -1; z <= 1; z++) {
            BlockPos pos = base.offset(x, y, z);
            if (!level.hasChunkAt(pos)) return true;
            // Avoid hoppers and modded block-entity extractors, without probing their inventories.
            if (level.getBlockEntity(pos) != null) return true;
        }
        return !level.getEntitiesOfClass(net.minecraft.world.entity.vehicle.MinecartHopper.class,
                new AABB(base).inflate(2)).isEmpty();
    }
    private static boolean site(ServerLevel level, Vec3 point) {
        BlockPos feet = BlockPos.containing(point);
        double half = 0.4;
        AABB body = new AABB(point.x - half, point.y, point.z - half,
                point.x + half, point.y + 2.0, point.z + half);
        if (!level.getWorldBorder().isWithinBounds(body) || extractorNear(level, point)) return false;
        for (int x = Mth.floor(body.minX); x <= Mth.floor(body.maxX - 0.001); x++)
            for (int z = Mth.floor(body.minZ); z <= Mth.floor(body.maxZ - 0.001); z++) {
                BlockPos floor = new BlockPos(x, feet.getY() - 1, z);
                if (!level.hasChunkAt(floor) || level.isOutsideBuildHeight(floor)
                        || !level.getBlockState(floor).isFaceSturdy(level, floor, Direction.UP)
                        || !level.getFluidState(floor).isEmpty() || danger(level.getBlockState(floor))) return false;
                for (int y = feet.getY(); y <= Mth.floor(body.maxY - 0.001); y++) {
                    BlockPos cell = new BlockPos(x, y, z);
                    if (level.isOutsideBuildHeight(cell) || !level.getFluidState(cell).isEmpty()
                            || danger(level.getBlockState(cell))
                            || level.getBlockState(cell).getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.DoorBlock
                            || level.getBlockState(cell).getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.FenceGateBlock) return false;
                }
            }
        return level.noCollision(null, body) && level.getEntitiesOfClass(LivingEntity.class, body, Entity::isAlive).isEmpty();
    }
    private static boolean clearLine(ServerLevel level, ItemEntity item, Vec3 to) {
        Vec3 from = item.position().add(0, 0.15, 0);
        int minX = Mth.floor(Math.min(from.x, to.x)) >> 4, maxX = Mth.floor(Math.max(from.x, to.x)) >> 4;
        int minZ = Mth.floor(Math.min(from.z, to.z)) >> 4, maxZ = Mth.floor(Math.max(from.z, to.z)) >> 4;
        for (int x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) for (int z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++)
            if (!level.hasChunkAt(new BlockPos(x << 4, Mth.floor(from.y), z << 4))) return false;
        return level.clip(new ClipContext(from, to, ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER, ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, item)).getType()
                == HitResult.Type.MISS;
    }

    private static boolean tryStart(ServerLevel level, State state, ItemEntity seed, long now) {
        if (state.formations.size() >= MAX_FORMATIONS || state.owners.containsKey(seed.getUUID())) return false;
        Player witness = level.getNearestPlayer(seed, 48);
        if (witness == null || !witness.isAlive() || witness.isSpectator()) return false;
        int kind = kind(level, seed.getItem()), radius = attractionRadius(level.getDifficulty(), hardcore(level));
        BlockPos caroFloor = seed.blockPosition().below();
        boolean onCaro = caro(level, caroFloor);
        Vec3 center = null;
        for (int[] offset : new int[][] {{0,0},{2,0},{-2,0},{0,2},{0,-2},{2,2},{-2,-2},{-2,2},{2,-2}}) {
            for (int dy : new int[] {0, -1, 1, -2}) {
                Vec3 point = Vec3.atBottomCenterOf(seed.blockPosition().offset(offset[0], dy, offset[1]));
                if (onCaro && !BlockPos.containing(point).below().equals(caroFloor)) continue;
                if (site(level, point) && clearLine(level, seed, point.add(0, 0.5, 0))) { center = point; break; }
            }
            if (center != null) break;
        }
        if (center == null || crowded(level, center) || !level.mayInteract(witness, BlockPos.containing(center))) return false;
        for (Cooldown cooldown : state.cooldowns)
            if (cooldown.dimension().equals(dimension(level)) && cooldown.point().distanceToSqr(center) < 32 * 32) return false;
        for (Formation other : state.formations.values())
            if (other.dimension.equals(dimension(level)) && other.point.distanceToSqr(center) < 6 * 6) return false;
        List<ItemEntity> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        candidates.add(seed); // A single verified death-loot item is sufficient on Lignum Caro.
        int[] examined = {0}; Vec3 target = center;
        level.getEntities().get(net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityTypeTest.forClass(ItemEntity.class),
                new AABB(center, center).inflate(radius), item -> {
            if (item != seed && !state.owners.containsKey(item.getUUID()) && eligible(level, item)
                    && item.distanceToSqr(target) <= radius * radius) candidates.add(item);
            return ++examined[0] >= 128 || candidates.size() >= MAX_ITEMS_PER_FORMATION ? net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.ABORT
                    : net.minecraft.util.AbortableIterationConsumer.Continuation.CONTINUE;
        });
        candidates.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble((ItemEntity item) -> item.distanceToSqr(target))
                .thenComparing(ItemEntity::getUUID));
        ItemStack reference = seed.getItem();
        if (kind == 5) {
            // A nearby wooden core determines the variant; sticks alone form the dimension's plank variant.
            for (ItemEntity item : candidates) if (kind(level, item.getItem()) != 5
                    && clearLine(level, item, center.add(0, 0.5, 0))) {
                reference = item.getItem(); kind = kind(level, reference); break;
            }
            if (kind == 5) kind = dimension(level).equals("the_backwoods:the_grain") ? 1 : 0;
        }
        ItemStack chosen = reference;
        candidates.removeIf(item -> kind(level, item.getItem()) != 5
                && !ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents(chosen, item.getItem()));
        // Spend whole wooden units before sticks, so a mixed pile never rounds up or overconsumes fuel.
        candidates.sort(Comparator.comparingInt((ItemEntity item) -> kind(level, item.getItem()) == 5 ? 1 : 0)
                .thenComparingDouble(item -> item.distanceToSqr(target)).thenComparing(ItemEntity::getUUID));
        Formation group = new Formation(); group.id = UUID.randomUUID(); group.dimension = dimension(level);
        group.point = center; group.radius = radius; group.kind = kind == 4 ? level.getRandom().nextInt(4) : kind; group.start = now;
        group.onCaro = onCaro; group.caroBase = caroFloor.asLong();
        group.yaw = (float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(-(witness.getX() - center.x), witness.getZ() - center.z));
        group.total = (onCaro ? 1 : requiredItems(kind, level.getDifficulty(), hardcore(level))) * materialUnits(kind);
        group.protectedItems = hardcore(level) || level.getDifficulty() != Difficulty.EASY;
        group.gather = 100 + radius * 2; // Gathering is followed by a smooth rise and a separate silhouette hold.
        int missing = group.total;
        for (ItemEntity item : candidates) {
            if (group.pieces.size() >= MAX_ITEMS_PER_FORMATION || missing == 0) break;
            if (!clearLine(level, item, center.add(0, 0.5, 0))) continue;
            Piece piece = new Piece(); piece.uuid = item.getUUID(); piece.count = item.getItem().getCount();
            int units = materialUnits(kind(level, item.getItem()));
            piece.take = Math.min(missing / units, piece.count);
            if (piece.take <= 0) continue;
            piece.sample = item.getItem().copy();
            group.pieces.add(piece); missing -= piece.take * units;
        }
        if (missing > 0 || state.owners.size() + group.pieces.size() > MAX_CLAIMED_ITEMS) return false;
        // All claims are acquired together on the server thread; overlapping radii can never pull the same entity.
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) {
            Entity entity = level.getEntity(piece.uuid);
            if (!(entity instanceof ItemEntity item) || !eligible(level, item) || state.owners.containsKey(piece.uuid))
                return false;
        }
        state.formations.put(group.id, group);
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) {
            ItemEntity item = (ItemEntity) level.getEntity(piece.uuid);
            CompoundTag data = item.getPersistentData();
            data.putString(CLAIM, group.id.toString());
            data.putBoolean("coalOldGravity", item.isNoGravity()); data.putBoolean("coalOldInvulnerable", item.isInvulnerable());
            state.owners.put(piece.uuid, group.id);
            item.setTarget(group.id); item.setNeverPickUp(); item.setNoGravity(true);
            if (group.protectedItems) item.setInvulnerable(true);
        }
        spreadReservedStacks(level, state, group);
        level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(center), SoundEvents.WARDEN_HEARTBEAT, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 0.55F, 0.65F);
        return true;
    }


    /** Subdivide reserved material, never manufacture it; at most twelve silhouette pieces per small pile. */
    private static void spreadReservedStacks(ServerLevel level, State state, Formation group) {
        int reserved = 0;
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) reserved += piece.take;
        int desired = Math.min(MAX_SHAPE_PIECES, reserved);
        for (Piece source : new ArrayList<>(group.pieces)) {
            if (!(level.getEntity(source.uuid) instanceof ItemEntity original)) continue;
            while (source.take > 1 && group.pieces.size() < desired && state.owners.size() < MAX_CLAIMED_ITEMS) {
                ItemStack stack = original.getItem().copy(); stack.setCount(1);
                ItemEntity fragment = new ItemEntity(level, original.getX(), original.getY(), original.getZ(), stack);
                // Retain the remaining despawn lifetime instead of resetting old loot to five minutes.
                fragment.lifespan = Math.max(1, original.lifespan - original.getAge());
                fragment.setNeverPickUp(); fragment.setTarget(group.id); fragment.setNoGravity(true);
                fragment.setInvulnerable(group.protectedItems || original.isInvulnerable());
                fragment.setDeltaMovement(original.getDeltaMovement());
                if (!level.addFreshEntity(fragment) || !fragment.isAlive() || fragment.isRemoved()
                        || fragment.level() != level || fragment.getItem().getCount() != 1
                        || !ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents(fragment.getItem(), stack)) {
                    if (!fragment.isRemoved()) fragment.discard();
                    break; // No material was removed from the original stack.
                }
                CompoundTag data = original.getPersistentData(), journal = fragment.getPersistentData();
                journal.putString(CLAIM, group.id.toString());
                journal.putBoolean("coalOldGravity", data.getBoolean("coalOldGravity"));
                journal.putBoolean("coalOldInvulnerable", data.getBoolean("coalOldInvulnerable"));
                fragment.setTarget(group.id);
                original.getItem().shrink(1);
                original.setItem(original.getItem().copy()); // Synchronize stack shrink with the new visible fragment.
                source.take--; source.count--; source.sample = original.getItem().copy();
                Piece piece = new Piece(); piece.uuid = fragment.getUUID(); piece.take = 1; piece.count = 1;
                piece.sample = fragment.getItem().copy();
                group.pieces.add(piece); state.owners.put(piece.uuid, group.id);
            }
        }
    }

    private static int shapeSlot(int index, int count) {
        if (count == 1) return 1;
        if (count == 2) return index == 0 ? 0 : 6;
        if (count == 3) return index == 0 ? 0 : index + 3;
        if (count == 4) return index < 2 ? index : index + 2;
        if (count == 5) return index == 0 ? 0 : index + 1;
        return Math.floorMod(index, MAX_SHAPE_PIECES);
    }

    private static Vec3 shapePoint(Formation group, int index) {
        // Feet-to-head silhouette fits the same two-block-tall, 0.8-block-wide validated standing volume.
        int slot = Math.floorMod(index, MAX_SHAPE_PIECES);
        double x = switch (slot) {
            case 2, 8 -> -0.27; case 3, 9 -> 0.27;
            case 4, 10 -> -0.14; case 5, 11 -> 0.14; default -> 0.0;
        };
        double y = switch (slot) {
            case 0 -> 1.62; case 1 -> 1.08; case 2, 3 -> 1.26;
            case 4, 5 -> 0.16; case 6 -> 0.72; case 7 -> 1.35;
            case 8, 9 -> 0.91; default -> 0.47;
        };
        double angle = Math.toRadians(group.yaw);
        return group.point.add(x * Math.cos(angle), y, x * Math.sin(angle));
    }

    private static void advance(MinecraftServer server, State state, Formation group, long now) {
        ServerLevel level = level(server, group.dimension);
        if (level == null || !permitted(level) || now < group.start
                || now - group.start > TELEGRAPH_TICKS + group.gather + SHAPE_RISE_TICKS + ASSEMBLY_TICKS + 80
                || !level.hasChunkAt(BlockPos.containing(group.point))) { cancel(level, state, group, now); return; }
        if (now % 4 == 0 && (!site(level, group.point) || crowded(level, group.point)
                || group.onCaro && !caro(level, BlockPos.of(group.caroBase)))) { cancel(level, state, group, now); return; }
        long age = now - group.start;
        boolean together = true;
        boolean shaping = group.shapeStart >= 0;
        double rise = shaping ? Mth.clamp((now - group.shapeStart) / (double) SHAPE_RISE_TICKS, 0.0, 1.0) : 0.0;
        rise = rise * rise * (3.0 - 2.0 * rise);
        int index = 0;
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) {
            Entity entity = level.getEntity(piece.uuid);
            if (!(entity instanceof ItemEntity item) || !item.isAlive()
                    || !group.id.equals(state.owners.get(piece.uuid))
                    || !group.id.toString().equals(item.getPersistentData().getString(CLAIM))
                    || item.getItem().getCount() != piece.count
                    || !ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents(item.getItem(), piece.sample)
                    || item.distanceToSqr(group.point) > (group.radius + 2.0) * (group.radius + 2.0)
                    || extractorNear(level, item.position())) { cancel(level, state, group, now); return; }
            item.setNeverPickUp(); item.setTarget(group.id); item.setNoGravity(true);
            if (group.protectedItems) item.setInvulnerable(true);
            if (!group.protectedItems && (item.isInLava() || item.isOnFire())) { cancel(level, state, group, now); return; }
            Vec3 gatheringPoint = group.point.add(0, 0.28, 0);
            Vec3 goal = shaping ? gatheringPoint.lerp(shapePoint(group, shapeSlot(index, group.pieces.size())), rise) : gatheringPoint;
            index++; // Stable body slots never orbit or swap while the silhouette is forming.
            if (age < TELEGRAPH_TICKS) {
                item.setDeltaMovement(item.getDeltaMovement().scale(0.7)); together = false; continue;
            }
            if (!clearLine(level, item, goal)) { cancel(level, state, group, now); return; }
            Vec3 difference = goal.subtract(item.position());
            double distance = difference.length();
            together &= distance < (shaping ? 0.18 : 0.6);
            double progress = Mth.clamp((age - TELEGRAPH_TICKS) / (double) group.gather, 0.0, 1.0);
            item.setDeltaMovement(gatherMotion(difference, item.getDeltaMovement(), distance, progress));
            item.hasImpulse = true;
        }
        if (shaping && age % 8 == 0 && group.pieces.size() < 6) {
            // A one-item Caro revival cannot be split into six real items; subtle smoke suggests missing limbs.
            for (int slot = 0; slot < 6; slot++) {
                boolean occupied = false;
                for (int piece = 0; piece < group.pieces.size(); piece++)
                    if (shapeSlot(piece, group.pieces.size()) == slot) occupied = true;
                if (!occupied) {
                    Vec3 hint = group.point.add(0, 0.28, 0).lerp(shapePoint(group, slot), rise);
                    level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SMOKE, hint.x, hint.y + 0.12, hint.z, 1, 0.015, 0.015, 0.015, 0.0);
                }
            }
        }
        if (age % 8 == 0) level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SMOKE, group.point.x, group.point.y + 0.2,
                group.point.z, 2, 0.25, 0.12, 0.25, 0.005);
        if (age > 0 && age % 30 == 0) {
            float progress = Mth.clamp(age / (float) (TELEGRAPH_TICKS + group.gather + SHAPE_RISE_TICKS + ASSEMBLY_TICKS), 0, 1);
            level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(group.point), SoundEvents.WOOD_PLACE, SoundSource.HOSTILE,
                    0.3F + progress * 0.25F, 0.55F + progress * 0.2F);
        }
        if (!shaping && together && age >= TELEGRAPH_TICKS + group.gather) {
            group.shapeStart = now;
            level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(group.point), SoundEvents.WOOD_PLACE, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 0.45F, 0.5F);
        }
        group.readyTicks = shaping && rise >= 1.0 && together ? group.readyTicks + 1 : 0;
        if (group.readyTicks < ASSEMBLY_TICKS) return;
        // Revalidate immediately before adding the entity; do not consume any items on failure/cancellation.
        if (!site(level, group.point) || group.onCaro && !caro(level, BlockPos.of(group.caroBase))) { cancel(level, state, group, now); return; }
        Mob preview = create(level, group.kind);
        preview.setPos(group.point.x, group.point.y, group.point.z);
        preview.finalizeSpawn(level, level.getCurrentDifficultyAt(BlockPos.containing(group.point)),
                MobSpawnType.MOB_SUMMONED, null);
        preview.setYRot(group.yaw); preview.yBodyRot = group.yaw; preview.yHeadRot = group.yaw;
        preview.getPersistentData().putBoolean("coalescenceSpawned", true);
        if (!site(level, group.point) || !validPieces(level, state, group)
                || preview.level() != level || preview.position().distanceToSqr(group.point) > 0.01
                || !level.noCollision(preview, preview.getBoundingBox())
                || !level.addFreshEntity(preview) || !preview.isAlive() || preview.isRemoved()
                || preview.level() != level || preview.position().distanceToSqr(group.point) > 0.01
                || !level.noCollision(preview, preview.getBoundingBox())
                || !state.formations.containsKey(group.id) || !validPieces(level, state, group)) {
            if (!preview.isRemoved()) preview.discard();
            cancel(level, state, group, now); return;
        }
        state.formations.remove(group.id);
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) state.owners.remove(piece.uuid);
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) {
            ItemEntity item = (ItemEntity) level.getEntity(piece.uuid);
            item.getItem().shrink(piece.take);
            restore(item);
            if (item.getItem().isEmpty()) item.discard();
            else { item.setDeltaMovement(0, 0.05, 0); queue(state, item); }
        }
        if (state.cooldowns.size() >= 128) state.cooldowns.removeFirst();
        state.cooldowns.addLast(new Cooldown(group.dimension, group.point, now + REGION_COOLDOWN));
        level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(group.point), SoundEvents.WARDEN_HEARTBEAT, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 0.8F, 0.5F);
    }

    private static Vec3 gatherMotion(Vec3 difference, Vec3 velocity, double distance, double progress) {
        progress=Mth.clamp(progress,0.0,1.0);
        double ease=progress*progress*(3.0-2.0*progress);
        Vec3 desired=difference.scale(0.025+ease*0.075);
        if(desired.lengthSqr()>0.28*0.28)desired=desired.normalize().scale(0.28);
        Vec3 motion=velocity.lerp(desired,0.18);
        if(distance<0.08)motion=motion.scale(0.35);
        if(motion.dot(difference)>0 && motion.lengthSqr()>distance*distance)motion=difference.scale(0.5);
        return motion;
    }

    private static boolean validPieces(ServerLevel level, State state, Formation group) {
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) {
            if (!(level.getEntity(piece.uuid) instanceof ItemEntity item) || !item.isAlive()
                    || !group.id.equals(state.owners.get(piece.uuid))
                    || !group.id.toString().equals(item.getPersistentData().getString(CLAIM))
                    || item.getItem().getCount() != piece.count
                    || !ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents(item.getItem(), piece.sample)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static void restore(ItemEntity item) {
        CompoundTag data = item.getPersistentData();
        if (!data.contains(CLAIM)) return;
        item.setNoGravity(data.getBoolean("coalOldGravity"));
        item.setInvulnerable(data.getBoolean("coalOldInvulnerable"));
        item.setNoPickUpDelay(); item.setTarget(null); item.setDeltaMovement(item.getDeltaMovement().scale(0.25));
        data.remove(CLAIM); data.remove("coalOldGravity"); data.remove("coalOldInvulnerable");
    }
    private static void cancel(ServerLevel level, State state, Formation group, long now) {
        state.formations.remove(group.id);
        for (Piece piece : group.pieces) {
            state.owners.remove(piece.uuid);
            if (level != null && level.getEntity(piece.uuid) instanceof ItemEntity item) {
                restore(item); queue(state, item);
            }
        }
        if (state.cooldowns.size() >= 128) state.cooldowns.removeFirst();
        state.cooldowns.addLast(new Cooldown(group.dimension, group.point, now + 60)); // Avoid repeatedly grabbing/releasing a blocked pile.
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
    public static void protectPickup(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.ItemEntityPickupEvent.Pre event) {
        if (reserved(event.getItemEntity())) {
            event.getItemEntity().setNeverPickUp();
            event.setCanPickup(net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.TriState.FALSE);
        }
    }

    private static boolean reserved(ItemEntity item) {
        if (item.getPersistentData().contains(CLAIM)) return true;
        if (!(item.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return false;
        State state = STATES.get(level.getServer());
        return state != null && (state.owners.containsKey(item.getUUID())
                || item.getTarget() != null && state.formations.containsKey(item.getTarget()));
    }

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void protectReservedTick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof ItemEntity item && item.level() instanceof ServerLevel && reserved(item)) {
            // Apply before vanilla item merging and mob pickup, not only during the later formation update.
            item.setNeverPickUp(); item.setNoGravity(true);
        }
    }
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void clearPickedLoot(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.ItemEntityPickupEvent.Post event) {
        if (!event.getOriginalStack().getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag().getBoolean(LOOT)) return;
        // Remove only the provenance marker from carried loot; foreign custom data is preserved.
        for (int slot = 0; slot < event.getPlayer().getInventory().getContainerSize(); slot++) {
            ItemStack stack = event.getPlayer().getInventory().getItem(slot);
            if (stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag().getBoolean(LOOT))
                CustomData.update(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, stack, tag -> tag.remove(LOOT));
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void markDeathDrops(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.living.LivingDropsEvent event) {
        if (event.isCanceled() || !(event.getEntity().level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        boolean fromSplinter = donor(event.getEntity());
        for (ItemEntity item : event.getDrops()) {
            if (fromSplinter && kind(level, item.getItem()) >= 0) {
                markLoot(item);
                queue(STATES.computeIfAbsent(level.getServer(), key -> new State()), item);
            } else rejectPlayerDrop(item);
        }
    }
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onItemLeave(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityLeaveLevelEvent event) {
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof ItemEntity item) || !(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return;
        State state = STATES.get(level.getServer());
        if (state == null) { restore(item); return; }
        UUID owner = state.owners.get(item.getUUID());
        Formation group = owner == null ? null : state.formations.get(owner);
        if (group != null) cancel(level, state, group, time(level));
        restore(item); state.queued.remove(item.getUUID());
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.SplinterEntity;

import java.util.Comparator;

public class SplinterNaturalEntitySpawningConditionProcedure {
	public static boolean execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z) {
		Entity targetPlayer = null;
		double radius = 0;
		radius = 128;
		targetPlayer = findEntityInWorldRange(world, Player.class, x, y, z, 64);
		if (targetPlayer != null) {
			if (targetPlayer.getPersistentData().getDouble("backwoods_time") > 20000) {
				radius = 32;
			} else if (targetPlayer.getPersistentData().getDouble("backwoods_time") > 17000) {
				radius = 48;
			} else if (targetPlayer.getPersistentData().getDouble("backwoods_time") > 11000) {
				radius = 72;
			} else if (targetPlayer.getPersistentData().getDouble("backwoods_time") > 7500) {
				radius = 96;
			} else if (targetPlayer.getPersistentData().getDouble("backwoods_time") > 4000) {
				radius = 112;
			}
		}
		if (!(!world.getEntitiesOfClass(SplinterEntity.class, new AABB(Vec3.ZERO, Vec3.ZERO).move(new Vec3(x, y, z)).inflate(radius / 2d), e -> true).isEmpty()) && world.getBlockState(BlockPos.containing(x, y - 1, z)).canOcclude()) {
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static Entity findEntityInWorldRange(LevelAccessor world, Class<? extends Entity> clazz, double x, double y, double z, double range) {
		return (Entity) world.getEntitiesOfClass(clazz, AABB.ofSize(new Vec3(x, y, z), range, range, range), e -> true).stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(e -> e.distanceToSqr(x, y, z))).findFirst().orElse(null);
	}
}

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.BlindspotSplinterEntity;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.LogSplinterEntity;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.UUID;

import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure {

	private static final double WATCH_DOT_THRESHOLD = 0.5;
	private static final double ACTIVE_MOVE_SPEED = 0.335;
	private static final double DEGRADED_MOVE_SPEED = 0.20;
	private static final float MINE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 33.33f;
	private static final float MINE_SPEED_BASE = 33.33f;
	private static final float DEGRADED_MINE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 66.67f;
	private static final float DEGRADED_MINE_SPEED_BASE = 66.67f;
	private static final float MAX_BREAKABLE_HARDNESS = 50f;
	private static final double TARGET_RANGE = 128;
	private static final double MINE_RAY_DISTANCE = 2.0;
	private static final double ROSE_WILT_TICKS = 450;
	private static final int ROSE_SCAN_XZ = 6;
	private static final int ROSE_SCAN_Y = 3;
	private static final int RAGE_WATCH_THRESHOLD = 600;
	private static final int RAGE_THRESHOLD_HIT_BONUS = 100;
	private static final double RAGE_ESCAPE_RANGE = 14.0;

	private static final int PATH_RECALC_INTERVAL_TICKS = 8;
	private static final double TARGET_MOVE_REPATH_DIST_SQR = 1.25;

	private static final String K_RAGE_BONUS = "rage_watch_bonus";
	private static final String K_LAST_HURT_TIME = "rage_last_hurt_time";

	private static final String K_HM_PHASE = "hm_phase";
	private static final String K_HM_PHASE_TIMER = "hm_phase_timer";
	private static final String K_HM_SILENT_CD = "hm_silent_cd";
	private static final String K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS = "forced_hunt_ticks";

	private static final String K_NAV_LAST_TICK = "nav_last_tick";
	private static final String K_NAV_TX = "nav_tx";
	private static final String K_NAV_TY = "nav_ty";
	private static final String K_NAV_TZ = "nav_tz";
	private static final String K_NAV_MODE = "nav_mode";

	private static final String K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS = "stalk_watch_ticks";
	private static final String K_FLANK_TICKS = "flank_ticks";
	private static final String K_FLANK_STREAK = "flank_streak";
	private static final String K_FLANK_X = "flank_x";
	private static final String K_FLANK_Y = "flank_y";
	private static final String K_FLANK_Z = "flank_z";
	private static final int STALK_WATCH_MIN = 16;
	private static final int STALK_WATCH_MAX = 40;
	private static final int STALK_WATCH_CHANCE = 160;

	// Personality
	private static final String K_PERSONALITY_INIT = "ai_personality_init";
	private static final String K_PERSONALITY = "ai_personality"; // 0=stalk/hunt, 1=angel
	private static final int PERSONALITY_STALK_HUNT = 0;
	private static final int PERSONALITY_ANGEL = 1;
	private static final int ANGEL_CHANCE_PERCENT = 50;

	private static final int PHASE_SILENT = 0;
	private static final int PHASE_STALK = 1;
	private static final int PHASE_HUNT = 2;

	private static final int SILENT_MIN_TICKS = 80;
	private static final int SILENT_MAX_TICKS = 220;
	private static final int STALK_MIN_TICKS = 120;
	private static final int STALK_MAX_TICKS = 300;
	private static final int HUNT_TICKS = 400;
	private static final int POST_HUNT_SILENT_CD = 240;

	private static final double STALK_SPEED = 0.14;
	private static final double STALK_FOLLOW_DIST = 18.0;

	private static final int AGE_THIRD_TO_LAST = 504000;
	private static final int AGE_SECOND_TO_LAST = 576000;
	private static final int AGE_LAST = 648000;

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onEntityTickAfterGoals(EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof SplinterEntity member) {
			if (!member.level().isClientSide() && Math.floorMod(member.tickCount + member.getId(), 5) == 0)
				member.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose,
						checkNearbyRoseBlocks(member.level(), member) ? 1 : 0);
			if (member.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose) == 1) {
				setSpeed(member, 0);
				stopNav(member);
				Vec3 motion = member.getDeltaMovement();
				member.setDeltaMovement(0.0, motion.y, 0.0);
				return;
			}
			if (SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.finishAction(member, member.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress))) return;
			SplinterHivemind.followFormationPost(member, member.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress));
		}
	}


	@SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
	public static void onHiveNavigationTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof Mob member && member.level() instanceof ServerLevel
				&& SplinterHivemind.member(member)) {
            if (member instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity && member.getPersistentData().contains("htMirrorUntil")) {
                Player target = member.getTarget() instanceof Player p ? p : null;
                if (!AdaptiveHive.validPlayer(target, (ServerLevel) member.level())
                        || AdaptiveHive.progress(member) != 0 || SplinterHivemind.frozen(member))
                    AdaptiveHive.endMirror(member, false);
            }
			AdaptiveHive.installNavigationGoals(member);
            AdaptiveHive.advanceCover(member);
            // Global fallback is variant-independent, including paths that returned before ordinary tactics.
            // Mining, roses and the afterimage lease remain exclusive; defendFor deduplicates each entity tick.
            if (member.getTarget() instanceof Player target && !AdaptiveHive.mirrorHidden(member)
                    && !member.getPersistentData().contains("htMirrorAttackUntil"))
                AdaptiveHive.defend(member, target, AdaptiveHive.progress(member));
			AdaptiveHive.updateVisuals(member, (ServerLevel) member.level(), false);
		}
	}


	@SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
	public static void onHiveVisualPost(EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof Mob member && member.level() instanceof ServerLevel level
				&& SplinterHivemind.member(member)) AdaptiveHive.updateVisuals(member, level, true);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onHiveVisualLeave(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.EntityLeaveLevelEvent event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof Mob member && event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level
				&& SplinterHivemind.member(member)) {
			AdaptiveHive.endMirror(member, false);
			AdaptiveHive.clearMiningVisual(member, level);
			AdaptiveHive.BUILDING_HANDS.remove(member);
		}
	}


	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onHiveVisualCleanup(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
		if (event.getServer().overworld().getGameTime() % 10 != 0) return;
		for (Mob member : new ArrayList<>(AdaptiveHive.MINING_VISUALS.keySet())) {
			if (member.level() instanceof ServerLevel level && level.getServer() == event.getServer()) {
				AdaptiveHive.MiningVisual visual = AdaptiveHive.MINING_VISUALS.get(member);
				if (visual != null && (member.isRemoved() || !member.isAlive()
						|| level.getGameTime() - visual.tick > 2)) AdaptiveHive.clearMiningVisual(member, level);
			}
		}
		for (Mob member : new ArrayList<>(AdaptiveHive.BUILDING_HANDS.keySet())) {
			if (member.level() instanceof ServerLevel level && level.getServer() == event.getServer())
				AdaptiveHive.updateVisuals(member, level, true);
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
		execute(event, event.getEntity().level(), event.getEntity().getX(), event.getEntity().getY(), event.getEntity().getZ(), event.getEntity());
	}

	public static void execute(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		execute(null, world, x, y, z, entity);
	}

	private static void execute(@Nullable Event event, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, Entity entity) {
		if (!(entity instanceof SplinterEntity splinter)) return;

		updatePlacedBlockCleanup(world, splinter, TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get().defaultBlockState());

		if (IsRotNearbyConditionProcedure.execute(world, splinter)) {
			splinter.setTarget(null);
			splinter.setLastHurtByMob(null);
			setSpeed(splinter, ACTIVE_MOVE_SPEED);
			return;
		}

		if (splinter.getTarget() instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) {
			splinter.setTarget(null);
		}
		if (splinter.getLastHurtByMob() instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) {
			splinter.setLastHurtByMob(null);
		}

		if (!splinter.getPersistentData().getBoolean(K_PERSONALITY_INIT)) {
			int p = (splinter.getRandom().nextInt(100) < ANGEL_CHANCE_PERCENT) ? PERSONALITY_ANGEL : PERSONALITY_STALK_HUNT;
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_PERSONALITY, p);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putBoolean(K_PERSONALITY_INIT, true);
		}
		int personality = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_PERSONALITY);

		if (splinter.isPassenger()) {
			Entity vehicle = splinter.getVehicle();
			if (vehicle instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.vehicle.Boat || vehicle instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.vehicle.ChestBoat) {
				splinter.stopRiding();
				splinter.setDeltaMovement(splinter.getDeltaMovement().add(0, 0.2, 0));
			}
		}

		int age = splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_Age);
		if (age >= AGE_LAST) {
			splinter.discard();
			return;
		}

		boolean isDegraded = age >= AGE_THIRD_TO_LAST;
		boolean isCritical = age >= AGE_SECOND_TO_LAST;

		Player foundPlayerDirect = findNearestPlayerInRange(world, splinter.getX(), splinter.getY(), splinter.getZ(), TARGET_RANGE);
		if (world instanceof Level level && level.isClientSide()) {
			return;
		}
		LivingEntity foundPlayer = foundPlayerDirect;

		LivingEntity prioritizedMob = null;
		String attackerUUIDStr = splinter.getPersistentData().getString("splinter_attacker_uuid");
		if (!attackerUUIDStr.isEmpty() && world instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel) {
			try {
				java.util.UUID attackerUUID = java.util.UUID.fromString(attackerUUIDStr);
				net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity foundEntity = serverLevel.getEntity(attackerUUID);
				if (foundEntity instanceof LivingEntity livingAttacker && livingAttacker.isAlive() && splinter.distanceToSqr(livingAttacker) < TARGET_RANGE * TARGET_RANGE) {
					boolean isWoodbound = livingAttacker.getType().is(net.minecraft.tags.TagKey.create(net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries.ENTITY_TYPE, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:woodbound_entities")));
					if (!isWoodbound && !(livingAttacker instanceof Player)) {
						prioritizedMob = livingAttacker;
					}
				}
			} catch (Exception e) {}
		}

		LivingEntity attacker = splinter.getLastHurtByMob();
		if (attacker != null) {
			boolean isWoodbound = attacker.getType().is(net.minecraft.tags.TagKey.create(net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries.ENTITY_TYPE, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:woodbound_entities")));
			if (isWoodbound) {
				if (splinter.getLastHurtByMob() == attacker) {
					splinter.setLastHurtByMob(null);
				}
				attacker = null;
			} else if (attacker.isAlive() && splinter.distanceToSqr(attacker) < TARGET_RANGE * TARGET_RANGE) {
				if (!(attacker instanceof Player)) {
					prioritizedMob = attacker;
					splinter.getPersistentData().putString("splinter_attacker_uuid", attacker.getUUID().toString());
				}
			}
		}

		boolean hadPrioritizedMob = !attackerUUIDStr.isEmpty();
		if (hadPrioritizedMob && prioritizedMob == null) {
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 0);
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_RAGE_BONUS, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
			if (splinter.getLastHurtByMob() != null) {
				splinter.setLastHurtByMob(null);
			}
			splinter.getPersistentData().remove("splinter_attacker_uuid");
		}

		if (prioritizedMob != null) {
			foundPlayer = prioritizedMob;
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 1);
			if (splinter.getTarget() != prioritizedMob) {
				splinter.setTarget(prioritizedMob);
			}
			if (splinter.getLastHurtByMob() != prioritizedMob) {
				splinter.setLastHurtByMob(prioritizedMob);
			}
		} else {
			if (attacker instanceof Player p && p.isAlive() && !p.isCreative() && !p.isSpectator() && splinter.distanceToSqr(attacker) < TARGET_RANGE * TARGET_RANGE) {
				foundPlayer = p;
			}
			if (foundPlayer != null) {
				if (splinter.getTarget() != foundPlayer) {
					splinter.setTarget(foundPlayer);
				}
			} else {
				if (splinter.getTarget() != null) {
					splinter.setTarget(null);
				}
			}
		}

		if (foundPlayer != null) {
			boolean isWoodbound = foundPlayer.getType().is(net.minecraft.tags.TagKey.create(net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries.ENTITY_TYPE, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:woodbound_entities")));
			if (isWoodbound) {
				foundPlayer = null;
			}
		}

		if (foundPlayer == null) {
			if (SplinterHivemind.search(splinter)) return;
			int remainingForcedHunt = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS);

			if (remainingForcedHunt <= 0) {
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_RAGE_BONUS, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, PHASE_SILENT);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
				stopNav(splinter);
			} else {
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS, remainingForcedHunt - 1);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 1);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, PHASE_HUNT);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, HUNT_TICKS);
			}
			return;
		}

		int frozenByRose = splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_frozenByRose);
		int isEnraged = splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged);
		int watchTimer = splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer);

		int forcedHuntTicks = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS);
		if (forcedHuntTicks > 0) {
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS, forcedHuntTicks - 1);
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 1);
			isEnraged = 1;
		}

		if (splinter.getLastHurtByMob() != null) {
			boolean isWoodbound = splinter.getLastHurtByMob().getType().is(net.minecraft.tags.TagKey.create(net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries.ENTITY_TYPE, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:woodbound_entities")));
			if (!isWoodbound) {
				int lastSeenHurtTime = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_LAST_HURT_TIME);
				int currentHurtTime = splinter.hurtTime;
				if (currentHurtTime > 0 && currentHurtTime != lastSeenHurtTime) {
					int bonus = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_RAGE_BONUS) + RAGE_THRESHOLD_HIT_BONUS;
					splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_RAGE_BONUS, bonus);
					splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_LAST_HURT_TIME, currentHurtTime);
				}
			}
		}

		int effectiveRageThreshold = Math.max(1, RAGE_WATCH_THRESHOLD - splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_RAGE_BONUS));

		boolean isWatched = false;
		if (foundPlayerDirect != null) {
			Vec3 toSplinter = splinter.getEyePosition().subtract(foundPlayerDirect.getEyePosition());
			if (toSplinter.lengthSqr() > 1.0e-8) toSplinter = toSplinter.normalize();
			double dot = foundPlayerDirect.getLookAngle().normalize().dot(toSplinter);
			isWatched = (dot > WATCH_DOT_THRESHOLD) && foundPlayerDirect.hasLineOfSight(splinter);
		}

		double distToPlayer = foundPlayerDirect != null ? splinter.position().distanceTo(foundPlayerDirect.position()) : Double.MAX_VALUE;
		if (isEnraged == 1 && distToPlayer > RAGE_ESCAPE_RANGE) {
			if (splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS) <= 0) {
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 0);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
				isEnraged = 0;
			}
		}

		if (isWatched && isEnraged == 0) {
			watchTimer++;
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, watchTimer);
			if (watchTimer >= effectiveRageThreshold) {
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 1);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
				isEnraged = 1;
			}
		} else if (!isWatched && isEnraged == 0) {
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
		}

		boolean foundRose = false;
		if (foundPlayerDirect != null) {
			foundRose = checkHeldRose(foundPlayerDirect, splinter, world, foundPlayerDirect.getX(), foundPlayerDirect.getY(), foundPlayerDirect.getZ());
		}
		if (foundRose || frozenByRose == 1) {
			setSpeed(splinter, 0);
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_isEnraged, 0);
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_RAGE_BONUS, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
			stopNav(splinter);
			return;
		}

		SplinterHivemind.observe(splinter, foundPlayerDirect, splinter.getLastHurtByMob());
        if (personality == PERSONALITY_STALK_HUNT && SplinterHivemind.beginGroupHunt(splinter, foundPlayerDirect)) {
            splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, PHASE_HUNT);
            splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, 160);
            splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
            splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
        }

		double heightDiff = foundPlayer.getY() - splinter.getY();
		double horizontalDist = splinter.position().distanceTo(foundPlayer.position());
		boolean isTowering = !isCritical && (heightDiff >= 1.4 && horizontalDist < 12);

		// One bounded cover move owns navigation while the archer is drawing.
		if (foundPlayerDirect != null && splinter.getTarget() == foundPlayerDirect
				&& SplinterHivemind.handleBowThreat(splinter, foundPlayerDirect,
					splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress),
					isDegraded ? DEGRADED_MOVE_SPEED : ACTIVE_MOVE_SPEED)) return;
		if (personality == PERSONALITY_STALK_HUNT
				&& SplinterHivemind.bowCommitActive(splinter, foundPlayerDirect)
				&& splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_HM_PHASE) != PHASE_HUNT) {
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, PHASE_HUNT);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, 90);
		}

		if (personality == PERSONALITY_ANGEL) {
			if (isWatched && isEnraged == 0 && !SplinterHivemind.bowCommitActive(splinter, foundPlayerDirect)) {
				setSpeed(splinter, 0);
				stopNav(splinter);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
				return;
			}

			if (splinter.tickCount % 3 == 0) {
				splinter.lookAt(EntityAnchorArgument.Anchor.EYES, new Vec3(foundPlayer.getX(), foundPlayer.getEyeY(), foundPlayer.getZ()));
			}

			setSpeed(splinter, isDegraded ? DEGRADED_MOVE_SPEED : ACTIVE_MOVE_SPEED);
			if (splinter instanceof Mob angelMob) {
				navMoveToEntityThrottled(splinter, angelMob, foundPlayer, 1.0, 3);
			}
		} else {
			int phase = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_HM_PHASE);
			int phaseTimer = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER);
			int silentCd = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_HM_SILENT_CD);

			if (phase == PHASE_SILENT && isEnraged == 0 && forcedHuntTicks <= 0) {
				phase = PHASE_STALK;
				phaseTimer = randomBetween(splinter, STALK_MIN_TICKS, STALK_MAX_TICKS);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, phase);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, phaseTimer);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
			}

			if (silentCd > 0) {
				silentCd--;
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_SILENT_CD, silentCd);
			}

			if (isEnraged == 1 || splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_FORCED_HUNT_TICKS) > 0) {
				phase = PHASE_HUNT;
				phaseTimer = HUNT_TICKS + 40;
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, phase);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, phaseTimer);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
			} else {
				phaseTimer--;
				if (phaseTimer <= 0) {
					if (phase == PHASE_HUNT) {
						phase = PHASE_SILENT;
						phaseTimer = randomBetween(splinter, SILENT_MIN_TICKS, SILENT_MAX_TICKS);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_SILENT_CD, POST_HUNT_SILENT_CD);
						splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_watchTimer, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
					} else if (phase == PHASE_SILENT) {
						phase = PHASE_STALK;
						phaseTimer = randomBetween(splinter, STALK_MIN_TICKS, STALK_MAX_TICKS);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
					} else {
						phase = PHASE_SILENT;
						phaseTimer = randomBetween(splinter, SILENT_MIN_TICKS, SILENT_MAX_TICKS);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, 0);
					}
				}
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE, phase);
				splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_HM_PHASE_TIMER, phaseTimer);
			}

			if (phase == PHASE_SILENT) {
				setSpeed(splinter, 0);
				stopNav(splinter);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
				return;
			}

			if (splinter.tickCount % 3 == 0) {
				splinter.lookAt(EntityAnchorArgument.Anchor.EYES, new Vec3(foundPlayer.getX(), foundPlayer.getEyeY(), foundPlayer.getZ()));
			}

			if (phase == PHASE_STALK) {
				setSpeed(splinter, STALK_SPEED);

				int watchTicks = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS);
				if (watchTicks > 0) {
					splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, watchTicks - 1);
					stopNav(splinter);
					splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
					return;
				}

				int flankTicks = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_FLANK_TICKS);
				if (flankTicks > 0) {
					splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, flankTicks - 1);
					if (splinter instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob mob2) {
						double fx = splinter.getPersistentData().getDouble(K_FLANK_X);
						double fy = splinter.getPersistentData().getDouble(K_FLANK_Y);
						double fz = splinter.getPersistentData().getDouble(K_FLANK_Z);
						navMoveToPosThrottled(splinter, mob2, fx, fy, fz, 0.8, 1);
					}
					splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
					return;
				}

				if (splinter.getRandom().nextInt(STALK_WATCH_CHANCE) == 0) {
					int flankStreak = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_FLANK_STREAK);
					boolean doFlank = !isWatched && flankStreak < 2 && splinter.getRandom().nextBoolean();

					if (doFlank) {
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, flankStreak + 1);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_TICKS, randomBetween(splinter, STALK_WATCH_MIN, STALK_WATCH_MAX));
						double dist = STALK_FOLLOW_DIST - 2.0;
						double angleOffset = (splinter.getRandom().nextDouble() * 30.0 + 60.0) * (splinter.getRandom().nextBoolean() ? 1 : -1);
						double angleRad = Math.toRadians(foundPlayer.getYRot() + angleOffset);
						double fx = foundPlayer.getX() - Math.sin(angleRad) * dist;
						double fz = foundPlayer.getZ() + Math.cos(angleRad) * dist;
						double fy = foundPlayer.getY();
						splinter.getPersistentData().putDouble(K_FLANK_X, fx);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putDouble(K_FLANK_Y, fy);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putDouble(K_FLANK_Z, fz);
					} else {
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_FLANK_STREAK, 0);
						splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_STALK_WATCH_TICKS, randomBetween(splinter, STALK_WATCH_MIN, STALK_WATCH_MAX));
						stopNav(splinter);
					}
					splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
					return;
				}

				if (splinter instanceof Mob mob) {
					Vec3 hiveStalkPoint = SplinterHivemind.stalkPoint(mob, foundPlayer);
					if (hiveStalkPoint != null) {
						SplinterHivemind.allowPost(splinter);
						navMoveToPosThrottled(splinter, mob, hiveStalkPoint.x, hiveStalkPoint.y, hiveStalkPoint.z, 0.8, 1);
					} else if (distToPlayer > STALK_FOLLOW_DIST) {
						navMoveToEntityThrottled(splinter, mob, foundPlayer, 0.8, 1);
					} else {
						if (!mob.getNavigation().isDone() && splinter.tickCount % 10 == 0) {
							stopNav(splinter);
						}
					}
				}
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
				return;
			}

			setSpeed(splinter, isDegraded ? DEGRADED_MOVE_SPEED : ACTIVE_MOVE_SPEED);
			if (splinter instanceof Mob huntMob) {
				navMoveToEntityThrottled(splinter, huntMob, foundPlayer, 1.0, 3);
			}
		}

		Vec3 splinterEyes = splinter.getEyePosition(1f);
		Vec3 splinterView = splinter.getViewVector(1f);
		Vec3 blockCheckTarget = splinterEyes.add(splinterView.scale(MINE_RAY_DISTANCE));

		HitResult hit = world.clip(new ClipContext(splinterEyes, blockCheckTarget, ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER, ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, splinter));

		BlockPos facePos;
		BlockPos feetPos;

		if (hit.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
			facePos = ((BlockHitResult) hit).getBlockPos();
			feetPos = new BlockPos(facePos.getX(), Mth.floor(splinter.getY()), facePos.getZ());
		} else {
			Vec3 look = splinter.getLookAngle().normalize();
			int fx = Mth.floor(splinter.getX() + look.x);
			int fz = Mth.floor(splinter.getZ() + look.z);
			feetPos = new BlockPos(fx, Mth.floor(splinter.getY()), fz);
			facePos = new BlockPos(fx, Mth.floor(splinter.getEyeY()), fz);
		}

		if (SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.detourAroundCover(world, splinter, foundPlayer, feetPos, facePos)) {
                splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
                return;
            }

		boolean canMineFeet = canMine(world, feetPos, foundPlayer);
		boolean canMineFace = canMine(world, facePos, foundPlayer);
		
		BlockPos downPos = splinter.blockPosition().below();
		boolean canMineDown = (heightDiff <= -2.0 && horizontalDist <= 3.0) && canMine(world, downPos, foundPlayer);
		
		int prevProgress = splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress);
		BlockPos prevTrackPos = new BlockPos(
			splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineX),
			splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineY),
			splinter.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineZ)
		);
		BlockPos trackPos = canMineDown ? downPos : (canMineFeet ? feetPos : facePos);
		if (prevProgress > 0 && trackPos != null && !trackPos.equals(prevTrackPos)) {
			boolean lockPrev = canMine(world, prevTrackPos, foundPlayer) && prevTrackPos.closerToCenterThan(splinter.position(), 4.0) && !isPositionClaimed(world, prevTrackPos, splinter);
			if (lockPrev) {
				trackPos = prevTrackPos;
				canMineDown = trackPos.equals(downPos);
				canMineFeet = trackPos.equals(feetPos);
				canMineFace = trackPos.equals(facePos);
				if (!canMineDown && !canMineFeet && !canMineFace) {
					if (trackPos.getY() < splinter.getY()) { canMineDown = true; downPos = trackPos; }
					else { canMineFeet = true; feetPos = trackPos; }
				}
			} else {
				prevProgress = 0;
			}
		}
		if (canMineDown && isPositionClaimed(world, downPos, splinter)) canMineDown = false;
		if (canMineFeet && isPositionClaimed(world, feetPos, splinter)) canMineFeet = false;
		if (canMineFace && isPositionClaimed(world, facePos, splinter)) canMineFace = false;

		if (canMineFeet || canMineFace || canMineDown) {
			splinter.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, ItemStack.EMPTY);
			int mineProgress = prevProgress + 1;
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, mineProgress);

			if (splinter.tickCount % 6 == 0) {
				splinter.swing(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND);
			}

			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineX, trackPos.getX());
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineY, trackPos.getY());
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineZ, trackPos.getZ());

			float speedRef;
			if (canMineDown) {
				speedRef = world.getBlockState(downPos).getDestroySpeed(world, downPos);
			} else if (canMineFeet) {
				speedRef = world.getBlockState(feetPos).getDestroySpeed(world, feetPos);
			} else {
				speedRef = world.getBlockState(facePos).getDestroySpeed(world, facePos);
			}

			float mineThreshold = isDegraded
					? speedRef * DEGRADED_MINE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER + DEGRADED_MINE_SPEED_BASE
					: speedRef * MINE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER + MINE_SPEED_BASE;

			SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.showMiningCracks(splinter, mineProgress, mineThreshold,
					canMineDown ? downPos : null, canMineFeet ? feetPos : null, canMineFace ? facePos : null);
			if (mineProgress > mineThreshold) {
				if (canMineDown) world.destroyBlock(downPos, false);
				if (canMineFeet) world.destroyBlock(feetPos, false);
				if (canMineFace) world.destroyBlock(facePos, false);
				stopNav(splinter);
				splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);
			}
		} else {
			splinter.getEntityData().set(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress, 0);

			if (!isCritical && !splinter.isSwimming() && !splinter.isInWater()) {
				if (heightDiff >= 1.4 && horizontalDist < 12) {
					splinter.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, new ItemStack(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get()));

					BlockPos under = BlockPos.containing(splinter.getX(), splinter.getY() - 1, splinter.getZ());
					BlockPos body = BlockPos.containing(splinter.getX(), splinter.getY(), splinter.getZ());
					BlockPos bodyUp = body.above();

					if (world.getBlockState(under).isAir()) {
						if (world.setBlock(under, TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get().defaultBlockState(), 3)) {
							SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.swingBuild(splinter);
							trackPlacedBlock(splinter, under);
						}
					}
					if (world.getBlockState(body).is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get())) {
						world.setBlock(body, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
					}
					if (world.getBlockState(bodyUp).is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get())) {
						world.setBlock(bodyUp, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
					}

					world.destroyBlock(BlockPos.containing(splinter.getX(), splinter.getY() + 2, splinter.getZ()), false);
					world.destroyBlock(BlockPos.containing(splinter.getX(), splinter.getY() + 3, splinter.getZ()), false);

					if (splinter.onGround()) {
						splinter.setDeltaMovement(new Vec3(splinter.getDeltaMovement().x(), 0.4, splinter.getDeltaMovement().z()));
					}
					splinter.fallDistance = 0;
				} else if (heightDiff > -0.5 && heightDiff < 2.5) {
					Vec3 look = splinter.getLookAngle();
					BlockPos bridgePos = BlockPos.containing(splinter.getX() + look.x, splinter.getY() - 1, splinter.getZ() + look.z);
					BlockPos farBridgePos = BlockPos.containing(splinter.getX() + look.x * 2.0, splinter.getY() - 1, splinter.getZ() + look.z * 2.0);
					boolean isNearGap = !(world.getBlockFloorHeight(bridgePos) > 0) || !(world.getBlockFloorHeight(farBridgePos) > 0);

					if (isNearGap) {
						splinter.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, new ItemStack(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get()));
						if (!(world.getBlockFloorHeight(bridgePos) > 0)) {
							if (world.setBlock(bridgePos, TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get().defaultBlockState(), 3)) {
								SplinterOnEntityTickUpdateProcedure.AdaptiveHive.swingBuild(splinter);
								trackPlacedBlock(splinter, bridgePos);
							}
						}
					} else {
						splinter.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, ItemStack.EMPTY);
					}
				} else {
					splinter.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, ItemStack.EMPTY);
				}
			} else {
				splinter.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, ItemStack.EMPTY);
			}
		}

		// Melee reach range increase for non-players only (by 50%)
		LivingEntity target = splinter.getTarget();
		if (target != null && target.isAlive() && !(target instanceof Player)) {
			double reach = splinter.getBbWidth() + target.getBbWidth() + 0.8;
			double increasedReach = reach * 1.5;
			double distSqr = splinter.distanceToSqr(target);
			if (distSqr <= increasedReach * increasedReach) {
				int lastAttackTick = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt("last_melee_attack_tick");
				if (splinter.tickCount - lastAttackTick >= 20) {
					splinter.doHurtTarget(target);
					splinter.swing(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND);
					splinter.getPersistentData().putInt("last_melee_attack_tick", splinter.tickCount);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static int randomBetween(SplinterEntity entity, int min, int max) {
		if (max <= min) return min;
		return min + entity.getRandom().nextInt(max - min + 1);
	}

	private static void setSpeed(LivingEntity entity, double speed) {
		if (entity.getAttributes().hasAttribute(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED)) {
			entity.getAttribute(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED).setBaseValue(speed);
		}

	}

private static boolean isPositionClaimed(LevelAccessor world, BlockPos pos, SplinterEntity thisEntity) {
		net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB box = new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(pos).inflate(3);
		java.util.List<SplinterEntity> others = world.getEntitiesOfClass(SplinterEntity.class, box, e -> e != thisEntity && e.isAlive());
		int ourProgress = thisEntity.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress);
		for (SplinterEntity other : others) {
			int otherProgress = other.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineProgress);
			if (otherProgress > 0 &&
				other.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineX) == pos.getX() &&
				other.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineY) == pos.getY() &&
				other.getEntityData().get(SplinterEntity.DATA_mineZ) == pos.getZ()) {
				
				if (ourProgress == 0) return true;
				if (otherProgress > ourProgress) return true;
				if (otherProgress == ourProgress && other.getId() < thisEntity.getId()) return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static boolean canMine(LevelAccessor world, BlockPos pos, LivingEntity player) {
		BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos);
		if (state.isAir()) return false;
		float speed = state.getDestroySpeed(world, pos);
		if (speed < 0 || speed >= MAX_BREAKABLE_HARDNESS) return false;
		if (pos.getY() == (int) (player.getY() - 2)) return false;
		return true;
	}

	private static boolean checkHeldRose(Entity holder, SplinterEntity splinter, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z) {
		if (!(holder instanceof LivingEntity living)) return false;

		ItemStack main = living.getMainHandItem();
		ItemStack off = living.getOffhandItem();

		boolean mainIsRose = main.getItem() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.ASH_ROSE.get().asItem();
		boolean offIsRose = off.getItem() == TheBackwoodsModBlocks.ASH_ROSE.get().asItem();

		if (!mainIsRose && !offIsRose) return false;

		setSpeed(splinter, 0);
		stopNav(splinter);

		if (mainIsRose) tickRoseItem(main, world, x, y, z);
		if (offIsRose) tickRoseItem(off, world, x, y, z);

		return true;
	}

	private static void tickRoseItem(ItemStack rose, LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z) {
		double wiltTimer = rose.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag().getDouble("wilt_timer") + 1.0;
		CustomData.update(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, rose, tag -> tag.putDouble("wilt_timer", wiltTimer));

		if (wiltTimer > ROSE_WILT_TICKS) {
			if (world instanceof Level level) {
				if (!level.isClientSide()) {
					level.playSound(null, BlockPos.containing(x, y, z), SoundEvents.FIRE_EXTINGUISH, SoundSource.NEUTRAL, 1f, 1f);
				} else {
					level.playLocalSound(x, y, z, SoundEvents.FIRE_EXTINGUISH, SoundSource.NEUTRAL, 1f, 1f, false);
				}
			}
			rose.shrink(1);
			CustomData.update(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, rose, tag -> tag.putDouble("wilt_timer", 0));
		}
	}

	private static boolean checkNearbyRoseBlocks(LevelAccessor world, SplinterEntity splinter) {
		BlockPos base = splinter.blockPosition();
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos check = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		for (int sx = -ROSE_SCAN_XZ; sx < ROSE_SCAN_XZ; sx++) {
			for (int sz = -ROSE_SCAN_XZ; sz < ROSE_SCAN_XZ; sz++) {
				check.set(base.getX() + sx, base.getY(), base.getZ() + sz);
				if (world instanceof Level level && !level.hasChunkAt(check)) continue;
				for (int sy = -ROSE_SCAN_Y; sy < ROSE_SCAN_Y; sy++) {
					check.set(base.getX() + sx, base.getY() + sy, base.getZ() + sz);
					BlockState roseState = world.getBlockState(check);
					if (roseState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.ASH_ROSE.get())
							|| roseState.is(TheBackwoodsModBlocks.POTTED_ASH_ROSE.get())) {
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static Player findNearestPlayerInRange(LevelAccessor world, double x, double y, double z, double range) {
		AABB box = AABB.ofSize(new Vec3(x, y, z), range, range, range);
		List<Player> players = world.getEntitiesOfClass(Player.class, box, e -> !e.isCreative() && !e.isSpectator());

		Player nearest = null;
		double best = range * range;
		for (Player p : players) {
			double d = p.distanceToSqr(x, y, z);
			if (d < best) {
				best = d;
				nearest = p;
			}
		}
		return nearest;
	}

	private static void stopNav(SplinterEntity splinter) {
		if (splinter instanceof Mob mob) {
			mob.getNavigation().stop();
		}
		splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_NAV_MODE, 0);
	}

	private static void navMoveToEntityThrottled(SplinterEntity splinter, Mob mob, Entity target, double speed, int mode) {
		Vec3 hiveApproach = SplinterHivemind.approach(mob, target);
		if (target instanceof Player && hiveApproach.distanceToSqr(target.position()) > 1.0) SplinterHivemind.allowPost(mob);
		navMoveToPosThrottled(splinter, mob, hiveApproach.x, hiveApproach.y, hiveApproach.z, speed, mode);
	}

	private static void navMoveToPosThrottled(SplinterEntity splinter, Mob mob, double tx, double ty, double tz, double speed, int mode) {
		int now = splinter.tickCount;
		int lastTick = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_NAV_LAST_TICK);
		int lastMode = splinter.getPersistentData().getInt(K_NAV_MODE);

		double lastTx = splinter.getPersistentData().getDouble(K_NAV_TX);
		double lastTy = splinter.getPersistentData().getDouble(K_NAV_TY);
		double lastTz = splinter.getPersistentData().getDouble(K_NAV_TZ);

		boolean timerReady = (now - lastTick) >= PATH_RECALC_INTERVAL_TICKS;
		boolean modeChanged = lastMode != mode;
		boolean noLast = (lastTick == 0 && lastMode == 0 && lastTx == 0.0 && lastTy == 0.0 && lastTz == 0.0);

		double movedSqr = noLast ? Double.MAX_VALUE : sqr(tx - lastTx) + sqr(ty - lastTy) + sqr(tz - lastTz);
		boolean targetMovedEnough = movedSqr >= TARGET_MOVE_REPATH_DIST_SQR;

		if (modeChanged || timerReady || targetMovedEnough || mob.getNavigation().isDone()) {
			mob.getNavigation().moveTo(tx, ty, tz, speed);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_NAV_LAST_TICK, now);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putInt(K_NAV_MODE, mode);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putDouble(K_NAV_TX, tx);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putDouble(K_NAV_TY, ty);
			splinter.getPersistentData().putDouble(K_NAV_TZ, tz);
		}
	}

	private static double sqr(double v) {
		return v * v;
	} // 1.21.1

	private static void trackPlacedBlock(Entity splinter, BlockPos pos) {
		net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag = splinter.getPersistentData();
		int size = tag.getInt("pb_size");

		for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
			int x = tag.getInt("pb_x_" + i);
			int y = tag.getInt("pb_y_" + i);
			int z = tag.getInt("pb_z_" + i);
			if (x == pos.getX() && y == pos.getY() && z == pos.getZ()) {
				return;
			}
		}

		if (size < 64) {
			tag.putInt("pb_x_" + size, pos.getX());
			tag.putInt("pb_y_" + size, pos.getY());
			tag.putInt("pb_z_" + size, pos.getZ());
			tag.putInt("pb_size", size + 1);
		}
	}

	private static void updatePlacedBlockCleanup(LevelAccessor world, Entity splinter, BlockState targetBlockState) {
		net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag = splinter.getPersistentData();
		int size = tag.getInt("pb_size");
		if (size == 0) return;

		boolean standingOnAny = false;
		for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
			int x = tag.getInt("pb_x_" + i);
			int y = tag.getInt("pb_y_" + i);
			int z = tag.getInt("pb_z_" + i);

			double dx = Math.abs(splinter.getX() - (x + 0.5));
			double dz = Math.abs(splinter.getZ() - (z + 0.5));
			double dy = splinter.getY() - y;

			if (dx <= 1.0 && dz <= 1.0 && dy >= -0.2 && dy <= 2.2) {
				standingOnAny = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		if (standingOnAny) {
			tag.putInt("pb_delay", 0);
		} else {
			int delay = tag.getInt("pb_delay") + 1;
			tag.putInt("pb_delay", delay);

			if (delay % 2 == 0) {
				int x0 = tag.getInt("pb_x_0");
				int y0 = tag.getInt("pb_y_0");
				int z0 = tag.getInt("pb_z_0");
				BlockPos pos0 = new BlockPos(x0, y0, z0);

				BlockState state = world.getBlockState(pos0);
				if (state.is(targetBlockState.getBlock())) {
					world.destroyBlock(pos0, false);
				}

				for (int i = 0; i < size - 1; i++) {
					tag.putInt("pb_x_" + i, tag.getInt("pb_x_" + (i + 1)));
					tag.putInt("pb_y_" + i, tag.getInt("pb_y_" + (i + 1)));
					tag.putInt("pb_z_" + i, tag.getInt("pb_z_" + (i + 1)));
				}
				size--;
				tag.putInt("pb_size", size);
				if (size == 0) {
					tag.putInt("pb_delay", 0);
				}
			}
		}
	}


	/**
	 * Shared server memory for all four variants. Calls are event/observation driven;
	 * the small server-tick handler only expires temporary cover in loaded chunks.
	 */
	public static final class AdaptiveHive {
		// Tune these in the main Splinter extract for each mod version; all four variants share them.
		public static final double LEARNING_RATE = 1.0; // Future experience: 0.5 = half, 2.0 = double.
		public static final double SHOT_LEARNING_GAIN = 0.5;
		public static final double HIT_LEARNING_GAIN = 1.0;
		public static final double BLOCK_LEARNING_GAIN = 2.0;
		public static final int SHOT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_TICKS = 20;
		public static final int OUTCOME_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_TICKS = 20;
		public static final int MEMORY_HALF_LIFE_DAYS = 7;
		// Pattern confidence is separate from experience; keep at least two observations.
		public static final int CADENCE_SAMPLES_REQUIRED = 4;
		public static final int PERCH_OBSERVATIONS_REQUIRED = 3;

		public static void swingBuild(Mob builder) {
			BlockState material = builder instanceof PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity
					? TheBackwoodsModBlocks.PETRIFIED_SPLINTERED_OAK_WOOD.get().defaultBlockState()
					: builder instanceof LogSplinterEntity ? TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_WOOD.get().defaultBlockState()
					: TheBackwoodsModBlocks.SPLINTERED_OAK_PLANKS.get().defaultBlockState();
			swingBuild(builder, material);
		}

		public static void swingBuild(Mob builder, BlockState material) {
			if (builder.level() instanceof ServerLevel && builder.isAlive()) {
				showBuildingHand(builder, material);
				builder.swinging = false;
				builder.swingTime = 0;
				builder.swing(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, true);
			}
		}

		// Only primitive identifiers are retained; weak keys never keep unloaded builders alive.
		private record PendingCover(String owner, String dimension, long base, int slot, int cover, long due) { }
		private static final java.util.Map<Mob, PendingCover> PENDING_COVER = new java.util.WeakHashMap<>();

		private static int coverStepDelay(int learned) {
