			if (i % 2 == 0) sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.FLASH, center.x, center.y, center.z, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
			if (i % 3 == 0) sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.END_ROD, px, py, pz, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0.02);
		}
	}

	private static void renderToweringBeam(ServerLevel level, Vec3 origin, double groundY, double r, double densityFactor, double quality) {
		if (net.mcreator.thebackwoods.VerdantEngineGravityBeam.MASTER_ENABLED) return;
		double h = origin.y - groundY;
		if (h <= 0 || quality <= 0.01) return;

		double densityBoost = 1.0 + (densityFactor * 2.0);
		int coreSteps = Math.max(2, (int) (h * 1.0 * densityBoost * quality));

		for (int i = 0; i < coreSteps; i++) {
			double y = origin.y - (i / (double) coreSteps) * h;
			if (i % 2 == 0 || densityFactor > 0.45) {
				sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.FLASH, origin.x, y, origin.z, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			if (i % 3 == 0 || densityFactor > 0.60) {
				sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.END_ROD, origin.x, y, origin.z, 1, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.01 + densityFactor * 0.02);
			}
		}

		int groundSmoke = (int) ((2 + densityFactor * 3) * quality);
		for (int i = 0; i < groundSmoke; i++) {
			double a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, d = Math.random() * (r + 0.8 + densityFactor * 2.0);
			sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.CAMPFIRE_COSY_SMOKE, origin.x + Math.cos(a) * d, groundY + 0.2, origin.z + Math.sin(a) * d, 1, Math.cos(a) * (0.15 + densityFactor * 0.25), 0.05 + densityFactor * 0.08, Math.sin(a) * (0.15 + densityFactor * 0.25), 0.02);
		}
	}

	private static void crumbleThinPillarsUnderBeam(ServerLevel level, Vec3 origin, double groundY, double r) {
		if (level.getGameTime() % 4 != 0) return;
		int centerX = Mth.floor(origin.x);
		int centerZ = Mth.floor(origin.z);
		int topY = Mth.floor(groundY);

		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos scanPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos neighborPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

		for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
			for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
				double distSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;
				if (distSq > 0 && Math.random() > 0.85) continue;

				int bx = centerX + dx;
				int bz = centerZ + dz;

				for (int y = topY + 2; y >= topY - 10; y--) {
					scanPos.set(bx, y, bz);
					if (!level.hasChunkAt(scanPos)) continue;
					BlockState state = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
					if (!state.isAir() && !state.getCollisionShape(level, scanPos).isEmpty() && state.getBlock() != Blocks.BEDROCK) {
						int lowerNeighbors = 0;
						for (int nx = -1; nx <= 1; nx++) {
							for (int nz = -1; nz <= 1; nz++) {
								if (nx == 0 && nz == 0) continue;
								neighborPos.set(bx + nx, y, bz + nz);
								BlockState nState = level.getBlockState(neighborPos);
								boolean isOpen = nState.isAir() || nState.getCollisionShape(level, neighborPos).isEmpty();
								if (isOpen) {
									neighborPos.set(bx + nx, y - 1, bz + nz);
									BlockState nStateDown = level.getBlockState(neighborPos);
									if (nStateDown.isAir() || nStateDown.getCollisionShape(level, neighborPos).isEmpty()) {
										lowerNeighbors++;
									}
								}
							}
						}

						if (lowerNeighbors >= 4 || (dx == 0 && dz == 0 && lowerNeighbors >= 3)) {
							level.destroyBlock(scanPos, false);
							sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.POOF, bx + 0.5, y + 0.5, bz + 0.5, 3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.05);
							playEngineSound(level, bx + 0.5, y + 0.5, bz + 0.5, "minecraft:block.stone.break", 0.8f, 0.7f);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void carveObstructingCanopy(ServerLevel level, Vec3 origin, double groundY, double r) {
		if (level.getGameTime() % 6 != 0) return;
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		int minY = Mth.floor(groundY), maxY = Mth.floor(origin.y);
		for (int s = 0; s < 6; s++) {
			double rad = Math.random() * r, ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
			pos.set(Mth.floor(origin.x + Math.cos(ang) * rad), minY + (int) (Math.random() * (maxY - minY + 1)), Mth.floor(origin.z + Math.sin(ang) * rad));
			if (level.hasChunkAt(pos)) {
				BlockState st = level.getBlockState(pos);
				if (st.is(BlockTags.LEAVES) || st.is(BlockTags.LOGS) || st.is(BlockTags.FLOWERS) || st.is(BlockTags.SAPLINGS)) {
					level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 2);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void spawnPreSlamOnionRings(ServerLevel level, Vec3 origin, double groundY, double beamR, double chargeProg, double ringTravel, double quality) {
		if (net.mcreator.thebackwoods.VerdantEngineGravityBeam.MASTER_ENABLED) return;
		double h = origin.y - groundY;
		if (h <= 0 || quality <= 0.01) return;

		double corePulse = (ringTravel * 2.0) % 1.0;
		double coreRingR = (beamR * 0.45) + corePulse * (beamR * 0.5);
		int coreCount = Math.max(3, (int) (2 * Math.PI * coreRingR * 1.0 * quality));
		for (int i = 0; i < coreCount; i++) {
			double a = (2 * Math.PI / coreCount) * i;
			double px = origin.x + Math.cos(a) * coreRingR;
			double pz = origin.z + Math.sin(a) * coreRingR;
		}

		int totalTiers = quality < 0.4 ? 2 : 3;
		double rotAngle = ringTravel * Math.PI * 4.0;
		for (int tier = 0; tier < totalTiers; tier++) {
			double phase = (ringTravel + (tier / (double) totalTiers)) % 1.0;
			double ringY = origin.y - phase * h;

			double oldInR = beamR + 0.35 + (1.0 - phase) * 1.2;
			double birthGrowth = Math.min(1.0, phase * 4.0);
			double smoothGrowth = Math.sin(birthGrowth * Math.PI * 0.5);

			double inR = (beamR * 0.4) + (oldInR - beamR * 0.4) * smoothGrowth;
			double outR = inR + (0.7 * smoothGrowth);

			int count = Math.max(4, (int) (2 * Math.PI * outR * 1.2 * quality));
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
				double a = (2 * Math.PI / count) * i + rotAngle;
				double c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a);
						if (chargeProg > 0.45 && i % 2 == 0) {
					double midR = (inR + outR) * 0.5;
					}
				if (i % 4 == 0) {
					sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.FLASH, origin.x + c * inR, ringY, origin.z + s * inR, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
				}
				if (i % 6 == 0) {
					sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.END_ROD, origin.x + c * outR, ringY, origin.z + s * outR, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0.02);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static boolean isSuspectedProjectile(Entity e) {
		return SUSPECTED_PROJECTILE_CLASSES.computeIfAbsent(e.getClass(), projectileClass -> {
			String n = projectileClass.getSimpleName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
			return n.contains("bullet") || n.contains("projectile") || n.contains("ammo");
		});
	}

	private static void handleGravityDistortionAndProjectiles(ServerLevel level, Entity engine, Vec3 core, double groundY, double gravR, int cycle, boolean isTerraforming) {
		double lockedY = engine != null ? persistentDouble(engine.getPersistentData(), "verdant_locked_y", core.y) : core.y;
		boolean isCeiled = isCeiledDimension(level);
		boolean isBedrockMode = isCeiled && isEpicenterBlockedCached(level, engine != null ? engine.getPersistentData() : null, core.x, groundY, core.z, lockedY);

		for (ServerPlayer sp : level.players()) {
			if (sp.isCreative() || sp.isSpectator()) continue;
			double pdx = sp.getX() - core.x;
			double pdz = sp.getZ() - core.z;
			double pDist = Math.sqrt(pdx * pdx + pdz * pdz);
			double maxShakeDist = isBedrockMode ? 84.0 : 48.0;
			if (pDist <= maxShakeDist && sp.getY() <= core.y + 40.0 && sp.getY() >= groundY - 10.0) {
				double force = (maxShakeDist - pDist) / maxShakeDist;
				float shakeStrength = (float) ((0.15 + force * 0.45) * (isBedrockMode ? 1.75F : 1.0F));
				sendCitadelCameraShakeAt(level, sp.getX(), sp.getY(), sp.getZ(), shakeStrength, 10, (float) maxShakeDist);
			}
		}

		if (level.getGameTime() % 20 == 0) {
			float beaconVol = isBedrockMode ? 4.5F : 1.5F;
			float beaconPitch = isBedrockMode ? 0.60F : 0.85F;
			playEngineSound(level, core.x, core.y, core.z, "block.beacon.ambient", beaconVol, beaconPitch);
			if (isBedrockMode) {
				playEngineSound(level, core.x, core.y, core.z, "block.beacon.activate", 3.5F, 0.50F);
				playEngineSound(level, core.x, core.y, core.z, "entity.warden.heartbeat", 3.0F, 0.40F);
			}
		}

		double dampeningPower = isTerraforming ? 1.0 : NON_TERRAFORMING_DAMPENING_MULTIPLIER;
		double defenseSphereR = 48.0 * dampeningPower;
		AABB defenseSphere = new AABB(core.x - defenseSphereR, core.y - defenseSphereR, core.z - defenseSphereR, core.x + defenseSphereR, core.y + defenseSphereR, core.z + defenseSphereR);
		int burstTicks = engine != null ? persistentInt(engine.getPersistentData(), "verdant_burst_spread_ticks", 0) : 0;
		float currentHealth = engine instanceof LivingEntity living ? living.getHealth() : 1000.0f;
		float maxHealth = engine instanceof LivingEntity living ? living.getMaxHealth() : 1000.0f;
		float healthRatio = Math.max(0.10f, Math.min(1.0f, currentHealth / Math.max(1.0f, maxHealth)));
		double queryR = Math.max(defenseSphereR, Math.max(gravR, 48.0));
		AABB livingBox = new AABB(core.x - queryR, groundY + ZERO_G_LIFT_VERTICAL_MIN, core.z - queryR, core.x + queryR, core.y + ZERO_G_LIFT_VERTICAL_MAX, core.z + queryR);
		AABB combinedFieldQuery = new AABB(
			Math.min(defenseSphere.minX, livingBox.minX), Math.min(defenseSphere.minY, livingBox.minY), Math.min(defenseSphere.minZ, livingBox.minZ),
			Math.max(defenseSphere.maxX, livingBox.maxX), Math.max(defenseSphere.maxY, livingBox.maxY), Math.max(defenseSphere.maxZ, livingBox.maxZ)).inflate(4.0);
		List<Entity> nearbyFieldEntities = getCachedGravityFieldEntities(level, engine, combinedFieldQuery);

		for (Entity ent : nearbyFieldEntities) {
			if (persistentBoolean(ent.getPersistentData(), "backwoods_verdant_real_block", false)) continue;
			if (!defenseSphere.intersects(ent.getBoundingBox()) || (!isSuspectedProjectile(ent) && !(ent instanceof Projectile))) continue;
			if (ent.isAlive() && ent != engine) {
				double dist = ent.position().distanceTo(core);
				if (dist <= defenseSphereR) {
					double baseDrag;
					if (dist <= 12.0) {
						double t = dist / 12.0;
						baseDrag = 0.05 + t * 0.13;
						if (healthRatio > 0.40f) {
							ent.setNoGravity(true);
						}
					} else if (dist <= 24.0) {
						double t = (dist - 12.0) / 12.0;
						baseDrag = 0.18 + t * 0.32;
					} else {
						double t = (dist - 24.0) / 24.0;
						baseDrag = 0.50 + t * 0.35;
					}

					double drag = Mth.lerp(1.0 - healthRatio, baseDrag, Math.min(0.88, baseDrag * 1.5 + 0.35 * (1.0 - healthRatio)));
					if (!isTerraforming) {
						drag = 1.0 - (1.0 - drag) * dampeningPower;
					}
					if (burstTicks > 0) {
						drag *= 0.10;
					}
					if (engine != null && persistentBoolean(engine.getPersistentData(), "verdant_supercharged_mode", false)) {
						drag *= SUPERCHARGED_DAMPENING_HORIZONTAL;
					}
					Vec3 vel = ent.getDeltaMovement();
					double currentSpeed = vel.length();
					double maxAllowedSpeed = Math.max(0.08 / Math.max(0.25, healthRatio), (dist * 0.04) / Math.max(0.20, healthRatio)) / dampeningPower;
					if (currentSpeed > maxAllowedSpeed) {
						vel = vel.scale(maxAllowedSpeed / currentSpeed);
					}

					double vx = vel.x * drag;
					double vy = vel.y * drag;
					double vz = vel.z * drag;

					if (dist > 7.0 && dist <= 36.0 && (Math.abs(vel.x) + Math.abs(vel.z) > 0.05)) {
						Vec3 toCenter = core.subtract(ent.position()).normalize();
						Vec3 tangent = new Vec3(-toCenter.z, 0.0, toCenter.x);
						double nudgeStrength = (1.0 - (dist / 36.0)) * 0.08 * healthRatio * dampeningPower;
						vx += tangent.x * nudgeStrength;
						vz += tangent.z * nudgeStrength;
					}

					ent.setDeltaMovement(vx, vy, vz);
					ent.hasImpulse = true;
				}
			}
		}

		for (Entity victim : nearbyFieldEntities) {
			if (!livingBox.intersects(victim.getBoundingBox())) continue;
			if (victim instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) {
				try {
					var gravAttr = p.getAttribute(Attributes.GRAVITY);
					if (gravAttr != null) {
						gravAttr.removeModifier(VERDANT_BEAM_GRAV_MOD_ID);
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
				GRAVITY_MODIFIED_ENTITIES.remove(p.getUUID());
				if (victim.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_lifted_by_zero_g") || victim.isNoGravity()) {
					victim.setNoGravity(false);
					victim.getPersistentData().remove("verdant_lifted_by_zero_g");
					victim.getPersistentData().remove("verdant_last_lift_tick");
				}
				continue;
			}
			if (isWoodbound(victim) || isVerdantEngine(victim)
					|| persistentBoolean(victim.getPersistentData(), "backwoods_verdant_real_block", false)) continue;

			int slammed = victim.getPersistentData().getInt("verdant_slammed_ticks");
			if (slammed > 0) {
				victim.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_slammed_ticks", slammed - 1);
				victim.setNoGravity(false);
				if (victim instanceof Player p) {
					p.stopFallFlying();
				}
				if (!victim.onGround()) {
					victim.setDeltaMovement(victim.getDeltaMovement().x * 0.25, Math.min(-3.8, victim.getDeltaMovement().y - 0.65), victim.getDeltaMovement().z * 0.25);
					victim.hasImpulse = true;
					victim.hurtMarked = true;
					if (victim instanceof ServerPlayer sp) sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
				} else {
					victim.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_slammed_ticks", 0);
					if (victim instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						applyTruePoundDamage(level, living, engine, GRAVITY_SLAM_IMPACT_DAMAGE);
						living.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 80, 2, false, false, true));
					} else if (victim instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.item.ItemEntity itemEnt) {
						damageItemEntitySeverely(level, itemEnt, GRAVITY_SLAM_IMPACT_DAMAGE);
					} else {
						DamageSource dmg = getVerdantDamage(level, engine);
						victim.hurt(dmg, GRAVITY_SLAM_IMPACT_DAMAGE);
					}
					playEngineSound(level, victim.getX(), victim.getY(), victim.getZ(), "item.mace.smash_ground_heavy", 1.4F, 0.6F);
				}
				continue;
			}

			double distToCore = victim.position().distanceTo(core);

			if (victim instanceof LivingEntity living) {
				if (distToCore <= defenseSphereR && living.isAutoSpinAttack()) {
					double riptideDrag = 1.0 - (1.0 - 0.15) * dampeningPower;
					living.setDeltaMovement(living.getDeltaMovement().scale(riptideDrag));
					living.hasImpulse = true;
					living.hurtMarked = true;
					playEngineSound(level, living.getX(), living.getY(), living.getZ(), "item.trident.riptide_1", 1.2F, 0.4F);
					playEngineSound(level, living.getX(), living.getY(), living.getZ(), "entity.generic.extinguish_fire", 1.0F, 0.6F);
				}

				if (distToCore <= 8.0) {
					int air = living.getAirSupply();
					if (air > -20) {
						living.setAirSupply(Math.max(-20, air - 6));
						if (air <= 0 && living.tickCount % 20 == 0) {
							applyTruePoundDamage(level, living, engine, CORE_ASPHYXIATION_DAMAGE);
							playEngineSound(level, living.getX(), living.getY(), living.getZ(), "entity.player.hurt_drown", 0.9F, 1.0F);
						}
					}
				}

				if (distToCore <= defenseSphereR && living.isFallFlying()) {
					if (living instanceof Player p) {
						p.stopFallFlying();
					}
					net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack chestItem = living.getItemBySlot(net.minecraft.world.entity.EquipmentSlot.CHEST);
					if (!chestItem.isEmpty() && (chestItem.is(net.minecraft.world.item.Items.ELYTRA) || chestItem.getItem().getDescriptionId().contains("elytra"))) {
						int elytraDmg = 25;
						if (living instanceof ServerPlayer sp) {
							chestItem.hurtAndBreak(elytraDmg, level, sp, item -> {});
						} else {
							chestItem.hurtAndBreak(elytraDmg, level, null, item -> {});
						}
						playEngineSound(level, living.getX(), living.getY(), living.getZ(), "entity.item.break", 1.2F, 0.85F);
					}
					AABB fireworkBox = living.getBoundingBox().inflate(4.0);
					for (Entity pr : nearbyFieldEntities) {
						if (!(pr instanceof Projectile) || !pr.getClass().getSimpleName().toLowerCase().contains("firework") || !fireworkBox.intersects(pr.getBoundingBox())) continue;
						pr.discard();
						playEngineSound(level, pr.getX(), pr.getY(), pr.getZ(), "entity.firework_rocket.blast", 1.2F, 0.6F);
					}
					Vec3 m = living.getDeltaMovement();
					double incomingSpeed = m.length();
					double downSlam = Math.min(-2.6, -1.3 - (incomingSpeed * 1.5));
					living.setDeltaMovement(m.x * 0.08, downSlam, m.z * 0.08);
					living.hasImpulse = true;
					living.hurtMarked = true;
					living.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_slammed_ticks", 35);
					playEngineSound(level, living.getX(), living.getY(), living.getZ(), "entity.warden.sonic_boom", 1.4F, 0.55F);
					playEngineSound(level, living.getX(), living.getY(), living.getZ(), "entity.wind_charge.wind_burst", 1.6F, 0.4F);
					if (living instanceof ServerPlayer sp) {
						sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
					}
					continue;
				}
			}

			double dx = core.x - victim.getX();
			double dz = core.z - victim.getZ();
			double horizDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);

			if (horizDist <= (BEAM_RADIUS + 0.35) && victim.getY() <= core.y + 1.0 && victim.getY() >= groundY - 16.0) {
				victim.setNoGravity(false);
				if (victim instanceof Player p) {
					p.stopFallFlying();
				}
				Vec3 curVel = victim.getDeltaMovement();
				double downwardForce = Math.min(-1.6, curVel.y - 0.55);
				victim.setDeltaMovement(curVel.x * 0.45, downwardForce, curVel.z * 0.45);
				victim.hasImpulse = true;
				victim.hurtMarked = true;
				if (victim instanceof ServerPlayer sp) {
					sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
				}

				double chargeRatio = (double) Math.min(cycle, CYCLE_TOTAL_TICKS) / (double) CYCLE_TOTAL_TICKS;
				int damageInterval = Math.max(2, (int) Math.round(15.0 - (chargeRatio * 13.0)));
				if (isBedrockMode) {
					damageInterval = Math.max(2, damageInterval - 2);
				}

				if (level.getGameTime() % damageInterval == 0) {
					if (victim instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						float dmgAmount = 4.0F + (float) (chargeRatio * 12.0F);
						if (isBedrockMode) {
							dmgAmount *= 2.2F;
						}
						applyTrueGravityForceDamage(level, living, engine, dmgAmount);
						playEngineSound(level, victim.getX(), victim.getY(), victim.getZ(), "entity.warden.heartbeat", 0.9F, 0.7F);
					}
				}
			}

			boolean inZeroGLift = (cycle >= RINGS_START_TICK && cycle < CYCLE_TOTAL_TICKS);
			double effectRadius = GRAVITY_BEAM_EFFECT_RADIUS;
			double maxBonus = getGravityBeamMaxModifier(engine != null ? engine.getPersistentData() : null);

			if (victim instanceof LivingEntity living) {
				if (horizDist <= effectRadius && victim.getY() <= core.y + ZERO_G_LIFT_MAX_Y_CAP && victim.getY() >= groundY + ZERO_G_LIFT_VERTICAL_MIN) {
					double proximityFactor = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, 1.0 - (horizDist / effectRadius)));
					double gravityAdd = proximityFactor * maxBonus;
					try {
						var gravAttr = living.getAttribute(Attributes.GRAVITY);
						if (gravAttr != null) {
							gravAttr.removeModifier(VERDANT_BEAM_GRAV_MOD_ID);
							if (gravityAdd > 0.005) {
								gravAttr.addTransientModifier(new AttributeModifier(VERDANT_BEAM_GRAV_MOD_ID, gravityAdd, AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE));
								GRAVITY_MODIFIED_ENTITIES.put(living.getUUID(), level.getGameTime());
							}
						}
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
				} else {
					try {
						var gravAttr = living.getAttribute(Attributes.GRAVITY);
						if (gravAttr != null) {
							gravAttr.removeModifier(VERDANT_BEAM_GRAV_MOD_ID);
						}
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
					GRAVITY_MODIFIED_ENTITIES.remove(living.getUUID());
				}
			}

			if (inZeroGLift && horizDist <= Math.max(gravR, 24.0) && victim.getY() <= core.y + ZERO_G_LIFT_MAX_Y_CAP) {
				victim.setNoGravity(true);
				victim.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_lifted_by_zero_g", true);
				victim.getPersistentData().putLong("verdant_last_lift_tick", level.getGameTime());
				victim.fallDistance = 0.0F;
				victim.setOnGround(false);

				double chargeProg = (double) (cycle - RINGS_START_TICK) / (CYCLE_TOTAL_TICKS - RINGS_START_TICK);
				double baseLift = 0.12;
				double accel = Math.pow(chargeProg, 1.6) * 0.95;
				double liftSpeed = (baseLift + accel) * (engine != null && persistentBoolean(engine.getPersistentData(), "verdant_supercharged_mode", false) ? SUPERCHARGED_ZERO_G_LIFT_SPEED_MULTIPLIER : 1.0);

				if (victim.getY() >= core.y - 2.0) {
					liftSpeed = Math.max(0.04, (core.y - victim.getY()) * 0.18);
				}

				Vec3 m = victim.getDeltaMovement();
				double driftX = m.x * 0.88 + Math.cos((level.getGameTime() + victim.getId() * 5) * 0.08) * 0.015;
				double driftZ = m.z * 0.88 + Math.sin((level.getGameTime() + victim.getId() * 5) * 0.08) * 0.015;

				victim.setDeltaMovement(driftX, liftSpeed, driftZ);
				victim.hasImpulse = true;
				victim.hurtMarked = true;
				if (victim instanceof ServerPlayer sp) {
					sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
				}
			} else {
				if (victim.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_lifted_by_zero_g")) {
					victim.setNoGravity(false);
					victim.getPersistentData().remove("verdant_lifted_by_zero_g");
					victim.getPersistentData().remove("verdant_last_lift_tick");
				} else if (victim.isNoGravity() && slammed <= 0) {
					victim.setNoGravity(false);
				}
				if (distToCore <= 48.0) {
					if (distToCore <= 16.0 && !inZeroGLift) {
						Vec3 delta = victim.position().subtract(core);
						double push = (16.0 - distToCore) / 16.0;
						Vec3 pushVec = new Vec3(delta.x, delta.y * 0.25, delta.z).normalize().scale(push * 0.16 * dampeningPower);
						victim.push(pushVec.x, pushVec.y, pushVec.z);
					}
					double drag = distToCore <= 12.0 ? 0.30 : (distToCore <= 24.0 ? 0.48 : (distToCore <= 36.0 ? 0.65 : 0.78));
					drag = 1.0 - (1.0 - drag) * dampeningPower;
					Vec3 m = victim.getDeltaMovement();
					double yMotion = m.y;
					if (burstTicks > 0) {
						drag *= 0.08;
						yMotion = Math.min(yMotion, yMotion * 0.08);
					} else if (engine != null && persistentBoolean(engine.getPersistentData(), "verdant_supercharged_mode", false)) {
						drag *= SUPERCHARGED_DAMPENING_HORIZONTAL;
						if (yMotion < 0 && !inZeroGLift) {
							yMotion = Math.min(yMotion, SUPERCHARGED_DAMPENING_VERTICAL);
						}
					} else if (yMotion < 0 && !inZeroGLift) {
						yMotion *= drag;
					} else if (yMotion > 0 && !inZeroGLift && distToCore <= 24.0) {
						yMotion *= 1.0 - (1.0 - 0.50) * dampeningPower;
					}
					victim.setDeltaMovement(m.x * drag, yMotion, m.z * drag);
					victim.hasImpulse = true;
					if (victim instanceof ServerPlayer sp) {
						sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		long now = level.getGameTime();
		TerraformWorkCoordinator coordinator = getTerraformCoordinator(level);
		if (coordinator.lastGravityCleanupTick != now) {
			coordinator.lastGravityCleanupTick = now;
			for (java.util.Map.Entry<UUID, Long> entry : GRAVITY_MODIFIED_ENTITIES.entrySet()) {
				if (entry.getValue() < now) {
					Entity tracked = level.getEntity(entry.getKey());
					if (tracked instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						try {
							var attr = living.getAttribute(Attributes.GRAVITY);
							if (attr != null) attr.removeModifier(VERDANT_BEAM_GRAV_MOD_ID);
						} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
					}
					GRAVITY_MODIFIED_ENTITIES.remove(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static DamageSource getVerdantGravityForceDamage(ServerLevel level, Entity engine) {
		ResourceKey<DamageType> key = ResourceKey.create(Registries.DAMAGE_TYPE, ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:verdant_engine_gravity_force_damage"));
		return new DamageSource(level.registryAccess().registryOrThrow(Registries.DAMAGE_TYPE).getHolderOrThrow(key), engine);
	}

	public static void applyTrueGravityForceDamage(ServerLevel level, LivingEntity victim, Entity engine, float rawDamage) {
		if (victim == null || !victim.isAlive()) return;
		if (isVerdantEngine(victim)) return;
		if (victim instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) return;
		if (isWoodbound(victim)) return;

		victim.invulnerableTime = 0;
		DamageSource dmg = getVerdantGravityForceDamage(level, engine != null ? engine : victim);
		float initialHp = victim.getHealth();
		try {
			victim.hurt(dmg, rawDamage);
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {}

		if (victim.getHealth() >= initialHp && victim.isAlive()) {
			float calculatedDmg = calculateDamageAfterArmorAndEffects(victim, rawDamage);
			float absorption = victim.getAbsorptionAmount();
			if (absorption > 0.0F) {
				if (absorption >= calculatedDmg) {
					victim.setAbsorptionAmount(absorption - calculatedDmg);
					calculatedDmg = 0.0F;
				} else {
					victim.setAbsorptionAmount(0.0F);
					calculatedDmg -= absorption;
				}
			}
			if (calculatedDmg > 0.0F) {
				victim.setHealth(Math.max(0.0F, victim.getHealth() - calculatedDmg));
				if (victim.getHealth() <= 0.0F) {
					victim.die(dmg);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static DamageSource getVerdantDamage(ServerLevel level, Entity engine) {
		ResourceKey<DamageType> key = ResourceKey.create(Registries.DAMAGE_TYPE, ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:verdant_engine_gravity_beam_damage"));
		return new DamageSource(level.registryAccess().registryOrThrow(Registries.DAMAGE_TYPE).getHolderOrThrow(key), engine);
	}

	public static float calculateDamageAfterArmorAndEffects(LivingEntity victim, float rawDamage) {
		float armor = (float) victim.getArmorValue();
		float toughness = (float) victim.getAttributeValue(Attributes.ARMOR_TOUGHNESS);
		float f = 2.0F + toughness / 4.0F;
		float f1 = Mth.clamp(armor - rawDamage / f, armor * 0.2F, 20.0F);
		float dmg = rawDamage * (1.0F - f1 / 25.0F);

		if (victim.hasEffect(MobEffects.DAMAGE_RESISTANCE)) {
			int amplifier = victim.getEffect(MobEffects.DAMAGE_RESISTANCE).getAmplifier() + 1;
			dmg = Math.max(0.0F, dmg * (1.0F - (amplifier * 0.20F)));
		}
		return Math.max(0.0F, dmg);
	}

		private static void damageItemEntitySeverely(ServerLevel level, net.minecraft.world.entity.item.ItemEntity itemEnt, float rawDamage) {
		if (itemEnt == null || !itemEnt.isAlive()) return;
		net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack = itemEnt.getItem();
		if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty()) {
			itemEnt.discard();
			return;
		}
		if (stack.isDamageableItem()) {
			int maxDmg = stack.getMaxDamage();
			int curDmg = stack.getDamageValue();
			int addedDmg = Math.max(1, (int) (maxDmg * 0.03F + rawDamage * 0.15F));
			int totalDmg = curDmg + addedDmg;
			if (totalDmg >= maxDmg) {
				level.playSound(null, itemEnt.getX(), itemEnt.getY(), itemEnt.getZ(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.ITEM_BREAK, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.AMBIENT, 1.0F, 0.9F + level.random.nextFloat() * 0.2F);
				try {
					level.sendParticles(new net.minecraft.core.particles.ItemParticleOption(net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.ITEM, stack), itemEnt.getX(), itemEnt.getY() + 0.2, itemEnt.getZ(), 15, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.1);
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
				stack.shrink(1);
				if (stack.isEmpty()) {
					itemEnt.discard();
				} else {
					stack.setDamageValue(0);
					itemEnt.setItem(stack);
				}
			} else {
				stack.setDamageValue(totalDmg);
				itemEnt.setItem(stack);

			}
		} else {
			level.playSound(null, itemEnt.getX(), itemEnt.getY(), itemEnt.getZ(), net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.ITEM_BREAK, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource.AMBIENT, 0.6F, 1.2F + level.random.nextFloat() * 0.2F);
			try {
				level.sendParticles(new net.minecraft.core.particles.ItemParticleOption(net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.ITEM, stack), itemEnt.getX(), itemEnt.getY() + 0.2, itemEnt.getZ(), 8, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.05);
			} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			stack.shrink(1);
			if (stack.isEmpty()) {
				itemEnt.discard();
			} else {
				itemEnt.setItem(stack);
			}
		}
	}
	public static void applyTruePoundDamage(ServerLevel level, LivingEntity victim, Entity engine, float rawDamage) {
		if (victim == null || !victim.isAlive()) return;
		if (isVerdantEngine(victim)) return;
		if (victim instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) return;
		if (isWoodbound(victim)) return;

		victim.invulnerableTime = 0;

		DamageSource dmg = getVerdantDamage(level, engine != null ? engine : victim);

		float initialHp = victim.getHealth();
		try {
			victim.hurt(dmg, rawDamage);
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {}

		if (victim.getHealth() >= initialHp && victim.isAlive()) {
			float calculatedDmg = calculateDamageAfterArmorAndEffects(victim, rawDamage);
			float absorption = victim.getAbsorptionAmount();
			if (absorption > 0.0F) {
				if (absorption >= calculatedDmg) {
					victim.setAbsorptionAmount(absorption - calculatedDmg);
					calculatedDmg = 0.0F;
				} else {
					victim.setAbsorptionAmount(0.0F);
					calculatedDmg -= absorption;
				}
			}

			if (calculatedDmg > 0.0F) {
				victim.setHealth(Math.max(0.0F, victim.getHealth() - calculatedDmg));
				if (victim.getHealth() <= 0.0F) {
					victim.die(dmg);
				}
			}
			victim.hurtMarked = true;
		}

		victim.invulnerableTime = 0;
	}

	private static void queueSuperchargedCraterWork(Entity engine, double ix, double gy, double iz, double radius, int poundCount, double penetrationSpeed) {
		if (engine == null || radius <= 0.0) return;
		SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_WORK.computeIfAbsent(engine.getUUID(), ignored -> new java.util.ArrayDeque<>())
			.addLast(new SuperchargedCraterWork(ix, gy, iz, radius, poundCount, penetrationSpeed));
	}

	private static void processPendingSuperchargedCraterWork(ServerLevel level, Entity engine) {
		if (level == null || engine == null) return;
		java.util.ArrayDeque<SuperchargedCraterWork> queue = SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_WORK.get(engine.getUUID());
		if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) return;
		long deadline = System.nanoTime() + SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_TIME_BUDGET_NANOS;
		int processedColumns = 0;
		CompoundTag engineNbt = engine.getPersistentData();
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		while (processedColumns < SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_COLUMNS_PER_TICK && System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
			SuperchargedCraterWork work = queue.peekFirst();
			if (work == null) break;
			if (work.cursor >= work.totalCandidates) {
				queue.removeFirst();
				continue;
			}
			int candidateIndex = work.cursor++;
			int angleIndex = candidateIndex / work.radialSteps;
			int distanceIndex = candidateIndex % work.radialSteps;
			double angle = (2.0 * Math.PI / 64.0) * angleIndex;
			double distance = distanceIndex * 1.2;
			int blockX = Mth.floor(work.centerX + fastCos(angle) * distance);
			int blockZ = Mth.floor(work.centerZ + fastSin(angle) * distance);
			long columnKey = (((long) blockX) << 32) | (blockZ & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
			if (!work.visitedColumns.add(columnKey)) continue;
			processedColumns++;

			LevelChunk chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(blockX >> 4, blockZ >> 4);
			if (chunk == null) continue;
			double normalizedDistance = distance / Math.max(1.0, work.radius);
			int carveDown = (int) Math.round((1.0 - normalizedDistance * SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_DEPTH_FALLOFF)
				* (SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_BASE_DEPTH + Math.min(SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_MAX_DEPTH_CAP, work.poundCount * SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_DEPTH_PER_POUND)) * work.penetrationSpeed);
			int groundBlockY = Mth.floor(work.groundY);
			for (int offsetY = 2; offsetY >= -carveDown; offsetY--) {
				pos.set(blockX, groundBlockY + offsetY, blockZ);
				if (pos.getY() < level.getMinBuildHeight() || pos.getY() >= level.getMaxBuildHeight()) continue;
				BlockState state = chunk.getBlockState(pos);
				Block block = state.getBlock();
				boolean indestructible = block == Blocks.BEDROCK || isIndestructibleBlock(state, level, pos);
				if (indestructible) recordMaterialEncounter(engineNbt, block);
				boolean shatter = shouldShatterBedrock(engineNbt, distance, work.poundCount, block);
				if (indestructible) {
					if (shatter) level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
					continue;
				}
				if (!state.getFluidState().isEmpty() || block == Blocks.WATER || block == Blocks.LAVA) {
					replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, pos, state, false);
					continue;
				}
				if (offsetY > -carveDown) {
					if (!state.isAir()) level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
				} else {
					replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, pos, state, false);
				}
			}
		}
		if (queue.isEmpty()) SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_WORK.remove(engine.getUUID(), queue);
	}

	private static void triggerPlanetaryPound(ServerLevel level, Entity engine, double ix, double gy, double iz, double poundR, int poundCount, boolean terraform) {
		CompoundTag nbt = engine != null ? engine.getPersistentData() : null;
		double lockedY = engine.getPersistentData().getDouble("verdant_locked_y");
		if (lockedY <= 0) lockedY = gy + getHoverTargetAltitude(nbt);

		boolean isBedrockMode = isCeiledDimension(level) && isEpicenterBlockedCached(level, nbt, ix, gy, iz, lockedY);

		float soundVol = isBedrockMode ? 16.0F : 12.0F;
		float soundPitch = isBedrockMode ? 0.005F : 0.01F;

		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.warden.sonic_boom", soundVol, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.generic.explode", soundVol, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "item.mace.smash_ground_heavy", soundVol, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.elder_guardian.curse", soundVol * 0.9F, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.wither.spawn", soundVol * 0.85F, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.lightning_bolt.impact", soundVol * 0.8F, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.iron_golem.attack", soundVol * 0.75F, soundPitch);
		playEngineSound(level, ix, gy, iz, "entity.wither.break_block", soundVol * 0.7F, soundPitch);

		boolean isSuperchargedPound = persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_supercharged_mode", false);
		float shakeStrength = (8.5F + (poundCount * 1.2F)) * (isBedrockMode ? 1.75F : 1.0F) * (isSuperchargedPound ? SUPERCHARGED_SCREENSHAKE_MULTIPLIER : 1.0F);
		float shakeDist = (isBedrockMode ? 84.0F : (isSuperchargedPound ? SUPERCHARGED_SCREENSHAKE_DISTANCE : 48.0F));
		int shakeDuration = (int) ((65 + (poundCount * 8)) * (isBedrockMode ? 1.35F : 1.0F));

		sendCitadelCameraShakeAt(level, ix, gy, iz, shakeStrength, shakeDuration, shakeDist);

		sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, ix, gy + 0.5, iz, 4, 1.0, 0.3, 1.0, 0);
		sendFarParticles(level, ParticleTypes.FLASH, ix, gy + 0.5, iz, 2, 0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 0);

		double maxY = lockedY + 32.0;
		AABB poundArea = new AABB(ix - poundR, gy - 12.0, iz - poundR, ix + poundR, maxY, iz + poundR);
		List<Entity> poundEntities = level.getEntitiesOfClass(Entity.class, poundArea, e -> e != engine && e.isAlive());
		for (Entity p : poundEntities) {
			if (persistentBoolean(p.getPersistentData(), "backwoods_verdant_real_block", false)) continue;
			if (!(p instanceof Projectile) && !isSuspectedProjectile(p)) continue;
			if (p.isAlive() && p != engine) {
				p.setNoGravity(false);
				p.setDeltaMovement(p.getDeltaMovement().x * 0.05, -12.0, p.getDeltaMovement().z * 0.05);
				p.hasImpulse = true;
			}
		}

		float slamDmg = PLANETARY_POUND_BASE_DAMAGE + (poundCount * PLANETARY_POUND_PER_POUND_DAMAGE);
		net.mcreator.thebackwoods.BackwoodsImpactDebris.verdantPound(engine, new Vec3(ix, gy, iz), BEAM_RADIUS, slamDmg);

		java.util.List<Long> hitIds = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
		for (Entity victim : poundEntities) {
			if (victim instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) continue;
			if (isWoodbound(victim) || isVerdantEngine(victim)
					|| persistentBoolean(victim.getPersistentData(), "backwoods_verdant_real_block", false)) continue;

			victim.setNoGravity(false);
			victim.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_slammed_ticks", 50);
			victim.setDeltaMovement(victim.getDeltaMovement().x * 0.02, -12.0, victim.getDeltaMovement().z * 0.02);
			victim.hurtMarked = true;
			victim.hasImpulse = true;
			victim.fallDistance += 16.0F;
			if (victim instanceof LivingEntity living) {
				applyTruePoundDamage(level, living, engine, slamDmg);
				living.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 200, 4, false, false, true));
				living.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.WEAKNESS, 200, 2, false, false, true));
				if (living instanceof ServerPlayer sp) sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
			} else if (victim instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.item.ItemEntity itemEnt) {
				damageItemEntitySeverely(level, itemEnt, slamDmg);
			}

			hitIds.add((long) victim.getId());
		}

		if (nbt == null) nbt = engine.getPersistentData();
		nbt.putInt("verdant_pound_burst_ticks", 20);

		BlockPos impactHeadPos = BlockPos.containing(ix, gy + 2.0, iz);
		if (level.hasChunkAt(impactHeadPos) && !level.getBlockState(impactHeadPos).isAir() && level.getBlockState(impactHeadPos).isRedstoneConductor(level, impactHeadPos)) {
			nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_stage", 0);
		} else {
			nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_stage", 1.0);
		}

		nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_ox", ix);
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_oy", gy);
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_oz", iz);
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_max_r", Math.min(getShockwaveParticleRadius(nbt), poundR));
		nbt.putFloat("verdant_shockwave_dmg", slamDmg);

		long[] hitIdArray = new long[hitIds.size()];
		for (int i = 0; i < hitIds.size(); i++) {
			hitIdArray[i] = hitIds.get(i);
		}
		nbt.putLongArray("verdant_shockwave_hit_ids", hitIdArray);

		double curDepth = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_crater_depth", 0.0);
		double penSpeed = getGravityBeamPenetrationSpeed(nbt);
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_crater_depth", Math.min(128.0, curDepth + (1.8 + (poundCount * 0.3)) * penSpeed));

		if (terraform) {
			double maxCarveCap = isSuperchargedPound ? SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_MAX_RADIUS_CAP : 64.0;
			double burstCarveRadius = Math.min(maxCarveCap, Math.min(poundR * 0.95, (isSuperchargedPound ? SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_BASE_RADIUS : 12.0) + (poundCount * (isSuperchargedPound ? SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_RADIUS_PER_POUND : 4.5))));
			if (isSuperchargedPound) {
				queueSuperchargedCraterWork(engine, ix, gy, iz, burstCarveRadius, poundCount, penSpeed);
			} else {
			BlockPos.MutableBlockPos cPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
			java.util.Set<Long> visitedCarveCols = new java.util.HashSet<>();
			for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
				double a = (2 * Math.PI / 64) * i;
				for (double dist = 0.0; dist <= burstCarveRadius; dist += 1.2) {
					int bx = Mth.floor(ix + Math.cos(a) * dist);
					int bz = Mth.floor(iz + Math.sin(a) * dist);
					long colKey = (((long) bx) << 32) | (bz & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
					if (!visitedCarveCols.add(colKey)) continue;
					double dNorm = dist / Math.max(1.0, burstCarveRadius);
					int carveDown = (int) Math.round((1.0 - dNorm * (isSuperchargedPound ? 0.55 : 0.60)) * ((isSuperchargedPound ? 7.0 : 3.5) + Math.min(isSuperchargedPound ? 64.0 : 32.0, poundCount * (isSuperchargedPound ? 3.0 : 1.5))) * penSpeed);
					for (int dy = 2; dy >= -carveDown; dy--) {
						cPos.set(bx, Mth.floor(gy + dy), bz);
						if (!level.hasChunkAt(cPos)) continue;
						BlockState st = level.getBlockState(cPos);
						boolean isCurBedrock = st.getBlock() == Blocks.BEDROCK;
						boolean isCurIndestructible = isCurBedrock || isIndestructibleBlock(st, level, cPos);
						if (isCurIndestructible) {
							recordMaterialEncounter(nbt, st.getBlock());
						}
						boolean shatterBedrock = shouldShatterBedrock(nbt, dist, poundCount, st.getBlock());

						if (isCurIndestructible) {
							if (shatterBedrock) {
								level.setBlock(cPos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
							}
							continue;
						}

						if (!st.getFluidState().isEmpty() || st.getBlock() == Blocks.WATER || st.getBlock() == Blocks.LAVA) {
							replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, cPos, st, false);
							continue;
						}
						if (dy > -carveDown) {
							if (!st.isAir()) {
								level.setBlock(cPos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
							}
						} else {
							replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, cPos, st, false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			}
		}

		if (terraform) {
			boolean hasCeiling = isCeiledDimension(level);
			boolean epicenterBlocked = hasCeiling && isEpicenterBlockedCached(level, nbt, ix, gy, iz, lockedY);

			if (!epicenterBlocked) {
				nbt.putDouble("verdant_burst_target_radius", Math.min(getMaxInfectionRadius(nbt), persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_infection_radius", BEAM_RADIUS + 0.5) + 32.0 + (poundCount * 14.0)));
				nbt.putInt("verdant_burst_spread_ticks", 40);
				nbt.putInt("verdant_pound_burst_ticks", 40);
			}
		}
	}

	private static void handleActiveShockwaves(ServerLevel level, CompoundTag nbt) {
		double stage = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_stage", 0.0);
		if (stage <= 0.0) return;

		long gameTime = level.getGameTime();
		if (persistentLong(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_last_tick", -1L) == gameTime) return;
		nbt.putLong("verdant_shockwave_last_tick", gameTime);

		double ox = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_ox", 0.0);
		double oy = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_oy", 0.0);
		double oz = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_oz", 0.0);

		if (!isPlayerInParticleRange3D(level, ox, oy, oz, 128.0 * 128.0)) {
			clearActiveShockwave(nbt);
			return;
		}

		double maxR = Math.min(getShockwaveParticleRadius(nbt), persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_max_r", 48.0));
		int pounds = persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_pound_count", 0);
		double expandSpeed = 2.0 + (pounds * 0.35);
		double radius = BEAM_RADIUS + (stage * expandSpeed);

		if (radius >= maxR || stage > 50.0) {
			clearActiveShockwave(nbt);
			return;
		}

		double quality = getShockwaveParticleQuality(nbt);
		if (quality > 0.0) {
			int count = Math.min(48, Math.max((int) (10 * quality), (int) (2.0 * Math.PI * radius * 0.45 * quality)));

			int lastChunkX = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
			int lastChunkZ = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
			LevelChunk chunk = null;

			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
				double a = (2.0 * Math.PI / count) * i;

				double wave1 = fastSin(a * 5.0 + stage * 0.3) * 0.85;
				double wave2 = fastCos(a * 11.0 - stage * 0.2) * 0.55;
				double organicRadialOffset = wave1 + wave2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;

				double effRadius = Math.max(0.5, radius + organicRadialOffset);
				double c = Math.cos(a);
				double s = Math.sin(a);

				double px = ox + c * effRadius + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
				double pz = oz + s * effRadius + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
				int ipx = Mth.floor(px);
				int ipz = Mth.floor(pz);
				int cx = ipx >> 4;
				int cz = ipz >> 4;

				if (cx != lastChunkX || cz != lastChunkZ) {
					lastChunkX = cx;
					lastChunkZ = cz;
					chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(cx, cz);
				}
				if (chunk == null) continue;

				int groundY = chunk.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING, ipx & 15, ipz & 15);
				if (groundY < level.getMinBuildHeight() + 1 || Math.abs(groundY - oy) > 24.0) continue;

				double surfaceY = groundY + 1.5;

				double outwardSpeed = 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.14;
				double upwardSpeed = 0.03 + Math.random() * 0.05;

				sendFarParticles(level, getBigSmokeParticle(), px, surfaceY, pz, 1, c * outwardSpeed, upwardSpeed, s * outwardSpeed, 0.03);

				if (i % 3 == 0) {
					double curlRadius = Math.max(0.5, effRadius - 0.4 - Math.random() * 0.5);
					double curlY = surfaceY + 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6;
					double inwardRollSpeed = 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.06;
					double upwardRollSpeed = 0.10 + Math.random() * 0.08;
					sendFarParticles(level, getBigSmokeParticle(), ox + c * curlRadius, curlY, oz + s * curlRadius, 1, -c * inwardRollSpeed, upwardRollSpeed, -s * inwardRollSpeed, 0.02);
				}
			}
		}

		float slamDmg = persistentFloat(nbt, "verdant_shockwave_dmg", 195.0F);
		double innerR = Math.max(0.0, radius - expandSpeed - 2.0);
		double outerR = radius + expandSpeed + 2.0;
		double innerRSq = innerR * innerR;
		double outerRSq = outerR * outerR;
		double maxRSq = maxR * maxR;
		AABB waveBox = new AABB(ox - outerR, oy - 12.0, oz - outerR, ox + outerR, oy + 35.0, oz + outerR);

		long[] hitIds = nbt.contains("verdant_shockwave_hit_ids") ? nbt.getLongArray("verdant_shockwave_hit_ids") : new long[0];
		int initialHitCount = hitIds.length;
		long[] newHitsBuffer = null;
		int newHitCount = 0;

		for (Entity victim : level.getEntitiesOfClass(Entity.class, waveBox, e -> e != null && e.isAlive())) {
			if (victim instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator())) continue;
			if (isWoodbound(victim) || isVerdantEngine(victim)
					|| persistentBoolean(victim.getPersistentData(), "backwoods_verdant_real_block", false)) continue;
			long id = victim.getId();
			boolean alreadyHit = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < initialHitCount; i++) {
				if (hitIds[i] == id) {
					alreadyHit = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (alreadyHit) continue;
			if (newHitsBuffer != null) {
				for (int i = 0; i < newHitCount; i++) {
					if (newHitsBuffer[i] == id) {
						alreadyHit = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (alreadyHit) continue;

			double dx = victim.getX() - ox;
			double dz = victim.getZ() - oz;
			double distSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;

			if (distSq >= innerRSq && distSq <= outerRSq && distSq <= maxRSq) {
				double dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
				if (newHitsBuffer == null) {
					newHitsBuffer = new long[16];
				} else if (newHitCount >= newHitsBuffer.length) {
					long[] expanded = new long[newHitsBuffer.length * 2];
					System.arraycopy(newHitsBuffer, 0, expanded, 0, newHitCount);
					newHitsBuffer = expanded;
				}
				newHitsBuffer[newHitCount++] = id;
				float waveDmg = Math.max(SHOCKWAVE_MIN_DAMAGE, slamDmg * (float) (1.0 - (dist / (maxR * 1.2))));

				victim.setNoGravity(false);
				victim.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_slammed_ticks", 30);

				double len = dist > 0.001 ? dist : 1.0;
				double pushX = (dx / len) * 1.8 * (1.0 - dist / (maxR * 1.5));
				double pushZ = (dz / len) * 1.8 * (1.0 - dist / (maxR * 1.5));
				double pushY = 0.6 + 0.4 * (1.0 - dist / (maxR * 1.5));

				victim.setDeltaMovement(pushX, pushY, pushZ);
				victim.hurtMarked = true;
				victim.hasImpulse = true;

				if (victim instanceof LivingEntity living) {
					applyTruePoundDamage(level, living, null, waveDmg);
					living.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 120, 2, false, false, true));
					if (living instanceof ServerPlayer sp) sp.connection.send(new ClientboundSetEntityMotionPacket(sp));
				} else if (victim instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.item.ItemEntity itemEnt) {
					damageItemEntitySeverely(level, itemEnt, waveDmg);
				}
			}
		}

		if (newHitCount > 0) {
			long[] updatedHits = new long[initialHitCount + newHitCount];
			if (initialHitCount > 0) {
				System.arraycopy(hitIds, 0, updatedHits, 0, initialHitCount);
			}
			System.arraycopy(newHitsBuffer, 0, updatedHits, initialHitCount, newHitCount);
			nbt.putLongArray("verdant_shockwave_hit_ids", updatedHits);
		}

		if ((int) stage % 3 == 1) playEngineSound(level, ox, oy, oz, "block.beacon.power_select", 24.0F, 0.20F - ((float) stage * 0.005F));
		processShockwaveDominoEffects(level, ox, oy, oz, radius, expandSpeed, oy + 85.0);

		nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_stage", stage + 1.0);
	}

	private static void clearActiveShockwave(CompoundTag nbt) {
		if (nbt == null) return;
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_shockwave_stage", 0.0);
		nbt.remove("verdant_shockwave_hit_ids");
		nbt.remove("verdant_shockwave_last_tick");
	}

	private static void performSlowKineticTerraforming(ServerLevel level, CompoundTag nbt, double cx, double gy, double cz, double r, int pounds) {
		double depth = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_crater_depth", 0.0);
		if (depth < 64.0) {
			depth += 0.0012;
			nbt.putDouble("verdant_crater_depth", depth);
		}

		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
			double a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, d = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * r * 1.6;
			double dx = Math.cos(a) * d, dz = Math.sin(a) * d, norm = d / r;
			if (norm > 1.65) continue;

			double rough = 0.5 + 0.22 * Math.sin(dx * 0.75 + dz * 0.6) + 0.15 * Math.cos(dx * 1.2 - dz * 0.8);
			int targetD = (int) Math.round(depth * Math.max(0.0, 1.0 - (norm * 0.65)) * (0.8 + 0.4 * rough));

			for (int dy = 2; dy >= -targetD - 1; dy--) {
				pos.set(Mth.floor(cx + dx), Mth.floor(gy + dy), Mth.floor(cz + dz));
				if (!level.hasChunkAt(pos)) continue;
				BlockState st = level.getBlockState(pos);
				boolean isCurBedrock = st.getBlock() == Blocks.BEDROCK;
				boolean isCurIndestructible = isCurBedrock || isIndestructibleBlock(st, level, pos);
				if (isCurIndestructible) {
					recordMaterialEncounter(nbt, st.getBlock());
				}
				boolean shatterBedrock = shouldShatterBedrock(nbt, d, pounds, st.getBlock());

				if (isCurIndestructible) {
					if (shatterBedrock) {
						level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
					}
					continue;
				}

				if (!st.getFluidState().isEmpty() || st.getBlock() == Blocks.WATER || st.getBlock() == Blocks.LAVA) {
					if (ENABLE_FLUID_EVAPORATION) level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
					continue;
				}
				if (dy > -targetD) {
					if (!st.isAir()) {
						level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
					}
				} else {
					replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, pos, st, false);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static final long[] DEEP_INFECTION_CACHE_KEYS = new long[4096];
	private static final long[] DEEP_INFECTION_CACHE_TICKS = new long[4096];

	private static long deepInfectionCacheKey(ServerLevel level, int bx, int bz) {
		long packedColumn = (((long) bx) << 32) | (bz & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
		long dimensionSalt = Integer.toUnsignedLong(level.dimension().location().hashCode());
		long levelSalt = Integer.toUnsignedLong(System.identityHashCode(level));
		return packedColumn ^ Long.rotateLeft(dimensionSalt, 17) ^ (levelSalt << 32);
	}

	private static int deepInfectionCacheSlot(long key) {
		return (int) (key ^ (key >>> 16) ^ (key >>> 32)) & 4095;
	}

	private static boolean isColumnDeeplyInfected(ServerLevel level, int bx, int bz, double hoverY) {
		long cacheKey = deepInfectionCacheKey(level, bx, bz);
		int cacheSlot = deepInfectionCacheSlot(cacheKey);
		long gameTime = level.getGameTime();
		if (gameTime > 0L && DEEP_INFECTION_CACHE_TICKS[cacheSlot] == gameTime && DEEP_INFECTION_CACHE_KEYS[cacheSlot] == cacheKey) return true;

		int chunkX = bx >> 4;
		int chunkZ = bz >> 4;
		net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(chunkX, chunkZ);
		if (chunk == null) return false;

		int minWorldY = (int) level.getMinBuildHeight() + 5;
		int localX = bx & 15;
		int localZ = bz & 15;
		int surfaceY = chunk.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES, localX, localZ);

		if (surfaceY <= minWorldY) {
			BlockPos.MutableBlockPos checkPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos(bx, minWorldY, bz);
			for (int y = Math.min((int) level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 1, (int) hoverY + 10); y >= minWorldY - 5; y--) {
				checkPos.setY(y);
				BlockState st = chunk.getBlockState(checkPos);
				if (!st.isAir() && isAlreadyInfectedBlock(st.getBlock())) {
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

		boolean surfInfected = isSampleLevelInfected1211(chunk, pos, bx, localX, localZ, Math.max(minWorldY, surfaceY - 1), minWorldY);
		if (!surfInfected) return false;

		int yMid = Math.max(minWorldY + 10, surfaceY - 25);
		boolean midInfected = isSampleLevelInfected1211(chunk, pos, bx, localX, localZ, yMid, minWorldY);
		if (!midInfected) return false;

		int yDeep = Math.max(minWorldY + 5, Math.min(yMid - 10, minWorldY + 20));
		boolean deepInfected = isSampleLevelInfected1211(chunk, pos, bx, localX, localZ, yDeep, minWorldY);

		if (deepInfected && gameTime > 0L) {
			DEEP_INFECTION_CACHE_KEYS[cacheSlot] = cacheKey;
			DEEP_INFECTION_CACHE_TICKS[cacheSlot] = gameTime;
		}
		return deepInfected;
	}

	private static boolean isSampleLevelInfected1211(net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess chunk, BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos, int bx, int localX, int localZ, int sampleY, int minWorldY) {
		pos.set(bx, sampleY, localZ);
		BlockState st = chunk.getBlockState(pos);
		while (pos.getY() > minWorldY && (!st.getFluidState().isEmpty() || st.getBlock() == Blocks.WATER || st.getBlock() == Blocks.LAVA)) {
			pos.move(Direction.DOWN);
			st = chunk.getBlockState(pos);
		}
		while (pos.getY() > minWorldY && st.isAir()) {
			pos.move(Direction.DOWN);
			st = chunk.getBlockState(pos);
		}
		if (st.isAir()) return false;
		Block b = st.getBlock();
		return isAlreadyInfectedBlock(b) || b == Blocks.BEDROCK || b == Blocks.BARRIER;
	}

	private static double sampleRelocationCandidateSaturation(ServerLevel level, double candidateX, double candidateY, double candidateZ) {
		int totalSamples = 0;
		int infectedSamples = 0;
		int centerX = Mth.floor(candidateX);
		int centerZ = Mth.floor(candidateZ);
		if (isHiveSaturationSampleInsideBorder(level, centerX, centerZ)) {
			totalSamples++;
			if (isColumnDeeplyInfected(level, centerX, centerZ, candidateY)) infectedSamples++;
		}
		for (int ring = 0; ring < 4; ring++) {
			double radius = ring == 0 ? 48.0 : ring == 1 ? 96.0 : ring == 2 ? 160.0 : 224.0;
			int sampleCount = (ring + 1) * 10;
			for (int sample = 0; sample < sampleCount; sample++) {
				double angle = Math.PI * 2.0 * sample / sampleCount + (ring == 0 ? 0.0 : 0.2);
				int sampleX = Mth.floor(candidateX + fastCos(angle) * radius);
				int sampleZ = Mth.floor(candidateZ + fastSin(angle) * radius);
				if (!isHiveSaturationSampleInsideBorder(level, sampleX, sampleZ)) continue;
				totalSamples++;
				if (isColumnDeeplyInfected(level, sampleX, sampleZ, candidateY)) infectedSamples++;
			}
		}
		return totalSamples > 0 ? (double) infectedSamples / (double) totalSamples : 0.0;
	}

	private static final long[] PROCESSED_COLUMNS = new long[16384];
	private static final int[] PROCESSED_COLUMNS_TAG = new int[16384];

	private static boolean markColumnVisitedThisTick(ServerLevel level, int bx, int bz, int tickEpoch) {
		long packedColumn = (((long) bx) << 32) | (bz & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
		long dimensionSalt = Integer.toUnsignedLong(level.dimension().location().hashCode());
		long levelSalt = Integer.toUnsignedLong(System.identityHashCode(level));
		long key = packedColumn ^ Long.rotateLeft(dimensionSalt, 17) ^ (levelSalt << 32);
		int mask = 16383;
		int idx = (int) (key ^ (key >>> 16) ^ (key >>> 32)) & mask;
		for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
			int slot = (idx + i) & mask;
			if (PROCESSED_COLUMNS_TAG[slot] == tickEpoch) {
				if (PROCESSED_COLUMNS[slot] == key) return false;
			} else {
				PROCESSED_COLUMNS_TAG[slot] = tickEpoch;
				PROCESSED_COLUMNS[slot] = key;
				return true;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static int infectRod3DBlock(ServerLevel level, int bx, int bz, double scanTop, double gy, double curR, boolean isSolidCore, boolean isBurst, boolean spawnBurstParticles) {
		return infectRod3DBlock(level, bx, bz, scanTop, gy, curR, isSolidCore, isBurst, spawnBurstParticles, new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos());
	}

	private static int infectRod3DBlock(ServerLevel level, int bx, int bz, double scanTop, double gy, double curR, boolean isSolidCore, boolean isBurst,
			boolean spawnBurstParticles, BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos) {
		int chunkX = bx >> 4;
		int chunkZ = bz >> 4;
		LevelChunk chunk = level.getChunkSource().getChunkNow(chunkX, chunkZ);
		if (chunk == null) return -1;

		int minWorldY = (int) level.getMinBuildHeight() + 5;
		int colHeight = chunk.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE, bx & 15, bz & 15);
		int startY = Math.min((int) scanTop, colHeight);
		if (startY <= minWorldY) return 0;

		boolean isCell = false;
		boolean isCellResolved = false;
		boolean canBreakIndestructible = canInfectIndestructible(null);
		int converted = 0;
		int changed = 0;
		int maxTarget = isBurst ? 96 : (isSolidCore ? 64 : 32);
		int localX = bx & 15;
		int localZ = bz & 15;
		LevelChunkSection[] sections = chunk.getSections();

		int y = startY;
		while (y >= minWorldY) {
			int sectionIndex = chunk.getSectionIndex(y);
			if (sectionIndex < 0 || sectionIndex >= sections.length) {
				y--;
				continue;
			}

			int sectionBottomY = chunk.getSectionYFromSectionIndex(sectionIndex) << 4;
			int sectionEndY = Math.max(minWorldY, sectionBottomY);
			LevelChunkSection section = sections[sectionIndex];
			if (section == null || section.hasOnlyAir()) {
				y = sectionBottomY - 1;
				continue;
			}

			for (; y >= sectionEndY; y--) {
				BlockState st = section.getBlockState(localX, y & 15, localZ);
				if (st.isAir()) continue;

				Block b = st.getBlock();
				if (isAlreadyInfectedBlock(b)) continue;
				if (b == Blocks.ANCIENT_DEBRIS || isAncientDebris(st, b)) continue;

				pos.set(bx, y, bz);
				if (isIndestructibleBlock(st, level, pos) && !canBreakIndestructible) continue;

				boolean isFoliage = isFoliageOrDebris(st, b);

				if (isFoliage) {
					level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
					changed++;
					continue;
				}

				if (!isCellResolved) {
					isCell = isCellularMembrane(bx, bz, level.getSeed());
					isCellResolved = true;
				}
				if (replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, pos, st, false, isCell)) {
					converted++;
					changed++;
					if (spawnBurstParticles && Math.random() < 0.10) {
						sendFarParticles(level, getOakPlanksParticle(), pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 1.05, pos.getZ() + 0.5, 2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.05);
					}
					if (converted >= maxTarget) return -(changed + 1);
				}
			}
		}
		return changed;
	}

	private static void performContinuousBeamTipInfection(ServerLevel level, CompoundTag nbt, double cx, double gy, double cz, int cycle, int pounds) {
		boolean hasCeiling = isCeiledDimension(level);
		double lockedY = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_locked_y", gy + getHoverTargetAltitude(nbt));
		if (hasCeiling && isEpicenterBlockedCached(level, nbt, cx, gy, cz, lockedY)) {
			return;
		}

		boolean supercharged = persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_supercharged_mode", false);
		double speedMult = getInfectionSpeedMultiplier(nbt) * (supercharged ? 3.0 : 1.0);
		double cycleProg = (double) Math.min(cycle, CYCLE_TOTAL_TICKS) / (double) CYCLE_TOTAL_TICKS;

		double tipRadius = BEAM_RADIUS + cycleProg * (9.0 + Math.min(6.0, pounds * 0.5));

		int sampleCount = (int) Math.max(12, Math.min(36, (12 + tipRadius * 2.0) * speedMult));
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		boolean canInfectIndestructible = canInfectIndestructible(nbt);
		boolean isCell = isCellularMembrane(Mth.floor(cx), Mth.floor(cz), level.getSeed());

		for (int i = 0; i < sampleCount; i++) {
			double angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2.0;
			double dist = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * tipRadius;
			int bx = Mth.floor(cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist);
			int bz = Mth.floor(cz + Math.sin(angle) * dist);

			int startY = (int) Math.min(level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 2.0, gy + 5.0);
			int endY = (int) Math.max(level.getMinBuildHeight() + 2.0, gy - 12.0);

			for (int y = startY; y >= endY; y--) {
				pos.set(bx, y, bz);
				if (!level.hasChunkAt(pos)) continue;
				BlockState st = level.getBlockState(pos);
				if (st.isAir()) continue;

				if (isIndestructibleBlock(st, level, pos)) {
					if (!canInfectIndestructible) {
						break;
					}
				}

				if (isFoliageOrDebris(st, st.getBlock())) {
					level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
					continue;
				}

				for (int dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
					int subY = y - dy;
					if (subY < endY) break;
					pos.set(bx, subY, bz);
					BlockState subSt = level.getBlockState(pos);
					if (subSt.isAir()) continue;
					if (isIndestructibleBlock(subSt, level, pos)) {
						if (!canInfectIndestructible) break;
					}
					if (isFoliageOrDebris(subSt, subSt.getBlock())) {
						level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), INFECTION_BLOCK_FLAGS);
						continue;
					}
					replaceBlockWithOakPlague(level, pos, subSt, false, isCell);
				}
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	private static void performContinuousSolidRadialWoodInfection(ServerLevel level, Entity entity, CompoundTag nbt, double cx, double gy, double cz, int pounds) {
		boolean hasCeiling = isCeiledDimension(level);
		double lockedY = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_locked_y", gy + getHoverTargetAltitude(nbt));
		boolean epicenterBlocked = hasCeiling && isEpicenterBlockedCached(level, nbt, cx, gy, cz, lockedY);
		if (epicenterBlocked) {
			nbt.putDouble("verdant_infection_radius", BEAM_RADIUS + 0.5);
			nbt.putDouble("verdant_burst_target_radius", 0.0);
			nbt.putInt("verdant_burst_spread_ticks", 0);
			nbt.putInt("verdant_pound_burst_ticks", 0);
			return;
		}

		boolean superchargedRadial = persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_supercharged_mode", false);
		double speedMult = getInfectionSpeedMultiplier(nbt) * (superchargedRadial ? 3.0 : 1.0);
		double maxInfR = superchargedRadial ? SUPERCHARGED_MAX_INFECTION_RADIUS : MAX_INFECTION_RADIUS;
		double curR = Math.min(maxInfR, persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_infection_radius", BEAM_RADIUS + 0.5) + (0.08 * speedMult));
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_infection_radius", curR);

		double density = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_last_sample_density", 1.0);
		double estimatedSatRatio = Math.min(1.0, (curR / maxInfR) * density);
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_estimated_block_saturation", estimatedSatRatio);
		double realSatRatio = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_real_block_saturation", 0.0);
		double scanTop = hasCeiling
			? Math.min(level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 4.0, gy + 15.0)
			: (level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 4.0);
		int tickEpoch = (int) level.getGameTime();

		if (entity != null) {
			UUID coreUuid = entity.getUUID();
			ResourceLocation coreDimension = level.dimension().location();
			ActiveVerdantCore activeCore = ACTIVE_CORES.get(coreUuid);
			if (activeCore == null || !activeCore.dimension.equals(coreDimension)) {
				ACTIVE_CORES.put(coreUuid, new ActiveVerdantCore(coreUuid, coreDimension, cx, cz, gy, scanTop, curR, pounds, level.getGameTime()));
			} else {
				activeCore.coreX = cx;
				activeCore.coreZ = cz;
				activeCore.groundY = gy;
				activeCore.scanTop = scanTop;
				activeCore.infectionRadius = curR;
				activeCore.pounds = pounds;
				activeCore.lastUpdateTick = level.getGameTime();
			}
		}

		if (ENABLE_INFECTION_CHAT_LOGGING && level != null && level.getGameTime() % 20 == 0) {
			double satPct = realSatRatio * 100.0;
			double radPct = Math.min(100.0, (curR / maxInfR) * 100.0);
			double satThreshold = getInfectionSaturationThreshold(nbt) * 100.0;
			int currentIntPct = (int) Math.round(satPct * 100.0);
			int lastLogged = persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_last_logged_sat_pct", -1);

			if (currentIntPct != lastLogged || level.getGameTime() % 60 == 0) {
				nbt.putInt("verdant_last_logged_sat_pct", currentIntPct);
				int engineIdx = getVerdantEngineIndex(level, entity);
				long worldRegions = persistentLong(nbt, "verdant_hive_world_regions", Long.MAX_VALUE);
				String worldRegionText = worldRegions == Long.MAX_VALUE ? "?" : Long.toString(worldRegions);
				String msg = String.format("§a[Verdant %d] §fMeasured Saturation: §e%.2f%% §f/ §c%.2f%% §f(Radius: §b%.1fm §f[%.0f%%] | Pounds: §d%d§f) §8| §fHive: §a%d§7/§a%s §fRegion: §6%.1f%% §fPhase: §b%d §fEnv: §b%d §fReloc: §b%d §fBorderQ: §b%d §fActive: §b%d §fDebt: §b%d/%d/%d §fSamples: §e%d§7/§e%d§7/§e%d §fTime: §c%dµs",
					engineIdx, satPct, satThreshold, curR, radPct, pounds,
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_hive_completed_region_count", 0), worldRegionText,
					persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_hive_current_region_saturation", 0.0) * 100.0,
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_hive_phase", HIVE_PHASE_ARRIVAL),
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_environment_state", ENVIRONMENT_STATE_UNCHECKED),
					persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_is_relocating", false) ? 1 : 0,
					persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_border_relocation_pending", false) ? 1 : 0,
					getActiveTerraformingEngineCount(level),
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_radial_work_debt", 0), persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_burst_work_debt", 0),
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_biome_work_debt", 0),
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_radial_requested_samples", 0), persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_radial_granted_samples", 0),
					persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_radial_executed_samples", 0), persistentLong(nbt, "verdant_radial_elapsed_us", 0L));
				Component comp = Component.literal(msg);
				double broadcastRange = Math.max(curR + 64.0, 256.0);
				double broadcastRangeSq = broadcastRange * broadcastRange;
				for (ServerPlayer player : level.players()) {
					if (player.distanceToSqr(cx, gy, cz) <= broadcastRangeSq) {
						player.sendSystemMessage(comp);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		boolean fullRadiusReached = curR >= maxInfR - 0.001;
		double radiusSampleMultiplier = fullRadiusReached ? FULL_RADIUS_SAMPLE_MULTIPLIER : 1.0;
		long fullRadiusPoundSamplesLong = fullRadiusReached ? (long) Math.max(0, pounds) * FULL_RADIUS_SAMPLES_PER_POUND : 0L;
		int fullRadiusPoundSamples = (int) Math.min(FULL_RADIUS_SAMPLE_CAP, fullRadiusPoundSamplesLong);
		long requestedSamplesLong = (long) Math.max(40.0,
			(2.0 * Math.PI * curR * 1.2 + (pounds * 12.0)) * speedMult * radiusSampleMultiplier) + fullRadiusPoundSamples;
		int requestedSamples = (int) Math.min(fullRadiusReached ? FULL_RADIUS_SAMPLE_CAP : 200L, requestedSamplesLong);

		int poundBurst = persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_pound_burst_ticks", 0);
		if (poundBurst > 0) {
			requestedSamples += (int) ((80 + (Math.random() * 40)) * speedMult);
			nbt.putInt("verdant_pound_burst_ticks", poundBurst - 1);
		}
		if (fullRadiusReached) requestedSamples = Math.min(FULL_RADIUS_SAMPLE_CAP, requestedSamples);
		int activeTerraformers = getActiveTerraformingEngineCount(level);
		nbt.putInt("verdant_active_terraformer_count", activeTerraformers);
		int totalSamples;
		if (superchargedRadial && activeTerraformers <= 1) {
			long combinedWork = (long) Math.max(0, persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_radial_work_debt", 0)) + requestedSamples;
			totalSamples = (int) Math.min(SUPERCHARGED_RADIAL_DEBT_CAP, combinedWork);
			nbt.remove("verdant_radial_work_debt");
		} else {
			totalSamples = claimTerraformingSampleBudget(nbt, "verdant_radial_work_debt",
				requestedSamples, fullRadiusReached
					? Math.min(FULL_RADIUS_SAMPLE_CAP, FULL_RADIUS_RADIAL_COLUMN_BUDGET + fullRadiusPoundSamples)
					: MULTI_ENGINE_RADIAL_COLUMN_BUDGET, activeTerraformers);
			activeTerraformers = persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_active_terraformer_count", activeTerraformers);
		}
		nbt.putInt("verdant_radial_requested_samples", requestedSamples);
		nbt.putInt("verdant_radial_granted_samples", totalSamples);

		int solidSamples = (int) (totalSamples * 0.90);
		double solidR = Math.max(0.0, curR - 2.5);
		long radialCursor = persistentLong(nbt, "verdant_radial_sample_cursor", 0L);
		double angleOffset = entity == null ? 0.0 : Math.floorMod(entity.getUUID().hashCode(), 3600) * (Math.PI / 1800.0);
		long radialWorkStartNanos = System.nanoTime();
		long reservedSuperchargedWork = superchargedRadial
			? SUPERCHARGED_BURST_TIME_BUDGET_NANOS + SUPERCHARGED_CRATER_TIME_BUDGET_NANOS
			: 0L;
		long radialBudgetPool = Math.max(1_000_000L, FULL_RADIUS_SERVER_TIME_BUDGET_NANOS - reservedSuperchargedWork);
		long radialTimeSliceNanos = Math.max(1_000_000L, radialBudgetPool / Math.max(1, activeTerraformers));
		boolean deterministicRadial = fullRadiusReached || superchargedRadial;
		int samplesExamined = 0;
		int samplesExecuted = 0;
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos infectionPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		TerraformWorkCoordinator terraformCoordinator = getTerraformCoordinator(level);
		long terraformGameTime = level.getGameTime();
		double edgeWidth = Math.max(0.1, curR - solidR);

		for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
			if (deterministicRadial && System.nanoTime() - radialWorkStartNanos >= radialTimeSliceNanos) break;
			samplesExamined++;
			long sequenceIndex = Math.floorMod(radialCursor + i, 1_000_000_007L);
			double a = deterministicRadial ? sequenceIndex * RADIAL_GOLDEN_ANGLE + angleOffset : Math.random() * Math.PI * 2.0;
			double sequenceValue = (sequenceIndex + 1L) * 0.7548776662466927;
			double radialFraction = deterministicRadial ? sequenceValue - Math.floor(sequenceValue) : Math.random();
			boolean isSolidCore = deterministicRadial ? Math.floorMod(sequenceIndex, 10L) != 0L : i < solidSamples;
			double d = isSolidCore
				? (Math.sqrt(radialFraction) * solidR)
				: (solidR + (radialFraction * edgeWidth));

			int trigIndex = fastTrigIndex(a);
			int bx = Mth.floor(cx + COS_LOOKUP[trigIndex] * d);
			int bz = Mth.floor(cz + SIN_LOOKUP[trigIndex] * d);

			if (!claimTerraformChunk(terraformCoordinator, terraformGameTime, level, entity, bx, bz, activeTerraformers)) continue;
			if (!claimTerraformColumn(terraformCoordinator, terraformGameTime, level, entity, bx, bz, activeTerraformers)) continue;
			if (!markColumnVisitedThisTick(level, bx, bz, tickEpoch)) continue;
			samplesExecuted++;
			int infectionResult = infectRod3DBlock(level, bx, bz, scanTop, gy, curR, isSolidCore, false, false, infectionPos);
			if (infectionResult == 0) markTerraformColumnComplete(terraformCoordinator, terraformGameTime, level, bx, bz);
		}
		if (deterministicRadial) nbt.putLong("verdant_radial_sample_cursor", radialCursor + samplesExamined);
		if (superchargedRadial && samplesExamined < totalSamples) {
			long totalDebt = (long) Math.max(0, persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_radial_work_debt", 0)) + (totalSamples - samplesExamined);
			nbt.putInt("verdant_radial_work_debt", (int) Math.min(SUPERCHARGED_RADIAL_DEBT_CAP, totalDebt));
		}
		nbt.putInt("verdant_radial_executed_samples", samplesExecuted);
		nbt.putLong("verdant_radial_elapsed_us", Math.max(0L, (System.nanoTime() - radialWorkStartNanos) / 1000L));
	}

	private static void handleBurstInfectionSpill(ServerLevel level, Entity entity, CompoundTag nbt, double cx, double gy, double cz, int pounds) {
		boolean hasCeiling = isCeiledDimension(level);
		double lockedY = persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_locked_y", gy + getHoverTargetAltitude(nbt));
		boolean epicenterBlocked = hasCeiling && isEpicenterBlockedCached(level, nbt, cx, gy, cz, lockedY);
		if (epicenterBlocked) return;

		boolean supercharged = persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_supercharged_mode", false);
		double speedMult = getInfectionSpeedMultiplier(nbt) * (supercharged ? 3.0 : 1.0);
		int burstTicks = persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_burst_spread_ticks", 0);
		int queuedBurstWork = persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_burst_work_debt", 0);
		if (burstTicks <= 0 && queuedBurstWork <= 0) return;
		boolean activeBurst = burstTicks > 0;
		if (activeBurst) {
			burstTicks--;
			nbt.putInt("verdant_burst_spread_ticks", burstTicks);
		}

		double maxInfR = persistentBoolean(nbt, "verdant_supercharged_mode", false) ? (SUPERCHARGED_MAX_INFECTION_RADIUS) : MAX_INFECTION_RADIUS;
		double targetR = Math.min(maxInfR, persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_burst_target_radius", 0.0));
		double curR = Math.min(maxInfR, persistentDouble(nbt, "verdant_infection_radius", 0.0));
		double stepR = activeBurst
			? Math.min(maxInfR, curR + (((targetR - curR) * (1.0 / (burstTicks + 1))) * speedMult))
			: curR;
		nbt.putDouble("verdant_infection_radius", stepR);

		double scanTop = hasCeiling
			? Math.min(level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 4.0, gy + 15.0)
			: (level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 4.0);
		int tickEpoch = (int) level.getGameTime();

		int requestedBurstSamples = activeBurst
			? (int) Math.min(600, Math.max(150, (2.0 * Math.PI * stepR * 1.8) * speedMult))
			: 0;
		int activeTerraformers = getActiveTerraformingEngineCount(level);
		nbt.putInt("verdant_active_terraformer_count", activeTerraformers);
		int burstSamples;
		if (supercharged && activeTerraformers <= 1) {
			long combinedWork = (long) Math.max(0, queuedBurstWork) + requestedBurstSamples;
			burstSamples = (int) Math.min(SUPERCHARGED_BURST_DEBT_CAP, combinedWork);
			nbt.remove("verdant_burst_work_debt");
		} else {
			burstSamples = claimTerraformingSampleBudget(nbt, "verdant_burst_work_debt",
				requestedBurstSamples, MULTI_ENGINE_BURST_COLUMN_BUDGET, activeTerraformers);
		}
		if (burstSamples <= 0) return;
		int solidSamples = (int) (burstSamples * 0.90);
		double solidR = Math.max(0.0, stepR - 2.5);
		long burstCursor = persistentLong(nbt, "verdant_supercharged_burst_cursor", 0L);
		long burstDeadline = supercharged ? System.nanoTime() + SUPERCHARGED_BURST_TIME_BUDGET_NANOS : Long.MAX_VALUE;
		int samplesExamined = 0;
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos infectionPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		TerraformWorkCoordinator terraformCoordinator = getTerraformCoordinator(level);
		long terraformGameTime = level.getGameTime();
		double edgeWidth = Math.max(0.1, stepR - solidR);

		for (int i = 0; i < burstSamples; i++) {
			if (supercharged && System.nanoTime() >= burstDeadline) break;
			samplesExamined++;
			long sequenceIndex = Math.floorMod(burstCursor + i, 1_000_000_007L);
			double a = supercharged ? sequenceIndex * RADIAL_GOLDEN_ANGLE : Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
			double sequenceValue = (sequenceIndex + 1L) * 0.7548776662466927;
			double radialFraction = supercharged ? sequenceValue - Math.floor(sequenceValue) : Math.random();
			boolean isSolidCore = i < solidSamples;

			double d = isSolidCore
				? (Math.sqrt(radialFraction) * solidR)
				: (solidR + (radialFraction * edgeWidth));

			int trigIndex = fastTrigIndex(a);
			int bx = Mth.floor(cx + COS_LOOKUP[trigIndex] * d);
			int bz = Mth.floor(cz + SIN_LOOKUP[trigIndex] * d);

			if (!claimTerraformChunk(terraformCoordinator, terraformGameTime, level, entity, bx, bz, activeTerraformers)) continue;
			if (!claimTerraformColumn(terraformCoordinator, terraformGameTime, level, entity, bx, bz, activeTerraformers)) continue;
			if (!markColumnVisitedThisTick(level, bx, bz, tickEpoch)) continue;
			int infectionResult = infectRod3DBlock(level, bx, bz, scanTop, gy, stepR, isSolidCore, true, activeBurst, infectionPos);
			if (infectionResult == 0) markTerraformColumnComplete(terraformCoordinator, terraformGameTime, level, bx, bz);
		}
		if (supercharged) {
			nbt.putLong("verdant_supercharged_burst_cursor", burstCursor + samplesExamined);
			int unfinishedSamples = burstSamples - samplesExamined;
			if (unfinishedSamples > 0) {
				long totalDebt = (long) Math.max(0, persistentInt(nbt, "verdant_burst_work_debt", 0)) + unfinishedSamples;
				nbt.putInt("verdant_burst_work_debt", (int) Math.min(SUPERCHARGED_BURST_DEBT_CAP, totalDebt));
			}
		}
	}
