		};
		int best = 2;
		double bestValue = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
		for (int i = 0; i < utility.length; i++) {
			// Learning breaks close choices; it cannot override eligibility or dominate immediate needs.
			double bias = i < biases.length && Double.isFinite(biases[i]) ? Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, biases[i])) : 0;
			double value = utility[i] + bias;
			if (value > bestValue) { bestValue = value; best = i; }
		}
		return modes[best];
	}

	private static boolean isTargetHoldingInfinityTotem(LivingEntity target) {
		if (target == null) return false;
		net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack mainHand = target.getMainHandItem();
		net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack offHand = target.getOffhandItem();
		if (!mainHand.isEmpty() && BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(mainHand.getItem()).toString().equals("avaritia:infinity_totem")) {
			return true;
		}
		if (!offHand.isEmpty() && BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(offHand.getItem()).toString().equals("avaritia:infinity_totem")) {
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static boolean isSpaceClearAt(LevelAccessor world, BlockPos pos) {
		if (pos == null) return false;
		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mpos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		for (int h = 0; h < 6; h++) {
			mpos.set(pos.getX(), pos.getY() + h, pos.getZ());
			BlockState state = world.getBlockState(mpos);
			if (!state.isAir() && !state.getCollisionShape(world, mpos).isEmpty()) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static BlockPos getOverpowerLeapTarget(LevelAccessor world, Mob mob, LivingEntity target) {
		if (!isCeilingHighEnough(world, mob)) return null;
		double jumpDX = target.getX() - mob.getX();
		double jumpDZ = target.getZ() - mob.getZ();
		double len = Math.sqrt(jumpDX * jumpDX + jumpDZ * jumpDZ);
		if (len > 0) { jumpDX /= len; jumpDZ /= len; }
		
		double landX = target.getX() + jumpDX * 6.0;
		double landZ = target.getZ() + jumpDZ * 6.0;
		BlockPos landPos = findGroundPos(world, landX, target.getY(), landZ);
		if (landPos != null && isSpaceClearAt(world, landPos)) {
			return landPos;
		}
		return null;
	}

	private static BlockPos findWallAmbushSpot(LevelAccessor world, LivingEntity target, Mob mob) {
		net.minecraft.util.RandomSource rand = mob.getRandom();
		BlockPos targetPos = target.blockPosition();

		for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 30; attempt++) {
			double angle = rand.nextDouble() * 2.0 * Math.PI;
			double radius = 12.0 + rand.nextDouble() * 28.0; // 12 to 40 blocks randomly away from player
			int candidateX = (int) Math.floor(target.getX() + Math.cos(angle) * radius);
			int candidateZ = (int) Math.floor(target.getZ() + Math.sin(angle) * radius);

			for (int yOffset = -5; yOffset <= 5; yOffset++) {
				int candidateY = targetPos.getY() + yOffset;
				BlockPos footPos = new BlockPos(candidateX, candidateY, candidateZ);

				// Check floor block below candidate
				BlockState floorState = world.getBlockState(footPos.below());
				if (floorState.isAir() || !floorState.isSolidRender(world, footPos.below())) continue;

				// Check for air space: minimum 2 width (dx 0..1, dz 0..1) and 6 high air (dy 0..5)
				boolean fitsAir = true;
				BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mpos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
				for (int dx = 0; dx <= 1; dx++) {
					for (int dz = 0; dz <= 1; dz++) {
						for (int dy = 0; dy <= 5; dy++) {
							mpos.set(candidateX + dx, candidateY + dy, candidateZ + dz);
							BlockState state = world.getBlockState(mpos);
							if (!state.isAir() && !state.getCollisionShape(world, mpos).isEmpty()) {
								fitsAir = false;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!fitsAir) break;
					}
					if (!fitsAir) break;
				}

				if (fitsAir) {
					// We have a space. Now check if there is a wall between this and the target.
					net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult hitResult = world.clip(new net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext(
							new Vec3(candidateX + 0.5, candidateY + 1.5, candidateZ + 0.5),
							target.getEyePosition(),
							net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER,
							net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext.Fluid.NONE,
							mob
					));
					
					if (hitResult.getType() == net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
						BlockPos hitPos = ((net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult)hitResult).getBlockPos();
						BlockState hitState = world.getBlockState(hitPos);
						float hardness = hitState.getDestroySpeed(world, hitPos);
						if (hardness >= 0.0F && hardness <= DASH_MAX_BLOCK_HARDNESS) {
							return footPos;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private static BlockPos findChargeTeleportSpot(LevelAccessor world, LivingEntity target, Mob mob) {
		net.minecraft.util.RandomSource rand = mob.getRandom();
		BlockPos targetPos = target.blockPosition();

		for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 25; attempt++) {
			double angle = rand.nextDouble() * 2.0 * Math.PI;
			double radius = 8.0 + rand.nextDouble() * 7.0; // 8 to 15 blocks randomly away from player
			int candidateX = (int) Math.floor(target.getX() + Math.cos(angle) * radius);
			int candidateZ = (int) Math.floor(target.getZ() + Math.sin(angle) * radius);

			for (int yOffset = -4; yOffset <= 4; yOffset++) {
				int candidateY = targetPos.getY() + yOffset;
				BlockPos footPos = new BlockPos(candidateX, candidateY, candidateZ);

				// Check floor block below candidate
				BlockState floorState = world.getBlockState(footPos.below());
				if (floorState.isAir() || !floorState.isSolidRender(world, footPos.below())) continue;

				// Check for air space: minimum 2 width (dx 0..1, dz 0..1) and 6 high air (dy 0..5)
				boolean fitsAir = true;
				BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mpos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
				for (int dx = 0; dx <= 1; dx++) {
					for (int dz = 0; dz <= 1; dz++) {
						for (int dy = 0; dy <= 5; dy++) {
							mpos.set(candidateX + dx, candidateY + dy, candidateZ + dz);
							BlockState state = world.getBlockState(mpos);
							if (!state.isAir() && !state.getCollisionShape(world, mpos).isEmpty()) {
								fitsAir = false;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!fitsAir) break;
					}
					if (!fitsAir) break;
				}

				if (fitsAir) {
					return footPos;
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private static void performWeaverTpOrDespawn(LevelAccessor world, Mob mob) {
		double x = mob.getX();
		double y = mob.getY();
		double z = mob.getZ();
		if (world instanceof ServerLevel sl) {
			sl.playSound(null, mob.blockPosition(), SoundEvents.ENDERMAN_TELEPORT, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 2.0F, 0.5F);
			sl.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.FLASH, x, y + 3.0, z, 50, 0.5, 1.5, 0.5, 0.1);
			sl.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE, x, y + 2.0, z, 40, 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.05);
		}
		if (mob.getRandom().nextBoolean()) {
			mob.discard();
		} else {
			double angle = mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2.0;
			double dist = 75.0 + mob.getRandom().nextDouble() * 35.0;
			double tx = x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
			double tz = z + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
			BlockPos ground = findGroundPos(world, tx, y, tz);
			if (ground != null) {
				mob.teleportTo(ground.getX() + 0.5, ground.getY() + 0.1, ground.getZ() + 0.5);
				if (world instanceof ServerLevel sl) {
					sl.playSound(null, ground, SoundEvents.ENDERMAN_TELEPORT, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 2.0F, 0.5F);
					sl.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.FLASH, ground.getX() + 0.5, ground.getY() + 2.0, ground.getZ() + 0.5, 40, 0.5, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1);
				}
			} else {
				mob.discard();
			}
		}
	}

	private static boolean processProjectileParryCheck(Mob mob, CompoundTag mData, LevelAccessor world) {
		if (mob == null || world == null || mData == null) return false;
		int parryCd = persistentInt(mData, "parry_cooldown", 0);
		if (parryCd > 0) return false;

		// Do not trigger parry if Weaver is already in Hypnosis, dashing, or dying
		if (persistentBoolean(mData, "is_dying", false) || persistentBoolean(mData, "is_dashing", false) || persistentInt(mData, "hypno_phase", 0) != 0) return false;

		AABB searchBox = mob.getBoundingBox().inflate(24.0);
		List<net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile> projectiles = world.getEntitiesOfClass(net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile.class, searchBox);

		Vec3 weaverCenter = mob.getBoundingBox().getCenter();

		for (net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile proj : projectiles) {
			if (proj == null || !proj.isAlive()) continue;
			if (proj.getOwner() == mob) continue;

			Vec3 pPos = proj.position();
			Vec3 pVel = proj.getDeltaMovement();
			double speed = pVel.length();
			if (speed < 0.15) continue;

			Vec3 toWeaver = weaverCenter.subtract(pPos);
			double dot = pVel.dot(toWeaver);
			if (dot <= 0) continue; // Projectile moving away from Weaver

			double distance = toWeaver.length();
			double ticksToImpact = distance / speed;

			// Predict location at point of closest impact
			Vec3 futurePos = pPos.add(pVel.scale(ticksToImpact));
			double closestDist = futurePos.distanceTo(weaverCenter);

			// Trigger predictive sweep parry: start windup so the claw reaches apex right as projectile arrives within reach
			if (closestDist <= 4.2 && ticksToImpact >= 4.0 && ticksToImpact <= 22.0) {
				clearOtherStates(mData, "ATTACKING");
				updateStateAndLog(mob, mData, "ATTACKING");
				mData.putBoolean("is_attacking", true);
				mData.putBoolean("is_parrying", true);

				// Select Sweep Left (6) or Sweep Right (7) animation
				int sweepType = mob.getRandom().nextBoolean() ? 6 : 7;
				mData.putInt("attack_type", sweepType);
				mData.putInt("attack_peak_tick", 20); // Apex swing centered at tick 20 of 40
				mData.putInt("attack_timer", MELEE_ATTACK_DURATION);
				mData.putInt("parry_cooldown", PARRY_COOLDOWN);

				// Lock facing toward incoming projectile source, but override with player facing if near player
				LivingEntity target = mob.getTarget();
				double distToTarget = (target != null && target.isAlive()) ? mob.distanceTo(target) : 999.0;

				Vec3 projSource = (proj.getOwner() != null) ? proj.getOwner().position() : pPos;
				double dx_source = projSource.x - mob.getX();
				double dz_source = projSource.z - mob.getZ();
				float parryYaw = (float) (Math.atan2(dz_source, dx_source) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0F;

				if (distToTarget <= 10.0 && target != null) {
					double dx_t = target.getX() - mob.getX();
					double dz_t = target.getZ() - mob.getZ();
					parryYaw = (float) (Math.atan2(dz_t, dx_t) * (180.0 / Math.PI)) - 90.0F;
				}

				applyRotationToAll(mob, parryYaw);
				mData.putFloat("attack_facing_yaw", parryYaw);

				syncWeaverEntityData(mob, false, mData);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static void processSwatProjectiles(Mob mob, CompoundTag mData, LevelAccessor world) {
		if (mob == null || world == null) return;
		AABB swatArea = mob.getBoundingBox().inflate(5.0, 3.5, 5.0);
		List<net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile> projectiles = world.getEntitiesOfClass(net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile.class, swatArea);

		for (net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.Projectile proj : projectiles) {
			if (proj == null || !proj.isAlive()) continue;
			if (proj.getOwner() == mob) continue;

			Vec3 pVel = proj.getDeltaMovement();
			double deflectSpeed = Math.max(1.35, pVel.length() * 1.25);
			Vec3 away = proj.position().subtract(mob.getBoundingBox().getCenter()).normalize();
			if (away.lengthSqr() < 0.001) away = mob.getLookAngle();

			Vec3 swatVel = new Vec3(
				away.x * deflectSpeed + (mob.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.4,
				Math.max(0.25, away.y * 0.5 + 0.35),
				away.z * deflectSpeed + (mob.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5) * 0.4
			);

			proj.setDeltaMovement(swatVel);
			proj.hasImpulse = true;
			proj.setOwner(mob);

			mob.level().playSound(null, proj.getX(), proj.getY(), proj.getZ(), SoundEvents.SHIELD_BLOCK, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 1.4F, 0.85F);
			mob.level().playSound(null, mob.getX(), mob.getY() + 1.2, mob.getZ(), SoundEvents.PLAYER_ATTACK_SWEEP, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 1.2F, 1.0F);

			if (world instanceof ServerLevel sl) {
				sl.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SWEEP_ATTACK, proj.getX(), proj.getY() + 1.0, proj.getZ(), 3, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.0);
				sl.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.CRIT, proj.getX(), proj.getY() + 1.0, proj.getZ(), 12, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.2);
			}
		}
	}

	private static void performDashBlockDestruction(LevelAccessor world, Mob mob, float lockedYaw) {
		double rad = Math.toRadians(lockedYaw + 90.0F);
		double dirX = Math.cos(rad);
		double dirZ = Math.sin(rad);
		double perpX = -dirZ;
		double perpZ = dirX;

		int footY = (int) Math.floor(mob.getY());
		int topY = footY + Math.max(1, DASH_DESTROY_HEIGHT - 1);
		double halfW = Math.max(0.5, (DASH_DESTROY_WIDTH - 1) * 0.5);

		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mpos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

		for (double fwd = 0.6; fwd <= 3.2; fwd += 0.8) {
			for (double side = -halfW; side <= halfW + 0.05; side += 0.8) {
				double checkX = mob.getX() + dirX * fwd + perpX * side;
				double checkZ = mob.getZ() + dirZ * fwd + perpZ * side;

				for (int y = footY; y <= topY; y++) {
					mpos.set((int) Math.floor(checkX), y, (int) Math.floor(checkZ));
					BlockState state = world.getBlockState(mpos);
					if (!state.isAir() && !state.getCollisionShape(world, mpos).isEmpty()) {
						float hardness = state.getDestroySpeed(world, mpos);
						if (hardness >= 0.0F && hardness <= DASH_MAX_BLOCK_HARDNESS) {
							if (world instanceof ServerLevel sl) {
								sl.levelEvent(2001, mpos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block.getId(state));
							}
							world.setBlock(mpos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(), 3);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	/** Learns from observed pearl/owner teleport pairs; reuses the existing leap request state. */
	@net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods")
	public static final class WoodweaverPearlAdaptation {
	    public static final boolean ENABLE_PEARL_LEARNING = true;
	    public static final int OBSERVATIONS_TO_LEARN = 3, OBSERVATION_INTERVAL = 4;
	    public static final int MAX_TRACKED_PEARLS = 6, MAX_TRAJECTORY_TICKS = 80, LEARNED_REACTION_COOLDOWN = 80;
	    public static final double WATCH_RANGE = 48, MAX_LEAP_RANGE = 48;
	    public static final int GLOBAL_PREDICTION_RAY_BUDGET = 160;
	    private record Prediction(int age, Vec3 point) {}
	    private static final Map<ThrownEnderpearl, Prediction> PREDICTIONS = new WeakHashMap<>();
	    private static int predictionTick = -1, predictionRays;
	    private static final String EXPERIENCE = "weaver_pearl_observations";
	    private static final Map<Mob, Memory> MEMORIES = new WeakHashMap<>();
	    private static final class Memory {
	        final Map<UUID, Track> pearls = new LinkedHashMap<>();
	        int lastTick = -1, reactAfter;
	        WeakReference<ThrownEnderpearl> attention;
	        int attentionUntil;
	    }
	    private static final class Track {
	        WeakReference<ThrownEnderpearl> pearl;
	        WeakReference<Entity> owner;
	        Vec3 previousOwner, previousPearl, predicted;
	        int samples, lastSeen, removedAt = -1;
	    }
	    public static void observe(Mob weaver) {
	        if (!ENABLE_PEARL_LEARNING || !(weaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level) || !weaver.isAlive()) return;
	        Memory memory = MEMORIES.computeIfAbsent(weaver, m -> new Memory());
	        if (memory.lastTick == weaver.tickCount) return;
	        memory.lastTick = weaver.tickCount;
	        int tick = weaver.tickCount;
	        Iterator<Track> iterator = memory.pearls.values().iterator();
	        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
	            Track track = iterator.next(); Entity owner = track.owner.get();
	            ThrownEnderpearl pearl = track.pearl.get();
	            if (owner == null || owner.level() != level || tick - track.lastSeen > 100) { iterator.remove(); continue; }
	            boolean removed = pearl == null || pearl.isRemoved();
	            if (removed && track.removedAt < 0) track.removedAt = tick;
	            if (removed && track.samples >= 2 && tick - track.lastSeen <= 16
	                && track.predicted != null && owner.position().distanceToSqr(track.previousOwner) > 25
	                && (owner.position().distanceToSqr(track.predicted) < 25
	                    || owner.position().distanceToSqr(pearl == null ? track.previousPearl : pearl.position()) < 64)
	                && canSee(weaver, owner)) {
	                var tag = weaver.getPersistentData();
	                tag.putInt(EXPERIENCE, Math.min(64, persistentInt(tag, EXPERIENCE, 0) + 1));
	                iterator.remove(); continue;
	            }
	            if (removed && tick - track.removedAt > 8) { iterator.remove(); continue; }
	            track.previousOwner = owner.position();
	        }
	        if (tick % OBSERVATION_INTERVAL != 0) return;
	        List<ThrownEnderpearl> visible = level.getEntitiesOfClass(ThrownEnderpearl.class,
	            weaver.getBoundingBox().inflate(WATCH_RANGE), p -> p.isAlive() && p.getOwner() != weaver);
	        int limit = Math.min(MAX_TRACKED_PEARLS, visible.size());
	        for (int visited = 0; visited < limit; visited++) {
	            ThrownEnderpearl pearl = visible.get((visited + tick / OBSERVATION_INTERVAL) % visible.size());
	            Entity owner = pearl.getOwner();
	            if (owner == null || owner.level() != level || !canSee(weaver, pearl)) continue;
	            if (weaver.getTarget() != null && owner != weaver.getTarget()) continue;
	            Track track = memory.pearls.get(pearl.getUUID());
	            if (track == null) {
	                if (memory.pearls.size() >= MAX_TRACKED_PEARLS) memory.pearls.remove(memory.pearls.keySet().iterator().next());
	                track = new Track(); track.pearl = new WeakReference<>(pearl); track.owner = new WeakReference<>(owner);
	                track.previousOwner = owner.position(); memory.pearls.put(pearl.getUUID(), track);
	            }
	            track.samples++; track.lastSeen = tick; track.previousPearl = pearl.position();
	            track.predicted = predict(level, pearl);
	            if (visited == 0) { memory.attention = new WeakReference<>(pearl); memory.attentionUntil = tick + 6; }
	            if (!busy(weaver)) weaver.getLookControl().setLookAt(pearl, 8, 12);
	            if (persistentInt(weaver.getPersistentData(), EXPERIENCE, 0) < OBSERVATIONS_TO_LEARN
	                || tick < memory.reactAfter || track.predicted == null || busy(weaver) || !weaver.onGround()
	                || weaver.getTarget() != owner) continue;
	            if (persistentInt(weaver.getPersistentData(), "leap_cooldown", 0) > 0) continue;
	            if (track.predicted.distanceToSqr(weaver.position()) > MAX_LEAP_RANGE * MAX_LEAP_RANGE
	                || track.predicted.distanceToSqr(weaver.position()) < 36) continue;
	            Vec3 landing = WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.landingNear(weaver, track.predicted);
	            if (landing == null) continue;
	            var tag = weaver.getPersistentData();
	            tag.putBoolean("leap_requested", true);
	            tag.putDouble("leap_requested_x", landing.x); tag.putDouble("leap_requested_y", landing.y);
	            tag.putDouble("leap_requested_z", landing.z);
	            memory.reactAfter = tick + LEARNED_REACTION_COOLDOWN;
	        }
	    }
	    @net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent(priority = net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority.LOWEST)
	    public static void watchAfterTick(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
	        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.WoodweaverEntity mob)
	            || mob.level().isClientSide()) return;
	        Memory memory = MEMORIES.get(mob);
	        if (memory == null || memory.attention == null || mob.tickCount > memory.attentionUntil || busy(mob)) return;
	        ThrownEnderpearl pearl = memory.attention.get();
	        if (pearl == null || pearl.isRemoved() || pearl.level() != mob.level()) return;
	        Vec3 from = mob.position().add(0, WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.ROOT_HEIGHT, 0)
	            .add(WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.up(mob, 1).scale(3.0));
	        Vec3 direction = pearl.position().subtract(from);
	        org.joml.Vector3f local = WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.rotation(mob, 1).conjugate().transform(
	            new org.joml.Vector3f((float)direction.x, (float)direction.y, (float)direction.z));
	        float wanted = (float)Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(-local.x, local.z));
	        float relative = net.minecraft.util.Mth.clamp(net.minecraft.util.Mth.wrapDegrees(wanted - mob.yBodyRot), -65, 65);
	        float previous = mob.yHeadRot;
	        mob.yHeadRotO = previous;
	        mob.setYHeadRot(net.minecraft.util.Mth.approachDegrees(previous, mob.yBodyRot + relative, 8));
	        float pitch = (float)-Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(local.y, Math.hypot(local.x, local.z)));
	        mob.setXRot(net.minecraft.util.Mth.approachDegrees(mob.getXRot(), pitch, 10));
	    }
	
	    private static boolean busy(Mob mob) {
	        var tag = mob.getPersistentData();
	        return persistentBoolean(tag, "is_dying", false) || persistentBoolean(tag, "is_attacking", false) || persistentBoolean(tag, "is_dashing", false)
	            || persistentBoolean(tag, "is_leaping", false) || persistentBoolean(tag, "is_preparing_leap", false) || persistentBoolean(tag, "is_landing_anim", false)
	            || persistentBoolean(tag, "is_playing_anim", false) || persistentInt(tag, "hypno_phase", 0) != 0 || persistentInt(tag, "stare_ticks", 0) > 0;
	    }
	    private static boolean canSee(Mob mob, Entity target) {
	        Vec3 up = WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.up(mob, 1);
	        Vec3 from = mob.position().add(0, WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.ROOT_HEIGHT, 0).add(up.scale(3.0));
	        Vec3 to = target.getBoundingBox().getCenter();
	        if (!WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.loadedBox(mob.level(), new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(from, to))) return false;
	        BlockHitResult hit = WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.clipLoaded(mob.level(), mob, from, to);
	        return hit == null || hit.getLocation().distanceToSqr(to) < 0.1;
	    }
	
	    public static Vec3 predict(ServerLevel level, ThrownEnderpearl pearl) {
	        Prediction cached = PREDICTIONS.get(pearl);
	        if (cached != null && pearl.tickCount - cached.age < OBSERVATION_INTERVAL) return cached.point;
	        int serverTick = level.getServer().getTickCount();
	        if (serverTick != predictionTick) { predictionTick = serverTick; predictionRays = GLOBAL_PREDICTION_RAY_BUDGET; }
	        Vec3 position = pearl.position(), velocity = pearl.getDeltaMovement();
	        for (int tick = 0; tick < MAX_TRAJECTORY_TICKS; tick++) {
	            if (predictionRays-- <= 0) return null;
	            Vec3 next = position.add(velocity);
	            if (next.distanceToSqr(pearl.position()) > 96 * 96
	                || !WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.loadedBox(level, new net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB(position, next).inflate(0.1))) return null;
	            BlockHitResult hit = WoodweaverSurfaceNavigation.clipLoaded(level, pearl, position, next);
	            if (hit != null) {
	                Vec3 point = hit.getLocation(); PREDICTIONS.put(pearl, new Prediction(pearl.tickCount, point)); return point;
	            }
	            // Actual vanilla pearl drag/gravity; fluid drag is sampled in loaded columns.
	            BlockPos cell = BlockPos.containing(next);
	            double drag = level.getFluidState(cell).isEmpty() ? 0.99 : 0.8;
	            velocity = velocity.scale(drag).add(0, pearl.isNoGravity() ? 0 : -0.03, 0);
	            position = next;
	        }
	        return null;
	    }
	}

	private static void tickWeightCollapse(ServerLevel world, Mob mob, CompoundTag mData) {
		if (!mob.onGround()) return;

		int centerFloorX = (int) Math.floor(mob.getX());
		int centerFloorY = (int) Math.floor(mob.getY());
		int centerFloorZ = (int) Math.floor(mob.getZ());

		CompoundTag collapsingMap = mData.getCompound("collapsing_map");
		boolean updatedMap = false;

		BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mpos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
		
		// Iterate 3x3 footprint directly below feet
		for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
			for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
				int bx = centerFloorX + dx;
				int bz = centerFloorZ + dz;
				int by = centerFloorY - 1;
				mpos.set(bx, by, bz);
				BlockState state = world.getBlockState(mpos);
				
				if (state.isAir() || state.is(net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.BEDROCK) || state.is(net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.BARRIER)) {
					continue;
				}
				float destroySpeed = state.getDestroySpeed(world, mpos);
				if (destroySpeed < 0) {
					continue; // Indestructible blocks
				}

				// Trace downwards to measure contiguous solid thickness before air/void layer
				int solidThickness = 0;
				boolean hasAirBeneath = false;
				BlockPos.MutableBlockPos tracePos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
				for (int dy = 1; dy <= 6; dy++) {
					tracePos.set(bx, by - dy, bz);
					BlockState belowState = world.getBlockState(tracePos);
					if (belowState.isAir()) {
						hasAirBeneath = true;
						break;
					} else if (belowState.is(net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.BEDROCK)) {
						// Bedrock means solid ground, never collapse
						solidThickness = 999;
						break;
					} else {
						solidThickness++;
					}
				}

				// Only collapse if there is actually air beneath (suspended) AND thickness is <= 3 blocks
				if (hasAirBeneath && solidThickness >= 1 && solidThickness <= 3) {
					String posKey = bx + "_" + by + "_" + bz;
					int progress = persistentInt(collapsingMap, posKey, 0);

					int rate = 1;
					if (solidThickness == 1) rate = 15;
					else if (solidThickness == 2) rate = 5;
					else if (solidThickness == 3) rate = 2;

					progress += rate;
					collapsingMap.putInt(posKey, progress);
					updatedMap = true;

					BlockPos finalPos = new BlockPos(bx, by, bz);

					if (progress >= 100) {
						// CRASH AND COLLAPSE!
						world.destroyBlock(finalPos, false);
						world.playSound(null, finalPos.getX(), finalPos.getY(), finalPos.getZ(), 
							state.getSoundType().getBreakSound(), SoundSource.BLOCKS, 1.2F, 0.6F);
						collapsingMap.remove(posKey);
					} else {
						// Play stress creaking/cracking and spawn stress particles
						if (progress % 10 == 0) {
							world.playSound(null, finalPos.getX(), finalPos.getY(), finalPos.getZ(), 
								SoundEvents.WOOD_HIT, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.8F, 0.40F);
							if (world.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.4F) {
								world.playSound(null, finalPos.getX(), finalPos.getY(), finalPos.getZ(), 
									SoundEvents.WOOD_BREAK, SoundSource.BLOCKS, 0.5F, 0.50F);
							}
						}
						if (progress % 5 == 0) {
							world.sendParticles(new net.minecraft.core.particles.BlockParticleOption(ParticleTypes.BLOCK, state), 
								finalPos.getX() + 0.5, finalPos.getY() + 0.5, finalPos.getZ() + 0.5, 4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.05);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if (updatedMap || !collapsingMap.isEmpty()) {
			// Slowly decay any non-active crumbling blocks back to 0
			java.util.Set<String> keys = new java.util.HashSet<>(collapsingMap.getAllKeys());
			for (String key : keys) {
				try {
					String[] parts = key.split("_");
					if (parts.length == 3) {
						int kx = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
						int ky = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
						int kz = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
						// If the Weaver is no longer standing close to this block, decay progress
						double distSqr = mob.distanceToSqr(kx + 0.5, ky + 1.0, kz + 0.5);
						if (distSqr > 16.0) {
							int currentProgress = persistentInt(collapsingMap, key, 0);
							if (currentProgress > 5) {
								collapsingMap.putInt(key, currentProgress - 5);
							} else {
								collapsingMap.remove(key);
							}
							updatedMap = true;
						}
					}
				} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
		}

		if (updatedMap) {
			mData.put("collapsing_map", collapsingMap);
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.WoodweaverEntity;

public class WoodweaverPlaybackConditionLandProcedure {
	public static boolean execute(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null)
			return false;
		return entity instanceof WoodweaverEntity _datEntL0 && _datEntL0.getEntityData().get(WoodweaverEntity.DATA_isLanding);
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

// 1.21.1
import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods")
public class Prosopagnosia {
	private static Holder<MobEffect> cachedEffectHolder = null;
	private static boolean effectHolderSearched = false;

	public static boolean isBackwoodsEntity(LivingEntity entity) {
		if (entity == null) {
			return false;
		}
		try {
			ResourceLocation id = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType());
			if (id != null && "the_backwoods".equals(id.getNamespace())) {
				return true;
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}
		return entity.getClass().getName().startsWith("net.mcreator.thebackwoods");
	}

	public static void purgeProsopagnosia(LivingEntity entity) {
		if (entity == null) {
			return;
		}

		try {
			if (entity.hasEffect(TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.PROSOPAGNOSIA_EFFECT)) {
				entity.removeEffect(TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.PROSOPAGNOSIA_EFFECT);
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		if (cachedEffectHolder != null && entity.hasEffect(cachedEffectHolder)) {
			try {
				entity.removeEffect(cachedEffectHolder);
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
			}
		}

		if (!entity.getActiveEffects().isEmpty()) {
			for (MobEffectInstance effect : new ArrayList<>(entity.getActiveEffects())) {
				Holder<MobEffect> holder = effect.getEffect();
				ResourceLocation id = holder.unwrapKey().map(ResourceKey::location).orElse(null);
				if (id != null && id.getNamespace().equals("the_backwoods") && id.getPath().startsWith("prosopagnosia")) {
					try {
						entity.removeEffect(holder);
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {
					}
				}
			}
		}

		try {
			if (entity.getPersistentData().contains("prosopagnosia_active")) {
				entity.getPersistentData().remove("prosopagnosia_active");
			}
			if (entity.getPersistentData().contains("prosopagnosia_hallucination")) {
				entity.getPersistentData().remove("prosopagnosia_hallucination");
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}
	}

	public static boolean hasProsopagnosia(LivingEntity entity) {
		if (entity == null) {
			return false;
		}

		// Mod ID entities are completely immune to Prosopagnosia: immediately purge if applied
		if (isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			purgeProsopagnosia(entity);
			return false;
		}

		if (!entity.getActiveEffects().isEmpty()) {
			try {
				if (entity.hasEffect(TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.PROSOPAGNOSIA_EFFECT)) {
					return true;
				}
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
			}

			if (!effectHolderSearched) {
				effectHolderSearched = true;
				for (Holder<MobEffect> holder : BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT.asHolderIdMap()) {
					ResourceLocation id = holder.unwrapKey().map(ResourceKey::location).orElse(null);
					if (id != null && id.getNamespace().equals("the_backwoods") && id.getPath().startsWith("prosopagnosia")) {
						cachedEffectHolder = holder;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			if (cachedEffectHolder != null && entity.hasEffect(cachedEffectHolder)) {
				return true;
			}

			if (cachedEffectHolder == null) {
				for (MobEffectInstance effect : entity.getActiveEffects()) {
					Holder<MobEffect> holder = effect.getEffect();
					ResourceLocation id = holder.unwrapKey().map(ResourceKey::location).orElse(null);
					if (id != null && id.getNamespace().equals("the_backwoods") && id.getPath().startsWith("prosopagnosia")) {
						cachedEffectHolder = holder;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		try {
			if (entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("prosopagnosia_active")) {
				return true;
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		return false;
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
		if (event.getEntity() == null) {
			return;
		}

		if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof LivingEntity entity) || entity instanceof Player) {
			return;
		}

		if (entity.level().isClientSide() || !entity.isAlive()) {
			return;
		}

		if (isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			purgeProsopagnosia(entity);
			return;
		}

		if (!hasProsopagnosia(entity)) {
			return;
		}

		// 1. Breakdown of Pack & Protective Instincts
		// Clear aggression, targets, and pack instincts: entity cannot distinguish allies from threats
		if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
			if (mob.getTarget() != null) {
				mob.setTarget(null);
			}
			if (mob.isAggressive()) {
				mob.setAggressive(false);
			}
			if (mob.isSprinting()) {
				mob.setSprinting(false); // Prevents sprinting/walking dust particles under feet
			}
		}

		if (entity instanceof NeutralMob neutral) {
			if (neutral.isAngry() || neutral.getPersistentAngerTarget() != null) {
				neutral.stopBeingAngry();
				neutral.setPersistentAngerTarget(null);
			}
		}

		if (entity instanceof TamableAnimal tamable) {
			if (tamable.isOrderedToSit() || tamable.isInSittingPose()) {
				tamable.setOrderedToSit(false);
				tamable.setInSittingPose(false);
			}
		}

		// 2. Scan for all living entities within paranoid sight range (16 horizontal, 8 vertical)
		AABB scanBox = entity.getBoundingBox().inflate(16.0, 8.0, 16.0);
		List<LivingEntity> nearby = entity.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
			LivingEntity.class,
			scanBox,
			other -> other != entity && other.isAlive() && !other.isSpectator()
				&& !(other instanceof Player p && (p.isCreative() || p.isSpectator()))
		);

		List<LivingEntity> seenThreats = null;
		if (!nearby.isEmpty()) {
			for (LivingEntity other : nearby) {
				// Line of sight check: flees from every entity they see (including pack mates, owners, villagers)
				if (entity.hasLineOfSight(other)) {
					if (seenThreats == null) {
						seenThreats = new ArrayList<>();
					}
					seenThreats.add(other);
				}
			}
		}

		// Read hallucination timer (1.21.1 raw int getter)
		int hallucinationTimer = 0;
		try {
			hallucinationTimer = entity.getPersistentData().getInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination");
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		// Determine if navigation re-pathing is needed this tick
		boolean shouldUpdateNav = false;
		if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
			// Recalculate immediately on collision, routine update every 8 ticks (staggered by entity ID),
			// or when navigation finished/idle check every 4 ticks (staggered) instead of every single tick
			shouldUpdateNav = entity.horizontalCollision
				|| ((entity.tickCount + entity.getId()) % 8 == 0)
				|| (mob.getNavigation().isDone() && ((entity.tickCount + entity.getId()) % 4 == 0));
		}

		// 3. Fleeing logic: Real Threats vs Phantom Hallucinations
		if (seenThreats != null && !seenThreats.isEmpty()) {
			// Real entities seen: clear any phantom hallucination timer because active threats take priority
			if (hallucinationTimer > 0) {
				try {
					entity.getPersistentData().putInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination", 0);
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				}
			}

			double entityX = entity.getX();
			double entityZ = entity.getZ();
			double repelX = 0.0;
			double repelZ = 0.0;
			LivingEntity nearestThreat = null;
			double minDistanceSq = Double.MAX_VALUE;

			for (LivingEntity threat : seenThreats) {
				double distSq = entity.distanceToSqr(threat);
				if (distSq < minDistanceSq) {
					minDistanceSq = distSq;
					nearestThreat = threat;
				}

				double dx = entityX - threat.getX();
				double dz = entityZ - threat.getZ();
				double hDistSq = dx * dx + dz * dz;
				if (hDistSq > 0.0001) {
					double hDist = Math.sqrt(hDistSq);
					double dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
					double scale = 1.0 / (hDist * Math.max(0.5, dist));
					repelX += dx * scale;
					repelZ += dz * scale;
				}
			}

			Vec3 repelVector;
			double rLenSq = repelX * repelX + repelZ * repelZ;
			if (rLenSq < 0.0001) {
				double rx = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
				double rz = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
				double rLen = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz);
				if (rLen > 0.0001) {
					repelVector = new Vec3(rx / rLen, 0.0, rz / rLen);
				} else {
					repelVector = new Vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				}
			} else {
				double rLen = Math.sqrt(rLenSq);
				repelVector = new Vec3(repelX / rLen, 0.0, repelZ / rLen);
			}

			Vec3 fleeTarget = entity.position().add(repelVector.scale(14.0));

			if (shouldUpdateNav && entity instanceof PathfinderMob pathfinderMob && nearestThreat != null) {
				try {
					Vec3 randomAway = DefaultRandomPos.getPosAway(pathfinderMob, 16, 7, nearestThreat.position());
					if (randomAway != null) {
						fleeTarget = randomAway;
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				}
			}

			executeFleeMovement(entity, fleeTarget, repelVector, shouldUpdateNav);

			// Erratic panicked glances while fleeing: rapidly look back at threats
			if (entity instanceof Mob mob && entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.30f) {
				if (nearestThreat != null && entity.getRandom().nextBoolean()) {
					mob.getLookControl().setLookAt(nearestThreat.getX(), nearestThreat.getEyeY(), nearestThreat.getZ());
				} else {
					float jitterYaw = (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 140.0f;
					mob.setYRot(mob.getYRot() + jitterYaw);
					mob.setYHeadRot(mob.getYRot());
				}
			}
		} else {
			// No real entities in sight: Handle Phantom Hallucinations & Paranoid Twitches
			if (hallucinationTimer > 0) {
				hallucinationTimer--;
				try {
					entity.getPersistentData().putInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination", hallucinationTimer);
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				}

				// Generate or maintain phantom flee vector away from an imaginary threat
				double px = Math.cos(entity.tickCount * 0.15);
				double pz = Math.sin(entity.tickCount * 0.15);
				if (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.10f) {
					px = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
					pz = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() - 0.5;
				}
				double pLen = Math.sqrt(px * px + pz * pz);
				Vec3 phantomRepel = pLen > 0.0001 ? new Vec3(px / pLen, 0.0, pz / pLen) : new Vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
				Vec3 fleeTarget = entity.position().add(phantomRepel.scale(12.0));

				if (shouldUpdateNav && entity instanceof PathfinderMob pathfinderMob) {
					try {
						Vec3 randomAway = DefaultRandomPos.getPos(pathfinderMob, 14, 7);
						if (randomAway != null) {
							fleeTarget = randomAway;
						}
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {
					}
				}

				executeFleeMovement(entity, fleeTarget, phantomRepel, shouldUpdateNav);

				// Panicked erratic head jerking during hallucination
				if (entity instanceof Mob mob && entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.35f) {
					float jitterYaw = (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 180.0f;
					mob.setYRot(mob.getYRot() + jitterYaw);
					mob.setYHeadRot(mob.getYRot());
				}
			} else {
				// 2% chance per tick (~every 2.5 seconds) to hallucinate a phantom threat in the shadows
				if (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.02f) {
					int newTimer = 30 + entity.getRandom().nextInt(40);
					try {
						entity.getPersistentData().putInt("prosopagnosia_hallucination", newTimer);
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {
					}
					// Sudden startle jump
					if (entity.onGround()) {
						entity.setDeltaMovement(entity.getDeltaMovement().add(0.0, 0.25, 0.0));
					}
				} else {
					// Paranoid idle scanning: frequently look around, checking behind their back
					if (entity instanceof Mob mob && entity.getRandom().nextFloat() < 0.20f) {
						float twitchYaw = (entity.getRandom().nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 160.0f;
						mob.setYRot(mob.getYRot() + twitchYaw);
						mob.setYHeadRot(mob.getYRot());
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static void executeFleeMovement(LivingEntity entity, Vec3 fleeTarget, Vec3 escapeDir, boolean shouldUpdateNav) {
		if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
			if (shouldUpdateNav) {
				mob.getNavigation().moveTo(fleeTarget.x, fleeTarget.y, fleeTarget.z, 1.45);
			}
			if (mob.isSprinting()) {
				mob.setSprinting(false); // Ensure no dust/walking particles spawn
			}
		} else {
			// Non-mob / aquatic / flying propulsion push
			Vec3 push = escapeDir.scale(0.035);
			entity.setDeltaMovement(entity.getDeltaMovement().add(push));
		}

		// Jump panic if obstructed by a wall or obstacle
		if (entity.horizontalCollision && entity.onGround()) {
			entity.setDeltaMovement(entity.getDeltaMovement().add(0.0, 0.38, 0.0));
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
	public static class ClientEvents {
		public static final boolean PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING = true;
		private static final ResourceLocation OAK_BIPED_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/oak_biped.png");
		private static final ResourceLocation OAK_BIPED_SLIM_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/oak_biped_slim.png");
		private static final ResourceLocation OAK_PLANKS_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:textures/block/oak_planks.png");
		private static boolean isRenderingSplinter = false;

		private static boolean isSlimPlayer(Player player) {
		if (player instanceof AbstractClientPlayer clientPlayer) {
			try {
				return clientPlayer.getSkin().model() == net.minecraft.client.resources.PlayerSkin.Model.SLIM
						|| "slim".equalsIgnoreCase(clientPlayer.getSkin().model().id());
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player != null && hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			if (mc.getMusicManager() != null) {
				mc.getMusicManager().stopPlaying();
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onPlaySound(PlaySoundEvent event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}

		if (event.getSound() != null) {
			ResourceLocation loc = event.getSound().getLocation();
			if (loc != null && "the_backwoods".equals(loc.getNamespace())) {
				return;
			}

			String name = event.getName() != null ? event.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) : "";
			if (name.startsWith("the_backwoods:") || name.contains("the_backwoods")) {
				return;
			}

			SoundSource source = event.getSound().getSource();
			if (source == SoundSource.MUSIC || source == SoundSource.AMBIENT || source == SoundSource.RECORDS) {
				event.setSound(null);
				return;
			}

			String path = loc != null ? loc.getPath().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) : "";
			if (name.contains("music") || name.contains("ambient") || path.contains("music") || path.contains("ambient")) {
				event.setSound(null);
			}
		}
	}

	// ---- Fog distance / sky override -------------------------------------------------
	private static final float FOG_START = 56.0f;
	private static final float FOG_END = 96.0f;

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderFog(ViewportEvent.RenderFog event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}
		// leave water / lava / powder snow fog alone
		if (event.getType() != FogType.NONE) {
			return;
		}
		event.setNearPlaneDistance(FOG_START);
		event.setFarPlaneDistance(FOG_END);
		event.setFogShape(FogShape.SPHERE);
		event.setCanceled(true); // required, otherwise vanilla values are used
	}

	/** Covers sky disc, sun, moon, stars (any dimension) with solid black right after the sky is drawn. */
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderLevelStage(RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
		if (event.getStage() != RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_SKY) {
			return;
		}
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}
		Matrix4f mv = new Matrix4f(event.getModelViewMatrix());
		Matrix4fStack stack = RenderSystem.getModelViewStack();
		stack.pushMatrix();
		stack.identity();
		RenderSystem.applyModelViewMatrix();
		RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();
		RenderSystem.depthMask(false);
		RenderSystem.disableBlend();
		RenderSystem.disableCull();
		RenderSystem.setShader(GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);
		BufferBuilder b = Tesselator.getInstance().begin(VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
		float s = 50.0f;
		float[][] faces = {
			{-s, -s, -s, s, -s, -s, s, s, -s, -s, s, -s},
			{-s, -s, s, s, -s, s, s, s, s, -s, s, s},
			{-s, -s, -s, -s, -s, s, -s, s, s, -s, s, -s},
			{s, -s, -s, s, -s, s, s, s, s, s, s, -s},
			{-s, -s, -s, s, -s, -s, s, -s, s, -s, -s, s},
			{-s, s, -s, s, s, -s, s, s, s, -s, s, s}
		};
		for (float[] f : faces) {
			for (int i = 0; i < 12; i += 3) {
				b.addVertex(mv, f[i], f[i + 1], f[i + 2]).setColor(0, 0, 0, 255);
			}
		}
		BufferUploader.drawWithShader(b.buildOrThrow());
		RenderSystem.enableCull();
		RenderSystem.depthMask(true);
		RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
		stack.popMatrix();
		RenderSystem.applyModelViewMatrix();
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onComputeFogColor(ViewportEvent.ComputeFogColor event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player != null && hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			event.setRed(0.0f);
			event.setGreen(0.0f);
			event.setBlue(0.0f);
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderNameTag(RenderNameTagEvent event) {
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player != null && hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			event.setCanRender(TriState.FALSE);
			event.setContent(Component.empty());
		}
	}

	private static MultiBufferSource wrapBuffers(MultiBufferSource original, ResourceLocation texture, boolean proceduralUv) {
		RenderType splinterType = RenderType.entityCutoutNoCull(texture);
		return renderType -> {
			if (renderType != null) {
				String str = renderType.toString().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
				if (str.contains("atlas") || str.contains("item") || str.contains("block") || str.contains("glint") || str.contains("gui") || str.contains("crumbling") || str.contains("translucent")) {
					return original.getBuffer(renderType);
				}
				if (str.contains("entity") || str.contains("armor") || str.contains("player")) {
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer base = original.getBuffer(splinterType);
					if (proceduralUv) {
						int[] count = new int[]{0};
						return (com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer) java.lang.reflect.Proxy.newProxyInstance(
							com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer.class.getClassLoader(),
							new Class<?>[]{com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer.class},
							(proxy, method, args) -> {
								String name = method.getName();
								if (name.startsWith("vertex") || name.startsWith("addVertex")) {
									count[0]++;
								} else if (name.equals("uv") || name.equals("setUv")) {
									if (args != null && args.length == 2 && args[0] instanceof Number && args[1] instanceof Number) {
										int idx = Math.max(0, count[0] - 1) & 3;
										float nu = (idx == 1 || idx == 2) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
										float nv = (idx == 2 || idx == 3) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
										args[0] = nu;
										args[1] = nv;
									}
								}
								Object res = method.invoke(base, args);
								return res == base ? proxy : res;
							}
						);
					}
					return base;
				}
			}
			return original.getBuffer(renderType);
		};
	}

	private static boolean isBiped(LivingEntity entity, Object renderer) {
		if (entity instanceof Player) {
			return true;
		}

		if (isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			return false;
		}

		// Never replace skeleton skin or non-human shaped mobs (skeletons have bone UVs, illagers/villagers have robes & joined arms, piglins have snouts/ears)
		if (entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.AbstractSkeleton
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.piglin.AbstractPiglin
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.AbstractIllager
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.npc.AbstractVillager
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Witch
				|| entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.ZombieVillager) {
			return false;
		}

		// Standard human-shaped zombies (Zombie, Husk, Drowned)
		if (entity instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Zombie) {
			return true;
		}

		// Safe model check avoiding direct PlayerModel/ZombieModel class references for maximum compatibility
		if (renderer instanceof LivingEntityRenderer<?, ?> livingRenderer) {
			Object model = livingRenderer.getModel();
			if (model != null) {
				String modelName = model.getClass().getSimpleName();
				if (modelName.contains("Player") || modelName.contains("Zombie")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		if (entity != null) {
			String name = entity.getClass().getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
			if (name.contains("splinter")) {
				return true;
			}
		}

		return false;
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderPlayerPre(RenderPlayerEvent.Pre event) {
		if (isRenderingSplinter) {
			return;
		}
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}

		Player target = event.getEntity();
		if (target == null || target == mc.player) {
			return;
		}

		event.setCanceled(true);

		try {
			isRenderingSplinter = true;
			PlayerRenderer renderer = event.getRenderer();
			ResourceLocation texture = isSlimPlayer(target) ? OAK_BIPED_SLIM_TEXTURE : OAK_BIPED_TEXTURE;
			MultiBufferSource bufferSource = wrapBuffers(event.getMultiBufferSource(), texture, false);
			PoseStack poseStack = event.getPoseStack();

			renderer.render(
				(AbstractClientPlayer) target,
				target.getYRot(),
				event.getPartialTick(),
				poseStack,
				bufferSource,
				event.getPackedLight()
			);
		} finally {
			isRenderingSplinter = false;
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderLivingPre(RenderLivingEvent.Pre<?, ?> event) {
		if (isRenderingSplinter) {
			return;
		}
		Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (mc.player == null || !hasProsopagnosia(mc.player)) {
			return;
		}

		LivingEntity entity = event.getEntity();
		if (entity == null || entity == mc.player || entity instanceof Player || isBackwoodsEntity(entity)) {
			return;
		}

		boolean isBipedMob = isBiped(entity, event.getRenderer());
		if (!PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING && !isBipedMob) {
			return;
		}

		event.setCanceled(true);

		try {
			isRenderingSplinter = true;
			@SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")
			LivingEntityRenderer rawRenderer = (LivingEntityRenderer) event.getRenderer();
			ResourceLocation texture = (!PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING || isBipedMob) ? OAK_BIPED_TEXTURE : OAK_PLANKS_TEXTURE;
			boolean useProceduralUv = PROCEDURAL_TEXTURING && !isBipedMob;
			MultiBufferSource bufferSource = wrapBuffers(event.getMultiBufferSource(), texture, useProceduralUv);
			PoseStack poseStack = event.getPoseStack();

			//noinspection unchecked
			rawRenderer.render(
				entity,
				entity.getYRot(),
				event.getPartialTick(),
				poseStack,
				bufferSource,
				event.getPackedLight()
			);
		} finally {
			isRenderingSplinter = false;
		}
	}
} // ClientEvents
} // Prosopagnosia (1.21.1)

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileWriter;

public class PrototaxitesFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    // MANDATORY RULE: Never remove the self-writing JSON logic from custom feature classes
    public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN = true;

    static {
        if (ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) {
            autoGenerateDataPackJsons();
        }
    }

    private static BlockState CACHED_LIGNUM_CARO = null;

    public PrototaxitesFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    public static void autoGenerateDataPackJsons() {
        if (!ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) return;

        try {
            String[] candidateRoots = new String[] {
                "src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "../src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "../../src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "build/resources/main/data/the_backwoods"
            };

            for (String rootPath : candidateRoots) {
                File rootDir = new File(rootPath);
                File parent = rootDir.getParentFile();

                if (rootDir.exists() || (parent != null && parent.exists())) {
                    File confDir = new File(rootDir, "worldgen/configured_feature");
                    confDir.mkdirs();
                    File confFile = new File(confDir, "prototaxites.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(confFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"type\": \"the_backwoods:prototaxites\",\n  \"config\": {}\n}");
                    }

                    // Rarity filter set to 100 per chunk
                    File placedDir = new File(rootDir, "worldgen/placed_feature");
                    placedDir.mkdirs();
                    File placedFile = new File(placedDir, "prototaxites_placed.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(placedFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"feature\": \"the_backwoods:prototaxites\",\n  \"placement\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:rarity_filter\",\n      \"chance\": 100\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:in_square\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:heightmap\",\n      \"heightmap\": \"WORLD_SURFACE_WG\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:biome\"\n    }\n  ]\n}");
                    }

                    // Strictly generates only in the Wood Plains biome
                    File biomeDir = new File(rootDir, "neoforge/biome_modifier");
                    biomeDir.mkdirs();
                    File biomeFile = new File(biomeDir, "add_prototaxites.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(biomeFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"type\": \"neoforge:add_features\",\n  \"biomes\": [\n    \"the_backwoods:wood_plains\"\n  ],\n  \"features\": \"the_backwoods:prototaxites_placed\",\n  \"step\": \"surface_structures\"\n}");
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private static BlockState getLignumCaroState() {
        if (CACHED_LIGNUM_CARO != null) {
            return CACHED_LIGNUM_CARO;
        }
        try {
            Block block = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.get(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("the_backwoods", "lignum_caro"));
            if (block != null && block != Blocks.AIR) {
                BlockState state = block.defaultBlockState();
                var infectedProp = state.getBlock().getStateDefinition().getProperty("infected");
                if (infectedProp instanceof BooleanProperty boolProp) {
                    state = state.setValue(boolProp, false);
                }
                CACHED_LIGNUM_CARO = state;
                return state;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        CACHED_LIGNUM_CARO = Blocks.OAK_LOG.defaultBlockState();
        return CACHED_LIGNUM_CARO;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level = context.level();
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        RandomSource random = context.random();

        int chunkBaseX = origin.getX() & ~15;
        int chunkBaseZ = origin.getZ() & ~15;

        // Keep 4 blocks inward from chunk boundaries to guarantee zero cross-chunk cascading
        int centerX = chunkBaseX + 4 + random.nextInt(8);
        int centerZ = chunkBaseZ + 4 + random.nextInt(8);
        int surfaceY = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, centerX, centerZ);

        if (surfaceY < level.getMinBuildHeight() + 10 || surfaceY > level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 20) {
            return false;
        }

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos placePos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        // Verify terrain foundation is solid ground
        placePos.set(centerX, surfaceY - 1, centerZ);
        BlockState ground = level.getBlockState(placePos);
        if (ground.isAir() || ground.canBeReplaced() || ground.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock) {
            return false;
        }

        BlockState lignumCaro = getLignumCaroState();

        // Prototaxites height: strictly 7 to 8 blocks tall
        int totalHeight = 7 + random.nextInt(2);

        // Optional natural lean/curvature (at most 1 block offset over full height)
        int leanDirX = (random.nextFloat() < 0.35f) ? (random.nextBoolean() ? 1 : -1) : 0;
        int leanDirZ = (leanDirX == 0 && random.nextFloat() < 0.35f) ? (random.nextBoolean() ? 1 : -1) : 0;

        // 1. Solid Downward Foundation Seal (Extrude 1 to 3 blocks deep under flared base)
        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                for (int dy = -1; dy >= -3; dy--) {
                    placePos.set(centerX + dx, surfaceY + dy, centerZ + dz);
                    BlockState st = level.getBlockState(placePos);
                    if (st.isAir() || st.canBeReplaced() || st.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock) {
                        level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Prototaxites Monolithic Column (Flared Base -> Tapered Trunk -> Rounded Apex)
        for (int h = 0; h < totalHeight; h++) {
            int currentY = surfaceY + h;
            int curCenterX = centerX + (leanDirX * h) / totalHeight;
            int curCenterZ = centerZ + (leanDirZ * h) / totalHeight;

            if (h == 0) {
                // Layer 0: Flared base foot (3x3 cross plus organic flare corners)
                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                    for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
                        boolean isCorner = (Math.abs(dx) == 1 && Math.abs(dz) == 1);
                        if (!isCorner || random.nextFloat() < 0.65f) {
                            placePos.set(curCenterX + dx, currentY, curCenterZ + dz);
                            level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else if (h == 1) {
                // Layer 1: Base transition collar (3x3 cross: center + 4 cardinal sides)
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                placePos.set(curCenterX + 1, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                placePos.set(curCenterX - 1, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ + 1);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ - 1);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
            } else if (h >= 2 && h <= 3) {
                // Layers 2 to 3: Stout trunk (2x2 or 4-block cluster with annular swell)
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                placePos.set(curCenterX + 1, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ + 1);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                if (h == 2) {
                    placePos.set(curCenterX + 1, currentY, curCenterZ + 1);
                    level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                }
            } else if (h >= 4 && h <= 5) {
                // Layers 4 to 5: Tapering upper stem (2 blocks: center + 1 side block)
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                if (h == 4) {
                    placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ + 1);
                    level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
                }
            } else {
                // Layers 6 to 7: Blunt rounded dome summit (single central block cap)
                placePos.set(curCenterX, currentY, curCenterZ);
                level.setBlock(placePos, lignumCaro, 2);
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.recipe.brewing;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.brewing.RegisterBrewingRecipesEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.brewing.IBrewingRecipe;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;

import net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.Ingredient;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potions;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.PotionContents;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potion;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
import net.minecraft.core.Holder;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModPotions;

import java.util.Optional;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class AtrophyRecipeBrewingRecipe implements IBrewingRecipe {
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(RegisterBrewingRecipesEvent event) {
		event.getBuilder().addRecipe(new AtrophyRecipeBrewingRecipe());
	}

	@Override
	public boolean isInput(ItemStack input) {
		Item inputItem = input.getItem();
		Optional<Holder<Potion>> optionalPotion = input.getOrDefault(DataComponents.POTION_CONTENTS, PotionContents.EMPTY).potion();
		return (inputItem == Items.POTION || inputItem == Items.SPLASH_POTION || inputItem == Items.LINGERING_POTION) && optionalPotion.isPresent() && optionalPotion.get().is(Potions.AWKWARD);
	}

	@Override
	public boolean isIngredient(ItemStack ingredient) {
		return Ingredient.of(new ItemStack(Items.PHANTOM_MEMBRANE)).test(ingredient);
	}

	@Override
	public ItemStack getOutput(ItemStack input, ItemStack ingredient) {
		if (isInput(input) && isIngredient(ingredient)) {
			return PotionContents.createItemStack(input.getItem(), TheBackwoodsModPotions.ATROPHY_POTION);
		}
		return ItemStack.EMPTY;
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.recipe.brewing;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.brewing.RegisterBrewingRecipesEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.brewing.IBrewingRecipe;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;

import net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.Ingredient;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.PotionContents;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potion;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.TheBackwoodsModPotions;

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

// 1.21.1 neoforge compatible
import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class RightSideUpCityFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    public RightSideUpCityFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level  = context.level();
        BlockPos      origin = context.origin();

        // --- CONFIGURABLE CITY SETTINGS ---
        int floorY = 63;               
        int gridSize = 10;             // Building grid spacing (blocks)

        int minBuildingWidthX  = 5;    
        int maxBuildingWidthX  = 8;   
        int minBuildingWidthZ  = 5;    
        int maxBuildingWidthZ  = 8;   
        int minBuildingLengthY = 20;   
        int maxBuildingLengthY = 50;   

        // Configurable chance out of 100 for a building cell to generate as a hollow shell
        int hollowBuildingChance = 40;  
        // ----------------------------------

        // --- ROUNDABOUT SETTINGS ---
        int macroChunkGrid = 10;       // Spawn a roundabout every 10x10 chunks
        double parkRadius  = 24.0;     // Radius of the roundabout circle in blocks
        // ----------------------------------

        BlockState plankState = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState airState   = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();

        // Convert the origin block coordinates to raw chunk grids
        ChunkAccess chunk = level.getChunk(origin);
        int minX = origin.getX() & (~15);
        int minZ = origin.getZ() & (~15);
        int chunkX = minX >> 4;
        int chunkZ = minZ >> 4;

        // Find the center chunk coordinates for the current 10x10 macro chunk sector
        int macroSectorX = Math.floorDiv(chunkX, macroChunkGrid);
        int macroSectorZ = Math.floorDiv(chunkZ, macroChunkGrid);
        
        // Find the absolute center block point of the roundabout for this 10x10 chunk macro sector
        int centerRoundaboutX = (macroSectorX * macroChunkGrid + (macroChunkGrid / 2)) * 16 + 8;
        int centerRoundaboutZ = (macroSectorZ * macroChunkGrid + (macroChunkGrid / 2)) * 16 + 8;
        double parkRadiusSquared = parkRadius * parkRadius;
        int maxClearY = floorY + maxBuildingLengthY + 5;
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos targetPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        // Single-pass direct buffer generation loop
        for (int rx = 0; rx < 16; rx++) {
            for (int rz = 0; rz < 16; rz++) {
                int blockX = minX + rx;
                int blockZ = minZ + rz;

                // Calculate the exact distance from this block to the roundabout center point
                double dx = blockX - centerRoundaboutX;
                double dz = blockZ - centerRoundaboutZ;
                boolean isInRoundabout = dx * dx + dz * dz <= parkRadiusSquared;
                int cellX = Math.floorMod(blockX, gridSize);
                int cellZ = Math.floorMod(blockZ, gridSize);
                int sectorX = Math.floorDiv(blockX, gridSize);
                int sectorZ = Math.floorDiv(blockZ, gridSize);
                long sectorHash = ((long) sectorX * 418731283L) ^ ((long) sectorZ * 13289791L) ^ 84729184L;
                int bWidthX = minBuildingWidthX + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 4567L) % (maxBuildingWidthX - minBuildingWidthX + 1));
                int bWidthZ = minBuildingWidthZ + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 9876L) % (maxBuildingWidthZ - minBuildingWidthZ + 1));
                int bHeight = minBuildingLengthY + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash) % (maxBuildingLengthY - minBuildingLengthY + 1));
                boolean hasBuilding = Math.abs(sectorHash % 100) < 85;
                boolean isHollowBuilding = (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 12345L) % 100) < hollowBuildingChance;

                for (int currentY = floorY; currentY <= maxClearY; currentY++) {
                    targetPos.set(blockX, currentY, blockZ);

                    if (currentY == floorY) {
                        // 1. Foundation Layer Pass - Reverted parameter to false for 1.21.1
                        setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);
                    } else {
                        // 2. Above-ground Structuring Pass
                        if (isInRoundabout) {
                            // Carve everything within the radius into clear open air space
                            setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, airState);
                        } else {
                            // Standard building placement logic
                            int dy = currentY - floorY;
                            if (cellX < bWidthX && cellZ < bWidthZ && dy <= bHeight && hasBuilding) {
                                if (isHollowBuilding) {
                                    // Bounding shell detection mechanics
                                    boolean isOuterWall = (cellX == 0 || cellX == bWidthX - 1 || cellZ == 0 || cellZ == bWidthZ - 1);
                                    boolean isRoofOrFloor = (dy == 1 || dy == bHeight);

                                    if (isOuterWall || isRoofOrFloor) {
                                        setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);
                                    } else {
                                        setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, airState); // Inner structural air cavity carve
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);
                                }
                            } else {
                                setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, airState); // Clears background noise walls
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static void setIfDifferent(ChunkAccess chunk, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (chunk.getBlockState(pos) != state) {
            chunk.setBlockState(pos, state, false);
        }
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;
