@EventBusSubscriber
public class RotDataGuardian {

	public static final boolean ENABLE_GUARDIAN = true;

	public static final boolean PREVENT_VERDANT_VILTRUMITE_GRAB = true;

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
	public static void preventVerdantGrab(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
		if (ENABLE_GUARDIAN && PREVENT_VERDANT_VILTRUMITE_GRAB
				&& event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) ViltrumiteGrabGuard.check(player, true);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
	public static void releaseVerdantGrab(EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
		if (ENABLE_GUARDIAN && PREVENT_VERDANT_VILTRUMITE_GRAB
				&& event.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) ViltrumiteGrabGuard.check(player, false);
	}

	private static final class ViltrumiteGrabGuard {
		private static Class<?> api;
		private static java.lang.reflect.Method target, trying, setTrying, release, holding;
		private static boolean initialized, warned;
		private static boolean ready() {
			if (!initialized) {
				initialized = true;
				try {
					Class<?> type = Class.forName("dev.baranhan.viltrumitecore.util.ViltrumiteCorePlayer");
					target = type.getMethod("getGrabbedTarget");
					trying = type.getMethod("isTryingToGrab");
					setTrying = type.getMethod("setTryingToGrab", boolean.class);
					release = type.getMethod("releaseTarget");
					holding = type.getMethod("isHoldingSubLevel");
					api = type;
				} catch (ClassNotFoundException absent) {
					// Optional integration: no dependency required when Viltrumite Core is absent.
				} catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError failure) { warn(failure); }
			}
			return api != null;
		}
		private static void warn(Throwable failure) {
			if (!warned) {
				warned = true;
				com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger().warn("Verdant Engine Viltrumite grab integration failed", failure);
			}
		}
		private static void check(ServerPlayer player, boolean acquisition) {
			if (!ready() || !api.isInstance(player)) return;
			try {
				Object held = target.invoke(player);
				if (held instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.VerdantEngineEntity) {
					release.invoke(player); // Native release clears the synced holder ID and ViltrumiteGrabbed tag.
					setTrying.invoke(player, false);
					return;
				}
				if (!acquisition || held != null || !Boolean.TRUE.equals(trying.invoke(player))
						|| Boolean.TRUE.equals(holding.invoke(player))) return;
				// Match Core 1.11.1's acquisition order and reach before its player tick moves the target.
				var center = player.getEyePosition().add(player.getLookAngle().normalize().scale(1.5));
				for (Entity candidate : player.level().getEntities(player, new AABB(center, center).inflate(1.5))) {
					if (!(candidate instanceof LivingEntity living) || !living.isAlive()) continue;
					boolean occupied = false;
					for (Player other : player.level().players()) {
						if (api.isInstance(other) && target.invoke(other) == candidate) { occupied = true; break; }
					}
					if (occupied || api.isInstance(candidate) && target.invoke(candidate) != null) continue;
					if (candidate instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.VerdantEngineEntity)
						setTrying.invoke(player, false);
					return; // Other first targets, including the Rot, retain native behavior.
				}
			} catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) { warn(failure); }
		}
	}

	public static final boolean SILENT_SECURITY_MODE = false;
	public static final boolean ENABLE_FEEDBACK_PENALTY = true;
	public static final boolean ENABLE_LIGHTNING_STRIKES = false;
	public static final boolean ENABLE_SOUND_EFFECTS = false;
	public static final boolean ENABLE_PARTICLE_EFFECTS = false;
	public static final boolean ENABLE_BROADCAST_WARNINGS = false;
	
	public static final String MSG_COMMAND_BLOCKED = "§c[System] Lethal Feedback Protocol: Remote administrative override blocked on structural target.§r";
	public static final String MSG_TAMPER_DETECTED = "§c[System] Structural anomaly detected (%s). Re-synchronizing atomics.§r";
	public static final String MSG_FEEDBACK_TRIGGERED = "§4[System] Lethal Feedback Protocol engaged. Neural suppression active. Access denied.§r";

	private static final StackWalker WALKER = StackWalker.getInstance(StackWalker.Option.RETAIN_CLASS_REFERENCE);
	private static boolean isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller() {
		return WALKER.walk(s -> s.map(StackWalker.StackFrame::getDeclaringClass)
			.filter(c -> c != RotDataGuardian.class)
			.findFirst()
			.map(c -> c.getModule() == RotDataGuardian.class.getModule()
				&& c.getClassLoader() == RotDataGuardian.class.getClassLoader()
				&& c.getName().startsWith("net.mcreator.thebackwoods."))
			.orElse(false));
	}

	private static final class RotVaultState {
		double validatedMaxHealth;
		double validatedHealth;
		int damageGraceTicks;
		int lastGraceTick = -1;
		int expectedGoals;
		int expectedTargets;
		boolean deathSequenceActive;
		boolean deathSequenceFinished;
		java.util.UUID authorizedKillerUUID;
		boolean advancementGranted;
	}

	private static final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, RotVaultState> ROT_SECURITY_VAULT = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	private static RotVaultState getVault(Entity entity) {
		return ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.computeIfAbsent(entity.getUUID(), k -> new RotVaultState());
	}

	private static final java.util.Set<java.util.UUID> FINISHED = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

	public static void authorizeVerdantFinished(Entity e) {
		if (e == null || !isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) return;
		FINISHED.add(e.getUUID());
		e.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_death_sequence_finished", true);
	}

	private static boolean isFinished(Entity e) {
		return e != null && FINISHED.contains(e.getUUID());
	}

	public static void authorizeDamageGrace(Entity entity, int ticks) {
		if (entity == null || !isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) return;
		RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
		v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, ticks);
		entity.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", v.damageGraceTicks);
	}

	public static void startRotDeathSequence(RotEntity rot, @Nullable Entity killer) {
		if (rot == null || rot.level().isClientSide()) return;

		rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", false);
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 0.0);
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 0.0);
		rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed", false);
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_railgun_heat_ticks", 0.0);

		try {
			rot.getEntityData().set(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, true);
		} catch (Exception ignored) {}
		rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active", true);
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_ticks", 240.0);
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_start_x", rot.getX());
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_start_y", rot.getY());
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_start_z", rot.getZ());
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_target_height", 12.0 + (Math.random() * 4.0));
		rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_hole_size", 8.0 + (Math.random() * 0.5));
		rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_hole_spawned", false);

		RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
		if (v != null) {
			v.deathSequenceActive = true;
			v.damageGraceTicks = 300;
			v.validatedHealth = 1.0;
			if (v.authorizedKillerUUID == null) {
				ServerPlayer player = killer instanceof ServerPlayer sp ? sp
					: rot.getKillCredit() instanceof ServerPlayer sp ? sp : null;
				if (player != null) {
					v.authorizedKillerUUID = player.getUUID();
					rot.getPersistentData().putString("rot_boss_killer_uuid", player.getStringUUID());
				}
			}
		}

		rot.setHealth(1.0F);
		rot.deathTime = 0;
		rot.hurtTime = 0;
		rot.setInvulnerable(true);
		rot.setInvisible(false);
		rot.setDeltaMovement(net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3.ZERO);
		rot.hasImpulse = false;
		rot.noPhysics = true;

		if (rot instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob mob) {
			mob.setNoAi(true);
			mob.getNavigation().stop();
			mob.setTarget(null);
			mob.setLastHurtByMob(null);
		}
	}

	public static void authorizeDeathSequenceActive(Entity entity) {
		authorizeDeathSequenceActive(entity, null);
	}

	public static void authorizeDeathSequenceActive(Entity entity, @Nullable Entity killer) {
		if (!(entity instanceof RotEntity rot) || entity.level().isClientSide()) return;
		startRotDeathSequence(rot, killer);
	}

	public static void grantRotBossAdvancement(Entity entity) {
		if (!(entity instanceof RotEntity rot) || entity.level().isClientSide()) return;
		net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag tag = entity.getPersistentData();
		double ticks = tag.getDouble("rot_death_ticks");
		if (!tag.getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active")
			|| !rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath)
			|| !Double.isFinite(ticks) || ticks <= 0 || ticks > 240
			|| rot.getHealth() > 25.0F) return;
		RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
		if (v.advancementGranted || tag.getBoolean("rot_boss_advancement_granted")) return;
		String credited = tag.getString("rot_boss_killer_uuid");
		java.util.UUID killer;
		try { killer = java.util.UUID.fromString(credited); }
		catch (IllegalArgumentException invalidCredit) { return; }
		ServerPlayer player = entity.level().getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(killer);
		if (player == null) return;
		AdvancementHolder adv = player.level().getServer().getAdvancements().get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rot_boss"));
		if (adv == null) return;
		// Latch before award callbacks; never revoke progress in response to a later attack.
		v.advancementGranted = true;
		tag.putBoolean("rot_boss_advancement_granted", true);
		AdvancementProgress progress = player.getAdvancements().getOrStartProgress(adv);
		for (String criterion : progress.getRemainingCriteria())
			player.getAdvancements().award(adv, criterion);
	}

	public static void authorizeDeathSequenceFinished(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null || !isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) return;
		FINISHED.add(entity.getUUID());
		RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
		v.deathSequenceFinished = true;
		entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_finished", true);
	}

	public static boolean isTheBackwoodsItem(@Nullable ItemStack stack) {
		if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty()) return false;
		net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation key = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(stack.getItem());
		return key != null && "the_backwoods".equals(key.getNamespace());
	}

	public static boolean isTheBackwoodsAttack(@Nullable DamageSource ds) {
		if (ds == null) return false;
		Entity attacker = ds.getEntity();
		if (attacker instanceof LivingEntity living) {
			if (isTheBackwoodsItem(living.getMainHandItem()) || isTheBackwoodsItem(living.getOffhandItem())) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		Entity direct = ds.getDirectEntity();
		if (direct != null) {
			net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation entKey = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(direct.getType());
			if (entKey != null && "the_backwoods".equals(entKey.getNamespace())) {
				return true;
			}
			if (direct instanceof LivingEntity livingDirect) {
				if (isTheBackwoodsItem(livingDirect.getMainHandItem()) || isTheBackwoodsItem(livingDirect.getOffhandItem())) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		}
		try {
			if (ds.typeHolder() != null && ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().isPresent()) {
				if ("the_backwoods".equals(ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().get().location().getNamespace())) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
		String msgId = ds.getMsgId();
		if (msgId != null && (msgId.startsWith("the_backwoods:") || msgId.startsWith("the_backwoods."))) {
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static boolean isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled() {
		return true;
	}

	public static boolean isShootingStarDamage(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds) {
		if (ds == null) return false;
		try {
			if (ds.typeHolder() != null && ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().isPresent()) {
				String typeId = ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().get().location().toString().toLowerCase();
				if (typeId.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star") || typeId.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star_hit")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
		String msgId = ds.getMsgId();
		if (msgId != null) {
			String lower = msgId.toLowerCase();
			return lower.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star") || lower.equals("shooting_star_demo:shooting_star_hit")
				|| lower.equals("shooting_star_demo.shooting_star") || lower.equals("shooting_star_demo.shooting_star_hit")
				|| lower.equals("shooting_star") || lower.equals("shooting_star_hit");
		}
		return false;
	}

	
	public static boolean isApotheosisExecutionDamage(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds) {
		if (ds == null) return false;
		try {
			if (ds.typeHolder() != null && ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().isPresent()) {
				String typeId = ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().get().location().toString().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
				if (typeId.equals("apotheosis:execute") || typeId.contains("apotheosis:execute") || typeId.contains("execute") || typeId.contains("executing") || typeId.contains("decapitat")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
		String msgId = ds.getMsgId();
		if (msgId != null) {
			String lower = msgId.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
			return lower.contains("apotheosis:execute") || lower.contains("apotheosis.execute") || lower.equals("execute") || lower.contains("execute") || lower.contains("executing") || lower.contains("decapitat");
		}
		return false;
	}



	public static boolean isRonovaEntity(@Nullable Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		String cls = entity.getClass().getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
		String name = entity.getName().getString().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
		return cls.contains("ronova") || name.contains("ronova");
	}

	public static boolean isRonovaDoomDamage(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds) {
		if (ds == null) return false;
		try {
			if (ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().isPresent()
				&& ds.typeHolder().unwrapKey().get().location().getNamespace().equals("ronova")) return true;
		} catch (RuntimeException ignored) {}
		String id = ds.getMsgId();
		if (id != null && (id.startsWith("ronova:") || id.startsWith("ronova."))) return true;
		// slay() falls back to generic kill damage, then finish() directly sets health to zero.
		for (StackTraceElement frame : Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()) {
			String cls = frame.getClassName();
			if (cls.equals("dev.mian.ronova.ability.RonovaDeath")
				|| cls.equals("dev.mian.ronova.ability.TotemDoom")) return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static final class RonovaGuard {
		private static boolean initialized;
		private static java.lang.reflect.Field ashenField;
		private static java.lang.reflect.Field doomedField;

		private static void init() {
			if (!initialized) {
				initialized = true;
				try {
					Class<?> deathCls = Class.forName("dev.mian.ronova.ability.RonovaDeath", false, RotDataGuardian.class.getClassLoader());
					for (var f : deathCls.getDeclaredFields()) {
						if (java.util.Map.class.isAssignableFrom(f.getType()) || java.util.Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(f.getType())) {
							f.setAccessible(true);
							if (f.getName().equalsIgnoreCase("ASHEN")) ashenField = f;
						}
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
				try {
					Class<?> totemCls = Class.forName("dev.mian.ronova.ability.TotemDoom", false, RotDataGuardian.class.getClassLoader());
					for (var f : totemCls.getDeclaredFields()) {
						if (java.util.Map.class.isAssignableFrom(f.getType()) || java.util.Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(f.getType())) {
							f.setAccessible(true);
							if (f.getName().equalsIgnoreCase("DOOMED")) doomedField = f;
						}
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
			}
		}

		public static void purgeDoom(Entity entity) {
			if (entity == null) return;
			try {
				entity.removeTag("ronova_doomed");
				entity.removeTag("ronova_ashen");
				var tags = new java.util.ArrayList<>(entity.getTags());
				for (String tag : tags) {
					if (tag != null && tag.startsWith("ronova")) {
						entity.removeTag(tag);
					}
				}
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
			init();
			try {
				if (ashenField != null) {
					Object val = ashenField.get(null);
					if (val instanceof java.util.Map<?, ?> map) {
						map.remove(entity);
						map.remove(entity.getUUID());
						map.remove(entity.getId());
					} else if (val instanceof java.util.Collection<?> col) {
						col.remove(entity);
						col.remove(entity.getUUID());
					}
				}
				if (doomedField != null) {
					Object val = doomedField.get(null);
					if (val instanceof java.util.Map<?, ?> map) {
						map.remove(entity);
						map.remove(entity.getUUID());
						map.remove(entity.getId());
					} else if (val instanceof java.util.Collection<?> col) {
						col.remove(entity);
						col.remove(entity.getUUID());
					}
				}
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static final class ShootingStarGuard {
		private static final java.util.Map<Entity, Float> health = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new java.util.WeakHashMap<>());
		private static final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, Entity> pending = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
		private static final java.util.List<java.lang.reflect.Field> watches = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
		private static boolean discovered, warned;

		private static boolean protects(Entity entity) {
			return entity instanceof RotEntity
				|| entity instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.VerdantEngineEntity;
		}

		private static void contact(Entity entity) {
			if (!(entity instanceof LivingEntity living)) return;
			if (!isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity)) {
				if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
					if (!entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_supercharged_mode")) {
						boolean absorbing = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 20;
						if (!absorbing) {
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_railgun_heat_ticks", 160);
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_railgun_hit_toggle", false);
						}
					}
				} else if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot && isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled()) {
					living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
					living.deathTime = living.hurtTime = living.hurtDuration = 0;
					living.invulnerableTime = 40;
					living.setInvulnerable(true);
					living.setInvisible(true);
					rot.getEntityData().set(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
					RotVaultState vault = getVault(rot);
					vault.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(vault.damageGraceTicks, 60);
					vault.validatedHealth = rot.getMaxHealth();
					entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
					entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
					entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
					entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
					entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed", true);
					entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_railgun_heat_ticks", 60.0);
					entity.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 60);
				}
			}
			health.put(entity, living.getHealth());
		}

		private static void preventDeath(LivingEntity entity) {
			if (entity.getHealth() <= 0.0F)
				entity.setHealth(Math.max(1.0F, health.getOrDefault(entity, 1.0F)));
			entity.deathTime = 0;
			contact(entity);
		}

		private static boolean capture(Entity entity) {
			if (!protects(entity)) return false;
			boolean shootingStar = java.util.Arrays.stream(Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace()).anyMatch(frame ->
				frame.getClassName().contains("shootingstardemo"));
			if (!shootingStar) return false;
			registerProtectedDeathEntity(entity);
			contact(entity);
			pending.put(entity.getUUID(), entity);
			return true; // The level's removal callback must finish before this instance is re-registered.
		}

		private static void forgetWatch(java.util.UUID uuid, Entity entity) throws ReflectiveOperationException {
			if (!discovered) {
				discovered = true;
				for (String[] binding : new String[][] {
					{"cyou.rimuru.shootingstardemo.mc1211.star.d", "e"},
					{"dev.aek.shootingstardemo.mc1211.star.Erasure", "WATCHED"}
				}) {
					try {
						Class<?> type = Class.forName(binding[0], false, RotDataGuardian.class.getClassLoader());
						var field = type.getDeclaredField(binding[1]);
						field.setAccessible(true);
						watches.add(field);
					} catch (ClassNotFoundException absent) {
						// Optional integration: no dependency on either Shooting Star version.
					}
				}
			}
			for (var field : watches) {
				Object value = field.get(null);
				if (value instanceof java.util.Map<?, ?> map) map.remove(uuid);
				else if (value instanceof java.util.List<?> list) {
					for (var iterator = list.iterator(); iterator.hasNext();) {
						Object watch = iterator.next();
						var victim = watch.getClass().getDeclaredField("victim");
						victim.setAccessible(true);
						if (victim.get(watch) == entity) iterator.remove();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
		public static void afterShootingStar(ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || pending.isEmpty()) return;
			for (var iterator = pending.entrySet().iterator(); iterator.hasNext();) {
				var entry = iterator.next();
				Entity entity = entry.getValue();
				if (!(entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)
						|| level.getDifficulty() == net.minecraft.world.Difficulty.PEACEFUL) {
					iterator.remove();
					continue;
				}
				// Respect the mod's authorized final removal, even if it finished after capture.
				if (isFinished(entity)) {
					iterator.remove();
					continue;
				}
				try {
					forgetWatch(entry.getKey(), entity); // Remove only this boss, never other victims or blast zones.
					Entity registered = level.getEntity(entry.getKey());
					if (registered != null && registered != entity) {
						iterator.remove(); // Do not replace a different live instance with the same UUID.
						continue;
					}
					if (registered == null) {
						clearEntityRemoval(entity);
						if (!level.addFreshEntity(entity)) continue;
					}
					iterator.remove(); // Re-registration pairs the original instance back to tracking clients.
				} catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) {
					if (!warned) {
						warned = true;
						System.getLogger(RotDataGuardian.class.getName()).log(System.Logger.Level.WARNING,
							"Shooting Star boss recovery could not finish; retaining the pending instance", failure);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void stop(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStoppedEvent event) {
			pending.clear();
			health.clear();
			FINISHED.clear();
		}
	}

	public static boolean isRot(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		return entity instanceof RotEntity;
	}

	public static boolean isVerdantEngine(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		return entity instanceof net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.VerdantEngineEntity;
	}

	public static boolean isStructuralBoss(Entity entity) {
		return isRot(entity) || isVerdantEngine(entity);
	}

	public static boolean isBossDeathSequenceActive(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return false;
		if (isRot(entity)) {
			RotVaultState v = ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.get(entity.getUUID());
			if (v != null && v.deathSequenceActive) return true;
			boolean flagged = false;
			try {
				if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot && rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath)) flagged = true;
			} catch (Exception ignored) {}
			if (!flagged) {
				flagged = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
			}
			if (flagged) {
				if (!entity.level().isClientSide() && v != null && v.validatedMaxHealth >= 1.0 && v.validatedHealth > 20.0 && v.damageGraceTicks <= 0) {
					try {
						if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) rot.getEntityData().set(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
					} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active", false);
					return false;
				}
				if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living && living.getHealth() <= 20.0F) {
					if (v != null) v.deathSequenceActive = true;
					return true;
				}
				return entity.level().isClientSide();
			}
			return false;
		}
		if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
			return entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_death_sequence_active");
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static void enforceEntitySecurityTick(Entity entity) {
		if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || entity == null || entity.level().isClientSide()) return;
		RotDataGuardianForgeBusEvents.runEntitySecurityCheck(entity);
	}

	
	private static final java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, Entity> PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

	public static void registerProtectedDeathEntity(Entity entity) {
		if (entity != null && isStructuralBoss(entity)) {
			PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.put(entity.getUUID(), entity);
		}
	}

	public static void unregisterProtectedDeathEntity(Entity entity) {
		if (entity != null && isAuthorizedBackwoodsCaller()) {
			FINISHED.add(entity.getUUID());
			if (isRot(entity)) {
				RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
				v.deathSequenceFinished = true;
			}
			PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.remove(entity.getUUID());
			ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.remove(entity.getUUID());
		}
	}

	
	public static void clearEntityRemoval(Entity entity) {
		if (entity == null) return;
		try {
			java.lang.reflect.Method m = Entity.class.getDeclaredMethod("unsetRemoved");
			m.setAccessible(true);
			m.invoke(entity);
		} catch (Exception ignored) {
			try {
				java.lang.reflect.Field f = Entity.class.getDeclaredField("removalReason");
				f.setAccessible(true);
				f.set(entity, null);
			} catch (Exception ignored2) {}
		}
	}

	
	public static boolean isCommandTargetingBoss(String cmdLower) {
		if (cmdLower == null || cmdLower.isEmpty()) return false;
		
		// Direct entity namespace/name matching
		if (cmdLower.contains("the_backwoods:rot") || cmdLower.contains("the_backwoods:verdant_engine")
			|| cmdLower.matches(".*\\brot\\b.*") || cmdLower.matches(".*\\bverdant_engine\\b.*")) {
			return true;
		}

		// Selector analysis: only @e can target non-player entities like the boss (@a, @p, @r only target players)
		if (cmdLower.contains("@e")) {
			int atEIdx = cmdLower.indexOf("@e");
			int bracketStart = cmdLower.indexOf('[', atEIdx);
			int bracketEnd = (bracketStart != -1) ? cmdLower.indexOf(']', bracketStart) : -1;

			if (bracketStart != -1 && bracketEnd != -1 && bracketEnd > bracketStart) {
				String selectorArgs = cmdLower.substring(bracketStart + 1, bracketEnd);
				for (String arg : selectorArgs.split(",")) {
					String trimmed = arg.trim();
					if (trimmed.startsWith("type=")) {
						String typeVal = trimmed.substring(5).trim();
						// Negated type filter excludes the entity (e.g. type=!the_backwoods:rot or type=!player)
						if (typeVal.startsWith("!")) {
							String ex = typeVal.substring(1);
							return !(ex.equals("the_backwoods:rot") || ex.equals("rot")
								|| ex.equals("the_backwoods:verdant_engine") || ex.equals("verdant_engine"));
						}
						// If an explicit type is given, only flag if it actually targets the boss
						return typeVal.equals("the_backwoods:rot")
							|| typeVal.equals("rot")
							|| typeVal.equals("the_backwoods:verdant_engine")
							|| typeVal.equals("verdant_engine");
					}
				}
			}
			// Unfiltered @e (e.g. "/kill @e") targets all entities including the boss
			return true;
		}

		return false;
	}

	public RotDataGuardian() {
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		new RotDataGuardian();
	}

	@OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT)
	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clientLoad(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static class RotDataGuardianForgeBusEvents {

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
		}

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onCommandExecuted(CommandEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN) {
				return;
			}

			String rawCommand = event.getParseResults().getReader().getString();
			if (rawCommand == null) {
				return;
			}

			String cmdLower = rawCommand.trim().toLowerCase();

			boolean isTamperCmd = cmdLower.matches(".*\\b(kill|data|attribute|damage)\\b.*");
			if (!isTamperCmd) return;
			var src = event.getParseResults().getContext().getSource();
			boolean hit = false;
			for (ServerLevel lvl : src.getServer().getAllLevels()) {
				for (Entity ent : lvl.getAllEntities()) {
					if (isStructuralBoss(ent) && ent.isAlive()
							&& (isCommandTargetingBoss(cmdLower) || cmdLower.contains(ent.getStringUUID()))) { hit = true; break; }
				}
				if (hit) break;
			}
			if (!hit) return;
			event.setCanceled(true);
			if (src.getEntity() instanceof ServerPlayer player) {
				ServerLevel level = (ServerLevel) player.level();
				if (SILENT_SECURITY_MODE) player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal(MSG_COMMAND_BLOCKED));
				else triggerGlobalTamperBacklash(level, player, "COMMAND_INJECTION: " + rawCommand);
			}
		}

		

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onLivingDeath(LivingDeathEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (isTheBackwoodsAttack(event.getSource())) {
				if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					startRotDeathSequence(rot, event.getSource().getEntity());
				}
				return;
			}
			if (entity instanceof RotEntity && isRonovaDoomDamage(event.getSource())
				&& isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity)) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				RonovaGuard.purgeDoom(entity);
				// Ronova must not accelerate or restart an already authorized Rot death.
				event.getEntity().setHealth(1.0F);
				event.getEntity().deathTime = 0;
				return;
			}
			if (ShootingStarGuard.protects(entity) && isShootingStarDamage(event.getSource())) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				ShootingStarGuard.preventDeath(event.getEntity());
				return;
			}
			if (isStructuralBoss(entity) && (isRonovaDoomDamage(event.getSource()) || isApotheosisExecutionDamage(event.getSource()) || ((entity.getPersistentData() != null && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("ronova_doomed"))))) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				RonovaGuard.purgeDoom(entity);
				if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
					living.deathTime = 0;
					living.hurtTime = 0;
					living.invulnerableTime = 40;
					RotVaultState vault = getVault(entity);
					if (vault != null) {
						vault.deathSequenceActive = false;
						vault.authorizedKillerUUID = null;
					}
					if (entity.getPersistentData() != null) {
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active", false);
						entity.getPersistentData().remove("rot_boss_killer_uuid");
						entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_death_ticks", 0.0);
					}
					try {
						entity.getEntityData().set(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
					} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
					if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) {
						vault.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(vault.damageGraceTicks, 60);
						vault.validatedHealth = rot.getMaxHealth();
						rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 60);
						rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
						rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
						rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
				boolean isDying = isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity);
				boolean isAbsorbing = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");

				if (isDying || isAbsorbing) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						if (isAbsorbing) {
							living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						} else {
							living.setHealth(1.0F);
						}
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
				}
			} else if (isRot(entity)) {
				boolean isDying = isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity);
				boolean shootingStarEnabled = isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled();
				boolean isAbsorbing = shootingStarEnabled && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed");
				net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds = event.getSource();
				String msgId = ds != null && ds.getMsgId() != null ? ds.getMsgId().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) : "";
				boolean isRailgun = shootingStarEnabled && (isAbsorbing || msgId.contains("railgun") || msgId.contains("star") || msgId.contains("shooting") || msgId.contains("gungnir") || msgId.contains("erasure"));

				boolean isPhasing = shootingStarEnabled && (entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_active") || entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_timer") > 0);

				if (!isDying) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						RotVaultState v = getVault(entity);
						float restoredHp = v != null && v.validatedHealth > 25.0 ? (float) v.validatedHealth : Math.max(25.0F, living.getMaxHealth() * 0.25F);
						living.setHealth(restoredHp);
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 60;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
						entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
						entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
						try {
							if (entity instanceof RotEntity r) r.getEntityData().set(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
						} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active", false);
					}
					return;
				}

				if (isDying || isRailgun || isPhasing) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						if (isRailgun || isPhasing) {
							living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
							entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed", true);
							entity.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_railgun_heat_ticks", 60.0);
						} else {
							living.setHealth(1.0F);
						}
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 40;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onEntityLeaveLevel(EntityLeaveLevelEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getLevel().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (isStructuralBoss(entity)) {
				boolean isFinished = isFinished(entity);
				if (!isFinished) {
					if (ShootingStarGuard.capture(entity)) return;
					clearEntityRemoval(entity);
					if (entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel && serverLevel.getEntity(entity.getUUID()) == null) {
						try {
							serverLevel.addFreshEntity(entity);
						} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onServerTick(ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.isEmpty()) return;

			java.util.List<java.util.UUID> toRemove = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
			for (java.util.Map.Entry<java.util.UUID, Entity> entry : PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.entrySet()) {
				Entity entity = entry.getValue();
				if (entity == null) {
					toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
					continue;
				}

				// Allow Peaceful Mode to naturally despawn hostile bosses
				if (entity.level().getDifficulty() == net.minecraft.world.Difficulty.PEACEFUL) {
					toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
					continue;
				}

				boolean isFinished = isFinished(entity);

				if (isFinished) {
					toRemove.add(entry.getKey());
					ROT_SECURITY_VAULT.remove(entry.getKey());
					continue;
				}

				// Hard Anti-Removal & Anti-Erasure Lock: Defeat victim.remove(RemovalReason.KILLED) / Erasure.WATCHED
				if (entity.isRemoved()) {
					try {
						RonovaGuard.purgeDoom(entity);
						clearEntityRemoval(entity);
					} catch (Exception ignored) {}

					if (entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
						if (serverLevel.getEntity(entity.getUUID()) == null) {
							try {
								clearEntityRemoval(entity);
								serverLevel.addFreshEntity(entity);
							} catch (Exception ignored) {}
						}
					}
				}

				if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
					boolean isVerdantAbsorbing = isVerdantEngine(entity) && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");
					boolean isRotAbsorbing = isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled() && isRot(entity) && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed");
					if (isVerdantAbsorbing || isRotAbsorbing) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					} else if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity)) {
						living.setHealth(1.0F);
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
				}
			}

			for (java.util.UUID uuid : toRemove) {
				PROTECTED_DEATH_ENTITIES.remove(uuid);
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			runEntitySecurityCheck(event.getEntity());
		}

		static void runEntitySecurityCheck(Entity entity) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || entity == null || entity.level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			if (isStructuralBoss(entity)) {
				registerProtectedDeathEntity(entity);
				if ((entity.getPersistentData() != null && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("ronova_doomed"))) {
					RonovaGuard.purgeDoom(entity);
				}
			}

			
			if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot && !rot.level().isClientSide() && rot.isAlive()) {
				if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
					return;
				}
				ServerLevel level = (ServerLevel) rot.level();

				RotVaultState vault = getVault(rot);
				double validatedMaxHealth = vault.validatedMaxHealth;
				double validatedHealth = vault.validatedHealth;
				int damageGraceTicks = vault.damageGraceTicks;
				int expectedGoals = vault.expectedGoals;
				int expectedTargets = vault.expectedTargets;

				double currentBaseMaxHealth = rot.getAttribute(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH).getBaseValue();

				if (validatedMaxHealth < 1.0) {
					validatedMaxHealth = currentBaseMaxHealth;
					validatedHealth = rot.getHealth();
					expectedGoals = rot.goalSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					expectedTargets = rot.targetSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					vault.validatedMaxHealth = validatedMaxHealth;
					vault.validatedHealth = validatedHealth;
					vault.expectedGoals = expectedGoals;
					vault.expectedTargets = expectedTargets;
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_max_health", validatedMaxHealth);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", validatedHealth);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_expected_goals", expectedGoals);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_expected_targets", expectedTargets);
				}

				if (currentBaseMaxHealth > validatedMaxHealth) {
					validatedMaxHealth = currentBaseMaxHealth;
					vault.validatedMaxHealth = validatedMaxHealth;
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_max_health", validatedMaxHealth);
				} else if (currentBaseMaxHealth < validatedMaxHealth) {
					rot.getAttribute(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH).setBaseValue(validatedMaxHealth);
					triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_ATTRIBUTE_DECREASE");
				}

				if (vault.lastGraceTick != rot.tickCount) {
					vault.lastGraceTick = rot.tickCount;
					if (damageGraceTicks > 0) {
						damageGraceTicks--;
						vault.damageGraceTicks = damageGraceTicks;
						rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", damageGraceTicks);
					} else {
						rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 0);
					}
				}

				double currentHealth = rot.getHealth();
				if (currentHealth < validatedHealth) {
					if (damageGraceTicks > 0 || rot.hurtTime > 0 || rot.getLastHurtByMob() != null) {
						vault.validatedHealth = currentHealth;
						rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", currentHealth);
					} else {
						rot.setHealth((float) validatedHealth);
						rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", validatedHealth);
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_NBT_MODIFY");
					}
				} else if (currentHealth > validatedHealth) {
					vault.validatedHealth = currentHealth;
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", currentHealth);
				}

				
				if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
					registerProtectedDeathEntity(rot);
				}

				if (rot.tickCount % 5 == 0) {
					int currentGoals = rot.goalSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					int currentTargets = rot.targetSelector.getAvailableGoals().size();
					
					if (expectedGoals > 0 && currentGoals != expectedGoals) {
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_GOAL_INJECTION_DETECTED");
					}
					if (expectedTargets > 0 && currentTargets != expectedTargets) {
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_TARGET_INJECTION_DETECTED");
					}

					LivingEntity combatTarget = rot.getTarget();
					if (combatTarget != null) {
						String targetName = net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(combatTarget.getType()).toString().toLowerCase();
						if (targetName.contains("rot") || targetName.contains("splinter")) {
							rot.setTarget(null);
							rot.setLastHurtByMob(null);
						} else if (combatTarget instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player) {
							boolean isDueling = rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_dueling");
							if (!isDueling) {
								rot.setTarget(null);
								rot.setLastHurtByMob(null);
							}
						}
					}

					boolean isManifesting = rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_manifesting");
					boolean isDying = false;
					try {
						isDying = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath);
					} catch (Exception e) {}
					if (!isDying) {
						isDying = rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
					}
					if (!isManifesting && !isDying) {
						if (rot.isNoAi()) {
							rot.setNoAi(false);
							triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_NO_AI_FREEZE");
						}
						if (rot.isSilent()) {
							rot.setSilent(false);
						}
						if (rot.isInvisible()) {
							rot.setInvisible(false);
							triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_INVISIBILITY_GLITCH");
						}
					}
					if (rot.isVehicle()) {
						rot.ejectPassengers();
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_PASSENGER_GLITCH");
					}
					if (rot.isNoGravity() && !isDying) {
						rot.setNoGravity(false);
						triggerTamperBacklash(level, rot, "ILLEGAL_GRAVITY_DISABLE");
					}

					java.util.List<net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect>> debuffsToRemove = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
					for (MobEffectInstance effect : rot.getActiveEffects()) {
						String effId = effect.getEffect().unwrapKey().map(k -> k.location().toString().toLowerCase()).orElse("");
						if (effect.getAmplifier() >= 4 || effId.contains("torment") || effId.contains("insanity") || effId.contains("mind_control") || effId.contains("arphex")) {
							debuffsToRemove.add(effect.getEffect());
						}
					}
					for (net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect> effHolder : debuffsToRemove) {
						rot.removeEffect(effHolder);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static boolean isPlayerOrDebugAttack(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds) {
			if (ds == null) return false;
			if (isRonovaDoomDamage(ds)) return false;
			Entity attacker = ds.getEntity();
			Entity direct = ds.getDirectEntity();
			if (isRonovaEntity(attacker) || isRonovaEntity(direct)) return false;
			if (attacker instanceof Player player) {
				if (player.isCreative() || player.isSpectator()) return true;
				ItemStack main = player.getMainHandItem();
				ItemStack off = player.getOffhandItem();
				String mainId = main.isEmpty() ? "" : net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(main.getItem()).toString().toLowerCase();
				String offId = off.isEmpty() ? "" : net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(off.getItem()).toString().toLowerCase();
				if (mainId.contains("null_pointer") || mainId.contains("debug") || mainId.contains("admin") || mainId.contains("kill")
					|| offId.contains("null_pointer") || offId.contains("debug") || offId.contains("admin") || offId.contains("kill")) {
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (direct instanceof Player || attacker instanceof Player) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
		public static void onLivingIncomingDamage(LivingIncomingDamageEvent event) {
			if (!ENABLE_GUARDIAN || event.getEntity() == null || event.getEntity().level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (!isStructuralBoss(entity)) return;

			if (entity.level().getDifficulty() == net.minecraft.world.Difficulty.PEACEFUL) {
				return;
			}

			registerProtectedDeathEntity(entity);

			net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource ds = event.getSource();
			if (isTheBackwoodsAttack(ds)) {
				if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) {
					if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
						event.setCanceled(true);
						event.setAmount(0.0F);
						return;
					}
					if (event.getAmount() >= rot.getHealth() || rot.getHealth() <= 20.0F) {
						event.setCanceled(true);
						event.setAmount(0.0F);
						startRotDeathSequence(rot, ds.getEntity());
						return;
					}
					RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
					v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 60);
					v.validatedHealth = Math.max(1.0, rot.getHealth() - event.getAmount());
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 60);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", v.validatedHealth);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (ShootingStarGuard.protects(entity) && isShootingStarDamage(ds)) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				event.setAmount(0.0F);
				ShootingStarGuard.contact(entity);
				return;
			}
			if (isRonovaDoomDamage(ds) || isApotheosisExecutionDamage(ds) || ((entity.getPersistentData() != null && entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("ronova_doomed")))) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				event.setAmount(0.0F);
				RonovaGuard.purgeDoom(entity);
				if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot && !isBossDeathSequenceActive(entity)) {
					// invulnerableTime alone does not satisfy RonovaDeath.slay()'s fallback check.
					rot.setInvulnerable(true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
				}
				return;
			}
			float amount = event.getAmount();
			boolean isKillCmd = ds != null && ds.is(net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageTypes.GENERIC_KILL);
			String msgId = ds != null && ds.getMsgId() != null ? ds.getMsgId().toLowerCase() : "";
			boolean isPlayerAttack = isPlayerOrDebugAttack(ds);
			boolean isRailgunAttack = !isPlayerAttack && (msgId.contains("railgun") || msgId.contains("shooting_star") || msgId.contains("erasure") || msgId.contains("star") || msgId.contains("gungnir")
				|| amount >= 500.0F || entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_hit_toggle"));

			if (isVerdantEngine(entity)) {
				if (isKillCmd) return;

				boolean isAlreadyAbsorbing = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing");
				boolean isAlreadySupercharged = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("verdant_supercharged_mode");
				boolean isShootingStar = isShootingStarDamage(ds);

				// Railgun strike before supercharge -> Absorb & start 8s countdown!
				if (!isAlreadySupercharged && (isShootingStar || isAlreadyAbsorbing)) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 20;
					}
					if (!isAlreadyAbsorbing) {
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_railgun_absorbing", true);
						entity.getPersistentData().putInt("verdant_railgun_heat_ticks", 160);
						entity.getPersistentData().putBoolean("verdant_railgun_hit_toggle", false);
					}
					return;
				}

				// While absorbing -> completely immune
				if (isAlreadyAbsorbing) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
					}
					return;
				}

				// Supercharged combat -> takes damage normally!
				return;
			} else if (entity instanceof RotEntity rot) {
				if (isBossDeathSequenceActive(rot)) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (rot instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(1.0F);
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (isKillCmd) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					return;
				}

				if (amount >= rot.getHealth() && !isKillCmd) {
					amount = Math.min(amount, Math.max(1.0F, rot.getHealth() - 1.0F));
					event.setAmount(amount);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
					rot.invulnerableTime = 40;
				}

				if (isPlayerAttack) {
					RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
					v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 40);
					v.validatedHealth = Math.max(1.0, rot.getHealth() - amount);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 40);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_validated_health", v.validatedHealth);
					return;
				}
				if (isShootingStarAdaptationEnabled() && (isRailgunAttack || rot.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_active"))) {
					event.setCanceled(true);
					event.setAmount(0.0F);
					if (rot instanceof LivingEntity living) {
						living.setHealth(living.getMaxHealth());
						living.deathTime = 0;
						living.hurtTime = 0;
						living.hurtDuration = 0;
						living.invulnerableTime = 40;
						living.setInvulnerable(true);
						living.setInvisible(true);
						try {
							rot.getEntityData().set(net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity.DATA_isDeath, false);
						} catch (Exception ignored) {}
					}
					RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
					v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 60);
					v.validatedHealth = rot.getMaxHealth();
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("rot_phase_active", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_timer", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks", 75.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("unlocked_phase_shift", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putBoolean("sentinel_railgun_hit_absorbed", true);
					rot.getPersistentData().putDouble("sentinel_railgun_heat_ticks", 60.0);
					rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 60);
					return;
				}
				RotVaultState v = getVault(rot);
				v.damageGraceTicks = Math.max(v.damageGraceTicks, 20);
				rot.getPersistentData().putInt("sentinel_damage_grace_ticks", 20);
			}
		}

private static void triggerTamperBacklash(ServerLevel level, RotEntity rot, String reason) {
			boolean showVisEffects = !SILENT_SECURITY_MODE;

			if (showVisEffects && ENABLE_SOUND_EFFECTS) {
				level.playSound(null, rot.getX(), rot.getY(), rot.getZ(), SoundEvents.WITHER_SPAWN, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 3.0F, 0.5F);
				level.playSound(null, rot.getX(), rot.getY(), rot.getZ(), SoundEvents.LIGHTNING_BOLT_THUNDER, SoundSource.HOSTILE, 3.0F, 0.5F);
			}

			if (showVisEffects && ENABLE_PARTICLE_EFFECTS) {
				level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.DRAGON_BREATH, rot.getX(), rot.getY() + 1.0, rot.getZ(), 120, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 0.15);
				level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.PORTAL, rot.getX(), rot.getY() + 1.0, rot.getZ(), 150, 2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 0.5);
				level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION_EMITTER, rot.getX(), rot.getY() + 1.0, rot.getZ(), 5, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0);
			}

			AABB searchBox = rot.getBoundingBox().inflate(32.0);
			List<ServerPlayer> nearbyPlayers = level.getEntitiesOfClass(ServerPlayer.class, searchBox);
			boolean playerInvolved = false;
			for (ServerPlayer p : nearbyPlayers) {
				if (!p.isCreative() && !p.isSpectator()) {
					playerInvolved = true;
					if (ENABLE_LIGHTNING_STRIKES) {
						net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt lightning = new net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt(net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType.LIGHTNING_BOLT, level);
						lightning.setPos(p.getX(), p.getY(), p.getZ());
						level.addFreshEntity(lightning);
					}

					if (ENABLE_FEEDBACK_PENALTY) {
						applyLethalFeedback(p);
					}
				}
			}

			if (showVisEffects && ENABLE_BROADCAST_WARNINGS && playerInvolved) {
				String alertMsg = String.format(MSG_TAMPER_DETECTED, reason);
				level.getServer().getPlayerList().broadcastSystemMessage(Component.literal(alertMsg), false);
			}
		}

		private static void triggerGlobalTamperBacklash(ServerLevel level, ServerPlayer player, String reason) {
			if (ENABLE_LIGHTNING_STRIKES) {
				net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt lightning = new net.minecraft.world.entity.LightningBolt(net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType.LIGHTNING_BOLT, level);
				lightning.setPos(player.getX(), player.getY(), player.getZ());
				level.addFreshEntity(lightning);
			}

			if (ENABLE_FEEDBACK_PENALTY) {
				applyLethalFeedback(player);
			}
		}
		
		private static void applyLethalFeedback(ServerPlayer player) {
			net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT.getHolder(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:cellular_collapse")).ifPresent(holder -> {
				player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(holder, 600, 1));
			});
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.DARKNESS, 600, 0));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.BLINDNESS, 600, 0));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.WITHER, 600, 3));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN, 600, 4));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.WEAKNESS, 600, 4));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.HUNGER, 600, 4));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.POISON, 600, 2));
			player.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.CONFUSION, 600, 2));
			player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal(MSG_FEEDBACK_TRIGGERED));
		}
	}
} // 1.21.1

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.minecraft.client.Minecraft;
import net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics;
import net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.RotEntity;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderGuiEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLivingEvent;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class RotImpactFrames {
	public static boolean ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES = true; // Setting to enable/disable impact frames

	private static int impactTicks = 0;
	private static int maxImpactTicks = 0;
	private static int hurtCooldown = 0;
	private static int previousHurtTime = 0;

	// --- Hitstop Micro-Freeze State ---
	private static int hitstopTicks = 0;
	private static Vec3 frozenPlayerPos = null;
	private static float frozenPlayerYaw = 0.0F;
	private static float frozenPlayerPitch = 0.0F;
	private static java.util.Map<RotEntity, Vec3> frozenRotPositions = new java.util.HashMap<>();

	public static void trigger(int ticks) {
		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES) {
			return;
		}
		impactTicks = ticks;
		maxImpactTicks = ticks;

		// Initiate Hitstop Micro-Freeze (3 ticks of freeze frame impact)
		hitstopTicks = Math.min(ticks, 3);
		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (minecraft.player != null) {
			frozenPlayerPos = minecraft.player.position();
			frozenPlayerYaw = minecraft.player.getYRot();
			frozenPlayerPitch = minecraft.player.getXRot();

			frozenRotPositions.clear();
			if (minecraft.level != null) {
				java.util.List<RotEntity> rots = minecraft.level.getEntitiesOfClass(
					RotEntity.class,
					minecraft.player.getBoundingBox().inflate(12.0D)
				);
				for (RotEntity rot : rots) {
					frozenRotPositions.put(rot, rot.position());
				}
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onClientTick(ClientTickEvent.Post event) {
		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();

		if (minecraft.player == null || minecraft.level == null) {
			hitstopTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES) {
			impactTicks = 0;
			hitstopTicks = 0;
			return;
		}

		// --- Hitstop Micro-Freeze Execution ---
		if (hitstopTicks > 0) {
			hitstopTicks--;

			// Halt player momentum & position lock during micro-freeze
			minecraft.player.setDeltaMovement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			if (frozenPlayerPos != null) {
				minecraft.player.setPos(frozenPlayerPos.x, frozenPlayerPos.y, frozenPlayerPos.z);

				// Micro camera shake/jitter on impact
				double shakePitch = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
				double shakeYaw = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
				minecraft.player.setXRot((float) (frozenPlayerPitch + shakePitch));
				minecraft.player.setYRot((float) (frozenPlayerYaw + shakeYaw));
			}

			// Halt nearby Rot entities' momentum & lock position
			for (java.util.Map.Entry<RotEntity, Vec3> entry : frozenRotPositions.entrySet()) {
				RotEntity rot = entry.getKey();
				Vec3 pos = entry.getValue();
				if (rot != null && rot.isAlive()) {
					rot.setDeltaMovement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					if (pos != null) {
						rot.setPos(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
					}
				}
			}
		} else {
			frozenPlayerPos = null;
			frozenRotPositions.clear();
		}

		if (impactTicks > 0) {
			impactTicks--;
		}

		if (hurtCooldown > 0) {
			hurtCooldown--;
		}

		int currentHurtTime = minecraft.player.hurtTime;

		/*
		 * Detect the moment the player starts taking damage.
		 * hurtTime jumps above 0 when damage starts.
		 */
		boolean justGotHurt = currentHurtTime > 0 && previousHurtTime <= 0;

		previousHurtTime = currentHurtTime;

		if (!justGotHurt) {
			return;
		}

		if (hurtCooldown > 0) {
			return;
		}

		/*
		 * Find nearby Rot entities.
		 * This makes the impact frame happen only during Rot combat.
		 */
		java.util.List<RotEntity> rots = minecraft.level.getEntitiesOfClass(
				RotEntity.class,
				minecraft.player.getBoundingBox().inflate(12.0D)
		);

		if (!rots.isEmpty()) {
			boolean bestMoveTriggered = false;
			for (RotEntity rot : rots) {
				try {
					boolean isGroundCrushing = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_ground_crushing);
					boolean isOverhead = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_overhead);
					boolean isRiderCharging = rot.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_rider_charging);

					if (isGroundCrushing || isOverhead || isRiderCharging) {
						bestMoveTriggered = true;
						break;
					}
				} catch (Exception e) {
					// Fallback in case of missing EntityData or init lag
				}
			}

			if (bestMoveTriggered) {
				trigger(8); // High-impact premium 8-tick cinematic flash!
				hurtCooldown = 15;
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderLivingPre(RenderLivingEvent.Pre<?, ?> event) {
		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES || impactTicks <= 0) {
			return;
		}

		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();
		if (minecraft.player == null) {
			return;
		}

		LivingEntity entity = event.getEntity();
		if (entity == null) {
			return;
		}

		boolean isRot = entity instanceof RotEntity;
		boolean isPlayer = entity == minecraft.player;

		if (!isRot && !isPlayer) {
			return;
		}

		// Calculate fighting-game hand-drawn style alternating high-contrast solid colors
		int color;
		if (impactTicks >= 5) {
			// Phase A: rot is solid bright vibrant red, player is solid pure white
			color = isRot ? 0xFFFF0000 : 0xFFFFFFFF;
		} else if (impactTicks >= 3) {
			// Phase B: rot is solid pure black, player is solid bright vibrant red
			color = isRot ? 0xFF000000 : 0xFFFF0000;
		} else {
			// Phase C: transition back - rot is solid pure white, player is solid pure black
			color = isRot ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF000000;
		}

		event.setCanceled(true);

		try {
			// RenderType.eyes is fullbright, ignores light/shadows - perfect for solid flat silhouettes
			RenderType renderType = RenderType.eyes(getEntityTexture(event.getRenderer(), entity));
			VertexConsumer vertexConsumer = event.getMultiBufferSource().getBuffer(renderType);

			@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
			EntityModel<LivingEntity> model = (EntityModel<LivingEntity>) event.getRenderer().getModel();
			model.renderToBuffer(
				event.getPoseStack(),
				vertexConsumer,
				event.getPackedLight(),
				OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY,
				color
			);
		} catch (Exception e) {
			// Safety escape callback
		}
	}

	@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
	private static <T extends LivingEntity> ResourceLocation getEntityTexture(net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer<?> renderer, LivingEntity entity) {
		return ((net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer<T>) renderer).getTextureLocation((T) entity);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void onRenderGui(RenderGuiEvent.Post event) {
		if (!ENABLE_IMPACT_FRAMES || impactTicks <= 0) {
			return;
		}

		Minecraft minecraft = Minecraft.getInstance();

		if (minecraft.player == null || minecraft.level == null) {
			return;
		}

		GuiGraphics guiGraphics = event.getGuiGraphics();

		int width = minecraft.getWindow().getGuiScaledWidth();
		int height = minecraft.getWindow().getGuiScaledHeight();

		float progress = maxImpactTicks <= 0 ? 1.0F : impactTicks / (float) maxImpactTicks;

		int baseColor;

		if (impactTicks % 2 == 0) {
			baseColor = 0x00FFFFFF; // white
		} else {
			baseColor = 0x00000000; // black
		}

		// 75% opacity maximum so that the stylized in-world silhouettes show through the high-contrast flash backgrounds
		int alpha = Math.min(190, Math.max(0, (int) (progress * 190.0F)));
		int color = (alpha << 24) | (baseColor & 0x00FFFFFF);

		guiGraphics.fill(0, 0, width, height, color);
	} // custom element, 1.21.1
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class RotRendererOverrider {

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void registerRenderers(EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event) {
		EntityType<RotEntity> entityType = (EntityType<RotEntity>) BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.get(ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:rot"));
		if (entityType != null) {
			event.registerEntityRenderer(entityType, CustomRotRenderer::new);
		}
