	public static class CustomRotRenderer extends MobRenderer<RotEntity, CustomRotRenderer.AnimatedModel> {
		private final ResourceLocation entityTexture = ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/entities/rotskin.png");
		public static final boolean ENABLE_PHASE_SHIFT = true;
		public static final boolean PHASE_SHIFT_COMBAT = false;
		public static final float MAX_TRANSPARENCY = 0.80f; // 80% maximum transparency
		public static final float MIN_PHASE_OPACITY = 1.0f - MAX_TRANSPARENCY; // 0.20f opacity at max transparency
		public static final float CINEMATIC_DELAY_TICKS = 12.0f; // cinematic pause after damage before phase begins
		public static final float PHASE_IN_TICKS = 8.0f; // ticks to easeOutCirc into 80% transparency
		public static final float PHASE_OUT_TICKS = 15.0f; // ticks to easeOutQuart back to 100% opaque

		// Mathematical easing functions (no pulsing, smooth continuous curves)
		public static float easeOutCirc(float t) {
			t = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, t));
			return (float) Math.sqrt(1.0 - Math.pow(t - 1.0, 2.0));
		}

		public static float easeOutQuart(float t) {
			t = Math.max(0.0f, Math.min(1.0f, t));
			return (float) (1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - t, 4.0));
		}

		public static boolean isRotPhasing(RotEntity entity) {
			if (entity == null || !ENABLE_PHASE_SHIFT) return false;
			return entity.isInvisible()
				|| entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_phase_active")
				|| entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_timer") > 0;
		}

		public static float calculatePhaseOpacity(RotEntity entity, float partialTick) {
			if (entity == null || !ENABLE_PHASE_SHIFT) return 1.0f;
			if (entity.getPersistentData().contains("rot_phase_opacity")) {
				return (float) Math.max(MIN_PHASE_OPACITY, Math.min(1.0f, entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_opacity")));
			}
			if (!isRotPhasing(entity)) {
				return 1.0f;
			}

			double remaining = entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_timer");
			double total = entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_phase_total_ticks");
			if (total <= 0) total = 75.0;

			// Exact fractional elapsed time with partialTick for smooth 60fps+ rendering
			float currentTimer = (float) Math.max(0.0, remaining - (double) partialTick);
			float elapsed = (float) Math.max(0.0, total - currentTimer);

			// 0. Cinematic Delay: Rot remains solid immediately following damage impact
			if (elapsed < CINEMATIC_DELAY_TICKS) {
				return 1.0f;
			}

			// 1. Phase-In: easeOutCirc from 1.0f down to MIN_PHASE_OPACITY (80% transparent)
			float phaseElapsed = elapsed - CINEMATIC_DELAY_TICKS;
			if (phaseElapsed < PHASE_IN_TICKS) {
				float progress = phaseElapsed / PHASE_IN_TICKS;
				float curve = easeOutCirc(progress);
				return 1.0f - (1.0f - MIN_PHASE_OPACITY) * curve;
			}

			// 3. Phase-Out: easeOutQuart from MIN_PHASE_OPACITY back up to 1.0f (100% opaque)
			if (currentTimer < PHASE_OUT_TICKS) {
				float progress = 1.0f - (currentTimer / PHASE_OUT_TICKS);
				float curve = easeOutQuart(progress);
				return MIN_PHASE_OPACITY + (1.0f - MIN_PHASE_OPACITY) * curve;
			}

			// 2. Full Phase Hold: capped at exactly 80% transparency (0.20f opacity)
			return MIN_PHASE_OPACITY;
		}

		public CustomRotRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
			super(context, new AnimatedModel(context.bakeLayer(ModelRot.LAYER_LOCATION)), 0.7f);
			this.addLayer(new net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.layers.ItemInHandLayer<>(this, context.getItemInHandRenderer()));
		}

		private net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType getTranslucentRenderType(net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType originalType) {
			if (originalType == null) {
				return originalType;
			}
			try {
				String str = originalType.toString();
				int start = str.indexOf("Optional[");
				if (start != -1) {
					int end = str.indexOf("]", start);
					if (end != -1) {
						String locStr = str.substring(start + 9, end);
						ResourceLocation loc = ResourceLocation.parse(locStr);
						return net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.itemEntityTranslucentCull(loc);
					}
				}
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
			return net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.itemEntityTranslucentCull(entityTexture);
		}

		@Override
		public void render(RotEntity entity, float entityYaw, float partialTicks, PoseStack poseStack, net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource bufferSource, int packedLight) {
			boolean isPhasing = isRotPhasing(entity);
			if (entity != null && entity.isInvisible() && !isPhasing) {
				return;
			}
			float opacity = calculatePhaseOpacity(entity, partialTicks);
			if (isPhasing && opacity < 0.999f) {
				net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource transparentBuffer = renderType -> {
					net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType translucentType = getTranslucentRenderType(renderType);
					return new AlphaVertexConsumer(bufferSource.getBuffer(translucentType), opacity);
				};
				super.render(entity, entityYaw, partialTicks, poseStack, transparentBuffer, packedLight);
			} else {
				super.render(entity, entityYaw, partialTicks, poseStack, bufferSource, packedLight);
			}
		}

		@Override
		protected boolean isBodyVisible(RotEntity entity) {
			if (isRotPhasing(entity)) {
				return true;
			}
			return super.isBodyVisible(entity);
		}

		@Override
		protected net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType getRenderType(RotEntity entity, boolean isBodyVisible, boolean translucent, boolean glowing) {
			if (isRotPhasing(entity) && calculatePhaseOpacity(entity, 0.0f) < 0.999f) {
				return net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.entityTranslucent(this.getTextureLocation(entity));
			}
			return super.getRenderType(entity, isBodyVisible, translucent, glowing);
		}

		@Override
		protected void scale(RotEntity entity, PoseStack poseStack, float f) {
			poseStack.scale(1.25f, 1.25f, 1.25f);
		}

		@Override
		public ResourceLocation getTextureLocation(RotEntity entity) {
			return entityTexture;
		}

		public static final class AnimatedModel extends ModelRot<RotEntity> implements net.minecraft.client.model.ArmedModel {
			private final ModelPart root;
			private final ModelPart rightArm;
			private final ModelPart leftArm;
			private final ModelPart trueRoot;
			private final ModelPart head;
			private final ModelPart body;
			private final ModelPart rightLeg;
			private final ModelPart leftLeg;

			public static boolean ENABLE_RECOVERY_BLEND = true;
			public static boolean ENABLE_RECOVERY_LOCOMOTION = true;
			public static float RECOVERY_BLEND_TICKS = 2.0f;
			private ModelPart[] recoveryParts;
			private boolean[] recoveryFaceParts;
			private final java.util.Map<RotEntity, RecoveryPose> recoveryPoses = new java.util.WeakHashMap<>();
			private static final class RecoveryPose {
				final float[] previous, from;
				int heavy;
				float lastAge = Float.NaN, heavyStarted, blendStarted = -1000;
				RecoveryPose(int size) { previous = new float[size]; from = new float[size]; }
			}
			private static float blendAngle(float from, float to, float weight) {
				float delta = (to - from) % ((float)Math.PI * 2);
				if (delta > Math.PI) delta -= (float)Math.PI * 2;
				if (delta < -Math.PI) delta += (float)Math.PI * 2;
				return from + delta * weight;
			}
			private void applyRecoveryPose(RotEntity entity, float age, int heavy, boolean protectedPose,
					float limbSwing, float limbAmount) {
				if (!ENABLE_RECOVERY_BLEND && !ENABLE_RECOVERY_LOCOMOTION) return;
				RecoveryPose pose = recoveryPoses.get(entity);
				if (pose == null && heavy == 0) return;
				if (recoveryParts == null) {
					recoveryParts = root.getAllParts().toArray(ModelPart[]::new);
					java.util.Set<ModelPart> face = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(new java.util.IdentityHashMap<>());
					for (ModelPart parent : recoveryParts) {
						for (String name : new String[]{"mouth", "mouth2", "mouth3", "mouth4", "mouth5", "mouth6"})
							if (parent.hasChild(name)) parent.getChild(name).getAllParts().forEach(face::add);
					}
					recoveryFaceParts = new boolean[recoveryParts.length];
					for (int i = 0; i < recoveryParts.length; i++) recoveryFaceParts[i] = face.contains(recoveryParts[i]);
				}
				if (pose == null) {
					if (recoveryPoses.size() >= 128) recoveryPoses.remove(recoveryPoses.keySet().iterator().next());
					pose = new RecoveryPose(recoveryParts.length * 9);
					recoveryPoses.put(entity, pose);
				}
				boolean continuous = Float.isFinite(pose.lastAge) && age >= pose.lastAge && age - pose.lastAge <= 4;
				if (!continuous) { pose.heavy = heavy; pose.heavyStarted = age; pose.blendStarted = -1000; }
				if (heavy != pose.heavy) {
					if (continuous && pose.heavy != 0 && age - pose.heavyStarted >= 14 && !protectedPose) {
						System.arraycopy(pose.previous, 0, pose.from, 0, pose.previous.length);
						pose.blendStarted = age;
					}
					pose.heavy = heavy;
					pose.heavyStarted = age;
				}
				if (protectedPose) pose.blendStarted = -1000;
				if (ENABLE_RECOVERY_LOCOMOTION && heavy != 0 && !protectedPose && age - pose.heavyStarted >= 18) {
					float amount = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, limbAmount)) * 0.7f;
					if (rightLeg != null) rightLeg.xRot += (float)Math.cos(limbSwing * 0.6662f) * amount;
					if (leftLeg != null) leftLeg.xRot += (float)Math.cos(limbSwing * 0.6662f + Math.PI) * amount;
				}
				float duration = Float.isFinite(RECOVERY_BLEND_TICKS) ? Math.max(0.25f, Math.min(2, RECOVERY_BLEND_TICKS)) : 2;
				float t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (age - pose.blendStarted) / duration));
				float weight = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
				if (heavy == 0 && t >= 1) { pose.lastAge = age; return; }
				for (int i = 0; i < recoveryParts.length; i++) {
					ModelPart part = recoveryParts[i]; int b = i * 9;
					pose.previous[b] = part.x; pose.previous[b + 1] = part.y; pose.previous[b + 2] = part.z;
					pose.previous[b + 3] = part.xRot; pose.previous[b + 4] = part.yRot; pose.previous[b + 5] = part.zRot;
					pose.previous[b + 6] = part.xScale; pose.previous[b + 7] = part.yScale; pose.previous[b + 8] = part.zScale;
					if (!ENABLE_RECOVERY_BLEND || protectedPose || t >= 1 || recoveryFaceParts[i]) continue;
					part.x = pose.from[b] + (part.x - pose.from[b]) * weight;
					part.y = pose.from[b + 1] + (part.y - pose.from[b + 1]) * weight;
					part.z = pose.from[b + 2] + (part.z - pose.from[b + 2]) * weight;
					part.xRot = blendAngle(pose.from[b + 3], part.xRot, weight);
					part.yRot = blendAngle(pose.from[b + 4], part.yRot, weight);
					part.zRot = blendAngle(pose.from[b + 5], part.zRot, weight);
					part.xScale = pose.from[b + 6] + (part.xScale - pose.from[b + 6]) * weight;
					part.yScale = pose.from[b + 7] + (part.yScale - pose.from[b + 7]) * weight;
					part.zScale = pose.from[b + 8] + (part.zScale - pose.from[b + 8]) * weight;
				}
				pose.lastAge = age;
			}

			private final HierarchicalModel animator = new HierarchicalModel<RotEntity>() {
				@Override
				public ModelPart root() {
					return root;
				}

					public final net.minecraft.world.entity.AnimationState localDeathAnimState = new net.minecraft.world.entity.AnimationState();

					@Override
					public void setupAnim(RotEntity entity, float limbSwing, float limbSwingAmount, float ageInTicks, float netHeadYaw, float headPitch) {
						this.root().getAllParts().forEach(ModelPart::resetPose);
						boolean isHeavyLeftPunching = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_heavy_left_punching);
						boolean isHeavyRightPunching = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_heavy_right_punching);
						boolean isUppercuttingLeft = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_uppercut_charging_left);
						boolean isUppercuttingRight = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_uppercut_charging_right);
						boolean isHeavyPunching = isHeavyLeftPunching || isHeavyRightPunching;
						boolean isUppercuttingActive = isUppercuttingLeft || isUppercuttingRight;

						boolean isLanding1 = false;
						boolean isLanding2 = false;
						try {
							isLanding1 = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isLand);
						} catch (Exception e) {}
						try {
							isLanding2 = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isLand2);
						} catch (Exception e) {}

						if (isLanding1) {
							entity.animationState21.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState21.stop();
						}

						if (isLanding2) {
							entity.animationState22.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState22.stop();
						}

						boolean isLanding = isLanding1 || isLanding2;

						if (isUppercuttingLeft) {
							entity.animationState20.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState20.stop();
						}

						if (isUppercuttingRight) {
							entity.animationState19.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState19.stop();
						}

						if (isHeavyLeftPunching) {
							entity.animationState17.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState17.stop();
						}

						if (isHeavyRightPunching) {
							entity.animationState18.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState18.stop();
						}

						boolean isDeath = false;
						try {
							isDeath = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath);
						} catch (Exception e) {}
						if (!isDeath) {
							isDeath = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
						}

						if (isDeath) {
							entity.animationState23.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
							localDeathAnimState.startIfStopped(entity.tickCount);
						} else {
							entity.animationState23.stop();
							localDeathAnimState.stop();
						}

						// [FIXED] Mapped rot_rider_kick to state 0 and checked WalkProcedure for conditional walking to prevent overlaps.
						this.animate(entity.animationState0, RotAnimation.rot_rider_kick, ageInTicks, 1f);
						if (net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures.RotPlaybackConditionWalkProcedure.execute(entity) 
							&& !entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_blocking")
							&& !isHeavyPunching
							&& !isUppercuttingActive
							&& !isLanding
							&& !isDeath)
							this.animateWalk(RotAnimation.rot_walk, limbSwing, limbSwingAmount, 2f, 500f);
						if (entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_sonic_boom") || entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_sonic_boom_large")) {
							if (AnimatedModel.this.rightArm != null) AnimatedModel.this.rightArm.resetPose();
							if (AnimatedModel.this.leftArm != null) AnimatedModel.this.leftArm.resetPose();
						}
						this.animate(entity.animationState2, RotAnimation.rot_air_time, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState3, RotAnimation.rot_overhead, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState4, RotAnimation.rot_slam_crush, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState5, RotAnimation.rot_left_punch, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState6, RotAnimation.rot_right_punch, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState7, RotAnimation.rot_open_mouth_laser, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState8, RotAnimation.rot_close_mouth_laser, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState9, RotAnimation.rot_slam_charge, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState10, RotAnimation.rot_fall, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState11, RotAnimation.rot_sonic_boom, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState12, RotAnimation.rot_sonic_boom_large, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState13, RotAnimation.rot_armor_rip, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState14, RotAnimation.rot_block, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState15, RotAnimation.rot_block_finish, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState16, RotAnimation.rot_dropkick_charge, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState17, RotAnimation.rot_heavy_left_punch, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState18, RotAnimation.rot_heavy_right_punch, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState19, RotAnimation.rot_uppercut_charge_right, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState20, RotAnimation.rot_uppercut_charge_left, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState21, RotAnimation.rot_land, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState22, RotAnimation.rot_land_2, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(entity.animationState23, RotAnimation.rot_death, ageInTicks, 1f);
						this.animate(localDeathAnimState, RotAnimation.rot_death, ageInTicks, 1f);

				}
			};

			public AnimatedModel(ModelPart root) {
				super(root);
				this.root = root;
				ModelPart rArm = null;
				ModelPart lArm = null;
				ModelPart tRoot = null;
				try {
					tRoot = root.getChild("root");
					rArm = tRoot.getChild("right_arm");
				} catch (Exception e) {
					try {
						rArm = root.getChild("right_arm");
					} catch (Exception e2) {
						try {
							rArm = root.getChild("rightArm");
						} catch (Exception e3) {}
					}
				}
				try {
					if (tRoot != null) {
						lArm = tRoot.getChild("left_arm");
					} else {
						lArm = root.getChild("root").getChild("left_arm");
					}
				} catch (Exception e) {
					try {
						lArm = root.getChild("left_arm");
					} catch (Exception e2) {
						try {
							lArm = root.getChild("leftArm");
						} catch (Exception e3) {}
					}
				}
				this.rightArm = rArm;
				this.leftArm = lArm;
				this.trueRoot = tRoot;
				
				ModelPart bPart = null;
				try {
					if (tRoot != null) {
						bPart = tRoot.getChild("body");
					} else {
						bPart = root.getChild("root").getChild("body");
					}
				} catch (Exception e) {
					try {
						bPart = root.getChild("body");
					} catch (Exception e2) {
						try {
							bPart = tRoot != null ? tRoot.getChild("torso") : root.getChild("torso");
						} catch (Exception e3) {
							try {
								bPart = tRoot != null ? tRoot.getChild("chest") : root.getChild("chest");
							} catch (Exception e4) {
								try {
									bPart = tRoot != null ? tRoot.getChild("waist") : root.getChild("waist");
								} catch (Exception e5) {}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				this.body = bPart;

				ModelPart hPart = null;
				try {
					if (tRoot != null) {
						hPart = tRoot.getChild("head");
					} else {
						hPart = root.getChild("root").getChild("head");
					}
				} catch (Exception e) {
					try {
						hPart = root.getChild("head");
					} catch (Exception e2) {
						try {
							if (bPart != null) hPart = bPart.getChild("head");
						} catch (Exception e3) {}
					}
				}
				if (hPart == null) {
					try {
						if (tRoot != null) hPart = tRoot.getChild("Head");
						else hPart = root.getChild("Head");
					} catch (Exception e4) {
						try {
							if (bPart != null) hPart = bPart.getChild("Head");
						} catch (Exception e5) {}
					}
				}
				this.head = hPart;

				ModelPart rlPart = null;
				ModelPart llPart = null;
				try {
					if (tRoot != null) {
						rlPart = tRoot.getChild("right_leg");
						llPart = tRoot.getChild("left_leg");
					} else {
						rlPart = root.getChild("root").getChild("right_leg");
						llPart = root.getChild("root").getChild("left_leg");
					}
				} catch (Exception e) {
					try {
						rlPart = root.getChild("right_leg");
						llPart = root.getChild("left_leg");
					} catch (Exception e2) {}
				}
				this.rightLeg = rlPart;
				this.leftLeg = llPart;
			}

			@Override
			public void setupAnim(RotEntity entity, float limbSwing, float limbSwingAmount, float ageInTicks, float netHeadYaw, float headPitch) {
				animator.setupAnim(entity, limbSwing, limbSwingAmount, ageInTicks, netHeadYaw, headPitch);
				
				boolean isHeavyLeftPunching = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_heavy_left_punching);
				boolean isHeavyRightPunching = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_heavy_right_punching);
				boolean isUppercuttingLeft = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_uppercut_charging_left);
				boolean isUppercuttingRight = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_uppercut_charging_right);
				boolean isHeavyPunching = isHeavyLeftPunching || isHeavyRightPunching;
				boolean isUppercuttingActive = isUppercuttingLeft || isUppercuttingRight;

				boolean isOverhead = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_overhead");
				boolean isFallingHeavy = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_falling_heavy");
				boolean isSonicBoom = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_sonic_boom");
				boolean isSonicBoomLarge = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_sonic_boom_large");
				boolean isBlocking = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_blocking");
				boolean isBlockingFinish = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_blocking_finish");
				boolean isLanding = false;
				try {
					isLanding = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isLand) || entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isLand2);
				} catch (Exception e) {}
				if (!isLanding) {
					isLanding = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("isLand") || entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("isLand2") || entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_land_timer") > 0;
				}

				double armorRipTicks = entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("rot_armor_rip_ticks");
				boolean armorRipFreezingActive = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("is_armor_ripping") && armorRipTicks <= 115;

				boolean isDeath = false;
				try {
					isDeath = entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_isDeath);
				} catch (Exception e) {}
				if (!isDeath) {
					isDeath = entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("rot_death_sequence_active");
				}

				boolean freezeHead = !isDeath && (isOverhead || isSonicBoom || isSonicBoomLarge || isBlocking || isBlockingFinish || isLanding);
				boolean freezeArms = !isDeath && (isSonicBoom || isSonicBoomLarge || isBlocking || isBlockingFinish || armorRipFreezingActive || isHeavyPunching || isUppercuttingActive || isOverhead || isFallingHeavy || isLanding);
				boolean freezeTorso = !isDeath && (armorRipFreezingActive || isHeavyPunching || isUppercuttingActive || isOverhead || isFallingHeavy || isLanding);
				boolean freezeLegs = !isDeath && (isUppercuttingActive || isOverhead || isFallingHeavy || isLanding);
				boolean freezeRoot = !isDeath && (isUppercuttingActive || isOverhead || isFallingHeavy || isLanding);

				float animHeadXRot = 0, animHeadYRot = 0, animHeadZRot = 0;
				if (this.head != null) {
					animHeadXRot = this.head.xRot;
					animHeadYRot = this.head.yRot;
					animHeadZRot = this.head.zRot;
				}

				float animRightArmXRot = 0, animRightArmYRot = 0, animRightArmZRot = 0;
				float animLeftArmXRot = 0, animLeftArmYRot = 0, animLeftArmZRot = 0;
				if (freezeArms) {
					if (this.rightArm != null) {
						animRightArmXRot = this.rightArm.xRot;
						animRightArmYRot = this.rightArm.yRot;
						animRightArmZRot = this.rightArm.zRot;
					}
					if (this.leftArm != null) {
						animLeftArmXRot = this.leftArm.xRot;
						animLeftArmYRot = this.leftArm.yRot;
						animLeftArmZRot = this.leftArm.zRot;
					}
				}

				float animTorsoXRot = 0, animTorsoYRot = 0, animTorsoZRot = 0;
				if (freezeTorso && this.body != null) {
					animTorsoXRot = this.body.xRot;
					animTorsoYRot = this.body.yRot;
					animTorsoZRot = this.body.zRot;
				}

				float animRightLegXRot = 0, animRightLegYRot = 0, animRightLegZRot = 0;
				float animLeftLegXRot = 0, animLeftLegYRot = 0, animLeftLegZRot = 0;
				if (freezeLegs) {
					if (this.rightLeg != null) {
						animRightLegXRot = this.rightLeg.xRot;
						animRightLegYRot = this.rightLeg.yRot;
						animRightLegZRot = this.rightLeg.zRot;
					}
					if (this.leftLeg != null) {
						animLeftLegXRot = this.leftLeg.xRot;
						animLeftLegYRot = this.leftLeg.yRot;
						animLeftLegZRot = this.leftLeg.zRot;
					}
				}

				float animRootXRot = 0, animRootYRot = 0, animRootZRot = 0;
				if (freezeRoot && this.trueRoot != null) {
					animRootXRot = this.trueRoot.xRot;
					animRootYRot = this.trueRoot.yRot;
					animRootZRot = this.trueRoot.zRot;
				}

				super.setupAnim(entity, limbSwing, limbSwingAmount, ageInTicks, netHeadYaw, headPitch);
				
				double dieKickPhase = entity.getPersistentData().getDouble("sentinel_die_kick_phase");
				if (dieKickPhase >= 1 && dieKickPhase <= 3) {
					if (this.trueRoot != null) {
						net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3 vel = entity.getDeltaMovement();
						double horiz = Math.sqrt(vel.x * vel.x + vel.z * vel.z);
						float divePitch;
						if (horiz > 0.1) {
							divePitch = (float)(-Math.atan2(vel.y, horiz));
						} else {
							divePitch = (float)Math.toRadians(entity.getXRot());
						}
						this.trueRoot.xRot = 0F;
						this.trueRoot.yRot = (float)(Math.PI / 2.0);
						this.trueRoot.zRot = divePitch;
					}
				} else {
					if (this.trueRoot != null && !freezeRoot) {
						this.trueRoot.xRot = 0F;
						this.trueRoot.yRot = 0F;
						this.trueRoot.zRot = 0F;
					}
				}

				if (this.head != null) {
					if (freezeHead) {
						this.head.xRot = animHeadXRot;
						this.head.yRot = animHeadYRot;
						this.head.zRot = animHeadZRot;
					} else {
						this.head.xRot = animHeadXRot + headPitch * ((float) Math.PI / 180F);
						this.head.yRot = animHeadYRot + netHeadYaw * ((float) Math.PI / 180F);
					}
				}

				if (freezeArms) {
					if (this.rightArm != null) {
						this.rightArm.xRot = animRightArmXRot;
						this.rightArm.yRot = animRightArmYRot;
						this.rightArm.zRot = animRightArmZRot;
					}
					if (this.leftArm != null) {
						this.leftArm.xRot = animLeftArmXRot;
						this.leftArm.yRot = animLeftArmYRot;
						this.leftArm.zRot = animLeftArmZRot;
					}
				}

				if (freezeTorso && this.body != null) {
					this.body.xRot = animTorsoXRot;
					this.body.yRot = animTorsoYRot;
					this.body.zRot = animTorsoZRot;
				}

				if (freezeLegs) {
					if (this.rightLeg != null) {
						this.rightLeg.xRot = animRightLegXRot;
						this.rightLeg.yRot = animRightLegYRot;
						this.rightLeg.zRot = animRightLegZRot;
					}
					if (this.leftLeg != null) {
						this.leftLeg.xRot = animLeftLegXRot;
						this.leftLeg.yRot = animLeftLegYRot;
						this.leftLeg.zRot = animLeftLegZRot;
					}
				}

				if (freezeRoot && this.trueRoot != null) {
					this.trueRoot.xRot = animRootXRot;
					this.trueRoot.yRot = animRootYRot;
					this.trueRoot.zRot = animRootZRot;
				}
				applyRecoveryPose(entity, ageInTicks, isHeavyLeftPunching ? 1 : isHeavyRightPunching ? 2 : 0,
						isDeath || isUppercuttingActive || isOverhead || isFallingHeavy || isSonicBoom || isSonicBoomLarge
						|| isBlocking || isBlockingFinish || isLanding || armorRipFreezingActive
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_left_punching)
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_right_punching)
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_slam_charge)
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_ground_crushing)
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_rider_kick)
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_rider_charging)
						|| entity.getEntityData().get(RotEntity.DATA_is_dropkick_charging), limbSwing, limbSwingAmount);
			}

			@Override
			public void translateToHand(net.minecraft.world.entity.HumanoidArm arm, PoseStack poseStack) {
				if (this.trueRoot != null) {
					this.trueRoot.translateAndRotate(poseStack);
				}
				if (arm == net.minecraft.world.entity.HumanoidArm.RIGHT) {
					if (this.rightArm != null) {
						this.rightArm.translateAndRotate(poseStack);
						// Tweak holding position here:
						// X: left/right relative to arm (negative is right, so increase X to move right arm inward)
						// Y: up/down along arm (decrease to move item UP closer to shoulder/inside the fist; increase to make it hang lower)
						// Z: forward/backward (positive moves item forward)
						poseStack.translate(0.0605F, 0.00F, 0.0625F);
					}
				} else {
					if (this.leftArm != null) {
						this.leftArm.translateAndRotate(poseStack);
						// For the left arm, decrease X to move it inward
						poseStack.translate(-0.0645F, 0.00F, 0.0625F);
					}
				} // for rendering held items, must register new animations
			}
		} // 1.21.1
	}

	private static class AlphaVertexConsumer implements com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer {
		private final com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer delegate;
		private final float alphaMultiplier;

		public AlphaVertexConsumer(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer delegate, float alphaMultiplier) {
			this.delegate = delegate;
			this.alphaMultiplier = alphaMultiplier;
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer addVertex(float x, float y, float z) {
			delegate.addVertex(x, y, z);
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer setColor(int r, int g, int b, int a) {
			delegate.setColor(r, g, b, Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (int)(a * alphaMultiplier))));
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer setColor(int color) {
			int a = (color >> 24) & 0xFF;
			int r = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
			int g = (color >> 8) & 0xFF;
			int b = color & 0xFF;
			int newA = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (int)(a * alphaMultiplier)));
			int newColor = (newA << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
			delegate.setColor(newColor);
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		public void addVertex(float x, float y, float z, int color, float u, float v, int overlay, int light, float normalX, float normalY, float normalZ) {
			int a = (color >> 24) & 0xFF;
			int r = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
			int g = (color >> 8) & 0xFF;
			int b = color & 0xFF;
			int newA = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (int)(a * alphaMultiplier)));
			int newColor = (newA << 24) | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
			delegate.addVertex(x, y, z, newColor, u, v, overlay, light, normalX, normalY, normalZ);
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer setUv(float u, float v) {
			delegate.setUv(u, v);
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer setUv1(int u, int v) {
			delegate.setUv1(u, v);
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer setUv2(int u, int v) {
			delegate.setUv2(u, v);
			return this;
		}

		@Override
		public com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexConsumer setNormal(float x, float y, float z) {
			delegate.setNormal(x, y, z);
			return this;
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

// 1.21.1 neo
import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.StairBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.Half;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class ScaffoldingTowerFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    // Pre-configured BlockStates to avoid evaluating state properties inside inner loops
    private static final BlockState STAIR_EAST = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
            .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.EAST)
            .setValue(StairBlock.HALF, Half.BOTTOM);

    private static final BlockState STAIR_SOUTH = Blocks.OAK_STAIRS.defaultBlockState()
            .setValue(StairBlock.FACING, Direction.SOUTH)
            .setValue(StairBlock.HALF, Half.BOTTOM);

    public ScaffoldingTowerFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level  = context.level();
        BlockPos      origin = context.origin();

        // --- CONFIGURABLE SETTINGS (14x14 SYMMETRICAL) ---
        int bottomY = 161;             
        int topY    = 319;             
        
        int gridSpacingXZ = 14;         
        int gridSpacingY  = 14;         
        // -------------------------------------------------

        BlockState plankState = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState airState   = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();

        int minX = origin.getX() & (~15);
        int maxX = minX + 15;
        int minZ = origin.getZ() & (~15);
        int maxZ = minZ + 15;
        ChunkAccess chunk = level.getChunk(origin);

        // Reusable position instance to prevent 40,000+ GC allocations per chunk
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos currentPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        for (int blockX = minX; blockX <= maxX; blockX++) {
            int cellX = Math.floorMod(blockX, gridSpacingXZ);
            int sectorX = Math.floorDiv(blockX, gridSpacingXZ);
            long sectorXHash = (long) sectorX * 341873128712L;

            for (int blockZ = minZ; blockZ <= maxZ; blockZ++) {
                int cellZ = Math.floorMod(blockZ, gridSpacingXZ);
                int sectorZ = Math.floorDiv(blockZ, gridSpacingXZ);
                
                // Pre-compute horizontal portion of room hash per column
                long columnHashBase = sectorXHash ^ ((long) sectorZ * 1328979813L);

                boolean isPillar = (cellX == 0) && (cellZ == 0);

                for (int y = bottomY; y <= topY; y++) {
                    currentPos.set(blockX, y, blockZ);

                    // 1. Pillars (Oak Planks Frame)
                    if (isPillar) {
                        setIfDifferent(chunk, currentPos, plankState);
                        continue;
                    }

                    int localY = y - bottomY;
                    int cellY  = Math.floorMod(localY, gridSpacingY);
                    int sectorY = Math.floorDiv(localY, gridSpacingY);

                    // 2. Horizontal Beams (Oak Planks Frame)
                    boolean isHorizontalBeam = (cellY == 0) && (cellX == 0 || cellZ == 0);
                    if (isHorizontalBeam) {
                        setIfDifferent(chunk, currentPos, plankState);
                        continue;
                    }

                    // 3. Structural Stair & Correct Under-Stair Block Check
                    long roomHash = columnHashBase ^ ((long) sectorY * 418731283L);
                    
                    BlockState placementState = airState; // Default to open air

                    if (Math.abs(roomHash % 100) < 65) { 
                        int stairDirection = Math.abs((int) (roomHash % 2));

                        if (stairDirection == 0) {
                            // X-Aligned Ramps (Climbing towards East)
                            if (cellZ > 0) { 
                                if (cellY == cellX && cellY > 0) {
                                    // The active step layer
                                    placementState = STAIR_EAST;
                                } else if (cellY == cellX - 1 && cellX > 0) {
                                    // FIXED: True mathematical block BELOW the step layer
                                    placementState = plankState;
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            // Z-Aligned Ramps (Climbing towards South)
                            if (cellX > 0) { 
                                if (cellY == cellZ && cellY > 0) {
                                    // The active step layer
                                    placementState = STAIR_SOUTH;
                                } else if (cellY == cellZ - 1 && cellZ > 0) {
                                    // FIXED: True mathematical block BELOW the step layer
                                    placementState = plankState;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // 4. Final Write Execution
                    setIfDifferent(chunk, currentPos, placementState);
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static void setIfDifferent(ChunkAccess chunk, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (chunk.getBlockState(pos) != state) {
            chunk.setBlockState(pos, state, false);
        }
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class SkyGridFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    public SkyGridFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {

        // --- EQUALIZED CONSTANTS FOR PERFECT CUBE CAVITIES ---
        int gridBaseHeight   = 190;  // Lowest Y layer of the sky grid
        int maxHeightLimit   = 319;  // Hard ceiling (overworld build limit)
        int gridSpacing      = 12;   // Horizontal distance between beam centers (11 blocks air + 1 block beam)
        int layerIntervalY   = 12;   // MATCHED: Vertical distance between floors (11 blocks air + 1 block beam)
        // -----------------------------------------------------

        WorldGenLevel level  = context.level();
        BlockPos      origin = context.origin();

        // Iterate strictly within this chunk's local offsets (0-15)
        for (int rx = 0; rx < 16; rx++) {
            for (int rz = 0; rz < 16; rz++) {

                // Absolute world-space coordinates for this column
                int blockX = origin.getX() + rx;
                int blockZ = origin.getZ() + rz;

                // Mathematically sound modulo that works in negative coordinate space identically
                int modX = ((blockX % gridSpacing) + gridSpacing) % gridSpacing;
                int modZ = ((blockZ % gridSpacing) + gridSpacing) % gridSpacing;

                boolean onXLine = (modX == 0); // Column lies on an X-aligned beam
                boolean onZLine = (modZ == 0); // Column lies on a Z-aligned beam
                boolean onPillar = onXLine && onZLine; // Exact grid intersection

                // Skip columns that are on neither beam axis
                if (!onXLine && !onZLine) continue;

                for (int currentY = gridBaseHeight; currentY <= maxHeightLimit; currentY++) {

                    boolean isLayerY = ((currentY - gridBaseHeight) % layerIntervalY == 0);
                    boolean place = false;

                    if (onPillar) {
                        // Vertical pillars run the full height at every intersection point
                        place = true;
                    } else if (isLayerY) {
                        // Horizontal beams only placed at matching layer intervals
                        if (onXLine || onZLine) {
                            place = true;
                        }
                    }

                    if (place) {
                        BlockPos pos = new BlockPos(blockX, currentY, blockZ);
                        // Only replace air to avoid overwriting terrain plates
                        if (level.isEmptyBlock(pos)) {
                            level.setBlock(pos, Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState(), 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods; // Replace with your actual mod package name

import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.sound.SoundEngineLoadEvent;

import java.lang.reflect.Field;
import sun.misc.Unsafe;

@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class SoundPoolBooster {

    public static boolean ENABLED = true;
    public static int STATIC_LIMIT = 2048;
    public static int STREAMING_LIMIT = 512;

    public static boolean checkEnabled() {
        try {
            if (net.neoforged.fml.ModList.get() != null && net.neoforged.fml.ModList.get().isLoaded("rsls")) {
                System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Mod 'rsls' (Raise Sound Limit Simplified) is loaded! Automatically disabling SoundPoolBooster to prevent conflicts.");
                return false;
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // ModList might not be loaded yet in static initializer, which is fine
        }
        return true;
    }

    static {
        ENABLED = checkEnabled();
        if (ENABLED) {
            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] SoundPoolBooster class loaded! Attempting immediate static classload-time boost...");
            createAlsoftConfig();
            applyBoost();
        } else {
            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] SoundPoolBooster is DISABLED (conflict with 'rsls'). Skipping immediate boost.");
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientSetup(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
        event.enqueueWork(() -> {
            ENABLED = checkEnabled();
            if (!ENABLED) {
                System.out.println("[SoundBooster] SoundPoolBooster is disabled (conflict with 'rsls'). Skipping setup boost.");
                return;
            }
            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] FMLClientSetupEvent triggered! Enforcing boost on thread queue...");
            createAlsoftConfig();
            applyBoost();
        });
    }

    public static void createAlsoftConfig() {
        if (!ENABLED) return;
        try {
            String configContent = "[general]\nsources = " + STATIC_LIMIT + "\nslots = 256\n";
            byte[] bytes = configContent.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

            // 1. Current Working Directory (CWD)
            writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File("alsoft.ini"), bytes);
            writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File("alsoft.conf"), bytes);

            // 2. config/ folder (CWD/config)
            writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File("config/alsoft.ini"), bytes);
            writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File("config/alsoft.conf"), bytes);

            // 3. APPDATA (Windows)
            String appdata = System.getenv("APPDATA");
            if (appdata != null && !appdata.isEmpty()) {
                writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File(appdata, "alsoft.ini"), bytes);
            }

            // 4. User Home directory (All OS)
            String home = System.getProperty("user.home");
            if (home != null && !home.isEmpty()) {
                // Windows-style in home
                writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File(home, "alsoft.ini"), bytes);
                // Unix-style hidden in home
                writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File(home, ".alsoft.conf"), bytes);
                // Unix-style .config/alsoft.conf
                java.io.File nixConfigDir = new java.io.File(home, ".config");
                if (!nixConfigDir.exists()) {
                    nixConfigDir.mkdirs();
                }
                writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File(nixConfigDir, "alsoft.conf"), bytes);
                // macOS Library/Preferences/alsoft.conf
                java.io.File macPrefsDir = new java.io.File(home, "Library/Preferences");
                if (!macPrefsDir.exists()) {
                    macPrefsDir.mkdirs();
                }
                writeConfigSafe(new java.io.File(macPrefsDir, "alsoft.conf"), bytes);
            }

            // Set environment variables using programmatic modification
            java.io.File cwdFile = new java.io.File("alsoft.ini");
            setEnv("ALSOFT_CONF", cwdFile.getAbsolutePath());
            setEnv("ALSOFT_NUM_SOURCES", String.valueOf(STATIC_LIMIT));

            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] OpenAL Soft configuration successfully deployed across multiple potential target paths.");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Error deploying config: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private static void writeConfigSafe(java.io.File file, byte[] bytes) {
        try {
            java.io.File parent = file.getParentFile();
            if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) {
                parent.mkdirs();
            }
            java.nio.file.Files.write(file.toPath(), bytes);
            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Deployed config to: " + file.getAbsolutePath());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Silently ignore write errors on restricted paths
        }
    }

    private static void setEnv(String key, String value) {
        try {
            Class<?> processEnvironmentClass = Class.forName("java.lang.ProcessEnvironment");
            
            // Try Windows environment map
            try {
                Field theEnvironmentField = processEnvironmentClass.getDeclaredField("theEnvironment");
                theEnvironmentField.setAccessible(true);
                Object obj = theEnvironmentField.get(null);
                if (obj instanceof java.util.Map) {
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    java.util.Map<String, String> env = (java.util.Map<String, String>) obj;
                    env.put(key, value);
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

            try {
                Field theCaseInsensitiveEnvironmentField = processEnvironmentClass.getDeclaredField("theCaseInsensitiveEnvironment");
                theCaseInsensitiveEnvironmentField.setAccessible(true);
                Object obj = theCaseInsensitiveEnvironmentField.get(null);
                if (obj instanceof java.util.Map) {
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    java.util.Map<String, String> env = (java.util.Map<String, String>) obj;
                    env.put(key, value);
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

            // Try Unix (Linux/macOS) environment map
            try {
                java.util.Map<String, String> env = System.getenv();
                Class<?> cl = env.getClass();
                Field field = cl.getDeclaredField("m");
                field.setAccessible(true);
                Object obj = field.get(env);
                if (obj instanceof java.util.Map) {
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    java.util.Map<String, String> writableEnv = (java.util.Map<String, String>) obj;
                    writableEnv.put(key, value);
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Could not modify System.getenv() via reflection: " + t.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public static void applyBoost() {
        if (!ENABLED) return;
        try {
            // Get the private limit field in Library.Pool (inner enum of Library)
            Field limitField = com.mojang.blaze3d.audio.Library.Pool.class.getDeclaredField("limit");
            limitField.setAccessible(true);

            int newStaticLimit = STATIC_LIMIT; 
            int newStreamingLimit = STREAMING_LIMIT;

            try {
                // Try standard reflection modification first
                limitField.setInt(com.mojang.blaze3d.audio.Library.Pool.STATIC, newStaticLimit);
                limitField.setInt(com.mojang.blaze3d.audio.Library.Pool.STREAMING, newStreamingLimit);
                System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Sound channels boosted successfully via Reflection! STATIC=" + newStaticLimit + ", STREAMING=" + newStreamingLimit);
            } catch (Exception reflectionError) {
                // Fallback: Bypass Java 21 final field restrictions using Unsafe
                Field theUnsafeField = Unsafe.class.getDeclaredField("theUnsafe");
                theUnsafeField.setAccessible(true);
                Unsafe unsafe = (Unsafe) theUnsafeField.get(null);

                long offset = unsafe.objectFieldOffset(limitField);
                unsafe.putInt(com.mojang.blaze3d.audio.Library.Pool.STATIC, offset, newStaticLimit);
                unsafe.putInt(com.mojang.blaze3d.audio.Library.Pool.STREAMING, offset, newStreamingLimit);
                System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Sound channels boosted successfully via Unsafe! STATIC=" + newStaticLimit + ", STREAMING=" + newStreamingLimit);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Failed to modify sound pool limits: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    public static void applyActivePoolBoost(Object soundEngine) {
        if (!ENABLED) return;
        if (soundEngine == null) return;
        System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Injecting custom pool limits into active SoundEngine...");
        try {
            Field libraryField = null;
            try {
                libraryField = soundEngine.getClass().getDeclaredField("library");
            } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
                for (Field f : soundEngine.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
                    if (f.getType().getName().equals("com.mojang.blaze3d.audio.Library")) {
                        libraryField = f;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (libraryField == null) {
                System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Could not find library field in SoundEngine!");
                return;
            }

            libraryField.setAccessible(true);
            Object library = libraryField.get(soundEngine);
            if (library == null) {
                System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Library instance in SoundEngine is null!");
                return;
            }

            Field staticPoolField = null;
            Field streamingPoolField = null;

            for (Field f : library.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
                if (f.getType().getName().contains("ChannelPool") || f.getType().getName().contains("Pool")) {
                    if (staticPoolField == null) {
                        staticPoolField = f;
                    } else if (streamingPoolField == null) {
                        streamingPoolField = f;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (staticPoolField == null) {
                try {
                    staticPoolField = library.getClass().getDeclaredField("staticPool");
                } catch (NoSuchFieldException ignored) {}
            }
            if (streamingPoolField == null) {
                try {
                    streamingPoolField = library.getClass().getDeclaredField("streamingPool");
                } catch (NoSuchFieldException ignored) {}
            }

            if (staticPoolField == null || streamingPoolField == null) {
                System.err.println("[SoundBooster] staticPool or streamingPool fields not found in Library!");
                return;
            }

            staticPoolField.setAccessible(true);
            streamingPoolField.setAccessible(true);

            Object staticPool = staticPoolField.get(library);
            Object streamingPool = streamingPoolField.get(library);

            if (staticPool == null || streamingPool == null) {
                System.err.println("[SoundBooster] staticPool or streamingPool instance is null!");
                return;
            }

            int newStaticLimit = STATIC_LIMIT;
            int newStreamingLimit = STREAMING_LIMIT;

            setPoolLimit(staticPool, newStaticLimit);
            setPoolLimit(streamingPool, newStreamingLimit);

            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] Active Sound Pool limits successfully boosted in running instance! STATIC=" + newStaticLimit + ", STREAMING=" + newStreamingLimit);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Error applying active pool boost: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    private static void setPoolLimit(Object pool, int limitValue) {
        try {
            Field limitField = null;
            try {
                limitField = pool.getClass().getDeclaredField("limit");
            } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
                for (Field f : pool.getClass().getDeclaredFields()) {
                    if (f.getType() == int.class || f.getType() == Integer.TYPE) {
                        limitField = f;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (limitField == null) {
                System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Could not find limit field in ChannelPool!");
                return;
            }

            limitField.setAccessible(true);
            try {
                limitField.setInt(pool, limitValue);
            } catch (Exception reflectionError) {
                Field theUnsafeField = Unsafe.class.getDeclaredField("theUnsafe");
                theUnsafeField.setAccessible(true);
                Unsafe unsafe = (Unsafe) theUnsafeField.get(null);
                long offset = unsafe.objectFieldOffset(limitField);
                unsafe.putInt(pool, offset, limitValue);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("[SoundBooster] Failed to set pool limit: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.GAME, value = Dist.CLIENT)
    public static class GameBusListener {
        @SubscribeEvent
        public static void onSoundEngineLoad(SoundEngineLoadEvent event) {
            ENABLED = checkEnabled();
            if (!ENABLED) {
                System.out.println("[SoundBooster] SoundPoolBooster is disabled (conflict with 'rsls'). Skipping active pool boost.");
                return;
            }
            System.out.println("[SoundBooster] SoundEngineLoadEvent triggered! Applying pool boost...");
            applyActivePoolBoost(event.getEngine());
        }
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Pose;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.AshWeaverEntity;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.BlindspotSplinterEntity;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.SplinterEntity;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.LogSplinterEntity;
import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.entity.PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity;
import java.util.UUID;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.Attributes;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.AttributeInstance;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.AttributeModifier;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLivingEvent;
import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.client.model.HumanoidModel;
import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack;
import com.mojang.math.Axis;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class SplinterSwimAbility {
	private static final ResourceLocation SWIM_BOOST_ID = ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("the_backwoods", "splinter_swim_boost");
	private static final SwimProfile BLINDSPOT_PROFILE = new SwimProfile(0.16D, 0.368D, 0.072D);
	private static final SwimProfile SPLINTER_PROFILE = new SwimProfile(0.12D, 0.32D, 0.060D);
	private static final SwimProfile LOG_PROFILE = new SwimProfile(0.096D, 0.288D, 0.052D);
	private static final SwimProfile PETRIFIED_PROFILE = new SwimProfile(0.056D, 0.24D, 0.040D);

	public SplinterSwimAbility() {
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void init(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
		new SplinterSwimAbility();
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void clientLoad(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
	}

	private static final class SwimProfile {
		final double speedBoost;
		final double maxVelocity;
		final double thrust;

		SwimProfile(double speedBoost, double maxVelocity, double thrust) {
			this.speedBoost = speedBoost;
			this.maxVelocity = maxVelocity;
			this.thrust = thrust;
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber
	private static class SplinterSwimAbilityForgeBusEvents {
		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void serverLoad(ServerStartingEvent event) {
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Pre event) {
			Entity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (!(entity instanceof Mob mob) || mob.level().isClientSide()) {
				return;
			}

			SwimProfile profile = getSwimProfile(mob);
			if (profile == null) {
				return;
			}

			if (!mob.isAlive() || mob.isRemoved()) {
				if (mob.isSwimming()) {
					mob.setSwimming(false);
				}
				if (mob.isSprinting()) {
					mob.setSprinting(false);
				}
				if (mob.getPose() == Pose.SWIMMING) {
					mob.setPose(Pose.STANDING);
				}
				removeWaterSpeedBoost(mob);
				return;
			}

			boolean inWater = mob.isInWater();
			LivingEntity target = mob instanceof AshWeaverEntity weaver ? getAshWeaverSwimTarget(weaver) : mob.getTarget();
			boolean isChasingTarget = target != null && target.isAlive() && !target.isSpectator()
					&& (mob instanceof AshWeaverEntity || !(target instanceof Player player && player.isCreative()));

			if (inWater && isChasingTarget) {
				if (!mob.isSwimming()) {
					mob.setSwimming(true);
				}
				if (!mob.isSprinting()) {
					mob.setSprinting(true);
				}
				if (mob.getPose() != Pose.SWIMMING) {
					mob.setPose(Pose.SWIMMING);
				}
				applyWaterSpeedBoost(mob, profile.speedBoost);
				guideUnderwaterChase(mob, target, profile);
			} else {
				if (mob.isSwimming()) {
					mob.setSwimming(false);
				}
				if (!(mob instanceof AshWeaverEntity) && mob.isSprinting()) {
					mob.setSprinting(false);
				}
				if (mob.getPose() == Pose.SWIMMING) {
					mob.setPose(Pose.STANDING);
				}
				removeWaterSpeedBoost(mob);
			}
		}

		private static LivingEntity getAshWeaverSwimTarget(AshWeaverEntity weaver) {
			if (!weaver.isInWater() || !(weaver.level() instanceof ServerLevel level)) return null;
			String ownerId = weaver.getEntityData().get(AshWeaverEntity.DATA_assignedPlayer);
			if (ownerId == null || ownerId.isEmpty()) return null;
			try {
				Player owner = level.getServer().getPlayerList().getPlayer(UUID.fromString(ownerId));
				if (owner == null || owner.level() != level || owner.isSpectator()) return null;
				LivingEntity attacker = owner.getLastHurtByMob();
				int hurtTime = owner.getLastHurtByMobTimestamp();
				if (attacker != null && hurtTime > 0 && owner.tickCount - hurtTime <= 100 && attacker.isAlive()
						&& attacker.level() == level && owner.distanceToSqr(attacker) <= 24.0 * 24.0) return attacker;
				return owner;
			} catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static void guideUnderwaterChase(Mob mob, LivingEntity target, SwimProfile profile) {
			Vec3 mobPos = mob.position();
			Vec3 targetPos = target.position();
			double dy = (target.getY() + (target.getBbHeight() * 0.5D)) - (mob.getY() + (mob.getBbHeight() * 0.5D));
			double distSq = mobPos.distanceToSqr(targetPos);

			if (distSq > 1.44D) {
				Vec3 dir = targetPos.subtract(mobPos).normalize();
				Vec3 vel = mob.getDeltaMovement();

				boolean submerged = mob.isUnderWater();
				double maxYThrust = submerged ? 0.30D : 0.12D;
				double targetVy = Math.max(-0.25D, Math.min(maxYThrust, dy * 0.35D));
				double newVy = (vel.y * 0.7D) + (targetVy * 0.3D);

				if (dy > -0.2D && newVy < 0.05D) {
					newVy = Math.max(newVy, submerged ? 0.08D : 0.04D);
				}

				double newVx = (vel.x * 0.8D) + (dir.x * profile.thrust);
				double newVz = (vel.z * 0.8D) + (dir.z * profile.thrust);

				double horizontalSpeed = Math.sqrt(newVx * newVx + newVz * newVz);
				if (horizontalSpeed > profile.maxVelocity) {
					double scale = profile.maxVelocity / horizontalSpeed;
					newVx *= scale;
					newVz *= scale;
				}

				mob.setDeltaMovement(newVx, newVy, newVz);
				mob.hurtMarked = true;
			}

			mob.getLookControl().setLookAt(target, 30.0F, 30.0F);
		}

		private static void applyWaterSpeedBoost(Mob mob, double speedBoost) {
			AttributeInstance attr = mob.getAttribute(Attributes.WATER_MOVEMENT_EFFICIENCY);
			if (attr != null) {
				if (attr.hasModifier(SWIM_BOOST_ID)) {
					AttributeModifier currentMod = attr.getModifier(SWIM_BOOST_ID);
					if (currentMod != null && Math.abs(currentMod.amount() - speedBoost) < 0.001D) {
						return;
					}
					attr.removeModifier(SWIM_BOOST_ID);
				}
				attr.addTransientModifier(new AttributeModifier(
					SWIM_BOOST_ID,
					speedBoost,
					AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_VALUE
				));
			}
		}

		private static void removeWaterSpeedBoost(Mob mob) {
			AttributeInstance attr = mob.getAttribute(Attributes.WATER_MOVEMENT_EFFICIENCY);
			if (attr != null && attr.hasModifier(SWIM_BOOST_ID)) {
				attr.removeModifier(SWIM_BOOST_ID);
			}
		}

		private static SwimProfile getSwimProfile(Mob mob) {
			if (mob instanceof AshWeaverEntity) return SPLINTER_PROFILE;
			if (mob instanceof BlindspotSplinterEntity) return BLINDSPOT_PROFILE;
			if (mob instanceof SplinterEntity) return SPLINTER_PROFILE;
			if (mob instanceof LogSplinterEntity) return LOG_PROFILE;
			if (mob instanceof PetrifiedLogSplinterEntity) return PETRIFIED_PROFILE;
			return null;
		}
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber(value = Dist.CLIENT)
	public static class SplinterSwimClientRender {
		// Height (blocks above feet) the body tilts around; tune to the model's visual center
		private static final float PIVOT_Y = 0.9F;

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onRenderLivingPre(RenderLivingEvent.Pre<?, ?> event) {
			LivingEntity entity = event.getEntity();
			if (entity instanceof AshWeaverEntity && event.getRenderer().getModel() instanceof HumanoidModel<?> model) {
				model.crouching = entity.isShiftKeyDown();
			}
			if (entity.getPose() != Pose.SWIMMING) {
				return;
			}
			ResourceLocation id = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(entity.getType());
			if (id == null || !"the_backwoods".equals(id.getNamespace())) {
				return;
			}
			switch (id.getPath()) {
				case "blindspot_splinter", "splinter", "log_splinter", "petrified_log_splinter", "ash_weaver" -> {
				}
				default -> {
					return;
				}
			}

			float pt = event.getPartialTick();
			float bodyRot = Mth.rotLerp(pt, entity.yBodyRotO, entity.yBodyRot);
			float xRot = Mth.lerp(pt, entity.xRotO, entity.getXRot());
			PoseStack pose = event.getPoseStack();
			float yaw = 180.0F - bodyRot;
			// Vanilla applies body yaw after this event: pre-apply it, tilt in that frame, undo it.
			pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(yaw));
			pose.translate(0.0F, PIVOT_Y, 0.0F);
			pose.mulPose(Axis.XP.rotationDegrees(-90.0F - xRot));
			pose.translate(0.0F, -PIVOT_Y, 0.0F);
			pose.mulPose(Axis.YP.rotationDegrees(-yaw));
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.living.LivingEntityUseItemEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.EventPriority;

import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.Set;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class StellarRemoteSecurityHandler {
	private static final Set<String> BLOCKED_DIMENSIONS = Set.of(
		"the_sub_strata",
		"the_petrified_weald",
		"the_grain",
		"the_familiar",
		"the_still",
		"rotting",
		"backwoods",
		"loss"
	);

	public static boolean isStellarRemote(ItemStack stack) {
		if (stack == null || stack.isEmpty()) return false;
		Item item = stack.getItem();
		ResourceLocation key = BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(item);
		if (key == null) return false;
		return (key.getNamespace().equals("shooting_star_demo") && key.getPath().contains("stellar_remote"))
			|| key.getPath().equals("stellar_remote")
			|| (item.getClass().getName().contains("shootingstardemo") && key.getPath().contains("remote"));
	}

	public static boolean isBlockedDimension(Level level) {
		if (level == null) return false;
		ResourceLocation dimLoc = level.dimension().location();
		// Strictly require the_backwoods namespace so other mods with matching paths are never blocked
		if (!"the_backwoods".equals(dimLoc.getNamespace())) {
			return false;
		}
		return BLOCKED_DIMENSIONS.contains(dimLoc.getPath().toLowerCase());
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
	public static void onPlayerRightClickItem(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickItem event) {
		Player player = event.getEntity();
		Level level = event.getLevel();
		ItemStack stack = event.getItemStack();

		if (player != null && level != null && isStellarRemote(stack)) {
			if (isBlockedDimension(level)) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				triggerCancelProcedure(event, level, player, stack);
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
	public static void onLivingUseItemStart(LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Start event) {
		if (event.getEntity() instanceof Player player) {
			Level level = player.level();
			ItemStack stack = event.getItem();
			if (isStellarRemote(stack) && isBlockedDimension(level)) {
				event.setCanceled(true);
				triggerCancelProcedure(event, level, player, stack);
			}
		}
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, receiveCanceled = true)
	public static void enforceRightClick(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickItem e) {
		if (isStellarRemote(e.getItemStack()) && isBlockedDimension(e.getLevel())) e.setCanceled(true);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, receiveCanceled = true)
	public static void enforceRightClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.RightClickBlock e) {
		if (isStellarRemote(e.getItemStack()) && isBlockedDimension(e.getLevel())) e.setCanceled(true);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, receiveCanceled = true)
	public static void enforceUseStart(LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Start e) {
		if (e.getEntity() instanceof Player p && isStellarRemote(e.getItem()) && isBlockedDimension(p.level())) e.setCanceled(true);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, receiveCanceled = true)
	public static void enforceUseTick(LivingEntityUseItemEvent.Tick e) {
		if (e.getEntity() instanceof Player p && isStellarRemote(e.getItem()) && isBlockedDimension(p.level())) e.setCanceled(true);
	}

	@SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST)
	public static void backstop(net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.PlayerTickEvent.Post e) {
		Player p = e.getEntity();
		if (!p.level().isClientSide() && p.isUsingItem() && isStellarRemote(p.getUseItem()) && isBlockedDimension(p.level())) p.stopUsingItem();
	}

	/**
	 * Dynamically invokes the MCreator Blockly procedure (StellarRemoteCancelProcedure)
	 * so custom, multiple, or rare messages configured in Blockly execute seamlessly
	 * without hardcoded messaging or compilation coupling.
	 */
	private static void triggerCancelProcedure(Object event, Level level, Player player, ItemStack stack) {
		if (level == null || player == null || level.isClientSide()) {
			return;
		}
		try {
			Class<?> clazz = Class.forName("net.mcreator.thebackwoods.procedures.StellarRemoteCancelProcedure");
			for (java.lang.reflect.Method m : clazz.getMethods()) {
				if (m.getName().equals("execute")) {
					Class<?>[] pts = m.getParameterTypes();
					Object[] args = new Object[pts.length];
					boolean canInvoke = true;
					int doubleCount = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
						Class<?> pt = pts[i];
						if (pt.isAssignableFrom(level.getClass())) {
							args[i] = level;
						} else if (pt.isAssignableFrom(player.getClass())) {
							args[i] = player;
						} else if (stack != null && pt.isAssignableFrom(stack.getClass())) {
							args[i] = stack;
						} else if (event != null && pt.isAssignableFrom(event.getClass())) {
							args[i] = event;
						} else if (pt == double.class || pt == Double.class) {
							if (doubleCount == 0) args[i] = player.getX();
							else if (doubleCount == 1) args[i] = player.getY();
							else args[i] = player.getZ();
							doubleCount++;
						} else {
							canInvoke = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (canInvoke) {
						m.invoke(null, args);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
		} catch (Throwable ignored) {
		}

		// Fallback message if the Blockly procedure is missing or not yet generated
		player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("§cUnknown location."), true);
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

public class SubGrainAtriaFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {
    public SubGrainAtriaFeature() {
        super(NoneFeatureConfiguration.CODEC);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel world = context.level();
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        
        BlockState plank = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState air = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
        
        int startY = 8;        // Starting Y level
        int floors = 3;        // Number of stacked floors
        int floorHeight = 6;   // Distance from one floor to the next (5 blocks structure + 1 block gap)
        
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos mpos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        for (int f = 0; f < floors; f++) {
            int currentFloorY = startY + (f * floorHeight);

            // 1. Generate the solid structural volume for this floor
            for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
                for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < 5; y++) {
                        mpos.set(origin.getX() + x, currentFloorY + y, origin.getZ() + z);
                        world.setBlock(mpos, plank, 2);
                    }
                }
            }

            // 2. Global Coordinate Carving
            for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
                for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                    int worldX = origin.getX() + x;
                    int worldZ = origin.getZ() + z;

                    boolean isHallX = Math.abs(worldX % 10) < 3;
                    boolean isHallZ = Math.abs(worldZ % 10) < 3;

                    if (isHallX || isHallZ) {
                        for (int y = 1; y <= 3; y++) {
                            mpos.set(worldX, currentFloorY + y, worldZ);
                            world.setBlock(mpos, air, 2);
                        }
                        
                        // OPTIONAL: Vertical Connection (Shafts)
                        // This carves a hole in the ceiling/floor to connect levels
                        // Only happens at certain intersections (e.g., every 20 blocks)
                        if (worldX % 20 == 0 && worldZ % 20 == 0 && f < floors - 1) {
                            // Carve a 2x2 hole through the ceiling of this floor and floor of the next
                            mpos.set(worldX, currentFloorY + 4, worldZ); world.setBlock(mpos, air, 2);
                            mpos.set(worldX + 1, currentFloorY + 4, worldZ); world.setBlock(mpos, air, 2);
                            mpos.set(worldX, currentFloorY + 5, worldZ); world.setBlock(mpos, air, 2);
                            mpos.set(worldX + 1, currentFloorY + 5, worldZ); world.setBlock(mpos, air, 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

public class SuspendedWardFeature extends net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature<net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration> {
    public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN = true;

    public static int CELL_SIZE = 48;
    public static int TIER_SPACING = 18;
    public static int FLOOR_SPACING = 6;
    public static double SPAWNER_BUILDING_CHANCE = 40.0; // Percent of buildings eligible for floor rolls.
    public static double SPAWNER_FLOOR_CHANCE = 20.0; // Percent per floor; one centered block per successful roll.
    public static double FALSE_ROOM_FLOOR_CHANCE = 10.0; // Percent per upper room; bottom safety plate stays solid.
    public static double FALSE_BRIDGE_CHANCE = 1.0; // Percent per complete bridge at each tier; false wins at crossings.
    public static double ROOM_PORTAL_CHANCE = 0.001; // Percent per room: 1 in 100,000 before room-fit checks.
    public static double GRAIN_PORTAL_CHANCE = 50.0; // Percent of portals leading to the Grain; remainder to Backwoods.

    public static int TOP_PLATE_THICKNESS = 2;
    public static boolean ENABLE_CEILING_PLATE = false;

    @Override public boolean place(net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext<net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        var level=context.level();
        if (!level.getLevel().dimension().location().toString().equals(DIMENSION_ID)) return false;
        int min=level.getMinBuildHeight(), max=level.getMaxBuildHeight();
        if (CELL_SIZE<40 || CELL_SIZE>96 || TIER_SPACING<12 || TIER_SPACING>48 || FLOOR_SPACING<4
                || TIER_SPACING%FLOOR_SPACING!=0 || BOTTOM_PLATE_OFFSET<5 || TOP_PLATE_THICKNESS<1 || TOP_PLATE_THICKNESS>8)

    public static int getTopRoomFloorY(int minY,int maxYExclusive) {
        int bottom=minY+BOTTOM_PLATE_OFFSET,roof=ENABLE_CEILING_PLATE?maxYExclusive-TOP_PLATE_THICKNESS:maxYExclusive;
        if(FLOOR_SPACING<4||roof-bottom<3) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No room with two blocks of headroom");
        return bottom+Math.floorDiv(roof-bottom-3,FLOOR_SPACING)*FLOOR_SPACING;
    }
    public static net.minecraft.core.BlockPos findEntryRoom(long seed,int nearX,int nearZ,int minY,int maxYExclusive) {
        int cx=Math.floorDiv(nearX,CELL_SIZE),cz=Math.floorDiv(nearZ,CELL_SIZE);
        Tower closest=null;long distance=Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for(int z=cz-4;z<=cz+4;z++) for(int x=cx-4;x<=cx+4;x++) {
            Tower t=tower(seed,x,z);if(t==null) continue;
            long dx=(long)t.x-nearX,dz=(long)t.z-nearZ,d=dx*dx+dz*dz;
            if(d<distance) {closest=t;distance=d;}
        }
        return closest==null?null:new net.minecraft.core.BlockPos(closest.x,getTopRoomFloorY(minY,maxYExclusive)+1,closest.z);
    }
    private static boolean solid(byte kind) { return kind==PLANK || kind==LOG || kind==FENCE || kind==FALSE_PLANK; }

    private static long hash(long seed,int x,int z) {

    }

    private static final java.util.Map<LayoutKey,Layout> LAYOUT_CACHE=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>(64,0.75f,true) {
        @Override protected boolean removeEldestEntry(java.util.Map.Entry<LayoutKey,Layout> entry) {return size()>64;}
