    private static Layout layout(long seed,int cellX,int cellZ) {
        var key=new LayoutKey(seed,cellX,cellZ,CELL_SIZE);
        synchronized(LAYOUT_CACHE) {var cached=LAYOUT_CACHE.get(key);if(cached!=null) return cached;}
        var towers=new Tower[11][11];
        for(int z=0;z<11;z++) for(int x=0;x<11;x++) towers[z][x]=tower(seed,cellX+x-5,cellZ+z-5);
        var built=new Layout(towers,bridges(towers,cellX*CELL_SIZE,cellZ*CELL_SIZE,seed));
        synchronized(LAYOUT_CACHE) {
            var cached=LAYOUT_CACHE.get(key);if(cached!=null) return cached;
            LAYOUT_CACHE.put(key,built);return built;
        }
    }
    private static Tower candidate(long seed,int cx,int cz) {
        long h=hash(seed,cx,cz);
        return new Tower(cx*CELL_SIZE+(int)Math.floorMod(h,CELL_SIZE),
            cz*CELL_SIZE+(int)Math.floorMod(h>>>8,CELL_SIZE),
            3+2*(int)Math.floorMod(h>>>16,3L),3+2*(int)Math.floorMod(h>>>24,3L));
    }
    private static Tower tower(long seed,int cx,int cz) {
        Tower a=candidate(seed,cx,cz);long priority=hash(seed^0xA24BAED4963EE407L,cx,cz);
        // Full-cell scatter, with deterministic local rejection instead of aligned rows.
        for(int z=cz-1;z<=cz+1;z++) for(int x=cx-1;x<=cx+1;x++) {
            if(x==cx&&z==cz) continue;
            Tower b=candidate(seed,x,z);int order=Long.compareUnsigned(hash(seed^0xA24BAED4963EE407L,x,z),priority);
            if(order>0 || (order==0&&(x>cx || (x==cx&&z>cz)))) continue;
            if(Math.abs(a.x-b.x)<a.halfX+b.halfX+12 && Math.abs(a.z-b.z)<a.halfZ+b.halfZ+12) return null;
        }
        return a;
    }
    private static java.util.List<Bridge> bridges(Tower[][] towers,int baseX,int baseZ,long seed) {
        var result=new java.util.LinkedHashSet<Bridge>();
        for(int z=2;z<=8;z++) for(int x=2;x<=8;x++) {
            Tower a=towers[z][x];if(a==null) continue;
            var nearby=new java.util.ArrayList<Tower>();
            for(int dz=-2;dz<=2;dz++) for(int dx=-2;dx<=2;dx++) {
                Tower b=towers[z+dz][x+dx];if(b!=null&&b!=a) nearby.add(b);
            }
            nearby.sort(java.util.Comparator.comparingLong(b->(long)(a.x-b.x)*(a.x-b.x)+(long)(a.z-b.z)*(a.z-b.z)));
            int count=Math.min(nearby.size(),2+(int)Math.floorMod(hash(seed,a.x,a.z),2L));
            for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
                Tower b=nearby.get(i);int margin=CELL_SIZE/4+3;
                if(Math.max(a.x,b.x)+margin<baseX-2||Math.min(a.x,b.x)-margin>baseX+CELL_SIZE+17
                        ||Math.max(a.z,b.z)+margin<baseZ-2||Math.min(a.z,b.z)-margin>baseZ+CELL_SIZE+17) continue;
                result.add(a.x<b.x || (a.x==b.x&&a.z<b.z)?new Bridge(a,b):new Bridge(b,a));
            }
        }
        return new java.util.ArrayList<>(result);
    }
    private static void route(boolean[] deck,int baseX,int baseZ,Bridge bridge,long seed,int tier) {
        Tower a=bridge.a,b=bridge.b;
        long h=hash(seed^((long)tier*0xD1B54A32D192ED03L),a.x^Integer.rotateLeft(b.x,16),a.z^Integer.rotateLeft(b.z,16));
        boolean alongX=Math.abs(a.x-b.x)>=Math.abs(a.z-b.z);
        int au=alongX?a.x:a.z,av=alongX?a.z:a.x,bu=alongX?b.x:b.z,bv=alongX?b.z:b.x;
        int ah=alongX?a.halfX:a.halfZ,bh=alongX?b.halfX:b.halfZ;
        int direction=bu>=au?1:-1,lo=au+direction*(ah+4),hi=bu-direction*(bh+4),span=Math.abs(hi-lo);
        // The dominant axis always has room because accepted towers have at least 12 blocks of clearance.
        if((hi-lo)*direction<0) {alongX=!alongX;au=alongX?a.x:a.z;av=alongX?a.z:a.x;bu=alongX?b.x:b.z;bv=alongX?b.z:b.x;
            ah=alongX?a.halfX:a.halfZ;bh=alongX?b.halfX:b.halfZ;direction=bu>=au?1:-1;
            lo=au+direction*(ah+4);hi=bu-direction*(bh+4);span=Math.abs(hi-lo);}
        int first=lo+direction*(int)Math.floorMod(h,span/2+1L);
        int last=hi-direction*(int)Math.floorMod(h>>>12,span/2+1L);
        int offset=CELL_SIZE/4,side=(av+bv)/2+(int)Math.floorMod(h>>>24,offset*2L+1)-offset;
        if((h&4)==0) {last=first;side=bv;} // Mix single elbows with three/four-turn paths.
        int[] us={au,first,first,last,last,bu},vs={av,av,side,side,bv,bv};
        for(int i=1;i<us.length;i++) {
            if(alongX) segment(deck,baseX,baseZ,us[i-1],vs[i-1],us[i],vs[i]);
            else segment(deck,baseX,baseZ,vs[i-1],us[i-1],vs[i],us[i]);
        }
    }
    private static byte[] plan(int baseX,int baseZ,int floor,int roof,int max,long seed) {
        int height=max-floor;byte[] blocks=new byte[PAD*PAD*height];
        boolean[] interior=new boolean[PAD*PAD];
        for(int z=0;z<PAD;z++) for(int x=0;x<PAD;x++) {
            blocks[index(x,0,z)]=PLANK;
            for(int y=roof;y<max;y++) blocks[index(x,y-floor,z)]=PLANK;
        }
        int cellX=Math.floorDiv(baseX,CELL_SIZE),cellZ=Math.floorDiv(baseZ,CELL_SIZE);
        var layout=layout(seed,cellX,cellZ);var towers=layout.towers;
        var connections=new java.util.ArrayList<Bridge>();int margin=CELL_SIZE/4+3;
        for(Bridge b:layout.connections) if(Math.max(b.a.x,b.b.x)+margin>=baseX-2&&Math.min(b.a.x,b.b.x)-margin<=baseX+17
                &&Math.max(b.a.z,b.b.z)+margin>=baseZ-2&&Math.min(b.a.z,b.b.z)-margin<=baseZ+17) connections.add(b);
        for(int cz=3;cz<=7;cz++) for(int cx=3;cx<=7;cx++) {
            Tower t=towers[cz][cx];if(t==null) continue;
            for(int z=0;z<PAD;z++) for(int x=0;x<PAD;x++) {
                int wx=baseX+x-2,wz=baseZ+z-2,dx=wx-t.x,dz=wz-t.z;
                if(Math.abs(dx)>t.halfX || Math.abs(dz)>t.halfZ) continue;
                interior[z*PAD+x]=true;
                boolean wallX=Math.abs(dx)==t.halfX,wallZ=Math.abs(dz)==t.halfZ;
                for(int y=floor+1;y<roof;y++) {
                    int layer=y-floor;byte kind=AIR;
                    if(wallX&&wallZ) kind=LOG;
                    else if(wallX||wallZ) {
                        int along=wallX?dz+t.halfZ:dx+t.halfX;
                        boolean window=layer%FLOOR_SPACING>=2&&layer%FLOOR_SPACING<=3
                            &&Math.floorMod(along,4)>=2;
                        kind=window?GLASS:PLANK;
                    } else if(layer%FLOOR_SPACING==0&&y+2<roof) kind=PLANK;
                    // The ladder stays against a continuous corner wall, clear of bridge doorways.
                    if(dx==-t.halfX+1&&dz==-t.halfZ+1) kind=LADDER;
                    blocks[index(x,layer,z)]=kind;
                }
            }
        }
        boolean[] deck=new boolean[PAD*PAD],falseDeck=new boolean[PAD*PAD];
        for(int y=floor+TIER_SPACING;y+4<roof;y+=TIER_SPACING) {
            int tier=(y-floor)/TIER_SPACING;java.util.Arrays.fill(deck,false);java.util.Arrays.fill(falseDeck,false);
            for(Bridge bridge:connections) {
                route(deck,baseX,baseZ,bridge,seed,tier);
                if(roll(seed^0xC6BC279692B5CC83L^((long)tier*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L),
                        bridge.a.x^Integer.rotateLeft(bridge.b.x,16),bridge.a.z^Integer.rotateLeft(bridge.b.z,16),FALSE_BRIDGE_CHANCE))
                    route(falseDeck,baseX,baseZ,bridge,seed,tier);
            }
            for(int z=0;z<PAD;z++) for(int x=0;x<PAD;x++) if(deck[z*PAD+x]) {
                blocks[index(x,y-floor,z)]=falseDeck[z*PAD+x]&&!interior[z*PAD+x]?FALSE_PLANK:PLANK;
                // Join doors and junctions before adding edge rails; no fences across an intersection.
                for(int dy=1;dy<=3;dy++) if(blocks[index(x,y-floor+dy,z)]!=LADDER) blocks[index(x,y-floor+dy,z)]=AIR;
            }
            for(int z=1;z<PAD-1;z++) for(int x=1;x<PAD-1;x++) {
                int k=z*PAD+x;
                if(deck[k]&&!interior[k]&&(!deck[k-1]||!deck[k+1]||!deck[k-PAD]||!deck[k+PAD]
                        ||!deck[k-PAD-1]||!deck[k-PAD+1]||!deck[k+PAD-1]||!deck[k+PAD+1]))
                    blocks[index(x,y-floor+1,z)]=FENCE;
            }

        }
        // A passing bridge may cut a doorway near another tower's ladder; retain its backing wall.
        for(int cz=3;cz<=7;cz++) for(int cx=3;cx<=7;cx++) {
            Tower t=towers[cz][cx];if(t==null) continue;
            int x=t.x-t.halfX+1-baseX+2,z=t.z-t.halfZ+1-baseZ+2;
            if(x<1||x>=PAD||z<0||z>=PAD) continue;
            for(int y=1;y<height;y++) if(blocks[index(x,y,z)]==LADDER) blocks[index(x-1,y,z)]=PLANK;
        }
        for(int cz=3;cz<=7;cz++) for(int cx=3;cx<=7;cx++) {
            Tower t=towers[cz][cx];
            if(t==null||t.x+t.halfX<baseX-2||t.x-t.halfX>baseX+17||t.z+t.halfZ<baseZ-2||t.z-t.halfZ>baseZ+17) continue;
            for(int y=floor+FLOOR_SPACING;y<roof;y+=FLOOR_SPACING) {
                if(!roll(seed^0xD1342543DE82EF95L^((long)y*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L),t.x,t.z,FALSE_ROOM_FLOOR_CHANCE)) continue;
                int loX=Math.max(0,t.x-t.halfX+1-baseX+2),hiX=Math.min(PAD-1,t.x+t.halfX-1-baseX+2);
                int loZ=Math.max(0,t.z-t.halfZ+1-baseZ+2),hiZ=Math.min(PAD-1,t.z+t.halfZ-1-baseZ+2);
                for(int z=loZ;z<=hiZ;z++) for(int x=loX;x<=hiX;x++) {
                    int k=index(x,y-floor,z);if(blocks[k]==PLANK) blocks[k]=FALSE_PLANK;
                }
            }
            for(int y=floor;y+4<roof;y+=FLOOR_SPACING) {
                long portalSeed=seed^0x94D049BB133111EBL^((long)y*0xD1B54A32D192ED03L);
                if(roll(portalSeed,t.x,t.z,ROOM_PORTAL_CHANCE)) {
                    RoomPortal portal=roomPortal(t,portalSeed);
                    if(portal!=null) placeRoomPortal(blocks,baseX,baseZ,y-floor,portal);
                }
            }
        }
        for(int cz=3;cz<=7;cz++) for(int cx=3;cx<=7;cx++) {
            Tower t=towers[cz][cx];
            if(t==null||!roll(seed^0xDB4F0B9175AE2165L,t.x,t.z,SPAWNER_BUILDING_CHANCE)) continue;
            int x=t.x-baseX+2,z=t.z-baseZ+2;
            if(x<0||x>=PAD||z<0||z>=PAD) continue;
            for(int y=floor+1;y+2<roof;y+=FLOOR_SPACING) {
                if(!roll(seed^0xBBE0563303A4615FL^((long)y*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L),t.x,t.z,SPAWNER_FLOOR_CHANCE)) continue;
                int k=index(x,y-floor,z);
                if(blocks[k]==AIR&&(blocks[k-PAD*PAD]==PLANK||blocks[k-PAD*PAD]==FALSE_PLANK)&&blocks[k+PAD*PAD]==AIR) blocks[k]=SPAWNER;
            }
        }
        return blocks;
    }
    private record RoomPortal(int x,int z,boolean alongX,int front,boolean grain) {}
    private static RoomPortal roomPortal(Tower t,long seed) {
        long h=hash(seed^0x9FB21C651E98DF25L,t.x,t.z);int first=(int)Math.floorMod(h,4L);
        for(int n=0;n<4;n++) {
            int choice=(first+n)&3;boolean alongX=(choice&1)==0;int side=(choice&2)==0?-1:1;
            int half=alongX?t.halfX:t.halfZ,other=alongX?t.halfZ:t.halfX,slots=2*half-4;
            for(int i=0;i<slots;i++) {
                int u=-half+1+(int)Math.floorMod((h>>>8)+i,slots);
                int x=t.x+(alongX?u:side*(other-1)),z=t.z+(alongX?side*(other-1):u),front=-side;
                int endX=x+(alongX?3:front*2),endZ=z+(alongX?front*2:3);
                int minX=Math.min(x,endX),maxX=Math.max(x,endX),minZ=Math.min(z,endZ),maxZ=Math.max(z,endZ);
                if(Math.floorDiv(minX,16)!=Math.floorDiv(maxX,16)||Math.floorDiv(minZ,16)!=Math.floorDiv(maxZ,16)) continue;
                int ladderX=t.x-t.halfX+1,ladderZ=t.z-t.halfZ+1;
                if(ladderX>=minX&&ladderX<=maxX&&ladderZ>=minZ&&ladderZ<=maxZ) continue;
                return new RoomPortal(x,z,alongX,front,roll(seed^0xABC98388FB8FAC03L,t.x,t.z,GRAIN_PORTAL_CHANCE));
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    private static void placeRoomPortal(byte[] blocks,int baseX,int baseZ,int y,RoomPortal portal) {
        byte kind=portal.grain?(portal.alongX?GRAIN_X:GRAIN_Z):(portal.alongX?BACKWOODS_X:BACKWOODS_Z);
        for(int u=0;u<4;u++) for(int depth=0;depth<3;depth++) {
            int x=portal.x+(portal.alongX?u:depth*portal.front)-baseX+2;
            int z=portal.z+(portal.alongX?depth*portal.front:u)-baseZ+2;
            if(x<0||x>=PAD||z<0||z>=PAD) continue;
            blocks[index(x,y,z)]=PLANK; // Real oak frame base and a stable landing on either destination type.
            for(int dy=1;dy<=4;dy++) {
                if(depth==0) blocks[index(x,y+dy,z)]=(u==0||u==3||dy==4)?PLANK:kind;
                else if(dy<4) blocks[index(x,y+dy,z)]=AIR;
            }
        }
    }
    private static boolean roll(long seed,int x,int z,double chance) {
        return (hash(seed,x,z)>>>11)*0x1.0p-53<chance/100.0;
    }
    private static void segment(boolean[] deck,int baseX,int baseZ,int ax,int az,int bx,int bz) {
        int loX=Math.max(0,Math.min(ax,bx)-1-baseX+2),hiX=Math.min(PAD-1,Math.max(ax,bx)+1-baseX+2);
        int loZ=Math.max(0,Math.min(az,bz)-1-baseZ+2),hiZ=Math.min(PAD-1,Math.max(az,bz)+1-baseZ+2);
        for(int z=loZ;z<=hiZ;z++) for(int x=loX;x<=hiX;x++) deck[z*PAD+x]=true;
    }

    public static void autoGenerateDataPackJsons() {
        if(!ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) return;
        try {
            var project=findDevelopmentProject(net.neoforged.fml.loading.FMLPaths.GAMEDIR.get(),java.nio.file.Path.of(""));
            if(project==null) return; // Release builds consume packaged data; never write into a player's instance.
            var resources=project.resolve("src/main/resources");
            // Dimension data lives in data/<namespace>/dimension/<path>.json.
            String[] dimension=DIMENSION_ID.split(":",2);
            var dimensionFile=resources.resolve("data/"+dimension[0]+"/dimension/"+dimension[1]+".json");
            com.google.gson.JsonObject dimensionJson=null;
            if(java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(dimensionFile)) {
                dimensionJson=com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(java.nio.file.Files.readString(dimensionFile)).getAsJsonObject();
            }
            var outputs=new java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String>();
            // The first 1.21.1 Crossworks export accidentally selected the Sub Strata biome.
            if(dimensionJson!=null&&migrateBiome(dimensionJson))
                outputs.put(resources.relativize(dimensionFile).toString().replace('\\','/'),dimensionJson.toString());
            outputs.put("data/the_backwoods/worldgen/configured_feature/suspended_ward.json","{\"type\":\""+ID+"\",\"config\":{}}");
            outputs.put("data/the_backwoods/worldgen/placed_feature/suspended_ward_placed.json","{\"feature\":\""+ID+"\",\"placement\":[{\"type\":\"minecraft:biome\"}]}");
            outputs.put("data/the_backwoods/neoforge/biome_modifier/add_suspended_ward.json","{\"type\":\"neoforge:add_features\",\"biomes\":\""+BIOME_ID+"\",\"features\":\"the_backwoods:suspended_ward_placed\",\"step\":\"surface_structures\"}");
            if(ENABLE_AUTO_WORLD_HEIGHT_GEN) {
                if(dimensionJson==null) throw new IllegalStateException("Create the target dimension before generating its height data");
                if(GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT<64||GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT>4064||GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT%16!=0)
                    throw new IllegalStateException("World height must be a supported multiple of 16");
                if(!dimensionJson.get("type").getAsString().equals(DIMENSION_ID))
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Refusing to change a shared dimension type");
                var typeId=dimensionJson.get("type").getAsString().split(":",2);
                var typePath=resources.resolve("data/"+typeId[0]+"/dimension_type/"+typeId[1]+".json");
                var type=com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(java.nio.file.Files.readString(typePath)).getAsJsonObject();
                int minY=type.get("min_y").getAsInt();
                if(minY+GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT>2032) throw new IllegalStateException("Requested height exceeds Minecraft's upper bound");
                type.addProperty("height",GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT);type.addProperty("logical_height",GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT);
                var settings=dimensionJson.getAsJsonObject("generator").get("settings");
                if(!settings.isJsonObject()) throw new IllegalStateException("Height generation requires inline noise settings");
                var noise=settings.getAsJsonObject().getAsJsonObject("noise");
                noise.addProperty("height",GENERATED_WORLD_HEIGHT);noise.addProperty("min_y",minY);
                outputs.put(resources.relativize(typePath).toString().replace('\\','/'),type.toString());
                outputs.put(resources.relativize(dimensionFile).toString().replace('\\','/'),dimensionJson.toString());
            }
            if(ENABLE_FAST_TERRAIN_GEN&&dimensionJson!=null&&fastTerrain(dimensionJson)) {
                var backup=project.resolve(".suspended-ward-backups").resolve(resources.relativize(dimensionFile));
                if(!java.nio.file.Files.exists(backup)) {
                    java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(backup.getParent());java.nio.file.Files.copy(dimensionFile,backup);
                }
                outputs.put(resources.relativize(dimensionFile).toString().replace(java.io.File.separatorChar,'/'),dimensionJson.toString());
            }
            for(var root:java.util.List.of(resources,project.resolve("build/resources/main"))) {
                if(!java.nio.file.Files.isDirectory(root)) continue;
                for(var output:outputs.entrySet()) write(root.resolve(output.getKey()),output.getValue()+"\n");
                removeLegacyTag(root);
            }
        } catch(java.io.IOException|RuntimeException failure) {LOGGER.error("Suspended Ward development data generation failed",failure);}
    }
    private static java.nio.file.Path findDevelopmentProject(java.nio.file.Path... candidates) {
        for(var candidate:candidates) {
            var current=candidate.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            for(int up=0;up<3&&current!=null;up++,current=current.getParent()) {
                if((java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(current.resolve("build.gradle"))||java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(current.resolve("build.gradle.kts")))
                        &&java.nio.file.Files.isDirectory(current.resolve("src/main/resources"))) return current;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    private static boolean fastTerrain(com.google.gson.JsonObject dimension) {
        if(!dimension.get("type").isJsonPrimitive()||!dimension.get("type").getAsString().equals(DIMENSION_ID)) return false;
        var generator=dimension.getAsJsonObject("generator");
        if(!generator.get("type").getAsString().equals("minecraft:noise")||!generator.get("settings").isJsonObject()) return false;
        var source=generator.getAsJsonObject("biome_source");String type=source.get("type").getAsString();
        if(type.equals("minecraft:fixed")) {if(!source.get("biome").getAsString().equals(BIOME_ID)) return false;}
        else if(type.equals("minecraft:multi_noise")&&source.has("biomes")) {
            for(var biome:source.getAsJsonArray("biomes")) if(!biome.getAsJsonObject().get("biome").getAsString().equals(BIOME_ID)) return false;
        } else return false; // Preserve climate sampling for other biomes and shared presets.
        var settings=generator.getAsJsonObject("settings");String before=settings.toString();
        int min=settings.getAsJsonObject("noise").get("min_y").getAsInt();
        var router=settings.getAsJsonObject("noise_router");
        var density=new com.google.gson.JsonObject();density.addProperty("type","minecraft:y_clamped_gradient");
        density.addProperty("from_y",min+4);density.addProperty("to_y",min+5);
        density.addProperty("from_value",1);density.addProperty("to_value",-1);
        for(var entry:router.entrySet()) entry.setValue(new com.google.gson.JsonPrimitive(0));
        router.add("final_density",density);
        if(router.has("initial_density_without_jaggedness")) router.add("initial_density_without_jaggedness",density.deepCopy());
        if(router.has("preliminary_surface_level")) router.addProperty("preliminary_surface_level",min+4);
        settings.addProperty("aquifers_enabled",false);settings.addProperty("ore_veins_enabled",false);
        settings.addProperty("sea_level",min-1);
        return !before.equals(settings.toString());
    }
    private static boolean migrateBiome(com.google.gson.JsonElement element) {
        boolean changed=false;
        if(element.isJsonArray()) for(var child:element.getAsJsonArray()) changed|=migrateBiome(child);
        else if(element.isJsonObject()) for(var entry:element.getAsJsonObject().entrySet()) {
            if(entry.getKey().equals("biome")&&entry.getValue().isJsonPrimitive()
                    &&entry.getValue().getAsString().equals("the_backwoods:the_dead_grain")) {
                entry.setValue(new com.google.gson.JsonPrimitive(BIOME_ID));changed=true;
            } else if(entry.getKey().equals("biome_is")&&entry.getValue().isJsonArray()) {
                var array=entry.getValue().getAsJsonArray();
                for(int i=0;i<array.size();i++) if(array.get(i).isJsonPrimitive()
                        &&array.get(i).getAsString().equals("the_backwoods:the_dead_grain")) {
                    array.set(i,new com.google.gson.JsonPrimitive(BIOME_ID));changed=true;
                }
            } else changed|=migrateBiome(entry.getValue());
        }
        return changed;
    }
    private static void removeLegacyTag(java.nio.file.Path root) throws java.io.IOException {
        var path=root.resolve("data/the_backwoods/tags/worldgen/biome/has_suspended_ward.json");
        if(!java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(path)) return;
        var tag=com.google.gson.JsonParser.parseString(java.nio.file.Files.readString(path)).getAsJsonObject();
        if(!tag.has("replace")||tag.get("replace").getAsBoolean()||!tag.has("values")) return;
        for(var entry:tag.getAsJsonArray("values")) {
            String id=entry.isJsonObject()?entry.getAsJsonObject().get("id").getAsString():entry.getAsString();
            if(!id.equals(BIOME_ID)&&!id.equals("the_backwoods:the_dead_grain")) return;
        }
        java.nio.file.Files.delete(path); // Retire only the previous generator's known tag, after replacing its modifier.
    }
    private static void write(java.nio.file.Path file,String content) throws java.io.IOException {
        if(java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(file)&&java.nio.file.Files.readString(file).equals(content)) return;
        java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());var temporary=java.nio.file.Files.createTempFile(file.getParent(),"suspended-ward-",".tmp");
        try {java.nio.file.Files.writeString(temporary,content);java.nio.file.Files.move(temporary,file,java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}
        finally {java.nio.file.Files.deleteIfExists(temporary);}
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;

import com.mojang.brigadier.context.CommandContext;

@EventBusSubscriber
public class SwitchDimensionsCommand {

	@SubscribeEvent
	public static void registerCommand(RegisterCommandsEvent event) {
		event.getDispatcher().register(Commands.literal("switchdimensions")
			.requires(s -> s.hasPermission(4))
			.then(Commands.argument("target_dim", DimensionArgument.dimension())
				.executes(SwitchDimensionsCommand::execute)
			)
		);
	}

	public static int execute(CommandContext<CommandSourceStack> arguments) {
		try {
			ServerPlayer player = arguments.getSource().getPlayerOrException();
			ServerLevel targetLevel = DimensionArgument.getDimension(arguments, "target_dim");

			if (targetLevel != null) {
				player.teleportTo(targetLevel, player.getX(), player.getY(), player.getZ(), player.getYRot(), player.getXRot());
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		return 0;
	}
} // 1.21.1

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods;

import org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger;
import org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.registration.PayloadRegistrar;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.network.handling.IPayloadHandler;

import net.mcreator.thebackwoods.network.TheBackwoodsModVariables;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;

import java.util.PriorityQueue;

import java.util.Comparator;

import it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.ints.IntObjectPair;

@Mod("the_backwoods")
public class TheBackwoodsMod {
	public static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(TheBackwoodsMod.class);
	public static final String MODID = "the_backwoods";

	public TheBackwoodsMod(IEventBus modEventBus) {
		// Start of user code block mod constructor
		net.mcreator.thebackwoods.init.ModFeatures.register(modEventBus);
		// End of user code block mod constructor
		NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.register(this);
		modEventBus.addListener(this::registerNetworking);
		TheBackwoodsModSounds.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModBlocks.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModItems.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModEntities.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModTabs.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModVariables.ATTACHMENT_TYPES.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModFeatures.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModPotions.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModMobEffects.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		TheBackwoodsModParticleTypes.REGISTRY.register(modEventBus);
		// Start of user code block mod init
		// End of user code block mod init
	}

	// Start of user code block mod methods
	// End of user code block mod methods
	private static boolean networkingRegistered = false;
	private static final Map<CustomPacketPayload.Type<?>, NetworkMessage<?>> MESSAGES = new HashMap<>();

	private record NetworkMessage<T extends CustomPacketPayload>(StreamCodec<? extends FriendlyByteBuf, T> reader, IPayloadHandler<T> handler) {
	}

	public static <T extends CustomPacketPayload> void addNetworkMessage(CustomPacketPayload.Type<T> id, StreamCodec<? extends FriendlyByteBuf, T> reader, IPayloadHandler<T> handler) {
		if (networkingRegistered)
			throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot register new network messages after networking has been registered");
		MESSAGES.put(id, new NetworkMessage<>(reader, handler));
	}

	@SuppressWarnings({"rawtypes", "unchecked"})
	private void registerNetworking(final RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent event) {
		final PayloadRegistrar registrar = event.registrar(MODID);
		MESSAGES.forEach((id, networkMessage) -> registrar.playBidirectional(id, ((NetworkMessage) networkMessage).reader(), ((NetworkMessage) networkMessage).handler()));
		networkingRegistered = true;
	}

	private static final Queue<IntObjectPair<Runnable>> workToBeScheduled = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
	private static final PriorityQueue<TickTask> workQueue = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(TickTask::getTick));

	public static void queueServerWork(int delay, Runnable action) {
		if (Thread.currentThread().getThreadGroup() == SidedThreadGroups.SERVER)
			workToBeScheduled.add(new IntObjectImmutablePair<>(delay, action));
	}

	@SubscribeEvent
	public void tick(ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
		int currentTick = event.getServer().getTickCount();
		IntObjectPair<Runnable> work;
		while ((work = workToBeScheduled.poll()) != null) {
			workQueue.add(new TickTask(currentTick + work.leftInt(), work.right()));
		}
		while (!workQueue.isEmpty() && currentTick >= workQueue.peek().getTick()) {
			workQueue.poll().run();
		}
	}
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

// 1.21.1 neo
import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class TheUndersideFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    public TheUndersideFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level  = context.level();
        BlockPos      origin = context.origin();

        // --- CONFIGURABLE BOUNDS ---
        int bottomY = 20;
        int topY    = 44;
        int gridSpacing = 4; 
        // ----------------------------

        BlockState plankState = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState fenceState = Blocks.OAK_FENCE.defaultBlockState();
        BlockState airState   = Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();

        // Grab raw chunk access to overwrite data sections directly
        ChunkAccess chunk = level.getChunk(origin);
        int minX = origin.getX() & (~15);
        int minZ = origin.getZ() & (~15);
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos targetPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        // Loop across the strict 16x16 chunk grid columns
        for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
            for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                int absX = minX + x;
                int absZ = minZ + z;

                // Determine if this absolute coordinate hits our fence grid lines
                boolean isFenceColumn = (Math.abs(absX) % gridSpacing == 0) && (Math.abs(absZ) % gridSpacing == 0);

                for (int y = bottomY; y <= topY; y++) {
                    targetPos.set(absX, y, absZ);

                    if (y == topY) {
                        // Strict Ceiling
                        setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);
                    } else if (y == bottomY) {
                        // Solid Floor Base
                        setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);
                    } else {
                        if (isFenceColumn) {
                            setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, fenceState);
                        } else {
                            // DEEP FORCE-OVERWRITE: Overwrites existing chunk generation states directly
                            // This replaces terrain rule blocks/mazes instantly as they process
                            setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, airState);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static void setIfDifferent(ChunkAccess chunk, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (chunk.getBlockState(pos) != state) {
            chunk.setBlockState(pos, state, false);
        }
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;

import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.util.RandomSource;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.RotatedPillarBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileWriter;

public class TimberBeamFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    // Toggleable self-writing JSON logic (defaults to true)
    public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN = true;

    // Configurable Odds Weights
    public static int WEIGHT_OAK_LOG = 50;
    public static int WEIGHT_OAK_PLANKS = 40;
    public static int WEIGHT_PETRIFIED_OAK_PLANKS = 10;

    // Barely noticeable catenary sag across the mountain span
    public static double MAX_SAG = 0.8;

    // Depth the beam embeds into the mountain cliff walls on both ends
    public static int EMBED_DEPTH = 7;

    // Candidate horizontal angles (degrees) to support slanted bridging
    private static final double[] ANGLES_DEG = {
        0.0, 11.25, 22.5, 33.75, 45.0, 56.25, 67.5, 78.75,
        90.0, 101.25, 112.5, 123.75, 135.0, 146.25, 157.5, 168.75
    };

    static {
        if (ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) {
            autoGenerateDataPackJsons();
        }
    }

    public TimberBeamFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    public static void autoGenerateDataPackJsons() {
        if (!ENABLE_AUTO_DATAPACK_GEN) return;

        try {
            String[] candidateRoots = new String[] {
                "src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "../src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "../../src/main/resources/data/the_backwoods",
                "build/resources/main/data/the_backwoods"
            };

            for (String rootPath : candidateRoots) {
                File rootDir = new File(rootPath);
                File parent = rootDir.getParentFile();

                if (rootDir.exists() || (parent != null && parent.exists())) {
                    File confDir = new File(rootDir, "worldgen/configured_feature");
                    confDir.mkdirs();
                    File confFile = new File(confDir, "timber_beam.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(confFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"type\": \"the_backwoods:timber_beam\",\n  \"config\": {}\n}");
                    }

                    // Count placement modifier set to 6 attempts per chunk
                    File placedDir = new File(rootDir, "worldgen/placed_feature");
                    placedDir.mkdirs();
                    File placedFile = new File(placedDir, "timber_beam_placed.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(placedFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"feature\": \"the_backwoods:timber_beam\",\n  \"placement\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:count\",\n      \"count\": 6\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:in_square\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:heightmap\",\n      \"heightmap\": \"WORLD_SURFACE_WG\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"minecraft:biome\"\n    }\n  ]\n}");
                    }

                    File biomeDir = new File(rootDir, "neoforge/biome_modifier");
                    biomeDir.mkdirs();
                    File biomeFile = new File(biomeDir, "add_timber_beam.json");
                    try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(biomeFile, false)) {
                        writer.write("{\n  \"type\": \"neoforge:add_features\",\n  \"biomes\": [\n    \"the_backwoods:wood_plains\",\n    \"the_backwoods:deep_backwoods\",\n    \"the_backwoods:the_thicket\"\n  ],\n  \"features\": \"the_backwoods:timber_beam_placed\",\n  \"step\": \"surface_structures\"\n}");
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private BlockState getPetrifiedOakPlanks() {
        try {
            Block block = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.get(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("the_backwoods", "petrified_oak_planks"));
            if (block != null && block != Blocks.AIR) {
                return block.defaultBlockState();
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
    }

    private boolean isMountainCliff(WorldGenLevel level, int x, int y, int z, int floorY, BlockPos.MutableBlockPos testPos) {
        // 1. Surface check: The terrain heightmap column at (x, z) must be near or above the beam elevation
        int surfaceY = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, x, z);
        if (surfaceY < y - 2) {
            return false;
        }

        // 2. Downward solid support check:
        // A floating timber beam has empty air directly beneath it over the canyon chasm.
        // A real mountain cliff has solid ground (planks, logs, petrified planks, stone, dirt) extending downwards.
        int checkY1 = y - 5;
        int checkY2 = y - 9;
        if (checkY1 > floorY + 2) {
            testPos.set(x, checkY1, z);
            BlockState s1 = level.getBlockState(testPos);
            if (s1.isAir() || s1.canBeReplaced() || s1.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (checkY2 > floorY + 2) {
            testPos.set(x, checkY2, z);
            BlockState s2 = level.getBlockState(testPos);
            if (s2.isAir() || s2.canBeReplaced() || s2.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level = context.level();
        BlockPos origin = context.origin();
        RandomSource random = context.random();

        int chunkBaseX = origin.getX() & ~15;
        int chunkBaseZ = origin.getZ() & ~15;
        int centerX = chunkBaseX + 8;
        int centerZ = chunkBaseZ + 8;

        // Strict 3x3 chunk writable boundaries of WorldGenRegion
        int safeMinX = chunkBaseX - 16;
        int safeMaxX = chunkBaseX + 31;
        int safeMinZ = chunkBaseZ - 16;
        int safeMaxZ = chunkBaseZ + 31;

        // Locate the lowest plausible valley point in the candidate chunk
        int centerFloorY = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, centerX, centerZ);
        int[][] centerCandidates = {
            {Math.max(chunkBaseX + 3, Math.min(chunkBaseX + 12, origin.getX())),
             Math.max(chunkBaseZ + 3, Math.min(chunkBaseZ + 12, origin.getZ()))},
            {chunkBaseX + 4, chunkBaseZ + 4}, {chunkBaseX + 8, chunkBaseZ + 4}, {chunkBaseX + 12, chunkBaseZ + 4},
            {chunkBaseX + 4, chunkBaseZ + 8}, {chunkBaseX + 12, chunkBaseZ + 8},
            {chunkBaseX + 4, chunkBaseZ + 12}, {chunkBaseX + 8, chunkBaseZ + 12}, {chunkBaseX + 12, chunkBaseZ + 12}
        };
        for (int[] candidate : centerCandidates) {
            int candidateY = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, candidate[0], candidate[1]);
            if (candidateY < centerFloorY) {
                centerX = candidate[0];
                centerZ = candidate[1];
                centerFloorY = candidateY;
            }
        }
        if (centerFloorY < level.getMinBuildHeight() + 10 || centerFloorY > level.getMaxBuildHeight() - 35) {
            return false;
        }

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos scanPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        int angleStartIdx = random.nextInt(ANGLES_DEG.length);
        boolean canyonFound = false;

        double chosenStartX = 0.0;
        double chosenStartZ = 0.0;
        double chosenEndX = 0.0;
        double chosenEndZ = 0.0;
        int chosenBeamY = 0;
        int chosenBaseRadius = 3;
        double chosenDirX = 1.0;
        double chosenDirZ = 0.0;
        int chosenScore = Integer.MIN_VALUE;

        for (int i = 0; i < ANGLES_DEG.length; i++) {
            double angleDeg = ANGLES_DEG[(angleStartIdx + i) % ANGLES_DEG.length];
            double rad = Math.toRadians(angleDeg);
            double dirX = Math.cos(rad);
            double dirZ = Math.sin(rad);

            int maxRayD = 52;

            // 1. Broad terrain sampling (up to 60 blocks outward) to detect true high mountain ridge summits
            int negPeakY = centerFloorY;
            for (int d = 4; d <= 60; d += 2) {
                int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX - d * dirX);
                int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ - d * dirZ);
                int hy = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, sx, sz);
                if (hy > negPeakY) negPeakY = hy;
            }

            int posPeakY = centerFloorY;
            for (int d = 4; d <= 60; d += 2) {
                int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX + d * dirX);
                int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ + d * dirZ);
                int hy = level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, sx, sz);
                if (hy > posPeakY) posPeakY = hy;
            }

            int minPeakY = Math.min(negPeakY, posPeakY);
            int relief = minPeakY - centerFloorY;
            // Grand canyon requirement: must have at least 22 blocks of mountain relief
            if (relief < 22) continue;

            // Test candidate bridge elevations aiming high in the canyon (around 34 blocks up)
            int[] candidateOffsets = {34, 30, 38, 26, 42, 48, (int) Math.round(relief * 0.72), (int) Math.round(relief * 0.82), minPeakY - centerFloorY - 5};
            for (int offset : candidateOffsets) {
                int targetBeamY = centerFloorY + offset;
                if (targetBeamY < centerFloorY + 18 || targetBeamY > minPeakY - 2) continue;

                // Open chasm verification: ensure wide empty gorge under the beam at canyon center
                scanPos.set(centerX, targetBeamY - 6, centerZ);
                BlockState under1 = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
                if (!under1.isAir() && !under1.canBeReplaced() && !(under1.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock)) {
                    continue; // Blocked under center: low hill or ground
                }
                if (targetBeamY - 14 > centerFloorY + 2) {
                    scanPos.set(centerX, targetBeamY - 14, centerZ);
                    BlockState under2 = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
                    if (!under2.isAir() && !under2.canBeReplaced() && !(under2.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                // 2. Raycast to locate opposing cliff walls (with mountain cliff verification)
                int negDist = 0;
                for (int d = 4; d <= maxRayD; d++) {
                    int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX - d * dirX);
                    int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ - d * dirZ);
                    scanPos.set(sx, targetBeamY, sz);
                    BlockState st = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
                    if (!st.isAir() && !st.canBeReplaced() && !(st.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock)) {
                        if (isMountainCliff(level, sx, targetBeamY, sz, centerFloorY, scanPos)) {
                            negDist = d;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                int posDist = 0;
                for (int d = 4; d <= maxRayD; d++) {
                    int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX + d * dirX);
                    int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ + d * dirZ);
                    scanPos.set(sx, targetBeamY, sz);
                    BlockState st = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
                    if (!st.isAir() && !st.canBeReplaced() && !(st.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock)) {
                        if (isMountainCliff(level, sx, targetBeamY, sz, centerFloorY, scanPos)) {
                            posDist = d;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (negDist < 5 || posDist < 5) continue;
                int canyonSpan = negDist + posDist;
                if (canyonSpan < 14 || canyonSpan > 70) continue;

                // Anti-hill check: ensure mountain mass continues behind the cliff contact points
                int negBackX = (int) Math.round(centerX - (negDist + 5) * dirX);
                int negBackZ = (int) Math.round(centerZ - (negDist + 5) * dirZ);
                int posBackX = (int) Math.round(centerX + (posDist + 5) * dirX);
                int posBackZ = (int) Math.round(centerZ + (posDist + 5) * dirZ);
                if (level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, negBackX, negBackZ) < targetBeamY - 3 ||
                    level.getHeight(Heightmap.Types.WORLD_SURFACE_WG, posBackX, posBackZ) < targetBeamY - 3) {
                    continue; // Drops off behind cliff: isolated bump or low hill
                }

                int candidateRadius = (canyonSpan > 26) ? (3 + random.nextInt(2)) : (2 + random.nextInt(2));

                // 3. Deep embedding verification: ensure beam core deeply enters solid rock/wood so flat ends are sealed
                int desiredEmbed = Math.max(candidateRadius + 2, EMBED_DEPTH);
                int maxNegEmbed = desiredEmbed;
                int actualNegEmbed = 0;
                for (int emb = 1; emb <= maxNegEmbed; emb++) {
                    int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX - (negDist + emb) * dirX);
                    int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ - (negDist + emb) * dirZ);
                    scanPos.set(sx, targetBeamY, sz);
                    BlockState st = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
                    if (st.isAir() || st.canBeReplaced()) break;
                    actualNegEmbed = emb;
                }
                if (actualNegEmbed < candidateRadius + 1) continue;

                int maxPosEmbed = desiredEmbed;
                int actualPosEmbed = 0;
                for (int emb = 1; emb <= maxPosEmbed; emb++) {
                    int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX + (posDist + emb) * dirX);
                    int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ + (posDist + emb) * dirZ);
                    scanPos.set(sx, targetBeamY, sz);
                    BlockState st = level.getBlockState(scanPos);
                    if (st.isAir() || st.canBeReplaced()) break;
                    actualPosEmbed = emb;
                }
                if (actualPosEmbed < candidateRadius + 1) continue;

                // 4. Verify open canyon clearance: allow trees and leaves, but reject if blocked by mountain ridge
                boolean airGapClear = true;
                int consecutiveSolids = 0;
                for (int d = -negDist + 2; d <= posDist - 2; d++) {
                    int sx = (int) Math.round(centerX + d * dirX);
                    int sz = (int) Math.round(centerZ + d * dirZ);
                    scanPos.set(sx, targetBeamY, sz);
                    BlockState st = level.getBlockState(scanPos);

                    if (st.isAir() || st.canBeReplaced() || st.getBlock() instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.LeavesBlock) {
                        consecutiveSolids = 0;
                        continue;
                    }

                    consecutiveSolids++;
                    if (consecutiveSolids >= 3) {
                        airGapClear = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!airGapClear) continue;

                // Calculate start and end coordinates deep within both mountain walls
                double startX = (double) centerX - (negDist + actualNegEmbed) * dirX;
                double startZ = (double) centerZ - (negDist + actualNegEmbed) * dirZ;
                double endX = (double) centerX + (posDist + actualPosEmbed) * dirX;
                double endZ = (double) centerZ + (posDist + actualPosEmbed) * dirZ;

                int minBoundX = (int) Math.floor(Math.min(startX, endX)) - (candidateRadius + 2);
                int maxBoundX = (int) Math.ceil(Math.max(startX, endX)) + (candidateRadius + 2);
                int minBoundZ = (int) Math.floor(Math.min(startZ, endZ)) - (candidateRadius + 2);
                int maxBoundZ = (int) Math.ceil(Math.max(startZ, endZ)) + (candidateRadius + 2);

                // STRICT ENGINE BOUNDARY CHECK:
                // WorldGenRegion only permits writing within the 3x3 chunks around the origin chunk (safeMinX..safeMaxX, safeMinZ..safeMaxZ).
                // Any block placed beyond this boundary is dropped by WorldGenRegion.ensureCanWrite(), which creates a flat slice in mid-air.
                // We reject the candidate entirely if ANY part of the beam (including embedded ends) lies outside this writable region.
                if (minBoundX < safeMinX || maxBoundX > safeMaxX || minBoundZ < safeMinZ || maxBoundZ > safeMaxZ) {
                    continue;
                }

                // Strongly prioritize highest canyon elevation (targetBeamY)
                int candidateScore = targetBeamY * 40 + canyonSpan;
                if (canyonFound && candidateScore <= chosenScore) continue;

                chosenStartX = startX;
                chosenStartZ = startZ;
                chosenEndX = endX;
                chosenEndZ = endZ;
                chosenBeamY = targetBeamY;
                chosenBaseRadius = candidateRadius;
                chosenDirX = dirX;
                chosenDirZ = dirZ;
                chosenScore = candidateScore;
                canyonFound = true;
            }
        }

        if (!canyonFound) {
            return false;
        }

        // Material Selection (Uniform per pillar)
        int totalWeight = WEIGHT_OAK_LOG + WEIGHT_OAK_PLANKS + WEIGHT_PETRIFIED_OAK_PLANKS;
        int roll = random.nextInt(Math.max(1, totalWeight));
        BlockState chosenMaterial;

        if (roll < WEIGHT_PETRIFIED_OAK_PLANKS) {
            chosenMaterial = getPetrifiedOakPlanks();
        } else if (roll < WEIGHT_PETRIFIED_OAK_PLANKS + WEIGHT_OAK_PLANKS) {
            chosenMaterial = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        } else {
            Direction.Axis axis = Math.abs(chosenDirX) > Math.abs(chosenDirZ) ? Direction.Axis.X : Direction.Axis.Z;
            chosenMaterial = Blocks.OAK_LOG.defaultBlockState().setValue(RotatedPillarBlock.AXIS, axis);
        }

        // 5. Continuous 3D Distance Field Voxelization
        // Tests every single integer voxel in the bounding box to guarantee 100% solid wood with zero sponge holes
        double dx = chosenEndX - chosenStartX;
        double dz = chosenEndZ - chosenStartZ;
        double spanLength = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (spanLength <= 1.0) return false;

        double normDirX = dx / spanLength;
        double normDirZ = dz / spanLength;
        double perpX = -normDirZ;
        double perpZ = normDirX;

        int minBoundX = (int) Math.floor(Math.min(chosenStartX, chosenEndX)) - (chosenBaseRadius + 2);
        int maxBoundX = (int) Math.ceil(Math.max(chosenStartX, chosenEndX)) + (chosenBaseRadius + 2);
        int minBoundZ = (int) Math.floor(Math.min(chosenStartZ, chosenEndZ)) - (chosenBaseRadius + 2);
        int maxBoundZ = (int) Math.ceil(Math.max(chosenStartZ, chosenEndZ)) + (chosenBaseRadius + 2);
        int minBoundY = chosenBeamY - (int) Math.ceil(MAX_SAG) - (chosenBaseRadius + 2);
        int maxBoundY = chosenBeamY + (chosenBaseRadius + 2);

        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos placePos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        for (int x = minBoundX; x <= maxBoundX; x++) {
            for (int z = minBoundZ; z <= maxBoundZ; z++) {
                double rx = (double) x - chosenStartX;
                double rz = (double) z - chosenStartZ;
                double distAlong = rx * normDirX + rz * normDirZ;

                // Seamless rounded capsule end caps preventing any flat cut-offs
                double distPast = 0.0;
                if (distAlong < 0.0) {
                    distPast = -distAlong;
                } else if (distAlong > spanLength) {
                    distPast = distAlong - spanLength;
                }

                if (distPast > (double) chosenBaseRadius + 1.0) {
                    continue;
                }

                double t = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, distAlong / spanLength));
                double sag = 4.0 * MAX_SAG * t * (1.0 - t);
                double spineY = (double) chosenBeamY - sag;

                double perpDist = Math.abs(rx * perpX + rz * perpZ);
                double lengthNoise = Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2.0) * 0.25;

                for (int y = minBoundY; y <= maxBoundY; y++) {
                    double dy = (double) y - spineY;
                    double distSq = perpDist * perpDist + dy * dy + distPast * distPast;

                    double angle = Math.atan2(dy, rx * perpX + rz * perpZ);
                    double surfaceFlaw = Math.cos(angle * 3.0 + distAlong * 0.35) * 0.25;
                    double currentRadius = (double) chosenBaseRadius + lengthNoise + surfaceFlaw;

                    // Solid continuous distance check
                    if (distSq <= currentRadius * currentRadius) {
                        if (x < safeMinX || x > safeMaxX || z < safeMinZ || z > safeMaxZ) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        placePos.set(x, y, z);
                        BlockState existing = level.getBlockState(placePos);
                        if (!existing.is(Blocks.BEDROCK)) {
                            // Never extrude exposed wood into open air behind thin mountain ridges
                            if (distPast > 0.5 && (existing.isAir() || existing.canBeReplaced())) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            level.setBlock(placePos, chosenMaterial, 2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

package net.mcreator.thebackwoods.world.feature;
// 1.21.1 neo
import com.mojang.serialization.Codec;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.WorldGenLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.ChunkAccess;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.Feature;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.FeaturePlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.configurations.NoneFeatureConfiguration;

public class UpsideDownCityFeature extends Feature<NoneFeatureConfiguration> {

    public UpsideDownCityFeature(Codec<NoneFeatureConfiguration> codec) {
        super(codec);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean place(FeaturePlaceContext<NoneFeatureConfiguration> context) {
        WorldGenLevel level  = context.level();
        BlockPos      origin = context.origin();

        // --- CONFIGURABLE CITY SETTINGS ---
        int ceilingY = 160;            // Fixed height altitude
        int gridSize = 10;             // The total size of each global sector tile

        // Configurable Building Sizes
        int minBuildingWidthX  = 5;    
        int maxBuildingWidthX  = 8;   
        int minBuildingWidthZ  = 5;    
        int maxBuildingWidthZ  = 8;   
        int minBuildingLengthY = 20;   
        int maxBuildingLengthY = 50;   
        // ----------------------------------

        BlockState plankState = Blocks.OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState();
        int minX = origin.getX() & (~15);
        int minZ = origin.getZ() & (~15);
        ChunkAccess chunk = level.getChunk(origin);
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos targetPos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();

        // Run through every block in the 16x16 chunk space sequentially
        for (int rx = 0; rx < 16; rx++) {
            for (int rz = 0; rz < 16; rz++) {
                int blockX = minX + rx;
                int blockZ = minZ + rz;

                targetPos.set(blockX, ceilingY, blockZ);
                
                // 1. Force the solid ceiling plate using Flag 16 (Bypasses carvers and boundary clipping)
                setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);

                // 2. Global Coordinate Grid Math
                int cellX = Math.floorMod(blockX, gridSize);
                int cellZ = Math.floorMod(blockZ, gridSize);

                int sectorX = Math.floorDiv(blockX, gridSize);
                int sectorZ = Math.floorDiv(blockZ, gridSize);
                
                long sectorHash = ((long) sectorX * 418731283L) ^ ((long) sectorZ * 13289791L);
                
                int bWidthX = minBuildingWidthX + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 4567L) % (maxBuildingWidthX - minBuildingWidthX + 1));
                int bWidthZ = minBuildingWidthZ + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash ^ 9876L) % (maxBuildingWidthZ - minBuildingWidthZ + 1));
                int bHeight = minBuildingLengthY + (int) (Math.abs(sectorHash) % (maxBuildingLengthY - minBuildingLengthY + 1));

                // If the block falls inside the calculated global box zone, stamp it down directly
                if (cellX < bWidthX && cellZ < bWidthZ) {
                    if (Math.abs(sectorHash % 100) < 85) { 
                        for (int dy = 1; dy <= bHeight; dy++) {
                            int currentY = ceilingY - dy;
                            targetPos.set(blockX, currentY, blockZ);
                            
                            // Inject building block straight into world data via Flag 16
                            setIfDifferent(chunk, targetPos, plankState);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static void setIfDifferent(ChunkAccess chunk, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (chunk.getBlockState(pos) != state) {
            chunk.setBlockState(pos, state, false);
        }
    }
}

	@EventBusSubscriber(value = Dist.CLIENT)
	public static class VerdantEngineGravityClientRenderer {
		private static final ResourceLocation WHITE_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:textures/misc/white.png");
		private static final ResourceLocation BEACON_TEXTURE = ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:textures/entity/beacon_beam.png");
		private static final java.util.Map<String, Field> SYNCED_DATA_FIELD_CACHE = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

		private static ResourceLocation getBeamTexture() {
			return USE_BEACON_TEXTURE ? BEACON_TEXTURE : WHITE_TEXTURE;
		}

		private static class ClientRenderState {
			double localRingTravel = 0.0;
			double prevRingTravel = 0.0;
			int lastGameTick = -1;
			int beamActiveTicks = 0;
			int currentCycle = 0;
			int decayTicks = 0;
			double opacityMultiplier = 1.0;
			double targetOpacity = 1.0;
			double groundY = 0.0;

			ClientRenderState(int initialTicks) {
				this.beamActiveTicks = initialTicks;
			}

			void update(LivingEntity entity, int gameTick, boolean isCharging, boolean isActive) {
				if (gameTick != lastGameTick) {
					lastGameTick = gameTick;
					prevRingTravel = localRingTravel;
					if (isCharging) {
						beamActiveTicks = 0;
						opacityMultiplier = 1.0;
						targetOpacity = 1.0;
					} else if (isActive) {
						beamActiveTicks++;
						if (beamActiveTicks >= 40) {
							currentCycle = (beamActiveTicks - 40) % 240;
							if (currentCycle == 0 && beamActiveTicks > 40) {
								decayTicks = 50;
								targetOpacity = 1.0;
							} else if (decayTicks > 0) {
								decayTicks--;
							}
						}
						// Smoothly decay opacity by a random 1-3% every second (20 ticks)
						if (beamActiveTicks >= 40) {
							if ((beamActiveTicks - 40) % 20 == 0) {
								double randDecrease = 0.01 + entity.getRandom().nextDouble() * 0.02;
								targetOpacity = Math.max(0.1, targetOpacity - randDecrease);
							}
							opacityMultiplier += (targetOpacity - opacityMultiplier) * 0.05;
						}
						// Direct client-side block collision check every tick
						groundY = findClientGroundBelow(entity.level(), entity.getX(), entity.getZ(), entity.getY() + entity.getBbHeight() * 0.5);
					}
					if (beamActiveTicks >= 40 && currentCycle >= 160 && currentCycle < 240) {
						double chargeProg = (double) (currentCycle - 160) / (240 - 160);
						double easeQuint = Math.pow(chargeProg, 3.2);
						double ringSpeed = 0.008 + 0.075 * easeQuint;
						localRingTravel += ringSpeed;
					} else {
						prevRingTravel = 0.0;
						localRingTravel = 0.0;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static final java.util.Map<Integer, ClientRenderState> CLIENT_STATES = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

		private static LivingEntity getEntityFromEvent(Object event) {
			if (event == null) return null;
			try {
				java.lang.reflect.Method m = event.getClass().getMethod("getEntity");
				Object res = m.invoke(event);
				if (res instanceof LivingEntity le) return le;
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
			try {
				java.lang.reflect.Method m = event.getClass().getMethod("getRenderState");
				Object state = m.invoke(event);
				if (state != null) {
					try {
						java.lang.reflect.Method m2 = state.getClass().getMethod("getEntity");
						Object res = m2.invoke(state);
						if (res instanceof LivingEntity le) return le;
					} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
					try {
						Field f = state.getClass().getDeclaredField("entity");
						f.setAccessible(true);
						Object res = f.get(state);
						if (res instanceof LivingEntity le) return le;
					} catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
				}
			} catch (Throwable ignored3) {}
			return null;
		}

		private static void setNoCulling(Entity entity) {
			if (entity == null) return;
			try {
				Field f = Entity.class.getField("noCulling");
				f.setBoolean(entity, true);
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {
				try {
					Field f = Entity.class.getDeclaredField("noCulling");
					f.setAccessible(true);
					f.setBoolean(entity, true);
				} catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
			}
		}

		private static Boolean shadersActiveCached = null;
		private static long lastShaderCheckTime = 0;

		public static boolean isShaderActive() {
			long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
			if (shadersActiveCached != null && (now - lastShaderCheckTime < 1000)) {
				return shadersActiveCached;
			}
			boolean active = false;
			try {
				Class<?> irisApi = Class.forName("net.irisshaders.iris.api.v0.IrisApi");
				Object instance = irisApi.getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
				if (instance != null) {
					Object res = irisApi.getMethod("isShaderPackInUse").invoke(instance);
					if (res instanceof Boolean b && b) {
						active = true;
					}
				}
			} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
			if (!active) {
				try {
					Class<?> optifineConfig = Class.forName("net.optifine.Config");
					Object res = optifineConfig.getMethod("isShaders").invoke(null);
					if (res instanceof Boolean b && b) {
						active = true;
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
			}
			if (!active) {
				try {
					Class<?> optifineConfig2 = Class.forName("Config");
					Object res = optifineConfig2.getMethod("isShaders").invoke(null);
					if (res instanceof Boolean b && b) {
						active = true;
					}
				} catch (Throwable ignored) {}
			}
			shadersActiveCached = active;
			lastShaderCheckTime = now;
			return active;
		}

		private static RenderType getGlowRenderType(ResourceLocation texture) {

		private static boolean isVerdantEngine(Entity entity) {
