		}

		private static boolean getSyncedCurrentlyTerraforming(Entity entity) {
			if (entity == null) return false;
			EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> acc = getEntityDataAccessor(entity, "currentlyTerraforming");
			if (acc != null) {
				try { return entity.getEntityData().get(acc); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
			return entity.getPersistentData().contains("currentlyTerraforming") ? entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("currentlyTerraforming") : false;
		}

		private static boolean getSyncedIsTerraforming(Entity entity) {
			if (entity == null) return false;
			EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> acc = getEntityDataAccessor(entity, "isTerraforming");
			if (acc != null) {
				try { return entity.getEntityData().get(acc); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
			return entity.getPersistentData().contains("isTerraforming") ? entity.getPersistentData().getBoolean("isTerraforming") : false;
		}

		@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
		private static <T> EntityDataAccessor<T> getEntityDataAccessor(Entity entity, String paramName) {
			if (entity == null || paramName == null) return null;
			String key = entity.getClass().getName() + ":" + paramName;
			Field field = SYNCED_DATA_FIELD_CACHE.get(key);
			if (field == null) {
				Class<?> cur = entity.getClass();
				while (cur != null && cur != Object.class) {
					for (Field f : cur.getDeclaredFields()) {
						if (EntityDataAccessor.class.isAssignableFrom(f.getType()) && (f.getName().equalsIgnoreCase("DATA_" + paramName) || f.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(paramName) || f.getName().toLowerCase().contains(paramName.toLowerCase()))) {
							f.setAccessible(true);
							SYNCED_DATA_FIELD_CACHE.put(key, f);
							field = f;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (field != null) break;
					cur = cur.getSuperclass();
				}
			}
			if (field != null) {
				try { return (EntityDataAccessor<T>) field.get(null); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static final double FANCY_RADIUS = 1.65;
		private static final double FANCY_HALO_RADIUS = FANCY_RADIUS * 1.5;
		private static final double[][] FANCY_CIRCLE = makeFancyCircle();
		private static final int[][] FANCY_BOX_FACES = {
			{3, 2, 1, 0}, {6, 7, 4, 5}, {7, 3, 0, 4},
			{2, 6, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 5, 4}, {7, 6, 2, 3}
		};

		private static double[][] makeFancyCircle() {
			double[][] circle = new double[65][2];
			for (int side = 0; side <= 64; side++) {
				double angle = side * Math.PI * 2.0 / 64;
				circle[side][0] = Math.cos(angle);
				circle[side][1] = Math.sin(angle);
			}
			return circle;
		}

		private static void renderFancyBeam(PoseStack poseStack, MultiBufferSource.BufferSource buffers, Vec3 origin, Vec3 camera,
				double height, double time, double density, double opacity, int cycle) {
			if (height <= 0.0) return;
			RenderType material = VerdantEngineGravityBeamShaders.ClientShaders.renderType(isShaderActive(), getBeamTexture());
			if (height >= 65535.0) material = VerdantEngineGravityBeamShaders.ClientShaders.renderType(true, getBeamTexture());
			float fade = (float) Mth.clamp(opacity, 0.1, 1.0);
			poseStack.pushPose();
			try {
				poseStack.translate(origin.x - camera.x, origin.y - camera.y, origin.z - camera.z);
				if (VerdantEngineGravityBeamShaders.ClientShaders.isAnalytic(material)) {
					// One bounded volume, 24 vertices: the shader evaluates Shooting Star's cylinder and air glow.
					VertexConsumer vertices = buffers.getBuffer(material);
					org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poseStack.last().pose();
					int clock = (int) (time * 16.0) & 0xFFFFFF;
					int wholeHeight = (int) height;
					int fractionalHeight = (int) Math.round((height - wholeHeight) * 65535.0);
					for (int[] face : FANCY_BOX_FACES) {
						for (int corner : face) {
							int nx = (corner & 1) == 0 ? -1 : 1;
							int nz = (corner & 2) == 0 ? -1 : 1;
							// Corners 2/3 and 6/7 follow the perimeter in the opposite X order.
							if ((corner & 2) != 0) nx = -nx;
							double down = corner < 4 ? 0.0 : height;
							// Custom-only vertex payload: RGB = clock, UV2 = height, normal = box corner.
							vertices.addVertex(matrix, (float) (nx * FANCY_HALO_RADIUS), (float) -down, (float) (nz * FANCY_HALO_RADIUS))
								.setColor((clock >>> 16) & 255, (clock >>> 8) & 255, clock & 255, (int) (fade * 255.0f))
								.setUv((float) FANCY_HALO_RADIUS, (float) down).setUv2(wholeHeight, fractionalHeight)
								.setNormal(nx, 0.0f, nz);
						}
					}
				} else {
					// External shader packs use ordinary white, full-bright vertices and vanilla materials.
					RenderType coreMaterial = isShaderActive() ? VerdantEngineGravityBeamShaders.ClientShaders.shaderPackRenderType(WHITE_TEXTURE) : getGlowRenderType(WHITE_TEXTURE);
					VertexConsumer core = buffers.getBuffer(coreMaterial);
					double dx = camera.x - origin.x, dz = camera.z - origin.z;
					double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
					int stride = distance < 48.0 ? 1 : distance < 128.0 ? 2 : 4;
					fancyColumn(poseStack, core, height, FANCY_RADIUS, 1.0f, stride);
					fancyCap(poseStack, core, 0.0, FANCY_RADIUS, 1.0f, stride);
					fancyCap(poseStack, core, -height, FANCY_RADIUS, 1.0f, stride);
					buffers.endBatch(coreMaterial);
					VertexConsumer vertices = buffers.getBuffer(material);
					double cy = camera.y - origin.y;
					// Closed, world-aligned volumes with true chord opacity; no camera-facing planes.
					for (int layer = FANCY_VOLUME_RADII.length - 1; layer >= 0; layer--) {
						fancyVolume(poseStack, vertices, height, FANCY_RADIUS * FANCY_VOLUME_RADII[layer], FANCY_VOLUME_DENSITY[layer],
							dx, cy, dz, fade, time, stride);
					}
				}
			} finally {
				poseStack.popPose();
			}
			buffers.endBatch(material);
		}

		private static final double[] FANCY_VOLUME_RADII = { 1.10, 1.25, 1.40, 1.50 };
		private static final double[] FANCY_VOLUME_DENSITY = { 0.40, 0.28, 0.22, 0.20 };
		private static final int[] FANCY_ALPHA_A = new int[65];
		private static final int[] FANCY_ALPHA_B = new int[65];
		private static final double[] FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS = new double[5];

		private static void fancyVolume(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, double height, double radius, double extinction,
				double cx, double cy, double cz, float fade, double time, int stride) {
			org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poses.last().pose();
			boolean inside = cx * cx + cz * cz < radius * radius && cy <= 0.0 && cy >= -height;
			boolean sidesVisible = inside || cx * cx + cz * cz > radius * radius;
			int[] previous = FANCY_ALPHA_A, next = FANCY_ALPHA_B;
			float scroll = (float) (-time * 0.025);
			// Keep a slice at the camera's height: endpoint-only interpolation over-brightens views from inside tall beams.
			double closest = Mth.clamp(cy, -height, 0.0);
			double span = Math.max(radius * 2.0, Math.sqrt(cx * cx + cz * cz));
			FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[0] = 0.0;
			FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[1] = Mth.clamp(closest + span, -height, 0.0);
			FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[2] = closest;
			FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[3] = Mth.clamp(closest - span, -height, 0.0);
			FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[4] = -height;
			int rows = 1;
			for (int i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
				if (FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[rows - 1] - FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[i] > 1.0e-8) FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[rows++] = FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[i];
			}
			for (int row = 0; sidesVisible && row < rows; row++) {
				double y = FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[row];
				for (int side = 0; side <= 64; side += stride) {
					next[side] = fancyVolumeAlpha(FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius,
						cx, cy, cz, height, radius, extinction, fade, false);
				}
				if (row > 0) {
					double y0 = FANCY_VOLUME_ROWS[row - 1];
					float v0 = (float) (-y0 * 0.1) + scroll, v1 = (float) (-y * 0.1) + scroll;
					for (int side = 0; side < 64; side += stride) {
						double nx = (FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] + FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0]) * 0.5;
						double nz = (FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] + FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1]) * 0.5;
						// Submit the entry surface outside the volume, or the exit surface inside it, never both.
						if (!inside && nx * cx + nz * cz <= radius * (nx * nx + nz * nz)) continue;
						float u0 = side / 64.0f, u1 = (side + stride) / 64.0f;
						fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, y0, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius, u0, v0, previous[side]);
						fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, y0, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius, u1, v0, previous[side + stride]);
						fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius, u1, v1, next[side + stride]);
						fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius, u0, v1, next[side]);
					}
				}
				int[] swap = previous; previous = next; next = swap;
			}
			for (int cap = 0; cap < 2; cap++) {
				double y = cap == 0 ? 0.0 : -height;
				if (!inside && (cap == 0 ? cy <= 0.0 : cy >= -height)) continue;
				int center = fancyVolumeAlpha(0.0, y, 0.0, cx, cy, cz, height, radius, extinction, fade, true);
				for (int side = 0; side < 64; side += stride) {
					int a = fancyVolumeAlpha(FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius,
						cx, cy, cz, height, radius, extinction, fade, true);
					int b = fancyVolumeAlpha(FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius,
						cx, cy, cz, height, radius, extinction, fade, true);
					fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, 0.0, y, 0.0, 0.5f, 0.5f, center);
					fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius, side / 64.0f, 0.5f, a);
					fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius, (side + stride) / 64.0f, 0.5f, b);
					fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, 0.0, y, 0.0, 0.5f, 0.5f, center);
				}
			}
		}

		private static int fancyVolumeAlpha(double x, double y, double z, double cx, double cy, double cz,
				double height, double radius, double extinction, float fade, boolean clipCaps) {
			// Cylinder chord gives a soft silhouette; finite cap chords handle axial views without flattening the sides.
			double dx = x - cx, dy = y - cy, dz = z - cz;
			double length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
			if (length < 1.0e-8) return 0;
			dx /= length; dy /= length; dz /= length;
			double near = 0.0, far = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
			double a = dx * dx + dz * dz;
			if (a < 1.0e-12) {
				if (cx * cx + cz * cz > radius * radius) return 0;
			} else {
				double b = cx * dx + cz * dz;
				double discriminant = b * b - a * (cx * cx + cz * cz - radius * radius);
				if (discriminant <= 0.0) return 0;
				double root = Math.sqrt(discriminant);
				near = Math.max(0.0, (-b - root) / a);
				far = (-b + root) / a;
			}
			if (clipCaps && Math.abs(dy) < 1.0e-10) {
				if (cy > 0.0 || cy < -height) return 0;
			} else if (clipCaps) {
				double t0 = -cy / dy, t1 = (-height - cy) / dy;
				near = Math.max(near, Math.min(t0, t1));
				far = Math.min(far, Math.max(t0, t1));
			}
			double chord = Math.max(0.0, far - near);
			double alpha = -Math.expm1(-extinction * chord / (radius * 2.0)) * fade;
			// Keep interior boundaries above common shader-pack alpha cutoffs; otherwise interpolation reveals triangle-shaped holes.
			if (cx * cx + cz * cz < radius * radius && cy <= 0.0 && cy >= -height) alpha = Math.max(alpha, 0.13 * fade);
			return Mth.clamp((int) Math.round(alpha * 255.0), 0, 254);
		}

		private static void fancyColumn(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, double height, double radius, float alpha, int stride) {
			org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poses.last().pose();
			int a = Mth.clamp((int) (alpha * 255.0f), 0, 255);
			for (int side = 0; side < 64; side += stride) {
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, 0.0, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius, 0.5f, 0.0f, a);
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, 0.0, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius, 0.5f, 0.0f, a);
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, -height, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius, 0.5f, 1.0f, a);
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, -height, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius, 0.5f, 1.0f, a);
			}
		}

		private static void fancyCap(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, double y, double radius, float alpha, int stride) {
			org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poses.last().pose();
			int a = (int) (alpha * 255.0f);
			for (int side = 0; side < 64; side += stride) {
				// NO_CULL vanilla materials make a single fan visible from either side.
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, 0.0, y, 0.0, 0.5f, 0.0f, a);
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * radius, 0.5f, 0.0f, a);
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * radius, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * radius, 0.5f, 0.0f, a);
				fancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, 0.0, y, 0.0, 0.5f, 0.0f, a);
			}
		}

		private static void fancyVertex(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, org.joml.Matrix4f matrix,
				double x, double y, double z, float u, float v, int alpha) {
			vertices.addVertex(matrix, (float) x, (float) y, (float) z).setColor(255, 255, 255, alpha)
				.setUv(u, v).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY)
				.setLight(15728880).setNormal(poses.last(), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
		}


		private static void renderFirstFancyBeam(PoseStack poseStack, MultiBufferSource.BufferSource buffers, Vec3 origin, Vec3 camera,
				double height, double time, double density, double opacity, int cycle) {
			RenderType material = VerdantEngineGravityBeamShaders.ClientShaders.firstRenderType(isShaderActive(), getBeamTexture());
			VertexConsumer vertices = buffers.getBuffer(material);
			double axisY = Mth.clamp(camera.y, origin.y - height, origin.y);
			double distanceSq = camera.distanceToSqr(new Vec3(origin.x, axisY, origin.z));
			boolean detailed = distanceSq < 128.0 * 128.0;
			int sides = distanceSq < 48.0 * 48.0 ? 64 : detailed ? 32 : 16;
			double charge = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, density));
			float fade = (float) Math.max(0.1, Math.min(1.0, opacity));
			poseStack.pushPose();
			try {
				poseStack.translate(origin.x - camera.x, origin.y - camera.y, origin.z - camera.z);
				// The white core remains readable without bloom; wider low-alpha shells supply a soft halo.
				firstFancyColumn(poseStack, vertices, height, 1.65, 0.88f * fade, time, sides);
				firstFancyColumn(poseStack, vertices, height, 1.85, 0.14f * fade, -time * 0.7, sides);
				firstFancyColumn(poseStack, vertices, height, 2.00 + charge * 0.03, 0.065f * fade, time * 0.4, sides);
				firstFancyColumn(poseStack, vertices, height, 2.12 + charge * 0.03, 0.035f * fade, -time * 0.3, sides);
				firstFancyColumn(poseStack, vertices, height, 2.25 + charge * 0.025, 0.018f * fade, time * 0.2, sides);

				int strands = detailed ? 6 : 3;
				int steps = Math.max(detailed ? 48 : 20, Math.min(sides == 64 ? 96 : detailed ? 48 : 24, (int) Math.ceil(height / 1.5)));
				for (int strand = 0; strand < strands; strand++) {
					double phase = strand * Math.PI * 2.0 / strands + time * 0.025;
					for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
						double t0 = (double) step / steps;
						double t1 = (double) (step + 1) / steps;
						double a0 = phase + t0 * Math.PI * 10.0;
						double a1 = phase + t1 * Math.PI * 10.0;
						double radius = 1.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(time * 0.035 + strand) + charge * 0.08;
						double width = 0.045 + charge * 0.035;
						firstFancyQuad(poseStack, vertices,
							Math.cos(a0 - width) * radius, -height * t0, Math.sin(a0 - width) * radius,
							Math.cos(a0 + width) * radius, -height * t0, Math.sin(a0 + width) * radius,
							Math.cos(a1 + width) * radius, -height * t1, Math.sin(a1 + width) * radius,
							Math.cos(a1 - width) * radius, -height * t1, Math.sin(a1 - width) * radius,
							0.78f * fade, 0.0f, 1.0f, (float) (t0 * 8.0 - time * 0.03), (float) (t1 * 8.0 - time * 0.03));
					}
				}

				// Cosmetic flow stays visible between charge windows; gameplay clocks are unchanged.
				boolean charging = cycle >= 160 && cycle < 240;
				double progress = charging ? Math.min(1.0, (cycle - 160 + time - Math.floor(time)) / 80.0) : 0.0;
				double travel = charging ? progress * 0.8 + Math.pow(progress, 4.2) * 1.8 : time * 0.010;
				for (int ring = 0; ring < 3; ring++) {
					double phase = (travel + ring / 3.0) % 1.0;
					float alpha = (float) (Math.min(1.0, phase * 10.0) * Math.min(1.0, (1.0 - phase) * 10.0)) * fade;
					double y = -phase * height;
					double radius = 2.29 + 0.035 * Math.sin(time * 0.04 + ring);
					double tube = Math.min(0.055, height * 0.02);
					firstFancyTorus(poseStack, vertices, y, radius, tube, alpha * (charging ? 0.95f : 0.72f), time, sides);
					firstFancyAnnulus(poseStack, vertices, y, radius - 0.12, radius + 0.12, alpha * 0.18f, time, sides);
				}

				// Impact ripples occupy the space outside the bright core, above the ground endpoint.
				double contactY = Math.min(-0.001, -height + 0.12);
				firstFancyAnnulus(poseStack, vertices, contactY, 1.70, 2.46, 0.12f * fade, time, sides);
				for (int ring = 0; ring < 3; ring++) {
					double phase = (time * 0.018 + ring / 3.0) % 1.0;
					double radius = 1.76 + phase * 0.58;
					float alpha = (float) (Math.min(1.0, phase * 8.0) * Math.pow(1.0 - phase, 0.65) * (0.80 + charge * 0.15)) * fade;
					firstFancyTorus(poseStack, vertices, contactY, radius, Math.min(0.045, height * 0.02), alpha, -time, sides);
					firstFancyAnnulus(poseStack, vertices, contactY, radius - 0.11, radius + 0.11, alpha * 0.20f, time, sides);
				}
			} finally {
				poseStack.popPose();
			}
			buffers.endBatch(material);
		}

		private static final double[][] FIRST_FANCY_TUBE = makeFirstFancyTube();

		private static double[][] makeFirstFancyTube() {
			double[][] circle = new double[7][2];
			for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
				circle[i][0] = Math.cos(i * Math.PI / 3.0);
				circle[i][1] = Math.sin(i * Math.PI / 3.0);
			}
			return circle;
		}

		private static void firstFancyTorus(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, double y, double radius, double tube,
				float alpha, double time, int sides) {
			int stride = 64 / sides;
			int tubeStride = sides == 64 ? 1 : 2;
			for (int side = 0; side < 64; side += stride) {
				for (int segment = 0; segment < 6; segment += tubeStride) {
					double r0 = radius + tube * FIRST_FANCY_TUBE[segment][0];
					double r1 = radius + tube * FIRST_FANCY_TUBE[segment + tubeStride][0];
					double y0 = y + tube * FIRST_FANCY_TUBE[segment][1];
					double y1 = y + tube * FIRST_FANCY_TUBE[segment + tubeStride][1];
					firstFancyQuad(poses, vertices,
						FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * r0, y0, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * r0,
						FANCY_CIRCLE[side][0] * r1, y1, FANCY_CIRCLE[side][1] * r1,
						FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * r1, y1, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * r1,
						FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][0] * r0, y0, FANCY_CIRCLE[side + stride][1] * r0,
						alpha, segment / 6.0f, (segment + tubeStride) / 6.0f,
						(float) (side / 32.0 - time * 0.025), (float) ((side + stride) / 32.0 - time * 0.025));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void firstFancyColumn(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, double height, double radius, float alpha, double time, int sides) {
			float scroll = (float) (time * 0.018);
			for (int side = 0; side < sides; side++) {
				int index = side * 64 / sides;
				int next = (side + 1) * 64 / sides;
				firstFancyQuad(poses, vertices,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[index][0] * radius, 0.0, FANCY_CIRCLE[index][1] * radius,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[next][0] * radius, 0.0, FANCY_CIRCLE[next][1] * radius,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[next][0] * radius, -height, FANCY_CIRCLE[next][1] * radius,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[index][0] * radius, -height, FANCY_CIRCLE[index][1] * radius,
					alpha, 0.40f, 0.60f, scroll, (float) (height * 0.20) + scroll);
			}
		}

		private static void firstFancyAnnulus(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, double y, double inner, double outer, float alpha, double time, int sides) {
			for (int side = 0; side < sides; side++) {
				int index = side * 64 / sides;
				int next = (side + 1) * 64 / sides;
				firstFancyQuad(poses, vertices,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[index][0] * inner, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[index][1] * inner,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[index][0] * outer, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[index][1] * outer,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[next][0] * outer, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[next][1] * outer,
					FANCY_CIRCLE[next][0] * inner, y, FANCY_CIRCLE[next][1] * inner,
					alpha, 0.0f, 1.0f, (float) (side * 0.125 + time * 0.01), (float) ((side + 1) * 0.125 + time * 0.01));
			}
		}

		private static void firstFancyQuad(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices,
				double ax, double ay, double az, double bx, double by, double bz,
				double cx, double cy, double cz, double dx, double dy, double dz,
				float alpha, float u0, float u1, float v0, float v1) {
			org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poses.last().pose();
			int a = Mth.clamp((int) (alpha * 255.0f), 0, 255);
			// No-cull materials display both sides without submitting the same face twice.
			firstFancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, ax, ay, az, u0, v0, a);
			firstFancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, bx, by, bz, u1, v0, a);
			firstFancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, cx, cy, cz, u1, v1, a);
			firstFancyVertex(poses, vertices, matrix, dx, dy, dz, u0, v1, a);
		}

		private static void firstFancyVertex(PoseStack poses, VertexConsumer vertices, org.joml.Matrix4f matrix,
				double x, double y, double z, float u, float v, int alpha) {
			vertices.addVertex(matrix, (float) x, (float) y, (float) z).setColor(255, 255, 255, alpha)
				.setUv(u, v).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY)
				.setLight(15728880).setNormal(poses.last(), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
		}


		private static void renderDoubleSidedCylinder(PoseStack poseStack, MultiBufferSource bufferSource, ResourceLocation texture,
													  long gameTimeSpin, int height, int color, float rOuter) {
			VertexConsumer builder = bufferSource.getBuffer(getGlowRenderType(texture));
			org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poseStack.last().pose();

			float r = (float) ((color >> 16) & 255) / 255.0f;
			float g = (float) ((color >> 8) & 255) / 255.0f;
			float b = (float) (color & 255) / 255.0f;
			float a = (float) ((color >> 24) & 255) / 255.0f;

			int slices = 4;
			double angleStep = 2.0 * Math.PI / slices;
			double angleOffset = Math.PI / 4.0;

			for (int slice = 0; slice < slices; slice++) {
				double a0 = slice * angleStep + angleOffset;
				double a1 = (slice + 1) * angleStep + angleOffset;

				float cos0 = (float) Math.cos(a0);
				float sin0 = (float) Math.sin(a0);
				float cos1 = (float) Math.cos(a1);
				float sin1 = (float) Math.sin(a1);

				float x0 = cos0 * rOuter, z0 = sin0 * rOuter;
				float x1 = cos1 * rOuter, z1 = sin1 * rOuter;

				float u0 = (float) slice / slices;
				float u1 = (float) (slice + 1) / slices;
				float scroll = (float) (-gameTimeSpin * 0.05f);
				float v0 = scroll;
				float v1 = (float) height + scroll;

				addDoubleSidedVerticalQuad(matrix, poseStack, builder,
					x0, 0.0f, z0,
					x1, 0.0f, z1,
					x1, (float) height, z1,
					x0, (float) height, z0,
					u0, u1, v0, v1,
					r, g, b, a);
			}
		}

		private static void addDoubleSidedVerticalQuad(org.joml.Matrix4f matrix, PoseStack poseStack, VertexConsumer builder,
													   float x0, float y0, float z0,
													   float x1, float y1, float z1,
													   float x2, float y2, float z2,
													   float x3, float y3, float z3,
													   float u0, float u1, float v0, float v1,
													   float r, float g, float b, float a) {
			// Front Face (CCW)
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x0, y0, z0).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u0, v0).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x1, y1, z1).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u1, v0).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x2, y2, z2).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u1, v1).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x3, y3, z3).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u0, v1).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);

			// Back Face (CW)
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x3, y3, z3).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u0, v1).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x2, y2, z2).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u1, v1).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x1, y1, z1).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u1, v0).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x0, y0, z0).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(u0, v0).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), 0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f);
		}

		private static void renderSquareOnionRing(PoseStack poseStack, VertexConsumer builder,
												 float inR, float outR, float r, float g, float b, float a) {
			org.joml.Matrix4f matrix = poseStack.last().pose();

			// Segment 1 (North)
			addDoubleSidedQuad(matrix, poseStack, builder,
					-outR, 0.0f, -outR,
					-inR, 0.0f, -inR,
					inR, 0.0f, -inR,
					outR, 0.0f, -outR,
					0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, r, g, b, a);

			// Segment 2 (East)
			addDoubleSidedQuad(matrix, poseStack, builder,
					outR, 0.0f, -outR,
					inR, 0.0f, -inR,
					inR, 0.0f, inR,
					outR, 0.0f, inR,
					0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, r, g, b, a);

			// Segment 3 (South)
			addDoubleSidedQuad(matrix, poseStack, builder,
					outR, 0.0f, inR,
					inR, 0.0f, inR,
					-inR, 0.0f, inR,
					-outR, 0.0f, inR,
					0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, r, g, b, a);

			// Segment 4 (West)
			addDoubleSidedQuad(matrix, poseStack, builder,
					-outR, 0.0f, inR,
					-inR, 0.0f, inR,
					-inR, 0.0f, -inR,
					-outR, 0.0f, -outR,
					0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, r, g, b, a);
		}

		private static void addDoubleSidedQuad(org.joml.Matrix4f matrix, PoseStack poseStack, VertexConsumer builder,
											   float x0, float y0, float z0,
											   float x1, float y1, float z1,
											   float x2, float y2, float z2,
											   float x3, float y3, float z3,
											   float nx, float ny, float nz,
											   float r, float g, float b, float a) {
			// Front Face
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x0, y0, z0).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(0.0f, 0.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), nx, ny, nz);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x1, y1, z1).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(1.0f, 0.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), nx, ny, nz);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x2, y2, z2).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(1.0f, 1.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), nx, ny, nz);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x3, y3, z3).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(0.0f, 1.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), nx, ny, nz);

			// Back Face
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x3, y3, z3).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(0.0f, 1.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), -nx, -ny, -nz);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x2, y2, z2).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(1.0f, 1.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), -nx, -ny, -nz);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x1, y1, z1).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(1.0f, 0.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), -nx, -ny, -nz);
			builder.addVertex(matrix, x0, y0, z0).setColor(r, g, b, a).setUv(0.0f, 0.0f).setOverlay(net.minecraft.client.renderer.texture.OverlayTexture.NO_OVERLAY).setLight(15728880).setNormal(poseStack.last(), -nx, -ny, -nz);
		}

		private static double findClientGroundBelow(Level level, double x, double z, double fromY) {
			int floorX = Mth.floor(x);
			int floorZ = Mth.floor(z);
			int startY = Mth.floor(fromY);
			if (startY > level.getMaxBuildHeight()) {
				startY = level.getMaxBuildHeight();
			}
			BlockPos.MutableBlockPos pos = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos(floorX, startY, floorZ);
			double highestLeafY = -999.0;
			while (pos.getY() > level.getMinBuildHeight()) {
				BlockState state = level.getBlockState(pos);
				if (!state.isAir() && !state.getCollisionShape(level, pos).isEmpty()) {
					boolean isLeafOrFoliage = state.is(BlockTags.LEAVES) || state.is(BlockTags.FLOWERS) || state.is(BlockTags.SAPLINGS) || state.is(BlockTags.CROPS)
						|| state.getBlock() == Blocks.SHORT_GRASS || state.getBlock() == Blocks.TALL_GRASS || state.getBlock() == Blocks.FERN || state.getBlock() == Blocks.LARGE_FERN
						|| state.getBlock() == Blocks.DEAD_BUSH || state.getBlock() == Blocks.VINE || state.getBlock() == Blocks.HANGING_ROOTS || state.getBlock() == Blocks.MOSS_CARPET;
					if (isLeafOrFoliage) {
						if (highestLeafY < -900.0) {
							highestLeafY = pos.getY() + 1.0;
						}
					} else {
						// Found solid ground!
						return pos.getY() + 1.0;
					}
				}
				pos.move(0, -1, 0);
			}
			if (highestLeafY > -900.0) {
				return highestLeafY;
			}
			return level.getMinBuildHeight() + 1.0;
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void onRenderLevelStage(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
			if (!MASTER_ENABLED) return;
			if (event.getStage() != net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_ENTITIES) return;

			net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
			if (mc.level == null) return;

			MultiBufferSource.BufferSource bufferSource = mc.renderBuffers().bufferSource();

			for (Entity entity : mc.level.entitiesForRendering()) {
				if (!(entity instanceof LivingEntity livingEntity)) continue;
				if (!isVerdantEngine(livingEntity)) continue;

				// Disable frustum culling safely via reflection
				setNoCulling(livingEntity);

				boolean isCharging = getSyncedIsTerraforming(livingEntity);
				boolean isActive = getSyncedCurrentlyTerraforming(livingEntity);

				if (isCharging) {
					ClientRenderState clientState = CLIENT_STATES.computeIfAbsent(livingEntity.getId(), id -> new ClientRenderState(0));
					clientState.update(livingEntity, (int) livingEntity.level().getGameTime(), isCharging, isActive);
					continue;
				}

				if (!isActive) {
					CLIENT_STATES.remove(livingEntity.getId());
					continue;
				}

				ClientRenderState clientState = CLIENT_STATES.computeIfAbsent(livingEntity.getId(), id -> new ClientRenderState(40));
				Level level = livingEntity.level();
				long gameTime = level.getGameTime();
				clientState.update(livingEntity, (int) gameTime, isCharging, isActive);

				if (clientState.beamActiveTicks < 40) {
					continue;
				}

				float partialTicks = event.getPartialTick().getGameTimeDeltaPartialTick(true);

				double entityX = Mth.lerp(partialTicks, livingEntity.xo, livingEntity.getX());
				double entityY = Mth.lerp(partialTicks, livingEntity.yo, livingEntity.getY());
				double entityZ = Mth.lerp(partialTicks, livingEntity.zo, livingEntity.getZ());

				double beamStartYOffset = 0.0;
				double coreY = entityY + livingEntity.getBbHeight() * 0.5 + beamStartYOffset;
				Vec3 origin = new Vec3(entityX, coreY, entityZ);

				double groundY = clientState.groundY;
				if (groundY <= level.getMinBuildHeight()) {
					groundY = findClientGroundBelow(level, origin.x, origin.z, origin.y);
				}

				double h = origin.y - groundY;
				if (h <= 0) continue;

				PoseStack poseStack = event.getPoseStack();

				int cycle = clientState.currentCycle;
				int decayTicks = clientState.decayTicks;

				double densityFactor = 0.0;
				if (cycle >= 160 && cycle < 240) {
					double chargeProg = (double) (cycle - 160) / (240 - 160);
					densityFactor = chargeProg * chargeProg * (3.0 - 2.0 * chargeProg);
				} else if (decayTicks > 0) {
					double decayProg = (double) decayTicks / 50.0;
					densityFactor = decayProg * decayProg * (3.0 - 2.0 * decayProg);
				}

				if (FANCY_BEAM) {
					Vec3 fancyCamera = mc.gameRenderer.getMainCamera().getPosition();
					double visualTime = (gameTime % 120000L) + partialTicks;
					if (FIRST_FANCY_BEAM) renderFirstFancyBeam(poseStack, bufferSource, origin, fancyCamera, h, visualTime, densityFactor, clientState.opacityMultiplier, cycle);
					else renderFancyBeam(poseStack, bufferSource, origin, fancyCamera, h, visualTime, densityFactor, clientState.opacityMultiplier, cycle);
					continue;
				}

				poseStack.pushPose();

				Vec3 camPos = mc.gameRenderer.getMainCamera().getPosition();
				double renderStartX = origin.x - camPos.x;
				double renderStartY = origin.y - camPos.y;
				double renderStartZ = origin.z - camPos.z;
				poseStack.translate(renderStartX, renderStartY, renderStartZ);

				Quaternionf rot = new Quaternionf().rotationTo(0, 1, 0, 0, -1, 0);
				poseStack.mulPose(rot);

				int height = (int) Math.ceil(h);
				if (height < 1) height = 1;
				float scaleY = (float) (h / (double) height);
				poseStack.scale(1.0f, scaleY, 1.0f);

				float widthFactor = 1.0f;

				double currentTargetOpacity = 0.75;
				if (cycle >= 160 && cycle < 240) {
					double chargeProg = (double) (cycle - 160) / (240 - 160);
					currentTargetOpacity = 0.75 + 0.20 * chargeProg;
				} else if (decayTicks > 0) {
					double progress = 1.0 - ((double) decayTicks / 50.0);
					double easeOutQuart = 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - progress, 4.0);
					currentTargetOpacity = 0.95 - 0.20 * easeOutQuart;
				}

				int coreA = Mth.clamp((int) (255 * currentTargetOpacity * clientState.opacityMultiplier), 0, 255);
				int coreColor = (coreA << 24) | (255 << 16) | (255 << 8) | 255;
				float coreRadius = 1.944f * widthFactor;
				renderDoubleSidedCylinder(poseStack, bufferSource, getBeamTexture(), (long) (gameTime * 0.2), height, coreColor, coreRadius);

				int coronaA = Mth.clamp((int) ((130 + 125 * densityFactor) * (currentTargetOpacity / 0.95) * clientState.opacityMultiplier), 0, 255);
				int coronaColor = (coronaA << 24) | (255 << 16) | (255 << 8) | 255;
				float outerRadius = 3.0f * widthFactor;
				renderDoubleSidedCylinder(poseStack, bufferSource, getBeamTexture(), (long) (-gameTime * 0.2), height, coronaColor, outerRadius);

				poseStack.popPose();

				if (cycle >= 160 && cycle < 240) {
					double cycleProgress = Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, ((double) (cycle - 160) + partialTicks) / 80.0));
					double ringTravel = cycleProgress * 0.8 + Math.pow(cycleProgress, 4.2) * 1.8;
					double chargeProg = (double) (cycle - 160) / (240 - 160);

					double corePulse = (ringTravel * 2.0) % 1.0;
					double coreRingR = (3.0 * 0.45) + corePulse * (3.0 * 0.5);
					float coreInR = (float) (coreRingR - 0.22);
					float coreOutR = (float) (coreRingR + 0.22);

					VertexConsumer builder = bufferSource.getBuffer(getGlowRenderType(getBeamTexture()));
					poseStack.pushPose();
					poseStack.translate(origin.x - camPos.x, origin.y - camPos.y, origin.z - camPos.z);
					poseStack.mulPose(new Quaternionf().rotationY((float) (ringTravel * Math.PI * 1.5)));
					renderSquareOnionRing(poseStack, builder, coreInR, coreOutR, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, (float) (0.90 * clientState.opacityMultiplier));
					poseStack.popPose();

					int totalTiers = 3;
					for (int tier = 0; tier < totalTiers; tier++) {
						double phase = (ringTravel + (tier / (double) totalTiers)) % 1.0;
						double ringY = origin.y - phase * h;

						double targetInR = (3.0 * 0.45) + (1.0 - phase) * (3.0 * 0.55);
						double birthProgress = Math.min(1.0, phase * 5.0);
						// Form in a manner of easeOutQuart strictly
						double easeOutQuartScale = 1.0 - Math.pow(1.0 - birthProgress, 4.0);

						double inR = targetInR * easeOutQuartScale;
						double outR = (targetInR + 0.45) * easeOutQuartScale;

						// Decay quickly at end of travel in a manner of easeOutExpo strictly
						double ringAlpha = 0.90;
						if (phase > 0.8) {
							double endProgress = (phase - 0.8) * 5.0;
							ringAlpha *= (endProgress >= 1.0) ? 0.0 : Math.pow(2.0, -10.0 * endProgress);
						}

						poseStack.pushPose();
						double ringRenderY = ringY - camPos.y;
						poseStack.translate(origin.x - camPos.x, ringRenderY, origin.z - camPos.z);
						poseStack.mulPose(new Quaternionf().rotationY((float) ((ringTravel + tier * 0.3) * Math.PI * 1.5)));

						VertexConsumer ringBuilder = bufferSource.getBuffer(getGlowRenderType(getBeamTexture()));
						renderSquareOnionRing(poseStack, ringBuilder, (float) inR, (float) outR, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, (float) (ringAlpha * clientState.opacityMultiplier));

						if (chargeProg > 0.45) {
							double midR = (inR + outR) * 0.5;
							poseStack.mulPose(new Quaternionf().rotationY((float) (-ringTravel * Math.PI * 2.0)));
							renderSquareOnionRing(poseStack, ringBuilder, (float) (midR - 0.15), (float) (midR + 0.15), 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, (float) (ringAlpha * clientState.opacityMultiplier));
						}
						poseStack.popPose();
					}
				}
			}
			bufferSource.endBatch(RenderType.entityTranslucent(getBeamTexture()));
			bufferSource.endBatch(RenderType.beaconBeam(getBeamTexture(), false));
			bufferSource.endBatch(RenderType.beaconBeam(getBeamTexture(), true));
		}
	}
 // 1.21.1
}

	public static boolean ENABLE_AUTO_SHADER_GEN = true;
	private static boolean generated;
	private static final org.slf4j.Logger LOGGER = com.mojang.logging.LogUtils.getLogger();
	static { autoGenerateShaderAssets(); }

	/** Development-only: installed jars have no matching workspace source tree and write nothing. */
	public static synchronized void autoGenerateShaderAssets() {
		if (!ENABLE_AUTO_SHADER_GEN || generated) return;
		java.nio.file.Path candidate = java.nio.file.Path.of(System.getProperty("user.dir")).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
		for (int parent = 0; parent < 3 && candidate != null; parent++, candidate = candidate.getParent()) {
			java.nio.file.Path source = candidate.resolve("src/main/java/net/mcreator/thebackwoods/VerdantEngineGravityBeamShaders.java");
			java.nio.file.Path resources = candidate.resolve("src/main/resources");
			if (!java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(source) || !java.nio.file.Files.isDirectory(resources)) continue;
			try {
				writeAssets(resources.resolve("assets/the_backwoods"));
				java.nio.file.Path output = candidate.resolve("build/resources/main");
				if (java.nio.file.Files.isDirectory(output)) writeAssets(output.resolve("assets/the_backwoods"));
				generated = true;
				LOGGER.info("Generated Verdant gravity beam shader assets in {}", resources);
			} catch (java.io.IOException exception) {
				LOGGER.error("Could not generate Verdant gravity beam shader assets", exception);
			}
			return;
		}
	}

	private static void writeAssets(java.nio.file.Path assets) throws java.io.IOException {
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam.vsh"), vertexSource().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam.fsh"), fragmentSource().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam.json"), shaderDefinition().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
		writePlasmaTextures(assets);
		writeFirstAssets(assets);
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam_analytic_v2.marker"), new byte[] { 2 });
	}

	private static void writeFirstAssets(java.nio.file.Path assets) throws java.io.IOException {
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam_first.vsh"), firstVertexSource().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam_first.fsh"), firstFragmentSource().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam_first.json"), firstShaderDefinition().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
		java.awt.image.BufferedImage texture = new java.awt.image.BufferedImage(128, 256, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
		for (int y = 0; y < texture.getHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < texture.getWidth(); x++) {
				double u = (x + 0.5) / texture.getWidth();
				double v = (double) y / texture.getHeight();
				double edge = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * u), 1.5);
				double flow = 0.0, amplitude = 0.5;
				for (int octave = 0; octave < 3; octave++) {
					double scale = 1 << octave;
					flow += amplitude * laserVolumeNoise(u * 32.0 * scale, v * 32.0 * scale);
					amplitude *= 0.5;
				}
				double streak = 0.50 + 0.50 * flow / 0.875;
				int alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, (int) (255.0 * edge * streak)));
				texture.setRGB(x, y, (alpha << 24) | 0xFFFFFF);
			}
		}
		java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream image = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
		if (!javax.imageio.ImageIO.write(texture, "png", image)) throw new java.io.IOException("PNG encoder unavailable");
		writeIfChanged(assets.resolve("textures/effect/verdant_gravity_beam.png"), image.toByteArray());
	}

	private static String firstVertexSource() {
		return """
#version 150

in vec3 Position;
in vec4 Color;
in vec2 UV0;

uniform mat4 ModelViewMat;
uniform mat4 ProjMat;

out vec4 vertexColor;
out vec2 texCoord0;

void main() {
    gl_Position = ProjMat * ModelViewMat * vec4(Position, 1.0);

    vertexColor = Color;
    texCoord0 = UV0;
}

			""";
	}


	private static String firstFragmentSource() {
		return """
#version 150

#moj_import <fog.glsl>

uniform sampler2D Sampler0;

uniform mat4 ProjMat;
uniform vec4 ColorModulator;
uniform float FogStart;
uniform float FogEnd;
uniform vec4 FogColor;

in vec4 vertexColor;
in vec2 texCoord0;

out vec4 fragColor;

void main() {
    vec4 color = texture(Sampler0, texCoord0);
    float plasma = 0.88 + 0.12 * sin(texCoord0.y * 6.2831853 + sin(texCoord0.x * 37.699112) * 0.8);
    float filament = 0.92 + 0.08 * sin(texCoord0.x * 125.66371 + texCoord0.y * 3.1415927);
    color = vec4(vec3(1.0), color.a * vertexColor.a * ColorModulator.a * plasma * filament);
    if (color.a < 0.002) discard;
    float fragmentDistance = -ProjMat[3].z / ((gl_FragCoord.z) * -2.0 + 1.0 - ProjMat[2].z);
    fragColor = linear_fog(color, fragmentDistance, FogStart, FogEnd, FogColor);
}

			""";
	}

	private static void writePlasmaTextures(java.nio.file.Path assets) throws java.io.IOException {
		// Shooting Star's smooth value-noise lattice, cached once instead of hashing every fragment.
		java.awt.image.BufferedImage noise = new java.awt.image.BufferedImage(258, 258, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
		for (int y = -1; y <= 256; y++) {
			for (int x = -1; x <= 256; x++) {
				int value = (int) Math.round(laserLattice(x & 255, y & 255) * 255.0);
				noise.setRGB(x + 1, y + 1, 0xFF000000 | (value << 16) | (value << 8) | value);
			}
		}
		writePng(assets.resolve("textures/effect/verdant_plasma_noise.png"), noise);

		// A periodic cylindrical energy texture; opacity belongs to the 3D chord, not a flat image profile.
		java.awt.image.BufferedImage texture = new java.awt.image.BufferedImage(128, 256, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
		for (int x = 0; x < texture.getWidth(); x++) {
			double angle = x * Math.PI * 2.0 / texture.getWidth();
			double px = Math.cos(angle) * 6.0, py = Math.sin(angle) * 6.0;
			for (int y = 0; y < texture.getHeight(); y++) {
				double flow = 0.0, amplitude = 0.5, scale = 1.0;
				for (int octave = 0; octave < 3; octave++) {
					flow += amplitude * laserVolumeNoise(px * scale, (py + y / 8.0) * scale);
					scale *= 2.0; amplitude *= 0.5;
				}
				int alpha = (int) Math.round(255.0 * (0.86 + 0.14 * flow / 0.875));
				texture.setRGB(x, y, (alpha << 24) | 0xFFFFFF);
			}
		}
		writePng(assets.resolve("textures/effect/verdant_gravity_beam_volume.png"), texture);
	}

	private static double laserLattice(int x, int y) {
		// hash12 from Shooting Star's common.glsl; wrapping is supplied by the padded texture.
		double px = x * 0.1031 - Math.floor(x * 0.1031);
		double py = y * 0.1031 - Math.floor(y * 0.1031);
		double pz = px;
		double d = px * (py + 33.33) + py * (pz + 33.33) + pz * (px + 33.33);
		double value = (px + py + d * 2.0) * (pz + d);
		return value - Math.floor(value);
	}

	private static double laserVolumeNoise(double x, double y) {
		int ix = (int) Math.floor(x), iy = (int) Math.floor(y);
		double fx = x - ix, fy = y - iy;
		fx *= fx * (3.0 - 2.0 * fx); fy *= fy * (3.0 - 2.0 * fy);
		double a = laserLattice(ix & 31, iy & 31) * (1.0 - fx) + laserLattice((ix + 1) & 31, iy & 31) * fx;
		double b = laserLattice(ix & 31, (iy + 1) & 31) * (1.0 - fx) + laserLattice((ix + 1) & 31, (iy + 1) & 31) * fx;
		return a * (1.0 - fy) + b * fy;
	}

	private static void writePng(java.nio.file.Path path, java.awt.image.BufferedImage texture) throws java.io.IOException {
		java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream image = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
		if (!javax.imageio.ImageIO.write(texture, "png", image)) throw new java.io.IOException("PNG encoder unavailable");
		writeIfChanged(path, image.toByteArray());
	}

	private static void writeIfChanged(java.nio.file.Path path, byte[] content) throws java.io.IOException {
		if (java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(path) && java.util.Arrays.equals(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(path), content)) return;
		java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
		java.nio.file.Files.write(path, content);
	}

	private static String vertexSource() {
		return """
#version 150

uniform mat4 ModelViewMat;
uniform mat4 ProjMat;

in vec3 Position;
in vec4 Color;
in vec2 UV0;
in ivec2 UV2;
in vec3 Normal;

out vec3 beamPosition;
flat out vec3 beamTop;
flat out float beamHeight;
flat out float beamTime;
flat out float beamExtent;
out vec4 vertexColor;

void main() {
    gl_Position = ProjMat * ModelViewMat * vec4(Position, 1.0);
    beamPosition = Position;
    beamTop = Position - vec3(Normal.x, 0.0, Normal.z) * UV0.x + vec3(0.0, UV0.y, 0.0);
    ivec2 height = UV2 & ivec2(65535);
    beamHeight = float(height.x) + float(height.y) / 65535.0;
    vec3 clock = floor(Color.rgb * 255.0 + 0.5);
    beamTime = dot(clock, vec3(65536.0, 256.0, 1.0)) / 320.0;
    beamExtent = UV0.x;
    vertexColor = Color;
}

			""";
	}

	private static String fragmentSource() {
		return """
#version 150

#moj_import <fog.glsl>

uniform mat4 ModelViewMat;
uniform mat4 ProjMat;
uniform vec4 ColorModulator;
uniform float FogStart;
uniform float FogEnd;
uniform vec4 FogColor;

uniform sampler2D Sampler0;
uniform sampler2D Sampler1;

in vec3 beamPosition;
flat in vec3 beamTop;
flat in float beamHeight;
flat in float beamTime;
flat in float beamExtent;
in vec4 vertexColor;

out vec4 fragColor;

// Beam formulas adapted from Shooting Star's star_beam.fsh and common.glsl, recolored white.
// The bounded proxy replaces its full-screen scene pass; no depth-buffer copy or raymarch is needed.
float vnoise2(vec2 p) {
    vec2 cell = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p);
    f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    // Padded periodic lattice: one filtered fetch replaces four procedural hash evaluations.
    return texture(Sampler1, (mod(cell, 256.0) + f + 1.5) / 258.0).r;
}

float fbm2(vec2 p, float footprint) {
    float v = 0.0, a = 0.5;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        // Unresolved octaves contribute their mean instead of shimmering at long distances.
        v += a * mix(vnoise2(p), 0.5, smoothstep(0.5, 1.5, footprint));
        if (footprint >= 1.5) {
            v += 0.5 * a * (1.0 - exp2(float(i - 4)));
            break;
        }
        p = p * 2.03 + vec2(17.1, 9.2);
        footprint *= 2.03;
        a *= 0.5;
    }
    return v;
}

bool rayCylinderY(vec3 rd, vec3 top, float height, float radius, out float t0, out float t1) {
    vec2 o = -top.xz;
    float a = dot(rd.xz, rd.xz);
    t0 = 0.0; t1 = 1e20;
    if (a < 1e-8) {
        if (dot(o, o) > radius * radius) return false;
    } else {
        float b = dot(o, rd.xz);
        float h = b * b - a * (dot(o, o) - radius * radius);
        if (h < 0.0) return false;
        h = sqrt(h);
        t0 = max((-b - h) / a, 0.0);
        t1 = (-b + h) / a;
    }
    if (abs(rd.y) < 1e-6) {
        if (top.y < 0.0 || top.y - height > 0.0) return false;
    } else {
        float cap0 = top.y / rd.y;
        float cap1 = (top.y - height) / rd.y;
        t0 = max(t0, min(cap0, cap1));
        t1 = min(t1, max(cap0, cap1));
    }
    return t1 > t0;
}

void main() {
    bool inside = all(lessThan(abs(beamTop.xz), vec2(beamExtent)))
        && beamTop.y >= 0.0 && beamTop.y - beamHeight <= 0.0;
    if (gl_FrontFacing == inside) discard;
    vec3 rd = normalize(beamPosition);
    float rayFootprint = length(fwidth(rd));
    float R = beamExtent / 1.5;
    float nearOuter, farOuter;
    // Same radii and extinction as FANCY_VOLUME_RADII / FANCY_VOLUME_DENSITY in the mesh renderer.
    if (!rayCylinderY(rd, beamTop, beamHeight, R * 1.50, nearOuter, farOuter)) discard;
    float nearCore, farCore;
    vec4 color;
    float drawT;
    if (rayCylinderY(rd, beamTop, beamHeight, R, nearCore, farCore)) {
        color = vec4(vec3(1.0), ColorModulator.a);
        drawT = max(nearCore, 0.001);
    } else {
        const float radii[3] = float[3](1.10, 1.25, 1.40);
        const float density[3] = float[3](0.40, 0.28, 0.22);
        float opticalDepth = 0.20 * (farOuter - nearOuter) / (R * 3.0);
        bool insideHeight = beamTop.y >= 0.0 && beamTop.y - beamHeight <= 0.0;
        // Match the mesh's 0.13 minimum interior opacity (-log(1 - 0.13)).
        if (insideHeight && dot(beamTop.xz, beamTop.xz) < R * R * 2.25) opticalDepth = max(opticalDepth, 0.139262);
        for (int layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
            float t0, t1;
            float radius = R * radii[layer];
            if (rayCylinderY(rd, beamTop, beamHeight, radius, t0, t1)) {
                float depth = density[layer] * (t1 - t0) / (radius * 2.0);
                if (insideHeight && dot(beamTop.xz, beamTop.xz) < radius * radius) depth = max(depth, 0.139262);
                opticalDepth += depth;
            }
        }
        vec3 enter = rd * nearOuter - beamTop;
        float angle = atan(enter.z, enter.x + 1e-6);
        vec2 uv = vec2(angle / 6.2831853, -enter.y * 0.1 - beamTime * 0.5);
        float flow = texture(Sampler0, uv).a;
        float footprint = max(rayFootprint * max(nearOuter, 1.0), 1e-4);
        float grain = fbm2(vec2(angle * 10.0, -enter.y * 0.016 + beamTime * 4.16), footprint);
        opticalDepth *= flow * (0.97 + 0.03 * grain);
        color = vec4(vec3(1.0), (1.0 - exp(-opticalDepth)) * vertexColor.a * ColorModulator.a);
        drawT = max(nearOuter, 0.001);
    }
    if (color.a < 0.002) discard;
    vec4 viewPoint = ModelViewMat * vec4(rd * drawT, 1.0);
    vec4 clip = ProjMat * viewPoint;
    gl_FragDepth = clamp(clip.z / clip.w * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
    float fragmentDistance = length(viewPoint.xyz);
    fragColor = linear_fog(color, fragmentDistance, FogStart, FogEnd, FogColor);
}

			""";
	}

	@EventBusSubscriber(modid = "the_backwoods", value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD)
	public static class ClientShaders {
		private static final net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation TEXTURE = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/effect/verdant_gravity_beam_volume.png");
		private static final net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation LAYOUT = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam_analytic_v2.marker");
		private static net.minecraft.client.renderer.ShaderInstance shader;
		private static net.minecraft.client.renderer.ShaderInstance firstShader;

		private static final net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation NOISE_TEXTURE = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/effect/verdant_plasma_noise.png");
		private static final net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation FIRST_TEXTURE = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:textures/effect/verdant_gravity_beam.png");
		private static boolean firstTextureAvailable;
		private static long nextTextureCheck;
		private static boolean noiseAvailable;
		private static boolean textureAvailable;

		private static net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation texture(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation fallback) {
			long now = System.nanoTime();
			if (nextTextureCheck == 0L || now - nextTextureCheck >= 0L) {
				// Old generated shaders/textures use a different vertex layout; fall back until the new set is loaded.
				textureAvailable = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(LAYOUT).isPresent()
					&& net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(TEXTURE).isPresent();
				firstTextureAvailable = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(FIRST_TEXTURE).isPresent();
				noiseAvailable = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().getResourceManager().getResource(NOISE_TEXTURE).isPresent();
				nextTextureCheck = now + 1_000_000_000L;
			}
			return textureAvailable ? TEXTURE : fallback;
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void registerShaders(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterShadersEvent event) {
			autoGenerateShaderAssets();
			shader = null;
			nextTextureCheck = 0L;
			var location = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:verdant_gravity_beam");
			if (event.getResourceProvider().getResource(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam.json")).isEmpty()) return;
			try {
				event.registerShader(new net.minecraft.client.renderer.ShaderInstance(event.getResourceProvider(), location,
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.BLOCK), loaded -> shader = loaded);
			} catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException exception) {
				LOGGER.warn("Verdant beam shader unavailable; retaining vanilla beam materials", exception);
			}
		}

		@SubscribeEvent
		public static void registerFirstShaders(net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterShadersEvent event) {
			autoGenerateShaderAssets();
			firstShader = null;
			nextTextureCheck = 0L;
			var location = net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:verdant_gravity_beam_first");
			if (event.getResourceProvider().getResource(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse("the_backwoods:shaders/core/verdant_gravity_beam_first.json")).isEmpty()) return;
			try {
				event.registerShader(new net.minecraft.client.renderer.ShaderInstance(event.getResourceProvider(), location,
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.BLOCK), loaded -> firstShader = loaded);
			} catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException exception) {
				LOGGER.warn("Verdant beam shader unavailable; retaining vanilla beam materials", exception);
			}
		}

		private static net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType analyticMaterial;

		public static boolean isAnalytic(net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType material) {
			return material == analyticMaterial;
		}

		public static boolean hasLaserTexture() {
			return textureAvailable;
		}

		public static net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType firstRenderType(boolean shaderPackActive, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation fallback) {
			texture(fallback);
			var texture = firstTextureAvailable ? FIRST_TEXTURE : fallback;
			if (!shaderPackActive && firstShader != null && firstTextureAvailable) return FirstType.MATERIAL;
			return shaderPackActive ? shaderPackRenderType(texture) : net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.beaconBeam(texture, true);
		}

		public static net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType renderType(boolean shaderPackActive, net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation fallback) {
			var texture = texture(fallback);
			if (!shaderPackActive && shader != null && noiseAvailable && texture.equals(TEXTURE)) return analyticMaterial = FancyType.MATERIAL;
			return shaderPackActive ? shaderPackRenderType(texture)
				: net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType.beaconBeam(texture, true);
		}

		public static net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType shaderPackRenderType(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation texture) {
			return ShaderPackType.MATERIALS.apply(texture);
		}

		private static class ShaderPackType extends net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType {
			private ShaderPackType() {
				super("verdant_beam_translucent", com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_TEX_COLOR,
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, 1536, false, true, () -> {}, () -> {});
			}
			// The vanilla textured-color shader maps to gbuffers_textured, not the pack's solid entity fallback.
			private static final java.util.function.Function<net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation, net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType> MATERIALS = net.minecraft.Util.memoize(texture -> create(
				"verdant_beam_translucent", com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_TEX_COLOR,
				com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, 1536, false, true,
				CompositeState.builder().setShaderState(new ShaderStateShard(net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer::getPositionTexColorShader))
					.setTextureState(new TextureStateShard(texture, true, false)).setTransparencyState(TRANSLUCENT_TRANSPARENCY)
					.setDepthTestState(LEQUAL_DEPTH_TEST).setWriteMaskState(COLOR_WRITE).setCullState(NO_CULL).createCompositeState(false)));
		}

		private static class FancyType extends net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType {
			private FancyType() {
				super("verdant_gravity_beam", com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.BLOCK,
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, 1536, false, true, () -> {}, () -> {});
			}
			private static final net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType MATERIAL = create("verdant_gravity_beam",
				com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.BLOCK, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, 1536, false, true,
				CompositeState.builder().setShaderState(new ShaderStateShard(() -> shader))
					.setTextureState(MultiTextureStateShard.builder().add(TEXTURE, true, false).add(NOISE_TEXTURE, true, false).build()).setTransparencyState(TRANSLUCENT_TRANSPARENCY)
					.setWriteMaskState(COLOR_WRITE).setCullState(NO_CULL).createCompositeState(false));
		}

		private static class FirstType extends net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType {
			private FirstType() {
				super("verdant_gravity_beam_first", com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.BLOCK,
					com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, 1536, false, true, () -> {}, () -> {});
			}
			private static final net.minecraft.client.renderer.RenderType MATERIAL = create("verdant_gravity_beam_first",
				com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.BLOCK, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, 1536, false, true,
				CompositeState.builder().setShaderState(new ShaderStateShard(() -> firstShader))
					.setTextureState(new TextureStateShard(FIRST_TEXTURE, true, false)).setTransparencyState(TRANSLUCENT_TRANSPARENCY)
					.setWriteMaskState(COLOR_WRITE).setCullState(NO_CULL).createCompositeState(false));

		if (level == null) return false;
		String id = level.dimension().location().toString().toLowerCase();
		return !id.contains("the_backwoods") && !id.contains("backwood");
	}
